prathamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
kalyāṇāni dadātu vo gaṇapatir yasminn atuṣṭe sati
kṣodoyasy api karmaṇi prabhavituṃ brahmāpi jihyāyate |
jāte taccaraṇapraṇāmasulabhe saubhāgyabhāgyodaye
raṅgasyāṅkam anaṅkuśā niviśate devendralakṣmīr api || 1 ||
śaśvat puṇyahiraṇyagarbharasanāsiṃhāsanādhyāsinau
seyaṃ vāg adhidevatā vitaratu śreyāṃsi bhūyāṃsi vaḥ |
yatpādāmalakomalāṅgulinakhajyotsnābhir udvelitaḥ
śabdabrahmasudhāmbudhirvvyudhamanasyucchṛṅkhalaṃ khelati || 2 ||
rāgaḥ kṛṣṇa navastabaśrutir iyaṃ cetaścamatkāriṇī
mugdhebesya yathā mayā śubharate vaidagdhām āviṣkṛtam |
jānīte dayitaiva sā śubharate yad yad vidhatte bhavan
ity ukto madhujin niruttaramukhaḥ śliṣyan priyāṃ pātu vaḥ || 3 ||
saṃsakto dharaṇīdhareśvarabhuvi krīḍan bhṛgāṅkānana-
śreṇīm ākalayan guṇānvayamilat pañcānanakhyātimān || 4 ||
atha dānapraśamā tāvad abhidhīyate | tatra vyāsaḥ |
[5]        varṇānām āśramāṇāṃ ca cāturvarṇye yudhiṣṭhira |
dānadharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā devena bhāṣitam ||
nandipurāṇe |
dānaṃ paraṃ praśaṃsanti dānam eva parāyaṇam |
dānaṃ bandhur manuṣyāṇāṃ dānaṃ koṣo hy anuttamam ||
dānaṃ tantraḥ paraṃ dravyaṃ dānaṃ mātrā pitā yathā |
dānena na vinā kiṃcit prārthitaṃ phalam āpyate ||
api vālāgramātrasya tulā tasya na vidyate |
na dānaśīlinām pat tasmād dānaṃ samāśrayet ||
hāranūpurasaṃghoṣapūritottamamandiraḥ |
lāvaṇyaguṇasaṃpattir dānād eva hi labhyate ||
saurapurāṇe |
na dānād adhikaṃ kiṃcid dṛśyate bhuvanatraye |
dānena prāpyate svargaḥ śrīr dānenaiva labhyate ||
dānena śatrūn jayati vyādhir dānena naśyati |
dānena labhyate vidyā dānena yuvatījanaḥ ||
dharmārthamāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ||
uśanā |
dānād ṛte nopacāro vidyate dhanino ‘paraḥ |
dīyamānaṃ hi tat tasya bhūya evābhivardhate ||
āha vedavysaḥ |
yad dadāsi viśiṣṭebhyo yac cāśnāsi dine dine |
tat te vittama ahaṃ manye śeṣaṃ kasyāpi rakṣati ||
yad dadāti yad aśnāti tad eva dhanino dhanaṃ |
anye mṛtasya krīḍanti dārair api dhanair api ||
[6]   bṛhaspatiḥ |
tapo dharmaḥ kṛtayuge jñānaṃ tretāyuge smṛtam |
dvāpare cādhvarāḥ proktāḥ kalau dānaṃ dayā damaḥ ||
atrārthe śatapathaśrutiḥ |
tad etat trayaṃ śikṣet damaṃ dānaṃ dayām iti |
dānena bhogī bhavati medhāvī vṛddhasevayā ||
ahiṃsayā ca dīrghāyur iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
yamaḥ |
yatīnāṃ tu śamo dharmas tv anāhāro vanaukasām |
dānam eva gṛhasthānāṃ śuśrūṣā brahmacāriṇām ||
pāpakarmasamāyuktaṃ patantaṃ narake naram |
trāyate dānam ekaṃ tu pātrabhūte dvije kṛtam ||
tathā nyāyenārjanam arthāṇāṃ vardhanaṃ cābhirakṣaṇam |
satpātrapratipattiś ca sarvaśāstreṣu paṭhyate ||
kūrmapurāṇam |
dānadharmāt paro dharmo bhūtānāṃ neha vidyate |
tasmād viprāya dātavyaṃ śrotriyāya dvijātibhiḥ ||
dvijātibhir ity upalakṣṇṃ dānasya sarvasādhāraṇatvāt | mahābhārate |
āyāsaśatalabdhasya prāṇebhyo ‘pi garīyasaḥ |
gatir ekaiva vittasya dānam anyā vipattayaḥ ||
brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya yo dadyād artham arthine |
nidadhāti nidhiś ceṣṭaṃ pāralaukikam ātmanaḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
na hi dānāt parataram anyad astīti me matiḥ |
dhanadhānyavataḥ kiṃcid ahāryaṃ rājataskaraiḥ ||
vahnipurāṇe |
tapaḥsu caiva tīrtheṣu vrateṣu niyameṣu ca |
samyak cīrṇeṣu viprarṣe paścād dānaṃ samācaret ||
[7]        yasya vittaṃ na dānāya nopabhogāya dehinām |
nāpi kīrtye na dharmāya tasya vittaṃ nirardhakam ||
tasmād dattaṃ samāsādya daivād vā pauruṣādayaḥ |
dadyāt samyag dvijātibhyaḥ kīrtanāni ca kārayet ||
vyāsaḥ |
ahany ahani yācantam ahaṃ manye guruṃ yathā |
mārjanaṃ darpaṇasyaiva yaḥ karoti dine dine ||
kiṃ dhanena kariṣyanti dehino bhaṅgurāśrayāḥ |
yadarthaṃ dhanam icchanti taccharīram aśāśvatam ||
yadi nāma na dharmyāya na kāmāya na kīrtaye |
yat parityajya gantavyaṃ tad dhanaṃ kiṃna dīyate ||
icchānurūpo vibhravaḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati |
adātā puruṣas tyāgī dhanaṃ saṃtyajya gacchati ||
dātāraṃ kṛpaṇaṃ manye mṛto ‘py arthaṃ na muñcati |
manuḥ |
dānadharmaṃ niṣeveta nityam aiṣṭikapaurtikam |
parituṣṭena bhāvena pātram āsādya śaktitaḥ ||
iṣṭe yajñe yad dīyate dakṣiṇādi tad aiṣṭikaṃ |
bahirvedi ca yad dānaṃ dīyat tat pūrtikam ||
yat kiṃcid api dātavyaṃ yācitenānasūyayā |
utpatsyate hi tat pātraṃ yat tārayati sarvataḥ ||
svargāyurbhūtikāmena tathā pāpopaśāntaye |
mumukṣuṇā ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyas tathānvaham ||
viṇḍudharmāt |
na dadāti ca dānāni modhaṃ tasya dhanārjanam |
[8]        uptyāyoptyāya dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira ||
vahnipurāṇe |
annaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ śākam udapātraṃ tapodhanāḥ |
dānaṃ vibhavatodatvā narāḥ svaryyānti dharmiṇaḥ ||
tathā |
yad yajanti dadantoha bhogān bhuñjanti nityaśaḥ |
mām udiśya na te mūḍhā ihaiva sukhinaḥ pare ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
dātavyaṃ pratyahaṃ pātre nimitteṣu viśeṣataḥ |
yāvitenāpi dātavyaṃ śraddhāpūtaṃ tu śaiktitaḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
uktasarvaguṇopetam uktadoṣair vivarjitam |
kāmadhuk dhenuvad dānaṃ phalaty ātmepsitaṃ phalam ||
iha kīrtiṃ vadānyākhyāṃ sphītān bhogāṃs tripiṣṭape |
dānaṃ śraddhāṃ tṛtīye ‘pi janmani prabhavottame ||
vadānyo bahupradaḥ |
dānam eva paro dharmo dānam eva paraṃtapaḥ |
na hi dānāt parataram iha loke paratra ca ||
dānena bhogān āpnoti dānenāyuś ca vindati |
naraḥ svargāpavargau ca dānenaiva samaśnute ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
kuṭumbaṃ pīḍayitvāpi brāhmaṇāya mahātmane |
dātavyaṃ bhikṣave ‘nyannam (?) ātmano bhūtim icchatā ||
devalaḥ |
durlabhaṃ bhārate varṣe janma tasmān manuṣyatā |
mānuṣyād brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca durlabhaṃ sutarāṃ matam ||
vipratve sati duṣprāyā vidyādiguṇayogitā |
[9]        tatra nyāyārjitārthāptis tato bhaktyāptir iṣyate ||
labdhvaitad guṇasaṃyogaṃ tīrthaṃ pātraṃ ca parva ca |
dānāni ye prayacchanti kṛtārthās te narā bhuvi ||
agastyaḥ |
gobhir vipraiś ca vedaiś ca satībhiḥ satyavādibhiḥ |
alubdhair dānaśīlaiś ca saptabhir dāryate mahī ||
yair na bhuktaṃ na ca hutaṃ na tīrthe maraṇaṃ kṛtam |
hiraṇyam annam udakaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo na cārcitam ||
dīnā vivasanā rukṣāḥ kapālāṅkitapāṇayaḥ |
dṛśyante hi mahārāja jāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
viṣṇudharmāt |
sīdate dvijamukhyāya yo ‘rthine na prayacchati |
sāmarthye sati durbuddhir narakāyopapadyate ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
yas tu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā nārcayet brāhmaṇān surān |
sarvasvam apahṛtyainaṃ rājā rāṣṭrāt pravāsayet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
sadācārāḥ kulīnāś ca rūpavanta priyaṃvadāḥ |
bahuśrutāś ca dharmajñā yācamānāḥ parād gṛhāt ||
dṛśyante duḥkhinaḥ sarve prāṇinaḥ sarvadā mune |
adattadānāj jāyante parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
akṣaradvayam abhyastaṃ nāsti nāstīti yat purā |
tad idaṃ dehi dehīti viparītam upasthitam ||
skandapurāṇe |
bodhayanti na yācante dehīti kṛpaṇaṃ janāḥ |
avastheyam adānasya mā bhūd evaṃ bhavan api ||
[10]        dehīty evaṃ bruvann arthī janaṃ bodhayatīva saḥ |
yad idaṃ kaṣṭam arthitvaṃ prāgadānaphalaṃ hi tat ||
ekena tiṣṭhatādhastād anyenoparitiṣṭhatā |
dātṛyācakayor bhedaḥ karābhyām eva sūcitaḥ ||
dīyamānaṃ tu yo mohād goviprāgnisureṣu ca |
nivārayati pāpātmā tiryagyoniṃ vrajet tu saḥ ||
‘dīyamānaṃ’ taduddeśena tyajyamānam ity arthaḥ | śātātapaḥ |
mādadasveti yo brūyād gavy agnau brāhmaṇeṣu ca |
tiryagyoniśataṃ gatvā cāṇḍāleṣv abhijāyate ||
yamaḥ |
kanyāpradāne yajñe vā yasmin vā dharmasaṃkaṭe |
vighnam ācaret yas tu tam āhur brahmaghātakam ||
tasmād vibhūtim anvicchann adāne vighnam ācaret |
dadyād ahar ahaḥ pātre lokadvayajigīṣayā ||
māhābhārate |
arhatām anurūpāṇāṃ nādeyaṃ hy asti kiṃcana |
uccaiḥ sravasam apy aśvaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ satāṃ viduḥ ||
anunīya yathākāmaṃ satyasaṃdho mahāvrataḥ |
svaiḥ prāṇair brāhmaṇaḥ prāṇān paritrāya divaṃ gataḥ ||
ranteidevaś ca sāṅkṛtyo vaśiṣṭāya mahātmane |
apaḥ pradāya śītāś ca nākapṛṣṭham ito gataḥ ||
ātreyacandradamayor arhator vidhivad dhanam |
datvā lokān yayau dhīmān anantān sa mahīpatiḥ ||
śivirīśīnarāṅgāni putraṃ ca priyam auras am |
brāhmaṇārtham upākṛtya nākapṛṣṭham upāgataḥ ||
[11]        pratardanaḥ kāśapatiḥ pradāya nayane svake |
brāhmaṇāyātulāṃ kīrtim iha cāmutra cāśnute ||
divyaṃ mṛṣṭaśalākāṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ paramarddhi tat |
chatraṃ devamṛdho datvā sarāṣṭro ‘bhyapatad divam ||
mṛṣṭaśalākam ujjvalapañjaram |
saṅkṛtiś ca tathātreyaḥ śiṣyebhyo brahma nirguṇam |
upadiśya mahātejā gato lokān anuttamān ||
ambrīṣo gavor datvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pratāpavān |
arbudāni daśaikaṃ ca sarāṣṭro ‘bhyapatad divam ||
sāvitro kuṇḍale divye śarīraṃ janamejayaḥ |
ramyam āvasathāṃ caiva datvāmuṃ lokam āsthitaḥ ||
brāhmaṇārthe parityajya jagmatur lokam uttamam |
sarvaratnaṃ vṛṣā darbhā yuvāno ‘śvāḥ priyās trayaḥ ||
ramyam āvasathaṃ caiva datvāmuṃ lokam āsthitaḥ |
nimirāṣṭraṃ ca vaideho jāmadagnyo vasuṃdharām ||
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau cāpi gayaś corvīṃ sapattanām |
avarṣiṇi ca paryanye sarvabhūtāni cāsakṛt ||
rājā mitrasahaśraś ca vaśiṣṭhāya mahātmane |
madayantīṃ priyāṃ datvā tayā saha divaṃgtaḥ ||
sahasrajic ca rājarṣiḥ prāṇāniṣṭān mahāyaśāḥ |
brāhmaṇārthe parityajya gato lokān anuttamān ||
sarvakāmaiś ca saṃpūrṇaṃ dattvā veśmaṃ hiraṇmayam |
mudgalāya gataḥ svargaṃ śatadyanmo mahāmatiḥ ||
[12]        nāmnā ca dyutimān nāma śālvarājaḥ pratāpavān |
datvā rājyam ṛcīkāya gato lokān anuttamān ||
madirāśvaś ca rājarṣir datvā kanyāṃ sumadhyamām |
suvarṇahastāya gato lokān devair abhiṣṭutān ||
lomapādaś ca rājarṣiḥ sa tāṃ datvā sutāṃ prabhuḥ |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgāya vipulaiḥ sarvakāmair ayujyata ||
datvā śatasahasraṃ tu gavāṃ rājā prasenajit |
savatsānāṃ mahātejā gato lokān anuttamān ||
ete cānye ca bahavo dānena tapasā saha |
mahātmāno gatāḥ svargaṃ śiṣṭātmāno jitendriyāḥ ||
teṣāṃ pratiṣṭhitā kīrtir yāvat sthāsyati medinī |
dānayajñaprajāsargair eke hi divam āpnuyuḥ ||
dānena bhūtā vaśībhvanti dānena vairāny api yānti nāśam | paro ‘pi bandhutvam upaiti dānāt dānaṃ hi sarvavyasanāni hanti |
iti śrīmahārājādhirāja-śrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādiviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe dānapraśaṃsāprakaraṇam
[13]
dvitīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha dānasvarūpam upavarṇyate
prācām ācārabhājāṃ dhuram anusaratā yena mṛṣṭair viśiṣṭair
iṣṭāpūrtai raṇārhīkṛtakṛtinivahair viśvam āsthāṃ sameti |
so ‘sya hemādisūrir vividhabudhamanaś citramaitrīpavitraṃ
nānādānasvarūpaprakaraṇam adhunā vakti nirmuktadoṣaḥ ||
tatra devalaḥ |
arthānām udite pātre śraddhayā pratipādanam |
dāna mity abhinirdiṣṭaṃ vyākhyānaṃ tasy akathyate ||
udite śāstranirūpite | arthānāṃ pratipādanaṃ nāma pātraṃ prati**svāmibhāvāpādanaparyantas tyāgaḥ |
dvihetu ṣaḍadhiṣṭhānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ṣaḍvipākayuk |
catuḥprakāraṃ trividhaṃ trināśaṃ dānam ucyate ||
asya vivaraṇaṃ tenaivoktam | tatra dvihetv iti |
nālpatvaṃ vā bahutvaṃ vā dānasyābhyudayāvaham |
śraddhā bhaktiś ca dānānāṃ vṛddhikṣayakare smṛte ||
śraddhā āstikyabuddhiḥ | snehapūrvam abhidhyānaṃ bhaktiḥ | śaktir iti pāṭhe śāṅtir audāryam | ṣaḍ adhiṣṭhānam iti | ṣaḍ adhiṣṭhānāni āśrayāḥ nimittatvena yasya tat tathā | tāny āha |
dharmam arthaṃca kāmaṃ ca vrīḍāharṣabhayāni ca |
adhiṣṭhānāni dānānāṃ ṣaḍ etāni pracakṣate ||
[14] tāni vivinakti |
pātrebhyo dīyate nityam anapekṣya prayojanam |
kevalaṃ tyāgabuddhyā yad dharmadānaṃ tad ucyate ||
‘prayojanam anapekṣya’ dṛṣṭaphalānanusandhānenety arthaḥ |
prayojanam apekṣyaiva prasaṅgād yat pradīyate |
tad arthadānam ity āhur aihikaṃ phalahetukam ||
strīpānamṛgayākṣāṇāṃ prasaṅgād yat pradīyate |
anarheṣu ca rāgeṇa kāmadānaṃ tad ucyate ||
saṃsadi vrīḍyā stutyācāryo ‘rthibhyaḥ prayācitaḥ |
pradīyate ca tad dānaṃ vrīḍādānam iti smṛtam ||
dṛṣṭvā priyāṇi śrutvā vā harṣavad yad pradīyate |
harṣadānam iti prāhur dānaṃ tad dharmacintakāḥ ||
ākrośānarthahiṃsānāṃ pratīkārāya yad bhavet |
dīyate tāpakartṛbhyo bhayadānaṃ tad ucyate ||
ṣaḍaṅgam iti |
dātā pratigrahītā ca śraddhādeyaṃ ca dharmayuk |
deśakālau ca dānānām aṅgānyetāni ṣaḍ viduḥ ||
tāni vivṛṇoti |
apāparogī dharmātmā ditsur avyasanaḥ śuciḥ |
anindyājīvakarmā ca ṣaḍbir dātā praśasyate ||
apāparogī rājayakṣmādirogarahitiaḥ |
triśuktaḥ kṛśvṛttiś ca ghṛṇāluḥ sakalendriyaḥ |
vimukto yonidoṣebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ pātram ucyate ||
triśukta iti | trīṇi vidyānvayavṛttāni śuktāni viśuddhāni yasya sa tathā | ghṛṇāluḥ kṛpāluḥ | sakalendriyaḥ avikalendriyaḥ |
[15]        saumukhyādyatisaṃprītir arthināṃ darśane sadā |
satkṛtiś cānasūyā ca tadā śraddheti kīrtyate ||
aparābādham akleśaṃ prayatnenārjanaṃ danam |
svalpaṃ vā vipulaṃ vāpi deyam ity abhidhīyate ||
yad yatra durlabhaṃ bhadraṃ yasmin kale ‘pi vā punaḥ |
dānārhau deśakālau tau syātāṃ śreṣṭhau na tān yathā ||
avasthā deśakālānāṃ pātradātroś ca saṃpadā |
hīnaṃ vāpi bhavec chreṣṭhaṃṇ śreṣṭhaṃ vāpy anyathā bhavet ||
ṣaḍvipākatvm āha | duṣphalaṃ niṣphalaṃ hīnaṃ tulyaṃ vipulam akṣayam |
ṣaḍ vipākayug uddiṣṭaṃ ṣaḍ etāni vipākataḥ ||
tāni vyācaṣṭe |
nāstikastenhiṃsrebhyo jārāya patitāya ca |
piśunabhrūṇahatṛbhyāṃ pradattaṃ duṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
duṣphalaṃ virītaphalam |
mahad apy aphalaṃ dānaṃ śraddhayā parivarjitam |
parabādhākaraṃ dānaṃ param apy ūnatāṃ vrajet ||
niṣphalam apakṛṣṭaphalam | atyantāphalatve tu yad eva śraddhayā karoti tad eva vīryavattaraṃ bhavatītītarārtho ‘nupapannāh syāt phalavacanavipākaśabdavirodhaś ca | paraṃ śreṣṭham | ūnatvaṃ ca kiṃcinnyūnābhiprāyam | anyathā pūrveṇa paunaruktyaprasaṅgāt |
yathoktam api yad dattaṃ cittena kaluṣeṇa tu |
tat tu saṃkalpadoṣeṇa dānatulyaphalaṃ bhavet ||
yuktāṅgaiḥ sakalaiḥ ṣaḍbhir dānaṃ syāt vipulodayam |
[16]        anukrośavaśād dattaṃ dānam akṣayatāṃ vrajet ||
anukrośaḥ dayā | catuḥprakāram āha |
dhruvam ājasrikaṃ kāmyaṃ naimittikam iti kramāt |
vaidiko dānamārgo ‘yaṃ caturdhā varṇyate dvijaiḥ ||
prapārāmataḍāgādi sarvakāmaphalaṃ dhruvam |
tad ājasrikam ity āhur dīyate yad dine dine ||
apatyavijayaiśvaryastrībālārthaṃ yad iṣyate |
icchāsaṃsthaṃ tu tad dānaṃ kāmyam ity abhidhīyate ||
kālāpekṣaṃ kriyāpekṣam arthāpekṣam iti smṛtam |
tridhā naimittikaṃ proktaṃ sahomaṃ homavarjitam ||
traividhyam āha |
navottamāni catvāri madhyamāni vidhānataḥ |
adhamānīti śeṣāṇi trividhatvam idaṃ viduḥ ||
tad eva vivinakti |
amlaṃ dadhi madhutrāṇaṃ gobhūrukmāśvahastinaḥ |

adhamāny avaśiṣṭāni sarvadānāny ato viduḥ ||
bahuvārṣikaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi prāptaṃ purātanam iti yāvat | etenottamam api hastyaśvādi, jīrṇatāṃ prāptam adhamaṃ bhavati | [17] vināśatvam āha |

ahany ahani yat kiṃcid dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe ||
anuddiśya phalaṃ tat syāt brāhmaṇāya tu nityakam |
yat tu papopaśāntyarthaṃ dīyate viduṣāṃ kare ||
naimittikaṃ tad uddiṣṭaṃ dānaṃ sadbhir anuṣṭhitam |
pāpopaśāntyā iti niyatanimittopalakṣaṇam |

cetasā bhuktiyuktena dānaṃ tad vimalaṃ śivam ||
manuḥ |
yena yena hi bhāvena yad yad dānaṃ prayacchati |
tena tena hi bhāvena tat prāpnoti hi pūjitaḥ ||
“yena yena hi bhāvena” sātvikarājasādinā | tad uktaṃ bhagavadgītāsu |
dātavyam iti yad dānaṃ dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe |

yat tu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalam uddiśya vā punaḥ |
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ tad dānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
[18]        adeśakāle yad dānam apātrebhyaś ca dīyate |

bālye vā dāsabhāve vā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |

sātvikānāṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkte devatve nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
matsyapurāṇāt |
yeṣāṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ karma sātvikaṃ manujottama |

karmaṇā prāpyate loke rājasasya tathā phalam |
kṛcchreṇa karmaṇā viddhi tāmasasya tathā phalam ||
gāruḍapurāṇāt |

arhate yat suvarṇādidānaṃ tat kāyikaṃ matam ||
ārtānām abhayaṃ dadmīty etad vai vācikaṃ smṛtam |
vidyayā syād yayā yogi taddānaṃ mānasaṃ dvijāḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
asaddravyapradānam asvargyam | yac ca dattvā paritapyate tarhy adānam aphalam | yac copakāriṇe dadāti tanmātraṃ pariśiṣṭam | yac ca sopadhaṃ dadāti abhyācitam alpaphalam | yac cāpātrāya dadāti aniṣṭadānaṃ sravati | yac ca dattvā parikīrtyate yac ca smayadānam āsuraṃ | yac cāśraddhayā dadāti krodhād rākṣasaṃ | yac cākruśya dadāti dattvā ca krośati asatkṛtaṃ paiśācam | yac cāvajñātaṃ dadāti dattvā cāvajānīte mumūrṣos tāmasam | yac cāprākṛto dadāti | ete dānopasargā yair upasṛṣṭaṃ dānam asiddham asaṃbaddham asvargyam ayaśasyam adhruvam aphalaṃ vā |
tarhy adānaṃ tasminn eva saṃkalpakāle dīyamānadravyāsamarpaṇam | upakāriṇe pratyupakārasamīhayety arthaḥ | tanmātraṃ yāvad dattaṃ tāvanmātram | sopadhaṃ snehādyupādhisahitam | abhyācitaṃ lokapratipattyarthaṃ khyāpitam | aniṣṭadānaṃ śatrave dānam | smayadānaṃ mādṛśo 'nyo dātāstīty evaṃvidho bhāvaviśeṣaḥ smayaḥ, tena yaddānam | aprākṛtaḥ, mattādiḥ |[1] bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
mahādānāni vai vidyād atidānāni sarvadā |

śaṅkhaḥ |

agnihotraṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ vedānāṃ caiva pālanam |

ekāgnikādau yat karma tretāyāṃ yac ca hūyate |

śaṅkhaḥ |
rogiṇāṃ paricaryā ca pūrtam ity abhinirdiśet ||
vyāsaḥ |

annadānam athārāmāḥ pūrtam ity abhidhīyate ||
nāradaḥ |
grahoparāge yad dānaṃ sūryasaṃkramaṇeṣu ca |
dvādaśyādau tu yad dānaṃ tad etat pūrtam ucyate ||

tṛtīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha dānāṅganirūpaṇam —
tāni ca dravyakālaśraddhāsaṃjñakāni | tad uktaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
pratigrahītā dravyaṃ ca kālo deśaś ca pāvanaḥ |
śraddhā ca sātviko jñeyaṃ dānānām aṅgapañcakam ||
tatra pātranirūpaṇam | skandapurāṇe devīṃ prati īśvaravacanam |
śrutīnām ākarā hy ete ratnānām iva sāgarāḥ |
viprā viprādhipamukhe pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ||
viprādhipaḥ candraḥ tadvan mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā devīsaṃbodhanam etat |
yatra vedavido viprā na prāśnanty uttamaṃ haviḥ |
na tatra deva deveśi havir aśnanti karhicit ||
tathā ca taittirīyaśrutiḥ| “yāvatorvyai devata stāḥ sarvā vedavidi brāhmaṇe vasantītyādi” |
viyad ity ucyate vyoma prakāraḥ prāpaṇe smṛtaḥ |
divaṃ saṃprāpayantye (?) te dātṝn viprās tataḥ smrtāḥ ||
api nārāyaṇo ‘nanto brahma skando ‘nilaḥ śikhī |
tajjñānaṃ nābhinandanti yatra viprā na pūjitāḥ ||
yeṣāṃ prasādasulabham āyur dharmaḥ sukhaṃ dhanam |
śrīr yaśaḥ svargavāsaś ca tān viprān arcayed budhaḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare śrībhavān uvāca |
[22]        brāhmaṇaiḥ pūjitair nityaṃ pūjito ‘haṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
nirbhatsitaiś ca nirbhatsye tair ahaṃ sarvakarmasu ||
viprāḥ parā gatir mahyaṃ yas tān pūjayate nṛpa |
tam ahaṃ svena rūpeṇa prapaśyāmi yudhiṣṭhira ||
kāṇāḥ kuṇṭḥāś ca ṣaṇḍhāś ca daridrā vyādhitāś ca ye |
evaṃrūpāś ca ye viprāḥ paśya rūpaṃ mamaiva te ||
etat tu brāhmaṇajātimātrastutiparaṃ | yājñavalkyaḥ |
tapas taptvāsṛjad brahma brāhmaṇān vedaguptaye |
tṛptyarthaṃ pitṛdevānāṃ dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca ||
matsyaḥ |

nāsti viprāt paraḥ śatrur nāsti viprāt paro vidhiḥ ||
vahnipurāṇāt |
na jātir na kulaṃ rājan an svādhyāyaḥ śrutaṃ na ca |
kāraṇāni dvijatvasya vṛttam evat u kāraṇam ||
kiṃ kulaṃ vṛttahīnasya kariṣyati durātmanaḥ |
kṛmayaḥ kiṃ na jāyante kusumeṣu sugandhiṣu ||
naikam ekāntato grāhyaṃ paṭhanaṃ hi viśāmyate |
vṛttam anviṣyatāṃ tata rakṣobhiḥ kiṃ na paṭhyate ||
bahunā kim adhītena naṭasyeva durātmanaḥ |

kapālasthaṃ yathā toyaṃ svadate ca yathā payaḥ |
dūrṣyaṃ syāt sthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīnaṃ tathā śrutam ||
tasmād viddhi mahārāja vṛttaṃ brāhmaṇalakṣaṇam |
caturvedo ‘pi durvṛttaḥ (?) śūdrād alpataraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
[23]        satyaṃ damas tapo dānam ahiṃsendriyanigrahaḥ |
dṛśyante yatra rājendra sa brāhmaṇa iti smṛtaḥ ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
yaṃ na santaṃ na cāsantaṃ nāśrutaṃ na bahuśrutam |
na suvṛttaṃ na durvṛttaṃ veda kaścit sa brāhmaṇaḥ ||
san viśiṣṭaḥ, asan tadviparītaḥ | atra cātmotkarṣaprakāśanaṃ yon a karoti sa pātram iti tātparyam iti | yamaḥ |
ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam |

asaṃbhinnāryamaryādaḥ sa vai brāhmaṇa ucyate ||
āśiṣo ‘rthārthaṃ pūjāṃ ca prasaṅgān na karoti yaḥ |

yamaśātāpau |

baudhāyanaḥ |

[24] yamaḥ |

saṃvartaḥ |

padmapurāṇe |

dakṣaḥ |

anāgatāṃ tu ya pūrvāṃ sāditāṃ caiva paścimām |

brahmaṇabruvas tu purastād apātreṣu vyākhyāsyate | ācāryas tu mahābhārate |
adhyāpayet tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ kṛtopanayanaṃ dvijaḥ |
sarahasyaṃ ca sakalaṃ vedaṃ bharatasattama ||
tam ācāryaṃ mahābhāho pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
ekadeśaṃ tu vedasya vedāṅgāny api vā punaḥ ||
yo ‘dhyāpayati vṛttyartham upādhyāyaḥ sa ucyate |
niṣekādīni karmāṇi yaḥ karoti nṛpottama ||
saṃbhāvayati cānnena sa vipro gurur ucyate |
agnyādheyaṃ pākayajñān agniṣṭomādikaṃ yathā ||
yaḥ karoti vṛto nūnaṃ sat u syād ṛtvijo dvijaḥ ||
[29] yamaḥ |
samam abrāhmaṇe dānaṃ dviguṇaṃ brāhmaṇabruve |

prādhītaḥ prārabdhādhyayanaḥ |
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ āgatiṃ gatim |
vetti vidyām avidyāṃ ca sa bhaved vedapāragaḥ ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |

śrotriye caiva sāhasram ācārye dviguṇaṃ tataḥ |
ātmajñe śatsāhasram anantaṃ tv agnihotriṇi ||
viṣṇudharmottare |

śataghnaṃ tad vinirdiṣṭaṃ prādhīte lakṣasaṃmitam |
anantaṃca tad evoktaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage ||
eteṣu keṣāṃcid abrāhmaṇabrāḥmaṇabruvādīnām apātrāṇām api pātratvanirūpaṇaṃ mantravad gavādidānavyatiriktadānaviṣayam | mantrapūrvaṃ ca yad dānam apātrāya pradīyate dātur nikṛtya hastaṃ tadbhoktur jihvāṃ nikṛntati śātātapavacanāt |
uparudanti dātāraṃ gaur aśvaḥ kāñcanaṃ kṣitiḥ |

manuḥ |
sāntānikaṃ yakṣyamāṇam adhvagaṃ sārvavedasam |

navaitān snātakān vidyād brāhmaṇān dharmabhikṣukān |
sāntānikaḥ santānaprayojanavivāhārthīty arthaḥ | adhvagaḥ atra dharmārthaṃ pracalitaḥ | (sārvavedasaḥ) sarvasvadakṣiṇayajñakṛt | upatāpo vyādhipīḍitaḥ |
niḥsvebhyo deyam etebhyo dānaṃ vidyāviśeṣataḥ ||

itarebhyo bahirvedi kṛtānnaṃ tu vidhīyate ||
vidyāviśeṣata iti, alpavidyāya alpaṃ bahividyāya bahv ity arthaḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
subrāhmaṇaśrotriyavedapāragebhyo gurvarthaniveśauṣadhārthavṛttikṣīṇa-yakṣyamāṇādhyayanādhvasaṃyogavaiśvajiteṣu dravyavibhāgo yathāśakti kāryo bahirvedi bhikṣamāneṣu kṛtānnam itareṣu ||
niveśaḥ vivāhaḥ | vaiśvajitaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇayā kṛtaviśvajitdyāgaḥ | bahirvedigrahaṇād etebhyo bahirvedy api dhanam avaśyaṃ deyam anyebhyas tu antarvady eva dhanadānaniyamaḥ | bahirvidi tu kṛtānnasyaiva |

garbhastho ‘jñānabālo ‘pi bhuṅkte vṛddho na yauvane |
tad dattasyeha nāśo ‘sti sarvathā ripusūdana ||
tadīyaphalam iti śeṣaḥ | viṣṇudharmāt |
parasthāne vṛthā dānaṃ sadoṣaṃ parikīrtitam |
ārūḍhapatite caiva anyāyāt tair dhanaiś ca yat ||
vyarthaṃ hi brāhmaṇe dānaṃ patite taskare tathā |
guroś cāprītijanake kṛtaghne grāmayājake ||
vedavikrāyake caiva yasya copapatir gṛhe |
strībhir jiteṣu yad dattaṃ vyālagrāhe tathaiva ca ||
brahmabandhau ca yad dattaṃ yad dattaṃ vṛṣalīpatau |
paricārake ca yad dattaṃ vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa ||
mahābhārate |
paṅgvandhabadhirā mūkā vyādhinopahatāś ca ye |
bhartavyās te mahārāja na tu deyaḥ pratigrahaḥ ||
iti pratigrahītṛnirūpaṇam |
atha dravyākhyaṃ dānāṅgam ucyate —
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yad yad iṣṭaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca nyāyaprāptaṃ ca yad bhavet |
tat tad guṇavate deyam ity etad dānalakṣaṇam ||
vahnipurāṇe |
subhopāttena yat kiṃcit karoti laghunā naraḥ |
anantaṃ phalam āpnoti mudgalo ‘pi yathā purā ||
subhopāttena nyāyopārjitena | laghunā svalpena dravyeṇeti śeṣaḥ |
devīpurāṇe |
nyāyato yāni prāptāni śākāny api nṛpottama |
tāni deyāni devyās tu kanyakāyoṣitāṃ sadā ||
tadbhukteṣu ca vipreṣu apareṣu ca nityaśaḥ ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ loke yac cāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe |
tat tad guṇavate deyaṃ tad evākṣayam icchatā ||
mahābhārate |
viśeṣato mahārāja tasya nyāyārjitasya ca |
śraddhayā vidhivat pātre dattasyānto na vidyate ||
gautamaḥ: “svāmī ṛkthakrayasaṃvibhāgaparigrahādhigameṣu brāhmaṇasyādhikaṃ labdhaṃ kṣatriyasya vijitaṃ nirviṣṭaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ” iti | apratibandhaḥ dāyaḥ tatra ṛktham | saṃvibhāgaḥ sapratibandho dāyaḥ | parigrahaḥ jalatṛṇakāṣṭhāder ananyapūrvasya svīkāraḥ | adhigamaḥ nidhyādeḥ prāptiḥ | eṣu nimitteṣu svāmī bhavati | adhikam asādhāraṇam | nirviṣṭam kṛṣyādinā dvijaśuśrūṣādinā ca yal labdham | “nirveśo bhṛtibhogayoḥ” iti smaraṇāt [Amara 3.3.801] | manuḥ |
sapta vittāgamā dharmyā dāyo lābhaḥ krayo jayaḥ |
prayogaḥ karmayogaś ca satpratigraha eva ca ||
nyāyopacayārthaṃ dravyaprayogaḥ | karmayogaḥ ārtvijyam | nāradaḥ |
dhanamūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yatnas tasyārjane mataḥ |
rakṣaṇaṃ vardhanaṃ bhoga iti tasya vidhiḥ kramāt ||
tat punas trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ śuklaṃ śabalam eva ca |
kṛṣṇaṃ ca tasya vijñeyo vibhāgaḥ saptadhā punaḥ || [NSm 1.30–40]
[42] ekaikasya śuklādeḥ sapta sapta bhedāḥ bhavantīty arthaḥ |
śrutaśauryatapaḥkanyāyājyaśiṣyānvayāgatam |
dhanaṃ saptavidhaṃ śuklam udayo ‘py asya tadvidhaḥ || [NSm 1.41]
āgataśabdaḥ śrutādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate | kanyāgatam ārṣavivāhe varād gṛhītaṃ gomithunādi | yājyāgatam ārtvijyādilabdam | śiṣyāgatam gurudakṣiṇādi | atra ca yathādhikāraṃ śuklatvam avadheyam | udayaḥ phalaṃ tad apy asya śuddham ity arthaḥ |
kuśīdakṛṣivāṇijyaśilpaśulkānuvṛttitaḥ |
kṛtopakārād āptaṃ ca śabalaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
nyāyopacayārthaṃ dravyaprayogaḥ kuśīdam | śilpaṃ kārukādikarma | ākarādibhyo dravyodayaḥ śulkam | anuvṛttiḥ sevā |
pārśvakadyūtacauryārtipratirūpakasāhasaiḥ |
vyājenopārjitaṃ yat tat sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇam ucyate ||
pārśvakopārjitam utkocādilabdham | ārtyupārjitam parapīḍayā labdham | pratirūpakaṃ maṇisuvarṇādeḥ pratirūpakaraṇam | sāhasaṃ svaprāṇātyayāṅgīkāreṇa paśyato haratvādikam | vyājaḥ dambhena tapaḥprabhṛti |
tena krayo vikrayaś ca dānaṃ grahaṇam eva ca |
vividhāś ca pravartante kriyāḥ saṃbhoga eva ca ||
yathāvidhena dravyeṇa yat kiṃcit kurute naraḥ |
tathāvidham avāpnoti saphalaṃ pretya ceha ca ||
yathāvidhena śuklena kṛṣṇena śabalena vā dānādi kurute tathāvidhaṃ phalam āpnotīti, śuklena śuddhaṃ duḥkharahitam | [43] śabalena miśram | kṛṣṇena asukhodayam |
padmapurāṇe |
śuklena vittena kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ bahuphalaṃ bhavet |
śabalaṃ madhyamaphalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hīnadhanaṃ phalam ||
brahmaprokte |
śuklavittena yo dharmaṃ prakuryāt śraddhayānvitaḥ |
tīrthaṃ pātraṃ samāsādya devatve tat samaśnute ||
rājasena ca bhāvena vittena śabalena ca |
dadyād dānam atithibhyo mānuṣatve tad aśnute ||
tamovṛttas tu yo dadyāt kṛṣṇavittena mānavaḥ |
tiryaktve tatphlaṃ pretya samaśnāti narādhamaḥ ||
nāradaḥ |
tat punar dvādaśavidhaṃ prativarṇāśrayāt smṛtam |
sādhāraṇaṃ syāt trividhaṃ śeṣaṃ navavidhaṃ smṛtam ||
dharmyam iti śeṣaḥ | prativarṇāśrayān navavidhaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ trividham ity evaṃ dvādaśavidham ity arthaḥ |
kramāgataṃ prītidāyaḥ prāptaṃ ca saha bhāryayā |
aviśeṣeṇa sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ trividhaṃ dhanam ||
vaiśeṣikaṃ dhanaṃ jñeyaṃ brāhmaṇasya trilakṣaṇam | |
pratigraheṇa saṃsabdhaṃ yājyataḥ śiṣyatas tathā ||
trividhaṃ kṣatriyasyāpi prāhur vaiśeṣikaṃ dhanam |
yuddhopalabdhaṃ kārāc ca daṇḍāc ca vyavahārataḥ ||
kāraḥ balyādiḥ |
vaiśeṣikaṃ dhanaṃ jñeyaṃ vaiśyasyāpi trilakṣaṇam |
kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyaiḥ śūdrasyaibhyas tv anugrahāt ||
ebhyaḥ brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ |
[44]        sarveṣām eva varṇānām evaṃ dharmo dhanāgamaḥ |
viparyayād adharmaḥ syān na ced āpad garīyasī ||
(evaṃ dharmasādhanaṃ dravyaṃ nirupya tac ca kiyad deyaṃ kiṃ deyam ity apekṣāyām)
yājñavalkyaḥ |
svaṃ kuṭumbāvirodhena deyaṃ dārasutād ṛte |
nānvaye sati sarvasvaṃ yac cānyasmai pratiśrutam ||
anvaye santāne | pratiśrutaṃ pratijñātam | kuṭumbāvirodhas tu vyākhyāto bṛhaspatinā |
kuṭumbabhaktavasanād deyaṃ yad atiricyate |
madhvāsvādo viṣaṃ paścād dātur dharmo ‘nyathā bhavet ||
bhaktam annam | vasanaṃ vastram | (yāvatā dravyeṇa kuṭumbasya vastram annaṃ saṃpadyate tadatiriktaṃ deyam, itarat tu na deyam ity arthaḥ) |
manuḥ |
śaktaḥ parajane dātā svajane duḥkhajīvini |
madhāpāno viṣāsvādaḥ sa dharmapratirūpakaḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
sarvasvaṃ gṛhavarjaṃ tu kuṭumbabharaṇādhikam |
yac ca dravyaṃ svakaṃ deyam adeyaṃ syād ato ‘nyathā ||
tathā |
saptarātrād gṛhakṣetrāt yad yat kṣetraṃ pracīyate |
pitrā vātha svayaṃ prāptaṃ tad dātavyaṃ vivakṣitam ||
(saptarātrādibhyo yat pracīyate, adhikaṃ bhavati, tad dātavyam iti vivakṣitam ity arthaḥ) |
śivadharmāt |
tasmāt tribhāgaṃ vittasya jīvanāya prakalpayet |
bhāgadvayaṃ tu dharmārtham anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ |||
[45] (aśeṣavittasya bhāgapañcakaṃ parikalpya bhāgatrayaṃ jīvanāya saṃrakṣya bhāgadvayaṃ dharmāya kalpayed ity arthaḥ) | mahābhārate |
ekāṃ gāṃ daśagur dadyād daś dadyāc ca gośatī |
śataṃ sahasragur dadyāt sarve tulyaphalāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
(* nanv etad vacanadvayopāttayor vittagośabdayor upalakṣaṇārthatvena deyamātraparatvād viṣamabhāgaparikalpanaṃ viruddhaṃ yathāśrutagovittaparatvenāvirodhe daśagur ekāṃ gāṃ dadyād iti vacanād daśāvaragor dhanino ‘pi godānānadhikāraḥ syāt daśadhenugrahaṇayogya-dhanaparatve tu upalakṣaṇapakṣāṅgīkārād virodhatād avasthyaṃ tasmān nyūnādhikakalpayoḥ kṛpaṇodārādhikāriviṣayatayaiva vyavastheti sustham | *)
(* kuṭumbāvirodhena deyam ity uktam | ) tasyāpavādam āha vyāsaḥ |
kuṭumbṃ pīḍayitvāpi brāhmaṇāya mahātmane |
dātavyaṃ bhikṣave cānnam ātmano bhūtim icchatā ||
(* yatyatithyādiviṣayam etat | ) kātyāyanaḥ |
svecchādeyaṃ svayaṃ prāptaṃ bandhācāreṇa bandhakam |
vaivāhikakramāyāte sarvadānaṃ na vidyate ||
bandhakam ādhiḥ tad bandhācāreṇādhirūpeṇaiva deyam | yad vivāhalabdhaṃ tat tasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ satyāṃ sarvam adeyam | yac ca pitāmahādikramāyātaṃ tatra putre sati na deyam |
saudāyikaṃ kramāyātaṃ śauryaprāptaṃ ca yad bhavet |
strījñātisvāmyanujñātaṃ dattaṃ siddhim avāpnuyāt ||
saudāyikaṃ vivāhalabdhaṃ tadbhāryayānujñātam | [46] kramāyātam avibhaktadhanair jñātibhir anujñātam | bhṛtena satā yuddhena labdhaṃ svāminānujñātam ity arthaḥ | yājñavalkyaḥ |
deyaṃ pratiśrutaṃ caiva datvā nāpaharet punaḥ |
yamaḥ |
yac ca vācā pratijñātaṃ karmaṇā nopapāditam |
tad dhanam ṛṇasaṃyuktam iha lohe paratra ca ||
ṛṇasaṃyuktam ṛṇāsamarpaṇajanyadoṣasaṃyuktam ity arthaḥ |
saptājātān naro hanyād vartamānāṃs tu sapta ca |
atikrāntān sapta hanyād aprayacchan pratiśrutam ||
pratiśrutāpradānena dattasya haraṇena ca |
janmaprabhṛti yat puṇyaṃ tat sarvaṃ sampraṇaśyati ||
mahābhārate |
brāhmaṇaṃ svayam āhūya bhikṣārthe kṛśavartinam |
paścān nāstīti yo bhrūyāt taṃ vidyād brahmaghātakam ||
tathā |
saṃśrutya yo na ditseta yācitvā yasya neṣyati |
ubhāv anṛtikāv etau mṛṣā pāpam avāpnutaḥ ||
tathā |
yo na dadyāt pratiśrutya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu |
āśās tasya hatāḥ sarvāḥ klībasyeva prajāphalam ||
yaṃ nirīkṣeta saṃkruddha āśayā pūrvajātayā |
pradahet hitaṃ rājan kaṅkam akṣayabhug yathā |
tasmād dātavyam eveha pratiśrutya yudhiṣṭhira ||
nāradaḥ |
brāhmaṇasya ca yad deyaṃ sānvayasya ca nāsti kaḥ |
sakulye tasya ninayet tad abhāve ‘sya bandhuṣu || [NSm 1.99]
[47]        yadā tun a sakulyaḥ syān na ca saṃbandhibāndhavāḥ |
dadyāt sajātiśiṣyebhyas tadabhāve ‘psu nikṣipet ||
gautamaḥ: “pratiśrutyāpy adharmasaṃyuktāya na dadyāt” | kātyāyanaḥ |
prāṇasaṃśayam āpannaṃ yo mām uttārayed itaḥ |
sarvasv ante pradāsyāmīty ukte ‘pi na tathā bhavet ||
atha phalātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ pātraviśeṣeṇa deyaviśeṣāḥ | bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
gobhūtilahiraṇyādi dadyān nityam atandritaḥ |
tathā dravyaveśeṣāṃś ca dadyāt pātraviśeṣataḥ ||
ārtānām annadānaṃ ca gonānaṃ ca kuṭumbinām |
tathā pratiṣṭhāhīnānāṃ kṣetradānaṃ praśasyate ||
savarṇaṃ yājñikānāṃ ca vidyāṃ caivorddhvaretasām |
kanyāṃ caivānapatyānāṃ dadatāṃ gatir uttamā ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
yuddhopakaraṇaṃ dravyaṃ kṣatriye dvijapuṅgavāḥ |
paṇyopayogi tad vaiśye śūdre śilpopayogi ca ||
yasyopayogi yad dravyaṃ deyaṃ tasyaiva tad bhavet |
yena yena ca bhāṇḍena yasya vṛttir udāhṛtā ||
tat tat tasyaiva dātavyaṃ puṇyakāmena dhīmatā |
daṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ caiva tathā viprāḥ kamaṇḍalum ||
dhīraṃ puṇyam avāpnoti datvaitān brahmacāriṇaḥ |
vastraṃ śayyāsanaṃ dhānyaṃ veśma veśmaparicchadam ||
gṛhasthāya tu tad dattaṃ jñeyaṃ bahuphalaṃ sadā |
nīvāraṃ valkalaṃ śākaṃ phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca gorasam ||
[48]        vānaprasthāya yad dattam anantaṃ parikīrtitam |
bhikṣāpradānaṃ yataye pātradānaṃ tathāhitam ||
gandhamaṅgalyatāmbūlaraktavastrādikaṃ striyaḥ |
strīṇāṃ pradānaṃ dātavyaṃ bhartṛhaste tu nānyathā ||
proktaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ hy etad guptaṃ bhartuḥ prayacchataḥ |
annaṃ pratiśrayaṃ caiva pānthe dattaṃ mahāphalam ||
vivāhādikriyākāle tat kriyāsiddhikāraṇam |
yaḥ prayacchati dharmajñaḥ so ‘śvamedham avāpnuyāt ||
āturebhyo dhanaṃ datvā dānaṃ bahuphalaṃ bhavet |
bālakrīḍanakaṃ datvā mṛṣṭam annaṃ tathaiva ca ||
phalaṃ manoharaṃ vāpi agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
mṛṣṭānnaṃ mānavo datvā mṛṣṭānnāni tu kāṅkṣatām ||
akṣayaṃ phalam āpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati |
śrīvihīne tathā datvā bhojanaṃ dvijasattama ||
vastraṃ śubhrambā dharmajñaḥ puṇyaṃ mahad upāśrate |
kṛpāsthānaṃ paraṃ viprā vicyutāḥ puruṣāḥ śriyā ||
tasyānukampā kartavyā satāṃ vartmani tiṣṭhatā |
kāryo satyadyamaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāṃ samupasthite ||
akṣayaṃ phalam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
yavasānāṃ pradānena dhenumatsu dvijātiṣu ||
lavaṇānāṃ ca dharmajñāḥ phalam akṣayam aśnute |
prasaveṣu tu yad dattaṃ vyasanārtibhayeṣu ca ||
tad dānam akṣayaṃ proktaṃ puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ |
[49]        data brāhmaṇaśārdūla jalapātram athārthine ||
phalam akṣayam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
aṅgirāḥ |
devatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca mātāpitros tathaiva ca |
puṇyaṃ deyaṃ prayatnena nāpuṇyaṃ noditaṃ kvacit ||
nandipurāṇe |
pāpadaḥ pāpam āpnoti naro lakṣaguṇaṃ sadā |
puṇyadaḥ puṇyam āpnoti śataśo ‘tha sahasraśaḥ ||
tathā pātraviśeṣeṇa dānaṃ syād uttarottaram |
pitṛmātṛgurubrahmavādināṃ dīyate tu yat ||
tal lakṣaguṇitaṃ vidyāt puṇyasvā pāpam eva vā ||
vahnipurāṇe |
dvāv imau puruṣau loke sūryamaṇḍalabhedinau |
dātānnasya ca durbhikṣe subhikṣe hemavastradā ||
atha adeyanirūpaṇam | devalaḥ |
anyāyādhigatāṃ datvā sakalāṃ pṛthivīm api |
śraddhāvarjam apātrāya na kāṃcid bhūtim āpnuyāt ||
vahnipurāṇāt |
anyāyopagataṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā yo hy apaṇḍitaḥ |
dharmābhikāṅkṣī yajate na dharmaphalam aśnute ||
dharmavaitaṃsiko yas tu pāpātmā puruṣas tathā |
dadāti dānaṃ viprebhyo lokaviśvāsakāraṇam ||
pāpena karmaṇā vipro dhanaṃ labdhvā niraṃśakaḥ |
rāgamohānvitasvāntaḥ kaluṣāṃ yonim āpnuyāt ||
arthasaṃcayabuddhir hi lobhamohavaśaṃgataḥ |
udvejayati bhūtāni hiṃsayā pāpacetanaḥ ||
evaṃ labdhvā dhanaṃ lobhād yajate yo dadāti ca |
[50]        sa pāpakarmaṇā ten ana sidhyati purāgamāt ||
tathā |
etair anyaiś ca bahubhir anyāyopārjitair dhanaiḥ |
ārabhyante kriya yās tu piśācās tatra daivatam ||
vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
dravyeṇānyāyalabdhena yaḥ karoty aurdhvadehikam |
na sa tat phalam āpnoti tasyārthasya durāgamāt ||
skandapurāṇe |
devadravyaṃ gurudravyaṃ dravyaṃ caṇḍeśvarasya ca |
trividhaṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dānalaṅghanabhakṣaṇāt ||
yamaḥ |
apahṛtya parasyārthaṃ dānaṃ yas tu prayacchati |
sa dātā narakaṃ yāti yasyārthas tasya tatphalam ||
tathā |
paribhuktam avajñātam aparyāptam asaṃskṛtam |
yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyas tad bhasmany avatiṣṭhate ||
paribhuktaṃ gṛhītopayogaṃ vastrādi | aparyāptaṃ svakāryākṣamaṃ jaradgavādi | śātātapaḥ |
vedavikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ strīṣu yac cārjitaṃ dhanam |
adeyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yac ca klībād upāgatam ||
(vedavikrayo nirdiśyate vyapadiśyate yat tat tathā | nirviṣṭam iti pāṭhe vedavikrayāl labdham ity arthaḥ) | strīṣu yac cārjitam iti strīvyāpāropajivanena yal labdham | strīṣu vikrītāsv iti kecit |
dakṣaḥ |
sāmānyaṃ yācitaṃ nyāsa ādhir dārāś ca taddhanam |
anvāhitaṃ ca nikṣepaḥ sarvasvaṃ cānvaye sati ||
āpatsv api na deyāni nava vastūni paṇḍitaiḥ |
yo dadāti sa mūḍhātmā prāyaścittīyate naraḥ ||

adhyagnyadhyāvāhanikaṃ dattaṃ ca prītikarmaṇi |
bhrātṛmātṛpitṛprāptaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ strīdhanaṃ smṛtam || [MDh 9.194]
adhyagni agnisamakṣaṃ yat striyai dattam | adhyāvāhanikaṃ vivāhakāle pitrādidattam | prītikarmaṇi strīpuṃsaṃbandhena bhartārpitam | vivāhottarakāle ‘pi bhrātrādibhyaḥ prāptam |
yājñavalkyo ‘py āha |
bhrātṛmātṛpitṛpatiprāptam adhyagnyupāgatam |
ādhivedanikaṃ caiva strīdhaṃ parikīrtitam ||
dārāntram icchatā bhartrā yad dattaṃ tad ādhivedanikam, evaṃprakāraṃ strīdhanaṃ na deyam iti | anvāhitaṃ yad ekasya haste nihitaṃ dravyaṃ tenāpy anu paścād anyasya haste svāmine dehīti nihitam | gṛhasvāmisamakṣaṃ sthāpitaṃ dravyaṃ nikṣepaḥ | kātyāyanaḥ |
vikrayaṃ caiva dānaṃ ca na neyāḥ syur anicchavaḥ |
dārāḥ putrāś ca sarvasvam ātmanaiva tu yojayet ||
āpatkāle tu kartavyaṃ dānaṃ vikraya eva vā |
anyathā na parvartanta iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ ||
(* āpatkāle tu kartavyaṃ dānaṃ vikraya eva veti svakīyadānavikrayecchudārādiviṣayam) |
[52] yat tu dārāṇām āpatsv api na deyānīti dakṣeṇādeyatvam uktaṃ tat svadānavikrayānicchu-dārādiviṣayam | vasiṣṭhaḥ: “śukraśoṇitasaṃbhavaḥ puruṣo mātāpitṛnimittikas tasya pradānavikrayaprarityāgeṣu mātāpitarau prabhavataḥ na tv ekaṃ putraṃ dadyāt pratigṛhnīyād vā anyatrānujñānāḍ bhartuḥ” [VaDh 15.1–5] | bṛhaspatiḥ |
kasmaicid yācamānāya dattaṃ dharmāya yad bhavet |
paścāc ca na tathā tat syān na deyaṃ tasya tad bhavet ||
(* dharmaṃ kartuṃ yācamānāya yad dattaṃ ten aced asau dharmaṃ na kuryāt tadā tat tasmai na deyam ity arthaḥ) | aṅgirāḥ |
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaur gṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ |
vibhaktadakṣiṇā hy etā dātāraṃ tārayanti hi ||
ekā ekasya dātavyā na bahubhyaḥ kathaṃcana |
dātur vikrayam āpannā dahaty ā saptamaṃ kulam ||
(* vikretur evaitad doṣapradarśanaṃ na prakṛtasya dātur iti) | aupakāyanaḥ |
kanyāśayyāgṛhaṃ caiva deyaṃ yad gostriyādikam |
tad ekasmai pradātavyaṃ na bahubhyaḥ kathaṃcana ||
vyāsaḥ |
na vyaṅgā rohiṇīṃ vandhyāṃ na kṛśāṃ mṛtavatsakām |
na vāmanāṃ vehataṃ ca dadyād viprāya gāṃ naraḥ ||
vehat garbhopaghātinī | devalaḥ |
vivatsāṃ rogiṇīṃ rūkṣāṃ sthavirāṃ śṛṅgabhīṣaṇīm |
kṣīṇakṣīraśarīrāṅgāṃ datvā doṣam avāpnuyāt ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
na coṣarāṃ na nirdagdhāṃ mahīṃ dadyāt kathaṃcana |
[53]        na śmaśānaparītāṃ ca na ca pāpaniṣevitām ||
pāpāḥ hiṃśraprāṇino vyāghrādayaḥ | viṣṇudharmottare |

na dadyāt tu dvijaśreṣṭhī yā ca saṃdhiṣu saṃsthitā ||
skandapurāṇe |
pāpadaḥ pāpam āpnoti naro lakṣaguṇaṃ sadā |
tasmān na dadyān medhāvī pātakaṃ jātu kasyacit ||
mahābhārate |
duḥkhitebhyo hi bhūtebhyo mṛtyurogajarādibhiḥ |

duḥkhaṃ dadāti yo ‘nyasya dhruvaṃ duḥkhaṃ sa vindati |
tasmān na kasyacid duḥkhaṃ dātavyaṃ duḥkhabhīruṇā ||
atha pātraviśeṣeṇa deyam ucyate | yamaḥ |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ yatibhyo yaḥ prayacchati |
na tatphalam avāpnoti tatraiva parivartate ||
parivartaḥ viparyayaḥ, evaśabdaḥ apyarthaḥ tena tatra tasmin datary api parivartate, dharmaviparītaṃ dharmaṃ janayatīty arthaḥ | tathā coktam |
yataye kāñcanaṃ datvā dātāpi narakaṃ vrajet || iti |
devalaḥ |
pakvam annaṃ gṛhasthasya vānaprasthasya gorasaḥ |
vṛttiṃ ca bhikṣuvṛttibhyo na deyaṃ puṇyam icchatā ||
vṛttiḥ bhikṣātiriktaṃ vartanam | tathā |
na śūdrāya havir dadyāt svasti kṣīraṃ tilān madhu |
na śūdrāt pratigṛhṇīyāt teṣām anyan nivedayet ||
gorasaṃ kāñcanaṃ kṣetraṃ gās tilā madhusarpiṣī |
tathā sarvān rasāṃś cāpi caṇḍālebhyo na dīyate ||
[54] svasti na dadyād iti praṇāmam antareṇa śūdrasya svastīti na brūyād ity arthaḥ | teṣām iti kṣīrādīnāṃ krayārtham anyad dravyaṃ nivedayed ity arthaḥ | śaṅkhalikhitau: “kṛśaraṃ pāyasaṃ yāvaṃ dadhimadhukṛṣṇājināni śūdrebhyo na dadyān nopākṛtaṃ kiṃcit” | viṣṇudharmottarāt |
bhuvaṃ dhenum athāśvaṃ ca ratnāni kanakaṃ tathā |
tilāṃś ca kuñjaraṃ dadyān nāvijñāya guṇāguṇān ||
atha grāhyam ucyate | tatra vyāsaḥ |
kuṭumbārthaṃ hi sacchūdrāt pratigrāhyam ayācitam |
vṛttyartham ātmane caiva na hi yāceta karhicit ||
skandapurāṇe |

asādhor api gṛhṇīyāt pratigraham atandritaḥ ||
ṛṇāpākaraṇārthaṃ ca pratigrāhyaṃ dvijottamaiḥ |
cikīrṣayā tu yajñasya mātāpitrartham eva ca ||
gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇād eva nityam ācāravartinaḥ |
śraddhayā vimalaṃ dattaṃ tathā dharmo na hīyate ||
abrāhmaṇakṛtād dānād viśuddhād api sarvataḥ |
brāhmaṇena kṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ niṣiddham api jānatā ||
niṣiddam api anāpadi niṣiddhaṃ kṛṣṇājinādi | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
anāpadyatidharmeṇa yājyataḥ śiṣyatas tathā |
gṛhṇan pratigrahaṃ vipro na dharmāt parihīyate ||
samāṣaṇmāsamāsaikaṣaḍahastridinakṣamam |
ekāgnikaṃ vā dharmāya gṛhṇīyād uttarottaram ||
[55] garuḍapurāṇāt |
yāvatā pañcayajñānāṃ kartuṃ nirvahaṇaṃ kṣamaḥ |
tāvad eva hi gṛhṇīyāt kuṭumbasyātmanas tathā ||
yad gṛhītam anindyebhyaḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ ca yad bhavet |

nindyasya dravyaleśo ‘pi niravāyaiva jāyate ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |

pṛthivīṃ nānyad icchanti pāvanaṃ hy etad uttamam ||
brahmavaivartāt |

saṃvartaḥ |
gṛhasthas tu sadā yukto dharmam evānucintayet |
poṣyavargārthasiddhyarthaṃ dhanam iccheta buddhimān ||

ayācitāhṛtaṃ grāhyam api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ |
anyatra kulaṭāṣaṇḍapatitebhyas tathā dviṣaḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
rājāntevāsiyājyebhyaḥ sīdann icched dhanaṃ kṣudhā |
dambhihaitukapāṣaṇḍibakavṛttīṃś ca varjayet ||
tathā |
devātityarcanakṛte gurubhṛtyādivṛttaye |

gurūn bhṛtyāṃś coccihīrṣann arciṣyan devatātithīn |
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt na tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tataḥ ||

śūdrān na pratigṛhṇīyān na tu bhuṅkte svayaṃ tataḥ ||
manuḥ |
āhūtām udyatāṃ bhikṣāṃ purastād apracoditām |

nāśnanti pitaras tasya daśavarṣāṇi pañca ca |

yājñavalkyaḥ |

māṃsaṃ śayyāsanaṃ dhānāḥ pratyākhyeyaṃ na vāri ca ||
manuḥ |
śayyāṃ gṛhān kuśān gandhān payaḥ puṣpaṃ mahīṃ dadhi |
matsyā dhānāḥ payo māṃsaṃ śākaṃ caiva na nirluṭhet ||
tathā |
edhodakaṃ mūlaphalam annam abhyudyataṃ ca yat |
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyān madhu cābhayadakṣiṇām ||
edhaḥ kāṣṭham | abhyudyatam ayācitāgatam | aṅgirāḥ |
khalakṣetragataṃ dhānyaṃ vāpikūpagataṃ jalam |
adadadbhyo ‘pi tad grāhyaṃ yac ca goṣṭhagataṃ payaḥ ||
pakvānnavarjaṃ viprebhyo godhānyaṃ kṣatriyād api |
vaiśyāt tu sarvadhānyāni śūdrād grāhyaṃ na kiṃcana ||
(abhojyānnaviprādiviṣayam etat)

sarvakālaṃ grahītavyaṃ śūdrabhyo ‘py aṅgiromatam ||
[57]        saṃskāraiḥ śudhyati hy etad dhānyaṃ tena śuci smṛtam |
tasmād dānaṃ grahītavyaṃ mṛtasūtyantareṣv api ||
mṛtasūtyantareṣv apīti tad āpadviṣayam |
āmamāṃsaṃ madhughṛtaṃ dhānāḥ kṣīram athoditam |
guḍaṃ takraṃ ca saṃgrāhyaṃ nivṛttir nāpi śūdrataḥ ||
śākamatsyāranālāni kantukāḥ saktavas tilāḥ |
ikṣuḥ phalāni piṇyākaṃ pratigrāhyāṇi sarvataḥ ||
kantukāḥ kanthāḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ |
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu tv antarāmṛtasūtake |

śaṅkhaḥ: “kumāraprasave nāḍyām acchinnāyāṃ guḍatilahiraṇyavastragodhānyapratigraheṣv adoṣaḥ | tadaha ity eke” | āha pracetāḥ: “sarveṣāṃ sakulyānāṃ dvipadacatuṣpadadhānya-vāsīdakṣiṇāpratigraheṣv adoṣaḥ” | viṣṇudharmottarāt |

athāgrhyam ucyate | brahmapuāṇe |

śayyālaṅgāravastrāṇi pratigṛhya mṛtasya ca ||
[58]        narakān na nivarteta dhenuṃ tilamahīṃ tathā |

āturāt mumūrṣoḥ | vahnipurāṇāt |

bhikṣāgrahaṇam adhikṛtya manuḥ |
cikitsakakṛtaghnānāṃ śalyakartuś ca vārdhuṣeḥ |
ṣaṇḍasya kulaṭāyāś ca udyatām api varjayet ||
(bhikṣām iti śeṣaḥ) | cikitsako ‘tra kuvaidyaḥ | ṣaṇḍaḥ klībaḥ | kulaṭā puṃścalī | yamaḥ |

[59] mṛgayuḥ mṛgahantā | āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |

viṣṇuḥ |

sā śāntā śāntidā nityaṃ śāntiṃ kuryāt sadaiva hi ||
snānadānādikaṃ sarvam asyām akṣayam ucyate |
yadā śuklacaturthyāṃ tu vāro bhaumasya vai bhavet ||
tadā sā sukhadā jñeyā sukhānām eti kīrthitā |
snānadānādikaṃ sarvam asyām akṣayam ucyate ||
skandapurāṇe |
śuklā mārgaśire māsi śrāvaṇe yā ca pañcamī |
snānadāne bahuphalā nāgalokapradāyinī ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yeyaṃ bhādrapade māsi ṣaṣṭhī ca bharatarṣabha |
snānadānādikaṃ sarvam asyām akṣayam ucyate ||
[63] tathā |
śukapakṣasya saptamyāṃ sūryavāro bhaved yadi |
saptamī vijayā nāma tatra dattaṃ mahāphalam ||
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ pañcatārakam |
yadā ca syāt tadā jñeyā jayānāmeti saptamī ||
snānadānādikaṃ tasyāṃ bhavet śataguṇaṃ vibho ||
pañca tārakam iti rohiṇyaśleṣāmaghāhastasya |
yā mārgaśīrṣamāsasya śuklapakṣe tu saptamī |
nandā sā kathitā vīra sarvānandakarī smṛtā ||
snānadānādikaṃ sarvam asyām akṣayam ucyate ||
ādipurāṇe |
revatī yatra saptamyām ādityadivase bhavet |
taddānaṃ śatasāhasram iti prāha divākaraḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
pauṣe māsi yadā devi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ budho bhavet |
tadā tu sā mahāpuṇyā mahārudeti kīrtitā ||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ mahādānaṃ tarpaṇaṃ viprabhojanam |
matprītaye kṛtaṃ devi śatasāhasrikaṃ bhavet ||
mahābhārate |
aṣṭakāsu ca yad dattaṃ tad anantam udāhṛtam ||
āśvalāyanaḥ: “hemantaśiśirayoś caturṇām aparapakṣāṇām aṣṭamīṣv aṣṭakā” iti | tathā śātapathaśrutiḥ: “dvādaśapaurṇamāsyo dvādaśāṣtakā dvādaśāmāvāsyā” iti | dvādaśāpi kṛṣṇāṣṭamya ity arthaḥ | devīpurāṇe |
āśvinasya tu māsasya navamī śuklapakṣajā |
jāyate koṭiguṇitaṃ dānaṃ tasyāṃ narādhipa ||
[64] garuḍapurāṇē |
jyaiṣṭhasya śukladaśamī saṃvatsaramukhī smṛtā |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ prakurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣaṃ yatra sattama |
tathau bhavati sā proktā viṣṇunā pāpanāśinī ||
dānaṃ yad dīyate kiṃcit samuddiśya janārdanam |
homo na kriyate tasyām akṣayaṃ kathitaṃ phalam ||
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravānvitā |
mahatī dvādaśī jñeyā upavāse mahāphalā ||
phalaṃ dattahutānāṃ ca tasyāṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
bhāgyarkṣasaṃyutā caitre dvādaśī syān mahāphalā ||
bhāgyarkṣaṃ pūrvaphalgunī |
hastayuktā tu vaiśākhe jyaiṣṭhe tu svātisaṃyutā |
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca tathāṣāḍhe mūlopetā ca vaiplave ||
vaiplave śrāvaṇe māsi |
tathā bhādrapade māsi śravaṇena tu saṃyutā |
āśvine dvādaśī puṇyā bhavaty ājarkṣasaṃyutā ||
ājarkṣaḥ pūrvabhādrapadāḥ |
kārtike revatīyuktā saumye kṛttikayā tathā |
saumyaḥ mārgaśīṣaḥ |
pauṣe mṛgaśiropetā māghe cādityasaṃyutā |
ādityaḥ punarvasuḥ |
phālgune puṣyasahitā dvādaśī pāvanī parā |
nakṣatrayuktāsv etāsu snānaṃ dānam upoṣitam ||
[65]        sakṛtkṛtaṃ manuṣyāṇām akṣayyaphaladāyakam |
skandapurāṇe |
yas tu caitratrayodaśyāṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ samācaret |
phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ tasya karmaṇo labhate naraḥ ||
jyotiḥśāstre |
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ madhāsv induḥ kare raviḥ |
yadā tadā gajachāyā śrāddhe puṇyair avāpyate ||
caitre caturdaśī śuklā śrāvaṇaproṣṭhapādayoḥ |
māghasya yā kṛṣṇapakṣe dāne bahuphalā hi sā ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī paurṇimā tu mahāphalā |
paurṇamāsīṣu sarvāsu māsarkṣasahitāsu ca ||
snānānām iha dānānāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhavet |
yasyāṃ pūrṇendunā yogaṃ yāti jīvo mahābalaḥ ||
paurṇamāsī tu sā jñeyā mahāpūrvā dvijottama |
snānaṃ dānaṃ tathā jāpyam akṣayyaṃ tat tadā smṛtam ||
brahmapurāṇe |
āgneyaṃ tu yadā ṛkṣaṃ kārtikyāṃ bhavati kvacit |
mahatī sā tithir jñeyā snānadāneṣu cottamā ||
āgneyam ṛkṣaṃ kṛttikā |
yadā yāmyaṃ tu bhavati ṛkṣaṃ tasyāṃ tithau kvacit |
tithiḥ sāpi mahāpuṇyā ṛṣibhiḥ parikīrtitā ||
yāmyaṃ ṛkṣaṃ bharaṇī |
prājāpatyaṃ yadā ṛkṣaṃ tithau tasyāṃ narādhipa |
sā mahākārtikī proktā devānām api durlabhā ||
prāyāpatyam ṛkṣaṃ rohiṇī | [66]
vyāsaḥ |
amā vai somavāreṇa ravivāreṇa saptamī |
caturthī bhaumavāreṇa viṣuvatsadṛśaṃ phalam ||
śaṅkho ‘pi |
amāvāsyā tu some tu saptamī bhānunā saha |
caturthī bhūmiputreṇa somaputreṇa cāṣṭamī ||
catasras tithayas tv etās tulyāḥ syur grahaṇādibhiḥ |
sarvam akṣayam atroktaṃ snānadānajapādikam ||
mahābhārate |
amā some tathā bhaume guruvāre yadā bhavet |
tat parva puṣkaraṃ nāma sūryaparvaśatādhikam ||
śātātapaḥ |
amāvāsyā somavāre sūryavāre ca saptamī |
aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthī vā caturdaśī ||
tatra yaḥ kurute karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kartā tat phalam aśnute ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
amāvasyā yadā maitra viśākhāṛkṣayoginī |
śrāddhe pitṛgaṇas tṛptiṃ tad āpnoty aṣṭavārṣikīm ||
amāvasyā yadā puṣye raudarkṣe vā punarvasau |
dvādaśābdīn tathā tṛptiṃ prayānti pitaro ‘rcitāḥ ||
raudrarkṣaṃ ārdrā |
vāsavājaikapādarkṣe pitṝṇāṃ tṛptim icchatā |
vāruṇe vāpyadaivatye devānām api durlabhā ||
vāsavaṃ dhaniṣṭhā | ajaikapādaṃ pūrvābhādrapadā | vāruṇaṃ śatatārakā | āpyaṃ pūrvāṣāḍhā |
māghāsite pañcadaśī kadācid upaiti yogaṃ yati vāruṇena |
ṛkṣeṇa kālaḥ sa paraḥ pitṝṇāṃ nah y alpapuṇyair nṛpa labhyate ‘sau ||
[67] vāruṇaṃ śatatārā |
atha yugādiprabhṛtayaḥ | tatra skandapurāṇe |
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārtike niragāt kṛtam |
treat sitatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe samapadyate ||
darśe tu māghamāsasya pravṛttaṃ dvāparaṃ yugam |
kaliḥ kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ labhasye māsi nirgataḥ |
yugādayaḥ smṛtā hy ete dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
yugārambhās tu tithayo yugādyās tena kīrtitāḥ |
phalaṃ dattahutānāṃ ca tāsv anantaṃ prakīrtitam ||
tathā |
etāś catasras tithayo yugādyā dattaṃ hutaṃ cākṣayam āśu vindyāt |
yuge yuge varṣaśatena yat tapo yugādikāle divasena tad bhavet ||
tathā |
sūryasya saṃhasaṃkrāntyām antaḥ kṛtayugasya ca |
tathā vṛścikasaṃkrāntyām antas tretāyugasya ca ||
jñeyas tu vṛśasaṃkrāntyāṃ dvāparāntas tu saṃkhyayā |
tathā ca kumbhasaṃkrāntyām antaḥ kaliyugasya ca ||
ādityapurāṇe |
dinarkṣaṃ revatī yatra gamanaṃ caiva rāśiṣu |
yugāntadivasaṃ viddhi tatra dānam anantakam ||
grahoparāge viṣuve saumye vā mihiropadiḥ |
saptamī śuklā kṛṣṇā vā yugāntadivasaṃ viduḥ ||
mihitopadiḥ sūryagrahaḥ | manuḥ |
sahasraguṇitaṃ dānaṃ bhaved dattaṃ yugādiṣu |
[68]        karmaśrāddhādikaṃ caitat tathā manvatarādiṣu ||
matsyapurāṇe |
aśvayukśuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtikasya tu |
caitrasya tu tṛtīyā yā tathā bhādrapadasya tu ||
phālgunasya tv amāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā |
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhasya paurṇimā ||
āṣāḍhasya tu daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī |
kārtikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī tathā ||
manvatarādayaś caitā dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyapitṛtarpaṇam ||
sarvam evākṣayaṃ vindyāt kṛtaṃ manvantarādiṣu ||
(atrāmāvasyāṣṭamīvyatirekeṇa sarvāḥ śuklā eva) | (purāṇāntareṇa tu śrāvaṇasyāmāvasyā bhādrapadasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamī manvatarādir iti pratipāditam) | tad yathā |
āśvine śuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtike tathā |
tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca ||
śrāvaṇasyāpy amāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā |
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī ||
nabhasyasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā |
kārtikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcamī tathā ||
manvantarādayaś caitā dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ |
atha vyatīpātādikālāḥ | [69]
yājñavalkyaḥ |
śatam indukṣaye dānaṃ sahasraṃ tu dinakṣaye |
viṣuve śatasāhasraṃ vyatīpāte tv anantakam ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
darśe śataguṇaṃ dānaṃ tacchataghnaṃ dinakṣaye |
śataghnaṃ tasya saṃkrāntau śataghnaṃ viṣuve tataḥ ||
yugādau tacchataguṇam ayane tacchatāhatam |
somagrahe tacchataghnaṃ tacchataghnaṃ ravigrahe ||
asaṃkhyeyaṃ vyatīpāte dānaṃ vedavido viduḥ ||
śataghnaṃ śataguṇam ity arthaḥ | tathā |
utpattau lakṣaguṇaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhramaṇanāḍikāyāṃ tu |
utpattyādimānam uktaṃ jyotiḥśāstre |
patane daśanāḍyas tu patate sapta nāḍikāḥ ||
(vyatīpāto ‘tra viṣkumbhādiyogeṣu saptadaśayogaḥ) | (vṛddhamanunā tu prakārāntareṇa vyatīpāto darśitaḥ) |
śravaṇāśvidhaniṣṭhārdrānāgadaivatamastake |
yad yamā ravivāreṇa vyatīpātaḥ sa ucyate ||
nāgadaivatam aśleṣā | mastakaṃ prathamacaraṇāḥ | (mastaka iti śravaṇādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate) | (śāstrāntare ‘nyo ‘pi vyatīpāta uktaḥ) |
pañcānanasthau gurubhūmiputrau meṣe raviḥ syād yadi śuklapakṣe |
[70]        pāśābhidhānā karabheṇa yuktā tithir vyatīpāta itīha yogaḥ ||
asmin hi gobhūmihiraṇyavastradānena sarvaṃ parihāya pāpam |
śūratvam indratvam anāmayatvaṃ manvādhipatyaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ ||
pañcānanaḥ siṃhaḥ | gurubhūmiputrau bṛhaspatyaṅgārakau | pāśābhidhānā dvādaśī | karabhaṃ hastanakṣatram iti | (jyotiḥśāstre tu ravicandrayoḥ saṃkrāntisāmye sūkṣmau vaidhṛtavyatīpātau darśitau) | tad āha gālavaḥ |
candrārkayor nayanavīkṣaṇajātamūrtiḥ
kālānaladyutinibhaḥ puruṣo ‘tiraudraḥ |
astrodyato bhuvi pataṃś ca nirīkṣamāṇaḥ
kaṅghātaye ‘ham iti ca vyatipātayogaḥ ||
āha bhṛguḥ |
krāntisāmyasamayaḥ samīritaḥ sūryaparvasadṛśo munīśvarāḥ |
tatra dattahutajaptapūjanaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇam āha bhārgavaḥ ||
(ayam arthaḥ sūryācandrasamoḥ krāntisāmye puṇyakāladvayaṃ saṃbhavati) | ekaḥ vyatīpātākhyaḥ | aparaḥ vaidhṛtākhyaḥ | (tatra saṃkrāntisāmyalakṣaṇasya vyatīpātasya gaṇḍottarārdhād ārabhya sārdheṣu saṃyogeṣu saṃbhavo ‘sti vaidhṛte vyatīpāte dattam akṣayakṛd bhavati) | bharadvājaḥ |
vyatīpāte vaidhṛte ca dattasyānto na vidyate |
vyatīpāte viśeṣeṇa sa hi sūkṣmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
(sthūlaprakāreṇa prasiddhas tu saptaviṃśatitamo yogo vaidhṛta iti) |
[71]
athoparāgakālaḥ |
padmapurāṇe |
candrasya yadi vā bhāno rāhuṇā saha saṃgamaḥ |
uparāma iti khyātas tatrānantaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
indor lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ raver deśaguṇaṃ bhavet |
gaṅgātīre tu saṃprāpte indoḥ koṭī raver daśa ||
raver daśaguṇam iti lakṣaguṇād daśaguṇam ity arthaḥ | evam uttaratrāpi | tathā |
ravivāre raver grāsaḥ some somagrahas tathā |
cūḍāmaṇir iti khyātas tatrānantaṃ phalaṃ smṛtam ||
bharadvājaḥ |
candrasūryoparāge ca yat kartavyaṃ tad ucyate |
sarvaṃ hemamayaṃ dānaṃ sarve brahmasamā dvijāḥ ||
sarvaṃ gaṅgāsaṃ toyaṃ rāhugraste divākare ||
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
rāhagrasto yadā sūryo yas tu śrāddhaṃ samācaret |
tenaiva sakalā pṛthvī dattā viprasya vai kare ||
śātātapaḥ |
ayaneṣu sadā deyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ svagṛheṣu yat |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe caiva vimokṣe candrasūryayoḥ ||
vimokṣe vartamāne na tu vimuktayor ity arthaḥ, “uparāge tu tat kalam” iti smaraṇāt | tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ |
nāḍyaḥ ṣoḍaś pūrveṇa saṃkrāntes tu pareṇa ca |
rāhor darśanamātreṇa puṇyakālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
jābālir api |
saṃkrāntau puṇyakālas tu ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalāḥ |
candrasūryoparāge tu yāvad darśanagocaraḥ ||
atha saṃkrāntikālāḥ | [72]
āha śātātapaḥ |
saṃkrāntau yāni dattāni havyakavyāni dātṛbhiḥ |
tāni nityaṃ dadāty arkaḥ punar janmani janmani ||
ravisaṃkramaṇe puṇye na snāyad yo hi mānavaḥ |
saptajanmāntaraṃ yogī duḥkhabhāgī sadā bhavet ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
ayane dve ca viṣuve catasraḥ ṣaḍaśītayaḥ |
catasro viṣṇupadyaś ca saṃkrāntyo dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ||
jhaṣakarkaṭasaṃkrānto dve tūdagdakṣiṇāyane |
viṣuve ca tulāmeṣe golamadhye tato parāḥ ||
jhaṣaḥ makaraḥ | golaḥ rāśicakram |
kanyāyāṃ mithane (mithuna?) mīne dhanuṣy api raver gatiḥ |
ṣaḍaśītimukhā proktā ṣaḍaśītiguṇā phalaiḥ ||
vṛṣavṛścikakumbheṣu siṃhe caiva yadā raviḥ |
etad viṣṇupadaṃ nāma viṣuvād adhikaṃ phale ||
gālavaḥ |
madhye viṣuvati dānaṃ viṣṇupade dakṣiṇāyane cādau |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe ‘tīte tathodagayanaṃ bhūri phalam ||
(etac ca phalādhikyapratipādanārtham uktam) |
parvakālas tu saṃkrānteḥ prāg ūrdhvaṃ ca bhaved iti |
tad āha devalaḥ |
saṃkrāntisamayaḥ sūkṣmo durjñeyaḥ piśitakṣaṇaiḥ |
tadyogaś cāpy adhaś cordhvaṃ triṃśannāḍyaḥ pavitritāḥ ||
āsannasaṃkramaṃ puṇyaṃ dinārdhaṃ snānadānayoḥ |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor viṣuvaty ayane dine ||
yāyāḥ sanihitā nāḍyas tās tāḥ puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ |
[73] (ayam arthaḥ sarvāsv api saṃkrāntiṣu atītatvam anāgatatvaṃ cānādṛtya atra dinārdhe atītānāgatā vā saṃkrāntiḥ saṃnihitā bhavati tatra snānadānādikaṃ kāryam iti) | vasiṣṭhas tu viśeṣam āha |
triṃśatkarkaṭake nāḍyo makare viṃśtiḥ smṛtāḥ |
vartamāne tulameṣe nāḍyas tūbhayato daśa ||
(atra vartamāna ubhayata iti ca sarvair eva karkaṭakādibhiḥ saṃbadhyate) |
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatītāyām aṣṭir uktās tu nāḍikāḥ |
puṇyākhhyā viṣṇupadyāś ca prāk paścād api ṣoḍaśa ||
aṣṭiḥ ṣoḍaśa | ṣaḍaśītyām atītāyām iti puṇyabhūyastvābhiprāyeṇaitat | (ṣaḍaśītimukhe ‘pi pūrvam api puṇyakālasya pratipāditatvāt) | tad uktaṃ smṛtyantare |
viṣṇupadyāṃ dhanur mīnanṛyukkanyāsu vai yadā |
pūrvottaragato rātrau bhānoḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ bhavet ||
pūrvāhṇe tu pañcaiva śraute smārte ca karmaṇi |
(anena rātrau ṣaḍaśītyām atītāyām uttaradine pūrvāhṇe pañcanādyaḥ puṇyā bhavanti) | bhāvinyāṃ ca pūrvadivase aparāhṇe pañcanāḍyaḥ puṇyā bhavantīty ucyate | nṛyuk mithunarāśiḥ |
ahni saṃkramaṇe puṇyam ahaḥ kṛtsnaṃ prakīrtitam ||
[74]        rātrau saṃkramaṇe puṇyaṃ dinārdhaṃ snānadānayoḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ saṃkramaṇe cordhvam udayāt praharadvayam ||
pūrṇe ced ardharātre tu yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
prāhur dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ muktvā makarakarkaṛau ||
ayam arthaḥ pūrvarātrasaṃkramaṇe pūrvasyāhna uttarārdhe dānādikriyā | apararātrasaṃkramaṇe tu uttaradivasasya pūrvāhṇe dānādi kriya | ayanarātrasaṃkrame tu uttaradivasasya pūrvāhṇe dānādi kriya | madhyarātrasaṃkrame tu dinadvayaṃ puṇyam | rātrau snānadānādi pratiṣedhāt | yas tu saṃśrūyate | saṃkrāntyādiṣu rātrāv api snānadānādikaṃ kuryād iti tad dakṣiṇottarāyaṇaviṣayam | ata evoktam muktvā makarakarkaṭāv iti | tataś ca makarakarkaṭayo rātrāv api snānadānānugrahe yā yāḥ saṃnihitā nāḍya ity avadheyam | rātrau snānadānādipratiṣedhas tu saṃkrāntyantare vyatiṣṭhata eveti |
viṣuvādiṣu sūkṣmapuṇyakālam āha gālavaḥ |
viṣuve ṣaṇmuhūrtaṃ syāt ṣaḍaśītimukhe dvayam |
tathā viṣṇupade trīṇi puṇyāni munayo viduḥ \\
phalam āha bharadvājaḥ |
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ tu yad dānaṃ yad dānaṃ viṣuve dvaye |
dṛśyate sāgarasyāntas tasyānto naiva vidyate ||
viṣṇupadādisūkṣmatamaṃ puṇyakālam āha gālavaḥ |
sthirabhe viṣṇupadaṃ ḍaḍaśītimukhaṃ dvitanubhe tulāmeṣe |
viṣuvanturye dakṣāyanaṃ mṛge saubhyakaṃ sūrye ||
[75] pūrvaślokair vyākhyātam etat |
ayanāṃśakatulyena kālenaitat sphuṭaṃ bhavet |
sarvaviṣṇupadādyuktabhedādi hy ayane ‘nyathā ||
mṛgakarkādige sūrye yāmyodagayane sati |
tadā saṃkrāntidāne syur uktā viṣṇupadādayaḥ ||
ayam arthaḥ | rāśiṃ prati triṃśadaṃśakā bhavanti sūryaś ca pratidinam ekaikam aṃśaṃ bhuṅkte tatra yāvadbhir aṃśair ayanacyutir bhavati tāvatā sūryasya bhogyakālena bhāvināṃ viṣṇupadādikānāṃ cyutir bhavatīti tataś ca yadā dvādaśabhir ayanacyutir bhavati tadābhāvinyāḥ saṃkrānter dvādaśabhir dinair arvāk puṇyakālo bhavati tasmiṃś ca tacchāntinimittaṃ dānādi kartavyam iti evaṃ nyūnātirikteṣv api boddhavyam | na kevalam ādityasyaiva saṃkramasamaye puṇyakālaḥ kiṃ tu sarveṣām api grahāṇāṃ nakṣatrarāśisaṃkrame puṇyakālo bhavatīti || tad uktaṃ jyotiḥśrāstre |
nakṣatrarāsyo ravisaṃkrame syur arvākparatrāpi rasendunāḍyaḥ |
puṇyās tathendos tridharāpalair yugā ekaiva nādī munibhiḥ subhoktā ||
māḍyaś catasraḥ sapalā kujasya budhasya tisraḥ palaviśvayuktāḥ |
ādyardhanāḍyaḥ palasaptayuktā guros tu śukre sapalāś catasraḥ ||
dvināganāḍyaḥ palasaptayuktā śanaiścarasvābhihitāḥ supuṇyāḥ |
ādye tu madhye japadānahomaṃ kurvann avāpnoti surendradhāma ||
asyārthaḥ | ādityasya rāśinakṣatragamane arvāk parataś ca ṣoḍaś ghaṭikāḥ puṇyakālaḥ | tathā candrasyāpi rāśinakṣatragamane ghaṭikaikā palāni [76] trayodaśa arvāk parataś ca puṇyakālaḥ | evaṃ maṅgalasya ghaṭikāś catasraḥ palam ekaṃ ca puṇyakālaḥ | tathā budhasya tisro ghaṭikāś caturdaśapalāni puṇyakālaḥ | bṛhaspater api sārdhāś catasro ghaṭikāḥ saptapalāni puṇyakālaḥ | śukrasya catasro ghaṭikāḥ palam ekaṃ ca puṇyakālaḥ | śanaiścarasyāpi dvāśītighaṭikāḥ saptapalāni puṇyakāla iti |
atha prakīrṇakālāḥ |
āha viṣṇuḥ |
amāvāsyā vyatīpāto grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ |
manvādayo yugādiś ca saṃkrāntir vaidhṛtis tathā ||
dinakṣayaṃ dinacchidram avamañ ca tathā param |
dve ‘yane viṣuvad yugmaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā ||
catasro viṣṇupadyaś ca putrajanmādi cāparam |
ādityādigrahāṇāṃ ca nakṣatraiḥ saha saṃgame ||
vijñeyaḥ puṇyakālo ‘yaṃ jyotirvidbhir vicārya ca |
tatra dānādikaṃ kuryād ātmanaḥ puṇyavṛddhaye ||
amāvāsyādīni prasiddhāni | dinakṣayam uktak padmapurāṇe |
dvau tithyantāv ekavāre yasmin sa syād dinakṣayaḥ |
vasiṣṭho ‘py āha |
ekasmin sāvane tv ahni tathīnāṃ tritayaṃ yadā |
tadā dinakṣayaḥ proktas tatra sāhasrikaṃ phalam ||
dinachidralakṣaṇam āha bhṛguḥ |
tithyardhatithiyogarkṣachedādau śaśiparvaṇaḥ |
sadṛśo divasachidrasamākhyau prāha bhārgavaḥ ||
(ayam arthaḥ | tithyardhaṃ karaṇaṃ karaṇatithiyoganakṣatrāṇām [77] ante ādau ca parvakālaḥ somagrahaṇatulyaḥ sa ca dinachidrasaṃjña iti) | kālamānam apy uktaṃ tenaiva |
chedādikālaḥ kathitas tithikṛtyor ghatīdvayam |
nāgavahnipalopetaṃ tadbhe (?) tattvapalair yutam ||
palaiḥ śoḍaśabhir yuktaṃ nāḍikādvitayaṃ yuteḥ |
chedādisamayaḥ prokto dāne ‘nantaphalapradaḥ ||
kṛtiḥ karaṇam | nāgaḥ aṣṭau | vahnayaḥ trayaḥ | bhaṃ nakṣatram | tattvaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | yutiḥ yogaḥ | tad ayam arthaḥ siddho bhavati | (tithikaraṇayor ādyante ghaṭikādvayam aṣṭatriṃśatpalāni puṇyakālaḥ) |
(nakṣatrasya tu pañcaviṃśatipalair yuktaṃ ghaṭikādvayam) |
yogasyāpi ṣoḍaśabhiḥ palair yuktaṃ ghaṭikādvayam iti) ||
avamalakṣaṇam āha viṣṇuḥ |
tithitrayaṃ spṛśaty eko vāraḥ syād avamaṃ hi tat |
trivāraspṛk tithir yatra dinaspṛk ca tad ucyate ||
(atra dinatrayāvamayor iyān bhedaḥ) |
yatra tithidvayāvasāne vārāvasānaṃ sa dinakṣayaḥ |
yatra tithidvayāvasāne ‘pi vārānuvṛttiḥ so ‘vama iti |
brahmaprokta |
ekādaśy apy amāvasyā pūrṇimā putrajanma ca |
vaidhṛtiś ca vyatīpāto bhadrā cāvamavāsaraḥ ||
****nyādayas te syur indraparvasamānakāḥ |
krāntisāmyaṃ dinachidraṃ grahāṇāṃ bhagamas tathā ||
[78] bhagamaḥ rāśinakṣatreṣu gamanam | devīpurāṇe |
vyatīpāto viṣṇupadaṃ śaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā |
krāntisāmyam amāvāsyā grahaṇaṃ caidhṛtiś ca yaḥ ||
ityādi puṇyakālas tu homadānādikarmaṇaḥ ||
sakandapurāṇe |
grahaṇaṃ candrasūryābhyām uttarāyaṇam uttamam |
viṣuvaṃ savyatīpātaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukaṃ tathā ||
dinachidrāṇi saṃkrāntir jñeyaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ punaḥ |
iti kālaḥ samākhyātaḥ puṃsāṃ puṇyavivardhanaḥ ||
asmin dattāni dānāni snānahomatapāṃsi ca |
anantaphaladāni syuḥ svargamokṣapradāny api ||
āha cyavanaḥ: “amāvāsyāsaṃkrāntivyatīpātaviṣuvāyanaṣaḍaśītimukhaviṣṇupadādivaidhṛti-grahaṇāntaṃ sa eva puṇyakālaḥ” |
ayane ṣaḍaśītau ca candrasūryagrahe tathā |
yugādau vaidhṛtau caiva dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||
āha śātātapaḥ |
ayaneṣu tu yad dattaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca |
candrasūryoparāge ca dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||
nāradaḥ |
viśākhāsu yadā bhānuḥ kṛttikāsu ca candramāḥ |
sa yogaḥ padmako nāma puṣkareṣv iti durlabhaḥ ||
atha niṣiddhakālāḥ | tatra śaṅkhalikhitau |
āhāraṃ maithunaṃ nidrāṃ samdhyākāle tu varjayet |
[79]        karma cādhyayanaṃ caiva tathā dānapratigrahau ||
skandapurāṇe |
rātrau dānaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācid api kenacit |
haranti rākṣasā yasmāt tasmād dātur bhayāvaham ||

ato nivarjayet prājño dādādiṣu mahāniśām ||
tathā snānaṃ caiva mahādānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ tun a tarpaṇam |
prathame ‘bde na kurvīta mahāgurunipātane ||
āha jyotiḥparāśaraḥ |
agnyādheyaṃ pratiṣṭāṃ ca yajñadānādyabhigrahān |
māṅgalyam abhiṣekaṃ ca malamāse vivarjayet ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgādipratiṣṭhodaṅmukhe ravau |

malamāsaḥ adhikamāsaḥ | tallakṣaṇam āha pracetāḥ |
ekarāśisthite sūrye yadā darśadvayaṃ bhavet |
havyakavyakriyāhantā tadā jñeyo ‘dhimāsakaḥ ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
vatsarāntargataḥ pāpo yajñānāṃ phalanāśakṛt |

kurvann anartham evāśu kuryāc cātmavināśanam ||
hārītaḥ |

tathaivābhyudayaṃ kāryaṃ nityam ekaṃ hi sarvadā ||

atha nimittānurodhena sadā puṇyakālāḥ | viṣṇudharmottare |

na hi kālaṃ pratīkṣeta jalaṃ dātuṃ tṛṣānvite |
[82]        annodakaṃ sadā deyam ity āha bhagavān manuḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
arhaprasūtāṃ gāṃ dadyāt kālādi na vicārayan |
kālaḥ sa eva grahaṇe yadā sā dvimukhī tu gauḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
āsannamṛtyunā deyā gauḥ savatsā tu pūrvavat |

vahnipurāṇāt |

śraddhāniṣṭhāḥ pratiṣṭhāś ca dharmāḥ śraddhaiva kīrtitāḥ ||
śrutimātrarasāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvarāḥ |

kāyakleśair na bahubhir na caivārthasya rāśibhiḥ |
dharmaḥ saṃprāpyate sūkṣmaḥ śraddhāhīnaiḥ surair api ||
śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā jñānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ |
śraddhāsvargaś ca mokṣaś ca śraddhā sarvam idaṃ jagat ||
