nāpnuyāt sakalaṃ kiṃcit śraddadhānas tato bhavet ||
vedavyāsaḥ |
śraddhā vai sātvikī devī sūryasya duhitā nṛpa |
savitrī prasavitrī ca jīvaviśvāsinī tathā ||
vāgvṛddhaṃ trāyate śraddhā manovṛddhaṃ ca bhārata ||
mahābhārate |
kriyāvān śraddadhānaś ca dātā prājño ‘nasūyakaḥ |
dharmādharmaviśeṣajñaḥ sarvaṃ tarata dustaram ||
[86]   skandapurāṇe |
śraddhā māteva jananī jñānasya sukṛtasya ca |
tasmāc chraddhāṃ samutpādya jñānaṃ sukṛtam arjayet ||
manuḥ |
śraddhayeṣṭaṃ ca pūrtaṃ ca nityaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
śraddhākṛte hy akṣaye te bhavataḥ svāgatair dhanaiḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
dātavyaṃ pratyahaṃ pātre nimitteṣu viśeṣataḥ |
yācitenāpi dātavyaṃ śraddhāputaṃ tu śaktitaḥ ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
mantrājyadoṣād dhome tu tapasīndriyadoṣataḥ |
nyūnatā syān na dāne tu śraddhāyukte bhavet kvacit ||
(* etac ca deśanirūpaṇaṃ ca pūrvaṃ vratakhaṇḍādāv eva prapañcitam, iha tu pātrādidānāṅganirūpaṇapratijñānirvahaṇārthaṃ diṅmānam eva pradarśitam | na cātra bhaviṣyapurāṇamatena dānāṅgapañcake nirūpyamāṇe dānāṅgabhūtasyāpi dātuḥ kathaṃ pṛthag anupādānam (?) iti śaṅkanīyaṃ dānasya dātṛvyatirekeṇānupapattes tenaiva tadākṣepāt evaṃ tarhi deśakālāder apy anupādānaṃ syāt |
atha sāmānyenaiva tadākṣepe ‘pi brahmāvartādiviśeṣalābhārthaṃ tannirūpaṇam iti dātāpi tarhi śucitvādiviśeṣalābhārthaṃ nirūpaṇīyaḥ syāt — ucyate tattadvidhāyakavākyagatākhyāta-pratyayopāttatvād eva tadanirūpaṇaṃ na tv ākṣepāt śucitvādiviśeṣalābhas tu vākyāntarād iti kartranabhidhānapakṣe tu pratyayopāttabhāvanayaivāsādhāraṇyena tadākṣepān na deśādi sāmyam | evamādikleśaparyālocanayā ṣaḍaṅgadānam iti vadatā devalena tu nirūpyata eva **) | tathā hi |
dātā pratigrahītā ca śraddhā deyaṃ ca dharmayuk |
deśakālau ca dānānām aṅgāny etāni ṣaḍ viduḥ || iti |
[87] (*tallakṣaṇaṃ tu prāg abhihitam iti tu na punar ādriyāmahe | na tu śraddhādivaditikartavyatāpi dānāṅgam ity ataḥ pratidānīyaiva) || yad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
deśakālaupāyena dravyaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam |
pātre pradīyate yat tat sakalaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam || iti |
upāyaḥ itikartavyatā | atrocyate | (* itikartavyatāviśeṣās tāvat tatra dānaviśeṣeṣv eva pratipādayiṣyante teṣām iha pratipādayitum aśakyatvāt sāmānyenetikartavyatā punar avaśyaṃ vaktavyeti tadartham idaṃ prakaraṇam ārabhyate | iti śraddhānirūpaṇam *) |
atha dānasāmānyavidhir ucyate | tatra dātṛdharmāḥ |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
samyak saṃsādhanaṃ karma kartavyam adhikāriṇā |
niṣkāmena mahāvīra kāmyaṃ kāmānvitena ca ||
ācārayuktaḥ śraddhāvān prājño yo ‘dhyātmavittamaḥ |
karmaṇāṃ phalam āpnoti nyāyārjitadhanaś ca yaḥ ||
samyak prathamakalpādinā | saṃsādhanaṃ yathāvihitasādhanam | adhikāriṇā arthinā samarthena viduṣā ca | adhyātmavittamaḥ paralokaphalabhāginy ātmani dṛḍhapratyayavān | nyāyārjitadhanaḥ svavṛttyarjitadhanaḥ | āpastambaḥ: “prayojayitānumantā karteti svarganarakaphaleṣu bhāginaḥ yo bhūya ārabhate tasmin phalaviśeṣaḥ” | yājñavalkyaḥ |
vidhidiṣṭaṃ tu yat karma karoty avidhinā tu yaḥ |
[88]        phalaṃ na kiṃcid āpnoti kleśamātraṃ hi tasya tat ||
manuḥ |
prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo ‘nukalpena vartate |
na sāmparāyikaṃ tasya durmater vidyate phalam ||
sāmparāyikaṃ pāralaukikam | yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
śraddhāvidhisamāyuktaṃ karma yat kriyate nṛbhiḥ |
suviśuddhena bhāvena tad ānantyāya kalpate ||
vidhihīnaṃ bhāvaduṣṭaṃ kṛtam aśraddhayā ca yat |
tad dharanty asurās tasya mūḍhasya hy akṛtātmanaḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare |
kāmyo dānavidhiḥ pārtha kriyamāṇo yathātatham |
phalāya munibhiḥ prokto viparīto bhayāvahaḥ ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
praśastadeśakāle ca pātre dattaṃ tad akṣayam |
koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ dadatas tv asya naśyati ||
sakalāṅgo ‘pi san bhāro yasya dānakriyāvidhau (?) |
saṃbhaved api pāpīyān sa sadyo muktim iṣyate ||
devīpurāṇe |
śucinā bhāvapūtena kṣāntisatyavratādinā |
api sarṣapamātro ‘pi dātāraṃ tārayed iha ||
dakṣaḥ |
dānaṃ ca vidhivad deyaṃ kale pātre guṇānvite ||
yamaḥ |
sarvatra guṇavad dānaṃ śvapākādiṣv api smṛtam |
deśe kale vidhānena pātre dattaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
guṇavat uttamaphalam | tathā |
dānaṃ hi bahumānād yo guṇavadbhyaḥ prayacchati |
sa tu pretya dhanaṃ labdhvā putrapautraiḥ sahāśnute ||
paraṃ cānupahatyeha dānaṃ datvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
[89]        sukhodayaṃ sukhodarkaṃ pretya vai labhate dhanam ||
anupahatya pīḍām anutpādya | sukhodarkaṃ sukhottaraphalam | rāmāyaṇe |
nāvajñayā pradātavyaṃ kiṃcid vā kenacit kvacit |
avajñayā hi yad dattaṃ dātus tad doṣaṃ āvahet ||
śātātapaḥ |
abhigamya tu yad dānaṃ yac ca dānam ayācitam |
vidyate sāgarasyāntas tasyānto naiva vidyate ||
pracchannāni ca dānāni jñānaṃ ca nirahaṃkṛtam |
tapāṃsi ca sutaptāni teṣāṃ phalam anantakam ||
brahmaprokte |
guptādhyāyī guptadātā guptapūjāgnisatkriyaḥ |
pūjyate sarvalokeṣu sarvadevaiḥ śatakratuḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
svayaṃ nītvā tu yad dānaṃ bhaktyā pātrāya dīyate |
tat sahasraguṇaṃ bhūtvā dātāram upatiṣṭhati ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
kṛte pradīyate gatvā tretāyāṃ dīyate gṛhe |
dvāpare ca prārthayati kalua cānugamānvite ||
(* pratigrahītṛgṛhaṃ gatvā yad dīyate tat kṛte yuge |
dattaṃ bhavati) pratigrahītāraṃ svagṛham āhūya yad dīyate |
tat tretāyuge dattaṃ bahatīty arthaḥ | evam uttaratrāpi | vahnipurāṇe |
tamovṛtas tu yo dadyād bhayāt krodhāt tathaiva ca |
nṛpa dānaṃ tu tat sarvaṃ bhuṅkte garbhasya eva ca ||
īrṣāmandhumanāś caiva dambhārthaṃ cārthakāraṇāt |
yo dadāti dvijātibhyaḥ sa bālatve tad aśnute ||
deśe kale ca pātre ca yo dadāti dvijātiṣu |
parituṣṭena manasā yauvane tu tad aśnute ||
[90]        vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ ca saṃdhyopāsanavarjitam |
yad dānaṃ dīyate tat tu vṛddhakāle samaśnute ||
āha manuḥ |
na vismayeta tapasā vaded iṣṭvā na cānṛtam |
nārto vipravaded viprān na datvā parikīrtayet ||
yajño ‘nṛtena kṣarati tapaḥ kṣarati vismayāt |
āyur viprāpavādena dānaṃ tu paritīrtanāt ||
yamaḥ |
āśāṃ kṛtvā hy adātāraṃ dānakāle nivedhakam |
datvā saṃtapyate yas tu tam āhur brahmaghātakam ||
hārītaḥ |
dānaṃ jñānaṃ tapas tyāgo mantrakarmavidhikriyāḥ |
maṅgalācāraniyamāḥ śaucabhraṣṭasya niṣphalāḥ ||
āha pracetāḥ |
snāto ‘dhikāro bhavati daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
pavitrāṇāṃ tathā jāpye dāne ca vidhicodite ||
vāyupurāṇe |
kriyāṃ yaḥ kurute mohād anācamyeha nāstikaḥ |
bhavanti na tathā tasya kriyāḥ sarvā na saṃśayaḥ ||
śāṭyāyanaḥ |
dānam ācamanaṃ homaṃ bhojanaṃ devatārcanam |
prauḍhapādena kurvīta svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||
āsanārūḍhapādas tu jānvor vā jaṅghayos tathā |
kṛtāvasakthiko yaś ca prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyate ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
yaj jale śuṣkavastreṇa sthale caivārdravāsasā |
japo homas tathā dānaṃ tat sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
homadevārcanādyāsu kriyāsv ācamane tathā |
naikavastraḥ pravarteta dvijavācanake jape ||
dvijavācanake dvijasvastivācanādau | [91] śātātapaḥ |
savyād aṃsāt paribhraṣṭakaṭideśabhṛtāmbaraḥ |
ekavastraṃ tu taṃ vidyāt daive pitrye ca varjayet ||
ślokagautamaḥ |
snāne dāne jape home daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
badhnīyān nāsurīṃ kakṣāṃ śeṣakāle yathā ruciḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
paridhānād bahiḥ kakṣā nibaddhā hy āsurī bhavet |
dharmakarmaṇi tadvidbhir varjanīyā prayatnataḥ ||
bahiḥ kakṣā bahirnirgatā kakṣety arthaḥ | manuḥ |
na kuryāt kasyacit pīḍāṃ karmaṇā manasā girā |
ācarann abhiṣekaṃ tu karmāṇy apy anyathā caran ||
saṃdhyayor ubhayor japye bhojane dantadhāvane |
pitṛkārye ca daive ca tathā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ||
gurūṇāṃ saṃnidhau dāne yoge caiva viśeṣataḥ |
eṣu maunaṃ samātiṣṭhan svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
parāśaraḥ |
snāne dāne jape home daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
savyāpasavyau kartavyau sapavitrau karau dvijaiḥ ||
laghuhārītaḥ |
jape home tathā dāne svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇe |
aśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kuryāt suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥ ||
darbhahīnā tu yā saṃdhyā yac ca dānaṃ vinodakam |
asaṃkhyātaṃ ca yaj japtaṃ tat sarvaṃ niṣprayojakam ||
hārītaḥ |
devāś ca pitaraś caiva tapoyajñadānānām īśate mantāraḥ sarvakāryasādhanānām ārtibhayopasargebhyo rakṣitāro bhavanti, mantra devatās tadā evaṃ siddhamantravat karoti, devavat karoti, yad dadāti devatābhir eva tad dadāti, yat pratigṛhṇāti devatābhir eva tat prati[92]gṛhṇāti, tasmān nāmantravat pratigṛhṇīyāt yat tv amantrataḥ pratipāditā hi devatās tūṣṇīṃ pratigṛhṇīyur hi śaṭhā bhavanti tasmān mantravad adbhir avokṣya dadyād ālabhya vā |
avokṣya prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā | ālabhya sodavyena pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā |
āpastambaḥ: “sarvāṇy udakapūrvāṇi dānāni | yathāśruti vihāre” | vihāre, yajñe anvāhāryadānādau yathāśruti yāvad eva śrutaṃ tāvad eva kuryān nodakapūrvatādiniyama ity ārthaḥ | varāhapurāṇe |
toyaṃ dadyād dvijakare dāne vidhir ayaṃ smṛtaḥ |
sakuśodakahastaś ca dadāmīti tathā vadet ||
gautamaḥ |
antarjānu karaṃ krtvā sakuśaṃ tu tilodakam |
phalāny api ca saṃdhāya pradadyāt śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
(* pātrāsaṃnidhāne tu nāradīyapurāṇe viśeṣa uktaḥ) |
manasā pātram uddiśya jalaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipet |
vidyate sāgarasyānto dānasyānto na vidyate ||
dhaumyaḥ |
dānakāle tu saṃprāpte pātrasyāsaṃnidhau jalam |
anyaviprakare datvā dānaṃ pātre nidhīyate ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmatāt |
pātraṃ manasi saṃcintya kriyāvantaṃ guṇānvitam |
deśe kale ca saṃprāpte deyam apsu vinikṣipet ||
(* ubhayāsaṃnidhāne tu viśeṣas tatraivoktam) |
dravyapātravikarṣaś cet parokṣaṃ datum udyataḥ |
tat yāyād vai bhuvaṃ pātraṃ dravyam ādityadaivatam ||
[93] dhaumyaḥ |
parokṣe ‘pi tu yad dattaṃ tīrthe snāne na sodakam |
tad dānaṃ sodakaṃ prāhur anantaphaladāyakam ||
parokṣe kalpitaṃ dānaṃ pātrābhāve kathaṃ bhavet |
gotrajebhyas tathā dadyāt tadabhāve svabandhuṣu ||
parokṣe ‘pi ca yad dattaṃ bhāvapūrveṇa cetasā |
gurumitradvijātibhyas tat tu dānam anantakam ||
parokṣe khalu yad dattaṃ svastyakṣaravivarjitam |
dṛśyate sāgarasyāntas tasyānto naiva dṛśyate ||
āpastambaḥ |
tasmād om ity udāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ |
parvartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinaḥ ||
trimātras tu prayoktavyaḥ satataṃ brahmavādinaḥ |
tiśraḥ sārdhās tu kartavyā mātrās tatvārthacintakaiḥ |
devatādhyānakāle na plutaṃ kuryāt na saṃśayaḥ ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
nāmagotre samuccārya saṃpradānasya cātmanaḥ |
saṃpradeyaṃ prayacchanti kanyādāne tu puṃstrayam ||
(* puṃstrayam iti prapitāmahādipuruṣatrayam ity arthaḥ) | tad uktam |
nāndīmukhe vivāhe ca prapitāmahapūrvakam |
nāma saṃkīrtayan vidvān anyatra pitṛpūrvakam ||
tathā dānahomajapān kurvann āsīnaḥ kuśasaṃstare |
eṣāṃ phalam anantaṃ tu labhate prāṅmukho naraḥ ||
smṛtyantarāt |
nāmagotre samuccārya samyak śraddhānvito dadet |
saṃkīrtya deśakālādi tubhyaṃ saṃpradade iti ||
na mameti svasvatvasya nivṛttim api kīrtayet |
[94] ṣaṭtriṃśanmatāt |
praṇīte tu samiddhe ‘gnau juhuyād vyāhṛtitrayam |
udagagreṣu darbheṣu pātraṃ teṣūpapādayet ||
prāgagreṣu svayaṃ sthitvā dātā ca parameśvaram |
dhyātvā svapuṇyam uddiśya dakṣiṇāṃ pratipādayet ||
samastā vyāhṛtīr hutvā tatropari samāpayet |
brāhmaṇaṃ pratipatyātha tataḥ pātraṃ visarjayet ||
anena vidhinā dānaṃ dātavyaṃ homapūrvakam |
tat karma dakṣiṇāvarjaṃ homavarjaṃ ca nārhati ||
etaṃ ca vihitāṅgabhūtahomakeṣu homānuvādapuraḥsaram upadarśitaṃ tattadguṇavidhiparam, anyathā hy atathādṛṣṭaśiṣṭācāreṣu tāmbūlādidāneṣv api prasaṅgaḥ syāt |
atha pratigrahītṛdharmāḥ |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
śuciḥ pavitrapāṇiś ca gṛhṇīyād uttarāmukhaḥ |
abhīṣṭadevatāṃ dhyāyan manasā vijitendriyaḥ ||
kṛtottarīyako nityam antarjānukaras tathā |
dātur iṣṭam abhidyāyan prahṇīyāt (?) prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
āpastambaḥ |
ārdravāsās tu yaḥ kuryāt japahomaṃ pratigraham |
sarvaṃ tad rākṣasaṃ vindet bahirjānu ca yat kṛtam ||
bodhāyanaḥ |
kāṣāyavāsā kurute japahomapratigrahān |
tad devagamaṃ bhavati havyakavyaṃ svadhā haviḥ ||
chagaleyaḥ |
hastamadhye brahmatīrthaṃ dakṣiṇāgrahaṇe na tu ||
āha pracetāḥ: “dakṣiṇamadhyahaste brāhmaṇasyāgneyaṃ tīrtham āgneyena pratigṛhīyāt” iti |
[95] gāruḍapurāṇe |
snātaḥ samyag upaspṛśya dadhāno dhautavāsasī |
sapavitrakaraś caiva pratigṛhṇīta dharmavit ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
mṛtake sūtake viprā na tu grāhyaḥ pratigrahaḥ |
tatrāpi ca tathā grāhyā narair abhayadakṣiṇā ||
kālaḥ sa eva grahaṇe yadā bhayam upasthitam |
pratigrahās tathānye tu grāhyā nāśucinā dvijāḥ ||
abhyaktena ca dharmajñās tathā muktaśikhena ca |
snātaḥ samyag upaspṛśya gṛhṇīyāt prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
pratigrahītā savitrīṃ sarvatraivānukīrtayet |
tatas tu kīrtayet sārdhaṃ dravyeṇa dravyadevatām ||
samāpayet tataḥ paścāt kāmastuyā pratigraham |
tadante kīrtayet svasti pratigrahavidhis tv ayam ||
sāvitrī savitṛdevatyā ṛk devasyatvetyādiprasiddhā | dravyadevatām abhayaṃ sarvadaivatyam ityādivakṣyamāṇām, kāmastutyā ko ‘dāt kamā adād itimantreṇa, śākhāntare tu kāmaḥ kāmāyetyādi prasiddhā | ādityapurāṇe |
oṃkāram uccaran prājño draviṇaṃ sa kuśodakam |
gṛhṇīyād dakṣiṇe haste tadante svasti kīrtayet ||
tathā |
pratigrahaṃ paṭhed uccaiḥ pratigṛhya dvijottamān |
mantraṃ paṭhet tu rājanye upāṃśu ca tathā viśi ||
manasā tu tathā śūdre svastivācanam eva ca |
soṃkāraṃ brāhmaṇe kuryān niroṃkāraṃ mahīpatau ||
[96]        upāṃśu ca tathā vaiśye manasā svasti śūdraje |
pratigrahaṃ pratigrahamantraḥ | mantraṃ madhyamasvaram | brāhmaṇe dātari soṃkāraṃ svastivācanaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ kṣatriyādiṣu. | viṣṇudharmottare |
abhayaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhūmir vai viṣṇudevatā |
kanyā dāsas tathā dāsī prājāpatyāḥ prakīṛtitāḥ ||
tathā caikaśakaṃ sarvaṃ kathitaṃ yamadaivatam |
mahiṣaś ca tathā yāmya uṣṭro vai nairṛto bhavet ||
raudrī dhenur vinirdiṣṭā chāgam āgneyam ādiśet |
meṣaṃ tu vāruṇaṃ vindyād varāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā ||
āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ sarve kathitā vāyudevatāḥ |
jalāśayāni sarvāṇi vāridhānīṃ kamaṇḍalum ||
kumbhaṃ ca karakaṃ caiva vāruṇāni nibodhata |
samudrajāni ratnāni vāruṇāni dvijottamāḥ ||
āgneyaṃ kanakaṃ proktaṃ sarvalohāni cāpy atha |
prājāpatyāni sarvāṇi pakvānnam api ca dvijāḥ ||
jñeyāś ca sarvagandhās tu gāndharvā vai vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
bārhaspatyaṃ smṛtaṃ vāsaḥ saumyā jñeyā rasās tathā ||
pakṣiṇas tu tathā sarve vāyavyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
vidyā brāhmī vinirdiṣṭā vidyopakaraṇāni ca ||
sārasvatāni jñeyāni pustakādīni paṇḍitaiḥ |
sarveṣāṃ śālyabhāṇḍānāṃ viśvakarmānudaivataḥ ||
drumāṇām atha puṣpāṇāṃ śākair haritakaiḥ saha |
[97]        phalānām api sarveṣāṃ tathā jñeyo vanaspatiḥ ||
matsyamāṃse vinirdiṣṭe prājāpatye tathaiva ca |
chatraṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śayyāṃ ratham āsanam eva ca ||
upānahau tathā yānaṃ yac cānyat prāṇivarjitam |
tat tu cāṅgirasatvena pratigṛhṇīta mānavaḥ ||
śūropayogi yat sarvaṃ śāstradharmadhvajādikam |
raṇopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ vijñeyaṃ sarvadaivatam ||
gṛhṇantu śakradaivatyaṃ yad anuktaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
taj jñeyaṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ sarvaṃ vā dvijasattamāḥ ||
dravyāṇām atha sarveṣāṃ devasaṃśrayaṇān naraḥ |
vācayej jalam ādāya kareṇātha pratigraham ||
datum atra prayogānte hy amukasmai surāya vai |
idam oṃ pratigṛhṇāmitadante svasti kīrtayet ||
tad yathā: agnaye hiraṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇāmīti |
dravyāṇy athāvyathādasya (?) spṛṣṭvā tān brāhmaṇaḥ paṭhet |
kanyādāne tun a paṭhed dravyāṇāṃ tu pṛthak pṛthak ||
pratigrahe dvijā śreṣṭhās tathaivāntarbhavanti te |
pratigrahasya yo dharmyaṃ na jānāti dvijo vidhim ||
dravyastainyasamāyukto narakaṃ pratipadyate |
vidhiṃ tu dharmyaṃ vijñāya brāhmaṇas tu pratigrahe ||
dātrā saha taraty eva mahādurgāṇy asau dhruvam |
[98]        tasmād uktaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇas tu pratigrahe ||
ātmanaḥ śreyaso yogaṃ kuryād dānaṃ tathaiva ca |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vidhir jñeyaḥ pratigrahe ||
tathā |
bhūmeḥ pratigrahaṃ kuryād bhūmiṃ kurvan pradakṣiṇam |
kare gṛhītvā kanyāṃ tu dāsadāsyau dvijottamaḥ ||
karaṃtu hṛdi vinyasya dharmyo jñeyaḥ pratigrahaḥ |
pratigrahaṃ svīkāram |
āruhya ca gajasyoktaḥ karṇe cāśvasya kīrtitaḥ ||
tathā caikaśaphānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ |
pratigṛhṇīta tān śṛṅge pucche kṛṣṇājinaṃ tathā ||
(* sāmānyenaikaśaphānāṃ karṇe pratigrahaḥ uktaḥ, ye tv ekaśaphāḥ śṛṅgiṇaḥ, tān viśeṣataḥ śṛṅge pratigṛhṇītety arthaḥ ) |
karṇajāḥ paśavaḥ sarve grāhyā pucche vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
gṛhṇīyān mahiṣaṃ śṛṅge kharaṃ vai pṛṣṭhadeśataḥ ||
pratigraham athoṣṭrasya yānānāṃ cādhirohaṇāt |
bījānāṃ muṣṭim ādāya ratnāny ādāya sarvataḥ ||
vastraṃ daśāntād ādadyāt paridhāyātha vā punaḥ |
āruhyopānahau mañcam āruhyaiva ca pāduke ||
dharmadhvajau ca saṃspṛṣṭvā praviśya ca tathā gṛham |
avatīrya ca sarvāṇi jalasthānāni vai dvijāḥ ||
īṣāyāṃ tu ratho grāhyaḥ chatraṃ daṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca |
drumāṃś ca pratigṛhṇīyān mūlanyastakaro dvijaḥ ||
[99]        āyudhāni samādāya tathāmucya vibhūṣaṇam ||
īṣāyāṃ daṇḍāgre | āmucya vadhvety arthaḥ | pariśiṣṭe |
parigṛhṇīta gāṃ pucche karṇe vā hastinaṃ kare |
mūrdhni dāsīm ajāñ caiva pṛṣṭhe ‘śvataragardabhau ||
aśvaṃ karṇe śaṭe vāpi antam uddiśya dhārayet |
śayyāsanagṛhakṣetraṃ saṃspṛśyādāya kāñcanam ||
uṣṭraṃ ca kakudi spṛṣṭvā mṛgāṃś ca mahiṣādikān |
godhāmakhavidhānena pucche saṃspṛśya pakṣiṇaḥ ||
daṃṣṭriṇo daṃśitaṃ caiva tathā kṣudramṛgāṃś ca ye |
ajādīnāṃ tu sattvānām eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
chatraṃ daṇḍe tarūn mūle phalaṃ saṃgṛhya gauravāt |
pragṛhyopānahaumañ ca vācayet pratimucya vai ||
vāsas tv atha samādāya kanyāśīrṣe ‘tha vā kare |
ṛtau bhāryāṃ parapūrvāṃ pratiggṛhṇīta cākṣatām ||
putram utsaṅgam āropya pratigṛhṇīta dattakam |
rathaṃ rathamukhe spṛṣṭvā pratigṛhṇīta kūvare ||
kūvaraḥ yugādhārakāṣṭham |
yugyakāñcanavastrāṇāṃ nāṅgayukte pratigrahaḥ ||
athobhayadharmāḥ | garuḍapurāṇe |
daivaṃ vā karma pitryaṃ vā nāśuciḥ karum arhasi |
snānam eva dvijātīnāṃ paraṃ śuddhikaraṃ smṛtam ||
ataḥ snāto ‘rhatām eti dāne caiva pratigrahe |
kṛtam asnāyinā karma rākṣasatvāya kalpate ||
[100]        prajāpatiḥ karmagupteḥ pavitram asṛjat purā |
rakṣoghnam etat paramaṃ munibhiḥ kalpitaṃ save ||
tasmāt tat karayor dhāryaṃ dadatā pratigṛhṇatā |
snānahomajapādīni kurvatā ca viśeṣataḥ ||
saṃtyajya vaiṣṇavaṃ mārgaṃ brahmamārgavinirgatam |
sakṛt pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pavitram abhidhīyate ||
vāyupurāṇe |
dānaṃ pratigraho homo bhojanaṃ balir eva ca |
sāṅguṣṭhena sadā kāryam asurebhyo ‘nyathā bhavet ||
sāṅguṣṭhena aṅgulīsaṅgatāṅguṣṭhena |
etāny eva ca kāryāṇi dānādīni viśeṣataḥ |
antarjānu vidheyāni tadvad ācamanaṃ nṛpa ||
bodhāyanaḥ |
bhojanaṃ havanaṃ dānam upahāraḥ pratigrahaḥ |
bahirjānu na kāryāṇi tadvad ācamanaṃ smṛtam ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
nādhikārī muktakaccho muktacūḍas tathaiva ca |
dāne pratigrahe yajñe brahmayajñādikarmasu ||
devāḥ sametya vastraṃ hi tac ca puṃsām akalpayan |
tataś ca vāsasā hīnam asaṃpūrṇaṃ pracakṣate ||
sottarīyas tataḥ kuryāt sarvakarmāṇi bhāvinaḥ |
adhautaṃ kākadhautaṃ ca paridadhyān na vāsasī ||
dadānaḥ pratigṛhṇaṃś ca dadhyād ahatam eva ca ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
susnātaḥ samyag ācāntaḥ kṛtasaṃdhyādikakriyaḥ |
kāmakrodhavihīnaś ca pāṣaṇḍasparśavarjitaḥ ||
jitendriyaḥ satyavādī pātraṃ dātā ca śasyate ||
[101] tathā |
pramīte gotrapuruṣe sūtake vā samāgame |
daśarātram anarhaḥ syāt kartuṃ dānapratigrahau ||
piṇḍodakādi mṛtake dātuṃ pretāya yujyate |
ācchinnāyāṃ tathā nāḍyāṃ dānārho mṛtasūtake ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
śucir vāpy aśucir vāpi dadyād abhayadakṣiṇām |
śucināśucinā vāpi grāhyobhayam upasthitam ||
chandogapariśiṣṭham | tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
kuśopari niviṣṭena tathā yajñopavītinā |
deyaṃ pratigrahītavyam anyathā viphalaṃ hi tat ||
āha jātūkarṇyaḥ: “oṃkāreṇa dadyāt pratigṛhṇīyāc ca” |
skandapurāṇe |
praṇavo jagatāṃ bījaṃ vedānām ādir eva ca |
eṣa eva paraṃ brahma pavitramayam uttamam ||
tasmāt praṇavam uccārya kāryau dānapratigrahau ||
yamaḥ |
yo ‘rcitaṃ pratigṛhṇāti yo ‘rcayitvā prayacchati |
tāv ubhau gacchataḥ svarge viparīte viparyayaḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
dadyād dānaṃ yathā śaktyā sadābhyarcanapūrvakam |
brāhmaṇaś cāpi gṛhṇīyād bhaktyā dattaṃ pratigraham ||
śātātapaḥ |
praśnapūrvaṃ tu yo dadyād brāhmaṇāya pratigraham |
sa pūrvaṃ narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇas tadanantaram ||
praśnapūrvam iti | etam adhyāyaṃ etam anuvākaṃ vā yadi tvam askhalitaṃ paṭhasi tadā ta etāvad dadāmīty uktvā tathā kṛte yad dīyate tat praśnapūrvakam | vyāsaḥ |
avamānena yo dadyād gṛhṇīyād yaḥ pratigraham |
tāv ubhau narake magnau vasetāṃ śaradāṃ śatam ||
[102] śātātapaḥ |
kāryalobhena yo dadyād gṛhṇīyād yaḥ pratigraham |
dātāgre narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇas tadanantaram ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
pratigraho yo vidhinā pradattaḥ
pratigraho yo vidhinā gṛhītaḥ |
dvayoḥ prayogaś caramaṃ tu kāryaḥ
śreyas tathāpnoti na saṃśayo ‘tra ||
atha miśradharmāḥ | nandipurāṇe |
dāne vidhim avijñāya na hi tad datum arhati |
pratigrahānabhijñaś ca gṛhṇan nirayam aśnute ||
sāvajñaṃ pratigṛhṇāno grahītāp pataty adhaḥ |
kiṃ tvaṃ vetsīti vaktavyo na dātrā brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit ||
so ‘pi pṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ tena dānārthaṃ taṃ na kīrtayet |
yadi tvam etat paṭhasi tadā tubhyam etad dadāmīti sākṣāt parīkṣaṇam atra viṣidhyate, pātratvabodhārtham upāyāntareṇa parīkṣaṇatvam anumatam eva ||
tad uktaṃ yamena |
śīlaṃ saṃvasanāj jñēyaṃ śaucaṃ saṃvyavahārataḥ |
prajñā saṃkathanāj jñeyā tribhiḥ pātraṃ parīkṣyate ||
saṃkathanaṃ śuddhabhāvena vidyākathā | vārāhapurāṇe |
api sarṣapamātraṃ hi na deyaṃ vicikitsatā |
manasā hy ananujñātaḥ pratigṛhṇīta naiva hi ||
dadānaḥ pratigṛhṇaṃś ca yato lobhabhayādinā |
nāpnoti śreyasā yogaṃ nirayaṃ caiva gacchati ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
deśakālavidhānādyair hīnaṃ dānaṃ bhayāvaham |
[103]        dātuḥ pratigrahītuś ca gṛhītam asataḥ sadā ||
ṣaṭtriṃśaṇmatāt |
nāmagotre samuccārya prāṅmukho deyakīrtanāt |
udaṅmukhāya viprāya datvānte svasti vācayet ||
(* deyakīrtanād iti, deyakīrtanottarakālaṃ datvety arthaḥ) |
prākpratyagāsyā vodvāhe dātṛgrāhakayoḥ sthitiḥ |
dadyāt pūrvamukho dravyam eṣa eva vidhiḥ sadā ||
(* yat tu kīrtayanti, “prāṅmukhas tu gṛhṇīyād divāhe tu viparyayaḥ” iti, tasya samūlatve siddhe anuṣṭhānavikalpaḥ, tatrāpy udaṅmukhasaṃpradānavaiśiṣṭyasmṛtes tad evānuṣṭheyam) |
tad uktaṃ smṛtyantare |
dadyāt pūrvamukho dānaṃ gṛhṇīyād uttarāmukhaḥ |
āyur vivardhate dātur grahītuḥ kṣīyate tu tat ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirāja-śrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśārada-śrīhemādiviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe dānāṅgaprakaraṇam
atha paribhāṣāḥ
saṃdhau durdharakālakūṭakuṭile pīyūṣaśaṅkaiva kā
kāntānāṃ madhurādharāsavarasaṃmpardhā sunirdhāritā ||
idraṃ ninditam āha rāhurasanāyogo viyogottaras
taṃniḥsīmasudhānidhānam adhunā hemādrisūrer giraḥ ||
anena sāmānyatayā pratīyate mahītalam |
[104]        anena sāmānyatayā paribhāṣeha kathyate ||
tatrāha yājñavalkyaḥ |
ārṣaṃ chandaś ca daivatyaṃ viniyogas tathaiva ca |
veditavyaṃ prayatnena brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ ||
aviditvā tu yaḥ kuryād yājanādhyayanaṃ japam |
homam antarjalādīni tasya cālpaphalaṃ bhavet ||
tathā |
yaś ca jānāti tattvena ārṣaṃ chandaś ca daivatam |
viniyogaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca mantrārthaṃ jñānakarma ca ||
ekaikasya ṛṣeḥ so ‘pi vandyo hy atithivad bhavet |
devatāyāś ca sāyujyaṃ gacchaty atra na saṃśayaḥ ||
pūrvoktena prakāreṇa ṛṣyādīn vetti yo dvijaḥ |
adhikārī bhavet tasya rahasyādiṣu karmasu ||
tathā |
yena yad ṛṣiṇā dṛṣṭaṃ siddhiḥ prāptā ca yena vai |
mantreṇa tasya tat proktam ṛṣibhir bhāvas tad ārṣakam ||
chandasā chada uddiṣṭaṃ vāsasī iva cākṛte |
ātmā saṃcchādito devair mṛtyor bhītais tu vai purā ||
ādityair vasubhī rudrais tena chandāṃsi tāni vai |
yasya yasya tu mantrasya uddiṣṭā devata tu yā ||
tadākāraṃ bhavet tasya devatvaṃ devatocyate |
purākalpe samutpannā mantrāḥ karmārtha eva ca ||
anena cedaṃ kartavyaṃ viniyogaḥ sa ucyate |
nairuktaṃ yac ca mantrasya viniyogaprayojanam ||
pratiṣṭhānaṃ stutiś caiva brāhmaṇaṃ tad ihocyate |
[105]        evaṃ pañcavidhaṃ yogaṃ jayārthaṃ gṛhy anusmaret ||
home cāntarjale yoge svādhyāye yājate tathā ||
chandogapariśiṣṭam | tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
akriyā trividhā proktā vidvadbhiḥ kāmakāriṇām |
akriyā ca paroktā ca tṛtīyā vāyathākriyā ||
svaśākhāśeṣam utsṛjya paraśākhāśrayaṃ ca yaḥ |
kartum icchati durmedhā moghaṃ tat tasya yat phalam ||
yan nāmnātaṃ svaśākhāyāṃ pārakyam avirodhi yat |
vidvadbhis tad anuṣṭheyam agnihotrādikarmavat ||
agnihotraṃ yajuarvedaśākhāsu vihitaṃ, yathā chandogādibhir anuṣṭhīyate |
gṛhyapariśiṣṭakāraḥ |
bahv alpaṃ vā svagṛhyoktaṃ yasya karma prakīrtitam |
tasya tāvati śāstrārthe kṛte sarvaḥ kṛto bhavet ||
pravṛttam anyathā kuryād yadi mohāt kathaṃcana |
yatas tad anyathābhūtaṃ tata eva samāpayet ||
pravṛttam ārabdham | anyathābhūtaṃ kramādyanyatvena yad vaiparītyam āpannam |
samāpte yad vijānīyān mayaitad ayathākṛtam |
tāvad eva punaḥ kuryān nāvṛttiḥ sarvakarmaṇaḥ ||
(* etat tu karmasamāptāv anyathākaraṇatāviṣayam) |
pradhānasyākriyā yatra sāṅgaṃ tat kriyate punaḥ |
[106]        tadaṅgakriyāyāṃ tu nāvṛttir na ca tat kriyā ||
yatra pradhānakarmākaraṇaṃ tat sāṅgam eva punaḥ kartavyam, tad aṅgākaraṇe punar na sāṅgapradhānāvṛttir nāpi tāvanmātrasyāṅgasya karaṇaṃ kiṃ tu prāyaścittam eva kāryam |
gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
darbhāḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ mantra brāhmaṇā havir agnayaḥ |
ayātayāmāny etāni niyojyāni punaḥ punaḥ ||
marīciḥ |
māse nabhasy amāvāsyā tasyāṃ darbhacayo mataḥ |
ayātayāmās te darbhā viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
chandogapariśiṣṭam | kātyāyanaḥ |
haritā yajñiyā darbhā pītakāḥ pañcayajñiyāḥ |
samūlāḥ pitṛdaivatyāḥ kalmāṣā vaiśvadevikāḥ ||
hrasvāḥ pravaraṇīñāḥ syuḥ kuśā dīrghāś ca barhiṣaḥ |
pañcayajñiyāḥ pañcayajñārhāḥ | pravaraṇam anuṣṭhānam, tadarhāḥ pravaraṇīyāḥ |
laghuhārītaḥ |
citau darbhāḥ pathi darbhā ye darbhā yajñabhūmiṣu |
staraṇāsanapiṇḍeṣu ṣaṭkuśān parivarjayet ||
piṇḍārthaṃ ye kṛtā darbhā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
mūtrocchiṣṭadhṛtā ye ca teṣāṃ tyāgo vidhīyate ||
nīvīmadhyeṣu ye darbhā brahmasūtre ca ye kṛtāḥ |
pavitrāṃs tān vijānīyād yathā kāyas tathā kuśāḥ ||
anantagarbhiṇaṃ sāgraṃ kauśaṃ dvidalam eva ca |
prādeśamātraṃ vijñeyaṃ pavitraṃ yatra kutracit ||
[107]        tad eva darbhapiñjalyā lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam |
ājyasyotpavanārthaṃ yat tad apy etāvad evat u ||
āpastambaḥ |
devāgāre tathā śrāddhe gavāṃ goṣṭhe tathādhvare |
saṃdhyayoś ca dvayoḥ sādhusaṃgame gurusaṃnidhau ||
agnyāgāre vivāheṣu svādhyāye bhojane tathā |
uddhared dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāpathe ||
(* uddhared dhakṣiṇaṃ pāṇim iti savyāṃśe vastraṃ nidhāya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum uttarīyād bahiḥkuryād ity arthaḥ) | yājñavalkyaḥ |
raudrapitrāsurān mantrāṃs tathā daivābhicārikān |
vyāhṛtyālabhya cātmānam apaḥ spṛṣṭvānyad ācaret ||
chandogapariśiṣṭam | kātyāyanaḥ |
pitramantrapravaraṇe ātmāmbhe avekṣaṇe |
adhovāyusamutsarge prahāse ‘nṛtabhāṣaṇe ||
mārjāramūṣikasparśe ākruṣṭe krodhasaṃbhave |
nimitteṣv eṣu sarvatra karma kurvann apaḥ spṛśet ||
ātmālambhe hṛdayasparśe yajñādau vihite, avekṣaṇam api yajñādivihitam eva grāhyam |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syāj japādiṣu kathaṃcana |
vyāhared vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smared vā viṣṇum avyayam ||
ajñānād yadi vā mohāt pracyavetādhvareṣu yat |
smaraṇād eva tad viṣṇoḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ syād iti śrutiḥ ||
tathā śatapathaśrutiḥ: “arthaṃ yad vācaṃyamo vyāharati tasmād u haiṣa visṛjo yajñaḥ parāṅ [108] āvartate, tatra vaiṣṇavīm ṛcaṃ vā yajur vā japed” ityādi | chandogapariśiṣṭam | kātyāyanaḥ |
yatropadiśyate karma kartur aṅgaṃ na sūcyate |
dakṣiṇas tatra vijñeyaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragaḥ karaḥ ||
yatra diṅniyamo nāsti japahomādikarmasu |
tisras tatra diśaḥ proktā aindrī saumyāparājitā ||
aindrī prācī | saumyā uttarā | aparājitā īśānadik |
āsīna ūrdhvaḥ brahmo vā niyamo yatra nedṛśaḥ |
tadāsīnena kartavyaṃ na prahvena na tiṣṭhatā ||
brahmaḥ praṇatajānukaḥ | prahveṇa nimreṇa | tiṣṭhatā ūrdhveṇa | vasiṣṭhaḥ |
japahomopavāseṣu dhautavastradharo bhavet |
alaṃkṛtaḥ śucir maunī śraddhāvān vijitendriyaḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
sadopavītinā bhāvyaṃ sadā baddhaśikhena tu |
viśikho ‘nupavītaś ca yat karoti na tat kṛtam ||
nigamapariśiṣṭe: “vāmaskandhe yajñopavītam, daive prācīnāvītm itarathā pitṛyajñe nābhyāṃ dvikaṇṭhāsaktam utsarge nivītaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśāvalambi grāmyadharmeṣu” | grāmyadharmaḥ strīsaṃyogaḥ | baudhāyanaḥ: “karmayukto lābher adhaḥsparśaṃ varjayet” | āha manuḥ |
caṇḍālaś ca varāhaś ca kukkuṭaḥ śvā tathaiva ca |
rajasvalā ca ṣaṇḍaś ca nekṣerann aśnato dvijān ||
home pradāne bhojye ca yad ebhir abhivīkṣyate |
daive haviṣi pitre vā tad gacchaty ayathātatham ||
[109] skandapurāṇe |
pāṣaṇḍinaś ca patitā ye ca vai nāstikā janāḥ |
puṇyakarmaṇi teṣāṃ vai saṃnidhir neṣyate kvacit ||
atha vijñānalalitāt |
pṛthivyaptejasāṃ vāyor maṇḍalāni krameṇa tu |
pītaṃ vakti catuṣkoṇaṃ pārthivaṃ śakradaivatam ||
tārtham āpyaṃ padmākaṃ śuktaṃ varuṇadaivatam |
asraṃ svastikasaṃyuktaṃ taijasaṃ vahnidaivatam ||
vṛttaṃ vindavṛtaṃ vāyudaivatam kṛṣṇamānilam ||
garuḍapurāṇe |
kastūrikāyā dvau bhāgau catvāraś candanasya ca |
kuṅkumasya trayaś caikā śaśinaḥ syāc catuḥsamam ||
karpūraś candanaṃ darbhakuṅkumaṃ ca samāṃśakam |
sarvagandham iti proktaṃ samastasuravallabham ||
tathā |
karpūram aguruś caiva kastūrīcandanaṃ tathā |
kakkolañ ca bhaved ebhiḥ pañcabhir yakṣakardamaḥ ||
śivadharme |
pañcāmṛtaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ sitā madhu ghṛtaṃ nṛpa ||
skandapurāṇe |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam |
pañcagavyam iti proktaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
aśvatthodumbaraplakṣacūtanyagrodhapallavāḥ |
pañcabhaṅgā iti proktāḥ sarvakarmasu śobhanāḥ ||
pañcarātre |
rajāṃsi pañcavarṇāni maṇḍālārthaṃ hi kārayet |
śālitaṇḍulacūrṇena śuktaṃ vā yavasaṃbhavam ||
raktaṃ kusumbhasindūragairikādisamudbhavam |
haritālodbhavaṃ pītaṃ rajanīsaṃbhavaṃ kvacit ||
[110]        kṛṣṇair dravyair vai haritaṃ pītakṛṣṇavimiścitam |
rajanī haridrā | ādityapurāṇe |
abhāve sarvaratnānāṃ hema sarvatra yojayet |
rudrabījaṃ paraṃ pūtaṃ yatas tasyaiva sarvadā ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
anuktadravyatatsaṅkhyādevatāpratimā nṛpa |
sauvarṇī rājatī tāmrī vṛkṣajā mārtikī tathā ||
citrajā piṣṭalepotthā nijavittānurūpataḥ |
āmāṣāt palaparyantaṃ kartavyā śāṭhyavarjitaiḥ ||
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmramārakūṭaṃ tathaiva ca |
lohaṃ trapu tathā sīsaṃ dhātavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
tathā |
āpaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi dadhyakṣatatilās tathā |
yavāḥ siddhārthakāś caivam argho ‘ṣṭāṅgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
tathā |
dūrvā yavāṅkurāś caiva vālakaṃ cūtapallavāḥ |
haridrādvayasiddhārthaśikhipatroragatvacaḥ ||
kaṅkaṇauṣadhayaś caitāḥ kautukākhyā nava smṛtāḥ ||
chandogapariśiṣṭe |
kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridre dve surā śaileyacandanam |
[111]        vacā campakamustaṃ ca sarvauṣadhyo daśa smṛtāḥ ||
āvāhanāsanārdhaṃ pādyācamanamadhuparkasnānāpaś ca ||
vāsobhūṣaṇagandhasumanoyutadhūpadīpabhojyāni prādakṣiṇyaṃ natir iti kathayanty upacāraṣoḍaśakam |
viṣṇudharmottare |
haimarājatatāmrā vā mṛṇmayā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ |
yātrodvāhapratiṣṭhādau kumbhāḥ syur abhiṣecane ||
pañcāśāṅgulavaipulyā utsedhe ṣoḍaśāṅgulā |
dvādaśākgulakaṃ mūlaṃ mukham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet ||
pañcāśākguleti, āśā diśaḥ, tāś ca daśasaṃkhyāvācakatvena jyotiḥśāstrādau praṣiddhāḥ | pañca ca āśāś ca pañcāśāḥ | tāvanti aṅgulāni vaipulyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathābhūtāḥ | madhyapradeśe tiryaṅmānena pañcadaśāṅgulā ity arthaḥ | atha vā bāhyapradeśe balayākṛtinā sūtreṇa nīyamānā madhyasthāne pañcāśadaṅgulā ity arthaḥ | asmin pakṣe pañcāśāṅguleti chāndasaḥ prayogaḥ, iti saṃkīrṇavidhiḥ |
atha dakṣiṇādinirṇayaḥ |
tatra śatapathaśrutiḥ: “sa eṣa yajño ‘hato nādakṣata devādakṣiṇābhir adakṣayaṃs tad yad enaṃ dakṣiṇābhir adakṣayaṃs tasmād dakṣiṇānāmeti” | bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
adattadakṣiṇaṃ dānaṃ vrataṃ caiva nṛpottama |
viphalaṃ tad vijānīyād bhasmanīva hutaṃ haviḥ ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmatāt |
śraddhāyuktaḥ śucir dānto dānaṃ dadyāt sadakṣiṇam |
[112]        adakṣiṇaṃ tu yad dānaṃ tat savyaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
maitrāyaṇīyapariśiṣṭam: “dakṣiṇālābhe mūlānāṃ bhakṣyāṇāṃ dadāti na tv evaṃ yajet” | tathā ca śatapathaśrutiḥ: “tasmān nādakṣiṇaṃ haviḥ syāt” iti | bhaviṣyottare |
kāmyaṃ yad dīyate kiṃcit tat samagraṃ sukhāvaham |
asamagraṃ tu doṣāya bhavatīha paratra ca ||
tasmān na dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vidhānavikalaṃ na ca |
deyaṃ dānaṃ mahārāja samagraphalakāṅkṣayā ||
anyathā dīyamānaṃ tad apakārāya kevalam |
pratyakṣataś cārthahānir na ca tat phaladaṃ bhavet ||
āha bhagavān vyāsaḥ |
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā |
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇeṣyate ||
etac ca, viśeṣavihitagovastrādidakṣiṇakadānavarjaṃ sāmānyavihitadakṣiṇeṣu dāneṣu vyavatiṣṭhate tatrāpi parāśreṣṭhatameti prāśastyaṃ darśayati na tv anyāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nirācaṣṭe ānantyārthatvād dakṣiṇāyāḥ suvarṇasya prakṛṣṭatvāt sarvadāneṣu suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇeti vacanārthaḥ anyad api puruṣasyāhāropayikaṃ taṇḍulādikaṃ dakṣiṇārthena yojyam | yat tu śrūyate:
anyeṣāṃ caiva dānānāṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā smṛtā |
suvarṇe dīyamāne tu rajataṃ dakṣiṇeṣyate ||
iti, tad etac chrotaḥ staṇyaṃ (?) parijñāya śraddhātavyam |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ taṇḍulā dhānyam eva ca |
nityaśrāddhaṃ devapūjā sarvam eva sadakṣiṇam ||
[113] skandapurāṇe |
deyadravyatṛtīyāṃśaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ parikalpayet |
anuktadakṣiṇe dāne daśāṃśaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ ||
tulāpuruṣādidānāni adhikṛtya liṅgapurāṇe |
dakṣiṇā ca śataṃ cārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pradāpayet |
ṛtvijāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ daś niṣkān pradāpayet ||
bhaviṣyottare |
jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ pārtha dāneṣu vidhir uttamaḥ |
madhyamas tu tadardhena tadardhenādhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meṣyāṃ ca kālapuruṣe tathānyeṣu mahatsv api |
evaṃ vṛkṣe tatheddhe ca dhenoḥ kṛṣṇājinasya ca ||
aśaktasyāpi kḷpto ‘yaṃ pañcasauvarṇiko vidhiḥ |
ato ‘py alpena yo dadyān mahādānaṃ narādhamaḥ ||
pratigṛhṇāti vā tasya duḥkhaśokāvahaṃ bhavet ||
jayābhiṣekam udāhṛtya liṅgapurāṇe |
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipalonmānaṃ dadyād vai dakṣiṇāṃ guroḥ |
hotṝṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ triṃśatpalam udāhṛtam ||
adhyetṝṇāṃ tadardhena dvārapānaṃ tadardhataḥ ||
etenānyatrāpi guror vṛddhaṛtvijāṃ tadardhaṃ jāpakānāṃ tadardhaṃ dvārapālānām iti dakṣiṇāvibhāgo ‘vamantavyaḥ | brahmavaivarte subāhur uvāca |
devānāṃ pratimāṃ vipra gṛhītvā brāhmaṇaḥ svayam |
ātmopayogaṃ kurute vikrītvā vā vibhajya vā ||
[114]        tiladhenvādayaś caiva kathaṃ bhakṣyā vijānatā |
dhenutvād bhakṣaṇaṃ śastaṃ na śastraṃ ceti saṃśayaḥ ||
viśvāmitra uvāca |
dharmaṃ ca mūlaṃ prathamaṃ śrutiṃ vedavido jaguḥ |
śrutir mūlaṃ smṛtīnāṃ tu purāṇaṃ setihāsakam ||
śrutimūlaṃ samākhyātaṃ taduktaṃ naiva cālayet |
dānakāle tu devatvaṃ pratimānāṃ prakīrtitam ||
dhenūnām api dhenutvaṃ śrutyuktaṃ dānayogataḥ |
dātur vai dānakāle tu dhenavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
viprasya vyayakāle tu dravyaṃ tad iti niścayaḥ |
dānasaṃbandhivipreṇa dravyam āgacchatā gṛham ||
tat sarvaṃ viduṣā tena vikreyaṃ svecchayā vibho |
kuṭumbabharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
anyathā narakaṃ yātīty evam āha pitāmahaḥ |
kathaṃ tilānāṃ dhenutvaṃ devatvaṃ pratimāsu ca ||
ubhayoḥ śāstrato vidyād dhenutvaṃ devatāṃ tathā |
śāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ pramāṇānām iti sthitiḥ ||
āgamād eva lokasya pratītir nānyataḥ kutaḥ |
purāṇaṃ mānavo dharmaḥ sāṅgo vedaś cikitsitam ||
ājñāsiddhāni catvāri na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ ||
atha dravyadānam | brahmapurāṇe |
dharmaśāstreṣu mānārthaṃ yāḥ saṃjñā munibhiḥ smṛtāḥ |
tāḥ sarvā vyavahārārthaṃ boddhavyāḥ saṃpradāyataḥ ||
[115] manuḥ |
lokasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ yāḥ saṃjñāḥ prathitā bhuvi |
tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ tāḥ pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ ||
jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |
paramaṃ tat parmāṇānāṃ trasareṇuḥ pracakṣyate ||
trasareṇvaṣtakaṃ jñeyā likṣaikā paramāṇutaḥ |
tā rājasarṣapas tisras te trayo gaurasarṣapaḥ ||
sarṣapāḥ ṣaṭ yavo madhyas triyavaṃ tv ekakṛṣṇataḥ (-laḥ) |
pañcakṛṇalako māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa ||
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ palāni dharaṇaṃ daśa |
dve kṛṣṇale samadhṛte vijñeyo raupyamāṣakaḥ ||
te ṣoḍaśa syād dharaṇaṃ purāṇaś caiva rājataḥ |
kārṣāpaṇas tu vijñeyas tāmrikaḥ kārṣikaḥ paṇaḥ ||
dharaṇāni daśa jñeyaḥ śatamānas tu rājataḥ |
catuḥsauvarṇiko niṣko vijñeyas tu pramāṇataḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
jālasūryamarīcisthaṃ trasareṇurajaḥ smṛtaḥ |
te ‘ṣṭau likṣā tu tās tisro rājasarṣapa ucyate ||
gauras tut e trayaḥ ṣaṭ te yavo madhyas tu te trayaḥ |
kṛṣṇalaḥ pañca te māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa ||
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ pañca vāpi prakīrtitam |
[116]        dve kṛṣṇale rūpyamāṣo dharaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva te ||
śatamānaṃ tu daśabhir dharaṇaiḥ phalam eva ca |
niṣkaḥ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ kārṣikas tāmrikaḥ paṇaḥ ||
āha viṣṇuḥ |
jālasthānamarīcigataṃ rajaḥ trasareṇusaṃjñam, tadaṣṭakaṃ likṣā, tattrayo rājasarṣapaḥ, tattrayaṃ gaurasarṣapaḥ, te ṣaṭ yavaḥ, tattrayaṃ kṛṣṇalam, tatpañcakaṃ māṣaḥ, tatdvādaśakam akṣārdham, sacaturmāṣakaṃ suvarṇaḥ, taccatuḥsauvarṇiko niṣkaḥ dve kṛṣṇale rūpyamāṣakaḥ, te ṣoḍaśa dharaṇam | tāmrikaḥ kārṣāpaṇaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
māṣo viṃśatibhāgaś ca jñeyaḥ kārṣāpaṇasya tu |
kākiṇau tu caturbhāgo māṣasya ca paṇasya ca ||
pañcanadyāḥ pradeśe tu saṃjñeyaṃ vyāvahārikī |
kārṣāpaṇapramāṇaṃ tu tannibaddham ihaiva yā ||
kārṣāpaṇasyaikā jñeyā tāś catasras tu dhānakaḥ |
te dvādaśa suvarṇas tu dīnāras tu trikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nāradaḥ |
kārṣāpaṇo dakṣiṇsyāṃ diśi raupyaḥ pravartate |
paṇair nibaddhaḥ pūrvasyāṃ ṣoḍaśaiva paṇasya tu ||
agastiprokte ‘pi |
yavaḥ syāt sarṣapaiḥ ṣaḍbhir guñjā ca syāt tribhir yavaiḥ |
guñjābhiḥ pañcabhiś caiko māṣakaḥ parikīritaḥ ||
bhavet ṣaḍaśabhir māṣaiḥ suvarṇas taiḥ punaḥ smṛtam |
caturbhiḥ palam ekasya daśaso dharaṇaṃ viduḥ ||
aṣṭabhir bhavati vyaktais taṇḍulo gaurasarṣapaiḥ |
[117]        sa vaiṇavo yavaḥ prokto godhūmaṃ cāpare jaguḥ ||
viṣṇuguptaḥ |
pañca guñjā bhaven māṣaḥ śāṇas taiś ca caturguṇaiḥ |
kaṇajo dharaṇaṃ prāhur maṇimānaviśāradāḥ ||
majjāṭikā kaṇajaviśeṣas taulye guñjādvayaṃ viduḥ |
majjāṭikāviṃśatis tu dharaṇaṃ tadvidāṃ matam ||
sthūlamadhyātisūkṣmāṇāṃ susūkṣmāṇām api smṛtam |
māṣakaiḥ padmarāgaḥ syād indranīlādiṣu smṛtam ||
kuhus tatra prayoktavyo na yasmin mānam īritam |
dīnāro raupakair aṣṭāviṃśatyā parikīrtitaḥ ||
suvarṇasya saptatimo bhāgo ropaka iṣyate ||
prakārāntareṇāpy āha |
sukṣetre yathāvan madhyapākakāle niṣpannā dhānyamāṣā daś suvarṇamāṣaḥ, pañca vā guñjāḥ suvarṇamāṣakaḥ te ṣoḍaśa suvarṇaḥ, evaṃ pramāṇasiddhasya dvitīyā saṃjñā karṣa iti | catuṣkarṣaṃ palam, palānāṃ śatena tulā, viṃśatitauliko bhāraḥ, asyaiva bhārasya udataulika iti dvitīyā saṃjñā |
brahmaprokte |
palānāṃ viṃśatir vīśaḥ pañcavīśās tulā matā |
udataulikaḥ sa eva syād bhāro viṃśatitaulikaḥ ||
viṣṇuguptaḥ |
rūpyasya suvarṇād bhinnamānam abhidhīyate aṣṭāśīti gaurasarṣapā rūpyamāṣakaḥ te ṣoḍaśa dharaṇaṃ nippāvā (?) viṃśatir vā rūpyapalaṃ ca daśadharaṇakaṃ tatpalānāṃ śataṃ tulā tattulāviṃśatir bhāra hati viṃśatyā vrīhitaṇḍulais tulāyāṃ vidhṛtair vyajrākhyaratnasya dharaṇaṃ bhavati | aṣṭabhir gaurasarṣapais taṇḍulaṃ kalpayed iti kecit | tathā nirghaṇṭau |
mānaṃ tulāṅguliprasthair guñjāḥ pañcādyamāṣakaḥ |
[118]        te ṣoḍaśākṣaḥ karṣostrī palaṃ karṣacatuṣṭayam ||
suvarṇavistī hemnokṣe kuruvistas tu tatpale |
tulā striyāṃ palaśataṃ bhāraḥ syād viṃśatis tulāḥ ||
ācitaṃ daśa bhārāḥ syuḥ śākaṭo bhāra ācitaḥ |
kārṣāpaṇaḥ kārṣikaḥ syāt kārṣikas tāmrikaḥ paṇaḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
ekaṃ daś śataṃ caiva sahasraṃ ceti sattama |
yathottaraṃ daśaguṇaṃ sahasrāṇi daśāyutam ||
śatāhataṃ sahasraṃ tu procyate niyutaṃ budhaiḥ |
tathā śatasahasrāṇi daśa prayutam ucyate ||
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi koṭir ity abhidhīyate |
arbudaṃ daśakoṭyas tu vṛṇdaṃkoṭiśataṃ viduḥ ||
sahasraṃ koṭayaś cāpi kharvam āhuś ca tadvidaḥ |
daśakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ śaṅkur ity abhidhīyate ||
sahasraṃ koṭayaś cāpi padmamātraṃ tu tad viduḥ |
sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ kōṭīnāṃ daśadhā punaḥ ||
gaṇitaṃ tu samudraṃ vai prāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ ||
atha dhānyamānam | śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
yajñire tāni bījāni grāmyāraṇyābhidhāni ca |
oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāḥ śataṃ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ ||
vrīhayaś ca yavāś caiva godhūmāḥ kaṅgukās tilāḥ |
priyaṅgavaḥ kovidārāḥ koradūṣāḥ sacīnakāḥ ||
[119]        māṣā mudgā masūrāś ca niṣpāvāḥ sakulotthakāḥ |
āṭakyaś caṇakāś caiva śaṇaḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ ||
ity etā oṣadhīnāṃ tu grāmyāṇāṃ jātayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
oṣadhyo yajñiyā jñeyā grāmyāraṇyāś caturdaśa ||
vrīhayaś ca yavāś caiva godhūmāḥ kaṅgusarṣapāḥ |
māṣā mudgāḥ saptamāś ca aṣṭamāś ca kulotthikāḥ ||
śyāmākāś caiva nīvārā jartilāḥ sa gavedhukāḥ |
kovidārasamāyuktās tathā veṇuyavāś ca ye |
grāmyāraṇyāḥ smṛtā jy etā oṣadhyaś ca caturdaśa ||
skandapurāṇe |
yavagodhūmadhānyāni tilāḥ kaṅgukulotthikāḥ |
māṣā mudgā masūrāś ca niṣpāvāḥ śyāmasarṣapāḥ ||
gavedhukāś ca nīvārā āḍhakyo ‘tha satīnakāḥ |
caṇakāś cīnakāś caiva dhānyāny aṣṭādaśaiva tu ||
dhānyāni vrīhayaḥ | gavedhukāḥ kasakāḥ | nīvārāḥ āraṇyavrīhayaḥ | satīnakā vartulakalāyāḥ | cīnakāḥ ṣaṣṭikaviśeṣāḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśanmatāt |
yavā godhūmadhānyāni tilāḥ kaṅgus tathaiva ca |
śyāmākaṃ cīnakaṃ caiva saptadhānyam udāhṛtam ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuḍvaṃ matam |
caturbhiḥ kuḍvaiḥ prasthaḥ prasthāś catvāra āḍhakaḥ ||
āḍhakais taiś caturbhiś ca droṇas tu kathito budhaiḥ |
kumbho droṇadvayaṃ sūrpakhārī droṇās tu ṣoḍaśa ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
palaṃ ca kuḍavaḥ prastha āḍhako droṇa eva ca |
[120]        dhānyamāneṣu boddhavyāḥ kramaśo ‘mī caturguṇāḥ ||
droṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ khārī viṃśtyā kumbha ucyate |
kumbais tu daśabhir bādho dhānyasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ muṣṭir ekaṃ palaṃ smṛtam |
aṣṭamuṣṭir bhavet kuñciḥ kuñcayoṣṭau tu puṣkalam ||
puṣkalāni ca catvāri āḍhakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
caturāḍhako bhavet droṇa ity etan mānalakṣaṇam ||
caturbhiḥ setikābhis tu pratha ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
(* muṣṭiḥ yajamānasyeti kecit) | “muṣṭir ekaṃ palaṃ smṛtam” iti proktaṃ setiketi kuḍavaḥ |
pādme |
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthaḥ pasthaiś caturbhir āḍhakaḥ |
caturāḍhako bhaved droṇa ity etan mānalakṣaṇam ||
atha gopathabrāhmaṇe |
pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣas taiś catuḥṣaṣṭibhiḥ palam |
palair dvātriṃśadbhiḥ prastho droṇaḥ syāc caturāḍhakaḥ ||
dravadravyaviṣaye skandapurāṇe |
paladvayena prasṛtam dviguṇaṃ kuḍavaṃ matam |
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prastha āḍhakas taiś caturguṇaiḥ ||
caturguṇo bhaved droṇa ity etat dravamānakam ||
atha bhūmānam | ādityapurāṇe |
jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |
prathamaṃ tat pramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate ||
trasareṇus tu vijñeyo aṣṭau ye paramāṇavaḥ |
[121]        trasareṇavas tut e hy aṣṭau rathareṇus tu sa smṛtaḥ ||
rathareṇavas te hy aṣṭau vālāgraṃ tat smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ |
vālāgrāṇy aṣṭa likṣā tu yūkā likṣāṣṭakaṃ budhaiḥ ||
aṣṭau yūkā yavaṃ prāhur aṅgulaṃ tu yavāṣṭakam |
dvādaśāṅgulamātro vai vitastis tu prakīrtitaḥ ||
aṅguṣṭhasya pradeśinyā nyāsaḥ prādeśa ucyate |
tālaḥ smṛto madhyamayā lokarṇaś cāpy anāmayā |
kaniṣṭhayā vitastis tu dvādaśāṅgulikā smṛtā ||
ratnis tv aṅgulaparvāṇi vijñeyas tv ekaviṃśatiḥ |
catvāri viṃśatiś caiva hastaḥ syād aṅgulāni tu ||
kiṣkuḥ smṛto dviratnis tu dvicatvāriṃśad aṅgulaḥ |
ṣaṇṇavatyāṅgulaiś caiva dhanurdaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
dhanurdaṇḍayugaṃ nālir jñeyo hy ete yavāṅguleḥ |
dhanuṣā triṃśatā nalvam āhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ ||
dhanuḥsahasre dve cāpi gavyūtir upadiśyate |
aṣṭau dhanuḥsahasrāṇi yojanaṃ tu prakīrtitam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
paramāṇuḥ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ trasareṇur mahīrajaḥ |
vālāgraṃ caiva likṣā ca yūkā cātha yavo ‘ṅgulam ||
kramād aṣṭaguṇāny āhur yavān aṣṭa tato ‘ṅgulam |
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ padaṃ prāhur vitastir dviguṇaṃ smṛtam ||
dvau vitastī tato hasto brahmatīrthaṃ dviceṣṭanaiḥ |
caturhasto dhanurdaṇḍo nālikā tadyugena tu ||
kośo dhanuḥsahasre dve gavyūtiś ca caturguṇā |
[122]        dviguṇaṃ yojanaṃ tasmāt proktaṃ saṃkhyātakovidaiḥ ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
daśahastena daṇḍena triṃśad daṇḍā nivartanam |
daśa tāny eva gocarma brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
daśahastena vaṃśena daśavaṃśān samantataḥ |
pañca cābhyadhikān dadyād etad gocarma cocyate ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
yad utpannam athāśnāti naraḥsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijaḥ |
ekaṃ gocarmamātraṃ tu bhuvaḥ proktaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
daṇḍena saptahastena triṃśad daṇḍā nivartanam |
tribhāgahīnaṃ gocarma mānam āha prajāpatiḥ ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
gavāṃ śataṃ vṛṣaś caiko yatra tiṣṭhed ayantritaḥ |
etad gocarmamātraṃ tu prāhur vedavido janāḥ ||
atha maṇḍapādilakṣaṇam | baudhāyanaḥ: “madhyāṅgulīkūrparayor madhye prāmāṇikaḥ karaḥ” | chandogapariśiṣṭe |
aṅguṣṭhāṅgulamānaṃ tu yatra yatropadiśyate |
tatra tatra bṛhatparvagranthibhir minuyād budhaḥ ||
atha pañcarātre |
kuryād vaiṣṇavayāgeṣu caturdvārāṃś ca maṇḍapān |
sāradārubhavān staṃbhān dṛḍhān kuryād ṛjūn samān ||
maṇḍapārhocchritān vedasaṃkhyāṃś cūḍānvitāṃs tathā |
valikāmūrdhatas teṣāṃ stambhadvādaśakaṃ punaḥ ||
bāhye pīṭhapramāṇena tatra sūtravibhāgataḥ |
madhyamottamayor vedī tatra sūtravibhāgataḥ ||
caturthāṃśocchritas tasyās trisaptapañcato ‘pi vā |
navaikādaśahāraṃ vā iṣṭakābhiḥ prakalpayet ||
[123]        kanīyān daśahastaḥ syān madhyamo dvādaśonmitaḥ |
tathā ṣoḍaśabhir hastair maṇḍapaḥ syād ihottamaḥ ||
vedasaṃkhyān catuḥsaṃkhyān ity arthaḥ | cūḍā śikhā, sā ca stambhaśirasi uparitanasrandhravalikāpraveśanārthaṃ kriyate | bāhya iti antarvinyastastambha-catuṣṭhayāpekṣayā bāhyatvam | ayam arthaḥ | pūrvaṃ madhyastambhacatuṣṭayaṃ vinyasya tato bāhyaparidhau stambhadvādaśakaṃ vinyaset evaṃ ca ṣoḍaśastambho maṇḍapaḥ saṃprapadyate | sūtravibhāgata iti, prāk paścimāyatasya dakṣiṇottarāyatasya vā kṣetrasūtrasya tṛtīyāṃśaparimitam antarālaṃ vihāya stambhā niveśanīyā ity arthaḥ | kanyase dvikaram iti, kanyase maṇḍape dvihastavistāraṃ dvāraṃ kāryam | madhyamottamayos tu caturaṅgulābhivṛddhyā vidheyam |
viśvanbharavāstuśāstre |
maṇḍapāntaram utsṛjya kartavyaṃ paṇḍapadvayam |
dhāmno dhāmnāntaraṃ tyaktvā dhāmāgre yajñamaṇḍapaḥ ||
daśadvādaśahasto vā kalāhasto ‘tha vā punaḥ |
yadā maṇḍapadvayaṃ kriyate tadā prathamamaṇḍapaparimitam antaraṃ tyaktvā dvitīyamaṇḍapaṃ kuryāt | yadā tu dhāmāgre maṇḍapaḥ kriyate tadā taddhāmaparimāṇam antaraṃ tyaktvā parato maṇḍapaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | kalāhastaḥ ṣoḍaśahastaḥ |
karaiḥ ṣaḍbhis tu saṃchādyā vijayādyās tu maṇḍapāḥ |
aśvatthoḍumbaraplakṣavaṭaśākhākṛtāni tu ||
[124]        maṇḍapasya pratidiśaṃ dvārāṇy etāni kārayet |
pañcahastapramāṇās te vistāreṇa dvihastakaḥ ||
ṣaḍaṅgulābhivṛddhās tu saptahastā yathottame ||
pañcahasteti, kanyase maṇḍape pañcahastāḥ | madhyame ṣaḍhastāḥ | uttame saptahastāḥ dvāraśākhā vidheyāḥ | tathā hi | hastāt prabhṛti ṣaḍaṅgulābhivṛddhā vistāro vidheyaḥ |
mastake dvādaśāṃśena śakhacakragadāmbujam |
prāgādikramayogena nyaset teṣāṃ sadārujam |
pañcamāṃśaṃ nyased bhūmau sarvasādhāraṇo vidhiḥ ||
tatra saṃgrahe |
pratikuṇḍaṃ patākās tu proktāḥ śāstrārthakovidaiḥ |
saptahastāḥ patākāḥ syuḥ saptamāṃśena vistṛtāḥ ||
lokapālānuvarṇena ṣaḍabhītu himaprabhā |
pītaraktādivarṇāś ca pañcahastā dhvajāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
dvipañcahastair daṇḍais tair vaṃśajaiḥ saṃyutā matāḥ ||
dvipañcahastaiḥ daśahastaiḥ | garuḍapurāṇe |
pañcahastā dhvajāḥ kāryā vaipulyena dvihastakāḥ |
saptahastāḥ patākāḥ syur viṃśatyaṅgulavistṛtāḥ ||
daśahastāḥ patākānāṃ daṇḍāḥ pañcāśaveśitāḥ |
sindūrāḥ karvurā dhūmrā dhūsarā meghasaṃnibhāḥ ||
haritāḥ pāṇḍuvarṇāś ca śubhrāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt |
evaṃvarṇāḥ śubhāḥ kāryāḥ patākāḥ pākaśātanaḥ ||
[125] bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
vedipādāntaraṃ tyaktvā kuṇḍāni nava pañca vā |
vedāstrāṇy eva tāni syur tulāny atha vā kvacit ||
vedāstrāṇi caturastrāṇi | āmnāyarahasye |
kuṇḍāni caturasrāṇi vṛttanālākṛtanīni vā |
nava pañcātha caikaṃ vā kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ||
navakuṇḍavidhāne tu dikṣu kuṇḍāṣṭake sthite |
navamaṃ kārayet kuṇḍaṃ pūrveśānadigantare |
vidhāne pañca kuṇḍānām īśāne pañcamaṃ bhavet ||
jñānaratnāvalyām |
dikṣu vedāsravṛttāni pañcamaṃ tv īśagocare |
nāradīye ‘pi |
yatropadiśyate kuṇḍacatuṣkaṃ tatra karmaṇi |
vedāsram arhacandraṃ ca vṛttaṃ padmanibhaṃ tathā ||
kuryāt kuṇḍāni catvāri prācyādiṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ |
kuṇḍavedyantaraṃ caiva sapādakarasaṃmitam |
pīṭhavaddhantu yat kuṇḍaṃ sapramāṇaṃ suvartakam ||
bahvṛcapariśiṣṭe |
bhūktau muktau tathā puṣṭau jīrṇoddhāre viśeṣataḥ |
sadā home tathā śāntau vṛttaṃ varuṇadiggatam ||
kāmike tu tattaddikṣu tat tat phalārthaṃ kuṇḍoktir yathā |
aindryāṃ stambhe catuṣkoṇe agnau bhoge bhagākṛtiḥ |
candrārdhaṃ māraṇe yāmye nairṛte dvitrikoṇakam ||
vāruṇyāṃ śāntike vṛttaṃ ṣaṭsu uccāṭane ‘nale |
udīcyāṃ pauṣṭike padmaṃ raudryām aṣṭāsramuktidam ||
sarveṣu caiteṣu homānusāreṇa hastādimātraṃ kṣetraphalam upakalpanīyam | [126] tad uktaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
muṣṭimānaṃ śatārdhe tu śate cāratnimātrikam |
sahasre tv atha hotavye kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ karātmakam ||
dvihastam ayute tac ca lakṣahome catuḥkaram |
aṣṭahastātmakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ koṭihomeṣu nādhikam ||
muṣṭimānam iti baddhamuṣṭihastamātram ity arthaḥ | idānīṃ caturasrādikuṇḍānām uddhārakramo ‘bhidhīyate | caturasraṃ tāvad āha viśvakarmāh |
kṛtvā prāk sūtram ardhāṅgaṃ dakṣiṇottaramatsyayoḥ |
nyasya sūtraṃ tataḥ koṇair aṅktaiś cautrasrakam ||
pūrvāṅkenāpy upāyena prācīṃ niścitya prākpaścimāyātāṃ rekhām ālikhya tām ardhabhāge lāñchayitvā dakṣiṇottaradiśor matsyadvayaṃ kuryāt sūtropari sūtrāntaranipātanāt svastikamadhyākṛtiḥ śilpaśāstreṣu matsya ity ucyate | matsyadvayaniṣpattiś cātraivaṃ kāryā | pūrvoktarekhāparimitasya sūtrasyādim, tasyā eva rekhāyā mūle nidhāya tatsūtrāntaraṃ paribhramya vṛttaṃ racayet tasyā eva rekhāyā aparaprānte tasyaiva sūtrasyādiṃ nidhāya tatsūtrāntaṃ paribhramya dvitīyantaṃ kuryāt evaṃ vṛtte dvaye kṛte dakṣiṇottaradiśor matsyadvayaṃ niṣpadyate atha matsyadvaye pūrvoktarekhālāñchane caikaṃ sūtraṃ niṣpātya dakṣiṇottarāyatāṃ rakhāṃ likhet | evaṃ dikṣu sādhitāsu vidiksādhanārthaṃ koṇān lāñchayet | tatrāyaṃ prakāraḥ | pūrvaniṣpannaprekhāprāntacatuṣṭayasya pratyekaṃ pārśvadvaye cikīrṣitaparimāṇasyārdham adhaṃ nidhāya tatsaṃdhau koṇalāñchanāni kuryāt tataḥ loṇalāñchaneṣu sūtracatuṣṭayanipātanāt pūrvaniśy udaṅmukhayo[127]nikaṃ caturasraṃ kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt | yonyākārādīnām uddhāraś caturasraprakṛtikas tu kāmikaśāstrāt |
pañcamāṃśaṃ puronyasya madhye vedāṃśamānataḥ |
bhramād aśvatthapatrābhaṃ kuṇḍam āgneyam ucyate ||
kṣetrasya pañcamabhāgaṃ puraprācyāṃ diśi vinyasya madhye koṇasūtrasyeti śeṣaḥ | vedāṃśaḥ turīyāṃśaś | bhramāt, sūtrāntaparibhramaṇena aśvatthapatrākāraṃ kuṇḍam āgneyadiśi kuryād iti | tatrāyaṃ nirmāṇaprakāraḥ | pūrvoktanyāyena samacaturasrīkṛtasya kṣetrasya paścimarekhāmadhyāt pūrvarekhāmadhyabhedinīṃ kṣetrasūtrapañcamāṃśādhikāṃ garbharekhām ālikhya nairṛtyadeśe koṇasūtrāntarīyāṃśe lāñchayitvā tallāñchanopari vinyastādeḥ sūtrasya pūrvoktagarbharekhāmūlāvanyastaṃ prāntaṃ paribhramya bahirvṛttārdhaṃ niṣpādya vāyavyakoṇe ‘py evam eva vṛttārdhaṃ racayet | tato garbharekhāprāntāt vṛttadvayaprāntasparśisūtradvayaṃ nipātya pippalapatrākāram āgneyadiṣy udaṅmukhayonikaṃ yonikuṇḍaṃ vidadhyāt | caturasre grahair bhakte tyaktvādyantau tadaṃśakau madhyasaptāṃśamāne tu kuṇḍaṃ khaṇḍenduvat kramāt | caturasre kṣetre grahair navabhir vibhakte ādyantau tyaktvā avaśiṣṭasaptamāṃśamānena sūtrabhramaṇāt khaṇḍendusadṛśaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt | atraivaṃ kṛtiḥ | caturasraṃ kṣetraṃ navadhā vibhajya tatra prathamo ‘ntimaś ceti bhāgadvayaṃ parimṛjya avaśiṣṭasaptabhāgādimarekhāgarbhadeśe sūtrādiṃ nidhāya tasyaiva bhāgasaptakasyāntimarekhāgarbhadeśe sūtrāntaṃ niveśya tatsūtraparibhramaṇena prathamarekhātulyaṃ viśrāntaprāntavṛttārdhaṃ viracayet | atha prathamarekhāprāntadvayam api vṛttārdhe saṃyojya dakṣiṇadigavasthitam uttarāśābhimukhayo[128]nikaṃ khaṇḍaṃ candrakhaṇḍaṃ vidadhyāt | tribhāgavṛddhito matsyais tribhir naiśācaraṃ bhavet | sthānatraye tṛtīyāṃśatrayaṃ vṛddhyā matsyatrayeṇa naiśācaraṃ nairṛtyadiksaṃbandhi kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt | ihāyaṃ saṃpradāyaḥ | pūrvavatsam acaturasraṃ kṣetraṃ nirmāya tattiraścīnapaścimarekhāmadhyāt tiryagavasthitapūrvarekhāmadhyabhedinīṃ kṣetrasūtratṛtīyabhāgādhikāṃ garbharekhām ālikhya pūrvoktapaścimarekhāprāntadvayam api kṣetrasūtratṛtīyabhāgādhikaṃ kuryāt | tato garbharekhāprāntāt pūrvoktapaścimarekhāprāntadvayasparśisūtradvayaṃ nipātya nairṛtyadiśi pūrvābhimukhayonikaṃ trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍam utpādayet | evaṃ ca vidhīyamāne sthānatraye tṛtīyāṃśatrayavṛddhis tatraiva matsyatrayam api niṣpadyata iti | karmārdhāṣṭāṃśasaṃnyāsād vṛttaṃ kuṇḍam ihoditam | karmasūtrārdhasya yo ‘ṣṭamāṃśas tasya saṃnyāsāt samyak nyāsāt vṛttaṃ kuṇḍaṃ syād iti | atraivaṃ racanāprakāraḥ | caturasre kṣetre koṇāt koṇāntarakāminaḥ sūtrasyārdhaṃ koṇārdhaśabdavācyam aṣṭadhā vibhajya yāvān aṣṭamo bhāgas tāvantaṃ bhāgaṃ caturdikṣu bahir vinyaset | tataḥ kṣetragarbhadeśe sūtrādiṃ nidhāya bahiḥsthitāṣṭamabhāgavinyastaṃ tasyaiva sūtrasya prāntaṃ sarvataḥ paribhramya paścimadiśi pūrvābhimukhayonikaṃ vṛttakuṇḍaṃ kuryāt | ṣaḍbhāgavṛddhito matsyaiś caturbhiḥ syāt ṣaḍasrakam | kṣetraprārśvayoḥ pratyekaṃ ṣaṣṭhabhāgavṛddhaṃ kṛtvā avaśiṣṭadiśīr matsyacatuṣṭayam utpadya sūtraṣaṭkapātāt ṣaḍasrakuṇḍaniṣpattir iti | atraivaṃ saṃpradāyaḥ | samacaturasraṃ kṣetraṃ ṣoḍhā vibhajya yāvān ṣaṣṭho bhāgas tāvatā mānena kṣetrasya dakṣiṇottarapārśve samantād vardhayitvā tad eva kṣetram āyata[129]caturasraṃ saṃpādayet | athānantaroktapārśvadvayarekhāsparśinīṃ dakṣiṇottarāyatāṃ garbharekhāṃ racayet | tataḥ kṣetramadhyād uttarapārśvarekhāmadhyāc ca pūrvoktagarbharekhārdhaparimitam ekaikaṃ sūtraṃ nipātya pūrveśānadiśor antarāle matsyam utpādya tenaiva prakāreṇa paścimavāyavyayor antarāle matsyaṃ kuryāt | atha bhūyo ‘pi kṣetramadhyād dakṣiṇapārśvarekhāmadhyāc ca prāguktagarbharekhāprāntadvayāt lāñchanacatuṣṭayasparśisūtracatuṣṭayaṃ nipātayet | evaṃ lāñchānnānantarālasthitasūtradvayena saha sūtraṣaṭkaprayogād vāyavyadiśi prāṅmukhayonikaṃ ṣaṭkoṇakuṇḍaṃ kuryāt |
caturasrāṣṭabhāgena karṇikā syād vibhāgaśaḥ |
tadbahis tv ekabhāgena kesarāṇi prakalpayet ||
tṛtīye dalamadhyāni turīye dalakoṭayaḥ |
bhramaṇāt padmadalaṃ syād dalāgraṃ darśayed bahiḥ ||
caturasrasya aṣṭadhā vibhaktasya madhye aṣṭamabhāgena karṇikā syāt karṇikāyā bahiḥ paridhisthe dvitīye aṣṭamabhāgavinyāse kesarāṇi syuḥ kesarād bahiḥ paridhisthite tṛtīye aṣṭamabhāge kesarāṇi syuḥ kesarād bahiḥ paridhisthite tṛtīye aṣṭamabhāge vinyāse dalamadhyāni kalpayitvā caturthe dalakoṭīṃ vidhāya caturasrād bahir dalāgrāṇi sparśayet | atrāpy aṣṭamabhāgeneti saṃbadhyate | vibhāgaśaḥ vibhāge vibhāge sarvadigbhāgeṣv ity arthaḥ | bhramaṇāt sūtrasyeti śeṣaḥ | etac ca sarvatra yojanīyam |
ayam arthaḥ | caturasraṃ kṣetraṃ prāgagrābhir udagagrābhiś ca rekhābhir aṣṭadhā vibhajya madhyadeśe lāñchayitvā kṣetrād bahiś caturdikṣu samantād aparam aṣṭabhāgaṃ vinyaset saty evaṃ lāñchanāt paritaḥ pratidiśaṃ [130] pañcapañcāṣṭamabhāgāvadhirekhā bhavanti | tataḥ pūrvoktalāñchanopari vinyastādes tattadrekhāvinyastaprāntasya ca sūtrasya paribhramaṇāt pañcavṛttāni saṃpādya vṛttātiriktarekhāḥ parimārjayet tataḥ prathame vṛtte karṇikā | dvitīye kesarāṇi | tṛtīye dalamadhyāni | caturthe dalakoṭayaḥ | pañcame dalāgrānīti kṛtvā aṣṭadalaṃ pūrvābhimukhayonikaṃ padmakuṇḍam uttaradiśi kuryāt |
idānīm eta deva kuṇḍaṃ prakārāntareṇocyate
vṛttakuṇḍaṃ samaṃ cānyad atha vānyaprakārataḥ |
vṛttakuṇḍaṃ purā kṛtvā caturdhā mekhalāṃ bhajet ||
utsedhaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā karṇikā sārdhikā bhavet |
avaśiṣṭaṃ dalaṃ vedadalam aṣṭadalaṃ tu vā ||
yathā pratīcyāṃ diśi vṛttakuṇḍam abhihitam ihāpi tathaiva kṛtvā tanmadhye yathāvibhāgaṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ kuryād iti | atha vetyādinā tṛtīyaḥ prakāra ucyate | pūrvaṃ vṛttakuṇḍam eva āmekhalaṃ mekhalām avadhīkṛtya vṛttatrayasya karaṇāc caturthakṣetravibhāgaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | tataḥ kṣetramadhye sārdhabhāgena vistṛtā karṇikā vidheyā | utsedhaṃ ca tathā kṛtveti, karṇikāyā ucchrayam api sārdhabhāgena kṛtvety arthaḥ | avaśiṣṭena sārdhabhāgadvayena kesaravyatiriktāni dalāny eva kuryāt | evaṃ caturdalam aṣṭadalaṃ vā padmakuṇḍaṃ kuryāt |
kṣetrād dvādaśamaṃ bhāgaṃ caturdikṣu tadantare |
vinyasya tatpramāṇena turyāṃśam aparaṃ nayet ||
tasya karṇapramāṇena tadbhajāsv api lāñchayet |
[131]        tatrāṣṭasūtrasaṃyogād aṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍam ucyate ||
dvādaśadhā vibhaktasya kṣetrasya yāvān dvādaśo bhāgas tāvantaṃ bhāgaṃ caturdikṣu vinyasya, tadantare tasya kṣetrasya antare bahiḥpradeśe antaraṃ bahir yogopasaṃvyānayor iti jñāpakād antaraśabdo ‘tra bahirvacanaḥ | tatpramāṇeneti tasya bahirvinyastadvādaśabhāgasya parimāṇena aparaṃ dvitīyaṃ dvitīyaṃ turyāsraṃ caturasraṃ nayet praṇayet kuryāt iti yāvat | turyāsram iti svārthiko ‘tra pūraṇapratyayaḥ | tasya karṇapramāṇeneti | koṇāt koṇāntarasparśisūtraṃ śiplaśāstreṣu karṇa iti prasiddham | iha tu kṣetragarbhād ārabhya catuṣkoṇagāminaḥ pṛthav eva catvāraḥ karṇā ity abhiprāyeṇa karṇārdham api karṇaśabdenoktam | tenāyam arthaḥ |
bāhyasthitacaturasrasya garbhadeśāvadhir yāvān karṇas tāvatā mānena tadbhujāsu tasya karṇasya bhujāsu lāñchayet | atra bāhyacaturasrasūtrāṇy eva karṇobhayapārśvavartīni nijabhujākāratayā bhujāśabdenocyante | ayam āśayaḥ | bāhyacaturasrasaṃbandhiny ekasmin koṇe karṇārdhaparimitasya sūtrasyādiṃ nidhāya tatsūtraṃ caturasrarekhopari prasārya sūtraprānte lāñchayet | evaṃ pratikoṇaṃ sūtrādiṃ nidhāya prātilomyānulomyena sūtraprasāraṇāt tattatprānte lāñchayan pradidiśaṃ [pratidiśaṃ?] lāñchanadvayakaraṇād dikcatuṣṭayena lāñchaneṣu sūtrāṣṭakanipātanād aṣṭāsrakuṇḍaṃ kuryād iti |
ayam ih nirmāṇaprakāraḥ |
pūrvavac caturasrīkṛtasya kṣetrasya bahiś caturdikṣu dvādaśamaṃ bhāgaṃ vinyasya tatparimāṇena aparaṃ caturasraṃ kuryāt | atha tadīya[132]karṇārdhaparimitasya sūtrasya pratikoṇam ādiṃ nidhāya caturasarekhopari prasāraṇāt tattatprānteṣu lāñchayan dikcatuṣṭayena lāñchanāṣtakaṃ kṛtvā tallāñchanopari sūtrāṣṭakanipātanād aiśānadiśi pūrvābhimukhayonikam aṣṭāśrakuṇḍaṃ kuryāt | idānīṃ digniyamam antareṇaiva tattatkarmopayogitayā vijñānalalitopadiṣṭaṃ kuṇḍadvayam ucyate |
saptamāṃśaṃ bahir nyasya kṛtvā vṛttam iha bhramāt |
caturthabhāgān nyūnena pūrvakṣetre ca [pūrvakṣetreṇa?] saṃmitaiḥ ||
dhanurjyākṛtibhiḥ pañcasūtraiḥ pañcāsrakuṇḍakam |
home praśasyate bhūtaśākinī grahanigrahe ||
caturasrasya kṣetrasya bahiḥpradeśe caturdikṣu kṣetrasaptamāṃśaṃ vinyaset | tataḥ kṣetragarbhavinyastādeḥ bāhyasthitasaptamāṃśopari vinyastaprāntasya sūtrasya sarvataḥ paribhramaṇāt vṛttaṃ niṣpādayet | pūrvakṣetreṇeti, bahiḥsthitavṛttāpekṣayā pūrvakṣetraśabdena āntaraṃ caturasrakṣetram evocyate |
tataś cāyam arthaḥ | āntaracaturasrasya yad dairghyaṃ tat svakīyacaturthabhāganyūnaṃ kṛtvā yan mānaṃ bhavati tāvatā mānena parimitaṃ sūtraṃ vidhāya tādṛśāni pañcasūtrāṇi bāhyavṛttasyāntarvinyasya sūtrasandhau koṇaṃ kuryāt | tāni ca pañca sūtrāṇi pretyekaṃ prāntadvayasaṃspṛṣṭavṛttatvāt dhanurjyākṛtīni dhanurārūḍhamaurvīsadṛśāni syuḥ | tataḥ pañcasūtrātiriktaṃ sarvaṃ parimṛjya pañcāsrakuṇḍaṃ racayet | tac ca grahanigrahādihome prayojyam |
daśamāṃsaṃ bahir nyasya kṛtvā vṛttam iha bhramāt |
bhiktākṣetraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tadbhāgaiḥ triṃśatā tribhiḥ ||
samāyasūtraṃ tādakṣāt saptāsraṃ sūtrasaptakāt |
abhicāropaśāntyarthaṃ homakuṇḍam iti smṛtam ||
ihāpi caturasrasya kṣetrasya daśamabhāgaṃ caturdikṣu bahir vinyasya pūrvavat vṛttaṃ kuryāt | atha pūrvakṣetraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā vibhajya teṣāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭisaṃkhyānāṃ bhāgānāṃ madhye trayas triṃśatsaṃkhyair bhāgaiḥ parimitaṃ sūtraṃ kṛtvā tādṛśāni saptasūtrāni vṛttasyānte vinyasya saptāsraṃ kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt | atrāpi sūtrāṇāṃ dhanurjyākāratvaṃ sūtrasaṃdhau koṇanirmāṇaṃ saptasūtrātiriktaparimārjanaṃ ceti pūrvavad eva veditavyam | etac ca kuṇḍam abhicāradoṣopaśamanahomeṣu prayojyam | āha viśvakarmā |
yāvanmātraḥ kuṇḍavistāra uktas
tāvatkhātasyāpi mānaṃ pradiṣṭam |
yādṛkkuṇḍasyākṛtiḥ saṃpradiṣṭā
tādṛgrūpaṃ mekhalāyā vidadhyāt ||
sthāpane sarvakuṇḍānāṃ dhvajāya sarvasiddhadaḥ ||
sarveṣu caiteṣu proktamānādvaddhāṅgulayavādi nyūnam atiriktaṃ vā vidhāya jvajāyaḥ sādhanīyaḥ | vistāre dairghyaguṇite aṣṭabhir vibhakte yady ekaḥ pariśiṣyate tadā dhvajāya iti |
khāte ‘dhike bhaved rogī hīne dhenudhanakṣayaḥ |
vakrakuṇḍe tu saṃtāpo maraṇaṃ bhinnamekhane ||
mekhalārahite śoko ‘bhyadhike vittasaṃkṣayaḥ |
[134]        bhāryāvināśanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍe yonyā vinā kṛte ||
apatyadhvaṃsanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yat kaṇṭhavarjitam ||
khātahīne bhaved roga ityādinā khātādilakṣaṇarahitasya kuṇḍasyāniṣṭaphlatvadarśanādidānīṃ khātādīnām eva lakṣaṇam abhidhīyate | tad yathā mohacūḍottaraśāstre |
caturviṃśatimaṃ bhāgaṃ aṅgulaṃ parikalpya tu |
caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ hastaṃ kuṇḍānāṃ parikalpayet |
hastamātraṃ khanet tiryag ūrdhvaṃ mekhalayā saha ||
muṣṭimānaṃ śatārdham ityādinā prasiddhenaiva hastāṅgulavyavahāreṇa homānusārāt kuṇḍamānam uktam | iyaṃ tu khātādimānakathanārthaṃ paribhāṣā kriyate | cikīrṣitakuṇḍakṣetraṃ caturviṃśatidhā vibhajya yāvān caturviṃśatitamo bhāgas tāvat parimāṇam aṅgulaṃ parikalpya caturviṃśatyā aṅgulair hastaṃ parikalpayet | tatas tena hastena parimitaṃ sarvakuṇḍānāṃ tiryakkātamānaṃ vidhāyamekhalāsahitasya khātasya tenaiva hastena parimitam ūrddhvamānaṃ vidadhyāt | prathameṣu uktam | kuṇḍaṃ jināṅgulaṃ tiryagūrdhvaṃ mekhalayā saha |  jināṅgulaṃ caturviṃśatyaṅgulam | pratiṣṭhāsārasaṃgrahe ‘pi |
pañcatrimekhalocchrāyāṃ jñātvā śeṣam adhaḥ khanet |
viśvakarmaṇāpy uktam |
vyāsāt khātaḥ karaḥ prokto nimnas tithyaṅgulena tu |
tithyaṅgulāni pañcadaśāṅgulāni khātasya nimratvam | unnatā sā navāṅgulair iti, vakṣyamāṇatvān mekhalātrayapakṣe navāṅgulaṃ prathamamekhalayotsedha ity ubhayoś caturviṃśatyaṅgulatvam | [135] kaṇṭhamānam uktaṃ kālottare |
khātād bāhye ‘ṅgulaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ sarvakuṇḍeṣv ayaṃ vidhiḥ |
khātamekhalayor antarāle aṅgulamānena kaṇṭham oṣṭhāparaparyāyaṃ (?) kuryāt | sārasamuccaye |
khātād bāhyāṅgulaḥ kaṇṭhas tad bāhye mekhalā kramāt |
mekhalālakṣaṇam uktaṃ kāmike |
kṣetrārkāṃśena tasyoṣṭhaḥ syāt tad vedartubhāgataḥ |
mekhalā pṛthutocchrāyaḥ kuṇḍākārā tu mekhalāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ tu prakartavyā mekhalaikātra lāghavāt ||
kṣetrasya, arkāṃśena, dvādaśāṃśena kuṇḍasyauṣṭhaḥ kaṇṭhaśabdavācyaḥ syāt tad vedabhāgataḥ kuṇḍacaturthāṃśato mekhalāyāḥ pṛthutā vistāraḥ | tathā ṛtubhāgataḥ ṣaṣṭhabhāgena mekhalocchrāyaḥ kāryaḥ | piṅgalāmate ‘pi |
khātād ekāṅgulaṃ tyajya mekhalānāṃ sthitir bhavet |
mekhalaikātha vā tisro bhūtasaṃkhyātha vā priye ||
bhūtasaṃkhyāḥ pañcasaṃkhyāḥ | uktaṃ ca prathame |
kaṇṭhāṅgulād bahiḥ kāryā mekhalaikā ṣaḍaṅgulā |
catustridvyaṅgulā yad vā tisraḥ sarvatra śobhanāḥ ||
yadā ekā mekhalā tadā sā vistārotsedhābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgulā vidheyā,
ekā ṣaḍaṅgulotsedhavistārā mekhalā matā |
iti piṅgalokteḥ | yadā tu mekhalātrayapakṣas tadā krameṇa catustridvyaṅgulamānāḥ kartavyāḥ | mohacūdrottare |
mekhalātritayaṃ kāryaṃ koṇarāmayamāṅgulaiḥ |
koṇāḥ catvāraḥ | rāmāḥ [136] trayaḥ | yamau dvau | tatra sarvāntimā dvyaṅgulā | madhyasthāḥ tryaṅgulāḥ | kuṇḍakaṇṭhasaṃnihitā caturaṅgulā iti | saty evaṃ prathamamekhalāyāḥ kuṇḍakaṇṭhād ārabya navāṅgula utsedhaḥ syāt | lakṣaṇasaṃgrahe ‘pi |
prathamāṣṭāṅgulā vyāsād unnatā sā navāṅgulaiḥ |
madhyāt tu tryaṅgulā bāhye tṛtīyā tu yamāṅgulā ||
mekhalāḥ pañca vā kāryāḥ ṣaṭpañcābditripakṣakaiḥ ||
prathamakuṇḍasaṃnihitā āntarotsedhanavāṅgulā bāhye tu caturaṅgulaiva | aṣṭāṅgulā caturaṅgulā | abdayaḥ catvāraḥ | pakṣau dvau | yonilakṣaṇam uktaṃ svāyaṃbhuve |
mekhalā madhyato yoniḥ kuṇḍārddhā tryaṃśavistṛtā |
aṅguṣṭhamanoṣṭhakaṇṭhā kāryā śvatyadalākṛtiḥ (?) ||
prāgagniyāmyakuṇḍānāṃ proktā yonir udaṅmukhā |
pūrvāmukhāḥ smṛtāḥ śeṣā yathā śobhaṃ samanvitāḥ ||
mekhalāyā garbhadeśe kuṇḍārdhadīrghā kuṇḍatṛtīrāṃśavistṛtā yoniḥ kāryāḥ | atroṣṭaśabdena yonyagram ucyate | kaṇṭhaśabdena ca yonimekhalā | aṅguṣṭhaśabdaḥ aṅgulaparyāyaḥ | ekāṅgulaparimāṇēna yoner agramekhalāṃ ca kuryād ity arthaḥ,
vistāro ‘ṣṭāṅgulo yoner agram aṅgulasaṃmitam |
iti piṅgalokteḥ | nāradīye |
kuṇḍatryaṃśapravistārā yonir ucchrayatāṅgulam |
kuṇḍārdhena tu dīrghā syāt kuṇḍoṣṭhī bodhipatravat ||
kuṇḍoṣṭhīti yathā kuṇḍe dvādaśāṃśena oṣṭho vihita evaṃ [137] yoner api dvādaśabhāgena oṣṭhaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | yathā kuṇḍe praviṣṭa oṣṭho yasyā iti | bodhipatram aśvatthapatram | trailokyasāre |
dīrghāt sūryāṅgulānābhis tryaṃśonā vistareṇa tu |
ekāṅgulocchritā sā tu praviṣṭābhyantare tathā ||
kumbhadvayasamāyuktā cāśvatthadalavan matā |
aṅgulamekhalā yuktā madhye tv ājyaghṛtis tathā ||
dakṣasthā pūrvayāmye tu jalasthā paścimottare |
navamāsyāpi kuṇḍasya yonir dakṣadalasthitā ||
sūryāṅgulāḥ dvādaśāṅgulāḥ | tryaṃśoneti dairghatṛtīyāṃśanyūnavistārā | ekenāṅgulenocchritā tathā ekenāṅgulena kuṇḍamadhye  praviṣṭā | kumbhadvayasamāyukteti pūrvoktāgneyakuṇḍasya tulyākṛter yoner budhnadeśasthitaṃ vṛttadvayam eva gajakumbhākṛtitvāt kumbhaśabdenoktam | tenātra kumbhasthalākṛtir ghaṭadvayaṃ mṛtpiṇḍadvayaṃ vā sthāpyam iti tad grāhyam | aṅguṣṭhamekhaleneti ekāṅgulamānayā mekhalayā pariveṣṭitety arthaḥ | madhye tv iti, yathā sruci ghṛtadhāraṇāya baliṃ kriyate tathā yonimadhe ‘pi bilaṃ kartavyam ity abhiprāyaḥ | dakastheti, pūrvāgneyayāmyakuṇḍeṣu dakṣiṇabhāgre uttarābhimukhā yoniḥ kāryā nairṛtyādikuṇḍeṣu tu paścimabhāge prāṅmukhā vidheyāḥ | navama iti, aṣṭadikṣu kuṇḍeṣv evaṃ vidhāya pūrveśānadiśor antarāle yan navamaṃ kuṇḍaṃ caturdikṣu vā kuṇḍacatuṣṭayam [138] kṛtvā īśānadiśi yat pañcamaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tayor api dakṣiṇabhāge ‘pi yoniḥ kāryety arthaḥ | bahvṛcapariśiṣṭe |
athābudhaḥ sa dhūme tu juhuyād yo hutāśane |
yajamāno bhaved andhaḥ saputra iti ca śrutiḥ ||
chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
pāṇyāhutir dvādaśa parva pūrvikā
rambhādinā cet sruci parvapūrikā |
daivena tīrthena ca hūyate haviḥ
svaṅgāriṇi svarviṣi tac ca pāvake ||
yo narciṣi juhoty agnau vyaṅgāriṇi ca mānavaḥ |

marīciḥ |

paiṭhīnasiḥ: “kāṇḍamūlaparṇapuṣpaphalapraroharasagandhādīnāṃ sādṛśyena pratinidhiṃ kuryāt sarvālābhe yavaḥ pratinidhir bhavati” | maitrāyaṇīyapariśiṣṭe |

tena vaidikahomāṅgakeṣu darśapūrṇamāsādiṣu antyeṣu ca vacanaviśeṣiteṣu karmasu vṛddhiśrāddham ācaṇīyam (ācaraṇīyam ?) |
tathā tulāpuruṣāsīnām api yāgasaṃśabdanāt lokapālāvāhanamantreṣu ca sarveṣu mamādhvarampāhiyajñaṃ (?) rakṣetyādiśabdaprayogāt saty api dānarūpatve yāgadharmair ābhavitavyam iti tatrāpi vṛddhiśrāddham kartavyam | evam eva sahomakeṣu dhānyaparvatādiṣv api anusaṃdheyāḥ |
tasya vidhim āha kātyāyanaḥ |
ābhyudike pradakṣiṇam upacāraḥ pūrvāhṇe ‘pi amantraparvaṃ japaṃ ṛjavo darbhā yavais tilārthaḥ saṃpannam iti tṛptipraśnaḥ susaṃpannam ity anujñāto dadhibadarākṣatamiśrāḥ piṇḍā nāndīmukhān pitṝn vācayiṣye iti pṛcchati, vācyatām ity anujñāto nāndīmukhān pitṝn āvāhayiṣye iti pṛcchaty āvāhayety anujñāto nādīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantām ity antakṣayyasthāne nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ mātaro mātāmahāś ca prīyantām iti, na svadhāṃ prayuñjīta yugmān āśayet | iti |
[142] nigadavyākhyātam etat | śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |

apūjya kārayet karma kinviṣeṇaiva yujyate ||
tadvidhis tu kātyāyanasūtre |
ṣaḍ arghyā bhavanty ācāryā ṛtvigvaivāhyā rājā priyaḥ snātaka iti pratisaṃvatsarān arhayeyur yakṣamānā ṛtvijaḥ |
āsanam āhāryāha | sādhubhāvānās tāṃ arcayiṣyāmībhavantm ity āharanti viṣṭaraṃ pādyaṃ pādārghyam udakam argham ācamanīyaṃ madhuparkadadhimadhugṛhtam kāṃsye kāṃśyenānyas tris triḥ prāha viṣṭarādīni viṣṭaraṃ pratigṛhṇāti varṣmosmi samānām udyatām asūryaḥ |
imantam abhitiṣṭāmi yo mākaś cābhidā satīty enam abyupaviśati pādayor anyaṃviṣṭara āsīnāya savyaṃ pādaṃ prakṣālya dakṣiṇaṃ prakṣālayati brāhmaṇaś ced dakṣiṇaṃ prathamaṃ virājo dohasi virājo doham aśīyamayi pādyāyai virājo doha ity arghyaṃ pratigṛhṇāty āpastha yuṣmābhiḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnavānīti vinayann abhimantrayate samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi svāṃ yonim abhigacchata |
ariṣṭā asmākaṃ vīrāṇām āparā secimatpaya ity ācāmaty āmāganya[143]sāmamīyasā sṛjavarcasā taṃ māṃ kurupriyaṃ prajānām adhipatiṃ paśūnām ariṣṭaṃ tanūnām iti mantrasya tveti madhuparkaṃ pratīkṣate devasya tveti pratigṛhṇāti tam | save pāṇau kṛtvā dakṣiṇasyānāmikayā triḥ prayauti namaḥ syāvāsyāvānyaśaneyā viddhaṃ tat te niṣkrānāmīty anāmikāṅguṣṭena ca trir nirukṣayati tasya triḥ prāśnāti yan madhuno madhavyaṃ paramam oṃ rūpam annādyantenāhaṃ madhuno madhavyena parameṇa rūpeṇānnādyena paramo madhavyo ‘nnādo ‘sānīti madhumatībhir vā pratyṛcyaṃ putrāyānte vāsinovāntarata āsīnāyocchiṣṭaṃ dadyāt sarvaṃ vā prāśnīyāt prāg vā saṃcareti nayed ācamya prāṇān saṃmṛśati vāṅma āsyenasoḥ prāṇokṣyoś cakṣuḥ karṇayoḥ śrotraṃ bāhvor balam urvo rojo riṣṭāni meṅgāni tanus tatvāme mahetyācāntodakāya śasemā dāyagaur iti triḥ prāha pratyāha mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitāvasūnāṃ | svasāpānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya māgām anāgāmad iti vadhiṣṭheti mama camuṣya pāpmānaṃ | hatomīti yady ālabhaitāvyayadyutsisṛkṣen mama cāmuṣya ca pāpmāhatam utsṛjata tṛṇānyattv iti brūyān na tvevāmāṃ | saurdhaḥ syād dadhiyajñam adhivivāhaṃ kurutety eva brūyād yady apy asakṛt saṃvatsarasya some na yajeta kṛtārghyā evainaṃ yājayeyur nākṛtārghyā iti śruteḥ |
asyārthaḥ | āsanam āhāryetyantaṃ subodhāḥ | sādhubhavān ityādim arghyaṃ pratyadhyeṣaṇam | āharanty arghyaṃ pitṛsaṃbandhi puruṣābhiprāyeṇa bahuvacanam | viṣṭarocchinnāgrapañcaviṃśatikuśapatrakṛtaḥ |
tathā ca pariśiṣṭe |
katibhis tu bhaved brahma katibhir viṣṭaro mataḥ |
pañcāṣadbhir bhaved brahma tadardhena tu viṣṭaraḥ ||
[144]        ūrdhvakeśo bhaved brahma lambakeśas tu viṣṭaraḥ |
dakṣiṇāvartako brahma vāmāvartas tu viṣṭaraḥ ||
prathamo viṣṭara upaveśanārtham | pādyam iti, pādārghyaṃ dvitīyaṃ viṣṭaram | pādārgham udakaṃ sukhoṣṇam | argho vyākhyātaḥ | ācamanīyam udakam eva madhuparkaṃ dadhimadhughṛtaṃ kāṃśabhājane tenaivāphihitam | arghārghapitṛvyatirikto ‘nya eva viṣṭarādīni tris triḥ prāha, viṣṭaro viṣṭaro viṣṭaraḥ pratigṛhyatām ity evam | arghas to tuṣṇīm eva viṣṭaraṃ pratigṛhya varṣmo’smīti mantreṇa tatropaviśati | pādayor anyam iti, pādārgheṇa bādhyate |
tataś ca pādaprakṣālanānantaraṃ dvitīyaviṣṭaradānam | tathā cottarasūtre viṣṭara āsīnāya savyaṃ pādaṃ prakṣālya dakṣiṇaṃ prakṣālayatīti, ekasmin viṣṭara āsīnasya pādaprakṣālanam upadiśyate | brāhmaṇaś ced argho bhavati tadā dakṣiṇapādaṃ prathamaṃ prakṣālayet | virājo doho ‘sīti mantreṇa jalaṃ gṛhītvā prakṣālayaty arghya eva, āpastha iti mantreṇa arghaṃ pratigṛhṇāti, arghyodakaṃ ninayat samudraṃ va iti japati, ācāmayann iti mantreṇācamati mitrasya sveti (tveti?) mantreṇa, madhuparkam īkṣate devasya tvety mantreṇa madhuparkaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | sarveṣu caiteṣu tris trir etāni dravyāṇy abhidhāya pratigṛhyatām ity arthyam āhānyaḥ |
athārghyo madhuparkapātraṃ satye pāṇau kṛtvā dakṣiṇasyānāmikayā namaḥsyāveti mantreṇa madhuparkaṃ triḥ prayauti, miśrayatīty arthaḥ | [145] anāmikāṅguṣṭhena ca tūṣṇīṃ trir nirūkṣati niṣiñcatīty arthaḥ | caśabdāt prayauti ca | ataś ca pratiyuvanam, nirūkṣaṇam evaṃ ca nirūkṣaṇavyavadhānāt samantrakaṃ triḥ prayuvanaṃ vidheyam iti siddhyati |
yan madhuna iti madhumatībhir vā madhuparkaṃ triḥ prāśnīyāt | madhuparke ca some ca nocchiṣṭo bhavatīti smaraṇāt, ucchiṣṭasyaiva mantrapāṭhaḥ | athācamya vāṅma āsya ityādibhir mantraiḥ prāṇāyatanāni saṃspṛśan atra sākāṅkṣatvād astīty adhyāhāraḥ | sa iti ca sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ |
ariṣṭāni meṅgāni tanur it yatra, santv ity adhyāhāraḥ | ācāntodakāya śāsam ādāya gaur iti triḥ prāheti, ācāntodakagrahaṇāt punar ācamanam iti kecit | apare tv āhuḥ | ācāntam udakaṃ yena sa ācāntodakaḥ tadarthaṃ śastrādānam iti tādarthyaṃ ca paśvālambhasya tadarthatvād etac cārghyakartrā vācyam | tato mātā rudrāṇām iti mantram arghyaḥ pratibrūyāt |
amucyeti cārghyayitur nāma grahaṇam, yady ālabheta pāpmānaṃ ghātayāmīti prayogaḥ | atha yady utsisṛkṣen mama cāmuṣya ca pāpmāhatam utsṛjata tṛṇānyatv iti brūyāt |

yamaḥ |

eta deva niroṅkāraṃ kuryāt kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ ||
kaśyapaḥ: “loke bhūtikarmasu vai tadādīny eva vākyāni syur yathā puṇyāhaṃ susamṛddham” iti | bhūtikarmasu saṃpatkarakarmasu, svastivācanādiṣv iti yāvat | etadādīni praṇavādīni | puṇyāhavācanam uktaṃ bahvṛcapariśiṣṭe |
avanikṛtajānumaṇḍalaṃ kamalamukulasadṛśam añjaliṃ śirasyādhāya, dakṣiṇena pāṇinā suvarṇapūrṇakalaśaṃ dhārayitvā, dīrghānāgānadyogirayas strīṇi viṣṇupadāni ca tena āyuḥpramāṇena puṇyāhaṃ dīrgham āyur astu, śivā āpaḥ santu, saumasyam astu, akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstu, gandhāḥ pāntu, māṅgalyaṃ cāstu, puṣpāṇi pāntu, saśriyam astu, akṣatāni pāntu, āyuṣyam astu, tāṃbūlāni pāntu, aiśvaryam astu, dakṣiṇāḥ pāntu, ārogyam astu, dīrgham āyuḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭituṣṭiḥ trīr yaśo vidyā vinayo vittaṃ bahuputraṃ cāyuṣyaṃ cāstu, yaṃ kṛtvā sarvavedīyajñakriyākaraṇakarmārambhāḥ śubhāḥ śobhanāḥ pravartante, tam aham oṅkāram ādiṃ kṛtvā ṛgyajuḥsāmāśīrvacanaṃ bahuṛṣimataṃ samanujñātabhavadbhir anujñātaḥ puṇyam, puṇyāhaṃ vācayiṣye, vācyatāṃ draviṇodā draviṇam astu, asya savitāpaścātān navo navo bhavati, jāyamānoccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthur ity etā ṛcaḥ puṇyāhe brūyāt, vrataniyamatapaḥ-svādhyāyaśatrudamadānaviśiṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ manaḥ samādhīyatām, [147] samāhitamanasaḥ smaḥ | prasīdantu bhavantaḥ prasannāḥ smaḥ śāntir astu, puṣṭir astu, tuṣṭir astu, vṛddhir astu, avighnam astu, āyuṣam astu, ārogyam astu, śivaṃ karmāstu, karmasiddhir astu, putrasamṛddhir astu, dhanadhānyasmṛddhir astu, iṣṭasampad astu, aniṣṭanirasanam astu, yat pāpaṃ tat pratihatam astu, yac chreyas tad astu, uttare karmaṇy avighnam astu, uttarottaram ahar ahar abhivṛddhir astu, uttarottarakriyāḥ śubhāḥ saṃpadyantām, tithikaraṇa-muhūrtanakṣatrasaṃpad astu, tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatragrahalagnādhidevatāḥ prīyantām, tithikaraṇe muhūrte nakṣatre sagrahe daivate prīyetām, durgāpāñcālyau prīyetām, agnipurogā viśvedevāḥ prīyantām, indrapurogā marudgaṇāḥ prīyantām, vasiṣṭhapurogā ṛṣigaṇāḥ prīyantām, maheśvarapurogā umā mātaraḥ prīyantām, arundhatīpurogā ekapatnyaḥ prīyantām, viṣṇupurogāḥ sarve devāḥ prīyantām, brahmapurogāḥ sarve vedāḥ prīyantām |
brahma ca brāhmaṇāś ca prīyantām, sarasvatyaḥ prīyantām, śraddhāmedhe prīyetām, bhagavaī kāatyāyanī prīyatām, bhagavatī māheśvarī prīyatām, bhagavato ṛddhikarī prīyatām, bhagavatī vṛddhikarī prīyatām, bhagavatī puṣṭikarī prīyatām, bhagavatī tuṣṭikarī prīyatām, bhavantau vighnavinyakau prīyetām, sarvāḥ kuladevatāḥ prīyantām, sarvāḥ grāmadevatāḥ prīyantām, hatāś ca brahmadviṣaḥ,
hatā vidviṣaḥ, hatāḥ paripanthinaḥ, hatāś ca vidhnakartāraḥ, hatāś ca vighnakarāḥ, śatravaḥ parābhavaṃ yāntu, śāmyantu ghorāṇi, śāmyantu pāpāni, śāmyantu ītayaḥ śubhāni vardhantām, śivā āpaḥ santu śivā ṛtavaḥ santu, śivā agnayaḥ santu, śivā āhutayaḥ santu, śivā vana[148]spatayaḥ santu, śivā āpaḥ santu, ahorātre śive syātāṃ nikāme, nikāme, naḥ parjanyo varṣatu | phalavatyo na oṣadhayaḥ pacyatāṃ yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatām, śukrāṅgārakabudha-bṛhaspatiśnaiśvararāhuketusomasahitā ādityapurogāḥ sarve grahāḥ prīyantāṃ, bhagavān nārāyaṇaḥ prīyatām, bhagavān pajanyaḥ prīyatām, bhagavān svāmī mahāsenaḥ prīyatāṃ puṇyāhakālaṃ vacayiṣye, vācyatām udgāteva śakune sāmagāyasi yājyayā yajati yat puṇyaṃ nakṣatraṃ tadvad akuvītopanyūṣaṃ yadā vai sūrya udeti adhanakṣatraṃ naiti yāvati tatra sūryo gacchet yatra jaghanyaṃ paśyet tāvat kurvīta yat kārīsyāt puṇyāha evaṃ kurute tāni yāni etāni yamanakṣatrāṇi yāny eva devanakṣatrāṇi teṣu kurvīta yat kārīsyāt puṇyāha evaṃ kurute puṇyāhaṃ bhavanto brūvantu aum puṇyāhaṃ svastaye vāyum upabruvāmahe āditya uditīya, svastina indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svastinaḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ svastinas tārkṣo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatir dadhātu |
aṣṭau deva vasavaḥ somyāsaḥ catasro devyorajasā śraviṣṭāḥ te yajñaṃ pāntu rajasaḥ purastāt saṃvatsarīṇam amṛtaṃ svsti |
