hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pratiranta āyuḥ || iti |
hārītaḥ |
āpo dadat tṛṣam abhijayaty ātmānaṃ ca niṣkrīṇāti | [151] annadānād asūn niṣkrīṇāti annavān annādo ‘nnapatiś ca bhavati | vastradānād vaco niṣkrīṇāti surūpo ‘nagno vastrabhāg bhavati | hiraṇyapradānāt tejo niṣkrīṇāti sutejāḥ śrīmān hiraṇyabāg bhavati | gopradānād vāco nikrīṇāti suvāg vipāpmā gobhāk ca bhavati | anaḍutpradānāt prāṇān niṣkrīṇāty arogo balavān dhuryabhāk ca bhavati | rathapradānāc charīraṃ niṣkrīṇāti bhṛtyavividhavimānabhāg bhavati | śayyāpradānāt sukhaṃ niṣkrīṇāti yānaśayanāsanavividhasukhaśrībhāg bhavati | aparimitapradānād aprimitatoṣaṃ puṣṇāti aparimitān kāmān avāpnoti |
tad dvividhaṃ bhavati avijñātadānaṃ ca vijñātadānaṃ ca | yad avijñātaviduṣe tad avijñātaṃ dānam | atha yad vijñātaviduṣe sabrahmacāriṇe vaiśvānaram ādadānāya yad dadāti pratigṛhṇāti ca tad vijñātadānam | tad apy etad yajuṣyuktam (idaṃ kasmā adād iti) |
ātmānaṃ niṣkrīṇāti ātmānam eva dadātīty arthaḥ | anena prakāreṇa jalādidānam eva stūyate |
viṣṇuḥ:
taijasānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ pradānena pātrī bhavati kāmānām | madhughṛtataila-dānenārogyam, auṣadhapradānena ca | dhānyapradānena tuṣṭiḥ, sasyadānena ca tathā | indhanapradānena dīptāgnir bhavati, saṃgrāme sajjayam āpnoti | āsanadānena sthānam | śayyādānena bhāryām | upānatpradānenāśvatarīyutaṃ ratham | kṣetrapradānena svargam | lātavṛntacāmarapradānenāduḥkhitvam | puṣpaprakānena jyāyān bhavati | anulepanapradānena kīrtimān bhavati || [ViDh 92.15–30]
[152] āha manuḥ |
vāridas tṛptim āpnoti sukham akṣayyam annadaḥ |
tilapradaḥ prajām iṣṭāṃ dīpadaś cakṣur uttamam ||
bhūmidaḥ sarvam āpnoti dīrgham āyur hiraṇyadaḥ |
gṛhado ‘grāṇi veśmāni rūpyado rūpam uttamam ||
vāsodaś candasālokyam aśvisālokyam aśvadaḥ |
anaḍuddaḥ śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godo bradhnasya viṣṭapam ||
yānaśayyāprado bhāryām aiśvaryam abhayapradaḥ |
dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahmasārṣṭitām||
brahmasārṣṭitāṃ brahmasamānagatitvam | yājñavalkyaḥ |
bhūdīpāśvānnavastrāmbhastilasarpiḥpratiśrayān |
naiveśikasvarṇadhūryān datvā svarge mahīyate ||
gṛhadhānyābhayopānacchatramālyānulepanam |
yānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ śriyaṃ śayyāṃ datvātyantaṃ sukhī bhavet ||
pratiśrayaḥ pravāsinām āśrayaḥ | naiveśikaṃ vivāhaprayojanakaṃ dravyam | tathā |
śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ rogiparicaryā surārcanam |
pādaśaucaṃ dvijocchiṣṭamārjanaṃ gopradāsamam ||
yamaḥ |
datvā pratiśrayaṃ loke tathā datvaiva cābhayam |
tathā datvā kṣitiṃ viper brahmaloke mahīyate ||
chatrado gṛham āpnoti gṛhado nagaraṃ tathā |
tathopānatpradānena ratham āpnoty anuttamam ||
indhanānāṃ pradānena dīptāgnir bhuvi jāyate |
gavāṃ grāmapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
[153]        rukmadaḥ sarvam āpnoti rūpyado rūpam uttamam |
vāsodaś candrasālokyaṃ sūryasālokyam aśvadaḥ ||
rājopakaraṇaṃ datvā ratnāni vividhāni ca |
nagaraṃ ca tathā datvā rājā bhavati bhūtale ||
tathā |
devamālyāpanayanaṃ devāgārasamūhanam |
arcanaṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ dvijocchiṣṭāpakarṣaṇam ||
pādaśaucapradānaṃ ca prakalpya paricāraṇam |
pādābhyaṅgapradānaṃ ca śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ tathā ||
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ caiva grāsadānābhivandane |
bhikṣādīpapradānaṃ ca tathaivātithipūjanam ||
ekaikasya phalaṃ prāha gopradānasamaṃ yamaḥ |
yas tu saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ||
tasya puṇyakṛtān lokān na vaktuṃ prabhavāmy aham ||
saṃbhāro yajñavivāhādyupakaraṇadravyam |
phalamūlāni pānāni śākāni vividhāni ca |
yānāni datvā viprebhyo mudāyuktaḥ sadā bhavet ||
tathā |
dhānyodakapradāyī ca sarpirdaḥ sukham aśnute |
viprebhyaḥ pāduke dadyāc chayanāny āsanāni ca ||
vividhāni ca dānāni datvā ca nṛpatir bhavet ||
tathā |
annadas tu bhavec chrīmān sutṛptaḥ kīrtimān api |
tailam āmalakaṃ yacchan pādābhyaṅgaṃ tathaiva ca |
naraḥ sutṛptas tejasvī sukhavāṃś caiva jāyate ||
[154] tathā |
mṛttikāṃ gośakṛd darbhān upavītaṃ tathottaram |
datvā guṇavate viper kule jāyeta cottame ||
sukhavāsaṃ tu yo dadyād dantadhāvanam eva ca |
śuciḥ syāt subhavo vāgmī sukhī caiva sadā bhavet ||
pādaśaucaṃ tathā yānaṃ śaucaṃ ca gudaliṅgayoḥ |
yaḥ prayacchati viprāya śuciḥ śuddhaḥ sadā bhavet ||
gandhauṣadham athābhyaṅgaṃ mākṣikaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā |
yaḥ prayacchati viprāya saubhāgyaṃ sat u vindati ||
atriḥ |
durbhikṣe annadātā ca sabhikṣe ca hiraṇyadaḥ |
pānīyadas tv araṇye ca brahmaloke mahīyate ||
devalaḥ |
śrāntāyānnapradaḥ svargaṃ vimānenādhirohati |
prāpnoti daśagodānaphalaṃ rogipratikriyaḥ ||
prakṣālya pādau viprāya labhet godānajaṃ phalam |
candanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca phalāni kusumāni ca ||
tāmbūlam āsanaṃ śayyāṃ datvātyantasukhī bhavet ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
pādābhyaṅgaiḥ śirobhyaṅgair dānamānārcanādibhiḥ |
mṛṣṭavākyair viśeṣeṇa pūjanīyā dvijottamaiḥ ||
vāyupurāṇe |
candanānāṃ pradātāraḥ śaṅkhānāṃ mauktikasya ca |
pāpakartṝn api pitṝṃs tārayanti yathāśrutiḥ ||
mahābhārate |
dāsīṃ dāsam alaṅkāraṃ kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca |
brahmadeyāṃ sutāṃ datvā svargam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
labhate ca śivasthānaṃ balipuṣpaprado naraḥ |
[155] tathā |
dhuryapradānena gavāṃ tathāśvair
lokān avāpnoti naro vasūnām |
chatrapradānena gṛhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ
yānaṃ tathopānahasaṃpradānāt ||
vastrapradānena phalaṃ surūpaṃ
gandhapradānāt surabhir naraḥ syāt |
bhikṣānnapānīyarasapradātā
prāpnoti sarvāṃś ca rasān prakāmān ||
pratiśrayācchādanasapradātā
prāpnoti tāny eva na saṃśayo ‘tra |
sragdhūpagandhānuvilepanāni
snāni mālyāni ca mānavo yaḥ ||
dadyād dvijebhyaḥ sa bhaved arogas
tathābhīrūpaś ca narendraloke ||
tathā |
candanāgurudhūpāṃś ca viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati |
tāmbūlaṃ ca srajaṃ caiva sa svargaṃ pravrajen naraḥ ||
tilān dadac ca pānīyaṃ dīpam annapratiśrayam |
satāṃ svargepsunām etat sūnṛtāni vacāṃsi ca ||
sāntvadaḥ sarvam āpnoti sarvaśokair vimucyate |
prekṣaṇīyapradānena smṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati ||
ādityapurāṇe |
dharmaśāstrapradātāraḥ satradānaratāś ca ye |
tīrthataḍāgakūpādinaukāsetupradāś ca ye ||
skandhena tārayed yas tu tṛṣārtānāṃ jalapradaḥ |
pakvān dadāti kedārān saphalāṃś caiva pādapān ||
ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi arbudānāṃ ca vai trayam |
krīḍanti te svargapure etad uktaṃ dvijottama ||
tathā |
aśvaṃ vā yadi vā yugyaṃ śobhane vātha pāduke |
dadāti yaḥ pradānaṃ vai brāhmaṇebhyaḥ susaṃyataḥ ||
tasya divyāni yānāni rathā dhvajapatākinaḥ |
duṣṭaḥ panthā na caiveha bhaviṣyati kathaṃcana ||
[156]        annapānāśvagovastrachatraśayyāsanāni ca |
pretaloke praśastāni dānāny aṣṭau viśeṣataḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
vastraṃ jalaṃ pavitraṃ ca datvātha śivayogine |
sa mahābhogam āpnoti ante yogaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ yo dadāti yaśasvine |
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tasya duḥkhaṃ na vidyate ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
abhyaṅgam indhanaṃ nīraṃ śayanāsanam eva ca |
dadyād gavāhnikaṃ caiva tam uddiśya dine dine ||
kāyinām annadānaṃ tu tad uddiśya nivedayet |
atha vā kiṃ pralāpena yat kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ bhuvi ||
kurvaṃs tat padam āpnoti śivam uddiśya līlayā ||
devīpurāṇe |
dravyaṃ bhūhemagodhānyaṃ tilavastraghṛtādikam |
vidhinā copavāsena ekānnanaktabhojanāt ||
śucinā bhāvapūtena kṣyāntyā(?) satyavratādinā |
api sarṣapamātrasya dātāraṃ tārayed dadat ||
ādityapurāṇe |
athānnadānād bhūdānāt prīto bhavati keśavaḥ |
guḍakṣīraghṛtair vastraiḥ prīto bhavati candramāḥ ||
jaladānāc ca varuṇaḥ suprasanno bhavet sadā |
rajatena ca dattena prītaḥ syāc ca maheśvaraḥ ||
suvarṇena tu dattena vahnir nityaṃ prasīdati |
hastyaśvarathayānaiś ca maghavān āsanais tathā ||
śayanair veśmabhir dharmas(s?)ūtreṇoṣṇāṃśur eva ca |
upānadbhyāṃ yamo gobhiḥ saurabheyaḥ kapardinaḥ ||
[157]        pādukābhyāṃ pradattābhyāṃ padmayoniḥ pratuṣyati |
alaṅkārais tathāmānyair jaganmātā ca pārvatī ||
skandapurāṇe |
yo gāṃ ca mahiṣīṃ dadyāt sālaṅkārāṃ payasvinīm |
kāṃśyavastrādibhir yuktāṃ sa kāmān labhate ‘khilān ||
saurapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca mahiṣīmeṣau ca daśadhenavaḥ |
brahmalokapradāyinyas tulāpuruṣa eva ca ||
vahnipurāṇe |
yānam aśvam anaḍvāhaṃ hemarūpyamaṇīṃs tilān |
ye prayacchanty (?) apāpeṣu niratāḥ sarvadā mune ||
na teṣāṃ bhairavaḥ panthā kadācid api jāyate ||
viṣṇudharmottare haṃsa uvāca |
naras tv āsanadānena sthānaṃ sarvatra nindati |
śayyādānena cāpnoti bhāryāṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
datvā dvijāya śayanaṃ svāstīrṇaṃ cottarachadam |
kule mahati saṃbhūtiṃ rūpadvaviṇasaṃyutām ||
tathā pakṣavatīṃ bhāryāṃ prāpnoti vaśagāṃ tathā |
anenaiva preadānena bhāryā patim avāpnuyāt ||
vitānakapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
chatradaś ca tathā vipro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
chatraṃ śataśalākaṃ ca vṛṣṭer ātapavāraṇam |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
yāmyaṃ mārgaṃ tathā yāti sukhena dvijasattama |
upānahau tathā datvā ślakṣṇasnehasamanvite ||
ratham aśvatarīyuktaṃ tridivaṃ pratipadyate |
[158]        sarvapāpavinirmukto yāmyaṃ mārgaṃ sukhaṃ vrajet ||
tālavṛntapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
tathā cāmaradānena sarvaduḥkhair vimucyate ||
pādukānāṃ pradānena gatim āpnoti śobhanām |
pādapīṭhapradānena sthānaṃ sarvatra vindati ||
snānam eva tathāpnoti daṇḍaṃ datvā dvijātaye |
yajñopavītadānena vastradānaphalaṃ labhet ||
uṣṇīṣadānasya tathā phalam etad udāhṛtam |
dantakāṣṭhapradānena saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt ||
mṛttikāyāḥ pradānena śuciḥ sarvatra jāyate |
śaucasnānodakaṃ datvā virogas tv abhijāyate ||
roganāśam avāpnoti tathābhyaṅgapradaḥ sadā |
tathaivauṣadhadānena roganāśam athāśnute ||
snānīyāni sugandhīni datvā saubhāgyam aśnute |
anulepanadānena rūpavān abhijāyate ||
kāyāgnidīptiprākāsyāṅgagiṃ caiva tathottamām |
yas tu saṃsādhanārthāya brāhmaṇāya prayacchati ||
sa yāti vahnisālokyaṃ śatrunāśaṃ ca vindati |
taijasāni tu pātrāṇi datvā salavaṇāni ca ||
taijasāni tu pātrāṇi satailāni prayacchataḥ |
ārogyam uttamaṃ proktaṃ lāvaṇyam api cottamam ||
tathā |
samudrajānāṃ bhāṇḍānāṃ śaṅkhādīni pradāyakaḥ |
pātrī bhavati kāmānāṃ yaśasaś ca na saṃśayaḥ ||
[159]        kaṅkatasya pradānena parāṃ bādhāṃ pramuñcati |
śayyāpradānaṃ lokeṣu tathā snānakaraṃ param ||
datvānulepanaṃ mālyaṃ parāṃ lakṣmīm upāśnute ||
tathā |
nṛvāhyaṃ puruṣo yas tu dvije samyak prayacchati |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya kathitaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
śivikāyāḥ pradānena vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ bhavet |
sa yāti śakrasālokyaṃ yas tu yodhaṃ prayacchati ||
yas tu karmakarīṃ dāsīṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati |
lokās tu sulabhās tasya vasūnāṃ samudāhṛtāḥ ||
taruṇīṃ rūpasaṃpannāṃ dāsīṃ yas tu prayacchati |
so ‘psarobhir mudāyuktaḥ krīḍate nandate vane ||
uṣṭraṃ vā gardabhaṃ vāpi yaḥ prayacchati tu dvijāḥ |
alakāṃ ca samāsādya yakṣendraiḥ saha modate ||
dānānām uttamaṃ proktaṃ pradānaṃ turagasya ca |
vaḍavāyāḥ pradānaṃ tu tathā bahuphalaṃ smṛtam ||
turagān yaḥ prayacchanti sūryalokaṃ vrajanti te |
yāvanti tasya romāṇi tāvad varṣaśatāni ca ||
śuklaṃ turaṅgamaṃ datvā phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhavet |
gaur yathā kapilā śreṣṭhā tathaiva turagaḥ sitaḥ |
turaṅgamaṃ suparvāṇaṃ sālaṃkāraṃ prayacchataḥ ||
puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ proktaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
caturbhis turagair yuktaṃ sarvopakaraṇair yutam ||
rathaṃ dvijātaye datvā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet |
[160]        pradāya kariṇīṃ samyag eta deva phalaṃ labhet ||
kuñjarasya pradānena manuṣyaḥ svargavicyutaḥ |
rājā bhavati loke ‘smin yaśovikramasaṃyutaḥ ||
suvarṇakakṣaṃ mātaṅgaṃ datvā viprāya vai dvijāḥ |
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindaty asaṃśayam ||
caturbhiḥ kuñjarair yuktaṃ rathaṃ datvā dvijātaye |
samagrabhūmidānasya phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
tathā |
yathoktavidhinā dadyāt krītvā tu kapilāṃ naraḥ |
sarvakāmasamṛddhaś ca sa yajñaphalam aśnute ||
gavāṃ lokam avāpnoti kulam uddharati svakam |
vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnoti datvā ca mahiṣīṃ tataḥ ||
alaṃkṛtāṃ tu tāṃ datvā godānaphalam āpnuyāt |
ajām alaṃkṛtāṃ datvā vahniloke mahīyate ||
tam eva lokam āpnoti datvājaṃ vidhivan naraḥ |
mahiṣasya pradānena yāmye loke mahīyate ||
vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnoti datvā ratnaṃ nṛpottama |
ghṛṣṭipradānāc tathā tad eva phalam aśnute ||
āraṇyapaśudānena vāyuloke mahīyate |
eta deva phalaṃ proktaṃ pradānena ca pakṣiṇām ||
brahmapurāṇe |
loke śreṣṭhatamaṃ sarvam ātmanaś cāpi yat priyam |
sarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dātavyaṃ teṣām evākṣayārthinā ||
jāmgranadamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ sūryasaṃnibham |
divyāpsarobhiḥ saṃpūrṇam annado labhate ‘kṣayam ||
[161]        ācchādanaṃ tu yo dadyād ahataṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi |
āyuḥprakāśam aiśvaryaṃ rūpaṃ ca labhate śubham ||
yajñopavītaṃ yo dadyāt pāduke śrāddhakarmaṇi |
śobhanaṃ labhate yānaṃ pādayoḥ sukham eva ca ||
vyajanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca datvā viprāya satkṛtam |
prāpnuyāt talpasaṃyuktaṃ śayanīyaṃ sukhāvaham ||
śrāddeṣūpānahau datvā brāhmaṇeṣu sadā bhuvi |
divyaṃ sa labhate cakṣur vājiyuktaṃ rathaṃ tathā ||
śreṣṭhaṃ chatraṃ ca vimalaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam |
prāsādas tūttamo bhūtvā gacchantam anugacchati ||
śaraṇaṃ ratnasaṃpūrṇaṃ saśayyāsanabhājanam |
śrāddhe datvā pitṛbhyas tu nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ||
muktāvaidūryavāsāṃsi ratnāni vividhāni ca |
lavaṇānāṃ supūrṇāni śrāddhe pātrāṇi yo dadet ||
rasās tam anutiṣṭanti āyuḥ saubhāgyam eva ca |
pātraṃ vai taijasaṃ datvā manojñaṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
pātraṃ bhavati kāmānāṃ vidyānāṃ ca dhanasya ca |
rājataṃ kāñcanaṃ caiva dadyāc chrāddhe tu karmaṇi ||
prabhūtaṃ labhate dātā prākāmyāṃ dhanam eva ca |
dhenuṃ śrāddheṣu yo dadyād gṛṣṭiṃ kumbhopadohanām ||
gāvastam anutiṣṭhanti gavāṃ puṣṭis tathaiva ca |
gandhavanti vicitrāṇi snānāni surabhīṇi ca ||
pūjayitvā tu pātrāṇi śrāddhe satkṛtya dāpayet |
[162]        gandhavahā mahānadyaḥ sukhāni vividhāni ca ||
dātāram upatiṣṭhanti punanty aśvapativratāḥ |
śayanāsanayānāni bhūmayo vāhanāni ca ||
dātāras upatiṣṭhanti tathā svarge mahīyate |
śrāddheṣv etāni yo dadyāt so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
sarpiḥpūrṇāni pātrāṇi śrāddhe satkṛtya dāpayet |
kumbhadohanakṣīrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ labhate gavām ||
ramyān āvasathān datvā rājasūyaphalārdhabhāk |
tathābharaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ sopadhānāṃ svalaṃkṛtām ||
śayyāṃ ca vividhāṃ datvā dvijo ‘gniṣṭomabhāg bhavet |
dāsīṃ dāsaṃ ca vividhaṃ tathaivoṣṭram ajāvikam ||
hastyaśvarathayānaṃ ca śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ |
tilāṃś ca vividhān datvā labhate phalam akṣayam ||
pitṛkarmaṇi yuktas tu śāliśobhanapuṇyakṛt |
ghanapuṣpaṃ phalopetaṃ datvā śobhanam aśnute ||
kūpārāmataḍāgāni kṣetrayoṣagṛhāṇi ca |
datvā tu modate svarge nityam ācandratārakam ||
svāstīrṇaṃ śayanaṃ datvā śrāddhe ratnavibhūṣitam |
pitaras tasya tuṣyanti svarge cānantyam aśnute ||
padakauśeyapatrorṇaṃ tathā pracchādakambalam |
ajinaṃ rauravapadaṃ pāvanaṃ mṛgaromajam ||
datvā caitāni viprebhyo bhojayitvā yathāvidhi |
prāpnoti śraddadhānas tu hayamedhasya yat phalam ||
[163]        kauśeyakṣaumamārgaṃ ca dukūlam ahataṃ tathā |
śrāddheṣv etāni yo dadyāt kāmān prāpnoty anuttamān ||
pakvānnāni karambhaṃ ca miṣṭānnaghṛtaśarkarāḥ |
kuśarā madhuparkaṃ ca payaḥ pāyasam eva ca |
snigdham uṣṇaṃ ca yo dadyāj jotiṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
mahābhārate |
vastrābharaṇadātāro bhaktapānānnadās tathā |
kuṭumbānnapradātāraḥ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
sahasrapariveṣṭaraḥ tathaiva ca sahasradāḥ |
trātāraś ca sahasrāṇāṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
suvarṇasya ca dātāro gavāṃ ca bharatarṣabha |
yānānāṃ ca pradātāras te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
vaivāhikānāṃ preṅkhāṇāṃ prekṣyāṇāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira |
dātāro vāsasāṃ caiva puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
vihārāvasatodyānakūpārāmasadapradāḥ |
prapāṇāṃ caiva kartāras te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
nayet pātāt tathā vādhād dāridryād vyādhidharṣaṇāt |
yatkṛte pratimucyante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
śuśrūṣābhis tapobhiś ca kṛtam ādāya bhārata |
ye pratigrahanisnehās te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
sarvahiṃsānivṛttāś ca narāḥ sarvasahāś ca ye |
sarvasyāśrayabhūtāś ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
āḍhyāś ca balavantaś ca yauvanasthāś ca bhārata |
ye vai jitendriyā dhīrās te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||
[164] nārasiṃhapurāṇe |
ekaviṃśatyamī svargā niviṣṭā merumūrdhani |
ahiṃsādānakartāro yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā ||
eteṣu nivasanti sma janāḥ krodhavivarjitāḥ |
ekaviṃśatisvargā anantaram eva vakṣyamāṇā ānandaprabhṛtayaḥ |
jalapraveśī cānandaṃ pramodaṃ vahnisāhase |
bhṛguprapāte sauravyaṃ raṇē caivātinirmalam ||
anaśane cātha saṃnyāse mṛto gacchet tripiṣṭapam |
kratuyājī nākapṛṣṭham agnihotrī ca nirvṛtim ||
kratuyājī somayāgakartā |
taḍāgakūpakartā ca labhate pauṣṭikaṃ dvija |
suvarṇadāyī saumbhāgyaṃ labhate svar mahātapāḥ ||
śītakāle mahāvahniṃ prajvālayati yo naraḥ |
sarvasatvahitārthāya sa svargaṃ cāpsaraṃ labhet ||
hiraṇyagobhūdānena nirahaṃkāram āpnuyāt |
bhūdānena tu suddhena labhate śāntikaṃ padam ||
gopradānena svargaṃ tu nirmalaṃ labhate naraḥ |
aśvadānena puṇyāhaṃ kanyādānena maṅgalam ||
dvijebhyas tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā datvā vastrāṇi bhaktitaḥ |
śvetaṃ tu labhate svargaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati ||
kapilā gopradānena paramārthe mahīyate |
ekānnabhojī yo martyo naktabhojī ca nityaśaḥ ||
upavāsī trirātrādyair ante svargasukhaṃ labhet |
[165] ekānnabhojī ekabhaktavrataḥ |
saritsnāyī jitakrodho brahmacārī dṛḍhavrataḥ |
nirmalaḥ sukham āpnoti tathā bhūtahite rataḥ ||
vidyādānena medhāvī nirahaṃkāram āpnuyāt ||
brahmapurāṇe |
karpūrāgurukastūrīcandanāni dvijātaye |
datvā samyag avāpnoti bhogam apsarasāṃ śubham ||
ratnālaṃkāravāsāṃsi śayanāsanabhājanam |
bahubhāgyaḥ sukhī caiva pradatvā jāyate naraḥ ||
yo dadāti mahāsatvaturaṅgarathadantinaḥ |
sa vimānavarārūḍhaḥ prajāpatipuraṃ vrajet ||
uṣṭrorabhrājamahiṣīṃ yo dadāti mahāyaśāḥ |
sa naiva narake vāsam āsādayati jātucit ||
nārasiṃhapurāṇe |
yas tu sarvāṇi dānāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
sa prāpya na nivarteta devaṃ śāntam anāmayam ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
kiṃ svit svakaiḥ pūjanair brāhmaṇānāṃ
lokaṃ gatvā brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇendrāḥ |
devair vipraiḥ pūjyamānaḥ sukhī syāt
tasmād deyaṃ prārthitaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe dānaphalaprakaraṇam ||

pañcamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha dānāni pratipādyante
tatra prathamaṃ viśiṣṭatayā tulāpuruādiṣoḍaśamahādānāni |
jātāḥ santi purā bhavanti bahavo ye dānaśauṇḍā narā |
stān kalpadrumakāmadhenutulayā stotuṃ samarthā janāḥ |
tāṃ dhenum api tadrumam bhuvimahādānacchālād yacchataḥ |
hemādrer upamānavastani punaḥ puṣnāti tūṣṇīṃ na kaḥ ||
tulāpuruṣamukhyanām api yena sahāsahā |
tulāpuruṣamukhyānāṃ dānānāṃ vidhim āha saḥ ||
tatra tulāpuruṣadānaṃ tāvad abhidhīyate | matsyapurāṇe sūta uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādānānukīrtanam |
dānadharme ‘pi yat proktaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ nṛṇāṃ duḥkhavināśanam |
yat tat ṣoḍaśadhā proktaṃ vāsudevena bhūtale ||
puṇyaṃ pavitram āyuṣyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham |
pūjitaṃ devatābhiś ca brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ ||
pādyaṃ tu sarvadānānāṃ tulāpuruṣasaṃjñitam |
[167]        hiraṇyagarbhadānaṃ ca brahmāṇḍaṃ tadanantaram ||
kalpapādapadānaṃ ca gosahasraṃ ca pañcamam |
hiraṇyakāmadhenuś ca hiraṇyāśvas tathaiva ca ||
hiraṇyāśvarathas tadvad dhemahastirathas tathā |
pañcanāṅgalakaṃ tadvad varādānaṃ tathaiva ca ||
dvādaśaṃ viśvacakraṃca tataḥ kalpalatātmakam |
saptasāgaradānaṃ ca ratnadhenus tathaiva ca ||
mahābhūtadhaṭas tadvat ṣoḍaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
sarvāṇy etāni kṛtavān purā śambarasūdanaḥ ||
vāsudevaś ca bhagavān ambaroṣō ‘tha pārthivaḥ |
kārtavīryārjuno nāma prahlādaḥ pṛthur eva ca ||
cakrur anye mahīpālāḥ kecic ca bharatādayaḥ |
yasmād vighnasahasrebhyo mahādānāni sarvadā ||
rakṣanti devatāḥ sarvā ekaikam api bhūtale |
eṣām anyatamaṃ kuryād vāsudevaprasādataḥ ||
na śakyam anyathā kartum api śakreṇa bhūtale |
tasmād ārādhya govindam umāpativināyakau ||
mahādānamakhaṃ kuryād vipraiś caivānumoditaḥ |
etad evāha manave parituṣṭo janārdanaḥ |
yathā tad anuvakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvam ṛṣisattamāḥ ||
manur uvāca |
mahādānāni yānīha pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca |
rahasyāni pradeyāni tāni me kathayācyuta ||
[168] matsya uvāca |
noktāni yāni guhyāni mahādānāni śoḍaśa |
tāni te saṃpravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
tulāpuruṣayogo ‘yaṃ yeṣām ādyo ‘bhidhīyate ||
ādyaḥ prakṛtibhūtaḥ |
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye |
yugādiṣūparāgeṣu tathā manvantarādiṣu ||
saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtidine caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca |
sitapañcadaśīparvadvādaśīṣv aṣṭakāsu ca ||
yajñotsavavivāheṣu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane |
dravyabrāhmaṇalābhe ca śraddhā vā yatra jāyate ||
tīrthe vāyatane goṣṭhe kūpārāmasaritsu ca |
gṛhe vātha vane vāpi taḍāge rucire tathā ||
mahādānāni deyāni saṃsārabhabhīruṇā |
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmād vasu cātīvañcalam ||
keśeṣv iva gṛhītas tu mṛtyunā dharmam ācaret |
puṇyāṃ tithim athāsādya kṛtvā brahmaṇavācanam ||
vakṣyamāṇaṃ maṇḍapādiṃ kārayed ity anvayaḥ |  tithim ity upalakṣaṇam | pūrvāhṇe puṇyamuhūrtādau ceti veditavyam, brāhmaṇavācanaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ puṇyāhādiśabdavācanam, tadvidhānaṃ tu paribhāṣāyāṃ prāg abhihitam |
iha cāyaṃ prayogakramaḥ | uktakālānyatamadānapratipādanadināt pūrvedyuḥ prātaḥ susnātaḥ [169] śvobhūte ‘ham amukadānaṃ pratipādayiṣye, iti yajamānaḥ saṃkalpaṃ vidhāya, pratyūhasamūhavighātāya śivaviṣṇuvināyakān saṃpūjya, brāhmaṇānujñātaḥ karma samārabhet, atha vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tadanantaram ṛtvigvaraṇaṃ vidhāya, tāṃś ca madhuparkavidhinā saṃpūjya, paścimadvāramaṇḍapaṃ praviśyāparāhṇe ‘dhivāsanaṃ vidadhyāt, madhuparkavidhikuṇḍamaṇḍapādilakṣaṇāni paribhāṣāyāṃ draṣṭavyāni | viśeṣas tu vakṣyate |
ṣoḍaśāratnimātraṃ ca daśa dvādaśa vā karān |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed vidvāṃś caturbhadrānanaṃ budhaḥ ||
yajamānasyaikaviṃśatyaṅgulaḥ, aratniḥ caturviṃśatyaṅgulaḥ, karaḥ | etac ca mānatrayam uttamamadhyamādhamabhedena vijñeyam | caturbhadrānanam iti catvāri bhadrayuktāni ānanāni dvārāṇi yasya sa tathā | yad āha dānasabhām adhikṛtya viśvakarmā |
dvāraiś caturbhiḥ parinirgatair yā
vibhūṣitā sundaramūrtirūpā |
ratnodbhavā sā kathitā sabhedyaṃ
bhadraṃ hy anindyaṃ karaṇīyam asyāḥ || iti |
matsyapurāṇe |
saptahastā bhaved vedī madhye pañcakarātha vā |
tanmadhye toraṇaṃ kuryāt sāradārumayaṃ śubham ||
uttamaṃ maṇḍape saptakarā vedī, itarayos tu pañcakareti vyavasthito vikalpaḥ, sā ceṣṭkāmayī caturthāṃśocchritā vidheyā |
tanmadhye tulāvalambānārthaṃ toraṇākṛtitvāt toraṇam, sāradārūṇi, śākeṅgudītyādi, vakṣyamāṇāni |
kuryāt kuṇḍāni catvāri caturdikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ |
[170]        sumekhalāyoniyutāni tadvat
saṃpūrṇakumbhāni mahāsanāni |
satāmrapātradvayasaṃyutāni
sayajñapātrāṇi saviṣṭarāṇi ||
hastapramāṇāni tilājyadhūpa-
puṣpopahārāṇi suśobhanāni ||
caturdiṣu vedyā iti śeṣaḥ | sapādahastasaṃmitaṃ ca kuṇḍavedyor antaraṃ vidheyam | pūrṇakumbhaḥ jalapūrṇakalaśaḥ | tāmrapātradvayaṃ havanīyahavyādhārabhūtam | yajñapātrāṇi sruksruvādīni | viṣṭaraḥ chinnāgrapañcaviṃśatikuśapatranirmitaḥ | dhūpaḥ guggulaprabhṛtiḥ | upahāraḥ phalānnādiḥ |
pūrvottare hastamitātha vedī
grahādideveśvarapūjanāya |
arcārcanaṃ brahmaśivācyutānāṃ
tathaiva kāryaṃ phalamālyavastraiḥ ||
pūrvottare īśānabhāge | āyāmato vistārataś ca hastasaṃmitā vitastimātrocchrayā ca vedī kāryā | tatra madhye sūryaṃ sthāpayet | āgneye somam, dakṣiṇato bhaumam, īśāne budham, uttare gurum, pūrve bhārgavam, paścimataḥ śanim, nairṛtyabhāge rāhum, vāyavyataḥ ketūn iti |
ādiśabdopāttāś caite, īśvaragaurīskandaviṣṇubrahmaśakrayamakālacitraguptā ity adhidevatāḥ |
agnijalabhūmiviṣṇuśakraśacīprajāpatisarpabrahmāṇa iti pratyadhidevatā ete svasvagrahaṇasaṃnidhau sthāpyāḥ |
tathā | vināyako durgā vāyur ākāśam aśvinau ceti śanisūryayor uttarabhāge rāhuketvoś ca dakṣiṇe durgāprabhṛtīnāṃ sthāpanam | tathā lokapālādīnām apy atra sthāpanam | teṣām uttaratra devatātvenābhidhānāt |
[171] tad uktaṃ smṛtyantare |
indraḥ pūrve tu saṃsthāpyaḥ preteśaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
varuṇaṃ paścime bhāge kuberaṃ cottare nyaset ||
indraḥ pīto yamaḥ śyāmo varuṇaḥ sphaṭikaprabhaḥ |
kuberas tu suvarṇābho agniś cāpi suvarṇabhaḥ ||
tathaiva nirṛtiḥ śyāmo vāyur dhūmraḥ praśasyate |
īśānas tu bhaved rakta evaṃ dhyāyet kramādimān ||
indrasya dakṣiṇe pārśve vasūn āvāhayed budhaḥ |
dhruvodhvaras tathā soma āpaś caivānilo ‘nalaḥ ||
pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavo ‘ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ |
deveśeśānayor madhye ādityānāṃ tathāyanam ||
dhātāryamā ca mitraś ca varuṇo ‘ṃśobhagas tathā |
indro vivasvān pūṣā ca parjanyo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tatas tvaṣṭā tato viṣṇur ajaghanyo ‘jaghanyajaḥ |
ity ete dvādaśādityā nāmabhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
agneḥ paścimato bhāge rudrāṇām ayanaṃ viduḥ |
vīrabhadraś ca śaṃbhuś ca girīśaś ca mahāyaśāḥ ||
ajaikapād ahirbradhnyaḥ pinākī cāparājitaḥ |
bhūvanādhīśvaraś caiva kapālī ca viśāmpatiḥ ||
sthāṇur bhagaś ca bhagavān rudrās tv ekādaśa smṛtāḥ |
[172]        preteśarakṣasor madhye mātṛsthānaṃ prakalpayet ||

maruto nāma te deva gaṇā vai saptasaptakāḥ |
āvahaḥ pravahaś caiva udvahaḥ saṃvahas tathā ||
vivahaḥ pravahaś caiva tathā parivaho ‘nilaḥ || iti |

atha tatraiva brahmaśivācyutānām arcanaṃ pratimāpūjanaṃ ca kartavyam | tallakṣaṇaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne vakṣyate | matsyapurāṇe |

catvāry api kṣīravanaspatīnām ||

lokeśavarṇāḥ, indraḥ pīto yamaḥ śyāma ityādinirantaroktalokapālasamānavarṇāḥ | paritaḥ, maṇḍapasya pūrvādisarvadikṣu | kiṅkiṇikāḥ, kṣudraghaṇṭikāḥ | kṣīravanaspatīnām, aśvatthodumbaraplakṣanyagrodhānāṃ pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimottaradvāreṣu yathākramaṃ mastake dārumayaśaṅkhacakragadāpadmacihnitāni toraṇāni kuryāt | [173] ratnāni kanakaprabhṛtīni paribhāṣāyām uktāni |

kṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ pañcakarocchitaṃ vā ||

śākaḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, mahārāṣṭre sādha iti prasiddhaḥ | śrīparṇī bhadraparṇī taruḥ | priyakaḥ bījakaḥ | stambhadvayaṃ caturaśrīkṛtya vedimadhye pūrvapaścimabhāgayor nidheyam | uttarāṅgaṃ stambhadvayor uparikāṣṭham | tac ca pañcakarocchritayoḥ stambhayor hastacatuṣṭayād upari nidheyam | athottarāṅgaṃ ca tadaṅgam eveti pāṭhe tadīyam iti stambhasajātīyakāṣṭhety arthaḥ |
samānajātiś ca tulāvalambyā

dairghyeṇa sā hastacatuṣṭayaṃ syāt

adhaś cakraṃ gadām ūrdhve vāmayoḥ karayoḥ kramāt |
ūrdhve śaṅkham adhaḥ padmaṃ govindaḥ kapilāṅgakaḥ ||
hastacatuṣṭayadīrghaṃ tu prāntadvayanyastayor lohapāśayor vahniḥ sthitamaṇḍalaṣaṭkaṃ vihāya vijñeyam |

īśaḥ śaśītyādi | atreśvaracandramārutasūryadevarājajaleśānāṃ brahmāṇḍadāne lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate | rudrasya viśvacakre | viśvakarmarūpanirmāṇam uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |

parjanyanāma vijñeyo gajavaktratrayānvitaḥ |
yo dhatte sarvajīvātmā varaṃ bījaṃ ca śaṅkhakam ||

[177]        mitraḥ kamalapāṇiś ca kamalāsanasaṃsthitaḥ |

varado bhaktalokānāṃ kirīṭī kuṇḍalo gadī |
kāryaḥ surūpo gandharvo vīṇāvādyaratas tathā ||
viṣṇulakṣaṇam āha viśvakarmā |

athartvijo vedavidaś ca kāryāḥ
surūpaveśānvayaśīlayuktāḥ |

ye cāryadeśaprabhavā dvijendrāḥ ||
guruś ca vedārthavid āryadeśasamudbhavaḥ śīlakulābhirūpaḥ |
[178]        kāryaḥ purāṇābhirato ‘tidakṣaḥ
prasannagambhīrasarasvatīkaḥ |

keyūrakaṇṭhābharaṇābhirāmaḥ ||

śubhās tatrāṣṭahotāro dvārapālās tathāṣṭa vai |

hemālaṃkāriṇaḥ kāryā dvijā vai pañcviṃśatiḥ ||

gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya dvārapālān samantataḥ |
paṭhadhvam iti tān brūyād ācāryas tv abhipūjayan ||
yajadhvam iti ca brūyād hotṛkān pura eva tu ||
utkṛṣṭamantrajāpyena tiṣṭhadhvam iti jāpakān iti |

matsyapurāṇe |
tato maṅgalaśabdena svāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ |

acyutādyor iti catasṛbhir avarohayet tāṃ tulām upasaṃskṛtya mahāvyāhṛtisāvitrīśāntibhirahomupayair ājyaṃ hutvā sarvasyāvṛtam iti pradakṣiṇam āvṛtyātmālaṃkāraṃ kartre dadyāt sahasraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ grāmavaraṃ ca | iti |
kartre ācāryāya ṛtvije ca |
tatrārdham ācāryasyārdham ṛtvijām iti, sahasraṃ dakṣiṇām it, sahasraśabdasyānupātta-saṃkhyeyaviśeṣatayā, matsyapurāṇe ca ratnānīty atra saṃkhyāviśeṣānupādānāt śākhāntare ca vararatnānāṃ dakṣiṇāsthānaśruteḥ ratnasahasram eva nyāyyam | tat tu yathāśakti yathālābhaṃ muktādīnām [186] anyatamasya sahasram avagamyate, dakṣiṇādhikaraṇanyāyena gavām iva samānajātīyānām eva saṃkhyāsaṃbandhāt \
grāmavaraṃ grāmaśreṣṭam |
kecit tu gurave grāmaratnānīty atrāpi śreṣṭatāvacano ratnaśabda iti vyācakṣate | teṣāṃ mate sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā smṛteti vacanāt, sahasraṃ dakṣiṇām it yatra suvarṇam eva dakṣiṇety avagantavyam | sahasrasaṃkhyāvyavacchedaś ca tasya kṛṣṇalātaprabhṛti yathāśakti saṃpādanīya iti |
prāpya teṣām anujñāṃ ca tathānebhyo ‘pi dāpayet |
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭādīn pūjayet brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ||
atrānyaśabdena jāpakā ucyante |
viśiṣṭā abrāhmaṇā api pitṛśuśrūṣādiguṇayuktāḥ | iha tāvad ardhaṃ gurave, ardham ṛtvigbhyaḥ, samastatulāpuruṣadravyaṃ deyam ity ekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
asmin pakṣe jāpakebhyo anyaiva dakṣiṇā dātavyā, gurvādīnām anujñayā anyebhyo ‘pi dadyād iti aparaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tatra gurvādīnāṃ pradeyadravyaparimāṇānirdeśe dharārddha (?)
caturbhāgaṃ gurave vinivedayed iti vikṛtibhūtapṛthivyādidānaprakaraṇaśrutaṃ deyadravyasaṃkhyāniyamo nyāyyaḥ |
yena vā tuṣyate gurur iti sāmānyopadiṣṭam ācaraṇīyaṃ tathā dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyo ‘pi deyam iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
[187]        atra yady api vikalpavācī śabdo nāsti tathāpi pakṣāntaraśrayaṇenārthād vikalpaḥ saṃpadyate | matyapurāṇe |
na ciraṃ dhārayed gehe suvarṇaṃ prokṣitaṃ budhaḥ |
tiṣṭhad bhayāvahaṃ yasmāc chokavyādhikaraṃ nṛṇām |
śīghraṃ parasvīkaraṇāc chreyaḥ prāpnoti puṣkalam ||
tataḥ prāgvat puṇyāhavācane kṛte devatāvedisamīpaṃ gatvā pūrve ca devatānāṃ pūjādi yajamānaḥ kuryāt | ācāryas tu –
yāntu devagaṇāḥ sarve pūjām ādāya pārthivāt |
iṣṭakām apradānārthaṃ punar āgamanāya ca ||
ity anena mantreṇa devatānāṃ visarjanaṃ kuryāt |
anena vidhinā yas tu tulāpuruṣam ācaret |
pratilokādhipasthāne pratimanvantare vaset ||
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā |
pūjyamāno ‘psarobhiś ca tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet |
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvat tasmiṃl loke mahīyate ||
karmakṣayād iha punar bhuvi rājarājaḥ
bhūpālamaulimaṇirañjitapādapīṭhaḥ |
śraddhānvito bhavati yajñasahasrayājī
dīptapratāpajitasarvamahīpalokaḥ ||
yo dīyamānam api paśyati bhaktiyuktaḥ
kālāntare smarati yācayatīha loke |
yo vā śṛṇoti paṭhatīndramānarūpaḥ
[188]                prāpnoti dhāma sa purandaradevajuṣṭam ||
vahnipurāṇe |
evaṃ datvā suvarṇaṃ ca brahmahatyādikaṃ tu tat |
pāpān nihatya puruṣaḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ rājan yad āyāti mahītale |
rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmān vītaśoko nirāmayaḥ ||
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno nityaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
punar viṣṇupadaṃ yāti yatra gatvā na śocati ||
iti tulāpuruṣadānavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
rājñāṃ ṣoḍaśadānāni nandina kathitāni ca |
dharmakāmārthamuktyarthaṃ karmaṇaiva mahātmanām ||
tulādhirohaṇādyāni śṛṇu tāni yathātathaṃ |
grahaṇādiṣu kāleṣu śubhe deśe suśobhane ||
viṃśahastapramāṇena maṇḍapaṃ kūṭam eva vā |
athāṣṭādaśahastena kalāhastena vā punaḥ ||
kṛtvā vediṃ tathā madhye navahastapramāṇataḥ |
aṣṭahastena vā kuryāt saptahastena vā punaḥ ||
dvihastādhardhahastā vā vedikā cātiśōbhanā |
dvādaśastambhasaṃyuktā sādhuramyāgramastakā ||
parito nava kuṇḍāni caturasrāṇi kārayet |
indra-īśānayor madhye pradhānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ||
atha vā caturasraṃ ca yonyākāram ataḥ param |
[189]        strīṇāṃ kuṇḍāni viprendra yānyākārāṇi kārayet ||
ardhacandraṃ trikoṇaṃ ca vartulaṃ kuṇḍam uttamam |
ṣaḍasraṃ sarvato vāpi trikoṇaṃ padmasaṃnibham ||
aṣṭāsraṃ sarvamārgeṣu sthaṇḍilaṃ kevalaṃ tu vā |
caturdvārasamopetaṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitam ||
diggajāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālāsamāśritam |
aṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktaṃ vitānopari śobhitam ||
tulāyāś ca dramāś cātha bilvādyāś ca viśeṣataḥ |
bilvāśvatthapalāśādyāḥ kevalaṃ khadiraṃ tu vā ||
evaṃ stambhāḥ kṛtā yena tena sarvaṃ tu kārayet |
atha vā miśramārgeṇa veṇanā vā prakalpayet ||
aṣṭahastapramāṇaṃ tu hastadvayasamāyatam |
tulāstambhasya viṣkambho nāhastatriguṇo mataḥ ||
dvyaṅgulena vihīnaṃ tu suvṛttaṃ nirvraṇaṃ tathā |
ubhayor antaraṃ caiva ṣaḍhastaṃ nṛpateḥ smṛtam ||
dvayoś caturhastakṛtam antaraṃ stambhayor api |
ṣaḍhastam antaraṃ jñeyaṃ tayor upari saṃsthitam ||
vitastimātravistāraṃ viṣkambhas tāvad aṅgulaḥ |
stambhayos tu pramāṇena uttaraṃ dvārasaṃmitam ||
ṣaṭtriṃśamātrasaṃyuktaṃ vyāyāmaṃ tu tulātmakam |
viṣkambham aṣṭamātraṃ tu yavapañcakasaṃyutam ||
ṣaṭtriṃśamātranālaṃ syān nirvraṇaṃ vartulaṃśubham |
viṃśahastetyādi | kūṭaḥ maṇḍāpaviśeṣaḥ | [190] kalāhastena ṣoḍaśahastaiḥ, viṃśatihastādi-maṇḍalatraye kramān navādihastavistārasya veditrayasya dvihasto ‘dhyardhahasto hastaś cety ucchrayo vidheyaḥ |
vidhāya maṇḍapaṃ tatra tanmadhye vedikān nayet |
navāṣṭasaptahastena dvihastādhyardhahastataḥ ||
vistāreṇocchrayeṇāpi dvādaśastambhasaṃyutām |
iti kāmikokteḥ | sādhuramyāgramastaketi, samacaturasratvaṃ samatalatvaṃ coparibhāgasya vidheyam ity arthaḥ | atha vā caturasram iti pūrvādikuṇḍānāṃ kramāc caturasrādayo nava saṃniveśyāḥ, strīṇāṃ tu yajamānatvena yonyākārāṇy eva | atha vā yathoktākāratvena sthaṇḍilatvena sarvatra hastamātraṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetraphalaṃ samam eva sādhyaṃ tac ca paribhāṣāyām upapāditam | vaṭodumbarāśvatthaplakṣajāni catvāi toraṇāni diggajāṣṭakaṃ tattaddikkālavarṇapatākāḥ, aṣṭamaṅgalāni viśvacakradāne vakṣyante | aṣṭahastapramāṇaṃ tulāstambhayor āyatam | āyāmaḥ, dairghyam ity arthaḥ | hastadvayasaḥ [hastadvayasamāyatam?], hastaparimāṇaḥ tulāstambhayor viṣkambha ity anvayaḥ | tasmāt triguṇaḥ parimāṇaḥ | dvyaṅgulena hīna iti, sa eva pariṇāhaḥ | kramahānyā agre aṅguladvayahīnaḥ saṃpādanīyaḥ | kāmike tu |
saptaṣaṭpañcahastais tu pārsvastambhocchrayo mataḥ |
aṣṭahastāditaś cātha dvipañcadvayasāṅgulaḥ ||
tulāstambhasya viṣkambho nāhastatriguṇo mene |
[191]        dvayāṅgulavihīnaṃ tu suvṛttaṃ nirvraṇaṃ tathā ||
iti dvipañcadvayasāṅgulo daśāṅgulamāno viṣkambhaḥ | triṃśadaṅgulaḥ pariṇāhaḥ | sa ca kramahānyā agre aṣṭāviṃśatyaṅgula ity arthaḥ | stambhayor anantaraṃ ṣaḍhastaṃ caturhastaṃ vā dṛśyastambhocchrayānurūpaṃ vidheyam | ṣaḍhastastambhayor antarālaṃ guṇadairghyasyopalakṣaṇam | uttaraṃ ca vistārosedhābhyāṃ dvādaśāṅgulam | tat prāntarandhrayoḥ stambhāgraśikhare praveśya toraṇaṃ niṣyādyam |
atha tulādaṇḍasya mānam āha | ṣaṭtriṃśanmānam ityādi | vyāyāmo nāma prasāritasabāhuhasta-dvayasya tiryagantarālabāhvoḥ karasaṃyutayoḥ vyāyāmas tiryagantarantayor ity abhidhānāt |
tataḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulānvitavyāyāmamātraṃ tulādaṇḍe dairghyam, viṣkambham aṣṭamātram iti, aṣṭāṅgulaḥ sapañcayavas tulādaṇḍaprāntayor nyāsaḥ |
tatrārthād yavonaṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaḥ pariṇāhaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśanmānamātram iti, tulādaṇḍamadhye ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaḥ pariṇāhaḥ | tatrārthāt dvādaśāṅgulo nyāsaḥ |
aṣṭāṅgulena vistāras tv agre bhūtayavānvitaḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmātranāhas tu madhyame tu vidhīyate ||
iti kāmikokteḥ |
agre mūle ca madhye ca hemapaṭṭena bandhayet |
paṭṭamadhye prakartavyam avalambanakatrayam ||
tāmreṇa vāpy arūpyeṇa āyasenaiva kārayet |
[192]        madhye cordhvamukhaṃ kāryam avalambaṃ suśobhanam ||
raśmibhis toraṇāgre vā bandhayec ca vidhānataḥ |
jihvām ekāṃ tulāmadhye toraṇaṃ ca vidhīyate ||
uttarasya tu madhye ‘tha śaṅkudvayam anuttamam |
vitānenoparichādya dṛḍhaṃ samyak prayojayet ||
sadṛḍhaṃ ca tulāmadhye mānam aṅgulamānataḥ |
paṭṭasyaiva tu vistāraḥ pañcamātrapramāṇataḥ ||
badhnīyāc cakrapāśaṃ ca avalambena susthitam |
śulbajau ca dṛḍhau vidvān bandhanena tu kārayet ||
śikyo [śikyau?] ‘dhastāt prakartavyau pañcapradeśavistarau |
sahasreṇa tu kartavyau pañcaprādeśavistarau ||
sahasreṇa tu kartavyau palenādhārakāmukau |
śatāṣṭakena vā kuryāt palānāṃ ṣaṭśatena vā ||
catustālavistāraṃ madhyamaṃ parikīrtitam |
sārdhatritālavistāro niyamaś ca vidhīyate ||
pañcamātraṃ caturmātraṃ trimātraṃ phalam ucyate |
caturdvārasamopetaṃ dvāram aṅgulinātha vā ||
kuṇḍalaiś ca samopetaṃ ślakṣṇasvacchasamanvitaiḥ |
kuṇḍale kuṇḍale kāryaṃ śṛṅkhalāparimaṇḍalam ||
śṛṅkhalādhāravalayam avalambena yojayet |
prādeśaṃ vā caturmātraṃ bhūmiṃ tyaktvāvalambdhayet ||
dhaṭo puruṣamātro tu kartavyo śobhanāv ubhau |
dvihastavālukāpūrṇe śile tatra vinikṣipet ||
[193]        dvihastamātram avaṭo sthāpanīyau prayatnataḥ |
śeṣaṃ saṃpūrayed vidvān bālukābhiḥ samantataḥ |
yena niścalatāṃ gacchet tena mārgeṇa kārayet ||
agre mūla ityādi, avalambanakīlakapraveśārthavedhanighātādinā yathā tulā na śīryeta tathā hemādinā paṭṭabandhas tulāyāḥ kāryaḥ |
avalambanam, samaśṛṅkhalādisaṃśliṣṭabalayādhārocchrakatuṇḍākārobhyāgralambanaṃ kāṛyam | atha vā tulām adhyāvalambanasthāne ūrdhvamukhaṃ tāmrādikīlakaṃ nidhāya tanmūlacchidraprotatiryakkīlakasthitaṃ madhyakīlakobhayapārśvasthāyi tāmrādimayaṃ toraṇaṃ kṛtvā tadagravalayabandharaśmibhir uttarādho’valambitaṃbalayaṃ saṃyojayet | jihvām ekām iti, pūrvokta eva tulāmadhyavartī ūrdhvamukhaḥ kaṭakākhyaḥ kīlakaḥ, jihvātoraṇam iti prāg uktam eva, etac ca suvarṇakārādilaghutulāsu dṛśyate | uttarasya tv iti, uttaramadhyāvalambitakuṇḍalāgro ‘yaḥśaṅkur ūrdhvamukhas tasya mūle uttaroparicitānavadvitataṃ lohapaṭṭaṃ nidhāya tadupari tanmūlaṃ dvidhābhūtaṃ tiryagvitatya ghaṭayet |
śaṅkuḥ sudhirasampanna iti, kuṇḍalitāgre uttamamadhyāvalambite ‘dhomukhaśaṅkau tulāmadhordhvamukhālambanaśaṅkī caikaṃ balayam aṅguṣṭhasthūlaṃ niyojayet śaṅkuḥ suṣirasaṃpanno valayena samanvita iti kāmikokteḥ | paṭṭasyeti, pūrvoktapaṭṭasyeyaṃ mānoktiḥ, pañcamātraṃ yavāṅgulaṃ badhnīyād iti, tulāprāntāvalambābhyāṃ tattacchikyaśṛṅkhalādhāraṃ cakrapāśākhyaṃ balayaṃ yojayet | śulvaṃ tāmram | ādhārāv [194] iti, tāmrapalānāṃ daśāṣṭaṣaṭśataiḥ kramāt pañcādiprādeśavistārau pañcacatustryaṅgulocchritaprāntāv aṅgulacatuḥchidraprotacaturvalayānvitau yajamānadravyadhārādhārakau kāryau | tadvalayacatuṣkāśliṣṭaśṛṅgalācatuṣkaṃ śikyākhyam upariviracitavalayadvayaṃ tulāgrādho’valambako yojayet | dhatākhyam upariviracitavalayadvayaṃ tulāgrādho’valambakau yojayet | dhaṭākhyādhārarandhracatuṣkaṃ madhūcchiṣṭena saṃśliṣṭaṃ kāryam, ādhārau ca bhūmer upari | caturṅgulam iti, prādeśamātre cāntarikṣe ‘valambyau | avaṭau tu dakṣiṇottarastambhanikhanārthau | atra stambhayoḥ dakṣiṇottaratvaṃ tulāyāś ca prākpañcimāyatatvam avadheyam | svameyaṃ caindradigbhāge suvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣiped iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | dvihastavālukā pūrṇe tatra śiḷe paṭṭaśilākhye nidhāya vālukābhiḥ prapūrya dṛḍhayet |
śrūyatāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ vedikopari maṇḍalam |
aṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktam aṅgulāṅkuśaśobhitam ||
phalapuṣpasamākīrṇe dhūpadīpasamanvite |
vedīmadhye prakartavyaṃ darpaṇodarasaṃnibhe ||
ālikhen maṇḍalaṃ pūrvaṃ caturdvārasamanvitam |
śobhopaśobhāsaṃyuktaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam ||
cullijātisamopetaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ ca kārayet |
vajraṃ bhāguttare bhāge āgneyyāṃ śaktim ujvalām ||
ālikhed dakṣiṇe daṇḍaṃ nairṛtyāṃ khaḍgām ālikhet |
pāśaṃ ca vāruṇe lekhyaṃ dhvajaṃ ca vāyugocare ||
kauveryāṃ ca gadāṃ lekhya īśānyāṃ śūlam ālikhet |
śūlasya vāmadeśe tu cakraṃ padmaṃ ca dakṣiṇe ||
[195]        evaṃ likhitvā paścāc ca homakarma samārabhet |
pradhānahomaṃ gāyatryā svāhā śakrāya vahnaye ||
yamāya devarājāya varuṇāya ca vāyave |
kuberāya tatheśāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe punaḥ ||
svāhāntaṃ praṇavenaiva hotavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam |
svaśākhāgnimukhenātha jayādi prati saṃyutam ||
sviṣṭāntaṃ sarvakāryāṇi kārayed vedavittamaḥ |
sarvahomāgrahome ca samitpālāśy athocyate ||
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ mantreṇānena homayet ||
ayaṃ na idhma ātmā jātavedas tena dvyasva (?) vardhasva ced uvardhaya cāsmān prajayā paśubhir brahmavarcasenānnādyena samedhayaḥ svāhā, bhūḥ svāhā, bhuvaḥ svāhā, svaḥ svāhā, bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā |
samiddhomaś carūṇāṃ ca ghṛtasya ca yathākramam |
śukrānnaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva mudgānāṃ caravaḥ smṛtāḥ |
sahasraṃ mbā tadardhaṃ mbhā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tu vā |
agna āyūṃṣi pavasa āśuvor jamiṣaṃ ca naḥ ārevādhasva dutsunāṃ agnir ṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ tamomahe mahāmayaṃ agnepavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryaṃ dadhad rāyaṃyami poṣam | prajāpate na tv etāny anyo viśvājātāni paritā babhūva yatkāmās te, juhumas tvan no astv ayam amuṣya pitāsāvasya pitā vayaṃ syāmaḥ patayoraiṇāṃ svāhā |
tat sarvaṃ sarvahome tu sāmānyaṃ vidhipūrvakam |
gāyatryā ca pradhānasya samiddhomas tathaiva ca ||
[196]        carūṇāṃ ca tathājyasya śakrādīnāṃ ca homayet |
vajrādīnāṃ ca hotavyaṃ sahasrādyaṃ tataḥ kramāt ||
brahmayajñān amantreṇa brahmaṇe viṣṇave namaḥ ||
nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāha dhīmahi |
tan no viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt ||
ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ kathito homamārgaḥ suśobhanaḥ |
dūrvayākṣīrasiktena pañcaviṃśat pṛthak pṛthak ||
tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanm |
urvārukam iva bandhnān mṛtyo mukṣīyam amṛtāt svāhā ||
dūrvāhomaḥ praśasto ‘yaṃ vāstuhomaś ca sarvathā |
prāyaścittam aghoreṇa vāstuhomaś ca sarvathā ||

viśālaḥ śālas tāmroṣṭho hy ambujātaḥ suniścayaḥ ||
kapilaḥ kalaśaḥ śūlaś cāyudhaś caiva romasaḥ |
gandharvo hy aditis tārkṣyo hy avijñeyaḥ susāradaḥ ||
[208]        parasvadhāyudho devo hy arthakārī suvāndhavaḥ |
jatuvīṇo mahākopa ūrdhvaretā jaleśayaḥ ||
ugravaṃśakaro vaṃśī vaṃśavandyo hy aninditaḥ |
sarvāṅgarūpī māyāvī suhṛdo hy anilonalaḥ ||
bandhano bandhakartā ca sabandhanavimocanaḥ |
rākṣasādiś ca kāmārir mahādaṃṣṭrasamāyudhaḥ ||
bahutvaninditaḥ sarvaśaṅkaraḥ sthāyy akopanaḥ |
amareśō mahāghoro viśvadevaḥ surārihā ||
ahirbudhnātirantiś ca cekitāno halī tathā |
ajaikapāc ca kāmālī śaṅkaro ‘jo mahādharaḥ ||
dhanvantarir dhūmaketuḥ śūnyo vaiśravaṇas tathā |
dhātā viṣṇuś ca śaṅkuś ca taryo tvaṣṭā dharo dhruvaḥ ||
prabhāsaḥ sarvatovāyur aryamā savitā raviḥ |
dhṛtiś caiva vidhātā ca māndhātā bhūtavāhanaḥ ||
tīras tīvraś ca bhīmaś ca sarvakarmā guṇodvahaḥ |
padmagarbho mahāgarbhaś candravaktro nabhonayaḥ ||
phalapāśopaśāntaś ca purāṇaḥ puṇyakṛttamaḥ |
krūrakartā krūravāsī dhanurātmā mahauṣadham ||
sarvāyaśaḥ sarvacārī prāṇeśaḥ prāṇināṃpatiḥ |
devadevasurotsiktaḥ sadasat sarvaratnavit ||
kailāsādiguhāvāsī himavahnirasaṃśriyaḥ |
kulahārī kulaṃkartā bahubhinno bahuprajaḥ ||
prāṇeśo vardhakī vṛkṣāvakulaś cādakis tathā |
[209]        sāragrīvo mahājatrur vilokaś ca mahauṣadhī ||
siddhānakāro siddhāntaś chandovyākaraṇottaraḥ |
siṃhanādaḥ jagatkālaḥ kālakampo tanūtanuḥ ||
sāraṅgo bhūtavakrāṅgaḥ ketumālī bhaven dhanam |
bhūtālayo bhūtapatir ahorātro palo malaḥ ||
astrahṛt sarvabhūtānāṃ niścalaś calavid budhaḥ |
amoghaḥ saṃyamo hṛṣṭo bhojanaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ ||
dhṛtimān natimāṃs tryakṣaḥ sakṛtas tu yugādhipaḥ |
gopālo goyuvāgrāmogo carmavasano haraḥ ||
hiraṇyavāyuś ca tathā guhāvāsaḥ praveśanaḥ |
mahāmantā mahākālo jitakamo jitendriyaḥ ||
gāndhāraś ca surāpaś ca tāpakarmarato hitaḥ |
mahābhūto bhūtavṛto hy asparśo gaṇasevitaḥ ||
mahāketudharo dhātā naikatānarataś ca saḥ |
avedanīya āvedyaḥ sarvagaś ca sukhāvahaḥ ||
toraṇas taraṇo dhātuḥ paridhāpattir ūrjitaḥ |
saṃyogavardhano vṛddho guṇiko ‘tha guṇādhipaḥ ||
nityo dhātā sahāyaś ca devāsurapatiḥ patiḥ |
avimuktaś ca vāhaś ca sadevo ‘pi suparvaṇaḥ ||
[210]        āṣāḍhaś ca suṣāḍhaś ca sakandado hairdo haraḥ |
vapurāvartamānānyo vapuḥśreṣṭho mahāvapuḥ ||
śiroharo ‘pi marṣaṇyaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ |
akṣayo rathagītaś ca sarvabhogī mahābalaḥ ||
samāyojyamahāmāyas tīrthadevo mahāpathaḥ |
nirjīvo jīvano mantraḥ subhago bahukartṛkaḥ ||
ratnabhūto ‘tha rathnāṅgo mahārṇavaninādabhṛt |
mūlo viśākho hy amṛto vyaktāvyaktas taponidhiḥ ||
ārohaṇo ‘tirohaś ca śīladhārī mahātapāḥ |
mahākaṇṭho mahāyogī yugo yugakaro hariḥ ||
yugarūpo mahārūpo ‘vanato gahanāñcanaḥ |
nyāyanirvāpaṇaḥ pādaḥ paṇḍito hy avalo yamaḥ ||
bahumālo mahāmālaḥ śipiviṣṭaḥ sulocanaḥ |
vistāro lavanaṃ rūpaṃ kusumāṃśaḥ palodayaḥ ||
vṛṣabho vṛṣabhāṅgāṅgo maṇibimbo jaṭādharaḥ |
indur visargaḥ sumukhaḥ śarasarvāyudhaiḥ saha ||
nivedanaḥ sudhātā ca svargahāro mahādhanaḥ |
gandhamālī ca bhagavān nartanaḥ sarvalakṣaṇaḥ ||
santānabāhuḥ sakalaḥ sarvamaṅgalavācanaḥ |
calastālī karastālī udvaṃśaḥ saṃyamī yuvā ||
yantratantrasuvikhyāto lokasarvāśrayo mṛduḥ |
[211]        muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto dīptatejāḥ sahasrapāt ||
sarvamūrdhā sarvadevaḥ sarvadevamayo guruḥ |
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokadhṛk ||
kāṣṭā kalā muhūrtaṃ vā mātrā vā pakṣapakṣakaḥ |
viśvakṣetraprado bījaṃ liṅgamadhyas tu nirmalaḥ ||
sadasadvyaktadhīnāmā mātā bhrātā pitāmahaḥ |
svargadvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ sukhadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam ||
nirvāṇahṛdayaś caiva brahmalokaḥ parā matiḥ |
devāsuravinirmātā devāsuragaṇādhipaḥ ||
devāsuragaṇādhyakṣo devāsuragaṇāgraṇīḥ |
devādhidevo devarṣir devāsurasudhāpradaḥ ||
devāsureśvaro viṣṇur devāsuramaheśvaraḥ |
sarvadevamayo ‘cintyo devatātmātmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
udgatas trikramo vaidyo virājo vīrajo varaḥ |
īḍhyo hastipuravyāghro devasiṃho maraprabhuḥ ||
vibudhaś ca suraśreṣṭhaḥ svargadevatapodhanaḥ |
saṃyukto śobhano vaktvā āśāyāṃ prabhavo ‘vyayaḥ ||
guruḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraṃ sarvavāhanaḥ |
śṛṅgī śṛṅgapriyo brabhrū rājarājo nirāśrayaḥ ||
avirāmaḥ saṃsmaraṇo nirāmaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ |
[212]        lalāṭākṣo viśvadeho hariṇo brahmavarcasaḥ ||
sthāvarāṇāṃ patiś caiva niyamendriyavardhanaḥ |
siddhārthaḥ sarvabhūtārtho cintyasatyavrataḥ śuciḥ ||
vratādhipaḥ paraṃ brahma muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ |
vimukto muktatejaś ca śrīmān śrīvardhano jagat ||
yathāpradhānaṃbhagavān iti bhaktyā stuto mayā |
bhaktim evaṃ puraskṛtya mahāyajñapatir vibhuḥ ||
tato ‘bhyanujñāṃ prāpyaivaṃ sūto gatimatāṃ gatiḥ |
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpya mahāyaśāḥ ||
gāṇapatyaṃ paraṃ prāpya prasādāt tasya yat prabhoḥ |
yaḥ paṭhec chruṇuyād vāpi śrāvayed brāhmaṇān api ||
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti vai dvijaḥ |
brahmaghnaś ca surāpaś ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ ||
śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśrambhaghātakaḥ |
mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva vīrahā bhrūṇahā tathā ||
saṃvatsaraṃ kramāj japtvā trisaṃdhyaṃ śaṃkarāśrame |
devam iṣṭvā trisaṃdhyaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
iti liṅgapurāṇoktas tulāpuruṣadānavidhiḥ |
śrīśaṅkara uvāca |
tulādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpavināśanam |
yad gauryā caritaṃ pūrvaṃ lakṣmyā nārāyaṇena ca ||
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmau kuryād dhaṭaṃ śubham ||
[213]        dāravaṃ śubhavṛkṣasya caturhastapramāṇataḥ |
suvarṇaṃ tatra badhnīyāt svaśaktyā ghaṭitaṃ dhaṭe ||
sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayet tatra vāsudevaṃ caturbhujam |
śaktyā dvayaṃ tu badhnīyāt sthāpayet paṭake tataḥ ||
tatrāruhet savastrāstraḥ puṣpālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ |
abhīṣṭāṃ devatāṃ gṛhya snāpayitvā ghṛtādibhiḥ ||
tulādānasya sarvasya vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
prathamā tu ghṛtasyoktā tejovṛddhikarī tulā ||
mākṣikena tu sobhāgyaṃ tailena bahulāḥ prajāḥ |
vastrasya divyavastrāṇi prāpnoti tulayā dhruvam ||
lavaṇasya tu lāvaṇyam arogitvaṃ guḍasya tu |
asapatnī śarkarayā surūpā candanena ca ||
aviyuktā bhaved bhartrā tulāyāḥ kuṅkumasya ca |
na saṃtāpo hṛdi bhavet kṣīrasya tulayā sadā ||
sarvakāmapradāḥ sarvāḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarāḥ |
yo dadāti tulāḥ sarvāḥ sa gauryālayam āpnuyāt ||
mantreṇa dadyād abhimantritāṃ tu
sakṛt tulā bhekatamāṃ dvijebhyaḥ |
sa yāti gauryāḥ sadanaṃ supuṇyair
na śokadīrgatyam upāśnute pumān ||
tvaṃ tule sarvabhūtānāṃ pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitā |
māṃ tolayantī saṃsārād uddharasva namo ‘stu te ||
ity āruhya kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā cintayitvā haripriyām |
avaruhya tato dadyād ardhaṃ pādam athāpi vā ||
guruṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat sarvālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
[214]        visarjayen namaskṛtya bhojayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
śeṣaṃ dvijebhyo dātavyaṃ strībhyo ‘nyebhyas tathaiva ca |
iṣṭabandhuviśiṣṭānām āśritānāṃ kuṭumbinām ||
kadalīdalasaṃsthāṃ tu pañcapiṇḍāṃ himādirjām |
karpūrasya tulā pūjyā kuṅkumenālabhet tu tām ||
avaruhya tulāyās tu gurave tāṃ nivedayet |
vidhinānena yo dadyāt tulādānaṃ vimatsaram ||
sa lokam eti pārvatyāḥ sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ |
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciram iha loke nṛpo bhavet ||
iti viṣṇudharmottarokto ghṛtāditulāpuruṣadānavidhiḥ |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
anenaiva vidhānena kecid rūpyamayaṃ punaḥ |
karpūreṇa tathecchanti kiṃcid brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ ||
aneneti, mukhyatulāpuruṣadānakathitenety arthaḥ |
tathā sitatṛtīyāyāṃ nāryaḥ saubhāgyadarpitāḥ |
kuṅkumena prayacchanti lavaṇena guḍena vā ||
tatra mantrā na homā vā evam eva pradāpayet ||
āha viśvāmitraḥ |
āditye rāhuṇā graste suvarṇais tolayet tanum |
somagrahe tu rūpyeṇa yathā dānaṃ tathā śṛṇu ||
pravargyasya mukhe yukta utyannapatradehataḥ |
sarvapāpaharāyaitad dadāmi prīyatāṃ vidhuḥ ||
ity uccārya jalaṃ tv apsu nikṣiped dvijasattamaḥ |
prīyante pitaraḥ kāṃsye tāmre caiva pitāmahāḥ ||
[215]        lavaṇe sindhuje lakṣmīḥ prīyate pārvatī guḍe |
gandhair guḍo vā vāsobhiḥ saubhāgyaṃ lavaṇe varam ||
prīyatāṃ viśvadhāprītir dānamantro ‘bhidhīyate |
tulāpuruṣato rājan yāhi tat paramaṃ padam ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā muktiṃ yānty apunarbhavām |
hatvā tu brāhmaṇaṃ bhūyas tolayed ātmanas tanum ||
suvarṇenātmatulyena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
iti rūpyāditulāpuruṣaḥ |
atha gāruḍapurāṇe |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
tulāpuruṣadānaṃ tu śṛṇu mṛtyuṃjayodbhavam |
aṣṭalohaṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvarogopaśāntaye ||
kāṃsyaṃ ca yakṣmaṇe deyaṃ trapu cārśovikārake |
apasmāre ca mīsaṃ syāt tāmraṃ kuṣṭhe sudāruṇe ||
paittalaṃ raktapitte ca rūpyaṃ pradaramehayoḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ sarvarogeṣu pradadyān mṛtphalodanam ||
phalodbhavaṃ tathā dadyād grahaṇe dīrghadāruṇe |
gauḍaṃ bhasmakarogeṣu yogaṃ tu gaṇḍamālake ||
jāṅgalaṃ cāgnināṃ māndye romotpāte tu pauṣyakam |
jāṅgalaṃ kāṣṭhajam iti |
madhūdbhavaṃ tathā deyaṃ kāśaśvāsajalodare ||
ghṛtodbhavaṃ tathā deyaṃ chardirogopaśāntaye |
kṣīraṃ pittavināśāya dādhikaṃ bhagadāraṇe ||
[216]        lāvaṇaṃ balanāśāya paiṣṭaṃ dadruvināśane |
annaṃ ca savyarogasya nāśane smṛtam eva ca ||
adhidaivataṃ lohe ca mahābhairava ucyate |
kāṃsye tu pūṣāśvinau ca vāyaś ca saisake smṛtaḥ ||
tāmre tu sūryas tathā proktaḥ paittale tu kujas tathā |
rūpye ca pitaro jñeyāḥ suvarṇe sarvadevatāḥ ||
phale somo guḍe cāpas tāmbūla tu vināyakaḥ |
gandharvāḥ kusume caiva jāṅgale ‘gnis tathā smṛtaḥ ||
madhau yakṣāḥ prayatnena ghṛte mṛtyuṃjayaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kṣīre tārāgaṇāḥ sarve dadhnaḥ sarpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
piṣṭhe prajāpatir devo anne sarvāś ca devatāḥ |
ārto yadā syāt pātraṃ vā prāpnuyāt puṇyadeśataḥ ||
mṛtyumṛtyuṃjayaprāptavidhinā yat pradīyate |
tad eva sarvaśāntyarthaṃ bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ ||
mṛtyuṃjayaprāptavidhinā, mṛtyuṃjayaṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
mṛtyuṃjayapūjāvidhiś ca devīpurāṇe |
oṃ juṃsa iti mantreṇa devo ‘yaṃ caturbhujas trinetrakaḥ |
akṣamālādharo devo dakṣiṇena tu pāṇinā ||
vāmenāmṛtakūṇḍī ca dhārayann amṛtānvitām |
varadābhayapāṇiś ca divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
śuklaḥ sanīlavāsāś ca padmasyoparisaṃsthitaḥ |
jātī tasya śrā jñeyaṃ javaṃvāśva śikhā smṛtā. ||
yo vauṣaḍ iti kavacaṃ jainetre ca prakīrtitāḥ |
[217]        jaḥphaḍastraṃ bhavet sadā | oṃkāraḥ āvāhanamantraḥ ||
oṃkāro vai visarjane, aṣṭaśaktavaḥ pañcākṣarasaṃmitāḥ |
jayā ca vijayā caiva ajitā cāparājitā ||
bhadrakālī kapālī ca kṣemyāmṛtaparājitā |
oṃ juṃsamantraprayogena pūjyo mṛtyuṃjayaḥ śivaḥ ||
gandhādibhir yathānyāyaṃ yathā brāhmaṇapūjanam |
mṛtyuṃjayoktadāneṣu sarveṣv evaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
japtavyaḥ |
oṃ jūṃsa iti vai dātuṃ kāmoghaṃ sādhayet sadā |
lohe tadā mantram amuṃ grahītur hṛdi ropayet ||
śirolalāṭadeśe ca jihvāmūle ca gaṇḍayoḥ |
mābhau ca brahmaguhye ca etad aṅgāṣṭakaṃ nyaset ||
aratnihastamātraṃ ca sāraṃ tasya prakīrtitam |
yathecchayā prayogeṇa yathāvat kartur icchayā ||
ṣaṣṭipalaiḥ saṅghaṭitam ajñātapalikaṃ bhavet |
lohaṃ ca tiṣpannam eva tatra annena miśritam ||
pañcāśatpalasaṃyuktaṃ daṇḍaṃ vāyasasaṃjñakam |
vastrair ācchadya dānena yamadaṇḍo na vidyate ||
iti nānārogaghnatulāpuruṣadānavidhiḥ |
ātmānaṃ tolayitvā tu dadyāl lohaṃ ca tatsamam |
dvijāya śivabhaktāya yad vānyasmai dvijātaye ||
pādukopānahachatracāmarāsanasaṃyutam |
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpātādiparvasu ||
[218]        śraddhāyuktaḥ sucau deśe viśeṣād uttarāyaṇe |
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya devadevam umāpatim ||
kevalena ghṛtenātha prathamātreṇa dhūrjaṭim |
sugandhicandanajalais tataḥ saṃsrāpayed vibhum ||
candanāgurukarpūrakaṅkolamṛganābhibhiḥ |
vilipya parameśānaṃ sumanobhir athārcayet ||
bhaktyā nivedya naivedyam anavadyena cetasā |
tataḥ praṇamya jagatām īśvaraṃ prārthayed iti ||
devadeva jagannātha kṛpālo parameśvara |
mām uddharasva saṃsārapaṅkasaṅkocaduḥthitam ||
iti saṃprārthya yo dadyāl loham ātmasamaṃ naraḥ |
sa yāti śivasālokyaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
tataḥ punar ihāyātaḥ pṛthivyām ekarāḍ bhavet ||
sarveṣu caiteṣu suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā, anuktadakṣiṇeṣu dāneṣu tasya yathāśakti vihitatvāt |
iti skandapurāṇokto lohatulāpuruṣadānavidhiḥ | atha hiraṇyagarbhākhyaṃṇ dvitīyaṃ mahādānam ucyate | matsyapurāṇe matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādānam anuttamam |
hemnā hiraṇyagarbhākhyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya tulāpuruṣadānavat |
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ||
kuryād upoṣitas tadval lokeśāvāhanaṃ dhaḥvi (?) |
[219]        puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā tadvat kṛtvādhivāsanam ||
atra deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjābrāhmaṇavācanaguruṛtvigvaraṇamadhuparkadānakuṇḍa-maṇḍapavedisaṃbhārahomādhivāsanādi sarvaṃ hiraṇyagarbhādipañcadaśamahādānaprakṛti-bhūtaṃ matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānivihitaṃ veditavyam |
brāhmaṇiar ānayet kuṇḍaṃ tapanīyam ayaṃ śubham |
dvāsapta aṅgulocchrāyaṃ hemapaṅkajagarbhavat ||
tribhāgahīnavistāraṃ praśastaṃ murajākṛti ||
kuṇḍam iti, hiraṇyagarbhākhyaṃ pātraṃ, tapanīyam ayam, svarṇamayaṃ hemapaṅkajam aṣṭadalaṃ tad eva nābhiśabdavācyam, tribhāgahīnavistāram iti, aṣṭācatvāriṃśadaṅgulavistāram ity arthaḥ | murajākṛti, mṛdaṅgākṛti | ājyakṣīrābhipūritam iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | tatra ghṛtakṣīre tulyaparimāṇe, yady api cātipūritam it ucyate tathāpi yajamānapraveśena yathā tan na bahir ucchalati tathā pūraṇīyam |
daśāntrāṇi saratnāni dātraṃ sūcīṃ tathaiva ca |
hemanālaṃ sapaṭikaṃ bahir ādityasaṃyutam ||
tathaivāvaraṇaṃ nābher upavītaṃ ca kāñcanam |
pārśvataḥ sthāpayet tadvad dhemadaṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍalum ||
daśāntrāṇi, daśakhaṇḍāni, abhrāṇīti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | tāni kāṃcanāni abhrākāratayā, abhrāṇīti | abhraṃ khanitram iti kecit, ratnāni pañca prasiddhāni, sapiṭakam, majñupānvitaṃ, bahir iti, hemakūṇḍād bāhyapradeśe pārśvataḥ sthāpayed ity anena saṃbandhaḥ | vahnir ādityasaṃyutam iti pāṭhāntaram | [220] vahnibhāskarayor lakṣaṇaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne vakṣyate | vahnim apyayasaṃyutam iti, tadā apyayaḥ, varuṇaḥ | tallakṣaṇam api tatraiva, nābher āvaraṇam iti, nābhyāvaraṇārthaṃ sauvarṇaṃ vastraṃ dātrādīny api suvarṇamayāny eva kāryāṇi |
padmākāraṃ vidhānaṃ syāt samantād aṅgulādhikam |
muktāvalīsamopetaṃ padmarāgadalānvitam ||
tiladroṇopari gataṃ vedīmadhye tato ‘rcayet ||
droṇaḥ paribhāṣāyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ \
iha khalu hiraṇyagarbhanirmāṇasuvarṇaparimāṇasyānāmnānāt yāvatā yajamānasya praveśadhāraṇopāyikaṃ kuṇḍaṃ bhavati tāvatā dhaṭanīyam, tac ca vedikāmadhye likhitacakrasyopari tiladroṇaṃ nidhāya tadupari saṃsthāpya pūjayet | atha tulāpuruṣadāna-tadadhivāsanadinād anyedyur brāhmaṇavācanaṃ vidhāya pūrṇāhutiprabhṛtikarmaśeṣasamāptiṃ kuryāt | tataś ca kuṇḍasamīpavartikalaśajalaiḥ pūrvavad abhiṣekaḥ | tad ucyate |
tato maṅgalaśabdena brahmaghoṣaraveṇa ca |
sarvauṣadhyodakasnānaṃ snāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ ||
sarvauṣadhyaḥ vyākhyātāḥ |
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
imam uccārayen mantraṃ gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya hiraṇyakavacāya ca |
saptalokasurādhyakṣa jagaddhātre namo namaḥ ||
bhūrlokapramukhā lokās tava garbhe vyavasthitāḥ |
[221]        brahmādayas tathā deva namas te viśvadhāriṇe ||
namas te bhuvanādhāra namas te bhuvanāśraya |
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya garbhe yasya pitāmahaḥ ||
yatas tvam eva bhūtātmā bhūtamūte(?) vyavasthitāḥ |
tasmān mām uddharaśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
evam āmantrya tanmadhyam āviśyāsta udaṅmukhaḥ |
muṣṭibhyāṃ parisaṃgṛhya dharmarājacaturmukhau |
jānumadhye śiraḥ kṛtvā tiṣṭhed ucchāsapañcakam (?) ||
dharmarājo ‘tra suvarṇamayaḥ, tallakṣaṇaṃ ca tulāpuruṣe ‘bhihitaṃ caturmukho ‘pi sauvarṇaḥ, tallakṣaṇaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne vakṣyte, tatra dakṣiṇamuṣṭau dharmarājaḥ, vāmamuṣṭau caturmukha iti |
garbhādānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā |
kuryur hiraṇyagarbhasya tatas te dvijapuṅgavāḥ ||
anavalobhanam ap yatra vijñeyam, eteṣu garbhādhānādiṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu jātakarmādiṣu, mantrayuktam anudhyānamātram atrācaraṇīyam |
gītamaṅgalaghoṣeṇa guruṃ saṃtoṣayet tataḥ |
jātakarmādikāḥ kuryāt kriyāḥ ṣoḍaśa cāparāḥ ||
tāś cābhidhīyante | jātakarma (1) nāmakaraṇam (2) niṣkramaṇam (3) annaprāśaṇam (4) cūḍākaraṇam (5) upanayanam (6) prājāpatyam (7) aindram (8) āgneyam (9) saumyam (10) iti, catvāri vedavratāni godānaṃ keśāntaś ceti dvādaśa, pūrvāś catasra ity ubhayeṣu ṣoḍaśatvam |
sūcyādikaṃ ca gurave datvā mantram imaṃ japet |
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya vi*garbhāya (?) te namaḥ ||
[222]        carācarasya jagato gṛhabhūtāya vai namaḥ |
mantro ‘haṃ janitaḥ pūrvaṃ martyadharmā dvijottamaḥ ||
tvadgarbhasaṃbhavād eṣa divyadeho bhavāmy ahaṃ |
caturbhiḥ kalaśair bhūyas tatas te dvijapuṅgavāḥ ||
snānaṃ kuryuḥ prasannāś ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||
kalaśaiḥ kuṇḍasamīpasthitair eva, snānaṃ kuryur yajamānasyeti śeṣaḥ |
devasya tveti mantreṇa sthitasya kanakāsane |
adyajātasya te ‘ṅgāni abhiṣekṣyāmahe vayam ||
divyenānena vapuṣā ciraṃjīva sukhī bhava |
tato hiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ tebhyo dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
atra dānavākyādiprayogo dravyavibhāgaś ca ṛtvigācāryāṇāṃ tulāpuruṣavad veditavyaḥ |
te pūjyāḥ sarvabhāvena bahavo vā tadājñayā |
tatropakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ gurave vinivedayet ||
pādukopānahachatracāmarāsanabhājanam |
grāmaṃ vā viṣayaṃ vāpi yac cānyad api saṃbhavet ||
viṣayaḥ grāmasamūhaḥ | anyat, ratnādi | atrāpy ātmālaṃkāraṃ gurave dadyāt grāmādayaś ca dakṣiṇātvenaiva saṃbadhyate, prakṛtau tathā darśanāt, tataḥ pūrvavat puṇyāhavācane kṛte devatāpūjāvisrajanādi vidheyam |
atha hiraṇyagarbhavidhiṃ vyākhyāmaḥ | sarvapāpāpanodana udagayana āpūryamāṇe pakṣe śvaḥ puṇye nakṣatre [223] ṛtvigyajamānau kḷptaśmaśruromanakho syātāṃ atha kutvik(?) prāg astaṃ gamanād āśvatthāvaraṇyā vādāya jāyasvāgne ‘śvatthād iti dvābhyāṃ mathyamānam anumantrayate tṛtīyayā jātaṃ caturthopasamādadhāti śuci dūriśaṃ paridhāpya yathoktam āñjanābhyañjanānulepanaṃ kārayitvā vāsogandhān hiraṇyasrajaś ca āvadhyāgnim upasamādhāyālabhyājyaṃ juhuyāt, hiraṇyagarbhāya svāhā, brahmaṇe svāhā viṣṇave svāhā prajāpataye svāhā parameṣṭhine svāhā kasmai svāheti ca śrāvayitvā tair evopasthāya agneḥ prajātaṃ pariyaddhiraṇyaṃ yadā badhrann iti hiraṇyasrajam āgrathya rakṣantu tvā agnaya iti catasṛbhī rakṣāṃ kṛtvā darbhān saṃstīryādhaḥśayyāsanau syātāṃ śvobhūte ‘bhijinmuhūrte hiraṇyamayaṃ maṇḍalākṛtinābhimātraṃ pātram ādhāya sāpidhānaṃ śrucājyasthālyudakapātrāṇy ātmālaṃkāraṃ ceti hiraṇyamayāni rājānaṃ hiraṇyavatībhiḥ snāpayitvā hiraṇyakalasais tasmin pātre payogaṇena payaśrāsībhyāṃ homucena śānto toyena hiraṇyagarbhasūtreṇa pañcabhiś ca nāmabhiḥ saṃpātān ānīya sasyāvṛtvijāpayed rājā hiraṇyagarbhatvam īpsati tasmai bhagavanto manujān īśeti tair anujñātāt tu dehi vājinn iti dvābhyāṃ praveśayet trayas triṃśad deva ity apidhāya tam anupidhāya tam anuśāsti vācaṃ niyamya prati saṃhṛtendriyāṇi viśeṣebhyo manasā ca bhagavantaṃ hiraṇyagarbhaṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ dhyāyann āsteti tathei tat pratipadyate saptadaśamātrāntaram āste saptadaśo vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āvṛtam ity uddhared dhanenam (?) iti ca tair anujñāpya tam uddharet tathaiva sadasyānanujñāpyoddhared dhiraṇyena cakreṇety apāvṛtya mate prāṇa ity uddhared uddhataṃ hiraṇyanāmnā pratimucyayas tvā mṛtyur ity upasyet saṃpa[224]śyamānā ity avekṣitāvekṣito brāhmaṇān svastivācya namas kuryāt hiraṇyagarbhāyety evamādibhir ete vai hiraṇyagarbhasya prītamānās taṃ brāhmaṇā brūyur uttiṣṭha hiraṇyagarbhānugṛhīto ‘sīty apratiratheneti hutvā saṃsthāpya apsu te rājā varuṇa iti varuṇam abhiṣṭayāvabhṛtam upetya snātvā pavitrair abhyukṣyālaṃkṛtyādityam upatiṣṭheta |
hiraṇyaṃ tava yad garbho hiraṇyasyāpi garbhajaḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhas tasmāt tvaṃ mām pāhi mahato bhayāt || iti |
sūryasyāvṛttam iti, pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya grahā naumīti grahān pratipadya tvam agne praminir ity agnim upasthāpyotsṛjed dvijebhyaḥ śatasahasraṃ dakṣiṇāgrāmavaraṃ ca srukśruvājyasthāṇyudakapātrātmālaṃkāraṃ ced dadyāt sadasyebhyo yāvad vā tuṣyeraṃs tāvad vā deyaṃ yathā kāmam annena brāhmaṇān paricaret | tatra ślokāḥ |
vedānāṃ pāragā yatra caturṇāṃ brahmavittamāḥ |
tuṣṭā yasyāśiṣo brūyus tasyejyā sakalā bhavet ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādena sūryo divi virājate |
indro ‘py eṣāṃ prasādena devān ativirājati ||
hiraṇyadānasya phalam amṛtatvam iti śrutiḥ |
śrūyate hy asya dātā yaḥ so ‘mṛtatvaṃ samaśnute ||
ya ikṣvākuprabhṛtayaḥ purā rājarṣayo ‘malāḥ |
datvā hiraṇyaṃ viprebhyo jyotir bhūtvā divi sthitāḥ ||
ya evaṃ saṃskṛto rājā vidhinā brahmavādinā |
prajānām iha sāmrājyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ sa gacchati ||
[225]        amusmin brahmaṇā sārdham ānandam anubhūya vai |
jyotirmayāt satyalokān na cehāvartate punaḥ ||
iti brāhmaṇam | matsyapurāṇe |
anena vidhinā yas tu puṇye ‘hni vinivedayet |
hiraṇyagarbhadānaṃ sa brahmaloke vidhīyate ||
pureṣu lokapālānāṃ pratimanvantare vaset |
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvad brahmaloke mahīyate ||
kalikaluṣavimuktaḥ pūjitaḥ siddhyasādhyai |
ramacaramamālāvījyamāno ‘psarobhiḥ ||
pitṛśatam atha bandhūn putrapautraprapautrān [-prapautrakān?] |
api narakanimagnāṃs tārayed eka eva ||
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotīha samyak
madhupuraripuloke pūjyate so ‘pi siddhaiḥ |
matim api ca janānāṃ yo dadāti priyārthaṃ
vibhdhapatijanānāṃ nāyakaḥ syād amogham ||
iti hiraṇyagarbhadānavidhiḥ |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
dānadharmeṣu yad dānaṃ dānadharmottaraṃ śṛṇu |
yat kṛtvā pātakaiḥ sarvair mucyante jantavaḥ sadā ||
yo dadāti ca viprebhyas tasya svargo ‘py adūrataḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ kuryād dhiraṇyāṣṭatulākṛtam ||
saptaṣaṭpañcacatvāri tulāyā vṛddhir ekataḥ |
[226]        śātakumbhamayaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvāratnitrayonnatam ||
dvyaṅgulaṃ vartulaṃ bhadraṃ nānāratnair alaṃkrtam |
śucideśe same deśe sauvarṇaṃ paṅkajaṃ likhet ||
caturasraṃ caturhastaṃ caturdvāraṃ ca maṇḍalam |
madhye padmaṃ samālikhya ratnakīrṇaṃ tu kārayet ||
padme saṃsthāpitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ hemagarbhas tu saṃjñitam |
prādeśadvayavistīrṇaṃ catuḥprādeśam āyatam ||
cāru kṛtvā tu sauvarṇaṃ nābhiṃ kanakasūtritam |
kṛtvā hatapramāṇaṃ tu kuṇḍasyābhyantare yadi ||
tat kuṇḍaṃ pūrayet kṣīrair gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
kuṇḍasyopari pārśve ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ||
sūryaṃ grahāṃś ca sauvarṇān lokapālāṃś ca kārayet |
śuciḥ snātvā naraḥ samyak pūjayet sarvadevatāḥ ||
sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kurvīta homayayur dvijātayaḥ |
kratusaṃveśanaṃ kṛtvā tat kuṇḍaṃ pariveṣṭayet ||
vāsobhiḥ paritaḥ sarvaṃ yāvat karma samāpyate |
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanādi ca ||
kṛtvā paścād viniṣkramya tatkuṇḍāntarasaṃvṛtam |
nābhiṃ nābhipradeśe ca kaṇṭhe kanakasūtrikām ||
gṛhītvā karṣayed viprān dātā svargān mahīṃ vrajet |
śaṅkhatūryaninādoccair uchityārkam udīrayet ||
[227]        namo hiraṇyagarbhāya mantram etam udāharet |
yāvat ṣoḍaśasaṃskārān jātakarmādi kārayet ||
yathoktaṃ vaidikaṃ karma mantravit kārayed dvijān |
tat kṣīrapāyasaṃ siddhaṃ bhojayed ṛtvijas tadā ||
tad evātmani yuñjīyāt bhuktaśeṣaṃ dvijottamaiḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhacāruṃ ca nābhiṃ sauvarṇikānvitam ||
tat sarvaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyād iṣṭāpūrtāni ṛtvije |
naro vā yadi vā nārī evaṃ brahmātmasaṃbhavam ||
yaḥ karoti mahāpuṇyaṃ tasyāpi śṛṇu yat phalam |
mṛto brahmatvam āpnoti haṃsayānaṃ raviprabham ||
brahmakanyābhiḥ saṃsevyo brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati |
brahmavat krīḍate tatra brahmasaṃvatsaratrayam ||
brahmalokāvatīrṇaś ca indraloke mahīyate |
indraloke ramitvā tu varṣakoṭiśatatrayam ||
brahmaṇas tu pure ramie krīḍitvātha tadopamam |
vidhyādharo ‘tha gāndharvo varṣakoṭiṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
iha loke tu saṃprāpte rājarājottamaḥ prabhuḥ |
śatayojanavistīrṇe triguṇe vātha maṇḍale ||
rūpasaubhāgyavān vīro jāyate hi na saṃśayaḥ |
yāvad varṣaśataṃ rājyaṃ susaṃpannam akaṇṭakam ||
tejasvī sukhabhāg nityaṃ dharmavān vijitendriyaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmokto hiraṇyagarbhadānavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
tulaikā kathitā hy eṣām ādyām āsādya rūpiṇīm |
[228]        hiraṇyagarbhaṃ vakṣyāmi dvitīyaṃ sarvasiddhidam ||
adhaḥpātraṃ sahasreṇa hiraṇyena vidhīyate |
ūrdhvapātraṃ tadardhena mukhasaṃveśamātrakam ||
phalām evaṃ śubhāṃ kuryāt sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutām |
adhaḥpātre smared dviyāṃ guṇatrayasamanvitām ||
caturviṃśatikāṃ devīṃ brahmaviṣnvagnirūpiṇīm |
ūrdhvapātre guṇātīte ṣaṭtriṃśakam umāpatim ||
ātmānaṃ puruṣaṃ dhyāyet pañcaviṃśakam abjakam |
pūrvoktasthānamadhe tu vedikoparimaṇḍale ||
śālimadhye kṣipen nītvā navavastraiś ca veṣṭitam |
māṣakalkena cālipya pañcagavyena pūrayet ||
īśānādyair yathānyāyaṃ pañcabhiḥ paripūjayet |
pūrvavac caiva pūjā ca homaś caiva yathākramam ||
ādyā hiraṇyagarbhādidānānāṃ prakṛtibhūtā tulā puruṣoktakriyā, ataḥ sā nānyarūpiṇī, hiraṇyagarbhādīn (?) prātisvikaviśeṣaiḥ saha tulāpuruṣoktaṃ maṇḍapādiṛtvigdakṣiṇāntaṃ sāmānyaṃ samuccayam ity arthaḥ, sahasreṇā karṣaṇam ity avadheyam |
kuryāt sahasrakarṣeṇa adhaḥpātraṃ hiraṇyataḥ |
tad ardhenōrdhvapātraṃ tu sahasreṇa dvayaṃ tu vā ||
dvipādaṃ vā tripādaṃ vā sapādaṃ sārdham eva vā |
dviguṇaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ yathā lābhaṃ tu vā bhavet ||
sadvṛkṣajaṃ vā taṃ kṛtvā svarṇapaṭṭais tu veṣṭayet ||
iti kāmikokteḥ | [229] etac ca svalpadānādhikāriviṣayam | āḍhyaviṣaye tu tulātantroktaṃ yathā |
catvāriṃśat ṣaḍadhikaiḥ sahastrair garbham uttamam |
pañcaviṃśasahastrais tu madhyamaṃ samudāhṛtam |
devīm upāpatiṃ ca smared iti, tayoḥ pratimāṃ kṛtvety avadheyam | vātule ‘pi |
adhaḥ pātre tu kartavyam umārūpaṃ prasannakam |
ūrdhvapātre tu kartavyo maheśasya tu vigrahaḥ ||
atha vā śaktibhāge tu lakṣmīṃ vai tatra kārayet |
ūrdhvapātre tu kartavyaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ paraṃ śubham ||
eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇam, brahmāṇḍadāne vakṣyate | ātmānam iti, yajamānam īśvareṇa niṣiktaṃ garbhasthaṃ puruṣatvena smaret tato maṇḍalāntasthapadmaṃ karṇikāmadhye dhānyarāśau hiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñāṃ phalāñ cen nikṣipet | māṣakalkaḥ ayaḥphalakasaṃbandhī nīrandhratārthaḥ | pañcagavyapūraṇam uktaṃ vātule |
gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ kṣīrāt kṣīrārdhaṃ dadhi kathyate |
tadardhaṃ gomayaṃ jñeyaṃ gomayārhaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhavet ||
hiṃ kṛṇvatītya cā tatra gomūtraṃ tu vinikṣipet |
śakamayam ity ṛcā tatra gomayaṃ parikalpayet ||
āpyāyasveti mantreṇa kṣīraṃ tatra prakalpayet |
dadhikrāvneti mantreṇa dadhi tatra prayojayet ||
ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ tatra viloḍayet |
[230]        evam āpūrayed yatnāj jānudadhnaṃ tu deśikaḥ ||
samyag āpūrayed vidvān brahmajajñānakena vai |
praviśet prāṅmukho vidvān āviśyāsta udaṅmukhaḥ || iti |
īśānādimantrās tu taittirīyakaśrutau |
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānām īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatir brahmaṇo ‘dhipatiḥ brahmā śivo me ‘stu sadāśivo sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ, bhave bhavenāti bhave bhajasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ, vāmadevāya namaḥ, jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ, śreṣṭhāya namaḥ, balavikaraṇāya namaḥ, balapramathanāya namaḥ, sarvabhūtadamanāya namaḥ, manonmanāya namaḥ aghorebhyo 'tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaś ca sarvataḥ sarvasarvadevebhyo namas te ‘stu rudrarūpebhyaḥ, tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāha dhīmahi tan no rudraḥ pracodayād iti ||
pūrvavad iti liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavad ity arthaḥ |
gaurīgāyatrikām japtvā praviśet prāṅmukhaḥ svayam |
subhagāyai vidmahe yaśīmālinyai dhīmahi |
tan no gaurī pracodayāt |
iti gaurīgāyatrī |
vidhinaiva tataḥ paścād garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
kṛtvā ṣoḍaśamārgeṇa vidhinā brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||
dūrvārasena kartavyaṃ secanaṃ dakṣiṇe puṭe |
udumbaraphalaiḥ sārdham ekaviṃśatkuśāṃs tadā ||
śaktyātha tāvad evātra kuryāt sīmantakarmaṇi |
udvāhe kanyakāṃ kṛtvā triṃśanniṣkena śobhanam ||
alaṃkṛtya tathā hutvā śivāya vinivedayet |
[231]        annaprāśanake vidvān bhojayet pāyasādibhiḥ ||
evaṃ viśvajidantāś ca garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
śaktibījena kartavyā brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ ||
śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ ca vidhinā tulādānavad ācaret ||
vidhinetyādi, garbhādānapuṃsavanasīmantonnayanajātakarmanāmakaraṇopaniṣkramaṇānna-prāśanacauḍopanayanavedavratacatuṣkagodānasamāvartanavivāhākhyāḥ ṣoḍaśakriyāḥ, tatra niṣekapuṃsavane yajamānasya mātāpitṛsthānīyamithunam ānīya tatra puṃsā striyā vā ca uparipātranāsārandhrasthāpanīye chidradvaye, dakṣiṇapuṭe dūrvārasaṃ secayed ācāryaḥ |

iti vātulokteś ca | udumbaraphalaiḥ saha ekaviṃśat kuśān hṛdāhullekhākhyena śaktibījena sīmantakarma kuryāt |

iti śrīliṅgapurāṇokto hiraṇyagarbhadānavidhiḥ |
atha brahmāṇdābhidhānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ mahādānaṃ likhyate | matsyapurāṇe |

athaiteṣāṃ diggajaprabhṛtīnāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇāny ucyate | ādityapurāṇe |

tathā |
vāyutulyena rūpeṇa maruto nāma devatāḥ |
kartavyā iti śeṣaḥ, vasvādināmāni, tulāpuruṣoktāni veditavyāni, mahāratnasamanvitam iti, mahāratnāni paribhāṣāyām uktāni, anantamithunānvitam iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | [236] phaṇāsaptānvito ‘nantaḥ pṛthvo svīrūpadhāriṇīty anantamithunam | atha prakṛtam ucyate |

agnim uttarato haimaṃ vāsudevam ataḥ param ||

pūrveṇetyādi, brahmāṇḍāt pūrvadeśe anantaśayanaṃ śeṣa śāyinaṃ guṇapīṭhe sthāpayet, tan murtilakṣaṇam | viṣṇudharmotarāt |
devadevaś ca kartavyaḥ śeṣasuptaś caturbhujaḥ |

eko bhujo ‘sya kartavyas tatra jānau prasāritaḥ ||

atra yady api prakṛter avyaktarūpatayā vidhānam aśkyaṃ tathāpi lakṣyādiśabdavyapadeśyaṃ sukaram asti tad rūpabhityatas tadanyatamarūpanirmāṇam eva nyāyyam | tad uktaṃ mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |

yogamūrddhvordhaśaṅkhaś ca hṛddeśārpitahastakaḥ |
dhārayed uttare cakraṃ kare vai dakṣiṇe gadām || iti |
ete ca devatāviśeṣāḥ, brahmāṇḍanirmāṇavat kṛptasuvarṇāt pṛthaksuvarṇenaiva ghaṭanīyā brahmāṇḍasya kilaviṃśatipalāt prabhṛti palasahasrāvadhir iha niyamaḥ, purāṇeṣu dṛśyate tato ‘vakṛṣyamāṇakāñcane tasmin nyūnasaṃkhyatvād yathāvadvihitatvam āpadyate na ca diggajāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ lokapālopetam ityādinā eka eva tāvadbhir aṅgair aṅgī niṣpādyata iti brahmāṇḍavat kḷptasuvarṇenaiva diggajādipratimānirmitau na kaścid vādha iti vācyam, kāñcanān kārayed iti punaḥ kāñcanopadeśānārthakyāpatteḥ aśrūyamāṇaparimāṇānāṃ pratimānām aṅguṣṭhaparvaprabhṛtivitastiparyantaṃ yathāśakti parimāṇaṃ kalpanīyam | pūrṇakumbhān sthāpayed it yatra samatād iti yojyam |
daśaiva dhenavo deyā sahemāmbaradohanāḥ |
pādukopānahachatratāmarāsanadarpaṇaiḥ ||

homādhivāsanānte ca sthāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ ||

sahemāmbaradohanā iti, hemaśṛṅgyaḥ tāmradohanāḥ savastrāḥ pārśato dakṣiṇārtham upakalpanīyāḥ tatrācāryāś ca dve ṛtvigbhyo ‘nyāḥ [239] saṃpradeyā, jāpakādīnāṃ anyaiva yathāśakti dakṣiṇeti, bhaviṣyottare tu jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ pārthetyādinā suvarṇam eva dakṣinārtham upakalpanīyam ity uktam, śrāddhādhivāsanadinād anyedur agnikuṇḍeṣu ṛtvigupadeśanādikarmaśeṣasamāptau tulāpuruṣadānavad vihitāyāṃ pūrvavad eva snāpitaḥ śuklamālyāṃ śuklamālyāṃ varadharo gṛhītakusumāñjalir yajamāno brahmāṇḍaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya mantram uccārayet | mantraḥ |
namo ‘stu viśveśvaraviśvadhāmajagatsavitre Bhagavan namas te |
saptādhilokāmarabhūtaleṇa garbheṇa sārdhaṃ vitarābhir akṣām ||

bhāgadvayaṃ tatra guroḥ prakalpā samaṃ bhajec cheśam ataḥ krameṇa |

vāmāratigatā tasya yoṣidrūpā vasuṃdharā ||
namaskāraparā tasya kartavyā dvubhujā śubhā |
[243]        yasmin bhuje dharā devī tatra śaṅkhaḥ kare bhavet ||
anye tasya karāḥ kāryāḥ padmacakragadādharāḥ |
padmāsanasthāṃ kurvīta śriyaṃ trailokyamātaram ||
gauravarṇāṃ surūpāṃ ca sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām |
raukmapadmakaravyagrāṃ varadāṃ dakṣiṇena tu ||
rudrarūpaṃ prāgabhitam, grahalakṣaṇāni tadvarṇāś ca navagrahadāne vakṣyante, sarvavarṇāni, grahasamānavarṇāni, ratnāni bhūṣaṇārthaṃ dāpayed ity arthaḥ | sarvadhātubhiḥ brahmāṇḍaṃ kartavyam ity uktam, tatra suvarṇasya pīṭhanirmāṇādiviniyogam abhidhāyedānīṃ dhātvantaraiḥ kartavyam, tad ucyate |
pīṭhāt saptaguṇaṃ raupyaṃ raupyāt tāmraṃ tathāvidham |
tāmrāt saptaguṇaṃ kāryaṃ kāṃsyam atra narādhipa ||
trapuṇaḥ parataḥ sīmaṃ tāval lohaṃ ca kārayet |
saptadvīpāḥ samudrāś ca saptaiva kulaparvatāḥ ||
anayā saṃkhyayā jñātvā nipuṇaiḥ śilpibhiḥ kṛtāḥ ||
tathāvidhaṃ saptaguṇm ity arthaḥ, saptadvīpā ityādi eteṣām ekaikadhātunā ekaikaṃ dvīpaṃ samudraṃ kulācalaṃ ca racayed ity arthaḥ |
yādṛśāni ca bhūtāni rājatāny eva kārayet |
araṇyāni ca satvāni sauvarṇāni ca kārayet ||
vṛkṣān vanaspatīṃś cātra tṛṇavallīḥ savīrudhaḥ |
yādṛśāni, jalasaṃbhavāni, puṣpaphalavanto vṛkṣāḥ, apuṣpāḥ phalino vanaspatayaḥ, vīrudho gucchagulmādayaḥ |
sarvaṃ prakalpya vidhivat tīrthe deyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
kurukṣetre gayāyāṃ ca prayāge ‘marakaṇṭake ||
[244]        dvāravatyāṃ prabhāse ca gaṅgādvāre ca puṣkare |
tīrtheṣv eteṣu vai deyaṃ grahaṇe somasūryayoḥ ||
dinachidreṣu sarveṣu ayane dakṣiṇottare |
vyatīpāte bahuguṇaṃ viṣuve ca viśeṣataḥ ||
dātavyam etad rājendra vicāraṃ naiva kārayet |
bālāgnihotriṇaṃ vipraṃ surūpaṃ ca guṇānvitam ||
sapatnīkaṃ ca saṃpūjya bhūṣayitvā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
purohitaṃ mukhyatamaṃ kṛtvānyāṃś ca tathartvijaḥ ||
caturviṃśadguṇopetān sapatnīkān nimantritān |
ahatāmbasucchannān sragvinaḥ suvibhūṣitān ||
aṅgulīyakaratnāni karṇaveṣṭāṃś ca dāpayet |
evaṃvidhāṃś ca saṃpūjya teṣām agre svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
purohitāya purataḥ kṛtvā vai karasaṃpuṭam ||
yūyaṃ vai brāhmaṇā dhātrā maitratvenānugṛhyate |
saumukhyeneha bhavatāṃ bhavet pūto naraḥ svayam ||
bhavatāṃ prītiyogena svayaṃ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ |
brahmāṇḍena tu dattena teṣāṃ matijanārdanaḥ ||
pinākapāṇir bhagavān śakraś ca tridaśeśvaraḥ |
ete vai toṣam āyānti anudhyātā dvijottamaiḥ ||
evaṃ stutvā tato rājā brāhmaṇān vedapāragān |
[245]        brahmāṇḍaṃ gurave prādāt savidhānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
sarvakāmais tatas tapto sa yayau svargaṃ narādhipa |
tenāpi guruṇā tac ca vibhaktaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ||
dattas taira pi cānyebhyo brahmāṇḍāṃśo narādhipaḥ |
brahmāṇḍaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca grāhyaṃ naikena tad bhavet ||
gṛhṇan doṣam avāpnoti brahmahatyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ caiva pratyakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ (?) taṃ narādhipaḥ ||
dīyamānaṃ ca paśyanti te ‘pi pūtā bhavanti hi |
darśanād eva te pūtā bhaveyur nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
bhīmadvādaśī vātroktā svarṇanābhimṛgājinam |
etāni gatvā paśyet tu dṛṣṭair etaiḥ kriyāphalam ||
ayatnād eva labhyeta kartuś caiva salokatām |
iti padmapurāṇe brāhmāṇḍadānavidhiḥ |
atha kalpapādapasaṃjñaṃ caturthaṃ mahādānam ārabhyate |
matsya uvāca |
kalpapādapadānākhyam ataḥ param anuttamam |
mahādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśanam ||
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya tulāpuruṣadānavat |
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kuryāl lokeśāvāhanaṃ tathā ||
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ||
ādiśabdena kāladeśavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjāguruṛtvigcatuṣṭayavaraṇamadhuparkadānahoma-vedikoparicakralekhanapañcavarṇa[246]vitānapatākātoraṇādi matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣa-dānavad veditavyam |
kāñcanān kārayed vṛkṣān nānāphalasamanvitān |
nānāvihāravastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca kārayet ||
nānāphalāni, strīpuruṣagogajavājimaṇivajrakanakarajatabhakṣyaphalādīni |
śaktitas tripalād ūrdhvam ā sahasrāt prakalpayet |
ardhāt kḷptasuvarṇasya kārayet kalpapādapam ||
guḍaprasthopariṣṭāc ca sitavastrayugāvṛtam |
brahmaviṣṇuśivopetaṃ pañcaśaṅkhaṃ sabhāskaram ||
kāmadevam adhastāc ca sakalatraṃ prakalpayet ||
ardhāt kḷptasuvarṇasyeti, yathāśaktidānavakḷptasuvarṇasyārdhena brahmādipratimāsahitaṃ kalpapādapaṃ kuryāt, dvitīyam apy ardhaṃ caturdhā vibhajya ekaikāṃśena vakṣyamāṇa-svasvadevatāsahitān santānādīn vidadhyāt, guḍaprastho ‘tra dvātriṃśatpalaparimitaḥ, tathā coktam, dvātriṃśatpalakaḥ prasthaḥ purāṇe parikīrtita iti, brahmādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne, kāmadevarūpaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottarāt |
kāmadevas tu kartavyo rūpeṇāpratimo bhuvi |
aṣṭabāhuḥ prakartavyaḥ śaṅkhapadmavibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
cāpavāṇakaraś caiva madād añcitalocanaḥ |
ratiḥ prītis tathā śaktir bhāryāś caitās tathojvalāḥ ||
catasras tasya kartavyāḥ patnyorūpamanoharāḥ |
catvāraś ca karās tasya karyā bhāryā stanopagāḥ ||
[247]        ketuś ca makaraḥ kāryaḥ pañcavāṇamukho mahān || iti |
adhastād iti brahmādibhir api saṃbadhyate | atha prakṛtau parimāṇābhāvāt puruṣecchayā pratimādiparimāṇaniyamaḥ | santānaṃ pūrvavat tadvat turīyāṃśena kalpayet |
turīyāṃśena, dvitīyārdhacaturthāṃśenety arthaḥ | tadvat kalpavṛkṣavat, pañcaśākhaṃ guḍaprasthoparigataṃ brahmādipratimānvitaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | kecit tu kāmadevam adhastāt prakalpayed iti santānavṛkṣe yojayanti, tanmate tatpratimaiva kartavyā |
mandāraṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyā sārdhaṃ ghṛtopari |
paścime paribhadraṃ tu sāvitryā saha jīrake ||
surabhisaṃyutaṃ tadvad vilepya haricandanam |
turīyāṃśena kurvīta saumyena phalasaṃyutam ||
śrīlakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇde | sāvitrīlakṣaṇam āha nāradaḥ |
padmāsanā ca sāvitrī sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
surabhilakṣaṇaṃ brahmāṇḍapurāṇe | savatsā surabhī, denur āgatā prastnutasnatīti |
saumyena uttareṇa | ghṛtādīnāṃ api parimāṇāpekṣāyāṃ tadvad iti vacanāt | saṃnidhānāc ca prasthaparimāṇatvam avadheyam |
kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktān ikṣumālyaphalānvitān |
tathāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśān pādukāsanabhājanam ||
dīpakopānahachatracāmarāsanasaṃyutam |
phalamālyayutaṃ tadvad upariṣṭād vināyakam ||
[248]        tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni samantāt parikalpayet |
aśanabhājanam, bhojyānvitabhājanaṃ vitānaṃ pañcavarṇam | atha pūrvavat pūrvedur adhivāsanaṃ vidhāya śvobhūte brāhmaṇavācanādipūrṇāhutiparyantaṃ karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
homādhivāsanānte ca snāpito vedipuṅgavaiḥ |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya mantram etam udīrayet ||
namas te kalpavṛkṣāya cintitārthapradāyine |
viśvaṃbharāya devāya namas te viśvamūrtaye ||
yasmāt tvam eva viśvātmā brahma sthāṇur divākaraḥ |
mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījam ataḥ pāhi sanātanaḥ ||
tvam evāmṛtasarvasvam anantaḥ puruṣo ‘vyayaḥ |
santānādyair upetaḥ san pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ||
amṛtā devāḥ teṣāṃ sarvasvam, amṛtasarvasvam |
evam āmantrya taṃ dadyāt gurave kalpapādapam |
caturbhyaś cāpi ṛtvigbhyaḥ santānādīn prakalpayet ||
dānavākyam atra, tulāpuruṣoktam ūhanīyam, caturbhyaḥ prakalpayed ity ekaikasmai dadyād ity arthaḥ, caturbhya iti vacanād atra caturṇām eva ṛtvijāṃ varaṇam iti gamyate, ṛtvigaṣṭakapakṣeṣu ṛtvigbhya iti ṛtvigyugmebhya ity arthaḥ, etasmiṃś ca pakṣe jāpakādibhyo anyaiva dakṣiṇā dātavyā, vedacatuṣṭayāpekṣayāyāṃ catuḥsaṃkhyatvam idam ṛtvijām iti kecit ihāpi | prāpya teṣām anujñāṃ ca tathānyebhyo ‘pi dāpayed iti boddhavyam | dakṣiṇānirṇayaś ca pūrvavat, svalpeṣv ekāgnivat kuryād guruve (gurave?) [249] vābhipūjanaṃ na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta na ca vismayavān bhavet | svalpatvavivaraṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍe, tataḥ puṇyāhavācane kṛte vedisamīpaṃ gatvā kṛtadevapūjo yajamāno guruḥ pūrvavad eva (?) devatāvisarjanaṃ kuryāt |
anena vidhinā yas tu mahādānaṃ nivedayet |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtaḥ siddhacāraṇapannagaiḥ |
bhūtān bhavyāṃś ca manujāṃs tārayed romasaṃmitān ||
stūyamāno divaḥ pṛṣṭhe pitṛputraprapautrakān |
vimānenārkavarṇena viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
divi kalpaśataṃ tiṣṭhed rājarājo bhavet tataḥ |
nārāyaṇavalopeto nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||
nārāyaṇakathāsakto nārāyaṇapuraṃ vrajet ||
yo vā paṭhet sakalakalpatarupradānaṃ
yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣo ‘lpadhanaḥ smared vā |
so ‘pīndralokam adhigamya sahāpsarobhir
manvantaraṃ vasati pāpavimuktadehaḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktakalpatarudānavidhiḥ | liṅgapurāṇe |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi kalpapādapam uttamam |
śataniṣkeṇa kartavyaṃ sarvaśākhāsamanvitam ||
sarvaśākhāḥ sarvadigantaśākhāḥ |
śākhāyāṃ vidhinā kṛtvā muktādāmapralambitam |
[250]        divyair marakataiś caiva cāṅkurāṇi pravinyaset ||
divyaiḥ, utkṛṣṭair ity arthaḥ |
pravālaṃkārayed dhīmān pravālena drumasya ca |
pravālena pravālaṃkārayed iti, drumair vyālapallavān kārayety arthaḥ |
phalāni padmarāgaiś ca pārijātasya śobhanam |
mūladaṇḍaṃ ca nīlena vajreṇa skandham uttamam ||
vaidūryeṇa drumāgraṃ ca puṣparāgeṇa mastakam |
skandhād ūrdhvabhāgo mastakam, tadūrdhvam, drumāgram |
gomedakena vai skandhaṃ sūryakāntena suvrataḥ |
candrakāntena vā vediṃ drumasya sphaṭikena vā ||
vitastimātra āyāmo vṛkṣasya parikīrtitaḥ |
śākhāṣṭakasamānaṃ ca vistāraṃ cordhatas (?) tathā ||
śākhāvyatiriktasya vṛkṣasya vitastimātraḥ, ucchrāyaḥ kāryaḥ, urdhatas (?) tatheti, skandhād urdhamukhī navamī yā madhyamaśākhā tasyā api vitastimātra ucchrāyaḥ, śākhāṣṭakasamānaṃ vistāram iti, aṣṭadigmukhīnām aṣṭaśākhānāṃ vistāraṃ tiryagvyāptivitastimātram eva kuryād ity arthaḥ |
tanmūle sthāpayel liṅgaṃ lokapālasamāvṛtam |
pūrvoktavedimadhye tu maṇḍale sthāpya pādapam ||
pūjayed devam īśānaṃ lokapālāṃś ca yatnataḥ |
pūrvavaj japahomādyaṃ tulābhāravad ācaret ||
nivedayed drumaṃ śaṃbhor brāhmaṇāyātha vā nṛpa |

palānāṃ tu sahasreṇa kalpayet kalpapādapam |

atha gosahasrākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ mahādānam ucyate |
matsya uvāca |

lokeśāvāhanaṃ kuryāt tulāpuruṣadānavat |

[252] payovratas trirātram iti, dānadināt pūrvaṃ trirātraṃ payovrataḥ syād ity arthaḥ, atrādiśabdena deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjāguruṛtvigvaraṇamadhuparkadānakuṇḍavedikā-vitānacakralekhanapatākādīni matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavihitāni gṛhyante, vṛṣaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktam, vṛṣalakṣaṇāni, unnataskandhakakudam ujvalāyatakambalam ityādīni vṛṣotsargaprakaraṇe matsyapurāṇoktāny eva veditavyāni, gosahasrād viniṣkramyeti daśottaragosahasrād iti veditavyam, agre daśādhikagosahasraviniyogadarśanāt, yady api gavāṃ daśakam it yatra gomātrapratītiḥ tathāpi uttaratra ṛtvigbhyo dhenum ekaikāṃ daśakād vinivedayed iti, dhenusaṃśabdanāt, purāṇāntare
gosahasrād viniṣkramya savatsaṃ daśakaṃ gavām |
iti śravaṇāc ca dehudaśakam evādhivāsanīyam | itarāsu punar nāvaśyaṃ dhenurūpatvādaraḥ |
gosahasraṃ bahiḥ kuryād vastramālyavibhūṣitam |

pādukopānahachatrabhājanāsanasaṃyutam ||
[253] daśasauvarṇike śṛṅge, khurāḥ pañcapalāḥ | pañcāśatpaladohanakaḥ anyatra tathābhidhānāt ghaṇṭikādisuvarṇaśabdo ‘tra ṣoḍaśamāṣaparimitahiraṇyavacanaḥ, sakṛduccaritasuvarṇa-śabdāvagataparimāṇaparityāgānupapatteḥ | pāduke, kāṣṭhamayyau, carmakṛte upānahāv iti bhedaḥ |

vāme tu śūlabhṛd dakṣe cākṣamālāsamanvitae || iti |

puṇyaṃ kalam athāsādya gītamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ |
sarvauṣadhyudakasnānasnāpito vedipuṅgavaiḥ ||
[254]        imam uccārayen mantraṃ gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
atrāpi pūrvavat pūrvedyur adhivāsanaṃ vidhāya dvitīyadivase brāhmaṇavācanānantaram agnikuṇḍeṣu ṛtvigupaveśanādipūrṇāhutiparyantaṃ karmaśeṣaṃ guruḥ samāpayet | tataḥ puṇyakālam ātmānukūlalagnamuhūrtādilakṣaṇam āsādya kuṇḍasamīpasthitakalaśodakena brāhmaṇaiḥ snāpitaḥ śuklamālyāmbaradharo yajamāno vakṣamāṇamantrān udīrayet |
namo vo viśvamūrtibhyo viśvamātṛbhya eva ca |
lokādhivāsinībhyaś ca rohiṇībhyo namo namaḥ ||
gavām aṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāny ekaviṃśatiḥ |
brahmādayas tathā deva rohiṇyaḥ pāntu mātaraḥ ||
