gavāṃ śatam athaikaikaṃ tadardhaṃ cātha viṃśatiḥ ||
daśapañcāśad vādhikas tadanujñayā |
dānavākyam atra tulāpuruṣavad veditavyam | ete ca śataprabhṛti pañcaparyantā vikalpā ṛtvigviṣayāḥ tadānantaryāt, tataś cāyam arthaḥ siddho bhavati godaśakamadhyān nandikeśvarayutaṃ goyugaṃ gurave pratipādyā[255]śeṣāṇām aṣṭānāṃ gavām ekaikām ekaikasmai ṛtvije dadyāt, tathā gosahasramadhyāt śatadvayaṃ gurave pradāya ekaikaṃ śatam ṛtvigbhyo dadyāt | atha vā śataṃ gurave pañcāśatam ṛtvigbhyaḥ | atha vā catvāriṃśataṃ gurave viṃśatiṃ viṃśatim ṛtvigbhyaḥ viṃśatim vā gurave daśa daśa ṛtvigbhyaḥ, daśa vā gurave pañca pañca ṛtvigbhyo dadyāt | śeṣā gās tadanujñayā anyebhyo ‘pi dadyāt | dakṣiṇāṃ cātra pūrvavad eva dadyāt | anuktadakṣiṇāṣu suvarṇadakṣiṇeti vacanāt yathāśakti suvarṇaṃ vā, tataḥ pūrvavad eva puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanādi kuryāt |
naikā bahubhyo dātavyā yato doṣakarī bhavet |
bahvyaś caikasya dātavyā śrīmadārogyavṛddhaye |
payovrataḥ punas tiṣṭhed ekāhaṃ gosahasradaḥ ||
idaṃ ca payovratānuṣṭhānaṃ śaktyāpekṣyayam (?), aśaktau naktam iṣyata iti vacanāt |
śrāvayet śṛṇuyād vāpi mahādānānukīrtanam |
taddinaṃ brahmacārī syād yadīcched vipulāṃ śriyam ||
ātharvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇe |
athāto gosahasravidhiḥ | goṣṭha udakānte śucau deśe prāñcam idhmam upasamādhāya anvālabhyātha juhuyāt | āgāvasūktenādyaṃ juhuyāt | mahāvrīhīṇām aindraṃ caruṃ saumyaṃ ca sahasraṃ tasyāḥ payasi śrapayitvā gāva iti, evam ubhaya ity etena juhuyāt | paścād agnes tīrthodakapūrṇakalaśam avasthāpyāhisaṃvogeṣṭheneti daśagāḥ snāpayet tvaramāṇīnyāḥ samabhyukṣya sahasraṃ tasyāḥ snānodakenemam indraṃ vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ ma iti, rājānam abhiṣicyemā āpa iti, ṣaḍbhir yathoktam añjanābhyaṃjanānulepanaṃ kṛtvā sahasratamīṃ prathamām [256] alaṃkṛtya gāvo mām upatiṣṭhata prajāvatī sūyavāsād iti ca saryāsayet priyam aśanaṃ datvā dvitṛṇam aghnya(?) iti sahasratamīm ālabhya japet mayā gāvopatinā savaddham iti mantreṇānenārghaṃ datvā sahasratamīṃ punar upasaṃgṛhya bhūmiṣṭā pratigṛhṇātv iti japet sahasraṃ tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhato vrajan sarvāḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskṛtya svasti vācya brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya daśagā dakṣiṇā kartre sahasratamāṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca tad api |
ślokāḥ |
saptajanmānugaṃ pāpaṃ puruṣaiḥ saptabhiḥ kṛtam |
tat kṣaṇād vidhinānena nāśayed goprado naraḥ ||
sarveṣām iha dānānāṃ phalaṃ yat parikīrtitam |
tad avāpnoti viprebhyo gosahasraprado naraḥ ||
aśvamedhaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ gosahasratrayaṃ tu yaḥ |
dadyān mādāya ity āhuḥ paritas tarpayanti hi ||
asmād anena vidhinā gosahasraṃ tu yo naraḥ |
pradadyāt sa viśuddhātmā yāti tat paramaṃ padam || iti |
matsyapurāṇe |
anena vidhinā yas tu gosahasraprado bhavet |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ ||
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkaṇījālamālinā |
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ loke saṃpūjyate nareḥ (?) ||
[257]        pratimanvantare tiṣṭhed rājarājo bhavet punaḥ |
aśvamedhaśataṃ kuryāc chivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āsthāya tato mucyeta bandhanāt |
pitaraś cābhinandanti gosahasrapradaṃ śubham ||
api syāt sa kule ‘smākaṃ putro dauhitra eva ca |
gosahasraprado bhūtvā narakād uddhariṣyati ||
tat sa karmakaro vā syād api draṣṭā tathaiva ca |
saṃsārasāgarād asmād yo ‘smān saṃtārayiṣyati ||
iti paṭhati ya etad gosahasrapradānam
surabhuvanam upeyāt saṃsmared vāpi paśyet |
anubhavati sukhaṃ vā vācyamāno nikāmam
prahatakaluṣadehaḥ so ‘pi yātīndralokam ||
iti gosahasradānavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
gosahasrapranānaṃ ca vadāmi śṛṇu siddhaye |
gavāṃ sahasram ādāya savatsaṃ saguṇaṃ śubham ||
tāś cābhyarcya yathāśāstram aṣṭau samyak prayatnataḥ |
tāsāṃ śṛṅgāṇi hemnātha pratiśṛṅgeṇa bandhayet ||
khurāṃś ca rājatenaiva bandhayet kaṇṭhadeśataḥ |
pratiniṣkeṇa kartavyaṃ kathaṃ vaktreṇa śobhanam ||
[258] gavāṃ sahasram ādāyeti, aṣṭādhikaṃ gosahasram ity jñeyam,
tāś cānyāś ca mahābhāga aṣṭau saṃgṛhya yatnataḥ |
iti vātulokteḥ | bandhayet kaṇṭhadeśata it yatra vastam iti śeṣaḥ,
vastraṃ badhvā gale gāś ca viprebhyo dāpayet kramāt |
niṣkaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kṛtvā paṭṭaṃ kaṇṭhe ca bandhayet ||
iti kāmikokteḥ |
viprebhyo dāpayed gāvo dakṣiṇāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak |
daśaniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdham athāpi vā ||
yathāvibhavavistāraṃ niṣkamānam athāpi vā |
vastrayugmaṃ ca dātavyaṃ pṛthag vipreṣu śobhanam ||
gāvaś cārādhy yatnena dātavyāḥ sumanoramāḥ |
evaṃ datvā vidhānena śivam abhyarcya śaṅkaram ||
japed agre yathānyāyaṃ gavāṃ stavam anuttamam |
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
hṛdaye naḥ sadā gāvo gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham |
evaṃ stutvā dvijāgrebhyo datvā gās tāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ ||
tadromasaṃkhyāvarṣāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
pūrvavad adhivāsanaṃ śivasya sahasrakalaśādyabhiṣecanaṃ kṛtvā gostavam uccārya pretyekaṃ godānaṃ kāryam, ācāryādidakṣiṇā ca prāgvat |
iti liṅgapurāṇokto gosahasradānavidhiḥ |
ataḥ paraṃ smṛtaṃ dānaṃ ye na rohanti dehinaḥ |
durlabhaṃ tat paraṃ dhāma tṛptā kāmair aśeṣataḥ ||
[259]        sahasraṃ tu vatsānāṃ dhenūnāṃ yaḥ śivāya vai |
snānārthaṃ vidhivad dadyāt so ‘pi tat padam āpnuyāt ||
tadgosahasrakṣīreṇa tathā dadhnā ca śaṅkaram |
sarpiṣā ca samagreṇa snāpya vādyādimaṅgalaiḥ |
dadyāt sarasijaṃ raukmaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ ||
raukmaṃ sauvarṇam |
tadante vāta puṣpais tu āpīṭhāntaṃ suśobhanam |
vitānahemaghaṇṭādīn yugmaṃ caiva nivedayet ||
āpīṭhāntaṃ puṣpaiḥ pūrayed iti śeṣaḥ |
dīpadarpaṇanaivedyaṃ hemadaṇḍaṃ ca cāmaram |
agniṃ saṃtarpya cājyena mantravic chrotriyeṇa ca |
hemavastrayugenaiva bhūṣitena dvijena vai ||
ājyenetyādi, ājyena dravyeṇa śrotriyeṇa ṛtvigyūtena saṃtarpayed ity arthaḥ | hemavastrayugeneti hemnā śobhanavastrayugmenety arthaḥ |
tato brahmaraveṇaiva śuklā gaus tatra yā śūbhā |
vitānaṃ cocchayet tasyā gacchet prāgdakṣiṇaṃ punaḥ ||
harāya cāparāḥ sarvā gās tās tad anucālayet |
maṇḍitā hemavastrādyair mahāvāditraniḥsvanaiḥ ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tato devaṃ kṛtvā gāvas tadagrataḥ |
sthāpayitvā tu tāḥ sarvā yajamānaḥ pradakṣiṇam ||
surabhīyā ca yā mukhyā tasyās tv agre ca kārayet |
[260]        sarvaṃ tat gosahasraṃ tu mahābrahmaraveṇa vai ||
tatas tu puccham ādāya tilahomayavākṣataiḥ |
sapuṣpodakahastābhyāṃ śaṅkarāya nivedayet ||
yavākṣataiḥ akṣatayavaiḥ |
tatas tv ekādaśabhyas tu brāhmaṇebhyas tathāparāḥ |
gāvo vatsānvitā dadyāt tebhyo deyaṃ vicintya ca ||
avratān suvratāṃs tatra brāhmaṇāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ |
dīnān suduḥkhitāṃś caiva bhojayed anivāritān ||
vidhinānena ye bhaktyā svarjitā gosavena tu |
uddiśya śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||
svarjidgosavau dṛṣṭāntaḥ | atha vānyat prakāreṇa dadyād gośatam uttamam iti | śataśabdo bahuvācī, sa cātra sahasraparaḥ, agre sahasraviniyogadarśanāt |
ekādaśādhikaṃ rudre cicchaktaye mitāya ca |
saṃpūrṇaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā cidhim ādau prayatnataḥ ||
homapūjādisaṃyuktaṃ dadyāt tatraiva śaṃbhave |
dīkṣitānāṃ śataṃ hy ekam āhrtya śivamandire ||
tataḥ pūjya yathānyāyaṃ dadyāt tebhyo yathā śṛṇu |
daśakaṃ daśakaṃ caiva ekaikasya pṛthak pṛthak ||
hṛdi śaṃbhuṃ gavāṃ caiva dhyātvā teṣāṃ nivedayet |
adhikaṃ daśakaṃ yatra nīlakaṇṭhenduśekhare ||
[261]        dadyāt pūrvavidhānena denūnāṃ ca savatsakam ||
dīkṣitānāṃ śatam ityādi śaṃbhuprītaye śaṃbhūṃ dhyātvā dīkṣitānāṃ saṃpradānabhūtānāṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ | pūrvavidhānena srapaṇaprakāreṇa |
atha vā śrotriyān viprān vedavedāṅgapāragān |
āhṛtya dviguṇaṃ tebhyaḥ pañca pañca dadet sudhīḥ ||
kṛtvā vidhim imaṃ jantuḥ na śocyaḥ syāt kadācana |
garbhāgārajvare bhūyaḥ parikrāmati naiva saḥ ||
garbhāgārajvare garbhavāsakleśe |
iti kālikāpurāṇoktatriḥprakāragosahasradānavidhiḥ |
agastya uvāca |
dānamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi gosahasrākhyam uttamam |
yat kṛtvā narmadātīre mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||
śaivānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāĕ ca sahasraṃ bhojayet tathā |
tataḥ sahasraṃ dogstrīṇāṃ(?) śuklānāṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ||
garbhiṇīdhenusaṃmiśraṃ vṛṣabhair daśabhir yutam |
arcitaṃ gandhapuṣpādyair haimavastrair alaṃkṛtam ||
pradakṣiṇam upakramya mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
oṃ namo bhagavata vāsudevāyeti mantraḥ |
vedavidbhiḥ samākīrṇe viṣṇor āyatane śubhe |
narmadātoyam āsādya dīpamālāṃ prabandhayet ||
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaspṛṣṭhata eva ca |
[262]        gāvo me hṛdaye cāpi gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham ||
gavāṃ mantraṃ samuccārya japed āsāṃ puraḥsthitaḥ |
gandhatoyākṣatair yuktaṃ gṛhītvā tāmrabhājanam ||
gavāṃ pucchāmbhasā snātaḥ śuklavastrasamanvitaḥ |
sarvakalmaṣanirmuktaḥ śuddhaḥ śucimanās tataḥ ||
snāpayitvā tu gās tatra tāviprānarmadājale |
pañcadaśyāṃ pūrṇacandre rāhusomasamāgame ||
tair eva sārdhaṃ viprendrair abhipūjya hariṃ smaret |
bhṛtyaputrakalastrādyair yuktaḥ svajanabāndhavaiḥ ||
nivedayet tu viprebhyo mantreṇa śraddhayānvitaḥ |
śrāddhe dāne ca home ca vivāhe maṅgale tathā ||
gomātarasthitā nityaṃ viṣṇuloke śivapriyā |
śivāyaitā mayā dattā viṣṇave ca mahātmane ||
evaṃ viprāya yo dadyād yajñārthaṃ samalaṃkṛtāḥ |
vinivedya ca śarvāya gosahasram alaṃkṛtam ||
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yad gatvā na nivartate |
kulāni triṃśad uttārya narakād bhṛtyabāndhavān ||
sthāpayed vaiṣṇave loke śivasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaś ca śuddhaḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ ||
saṃsārasāgaraṇ mukto haritulyaḥ prajāyate |
anenaiva vidhānena gṛhasthā mokṣam āpnuyuḥ ||
vināpi jñānayogena gosahasrapradānataḥ |
tasmāt tvam api rājendra gosahasraprado bhava ||
[263]        devavad divi modante yen ate pitaraḥ sadā |
iti skandapurāṇokto gosahasradānavidhiḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
atha prayacched vipreṣu gosahasraṃ mahāmune |
arcayed gandhapuṣpais tu paṭṭaiḥ sarvāḥ samarcayet ||
paṭṭaiḥ vastraiḥ |
sarvāḥ kanakaśṛṅgās tāḥ sarvā raupyakhurārcitāḥ |
hīnāṅgā na dadet gāvaḥ kṛśā vṛddhāturās tathā ||
ekāṅgām arcayet tāsāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ ca vidhiṃ śṛṇu |
tilānāṃ tu śataṃ hy eṣāṃ dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām ||
pādyena vidhinā caiva tarpayitvā dvijāṃs tathā |
tilānāṃ śatam, tilānāṃ droṇaśatam ity arthaḥ | pādyena pādyārghādinā |
śuciḥ śuddhamanā bhūtvā yo ‘rcayec ca janārdanam ||
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ datvā gāvaś ca satvaram |
tena tā arcitāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
vedaśāstrārthatattvajñāḥ saṃhitādhyāpakā dvijāḥ |
agnihotraratā ye ca svādhyāyaniratāś ca ye ||
etān viprān parīkṣeta gopradāne mahāmune |
īdṛśānāṃ tu yad dattaṃ tac cānantam ihocyate ||
anantasya tadā dānam iti satyaṃ mahāmune |
upoṣya vidhivac caiva prasannamanā sendriyaḥ ||
[264]        upetya brāhmaṇebhyaś ca dadyād gāvaś ca satvaraḥ |
sparśayitvā tu tāṃ gāvaḥ sumanāḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
sparśayitvā datvā |
na caitās tāḍayed daṇḍair na hasten ana leṣṭunā |
yathoktaṃ gosahasraṃ tu yaḥ prayacchati vai dvijaḥ ||
sarvakleśān parityajya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
tathā |
tilānāṃ tu śataṃ yas tu vinā gobhyaḥ prayacchati ||
palam ekaṃ suvarṇasya gosahasrād viśiṣyate |
yathoktaṃ gosahasraṃ tu prayacchet tu dvijātiṣu ||
tatphalaṃ labhate dātā sadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate |
yas tu paśyati pāpātmā so ‘pi pāpāt pramucyate ||
ekaviṃśatim uddhṛtya ye ca pūrve vyavasthitāḥ |
tārayanti narāḥ kṣipraṃ kunāny ekottaraṃ śatam ||
alābhe gosahasrasya suvarṇaṃ datum arhati |
sahasrārdhaṃ śataṃ nyūnaṃ dvijānāṃ ca tilaiḥ saha ||
tathā ca labhate nityaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ dvijasattama |
arcitānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaṃ vipra gosahasraṃ prakīrtitam |
tilānāṃ tu śataṃ hy ekaṃ gavāṃ dānena tatsamam ||
sahasrārdhaṃ suvarṇasya, ṣoḍaśamāṣaparimitasyeti śeṣaḥ | mahābhārate |
sarvatra vijayaṃ cāpi labhate manujādhipa |
[265]        daśagosahasrado nityaṃ śakreṇa saha modate ||
akṣayān labhate lokān naraḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgais tu virājitānāṃ
gavāṃ sahasrasya punaḥ pradātā |
prāpnoti puṇyaṃ divi śakralokam
ity evam āhur munivedasaṅghāḥ ||
iti gosahasradānavidhiḥ |
atha hiraṇyakāmadhenusaṃjñaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ mahādānam ucyate |
matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kāmadhenuvidhiṃ param |
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
lokeśāvāhanaṃ tadvad dhomaḥ kāryo ‘dhivāsanam |
tulāpuruṣavat kuryāt kuṇḍamaṇḍapavedikāḥ ||
svalpeṣv ekāgnivat kuryād gurur eva samāhitaḥ |
kuṇḍamaṇḍapavedikā ity upalakṣaṇam | iha hi deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjābrāhmaṇa-vācanaguruṛtvigvaraṇamadhuparkadānavedikoparicakralekhanapañcavarṇavitānatoraṇa-patākādisarvam uktaṃ matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavihitaṃ veditavyam | svalpeṣv ekāgnivad iti, ekāgnivat karaṇaṃ vyākhyātam |
kāñcanasyātiśuddhasya dhenuṃ vatsaṃ ca kārayet |
uttamā palasahasrais tadardhena tu madhyamā ||
kanīyaso tadardhena kāmadhenuḥ prakīrtitā |
śaktitas tripalād ūrdhvam aśakto ‘pīha kārayet ||
[266] atra yady api vatsaparimāṇam anuktaṃ tathāpi kāmadhenuvidhānavat taptakāñcana-caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, samastadhenuparimitadravyaniṣkṛṣṭavatsanirmāṇavyāpti-darśanād ihāpi dhenudāntvāviśeṣāt tathaiva niścīyate | tathā ca guḍadhenvādiṣu taccaturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syād iti tatra tatra vakṣyate |
vedyāṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ tasya guḍaprasthasamanvitam |
nyased upari tāṃ dhenuṃ mahāratnair alaṃkṛtām ||
kumbhāṣṭakasamopetāṃ nānāphalasamanvitām ||
kalpatarudāne prastho vyākhyātaḥ | mahāratnāni, padmarāgaprabhṛtīni | “vatsaṃ dakṣe tu vinyased” iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | nānāphalāni, gogajavājistrīpuruṣaprabhṛtīni | sauvarṇāni kalpatarudānoktāni |
tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni samantāt parikalpayet |
ikṣudaṇḍāṣṭakaṃ tadvan nānāphalasamanvitam ||
bhājanaṃ cāsanaṃ tadvat tāmradohanakaṃ tathā ||
aṣṭādaśadhānyāni paribhāṣāyāṃ draṣṭavyāni | nānāphalāni, mātuliṅgādīni |
kauśeyavastradvayasaṃprayuktām
dīpātapatrābharaṇābhirāmām |
sa cāmarāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ saghaṇṭāṃ
gaṇitrikāpādukaraupyapādām ||
rasaiś ca sarvaiḥ parito ‘bhijuṣṭāṃ
haridrayā (?) puṣpaphalair anekaiḥ |
ajājikustumburuśarkarābhiḥ
[267]                vitānakaṃ copari pañcavarṇam ||
snātas tato maṅgalavedaghoṣaiḥ
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sapuṣpahastaḥ |
āvāhayet tāṅguḍadhenumantraiḥ
dvijāya dadyād atha darbhapāṇiḥ ||
aghaṇṭāgaṇatriketyādi ghaṇṭāgaṇatrikāpādukābhiḥ saha vartata iti saghaṇṭāgaṇatrikāpādukā sācāso raupyapādā ceti vigrahaḥ | gaṇanāsādhanatvād gaṇatrikā, akṣamālāgaṇatriketi kvacit pāṭhaḥ | tatra gaṇatrikā kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ kecit, kecit tu galantiketi paṭhitvā jalapūrvākarkarīti vyācakṣate | rasāḥ paribhāṣāyām uktāh ajājīrakam, kustumburur dhānyakam, evam upakalpitasaṃbhāraḥ pūrvavad adhivāsanaṃ vidhāya tadanyadivase prātaḥ kṛtapuṇyāhavācano ‘gnikuṇḍeṣu ṛtvigupaveśanādipūrṇāhutiparyantakarmaśeṣasamāptiṃ kṛtvā sarvauṣadhijalasnātaḥ śuklamālyāmbaro gṛhītakusumāñjalir yajamānas triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya guḍadhenumantrais tām āvāhayet | guḍadhenumantrāḥ — yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānām ityādayaḥ tatprakaraṇe draṣṭavyāḥ, āvāhanānantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇamantreṇāmantrayet |
tvaṃ sarvadevaganamandirasaṅghabhūtā
viśveśvaratripathagodadhiparvatānām |
tvaddānaśastrasakalīkṛtapātakaughaḥ
prāpto ‘smi nirvṛtim atīva parāṃ namāmi ||
loke yathepsitaphalardhividhāyinīṃtvām
[268]                āsādya ko hi bhavaduḥkham upaiti martyaḥ |
saṃsāraduḥkhaśamanāya yatasva kāmaṃ
tvāṃ kāmadhenur iti devagaṇā vadanti ||
āmantrya śīlakularūpaguṇānvitāya
viprāya yaḥ kanakadhenum imāṃ pradadyāt ||
prāpnoti dhāma sapurandaradevajuṣṭaṃ
kanyāgaṇaiḥ parivṛtaṃ padam indumauleḥ(?) ||
dānavākyam atra tulāpuruṣoktam ūhanīyam | viprāyety ekavacanam ekāgnividhānapakṣe | anekāgnividhānapakṣe tu pakṛtibhūtatulāpuruṣadānavad ācāryādīnāṃ vibhāgavyavasthā tadanantaraṃ puṇyāhavācanavedisthitadevatāpūjanavisarjanāni kuryāt dakṣiṇāvicāraś ca pūrvavat |
iti matsyapurāṇoko hiraṇyakāmadhenudānavidhiḥ |
vyāsa uvāca |
rājann ihaikām api kāmadhenuṃ
dadyāt samuddiśya tu keśavaṃ tvām |
viprāya vai sarvaguṇopapannāṃ
kṛtvā vrataṃ kṛcchramanoharais tu ||
samyak pradattais tu gavāṃ sahasraiḥ
savatsavastraiḥ sahitaiś ca hemnā |
kale phalaṃ yal labhate manuṣyo
na kāmadhenoś ca samaṃ dvijebhyaḥ ||
śataiḥ sahasraiś ca tathā hayānāṃ
[269]                samyak pradattaiś ca mahādvipānām |
kanyārathair vā karavājiyuktaiḥ |
śataiḥ sahasraiḥ satataṃ dvijebhyaḥ ||
dattaiḥ phalair yal labhate manuṣyaḥ
samaṃ tathā syān na tu kāmadhenoḥ |
yo jāhnavītīragato himādrau
saṃtapyate ‘tīva tapaḥ sadā vai ||
brāhmaṃ padaṃ gantumanā dvijendro
naitat phalaṃ tac ca hi kāmadhenoḥ |
cāndrāyaṇaiḥ kṛcchramahāparākaiḥ
saṃśudhyate pāpayuto manuṣyaiḥ ||
kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu naraḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
ekādaśyām upoṣyātha naro dinacatuṣṭayam ||
ghṛtena snāpayed viṣṇuṃ gavyena payasāpivā |
naktāśī gorasair havyaiḥ pūjayen madhusūdanam ||
gandhapuṣpaiḥ sunaivedyair vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ ||
śaṅkhāsicakrodyatabāhuviṣṇor
gadāñjahastasya tu śārṅgapāṇeḥ |
ardhaṃ prayacchāmi janārdanasya
śriyā yutasyāpi dharādharasya ||
śriyaḥ patiṃ śrīdharam ekakāntaṃ
[270]                śriyaḥ sakhāyaṃ hi śriyonukūlam |
namāmy ahaṃ śrīdharasaṃnivāsam
samarcito me pradadātu kāmān ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena śriyāyuktais tu nāmabhiḥ |
pṛthak jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt śriyā sārdhaṃ jagatpateḥ ||
yā devī bhārgavaṃ bheje kulaṃ sarvatra pūjitā |
āyātu sā gṛhe nandā suprītā varadā mama ||
yāṅgirasaṃ sadā devo sunandā pratyupasthitā |
āyātu me gṛhe sā tu suprītā varadā satī ||
surabhī yā bharadvājaṃ kāmadhenuḥ sukāmadā |
sadā bhaved gṛhaṃ sātra mamāyātu surārcitā ||
suśīlā kaśyapaṃ yā tu bheje sarvatra kāmadā |
sā me bhavatu suprītā kāmadhenur gṛhe sadā ||
sumanā yā vasiṣṭhaṃ tu saṃprāpya mumude śubhā |
sā me bhavetu suprītā kāmadhenur gṛhe sadā ||
sā me gṛhaṃ sadāyātu kāmadā varapūjitā ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena prabhāte vimale śubhe |
śuklāmbaradharaḥ snātaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
kṛtanityakriyo hṛṣṭaḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadabhūṣitaḥ |
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinasusaṃsṛte ||
tilaprasthena vākīrṇe catuḥvarṇavibhūṣite |
kṣaumavastrānvite śubhre madhvājyapātrasaṃyute ||
[271]         śubhavastraiḥ samāvṛtya sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtām |
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ sakhurāṃ catuṣkarṣāṃ manoramām ||
kṣīrābdhipayasopetāṃ dhenumantrais tu pūjayet |
yā dhenuḥ sarvadevānām ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ||
kṣīrābdhinirgatā yā ca sā me bhavatu susthirā |
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ prayatnataḥ ||
samabhyarcya yathā jñeyaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvaḥ pārśve tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
gāvo me hṛdaye nityaṃ gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukhīṃ vāpi sitayajñopavāsinīm ||
imān tvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva deva deva jagatpate |
savatsālaṃkṛtāṃ dhenuṃ govindaḥ prīyatām iti ||
evaṃ viprāya tān dadyāt kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam |
anuvrajac ca gacchantaṃ padāny aṣṭau narādhipa ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kāmadhenuṃ prayacchati |
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaḥ svargaloke sa gacchati ||
yad datvā sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ rāhugraste divākare |
tatphalaṃ prāpyate rājan kāmadhenvā na saṃśayaḥ ||
cintāmaṇiḥ kāmadhenus tathā bhadraghaṭo nṛpa |
trīṇi samaphalāny āhur dānāni munisattamāḥ ||
saptāvarān saptaparān ātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ |
śatajanmakṛtāt pāpān mocayaty avanīpate ||
pade pade ‘śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
[272]        dānānām eva sarveṣām uttamaṃ parikīrtitam ||
sarvakāmapradandhyanyaṃ(?) pāpaghnaṃ sarvadaṃ śubham |
sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ jātānāṃ mahatma api ||
prāyaścittam idaṃ śastaṃ kathitaṃ brahmaṇā nṛpa |
brahmaviṭkṣatraśūdrāṇāṃ kartavyā yatnato nṛpa ||
sarvakāmaphalārthāya kāmadhenur iyaṃ satām |
vṛṣājyatilahomena kāmadhenuṃ prayatnataḥ ||
sakalaṃ pratipādyeha sarvapṛthvīprado bhavet ||
iti vahnipurāṇoktakāmadhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha liṅgapurāṇe |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi hemadhenuvidhiṃ kramāt |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ deśadurbhikṣanāśanam ||
upasargavināśaṃ ca sarvavyādhinivāraṇam |
niṣkāṇāṃ tu sahasreṇa suvarṇena tu kārayet ||
tadardhenāpi vā samyak tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
śatena vā prakartavyaṃ sarvakāryeṣu suvrataḥ ||
sarvakāryeṣv it avyakteṣu anuktamāneṣu sauvarṇasaṃpradeyeṣu sahasrādiśatāvaramānatvam avadeyam iti iyaṃ coktiḥ prāsaṅgikī vātulemānāntaram uktam | tripalādisahasrāntaṃ hemnā dhenuṃ prakalpayed iti |
[273]        śivāgrakāmadhenuṃ tu palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ |
yo dadāti mahāsena rāhugraste divākare |
tena dattaṃ bhavet sarvam ābrahmabhuvanāntikam ||
iti kālottaramatam |
gorūpaṃ sakhuraṃ divyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam |
khurāgre vinyased vajraṃ śṛṅge vai padmarāgakam ||
bhuvor [bhruvor?] madhye nyased divyaṃ mauktikaṃ munisattama |
vaidūryeṇa stanān kuryāl lāṅgūlaṃ nīlanirmitam ||
dantasthāne prakartavyaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam |
paśuvat kārayitvā tu vatsaṃ kuryāt suśobhanam ||
daśāṃśakena kartavyaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam ||
kāmike tu turīyāṃśena vatsa ity uktam |
pūrvoktavedikāmadhye maṇḍalaṃ ca prakalpayet |
tanmadhye surabhiṃ sthāpy sarvataḥ sarvaratnakām ||
savatsāṃ surabhiṃ tatra vastrayugmena veṣṭayet |
saṃpūjayet tu gāyatryā savatsāṃ surabhiṃ punaḥ ||
athaikāgnividhānena homaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi |
samidaṃ tv ājyabhāgena pūrvavat śeṣam ācaret ||
śivapūjā prakartavyā liṅgaṃ snāpya ghṛtādibhiḥ |
gām ālabhy ca gāyatryā viprebhyo dāpayec ca tām ||
dakṣiṇā ca pradātavyā triṃśan niṣkaṃ mahāmate ||
gāyatryā gosāvitryākhyastotramantreṇety arthaḥ.
gosāvitrīti mantreṇa ca mantrayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ |
[274] iti vātulokteḥ | kāmike tu |
ghṛtādyaiḥ pūjayed devaṃ sahasrakalaśādibhiḥ |
gām ārādhya tu gāyatryā viprebhyo dāpayec ca tām ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayet pūrvaṃ keyūrakaṭakādibhiḥ |
vastrayugmaṃ ca datvā tu vijñāpya vidhipūrvakam ||
dakṣiṇā tu pradātavyā triṃśanniṣkā mahātapaḥ ||
triṃśan niṣkadakṣiṇādānaṃ tu ekāgnipakṣaviṣayam | anekāgnipakṣe tulāpuruṣavad dakṣiṇā | tad uktaṃ śaive |
athaikāgnividhānaṃ vā samid ājyaṃ haviṣyayuk |
triṃśanniṣkāvarā deyā guror ekāgnikalpate || iti |
ekāgnipakṣaś ca svalpavittaviṣayaḥ | pūrvavac cheṣam iti, śeṣam anuktaṃ kiṃcit tad akhilaṃ liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavihitam ācared ity arthaḥ | kālottare |
etasyāstu pradātā yas tena dattaṃ carācaram |
triḥsaptakulasaṃyukto vimānair divyavarcasaiḥ ||
śivalokam avāpnoti yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
tadante cakravartī syāt jñānavāṃs tu śivaṃ vrajet ||
iti nānāśāstrīyakāmadhenudānam |
atha hiraṇyāśvābhidhānaṃ saptamaṃ mahādānam ālikhyate |
matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi hiraṇyāśvavidhiṃ param |
[275]        yasya prasādād bhuvanam anantaphalam aśnute ||
puṇyaṃ tithim athāsādya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
lokeśāvāhanaṃ kuryāt tulāpuruṣadānavat ||
ṛtivigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam |
svalpeṣv ekāgnivat kuryād dhemavājimakhaṃ budhaḥ ||
atrādiśabdena deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjāguruṛtvigvaraṇamadhuparkadānavedikopari-cakralekhanavitānatoraṇapatākādhivāsanādi matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavihitaṃ saṃgṛhyate, svalpeṣv ekāgnivad iti vyākhyātam, sthāpayed vedimadhye tu kṛṣṇājinatilopari kṛṣṇājinanihitadroṇaparimitatiloparīti vijñeyam |
kauśeyavastrasaṃvītaṃ kārayed dhemavājinam |
śaktitas tripalād ūrdhvam ā sahasrapalād budhaḥ ||
pādukopānahachatracāmarāsanabhājanaiḥ |
pūrṇakumbhāṣṭakopetaṃ mālyekṣuphalasaṃyutam ||
śayyopaskarā vividhāstaranopadhānavastraphalapuṣpakuṅumakarpūrāgurucandanatāmbūla-darpyaṇakaṅkatikācāmaravyajanāsana etad agrasthitapātrāsi mudrikopānahayugalatāmra-ghaṭikādijalapātradīpikāvitānādayaḥ, mārtaṇḍasaṃyutam iti, uparyārūḍhasauvarṇaṃ sūryāśvaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | [276] sūryalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍe |
tataḥ sarvauṣadhisnānasnāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ |
imam uccārayen mantraṃ gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
ihāpi pūrve dyur adhivāsanaṃ vidhāya dvitīyadivase pūrvavat puṇyāhavācanādipūrṇāhuti-paryantaṃ karma, guruḥ samāpayet |
atha sarvauṣadijalasnātaḥ śuklāmbaro yajamānas triḥ pradakṣiṇīkrtya vakṣyamāṇamantram udīrayet |
namas te sarvadeveśa devāharaṇalampaṭa |
vājirūpeṇa mām asmāt pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ||
tvam eva saptadhā bhūtvā chandorūpeṇa bhāskaram |
yasmād bhrāmayase lokān ataḥ pāhi sanātanaḥ ||
evam uccārya gurave tam aśvaṃ vinivedayet |
datvā pāpakṣayād bhānor lokam abhyeti śāśvatam ||
gobhir vibhavataḥ sarvān ṛtvijaś cābhipūjayet |
sarvadhānyopakaraṇaṃ gurave vinivedayet ||
sarvaṃ śayyādikaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjītātailam eva hi |
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tadvat kārayed bhojanād anu ||
dānavān tvam atra pūrvavad anusaṃdheyam, anuktadakṣiṇeṣu suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇeti, yathāśakti suvarṇadakṣiṇā, vibhavatāṃ svavibhavānusāreṇa sarvān sadasyādīn ṛtvijaś ca gobhiḥ pūjayet | sarvadhānyopakaraṇam iti viniyogāt pūrvaṃ dhānyasādanaṃ gamyate | gurave nivedayed iti svalpadravyadāne ācāryāyaiva aśvaṃ pradāya ṛtvigbhyo yathāśakti suvarṇādi dadyāt sahasrapalādidravyadāne tu prakṛtivad vyavasthā, [277] svalpatareṣv ekāgnipakṣe ‘pi draṣṭavyā tataś ca pūrvavat puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisrjanāni kuryāt |
imaṃ hiraṇyāśvavidhiṃ karoti yaḥ
saṃpūjymāno divi devatendraiḥ |
vimuktapāpaḥ sa puraṃ murāreḥ
prāpnoti siddhair abhipūjitaḥ san ||
iti paṭhati ya etad dhemavājipradānam
sakalakaluṣamuktaḥ so ‘śvamedhena bhūpaḥ |
kanakamayavimānenārkalokaṃ prayāti
tridaśapativadhūbhiḥ pūjyate yo ‘tha paśyet ||
yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣo ‘lpadhanaḥ smared vā
hemāśvadānam abhinandayatīha loke |
so ‘pi prayāti hatakalmaṣaśuddhadehaḥ
snānaṃ purandaramaheśvaradevajuṣṭam ||
iti matsyapurāṇokto hiraṇyāśvadānavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |

aśvamedhāyutaśreṣṭhaṃ rahasyaṃ śṛṇu suvrata ||
aṣṭottarasahasreṇa aṣṭottaraśatena vā |
kṛtvāśvaṃ lakṣaṇair yuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam ||
śatasahasraśabdau vihitopalakṣaṇaparau |
śaktitas tripalād ūrdhvam āsahasrapalāv api |
[278]        alpe tv ekāgnivat kuryād dhemavājimakhaṃ budhaḥ ||
iti vātulokteḥ |
pañcakalyāṇakaṃ samyak rajatena tu kārayet |
caturṣu padeṣu mukhe ca śveto hayaḥ pañcakalyāṇaka ucyate ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvāṅgaiś ca samanvitam |
sarvāyudhasamopetaṃ indravāhanam avyayam ||
taṃ madhyadeśe saṃsthāpya turaṅgaṃ sadguṇānvitam |
uccaiḥśravaḥsamaṃ jñātvā ānīyaiva samarcayet ||
madhyadeśe saṃsthāpyeti, etad dānaprakṛtibhūtaliṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavihiitavedikā-maṇḍalamadhye tilopari tam aśvaṃ saṃsthāpy uccaiḥśravasam anudhyāyan pūjayet |
tasya pūrvadiśo bhāge brāhmaṇaṃvedapāragam |
surendrabuddhyā saṃpūjya pañcaniṣkān pradāpayet ||
tam aśvaṃ brāhmaṇe ‘bhyarcya pradadyād vidhinaiva tu |
suvarṇāśvaṃ pradadyāt tu ācāryam atha pūjayet ||
yathā vibhavavistāraṃ pañcaniṣkair athāpi vā |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāthabālavṛddhakṛśāturān |
toṣayed annadānena brāhmaṇāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ ||

saṃkhyāpalaśataṃ tasya payasā tv evam eva hi ||
brahmakūrcena saṃsthāpya vilepyāgurucandanaiḥ |
saṃpūjya praṇipatyātha devadevaṃ kṣamāpayet ||
etad yaḥ kurute bhaktyā dānam **** mānavaḥ |
[279]        aindrāṃl lokāṃś ciraṃ bhuktvā bhuvi rājeśvaro bhavet ||
indrabuddhyā ārādhitaviprāya pañcaniṣkān datvā śrotriyādibhyo hiraṇyāśvaṃ datvā ācāryaṃ **ābhyarcya tasmai niṣkapañcakaṃ dadyāt śivasnapanādipūrvottaratantraṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavat | matsyapurāṇādau tu ācāryāyaivāśvadānam uktaṃ | kāmike tu |
gandhādibhis tam abhyarcya viprebhyo vinivedayet |

maṇḍalābhyarcanaṃ homaṃ kalaśasthāpanaṃ tathā |
dakṣiṇāṃ deśikādīnāṃ tulābhāravad ācaret ||
iti liṅgapurāṇokto hiraṇyāśvadānavidhiḥ |

matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādānam anuttamam |
puṇyam aśvarathaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam ||
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
lokeśāvāhanaṃ kuryāt tulāpuruṣadānavat ||
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ||
tulāpuruṣadānavad iti, matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavad veditavyam, ādiśabdasyāpi pūrvavad eva vyākhyā |
kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛtvā kāñcanaṃ kārayed ratham |
aṣṭāśvaṃ caturaśvaṃ vā catuścakraṃ saṅuvaram ||
[280]        indranīlena kumbhena dhvajarūpeṇa saṃyutam |
lokapālāṣṭakopetaṃ padmarāgadalānvitam ||
atra tilānāṃ rathasya ca parimāṇāpekṣāyāṃ puruṣecchayā niyamaḥ prakṛtau parimāṇāśravaṇāt, kecit tu saṃnidhānāt suvarṇahastirathādidānasthitaṃ tilānāṃ droṇaparimāṇatva iha vadanti | kūvaro yugādārakāṣṭham | dhvajo daṇḍaḥ, sa ca rathasya sauvarṇatvāt sauvarṇa eva tathā coparisthitena indranīlamaṇimayena kalaśena yuktaḥ kartavyaḥ | lokapālalakṣaṇam uktam brāhmaṇḍe |
catvāraḥ pūrṇakalaśā dhānyāny aṣṭau daśaiva tu |
kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktam upariṣṭād vitānakam ||
mālye kṣupalasaṃyuktaṃ puruṣeṇa samanvitam |
yo yadbhaktaḥ pumān kuryāt śatanāmnādhivāsanam ||
vitānam atra pañcavarṇam, puruṣa iṣṭadevatākāraḥ sauvarṇarathe sthāpanīyaḥ, svastropānahapādukāḥ |
gobhir vibhavataḥ sardhaṃ dadyāc ca śayanāsanam |
ābhārātripalād ūrdhvaṃ śaktitaḥ kāreyad budhaḥ ||
bhāraḥ palasahasradvayam | etac ca suvarṇamānaṃ dhvajapuruṣalokapālāśvacakrarakṣaka-sahitasya veditavyam |
aṣṭabhī rathasaṃyuktaṃ caturbhī rathavājibhiḥ |
dvābhyām atha yutaṃ dadyād hemasiṃhadhvajānvitam ||
haimena siṃhāṅkitena yuktam iti aṣṭāśvapakṣe, caturaśvapakṣe ca indranīlamayukumbo dhvaje kāryaḥ, aśvadvayapakṣe hemasiṃha iti vyavasthā |
[281]        cakrarakṣāv ubhau tasya turagasthāv athāśvinau |
puṇyaṃ kālaṃ tataḥ prāpya pūrvavat snāpito dvijaiḥ ||
śuklamālyāmbaro dadyād imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
cakrarakṣau cakrasamīpe aśvārūḍhāv aśvinīkumārau kāryau | tallakṣaṇam āha gobhilaḥ |
dvibujau devabhiṣajau kartavyāv aśvavāhanau |
tayor oṣadhayaḥ kāryā divyā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ |
vāmayoḥ pustakau karyau darśanīyau tathā dvija || iti |
puṇyakālaṃ yajamānānukūlaṃ lagnamuhūrtādikam | atrāpi pūrvavad adhivāsanadinād anyadivase puṇyāhavācanādisakalakarmasamāptau sarvaupadhijalasnāto gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ yajamānas triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vakṣyamāṇaṃ mantram udāharet |
namo namaḥ pāpavināśanāya
viśvātmane vedaturaṅgamāya |
dhāmnām adhīśāya bhavābhavāya
pāpaughadāvānala dehi śāntim ||
vasvaṣṭakādityamarudgaṇānām
tvam eva dhātā paramaṃ nidhānam |
yatas tato me hṛdayaṃ prayātu
dharmaukatānatvam aghaughanāśāt ||
ihāpi dānaprayogasuvarṇadakṣiṇādānaṛtvigācāryadravyavibhāgasvalpaikāgnividhānādi pūrvavad anusaṃdheyam | tataḥ puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanādi kuryāt |
athātharvaṇīpathabrāhmaṇe |
oṃ athāto aśvarathavidhim anukramiṣyāmaḥ | sarvapāpāpanodana udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe 'śvaḥ puṇye nakṣatre śraddhāprerito grahayukto grahaṇakāle vā atha ṛtvik pradānakālāt suvarṇaṃ ratham ānīya sarvaṃ śāntyudakenābhyukṣya yathoktamāñcanābhyañcanānulepanaṃ kārayitvā, vāsogandhān srajaś cāvadhya agnim upasamādhāya anvālabhyātha juhuyād ud ehi vājinn iti dvābhyām, sūryaṃ caruṃ śrapayitvā viṣāsahiṃ sahamānam ity abhimantryānvālabhyātha juhuyāt |
rathaṃ yoktraṃ yugam aśvau ca sarvaṃ śāntyudakenāplāvya vā turaṅgam vājin ity aśvayor mūrdhni saṃpātān sthālīpākād yajet | udayate nama iti navabir mantraiḥ namaskṛtya dvijān ante tarpayet |
tatra ślokau |
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ phalaṃ yat tat prakīrtitam |
tat tad āpnoti viprebhyo vidhināśvarathaṃ dadat ||
anāmayaṃ sthānam avāpya devair
alaṅghanīyaṃ sukṛtaṃ hiraṇmayam |
suvarṇatejāḥ pravimuktapāpo
rathaiś caran dviyati sūryaloke ||
matsyapurāṇe |
iti turagarathapradānam etad
bhavabhayasūdanam atra yaḥ karoti |
sakalakaluṣapaṭakhair vimuktadehaḥ
paramam upaiti padaṃ pinākapāṇeḥ ||
[283]        dedīpyamānavapuṣā vijitaprabhāgam
ākramya maṇḍalam akhaṇḍalacaṇḍabhānoḥ |
siddhāṅganānayanaṣaṭpadapīyamāno
vaktrāmbujāmbujabhavena ciraṃ sahāste ||
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya ittam
kanakaturaṅgamarathapradānam eva |
na sa narakapuraṃ vrajet kadācin
narakaripor bhavanaṃ prayāti bhūyaḥ ||
iti hiraṇyāśvarathadānavidhiḥ |
atha hemahastirathābhidhānaṃ navamam mahādānam ārabhyate | mātyapurāṇe |
matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi hemahastirathaṃ śubham |
yasya pradānād bhavanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ||
puṇyāṃ tithim athāsādya tulāpuruṣadānavat |
vipravācanakaṃ kuryāl loke śāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ ||
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam |
atrāpy upoṣitaṃ tadvad brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhojanam ||
ihāpy ādiśabdena deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhādisarvam anuktaṃ matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣasthitaṃ veditavyam | upoṣitam iti, upavāsāśaktau naktam api veditavyam |
kuryāt puṣparathākāraṃ kāñcanaṃ maṇimaṇḍitam |
valabhībhir vicitrābhiś catuścakrasamanvitam ||
lokapālāṣṭakopetaṃ śivārkabrahmasaṃyutam |
[284]        madhye nārāyaṇopetaṃ lakṣmīpuṣṭisamanvitam ||
puṣparathaḥ, krīḍārtho rathaḥ | sa catuṣkikākāreṇoparyācchādito bhavati valayebhyo lokapālāśrayaḥ, lokapālabrahmaśivārkalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍe | madhyaśabdaḥ pūrvāparābhyāṃ saṃbadhyate, śivādīnām api sthānāpekṣāyās tenaiva nivṛtteḥ | nārāyaṇādilakṣaṇaṃ pañcarātrāt |
nārāyaṇo caturbāhuḥ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ tathottare |
dakṣiṇe tu mahāpadmaṃ mīlañjībhūtasaṃnibhe |
vāme śrīr vallakīhastā muṣṭiḥ padmakarā parā || iti |
kṛṣṇājine tiladroṇe kṛtvā saṃsthāpayed ratham |
tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni bhājanāsanacandanaiḥ ||
dīpikopānahachatrapādukādarpaṇānvitam |
dhvaje tu garuḍaṃ kuryāt kūvārāgre vināyakam ||
nānāphalasamāyuktam upariṣṭād vitānakam |
kauśeyaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ ca amlānakusumānvitam ||
caturbhiḥ kalaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ gobhir aṣṭābhir anvitam |
caturbhir hayamātaṅgair muktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ ||
svarūpataḥ karibhyāṃ ca yuktaṃ kṛtvā nivedayet |
kuryāt pañcapalād ūrdhvam ābhārād api śaktitaḥ ||
dhvaje tu garuḍaṃ kuryād ityādi dhvajo daṇḍaḥ | garuḍalakṣaṇam uktaṃ nāradīye |
oṃ aindrasyāgrataḥ pakṣī guḍākeśaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ |
savyajānugato bhūmau mūrdhā ca phaṇimaṇḍitaḥ ||
[285]        pakṣijaṅgho naragrīvas tuṅganāso narāṅgakaḥ |
dvibāhuḥ pakṣayuktaś ca kartavyo vinatāsutaḥ ||
atha vināyakasya |
caturbhujas trinetraś ca kartavyo ‘tra gajānanaḥ |
nāgayajñopavītaś ca śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharaḥ ||
dantaṃ dakṣakare dadyād dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam |
tṛtīye paraśuṃ dadyād caturthe modakaṃ tathā ||
uparyadhohastayor dantādi, deyam iti, kūvaro vyākhyātaḥ | amlānakusumaṃ puṣpaviśeṣaḥ, rūḍhir yaugikam upaharatīty nyāyāt | mahāsaheti prasiddham eva gṛhyate bhāro vyākhyātaḥ | dhvajagatadevatāś ca pañcapalādiparimitena rathavat kṛtasuvarṇenaiva niṣpādanīyāḥ evaṃ saṃbhārānupakalpā pūrvavad adhivāsanaṃ vidhāya divaseṣu puṇyāhavācanādisakalaṃ karmakāṇḍaṃ samāpya sarvauṣadhijalair ācāryo yajamānasya snapanaṃ kuryāt |
tato maṅgalaśabdena snāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
imam uccārayen mantraṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet ||
namo namaḥ śaṅkarapadmajārkalokeśavidyādharavāsudevaiḥ |
tvaṃ sevyase deva purāṇayajñatejomayaspandana pāhi yasmāt ||
yat tat padaṃ guhyatamaṃ surārer ānandahetuguṇarūpamantaḥ |
yogaikamānasadṛśo munayaḥ samādhau paśyanti tattvam asi nātha rathe ‘dhirūḍhaḥ|
[286]        yasmāt tvam eva bhavasāgarasaṃśritānām
ānandabhāṇḍabhṛtam adhvarapānapātram |
tasmād aghaughaśamanena kuru prasādaṃ
cāmīkarebharathasādhavasaṃpradānāt ||
mantreṇānena praṇamya yathāśakti suvarṇadakṣiṇām upakalpāpūrvavat prayogam uccārya taṃ gajarathaṃ pratyakṣagajasaṃyutaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pratipādayet, ācāryādīnām ardhacaturbhāgādivyavasthā tadanujñayā cānyebhyo ‘pi dānam, dīnānāthapūraṇaṃ ceti, prakṛtivad ācaraṇīyam, tataḥ puṇyāhavācane kṛte yajamāno vedisamīpaṃ gatvā devatāpūjāṃ vidadhyāt | ācaryas tu visaryayec ca | ātharvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇe |
athāto hastirathadānavidhiṃ vakṣye |
jātarūpamayaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ cakrasuśobhanam |
hastibhiḥ saptabhir yuktam arcayitvā yathāvidhi ||
atha vā caturbhir yuktaṃ haimaṃ rājatam eva vā |
aspṛṣṭaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi sarvasaṃbhārapūritam ||
hastiyugmena saṃvītaṃ saurabheyayugena vā |
bhuṅkte saptaiva janmāni saptadvīpāṃ sasundharām ||
hastiyukte candramasi paurṇamāsyamāvāsyayor anyasmin puṇye tithāv ahni hasti vā śucau deśe tantram ity uktaṃ prāñcam idhmam agnim upasamādhāyānvārābhyātha juhuyāt | savitre svāhā pataṅgāya svāhā pāvakāya svāhā sahasraraśmaye svāhā mārtaṇḍāya svāha viṣṇave svāha prajāpataye svāh parameṣṭhine svāhety hutvā hastivarcasaprathatāṃ [287] bṛhadyaśa iti kalaśe saṃpātān ānīya yugaṃ yoktraṃ ratham iti sarvaṃ saṃprokṣya yajñasya tvām anasā yunajmīti yojayet | aśrāntasya tvām anasā yunajmi pradhamasya ca uktam udvaho | bhavoduhya dhāvatāṃ yuktāyārghaṃ dadyāt syāvair (?) yuktaḥ sitapāhiraṇmayo yasya rathaḥ pathibhir vartate śivaiḥ śanto agne vasuvidā hiraṇyakṛd viraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā no ‘bhirakṣatu |
bṛhaddhastirathaṃ yuktaṃ hastena tudadantaraḥ |
savituḥ sthānam āpnoti divyāṃ kāmajavāṃ śubhām ||
matsyapurāṇe |
itthaṃ praṇamya kanakena rathapradānam |
yaḥ kārayet sakalapāpavimuktadehaḥ ||
vidyādharāmaramunīndragaṇābhijuṣṭam |
prāpnoty asau padam atīndriyam indumauleḥ ||
kṛtaduritavitānaprorjvalad vahnijāla-
vyatikarakṛtadāhodvegabhājo ‘pi bandhūn |
nayati ca pitṛpautrān rauravād apy aśeṣān
kṛtagajarathadānaḥ śāśvataṃ sadma viṣṇoḥ ||
iti hemahastirathadānavidhiḥ |
atha pañcalāṅgalākhyaṃ daśamaṃ mahādānam upapādyate |
matysa uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādānam anuttamam |
pañcalāṅgalakaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam ||
puṇyāṃ tithim athāsādya yugādigrahaṇādikām |
bhūmidānaṃ naro dadyāt pañcalāṅgalakānvitam ||
[288]        karvaṭaṃ kheṭakaṃ vāpi grāmaṃ vā sasyaśālinam |
nivartanaṃ śataṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ ||
sāradārumayān kṛtvā halān pañca vicakṣaṇaḥ |
sarvopakaraṇair yuktāṃs tathānyān pañca kāñcanān ||
karvaṭādisvarūpaṃ mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
sotsedhavaprākāraṃ sarvataḥ khātakāvṛtam |
yojanārdhārdhaviṣkambham aṣṭabhāgāyataṃ puram ||
tadardhena tathā kheṭaṃ tatpādena ca karvaṭam |
tathā śuddhajanaprāyāḥ susamṛddhakṛṣīvalāḥ ||
kṣetropabhāgabhūmadhye vasati grāmasaṃjñitā || iti |
nivartamānaṃ tu saptahastena daṇḍenetyādi vakṣyati | sāradārūṇi śākeṅgudīcandanaprabhṛtīni, upakaraṇāni yugayoktraphālarajjuprājanādīni |
vṛṣān lakṣaṇasaṃyuktān daśaiva ca dhurandharān |
suvaṇaśṛṅgābharaṇān muktālāṅgūlabhūṣaṇān ||
raupyapādāgratilakān raktakośeyabhūṣitān |
sragdāmacandanayutān śālāyām adhivāsayet ||
vṛṣalakṣaṇāni suśīlatvaṃ tvaruṇatvam indriyatvam arogitvam kleśasahatvam ityādīni | agraṃ lalāṭadeśaḥ, tataś ca raupyapādān raupyalalāṭatilakāś ceti |
parjanyādityarudrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ nirvapec carum |
ekasminn eva kuṇḍe tu carum asmai nivedayet ||
[289]        palāśasamidhas tadvad ājyaṃ kṛṣṇatilāṃs tathā ||
ihāpi pūrvavad adhivāsanādi vidhāya tadanyadivase puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā agnikuṇḍeṣu ṛtvigupaveśanādikarmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | kiṃ tv aparo ‘yaṃ viśeṣaḥ, tulāpuruṣoktahome vihitaśeṣāṇām ṛtvijām anyatamaṃ gurur ādiśet sa eka eva ṛtvig ekasminn eva kuṇḍe parjanyādityarudrebhyas talliṅgamantraiḥ pāyasacaruprabhṛtidravyenāṣṭottarasahasraṃ juhuyāt |
tulāpuruṣavat kuryāl lokeśāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ |
tato maṅgalaśabdena śuklamālyāmbaro budhaḥ ||
āhūya dvijadampatyaṃ hemasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
kauśeyavastrakaṭakair maṇibhiś ca vibhūṣayet ||
śayyāṃ sopaskarān dadyād dhenum ekāṃ payasvinīm |
tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni samantād adhivāsayet ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
imam uccārayen mantram atha sarvaṃ nivedayet ||
lokeśāvāhanam ity upalakṣaṇam | atra hi deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjā brāhmaṇavācana-guruṛtvigvaraṇamadhuparkadānakuṇḍamaṇḍapavedikāvitānacakralekhanatoraṇapatākādi matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavihitaṃ gṛhyate | tata iti, homānantaraṃ sarvauṣadhijalasnātaḥ śuklāmbaradharo dadyād ity anvayaḥ | āhūya dvijadampatyam iti, sakalakarmaniyuktasya guror dakṣiṇāntarāpratīteḥ saṃnihitaparityāge kāraṇābhāvāt dvijaśabdasyāvirodhāc ca sakalatrasya guror eva dātavyam iti gamyate, [290] tadanujñayā cānyebhyo ‘pi deyam iti, svalpeṣv ekāgnividhānam api boddhavyam, śayyopaskarā hiraṇyāśvadāne vyākhyātāḥ | atha mantraḥ |
yasmād devagaṇāḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
dhurandarāṅge tiṣṭhanti tasmād bhaktiḥ śive ‘stu me ||
yasmāc ca bhūmidānasya kalān nāharhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
dānāny anyāni me bhaktir dharma eva dṛḍhā bhavet ||
iti mantram uccārya yathāśakti dakṣiṇām upakalpā pūrvaprayogeṇa pratipādayet, tataś ca puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanāni |
daṇḍena saptahastena triṃśad daṇḍā nivartanam |
tribhāgahīnaṃ gocarmamānam āha prajāpatiḥ |
mānenānena yo dadyān nivartanaśataṃ budhaḥ |
vidhinānena tasyāśu kṣīyate pāpasaṃhatiḥ ||
tadardham api vā dadyād api gocarmamātrakam |
bhavanasthānamātraṃ vā so ‘pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
yāvanti lāṅgalakamārgamukhāni bhūmer
bhāṣāmpater duhitur aṅgajaromakāṇi |
tāvanti śaṅkarapure sa samā hi tiṣṭhed
bhūmipradānam iha yaḥ kurute manuṣyaḥ ||
gandharvakinnarasurāsurasiddhasaṅghair
ādhūtacāmaram upetya mahad vimānam |
saṃpūjyate pitṛpitāmahabandhuyuktaḥ
[291]                śambhoḥ puraṃ vrajati cāmaranāyakaḥ san ||
indratvam apy adhigataṃ kṣayam abhyupaiti
gobhūmilāṅgaladhurandharasaṃpradānāt |
tasmād aghaughapaṭhlakṣayakāri bhūmer
dānaṃ vidheyam apy atibhūtibhavodbhavāya ||
iti śrīmatsyapurāṇoktaḥ pañcalāṅgaladānavidhiḥ |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānam apy adbhutaṃ tava |
yena dānena rājendra sarvadānaprado bhavet ||
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakam |
saṃyuktahalapaṅktyākhyadānaṃ sarvaphalapradam ||
paṅktir daśahalā proktā halasya syāc caturyugam |
sāradārumayāny āhur dalāni daś paṇḍitāḥ ||
sauvarṇapaṭṭanaddhāni ratnavanti śubhāni ca |
yuvāno balino bhavyānnāṅgahīnān svalaṅkṛtān ||
vastrakāñcanapuṣpais tu candanādigdhamastakān |
bhadrāṅgān yojayet teṣu lāṅgaleṣu vṛṣān pumān ||
yoktrāṇi yugalagnāni savṛṣāṇi ca kārayet |
pratodakīlikābandhasarvopakaraṇāni ca ||
evamvidhair halaiḥ kuryāt saṃyuktāṃ dalapaṅktikām |
kheṭikaṃ karvaṭaṃ vāpi grāmaṃ vā sasyaśālinam ||
[292]        nivartanaśataṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vāpi kalpayet |
evaṃvidhāṃ parvakāle dadyāt prayatamānasaḥ ||
kārttikyāṃ vātha vaiśākhyām uttare tv ayane tathā |
janmartau grahaṇe vāpi viṣuve cātha dāpayet ||
brāhmaṇān vedasaṃpannān avyaṅgāṅgān svalaṃkṛtān |
śrotiryāṃś ca vinītāṃś ca dalasaṃkhyān nimantrayet ||
daśahastapramāṇena kārayen maṇḍapaṃ budhaḥ |
pūrvedyuḥ kuṇḍam ekaṃ ca hastamātraṃ ca śobhanam ||
tatra vyāhṛtibhir homaṃ kuryus te dvijasattamāḥ |
parjanyādityarudrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ nirvapec carum ||
palāśasamidhas tadvad ājyaṃ kṛṣṇatilāṃs tathā |
āvāsya ca tataḥ paṅktiṃ dhānyamadhyagatāṃ śubhām ||
tataḥ sarmasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ |
halapaṅktiṃ yojayitvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
śaṅkatūryaninādaiś ca brahmaghoṣaiḥ sapuṣkalaiḥ |
imam uccārayen mantraṃ gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
yasmād devagaṇāḥ sarve hale tiṣṭhanti sarvadā |
vṛṣaskandhe saṃnihitās tasmād bhaktiḥ śive ‘stu me ||
yasmāc ca bhūmidānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
dānāny anyāni me bhaktir dharme cāstu sadā dṛḍhā ||
evam ukte tataḥ paṅktiṃ prerayed yo dvijottamaḥ |
bījāni sarvaratnāni suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā ||
svayaṃ paścād gale lagno viprahasteṣu nirvapet |
[293]        yāyān nivartanaṃ yāvat tatas tu viramed budhaḥ ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā viprāṇāṃ pratipādya ca |
sadakṣiṇavidhānena praṇipatya visarjayet ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dānam etat prayacchati |
ekaviṃśatkulopetaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
saptajanmāni dāridryaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vyādhayas tathā |
na paśyati ca bhūmeś ca tathaivādhipatir bhavet ||
dṛṣṭvā tu dīyamānaṃ tu dānam eva yudhiṣṭhira |
ājanmanaḥ kṛtāt pāpāt mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
dānam etat purā dattaṃ dilīpena yayātinā |
śibinā niminā caiva baratena ca dhīmatā ||
te ‘dyāpi divi modante dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
prayatnena mahīpāla dānam etan nṛpottama ||
dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktena striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā |
yadi paṅktir na vidyeta pañcacatvāri vā nṛpa |
ekam apy uktavidhinā halaṃ deyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
yāvanti lāṅgalamukhotthamṛdāṃ rajāṃsi
yāvanti cātra sudhurandhararomakāṇi |
tāvanti śaṅkharapure sa yugāni niṣṭhet
paṅktipradānam iha yaḥ kurute manuṣyaḥ ||
yuktāṃ vṛṣair atibalair halapaṅktim enām
puṇye ‘hni bhaktisahitāṃ dvijapuṅgavānām |
[294]        icchanti ye sukṛtino vasudhāsametās
te bhūbhujā mukham upetya bhavanti bhavyāḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottarokto halapaṅktidānavidhiḥ |
athaikādaśadharādhānasaṃjñaṃ mahādānam upavarṇyate | śrīmatsyapurāṇe |
matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dharādānam anuttamam |
pāpakṣayakaraṃ nṛṇām amaṅgalyavināśanam ||
kārayet pṛthivīṃ haimīṃ jambudvīpānukāriṇīm |
maryādāparvatavatīṃ madhye merusamanvitām ||
lokapālāṣṭakopetāṃ navavarṣasamanvitām |
nadīnadaśatopetām ante sāgaraveṣṭitām ||
anukāriṇīm sadṛśīm ity arthaḥ | iha hi jambudvīpasadṛśīṃ kuryād ity ukte nikhilanaganagarasaro-varavanādyanvitamahīsādṛśyaprāptī maryādāparvatavatīm ityādinā tāvanmātrānvitadharaṇyanukāra iti gamyate | itarathā sāmānyenaiva tadavagater viśeṣānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | tad ayam arthaḥ haimīṃ pṛthvīṃ kuryād ity ukte saptadvīpavatyāḥ prasaṅge jambudvīpānukāriṇīm ity ucyate | tatrāpi nānāparvatānvitānukāraprasaṅge maryādāparvatavatīm iti | tathā sati meror anukaraṇaprāptau madhye merusamanvitām iti nānādevagaṇānivṛttyarthaṃ lokapālāṣṭakopetām it | evaṃ ca saṃkhyeyapakṣāśrayaṇe purāṇā- [295] ntaropadarśitavarṣacatuṣṭayādipakṣaparigrahaśaṅkānivṛttyarthaṃ navavarṣasamanvitām ity ucyate | tatra jambudvīpam upavarṇitaṃ viṣṇupurāṇe |
navavarṣaṃ tu maitreya jambudvīpam idaṃ mayā |
lakṣayojanavistāraṃ saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ tava ||
jambudvīpaṃ samāvṛtya lakṣayojanavistaraḥ |
maitreya valayākāraḥ sthitaḥ kṣīrodadhir bahiḥ ||
jambudvīpaḥ samastānāṃ dvīpānāṃ madhyataḥ sthitaḥ |
tasyāpi merur maitreya madhye kanakaparvataḥ ||
caturaśītisāhasrayojanair asya cocchrayaḥ |
pratiṣṭhā ṣoḍaśād dhastād dvātriṃśan mūrdhni vistṛtaḥ ||
mūle ṣoḍaśasāhasro vistāras tasya sarvataḥ |\
purāṇāntare tu aṣṭaṣaṣṭiyojanocchraya ity uktam | tathā |
meroś caturdiśaṃ tatra navasāhasravistṛtam |
ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāgaś catvāraś cānuparvatāḥ ||
pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ |
vaibhrājaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaś cottare smṛtaḥ ||
maryādāparvatās tu brahmāṇḍe purāṇe darśitāḥ |
jāṭharo devakūṭaś ca pūrvasyāṃ diśi parvatau |
tau dakṣiṇottarāyām āvānīlaniṣadhāyatau ||
[296]        kailāso himavāṃś caiva dakṣiṇe varaparvatau |
pūrvapaścāyatāv etāv arṇavāntavyavasthitau ||
triśṛṅgo jārudhiś caiva uttarau varaparvatau |
pūrvapañcāyatāv etāv arṇavāntavyavasthitau ||
niṣadhaḥ pārijātaś ca paścimau varaparvatau |
tau dakṣiṇottarāyām āvānīlaniṣadhāyatau ||
nīlaniṣadhaparvatau tu agre vakṣyete | lokapālāṣṭakopetām iti, lokapālā indrādayo ‘ṣṭau, teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pūrvam uktaṃ brahmāṇddāne, tatsaṃniveśāś ca meror upari pradakṣiṇakrameṇa pūrvādidikṣu kartavyāḥ, navavarṣasamanvitām iti | varṣopavarṇanaṃ ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
uttaraṃ yat samudrasya himādreś caiva dakṣiṇam |
etad vai bhārataṃ nāma bhāratī yatra santatiḥ ||
bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam |
harivarṣaṃ tathaivānyaṃ meror dakṣiṇato dvija ||
ramyakaṃ cottare varṣaṃ tasyaivānu hiraṇmayam ||
uttarāḥ kuravaś caiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā |
meroḥ pūrveṇa bhadrāś ca ketumālaṃ ca paścime ||
varṣe dve tu samākhyāte tayor madhyamilāvṛtam |
navasahasram eteṣām ekaikaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
[297] tathā |
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhaś caiva dakṣiṇe |
nīlaḥ śvetaś ca śṛṅgī ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ ||
sahasradvitayocchāyās tāvad vistāriṇaś ca te |
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnās tathāpare ||
lakṣapramāṇāv ityādi, ilāvṛtasyobhayapārśvavartinau nīlaniṣadhau dvau parvatau dairghyeṇa lakṣaguṇau vijñeyau, tadvāhyavartinau śvetahemakūṭau navatisahasrayojanapramāṇau vijñeyau, tathā tadvāhyasthitau śṛṅgīhimavantau aśītisahasrayojanapramāṇāv ity arthaḥ | atra yuktir uktā matsyapurāṇe, dvīpasya dvīpasya maṇḍalībhāvāt hrāsavṛddhiḥ prakīrtiteti |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
meros tu paścime bhāge navasāhasrasaṃmite |
catustriṃśatsahasrāṇi gandhamādanaparvataḥ ||
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi parivṛddho mahītalāt |
sahasram avagāhe tu sati dviguṇavistaraḥ |
pūrveṇa mālyavān śailas tatpramāṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
atra śatasahasrādiyojanaparimāṇānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ kartum aśakyatvāt yojanasahasrasthāne ardhāṅgulādimānaṃ parikalpya yathoktasaṃkhyātāratamyam anuṣṭheyam | nadīnadaśatopetam iti, nadyo bhāgīrathīprabhṛtikāḥ, nadāḥ śoṇādayaḥ, teṣāṃ sākalyena vidhātum aśakyatvād yāvacchakyam anukāraḥ kartavyaḥ | ante sāgaraveṣṭitām iti, yady api yāvatparimāṇā pṛthvī tāvān eva sāgaraḥ tathāpy anukāramātropadeśāt śakyānukāramātram ācaraṇīyam |
[298]        mahāratnasamākīrṇāṃ vasurudrārkasaṃyutām |
hemnaḥ palasahasreṇa tadardhaṃ vātha śaktitaḥ ||
śatatrayeṇa vā kuryād dviśatena śatena vā |
kuryāt pañcapalād ūrdhvam aśakto ‘pi vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
tulāpuruṣavat kuryāt lokeśāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ |
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ||
vedyāṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ kṛtvā tilānām upari nyaset |
tathāṣṭādaśa dhānyāni rasāṃś ca lavaṇādikān ||
tathāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśān samantāt parikalpayet |
vitānakaṃ ca kauśeyaṃ phalāni vividhāni ca ||
tathāṃśukāni ramyāṇi śrīkhaṇḍaśakalāni ca |
ity evaṃ racayitvā tām adhivāsanapūrvakam ||
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ śuklābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
mahāratnetyādi, mahāratnāni, māṇikyaprabhṛtīni paribhāṣāyāṃ darśitāni, vasurudrārkarūpam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne, ācchādanādikam ityādikaśabdena deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjā-brāhmaṇavācanādhivāsanādisarvaṃ tulāpuruṣoktam anuṣṭheyam, pūrṇakalaśān sraggandhapañcaratnadūrvāṃkuracūtapallavānvitān ity avadheyam, vitānaṃ pañcavarṇam iti, pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtveti, triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtyety arthaḥ, pradakṣiṇādikaṃ ca dvitīyadivase pūrṇāhutyantakarmaśeṣasamāptau sarvauṣadhisnānānantaram anusaṃdheyam |
puṇyakālam athāsādya mantrān etān udāharet |
[299]        namas te sarvadevānāṃ tvam ekaṃ bhavanaṃ yataḥ |
dhātrī ca sarvabhūtānām ataḥ pāhi vasundhare ||
vasūn dhārayase yasmād vasucātīva nirmalaṃ |
vasundharā tato jātā tasmāt pāhi bhayād alam ||
caturmukho ‘pi no gacched yasmād antaṃ tavācale |
anantāyai namas tasmāt pāhi saṃsārakardamāt ||
tvam eva lakṣmīr govinde śive gaurīti saṃsthitā |
gayatri brahmaṇaḥ pārśve jyotsnā candre ravau prabhā ||
buddhir bṛhaspatau khyātā medhā muniṣu saṃsthitā |
viśvaṃ vyāpya sthitā yasmāt tato viśvaṃbharā matā ||
dhṛjiḥ kṣitiḥ kṣamā kṣauṇī pṛthī vasumatau rasā |
etābhir mūrtibhiḥ pāhi devi saṃsārasāgarāt ||
evam uccārya tāṃ devīṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet |
dharārdhaṃ vā caturbhāgaṃ gurave pratipādayet ||
śeṣaṃ caivātha ṛtvigbhyaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet ||
atrāpi pūrvavad dānavakyam uccārya jalapūrvaṃ dānam ācāryānujñayā anyebhyo ‘pi dānaṃ dīnānāthapūraṇam, svalpe tv ekāgnividhānam, bhūmipatikartavye karmaṇi grāmādidakṣiṇādānam aśaktakartṛke yathāśakti suvarṇadakṣiṇādānam ity anusaṃdheyam, atha brāhmaṇavācanānantaraṃ devatāpujanavisarjanāni kuryāt | ātharvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇe |
atha rohiṇyāṃ sakalām upoṣito brahma yathābījarasaratnagandhāvakīrṇa- [300] tīrthodakapūrṇakalaśam abhimṛṣṭābhiṣekamantrair yathoktair dātāram abhiṣiñcati vratena tvaṃ vratapata iti vratam upaityāyācitāśanāvadhaḥśāyinau bhavato vratopacāraṃ yathāśakty ekarātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā dvādaśarātraṃ vrataṃ caritvā śvobhūte tantram ājyabhāgāntaṃ kṛtvānvārabhyāthājyaṃ juhuyāt kāmasūktaṃ kāsasūktaṃ puruṣasūktam ity atha suvarṇamayīṃ bhūmiṃ bhūmeḥ pratikṛtiṃ gocarmamātrāṃ kṛtvānīya vedyuttarato ‘syāṃ vedim ity upasthāpya girayas te parvatā iti parvatān avasthāpya hiraṇyarajatamaṇimuktāpravālakādibhir upaśobhayed yad ahaḥ saṃprayatīr iti sāmandasāneti nadīḥ kalpayitvā rasaiś ca paripūrayet aparam agram asi samudraṃ tvābhyavasṛjāmīti samudrān vanaspatiḥ saha devair na śrāyagann iti bṛhaspatir neti vanaspatīn anyāṃś ca yajñe tvā manasā saṃkalpayen manasā saṃkalpavatīha bhavati nidhau bibhartīti namaskārayitvā satyaṃ bṛhaspatyanuvāko ye devāso divvy ekādaśastheti puṇyāhaṃ vācayet saṃsthāpayen na ca divo devajñatenety abhimantrā brāhmaṇebhyo dadyād dātur eṣāsmai rohiṇīkāmaṃ nikāmaṃ vā duḥkha iti |
yathā rohanti bījāni halākṛṣṭe mahītale |
evaṃ kāmāḥ prarohanti pretya hi manasā sadā ||
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ yat phalaṃ samudāhṛtam |
tat prāpnoti ca viprebhyo datvā bhūmiṃ yathāvidhi ||
atha matsyapurāṇe |
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyād dhemadharāṃ śubhām |
puṇyakāleti saṃprāpte sa padaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam ||
[301]        vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkaṇījālamālinā |
nārāyaṇapuraṃ gatvā kalpatrayam atho vaset ||
putrapautraprapautrāṃś ca tārayed ekaviṃśatim |
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṅgād
api kaluṣavimānair muktadehaḥ samantāt |
divam amaravadhūbhir yāti saṃprārthyamānaḥ |
padam amarasahasraiḥ sevitaṃ candramauleḥ ||
iti dharādānavidhiḥ |
liṅgapurāṇe |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
suvarṇamedinīdānaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ |
pūrvoktadeśakāle tu kārayen munibhiḥ saha ||
lakṣaṇena yathāpūrvaṃ kūpe vā maṇḍape ‘tha vā |
medinīṃ kārayed divyāṃ sahasreṇāpi vā punaḥ ||
ekahastena kartavyā caturasrā suśobhanā |
saptadīpasamudrādyaiḥ parvatair api saṃyutā ||
sarvatīrthanagopetā madhye merusamanvitā |
atha vā madhyato dvīpaṃ navakhaṇḍaṃ prakalpayet ||
pūrvavan nikhilaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍale vedimadhyataḥ |
saptabhāgaikabhāgena sahasrād vidhipūrvakam ||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradātavyā dakṣiṇā pūrvacoditā |
sahasrakalaśādyaiś ca śaṅkaraṃ pūjayec chivam ||
suvarṇamedinī proktā liṅge ‘smin parvataṃ matam ||
munibhiḥ, niyatātmabhir vipraiḥ sahety arthaḥ | [302] sahasreṇa, palānām iti jñeyam, hemnaḥ palasahasreṇetyādi pañcapalād ūrdhvaṃ kuryād iti matsyokteḥ | sā ca ekahastamitā caturasrā saptadvīpavatī kāryā | atha veti pakṣāntaram, svalpadravyābhiprāyaṃ tad evāha saptabhāgaikabhāgena, sahasrād iti sahasrasaptamāṃśena, navakhaṇḍaṃ jambudvīpamātrāṃ kalpayed ity arthaḥ | brāhmaṇebhya iti, bahutvam anekāgnipakṣaviṣayam | pūrvavad iti, liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavad ity arthaḥ | kālottare |
pṛthivīdānam evātra śṛṇu leśena ṣaṇmukha |
uttamā madhyamā kanya pṛthivī trividhā matā ||
śatārdhakoṭivistāyā tūttamā parikīrtitā |
saptadvīpāvasānā tu madhyamā samudāhṛtā ||
jambudvīpāvadhiḥ kanya trividhāṃ parikalpayet |
uttamāḥ pañcabhir bhāraiḥ kāñcanena prakalpayet ||
sahasradvitayenaiva kanya dvādaśaparvatāḥ |
tadardhāt tārajaṃ kūrmaṃ tathā padmaṃ samādiśet ||
dvādaśaparvatās tu kālottaroktaratnamerudāne draṣṭavyāḥ, tārajaṃ rūpyakṛtam |
uttamā kathitā pṛthvī tryaṃśena madhyamā matā |
kanyakātra tribhāgena trihānyā kūrmapaṅkaje ||
ṛgyajuḥsāmagānān tu śivabhakteṣu nikṣipet |
catuṣpādaṣaṭpadārthasaṃhitāpāṭhakāya ca ||
tasya pādaḥ pradātavyaḥ pṛthī kūrmakajeṣu ca |
śeṣeṣu ca yathānyāyaṃ jñānaṃ jñātvā nivedayet ||
sūryasya grahaṇe vatsaṃ śivasyāgre nivedayet |
[303]        meruvat kalpayet tatra parvatāṃś ca trayodaśa ||
sahasreṇa palānān tu tatra meruṃ prakalpayet |
sahasradvitayenaiva kalpyā dvādaśaparvatāḥ ||
catuḥśatasamāyuktāḥ pratyekaṃ tu grahāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tathaiva rāśayaḥ kalpyā nakṣatrāṇi tadardhataḥ ||
dvīpāṃ ca grahavat kalpyā jambusaṃjñādikās tataḥ |
kṣārādyas tu tathā sapta devayonyaṣṭakaṃ tathā ||
mṛgādyāś ca yathā yadvad bhuvo brahmādayas tathā |
pātālasaptakaṃ kalpyaṃ bhūrlokā divasaptakam ||
sahasrakhaṇḍaṃ kūrmaṃ ca navakhaṇḍaṃ kajodbhavam |
evaṃ kalpya śivasyāgre śivavipreṣu dāpayet ||
suvrateṣv ahatāṅgeṣu vedasiddhāntavediṣu |
dātavyā pṛthivī teṣāṃ bahurūpaṃ smaraṃs tathā ||
bahūni aghoravīratarāṇi rūpāṇi yasyāsau bahurūpo aghoramantraḥ |
adhorebhyo ‘tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ |
sarvataḥ śarvasarvebhyo namas te astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ ||
rāhuṇā gṛhyamāṇe tu sūryabimbe tu nirvapet |
evaṃ saṃkalpya vidhivac chivasyāgre pradāpayet ||
paramāṇavo yāvanto brahmāṇḍasya bhavanti hi |
tāvat kalpasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
pitaras tasya nandanti valanti ca yathāsukham |
rudrāyur yāvad ante ca rudraloke vasanti ca ||
[304]        mahībhujas tadante tu śivabhaktyā bhavanti hi |
mokṣaḥ prajāyate teṣāṃ śivabhāvānudīkṣayā ||
iti suvarṇapṛthivīdānavidhiḥ |
sūta uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ munisattamāḥ |
jambudvīpapradānākhyaṃ dānānām uttamottamam ||
yasya pradānān manujo vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āpnuyāt |
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvamaṅgalakārakam ||
ārogyaśrīkaṃ caivam āyurvardhanam uttamam |
bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇām abhīṣṭaphaladaṃ śubham ||
yathāha bhagavān śambhuḥ pṛṣṭaḥ parvatakanyayā |
tathedaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
īśam āsīnam ekānte kailāse himavatsutā |
praṇipatya jagannāthaṃ paryapṛcchata sādarā ||
bhagavan kiṃ naraiḥ kāryaṃ sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇam |
anāyāsena deveśa sarvamaṅgalakārakam ||
ity evamuktaḥ pārvatyā pinākī vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
yathāha bhavavān devyai tat sarvaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ ||
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu devi mahādānaṃ jambudvīpāhvayaṃ tu tat |
yathāha bhagavān adya padmayonir janārdanaḥ ||
puṇyi ‘hni puṇyanakṣatre puṇyakāle tu sarvataḥ |
viṣuvaty ayanādau ca grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
[305]        vyatīpāte ‘tha vā kuryāj janmarkṣe vā viśeṣataḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā nityaṃ vā dānam ācaret ||
puṇyadeśeṣu sarveṣu nadīdevālayādiṣu |
dānaṃ gṛhe vā dātavyaṃ śraddhā vā yatra jāyate ||
vipraṃ tu vedaviduṣaṃ guruṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ |
bhūlepanādi yat kāryaṃ sarvaṃ vipreṇa kārayet ||
vilepayet sarvabhūmiṃ gomayena savāriṇā |
tatra viṃśatihastaṃ tu lepayet parimaṇḍalam ||
lavaṇenodadhiṃ tatra paritaḥ parikalpayet |
prādeśamātraṃ vistārād aṣṭadroṇena pārvati ||
tatrākṣatān nirvikiret śvetapuṣpaiḥ samantataḥ |
tanmadhye kārayen meruṃ dhānyabhāratrayeṇa vai ||
merur mahāvrīhimayas tu madhye
suvarṇakalpadrumasaṃyutaḥ syāt |
pūrveṇa muktāphalavajrayukto
yāmyena gomedakapuṣparāgaiḥ ||
paścāc ca gārutmatanīlaratnaiḥ
saumyena vaidūryasarojarāgaiḥ |
śrīkhaṇḍakhaṇḍair abhitaḥ pravāla-
latānvitaḥ śuktiśilātalaḥ syāt ||
śuklāmbarāṇy ambudharāvalī syāt
pūrveṇa pītāni ca dakṣiṇe tu |
vāsāṃsi paścād atha karburāṇi
[306]                raktāni caivottaratoghanālau ||
brahma tu madhye kamalāsanasthaś
caturmukhaḥ kāñcananirmitāṅgaḥ |
caturbhujaś cātra niveśanīyo
dadhat srucaṃ cātra kamaṇḍaluṃ ca ||
tathākṣasūtraṃ japasādhanaṃ ca
kṛṣṇājinaṃ coparitaś ca bibhrat |
gaṅgāṃ caturdhā patitān nidhāya
caturdiśaṃ codakapūrṇarūpām ||
raupyān mahendraprabhṛtīn athāṣṭau
saṃsthāpya lokādhipatīn krameṇa |
nānādvijaughāni ca rājatāni
mṛgāś ca sarvatra niveśanīyāḥ ||
pūrveṇa mandaragirir yavataṇḍulābhyām
śuklāmbareṇa paritaḥ pariveṣṭitāntaḥ |
plakṣeṇa kāñcanamayena vṛṣeṇa tadvad
rāupyeṇa vṛkṣamṛgapakṣiyuto vidheyaḥ ||
yāmyena jambutaruṇā ca hiraṇmayena
mudgaiś ca jambutaruṇā ca hiraṇmayena |
haimena yakṣapatinā ca virājamānaḥ
pītāmbareṇa paritaḥ pariveṣṭitaś ca ||
paścāt tilācalam athopari karburābhaṃ
vāsaḥ sapippalahiraṇmayahaṃsayuktam |
[307]        ākārayed vipulamandrasugandhapuṣpam
raupyeṇa śaktighaṭitena virājamānam ||
saṃsthāpya taṃ vipulaśailam athottareṇa
śailaṃ supārśvam api māṣamayaṃ suvastram |
nyagrodhavṛkṣaṃ api hemamayaṃ sudhenum
raupyaiś ca śaktighaṭitaiś ca subhaṃ vidhāy ||
meroś ca puṣpābharaṇaṃ ca kāryam
ghṛtodakaṃ praśravaṇaṃ ca dikṣu |
kṣīrājyadadhnā madhunā sarāṃsi
prāgādi teṣāṃ ca yathākrameṇa ||
himahemakūṭaniṣadhāḥ kramaś ca yājye
saumye ca nīlasitaśṛṅgayutāḥ krameṇa |
prādeśamātraṃ parinisṛtās te
prāgāyatā hy upari vastrayutāś ca sarve ||
pratyekam atra varṣacchadaparvatānām
bhāreṇa dhānyaparimāṇam uśanti santaḥ |
śaktyā ca raupyakṛtapakṣiyutāś ca sarve
saugandhipuṣpaphalavastrayugā vidheyāḥ ||
ānīlaniṣadhāyāsau mālyavad gandhamādanau |
teṣāṃ madhyagato merus tau ca dhānyavinirmitau ||
niṣadhaḥ pārijātaś ca maryādāparvatāv imau |
meroḥ pañcamabhāgena yathā tau gandhamādanau ||
[308]        gandhamādanaśailo ‘sau pūrvapaścād yathāvidhau |
śvetataṇḍulanirmāṇau dakṣiṇottarataḥ sthitau ||
sitāntaḥpramukhāḥ sarve dakṣiṇe kakubhādayaḥ |
śaṅkhakūṭādayaś caiva uttare parikīrtitāḥ ||
tāṃs trīn keśaraśailāṃś ca kṛtvā dhānyamayān śubhān |
vastrair āveṣṭya śailendraṃ merumanyāṃś ca veṣṭayet ||
dakṣiṇaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tat kiṃpuruṣasaṃvṛtam |
harivarṣaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ meror dakṣiṇatas tataḥ ||
ilāvṛtaṃ vṛtaṃ meroś caturthaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā |
ramyaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ tasmāt kuravaś ceti cottarāḥ ||
bhadrāśvaḥ ketumālaś ca pūrvapaścimataḥ sthitau |
proktāni navavarṣāṇi jambudvīpe tu nāmataḥ ||
himādrimadhye deveśaṃ śriyaṃ ca viniveśayet |
prāsādābhimukhāv etau kāñcanena vinirmitau ||
śaṅkhacakrapāṇiṃ pītavāsasam acyutam |
kirīṭakeyūradharaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam ||
padmāsane samāsīnāṃ padmahastāṃ sulocanām |
prasannavadanāṃ devīṃ tasya dakṣiṇato nyaset ||
kailāsamadhyato māñca tvāṃ caiva viniveśayet |
māṃ ca śaṅkaranāmānaṃ tvāṃ ca gaurīṃ varānane ||
caturbhujaṃ vṛṣasthaṃ ca jaṭilaṃ candramaulinam |
khaṭvāṅgaśūlavaradābhayahataṃ ca māṃ nyaset ||
madutsaṅgagatāṃ tvāṃ ca darpaṇe dīvarānvitām |
[309]        bhadrāsane bhagavantaṃ hayarūpamukhaṃ harim ||
sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayed devaṃ bhārate kūrmarūpiṇam |
vārāhaṃ ketumālaṃ vai matsyaṃ kuruṣu cottare ||
sauvarṇānn atha vā raupyān sthāpayet tu yathākramam |
evaṃ jambvāhvayaṃ dvīpaṃ kṛtvā caiva yathāvidhi ||
ardhapādyāsanaṃ snānaṃ yathāvat sthāpanaṃ kramāt |
brahmādayas tathā devāḥ śailāḥ kalpadrumās tathā ||
svanāmamantraiḥ pūjārhā namaskārāntadīpitaiḥ |
gandhapuṣpanamaskāradhūpadīpaphalais tathā ||
tathopaharaṇādyaiś ca pūjayitvā prayatnataḥ |
bhadrāśvavarṣe homaṃ tu sarpiṣā ca samācaret ||
svanāmamantrair hotavyaṃ svāhākārasamāyutaiḥ |
daśottaraśataṃ hutvā brahmaṇe merave tathā ||
itareṣāṃ ca sarveṣām aṣṭottaraśatāhutīh |
snānārthaṃ yajamānasya purataḥ kalaśaṃ nyaset ||
āḍhakodarapūrṇaṃ tu svakūrcaṃ vastraveṣṭitam |
gandhāḥ sumanasas tasya kuśāgrān viniveśayet ||
yāś ca śreyo vidhāsyanti tāś cātrāvāhayet tataḥ |
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāś ca sarāṃsi ca ||
āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ |
ity āvāhya tatas tasya kalaśaṃ vimalodakam ||
[310]        abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ sthāpayet prītipūrvakam |
snāpayet prāṅmukhaṃ tatra dātāraṃ kalaśodakaiḥ ||
ṛgbhir varuṇadevībhiḥ pāvamānībhir eva ca |
dānakāle ca saṃprāpte dātā nārī naro ‘tha vā ||
snāpito guruṇā tena sārdhaṃ dānaṃ samācaret |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
pratyekaṃ parvān sarvān praṇipatya puraḥsaram |
madhyamaṃ gurave dadyād imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
anyasmai vā pradātavyaṃ tasyānujñām avāpya ca |
yathā ca bhūrādisamastalokās
tvayi sthitā bhūdhararāja nityam |
amī surā asurā lokanāthā
brahmādayo devagaṇāś ca nityam ||
tvatsaṃpradānād aham apy aśeṣaiḥ
pāpair vimuktas tu yathā bhaveyam |
śreyas tathā parvatarājamahyaṃ
kuru prabho devavaraiś ca sārdham ||
itīdam uktvā pradadet tu meruṃ
sakāñcanaṃ rājatavastrayugmam |
pratyekam ekaṃ dvijapuṅgavānām
prāgādi dadyād itarān krameṇa ||
surāsurāṇām amṛtārthakṛtyai
tvayā kṛtaṃ mandaraśaila satya |
[311]        tathā ca māṃ rakṣa ca sarvatas tvaṃ
tava prasādād vijarā yathāham ||
gandhādrimādana itīritabhūdharendra
vede tavāpi garuḍāya namo ‘stu tubhyam |
tvatsaṃpradānahatapāpasamastadoṣaṃ
chāyādhiśailavara rakṣa ca mām ajasram ||
devālayāya vipulāya namo ‘calāya
haṃsāya vedapuruṣāya namo ‘cyutāya |
yuṣmatpradānanihatākhilapāparāśiṃ
haṃsena sārdham amarācala pāhi māṃ tvam ||
vande supārśvam amarācalam aprameyaṃ
dhenuṃ ca devasurabhiṃ praṇato ‘smi nityam |
tvaddānabhaktiyutasatkriyayāham adya
tvām eva yāmi śaraṇārtham avaihi māṃ tvam ||
śrīvatsavakṣasam anādim ajaṃ samasta-
lokādhipaṃ sakalakāraṇam acyutaṃ ca |
nārāyaṇaṃ śaraṇam emi dharādharendaiḥ
sārdhaṃ śriyā himavataḥ sthitim ādim īḍe ||
devāya devagaṇapūjitapādapadma-
yugmāya bhaktajanaduḥkhavināśanāya |
kailāśaśailanilayāya bhavāya nityaṃ
gaurīpriyāya vardāya namaḥ śivāya ||
cakrī tv anādinidhanaḥ śaraṇāgataṃ māṃ
[312]                bhadrāśvanāmanigato harir acyuto ‘sau |
āste ha nātha na vapuḥsanakādiyogi-
pūgair abhiṣṭutapurātanakīrtiyuktaḥ ||
madhye mahārṇavahimācalayor niṣanna-
kūrmākṛtiṃ śaraṇam emi bhavābhavāya |
pārāvaraṃ mathitam atra sadā dadhāti
yas tvaṃ namāmi surapūjitam aprameyam ||
vārāharūpiṇam anantam anantaketum
lokasvarūpiṇam anekaśirokṣipādam |
vande mahīdharam ameyam apārakīrtiṃ
yajñeśam emi śaraṇaṃ haram īśitāram ||
devas tathottarakuruṣv api nityam āste
matsyaḥ surendragaṇapūjitapādapadma |
rakṣa tv aśeṣajagatāṃ patir acyuto ‘sau
saṃsāraduḥkhacalitaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ mām ||
uktvaiva mātram aghanāśanadānamantraṃ
pratyekam ekaṃ dvijapuṅgavānām |
bhuktvā śubhāni manasecchati yāni vāsau
gacchec ca yatra na nivartayatīha martyaḥ ||
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt suvarṇaṃ caiva vāsasī |
yāgopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ gurave vinivedayet ||
ity āha bhagavān prītaḥ pārvatyā parameśvaraḥ |
aham apy abruvai sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
[313]
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇokto jambudvīpadānavidhiḥ
brahmā uvāca |
śṛṇu deva mune dānaṃ saptadvīpāhvayaṃ ca tat |
tat kṛtvā pṛthivīdānaphalaṃ sarvam upāśnute ||
puṇyakāleṣu sarveṣu candrasūryagrahādiṣu |
devāgārādideśeṣu puṇyeṣv āyataneṣu ca ||
vipraṃ guruṃ vedavidaṃ ca dakṣaṃ
vidyāpradaṃ vṛṇuyāt tatra pūrvam |
sa kārayec chaivatadaṅgakāryam
ṛte dānaṃ guruṇānena sarvam ||
samāṃ bhūmiṃ limpayed gomayena
savāriṇā śuci tatrāpi madhye |
kṛtvā dvīpaṃ jambusaṃjñaṃ yathāvat
tadbāhye ca plakṣanāmā nibaddhaḥ ||
ambuplakṣāhvayo dvīpo śālmalaś ca tathāparaḥ |
kuśaḥ krauñcaś ca śākaś ca puṣkaraś caiva saptamaḥ ||
ete dvīpāḥ samudraiś ca saptasaptabhir āvṛtāḥ |
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalaiḥ samam ||
jambudvīpaḥ samastānām eteṣāṃ madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tasyāpi merur devarṣe madhye kanakaparvataḥ ||
plakṣadvīpasya vistāraḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgula iṣyate |
pādādhikas tathānyeṣām uttarottaram ucyate ||
ṣoḍaśadroṇadhānyaiś ca plakṣadvīpaṃ prakalpayet |
[314]        tataḥ pādādhikaṃ proktam anyeṣām uttarottaram ||
vistāra eṣa dvīpānām udadhīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
plakṣādipañcadvīpeṣu varṣabhūdharanimnagāḥ |
pratyekaṃ sapta sapta syuḥ śvetataṇḍulanirmitāḥ ||
puṣkare bhūdharaṃ tv ekaṃ madhyato valayākṛtim |
varṣadvayaṃ tathā cānyan nāmataḥ śrūyatāṃ mune ||
plakṣe śāntamayaṃ varṣaṃ śiśiraṃ sukhadaṃ tathā |
ānandaṃ ca śivaṃ caiva kṣemakṛt sukham eva ca ||
gomedaparvataś cāndro nārado dundubhis tathā |
somakaḥ sumanāś caiva vaibhrājaḥ sapta parvatāḥ ||
anutaptā śivā cāpi ambikā tridivī kramāt |
amṛtā sukṛtā caiva saptaitās tatra nimnagāḥ ||
plakṣaṃ tu prathame varṣe madhyato viniveśayet |
palena vā yathāśakti tadardhena vinirmitam ||
tatpārśve devadeveśaṃ sarvalokaguruṃ harim |
somarūpadharaṃ devaṃ sauvarṇaṃ viniveśayet ||
śvetau haritalībhūtau rohito vaidyutas tathā |
narmataḥ suprabhaḥ sapta varṣāṇy ete ca parvatāḥ ||
kumudaś codanaś caiva tṛtīyaś ca valāhakaḥ |
kaṅkaś ca mahiṣaś caiva kakudmān saptamo giriḥ ||
yonis toyā vitṛṣṇā ca candrā śuklā ca mocanī |
vivṛttiḥ sapta nadyaś ca śālmale parikīrtitāḥ ||
udbhido veṇumāṃś caiva suratno lavaṇo dhṛtiḥ |
[315]        prabhākaraś ca kapilaḥ parvatān śṛṇu nārada ||
maṇidrumo haimaśailo dyutimān puṣpavāṃs tathā |
kuśoghamaś ca harito mandaraḥ saptamas tathā ||
dhūtapāpā śivā cāpi pavitrā śamitā tathā |
dyudambhā mahiṣī caiva sarvapāpaharā tathā ||
kuśastambaṃ kuśadvīpe krauñce caitān nibodha me |
varṣāṇi bhūdharāś caiva viṣṇuś ca para eva ca ||
andhakāro muniś caiva dandubhiḥ saptamas tathā |
krauñcaś ca vāmanaś caiva andhakāro ‘tha pañcamaḥ ||
puṇḍarīko dundubhiś ca saptaite syur ihācalāḥ |
gaurī kumārī saṃdhyā ca rātriś caiva manojavā ||
yakṣādiḥ puṇḍarīkaś ca sapta sapta udāhṛtāḥ |
śākamadhye śākavṛkṣo varṣaplakṣe ca nimnagāḥ ||
sapta sapta ca devarṣe śrūyatāṃ gadato mama |
jaladaś ca kumāraś ca sukumāro maṇīcakaḥ ||
kusumottamamodaś ca saptamaś ca mahādrumaḥ |
udayo jaladhāraś ca raivataś cānuparvatāḥ ||
pañcamo ‘bhragiriḥ śailo ambikā kesarī tathā |
sukumārī kumārī ca nalinī veṇukā tathā ||
indukā reṇukā caiva gabhastiḥ saptamī tathā |
puṣkare tu mahāpadmo dhātakīti prakīrtitau ||
madhyato valayākārau mānaso ‘tra ca parvatāḥ |
nyagrodhavṛkṣaḥ pūrveṣu brahmaṇaḥ sthānam ucyate ||
[316]        saptamaḥ puṣkaradvīpaḥ tadvad eva samāvṛtaḥ |
evaṃ dvīpāḥ samudraiś ca saptasaptabhir āvṛtāḥ ||
dvīpaiś caiva samudraiś ca samānā dviguṇā pare |
dvīpamānān drumān sarvān rājatān viniveśayet ||
tathā pakṣimṛgān matsyān parvatodadhiṣ kṣipet |
jambudvīpādhipaṃ viṣṇuṃ tatra caiva niveśayet ||
plakṣe somaṃ śālmale vāyurūpaṃ
kuśadvīpe brahmarūpaṃ purāṇam |
krauñce rudraṃ śākasaṃjñe ‘tha sūryaṃ
brāhmaṃ rūpaṃ puṣkare deva devaṃ ||
kṛtvā caikaṃ bahudhā cārumūrtiṃ
hiranyajaṃ jagatām īśam ādyam |
prakṣālya pūtena jalena mantraiḥ
saṃprokṣya darbhaiś ca nidhāya devān ||
saṃveṣṭya vastraiś ca dharādharendrān
samantato vikiret puṣpavṛṣṭyā |
arghādibhir havyayutaiś ca hastaiḥ
saṃpūjya meruṃ pramathāṃś ca sarvān ||
svanāmamantraiś ca namoyutaiś ca
svāhāyutaiḥ pūrvavad dhomamantraḥ |
yathā puro tatra tathaiva kuryād
evādhiśailendravanaspatīnām ||
pūrvedyur eva vidhinā samāpya
[317]                gurus ca tatrādhivasen niśāyām |
niśāsu vedānumatas tathaiva
vastrādidānaṃ ca tataḥ krameṇa ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale tu dāna-
kale tadā snāpito dhautavastraḥ |
yathā pūrvaṃ jambusaṃjñasya coktaṃ
tathā dānaṃ sādaraṃ kārayitvā ||
tato viprān pūjya teṣāṃ krameṇa
tāṃ dāpayen mantrapūrvaṃ tathaiva |
somaṃ vāyuṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca candraṃ
tathā sūryaṃ brahmaṇo rūpam ādyam ||
vīrudhauṣadhivṛkṣāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ jagatāṃ prabhoḥ |
āhnād ajanano yasmāt tasmāt tvaṃ pāhi māṃ sadā ||
antar bahiś ca tat sarvaṃ vyāpya yojayati sthitaḥ |
sadā gatir ameyātmā rakṣa tvaṃ vyāhṛtas tu mām ||
yaḥ kartā jagatāṃ pātā brahmalokapitāmahaḥ |
tvatsaṃpradānād deveśa śreyaś cāstu sadā mama ||
rakṣārthaṃ devadevānāṃ jagatām api śaṅkara |
tvayā tu tripuraṃ dagdhaṃ sadā me saṃprasīda tat ||
udety astamanaṃ yāti nityaṃ pāti jagattrayam |
pratyakṣaṃ sarvalokānāṃ yo ‘sau me saṃprasīdatu ||
sṛṣṭisthitivināśānāṃ kāraṇaṃ jagatām asau |
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān sadā me saṃprasīdatu ||
[318]        ity evam eva vidhibhir dvija puṅgavānām
pratyekam ekaṃ ca yathā krameṇa |
dadyāt tadā gurave dakṣiṇāṃ ca
vāsaḥ suvarṇād adhikaṃ suvarṇam ||
kṛtvā saptadvīpaparyantabhūmiṃ
datvā devān jātarūpān krameṇa |
dadyāt tasmai gurave dānaśeṣaṃ
sāṅgo ‘pāṃgan dhānyavastrādi sarvam ||
ādāv ante pañcabhir vipravaryaiḥ

dakṣiṇāvartaśaṅghāś ca rocanā candanaṃ tathā |
muktāphalaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca chatraṃ cāmaram eva ca |
ādarśaś ceti vijñeyaṃ maṅgalyaṃ maṅgalāvaham ||
antarāntara iti pūrvoktiḥ, sarvair eva saṃbadhyate antarāṇām antaro madhyadeśa ity arthaḥ aṣṭamāvaraṇe tu pūrvoktān brahmādīn ṣoḍaśadevān vinyased iti dānavivekakāraḥ | abhīṣṭadevān vinyased iti kecit | ete ca devatāviśeṣā viśvacakranirmāṇārtham avakḷptasyaiva suvarṇasya madhyataś cakrārūḍhā niṣpādanīyāḥ na pṛthak suvarṇena tathāvidhasyaiva cakrasya kāryatayopadeśāt |
tulāpuruṣavac cheṣaṃ samantāt parikalpayet |
ṛtviṅmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ||
viśvacakraṃ tataḥ kuryāt kṛṣṇājinatilopari |
tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni rasāṃś ca lavaṇādikān ||
pūrṇakumbhāṣṭakaṃ caiva vastrāṇi vividhāni ca |
mālyekṣuphalaratnāni vitānaṃ vāpi kārayet ||
atrādiśabdena vṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūja[332]brāhmaṇavācanādhivāsanādīni saṃgṛhyante |
bhaviṣyottare |
adhivāsya tataś cakraṃ paścād dhomaṃ samācaret |
cātuścaraṇikāsūtrabrāhmaṇāś caturo ‘ṣṭa vā ||
homaṃ kuryur yatātmāno vastrābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
homadravyasamopetāḥ sruksruvais tāmrabhājanaiḥ ||
cakrapratiṣṭhitānāṃ tu surāṇāṃ homa iṣyate |
talliṅgair juhuyān mantraiḥ sarvopadravaśāntaye ||
matsyapurāṇe |
tato maṅgalaśabdena snātaḥ śuklāmbaro gṛhī |
homādhivāsanānteṣu gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
imam uccārayen mantraṃ triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇam |
namo viśvamāyāyeti viśvacakrātmane namaḥ ||
paramānandarūpī tvaṃ pāhi saṃsārakardamāt |
tejomayam idaṃ yasmāt sadā paśyanti yoginaḥ ||
hṛdi tattvaṃ guṇātītaṃ viśvacakraṃ namāmy aham |
vāsudeve sthitaṃ cakraṃ cakramadhye ca mādhavaḥ ||
anyonyādhārarūpeṇa praṇamāmi sthitāv iha |
viśvacakram idaṃ yasmāt sarvapāpaharaṃ param ||
āyudhaṃ cādhivāsasya bhavād uddhara mām ataḥ |
ity āmantrya ca yo dadyād viśvacakraṃ vimatsaraḥ ||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
[333]        vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ samāsādya caturbāhuḥ sanātanaḥ |
sevyate ‘psarasāṃ saṅghais tiṣṭhet kalpaśatatrayam ||
atrāpi pūrvavad dānavākyam abhidhāya, yathāśakti suvarṇadakṣiṇāsahitaṃ jalapūrṇam ācāryāsibhyaḥ saṃpradānapratipādanaṃ tadanujñayānyebhyo ‘pi dānam dīnānāthatarpaṇaṃ svalpe tv ekāṅnividhānam ṛtvigācāryāṇāṃ vibhāgavyavasthā ceti sarvaṃ prakṛtivad anuṣṭheyam, tataḥ puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanāni kuryāt |
praṇamed vā svayaṃ kṛtvā viśvacakraṃ dine dine |
tasyāyur vardhate nityaṃ lakṣmīś ca vipulā bhavet ||
iti sakalajagatsurādhivāsam
vitarati yas tapanīyaṣoḍaśāram |
haribhuvanam upāgataḥ sasiddhaiś
ciram adhigamya namasyate śirobhiḥ ||
asudarśanatāṃ prayāti śatror
madanasudarśanāṃ ca kāminīnām |
sasudarśanakeśavānurūpaḥ
kanakasudarśanadānadagdhapāpaḥ ||
kṛtaguruduritāni ṣoḍaśāra-
pravarasudarśanāntā nirasya |
vrajati ca samurāridhāma bhittvā
bhavamatitya bhuvane bhatvā na (?) bhūyaḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇokto viśvacakradānavidhiḥ |

atha kalpalatābhidhānaṃ trayodaṃ mahādānam upavarṇyate |
matsya uvāca |

ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam |

ādiśabdavyākhyānaṃ pūrvavat |
cāmīkaramayīḥ kuryāt daśakalpalatāḥ śubhāḥ |
