vidyādharasuparṇānāṃ mithunair upaśobhitāḥ |
haronāditsubhiḥ siddhaiḥ phalāni ca vihaṅgamaiḥ ||
nānāphalāni, puṃstrīgogajavājiprabhṛtīni, svarūpapuṣpaphalānāṃ tulanārthatvenaivopapatteḥ | aṃśukāni vastrāṇi | suparṇāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ | evaṃ daśakalpalatāṃ vidhāya vedikāyām likhitacakrasyopari madhye dvayaṃ pūrvādidiṣu cāṣṭau sthāpayet |
lokapālānusāriṇyaḥ kartavyās tāsu devatāḥ |
brāhmīm anantaśaktiṃ ca lavaṇasyopari nyaset |
adhastāc ca tayor madhye padmaśaṅkhakare śubhe ||
[335] lokapālānusāruṇyo devatāḥ, lokapālaśaktaya ity arthaḥ | adhastāc ca tayor iti, madhyasthāpitayoḥ kalpalatayor adhastāt padmākārāṃ brāhmīm, śaṅhadharām anantaśaktiṃ ca sthāpayet | lavaṇādiparimāṇaṃ ca, parimāṇaviśeṣānirdeśāt puruṣecchayā niyamyate | lavaṇaṃ stūpayor nyasyed iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ tatra stūpo rāśiḥ dvivacanaṃ rāśidvyāpekṣayeti |
ibhāsanasthā tu guḍe pūrvataḥ kuliśāyudhā |
rajanyajasthitāgneyostuhīpāṇirathānale (?) ||
pāmyāmahiṣam (?) ārūḍhā gadinī tandulopari |
ghṛtena nairṛtau sthāpyā sakhaḍgā dakṣiṇāpare ||
vāruṇe vāruṇī kṣīre jhaṣasthā nāgapāśiṇī |
patākinī ca vāyavye mṛgasthā śarkaropari ||
saumyānileṣu saṃsthāpyā śaṅkhinī nidhisaṃsthitā |
māheśvarī vṛṣagatā tvīśapāṇiḥ triśūlinī ||
ibho gajaḥ sa ca caturdano vidheyaḥ, kuliśaṃ vajram, rajanyajasthiteti, rajanī haridrā, ajaḥ chāgaḥ, haridroparisthāpitā chāgavāhanety arthaḥ, anale āgneyadigbhāge, dakṣiṇāpare nairṛtadigbhāge naiṛtīpretavāhanety avadheyaṃ jaṣasthāmakaravāhanety arthaḥ | nidhisaṃsthiteti nidhirūpaṃ kalaśānukāri |
maulinyo varadās tadvat kartavyā vālikānvitāḥ |
śaktyā pañcapalād ūrdhvam ā sahasrāt prakalpayet ||
sarvāsām upariṣṭāc ca pañcavarṇaṃ vitānakam |
dhenavo daśakumbhāś ca vastrayugmāni caiva hi ||
[336] maulinyo mukutadharāḥ, varadā iti, yathoktāyudhadhāriṇaḥ karāditareṇa kareṇa varadamudrānvitā ity arthaḥ | vālikā karṇabhūṣaṇaṃ, vālakānvitā iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ | tadā vāmotsaṅgasthitavālakā iti vyākhyā | etac ca pañcapalādiparimitakalpalatākaraṇopa-kḷptasuvarṇenaiva vibhajya sarvaṃ kartavyam, pṛthakdravyeṇa kartavyānupadeśāt |
madhyamadve tu gurave ṛtvigbhyo ‘nyās tathaiva ca |
tato maṅgalaśabdena snātaḥ śuklāmbaro budhaḥ |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya mantrān etān udīrayet ||
tata iti homādhivāsanapuṇyāhavācanādipūrvoktakarmakalāpānantaryam ucyate | snāta iti kuṇḍasamīpavartikalaśasthitasarvauṣadhijalena ṛtvigbhiḥ snāpitaḥ, gṛhītakusumāñjalir ity api jñeyam | atha mantraḥ |
namo namaḥ pāpavināśiṇībhyo
brahmāṇḍalokeśvarapālanībhyaḥ |
āśaṃsitādhikyaphalapradābhyo
digbhyas tathākalpalatāvadhūbhyaḥ ||
atha pūrvavat prayogam uccārya madhyame dve devatādisahite kalpalate gurave pratipādya śeṣā ṛtvigbhyaḥ pratipādayet | tadanujñayā anyebhyo ‘pi dānaṃ dīnā nātha pūraṇam, svalpe tv ekāgnividhānaṃ ceti pūrvoktam anusaṃdheyam | tataḥ puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanāni kuryāt |
iti sakaladigaṅganāpradānaṃ
bhavabhayasūdanakāri yaḥ karoti |
[337]        abhimataphalade na nākaloke
vasati pitāmahavatsarāṇi triṃśat ||
abhimataphalade iṣṭaphaladāyini |
pitṛśatam avatārayed bhavābdheḥ
sa ca duritaughavināśaśuddhadeśaḥ |
surapativanitāsahasrasaṃkhyaiḥ
parivṛtam ambujasaṃsadābhivandyaḥ ||
iti vidhānam idaṃ sadigaṅganā
kanakakalpalatāvinivedane |
paṭhati yaḥ smaratīha tadīkṣate
sa padam eti purandarasevitam ||
iti matsyapurānoktaḥ kalpalatādānavidhiḥ |
atha saptasāgarasaṃjñaṃ caturdaśaṃ mahādānam ākhyāyate |
matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādānam uttamam |
saptasāgarakaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam ||
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
tulāpuruṣavat kuryāl lokeśāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ ||
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam |
ādiśabdena vṛddhiśrāddhapuṇyāhavācanādi |
kārayet saptakuṇḍāni kāñcanāni vicakṣaṇaḥ |
prādeśamātrāṇi tathāratnimātrāṇi vā punaḥ ||
[338]        kuryāt saptpalād ūrdhvam ā sahasrāc ca śaktitaḥ |
saṃsthāpyāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇājinatilopari ||
kuṇḍāni bhāṇḍāni, prādeśādiparimāṇam, tiryāgūrdhvaparijñeyam | ekviṃśatyaṅguṣṭhaparva-parimito ‘ratniḥ tadardhaṃ prādeśaḥ, tilā droṇaparimāṇāḥ sauvarṇasaṃpradeyāśayāṇāṃ kṛṣṇājinasaṃbandhināṃ teṣāṃ tathā vyāptidarśanāt |
prathamaṃ pūrayet kuṇḍaṃ lavaṇena vicakṣaṇaḥ |
dvitīyaṃ payasā tadvat tṛtīyaṃ sarpiṣā punaḥ ||
caturthaṃ tu guḍenaiva dadhnā pañcamam eva ca |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ śarkarayā tadvat saptamaṃ tīrthavāriṇā ||
sthāpayel lavaṇasyānte brahmāṇaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubham |
keśavaṃ kṣīramadhye tu ghṛtamadhye maheśvaram ||
bhāskaraṃ guḍamadhye tu dadhimadhye surādhipam |
śarkarāyāṃ nyasel lakṣmīṃ jalamadhye tu pārvatīm ||
sarveṣu sarvaratnāni dhānyāni ca samantataḥ |
brahmādipratimālakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne sarvaratnāni sarvadhānyāni ca paribhāṣāyām |
tulāpuruṣvac cheṣam atrāpi parikalpayet |
tato vāruṇahomānte snāpito vedapuṅgavaiḥ |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya mantrān etān udāharet ||
śeṣaśabdena puṇyāhavācanam ācāryādibhyo jalapūrvoktaṃ dānam | tadanujñayātrānyebhyo ‘pi dānaṃ dīnānāthatarpaṇam, svalpeṣv ekāgnividhānam ityādy anusaṃdheyam | ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ, dvitīyadivase tulāpuru[339]ṣoktakarmaśeṣasamāptau pūrṇāhuteḥ pūrvam ājyatilais talliṅgamantreṇa sahasrasaṃkhyo vāruṇahomaḥ kartavyaḥ |
namo vaḥ sarvasindhūnām ādhārebhyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
jantūnāṃ prāṇadebhyaś ca samudrebhyo namo namaḥ ||
kṣīrodakājyadadhimādhavalāvaṇekṣu-
sārāmṛtena bhuvanatrayajīvasaṅghān |
ānandayanti vasubhiś ca yato bhavantas
tasmān mamāpy aghavināśam alaṃvidadhvam ||
yasmāt samastabhuvaneṣu bhavanta eva
tīrthāmarāsurasubaddhamaṇipratānam |
pāpakṣayāmbaravilepanabhūṣaṇāya
lokasya bibhrati tad astu mamāpi lakṣmīḥ ||
tato yathā śaktidakṣiṇāsahitasaṃpradānānte pūrvavat puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanāni kuryāt |
iti dadati rasāmarasaṃyutān
suciravismayavān iha sāgarān |
amalakāñcanavarṇamayān asau
padam upaiti harer amarāvṛtaḥ ||
sakalapāpavighātavirājitaḥ
pitṛpitāmahaputrakalatrakam |
narakalokasamākulam apy alam
ṛg iti so ‘rpayate śivamandiram ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaḥ saptasāgaradānavidhiḥ |
[340]
atha ratnadhenusamākhyaṃ pañcadaśamahācanaṃ pratipādyate | matsyapurāṇe |
matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādānam anuttamam |
ratnadhenu iti khyātaṃ golokaphalaṃ nṛṇām ||
puṇyāṃ tithim athāsādya tulāpuruṣadānavat |
lokeśāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā tato dhenuṃ prakalpayet ||
bhūmau kṛṣṇājinaṃ kṛtvā lavaṇadroṇasaṃyutam |
dhenuṃ ratnamayīṃ kuryāt saṃkalpya vidhipūrvakam ||
lokeśāvāhanam ity upalakṣaṇam | atra hi deśakālavṛddhiśrāddhaśivādipūjābrahmaṇavācana-guruṛtvigvaraṇamadhuparkadānakuṇḍamaṇḍapavedikācakralekhanavitānatoraṇapatākādikaṃ matsyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavihitaṃ saṃgṛhyate dhenuṃ prakalpayed iti lavaṇādroṇopari prāṅmukhīm udakyādārekhābhiḥ savatsāṅgavākṛtiṃ racayed ity arthaḥ |
sthāpayet padmarāgāṇām ekāśītiṃ mukhe budhaḥ |
puṣparāgaśataṃ tadvad ghoṇāyāṃ parikalpayet |
lalāṭe hematilakaṃ muktāphalaśataṃ dṛśoḥ ||
ghoṇāyāṃ nāsikāgrabhāge, hematilakādiṣu, sārataḥ, parimāṇataś ca phalaviśeṣe iti nyāyāt jñāyate, yathāśakty anuṣṭhānaṃ muktāphalaśataṃ netradvaye vibhajya sthāpanīyam |
bhrūyuge vidrumaśataṃ śuktī karṇadvaye sthite |
kāñcanāni ca śṛṅgāṇi śiro vajraśatātmakam ||
śṛṅgāṇīti vatsaśṛṅgāpekṣayā bahucavanam |
[341]        grīvāyāṃ netrapaṭṭakaṃ gomedakaśatātmakam |
indranīlaśataṃ pṛṣṭhe vaidūryaśatapārśvake ||
sphaṭikair udaraṃ tadvat saugandhikaśatāt kaṭim |
khurā hemamayāḥ kāryāḥ pucchakaṃ muktāvalīmayam ||
sphaṭikair it yatra sāhacaryāt tadvad iti vacanāc chatasaṃkhyair ity avadheyam, saugandhikam, māṇikyaviśeṣaḥ, muktāphalānām api śatasaṃkhyatvam avadheyam |
sūryakāntendukantau ca ghrāṇe karpūracandanam |
kuṅkumāni ca romāṇi raupyāṃ nābhiṃ ca kārayet ||
gārutmataśataṃ tadvad apāne parikalpayet |
tathānyāni ca ratnāni sthāpayet sarvasaṃdhiṣu ||
anyāni māṇikyādīni yathāśakti yathālābhaṃ sthāpayet |
kuryāt śarkarayā jihvāṃ gomayaṃ ca guḍātmakam |
gomūtram ājyena tathā dadhidugdhaṃ svarūpataḥ ||
pucchāgre cāmaraṃ dadyāt samīpe tāmradohanam |
kuṇḍalāni ca haimāni bhūṣaṇāni ca śaktitaḥ |
kārayed evam evaṃ tu caturthāṃśena vatsakam ||
evam evam iti etair eva dhenūktai ratnādidravyair ity arthaḥ |
tathā sarvāṇi dhānyāni pādāś cekṣumayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
nānāphalāni sarvāṇi pañcavarṇavitānakam ||
evaṃ viracanāṃ kṛtvā tadvad dhomādhivāsanam |
ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ datvā dhenum āmantrayed budhaḥ ||
guḍadhenuvad āmantrya idaṃ codaharet tataḥ ||
[342] tadvad iti matyapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavad ity arthaḥ | sarvauṣadhisnānādikam api tadvad eva jñeyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datveti kramo ‘trāvivakṣitaḥ, dakṣiṇā cātra yathāśakti suvarṇam, nṛpakartṛke tu dāne grāmaratnādaya iti guḍadhenuvad yā lakṣmīr ityādimantraiḥ |
tvāṃ sarvadevagaṇadhāma yatah paṭhanti
rudrendraviṣṇukamalāsanavāsudevāḥ |
tasmāt samastabhuvanatrayadevayuktā
māṃ pāhi devi bhavasāgarapīḍyamānam ||
āmantrya vettham abhitaḥ parivṛtya bhaktyā
dadyād dvijāya gurave jalapūrvakantām |
yaḥ puṇyam āpya dinam atra kṛtopavāsaḥ
pāpair vimuktatanur eti padaṃ murāreḥ ||
parivṛtya, padakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjalir ity api jñeyam | kṛtopavāsatvam adhivāsanadine, aśaktau tu naktam ity uktaṃ gurave dadyād ity ekāgnipakṣaviṣayam | anekāgnipakṣe tu tulāpuruṣavad vyavasthā dānānānantaraṃ pūrvavat puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjanavisarjanāni kuryāt |
iti sakalavidhijño ratnadhenupradānam
vitarati sa vimānaṃ prāpya dedīpyamānam |
sakalakaluṣamukto bandhubhiḥ putrapautraiḥ
sahamadanasurūpaḥ sthānam abhyeti śambhoḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇokto ratnadhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha mahābhūtaghaṭaśabditaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ mahādānam iha nirūpyate |
[343]                matsya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahādanam anuttamam |
mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam ||
puṇyāṃ tithimathāsādya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam |
tulāpuruṣavat kuryāt lokeśāvāhanādikam ||
ādiśabdas tu pūrvavd eva vyākhyeyam |
kārayet kāñcanaṃ kumbhaṃ mahāratnācitaṃ budhaḥ |
prādeśād aṅgulaśataṃ yāvat kuryāt pramāṇataḥ ||
kṣīrājyapūritaṃ tadvat kalpavṛkṣasamanvitam |
kṣīraghṛte gavye, samaparimāṇe ca sthāpanīye kalpavṛkṣalakṣaṇaṃ pañcaśākhatvādikalpataru-dāne draṣṭavyam |
padmāsanagatāṃs tadvad brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān |
vahāheṇoddhṛtāṃ tadvat kuryāt pṛthvīṃ sapaṅkajām ||
varuṇaṃ cāsanagataṃ kāñcanaṃ makaropari |
hutāśanaṃ meṣagataṃ vāyuṃ kṛtamṛgāsanam ||
tathākāśādhipaṃ kuryāt mūṣakasthaṃ vināyakam |
vinyased ghaṭamadhye tān vedapañcakasaṃyutān ||
brahmādilakṣaṇaṃ varuṇādilakṣaṇaṃ ca matsyapurāṇoktabrahmāṇḍadānavihitaṃ veditavyam, varāhalakṣaṇaṃ tu padmapurāṇoktabrahmāṇḍe | vināyakasvarūpaṃ hastiratha iti |
ṛgvedasyākṣasūtraṃ tu yajurvedasya paṅkajam |
sāmavedasya vīṇā syād vīṇāṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset ||
[344]        atharvavedasya punaḥ sruksruvau kamalaṃ kare |
purāṇavedo varadaḥ sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
paritaḥ sarvadhānyāni cāmarāsanadarpaṇam |
pādukopānahacchatradīpikābhūṣaṇāni ca ||
śayyā ca jalakumbhāś ca pañcavarṇavitānakam |
snātvādhivāsanānte tu mantram etam udīrayet ||
pādukā kāṣṭhakṛtā, jalakumbhāḥ ṣoḍaśa, prakṛtau tathādarśanāt | adhivāsanānte snātveti pūrvasmin dine adhivāsanaṃ vidhāya dvitīyadivase puṇyāhavācanādipūrṇāhutparyantaṃ karmaśeṣaṃ samāpya sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ pūrvavad ṛtvigbhiḥ snāpito yajamānas triḥ “pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ” vakṣyamānaṃ mantram udāharet |
namo vaḥ sarvadevānām ādhārebhyaś carācare |
mahābhūtādhidevebhyaḥ śāntir astu śivaṃ mama ||
yasmān na kiṃcid apy asti mahābhūtair vinā kṛtam |
brahmāṇḍe sarvabhūteṣu tasmāt śrīrakṣayāstu me ||
ity uccārya mahābhūtaghaṛaṃ yo vinivedayet |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||
vimānenārkavarṇena pitṛbandhusamanvitaḥ |
stūyamāno ‘marastrībhiḥ padam abhyeti vaiṣṇavam ||
atra ca jalapūrvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradeye (?) | pratipādite tulāpuruṣavad vibhāgavyavasthā tadanujñayā cānyebhyo ‘pi dānaṃ dīnānāthapūraṇaṃ ca kartavyam adakṣiṇasya karmaṇo niṣphalatvāt | [345] yathāśakti gurvādibhyo bhūmisuvarṇādikaṃ dakṣiṇeti svalpe tv ekāgnividhānam apy avagantavyaṃ tadanantaraṃ pūrvavat puṇyāhavācanadevatāpūjana-visarjanāni |
ṣoḍaśaitāni yaḥ kuryān mahādānāni mānavaḥ |
na tasya punarāvṛttir iha lome ‘bhijāyate ||
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ vāsudevasya pārśve
sasutapitṛkalatraḥ saṃśṛṇotīha samyak |
puraripubhavane vā mandire vārkalakṣmīś
ciram amaravadhūbhir modate so ‘pi kalpam ||
iti matsyapurāṇokto mahābhūtaghaṭadānavidhiḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirāja-śrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādiviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe ṣoḍaśapradānavidhiḥ
[346]
atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāyaḥ
atha parvatadānavidhiḥ
ayaṃ lokālokaḥ paramahimavān śaśvad udayaḥ
supārśvasthāyiśrīḥ kalitavipulābhogasubhagaḥ |
iti pratyakṣe ‘pi sphuradakhilaśailendravibhavaḥ
paraṃ hemādritvaṃ prakaṭayati viśrāntavibudhaḥ ||
dhānyaśailādidānānām iha hemādrisūriṇā |
vicitravidhivistāraḥ prastāvaḥ kriyate ‘dhunā ||
tatra dānyaparvatadānaṃ tāvad ucyate | tad eva padmapurāṇe |
bhīṣma uvāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi dānamāhātmyam uttamam |
yad akṣayaṃ pare loke devarṣigaṇapūjitam ||
pulastya uvāca |
meroḥ pradānaṃ vakṣyāmi daśadhā munisattama |
yat prasādān naro lokān āpnoti surapūjitān ||
purāṇeṣu ca deveṣu yajñeṣv āyataneṣu ca |
[347]        na tat phalam adhīteṣu kṛteṣv iha yad āśnute ||
“purāṇeṣu vedeṣu yajñeṣv āyataneṣu ca”, kṛteṣu na tat phalam iti saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmād vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi parvatānām anuttamam |
prathamo dhānyaśailaḥ syād dvitīyo lavanācalaḥ ||
guḍācalas tṛtīyas tu caturtho hemaparvataḥ |
pañcamas tilaśailaḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhaḥ kārpāsaparvataḥ ||
saptamo ghṛtaśailaś ca ratnaśailas tathāṣṭamaḥ |
rājato namas tadvad daśamaḥ śarkarācalaḥ ||
vakṣye vidhānam eteṣāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte dinakṣaye ||
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyām uparāge śaśikṣaye |
vivāhotsavayajñe vā dvādaśyām atha vā punaḥ ||
śuklāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā puṇyarkṣe ca vidhānataḥ |
dhānyaśailādayo deyā yathāśraddhaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
tīrthe vāyatane vāpi goṣṭhe vāpi bhavāṅgaṇe |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed bhaktyā caturasram udaṅmukham ||
prāgudakpravaṇaṃ tadvat prāṅmukho vā vidhānataḥ |
maṇḍapalakṣaṇaṃ tu paribhāṣāyāṃ pratipāditam | atra cāyaṃ vidhānakramaḥ dānadivasāt pūrvedyuḥ pūrvāhṇe kṛtasnātādikriyo yajamāno amukaparvatadānam ahaṃ śvaḥ kariṣye iti kṛtasaṃkalpo vṛddhiśrāddham ābhyudayikaṃ vidhāya pūrvavat puṇyāhavācanaṃ kuryāt, tadanantaraṃ tu adya amukasmin deśe amukasmin kale [348] amukaparvatadānenāhaṃ yakṣye tatra tadaṅgabhūtahomādike amukaśarmāṇam amukavedādhyāyinam ṛtvijaṃ tvām ahaṃ vṛṇē iti |
purāṇavedavidāṃ caturṇām ṛtvijām varaṇam, tathā om adya amukasmin deśe amukasmin kale amukaparvatadānehāhaṃ yakṣye tatra tadakgabhūtāni karmāṇi kartuṃ kārayituṃ ca amukasagotraṃ amukaśarmāṇam amukavedādhyāyinaṃ guruṃ tvām ahaṃ vṛṇe ityācāryaṃ vṛṇuyāt vṛto ‘smīti sarvatra prativacanaṃ tatra tāvan madhuparkeṇārcayed iti sarvaparvatadāna-sādhāraṇo ‘yaṃ vidhiḥ |
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmāv āstīrya vai kuśān |
tanmadhye parvataṃ kuryād viṣkambhaparvatānvitam ||
dhānyadroṇasahasreṇa bhaved girir ihottamaḥ |
madhyamaḥ pañcaśatikaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāt tribhiḥ śataiḥ ||
droṇalakṣaṇam uktaṃ paribhāṣāyām |
pramāṇasthakaracaraṇasya puṃso dvādaśabhiḥ prasṛtibhiḥ kuḍavo bhavati | anena kuḍavena caturguṇottaraṃ prathāḍhakadroṇā bhavanti ataḥ caturdroṣaṣṭyā (?) kuḍavaiḥṇo (?) bhavatīti kalapataruṇā vyākhyātam |
merur mahāvrīhimayas tu madhye
suvarṇavṛkṣatrayasaṃyuktaḥ syāt |
pūrveṇa muktāphalavajrayukto
yāmyena gomedakapuṣparāgaiḥ ||
paścāc ca gārutmatanīlaratnaiḥ
saumyena vaidūryasarojarāgaiḥ |
[348]        śrīkhaṇḍakhaṇḍair abhitaḥ pravāla-
latānvitaḥ śuktiśilātalaḥ syāt ||
brahmātha viṣṇur bhagavān murārir
divākaro ‘py atra hiraṇmayaḥ syāt |
mūrdhavyavasthā gatamatsareṇa
kāryāḥ suvarṇena tathā dvijaughāḥ ||
catvāri śṛṅgāṇi ca rājatāni
nitambabhāgeṣv api rājataḥ syāt |
ārdrekṣuvaṃśāvṛtakandaras tu
ghṛtodakaḥ praśravaṇaś ca dikṣu ||
śuklāmbarāṇy ambudharāvalī syāt
pūrveṇa pītāni ca dakṣiṇena |
vāsāṃśi paścād atha karvurāṇi
raktāni caivottarato ghanālī ||
raupyān mahendrapramukhān athāṣṭau
saṃsthāpya lokādhipatīn krameṇa |
nānāphalālī ca samantataḥ syāt
manoramaṃ mālyavilepanaṃ ca ||
vitānakaṃ copari pañcavarṇam
amlānapuṣpābharaṇaṃ sitaṃ ca ||
merur ityādi mahāvrīhayo, rājānnaśālayaḥ, vṛkṣatrasaṃyuta iti dakṣiṇe mandāraḥ, uttare pārijāto, madhye kalpatarur iti vṛkṣatrayam, tathā pūrvato haricandanam, paścime santāna iti tarudvayaṃ ca [350] kuryāt | ete sarvavarvateṣu kartavyā iti śarkarācale vakṣyamāṇatvāt sarveṣāṃ ca pañcaśākhatvam avadheyam iti | vajraṃ horakam | gārutmataṃ marakatam | sarojarāgaḥ padmarāgaḥ | muktāphalādīni ca yathādiśaṃ vakṣyamāṇarājataśṛṅgeṣu niveśanīyāni | murāriḥ (?) maheśvaraḥ | brahmādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne | mūrdhavyavasthā uparideśasthitā | gatamatsareṇa vittaśāṭhārahitena | dvijaughāḥ pakṣisamūhāḥ | divīśā iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ |
tatra ādityāvasavo rudrā divīśāḥ teṣu, vasvādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne, rudralakṣaṇam viśvacakre, ikṣur eva vaṃśaḥ, ghṛtam evodakam, vastrāṇy eva meghasamūhāḥ karvurāṇi, citrāṇi | lokapālalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
itthaṃ niveśyāmaraśailam agryaṃ
meroś ca viṣkambhagirīn krameṇa |
turīyabhāgena caturdiśaṃ tu
saṃsthāpayet puṣpavilepanāṭyān ||
pūrveṇa mandaram anekaphalaiś ca yuktaṃ
yuktaṃ gaṇaiḥ kanakabhadrakadambacihnam |
kāmena kāñcanamayena virājamānam
ākārayet kusumavastravilepanāṭyam ||
kṣīrāruṇodasarasātha vanena caiva
[351]                rapyeṇa śaktighaṭitena virājamānam |
yāmyena gandhamadanaś ca niveśanīyo
godhūmasañcayamayaḥ kaladhautajaṃ vā ||
haimena yakṣapatinā ghṛtamānasena
vastraiś ca rājatavanena ca saṃyutaḥ syāt |
paścāt tilācalam anekasugandhipuṣpa-
sauvarṇapippalahiraṇmayahaṃsayuktam ||
ākārayed rajatapuṣpavanena tadvad
vasvanvitaṃ dadhisitodarasas tathāgre |
saṃsthāpya taṃ vipulaśailam athottareṇa
śailaṃ supārśvam api māṣamayaṃ savastram ||
puṣpaiś ca hemavaṭapādapaśekharantam
ākārayet kanakadhenuvirājamānam |
sākṣīkabhadrasarasā ca vanena tadvad
raupyeṇa bhāskaravatā ca yutaṃ vidhāya ||
itthaṃ niveśyetyādi, evaṃ meruṃ niveśya taccaturthabhāgaparimitena pṛthakdravyeṇa ekaikaṃ viṣkambhagiriṃ kuryāt na tu caturthabhāgena caturo ‘pīti, tathā ca lavaṇācale vakṣyati caturthāṃśena viṣkambhaparvatān kārayet, pṛthag iti, pūrveṇa mandaram iti, saṃnidhānān mandaro ‘pi vrīhimaya eva, gaṇair yuktam iti, puruṣākṛtigaṇatrayānvitam ity arthaḥ | anekaphalālī yuktaṃ yavair iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | tasya sabhūlatve (?) yavānuṣṭhānam api kāryam | [352] kanakaghaṭitena bhadrakadambākhyena vṛkṣeṇa lakṣitam | kāmalakṣaṇam āha viśvakarmā |
cāpabāṇadharaḥ kāmo ratipreyān sumadhyamaḥ |
ālīḍho nandano rājī rūpavān viśvamodakaḥ || iti |
kṣīrapūritena, aruṇodasaṃjñikena rūpyaghaṭitena sarasā vanenāpi rūpyaghaṭitena virājamānam iti saṃbandhaḥ | yāmyenatyādi, gandhamadanī gandhamādanaḥ | kaladhotajambeti suvarṇajambuvṛkṣeṇa | yakṣapatirūpam uktaṃ śrīpraśne |
hrasvam āpiṅganetraṃ ca gadinaṃ pītavigraham |
puṣpakasthaṃ dhanādhyakṣaṃ dhyāyet śivasakhaṃ sadā || iti |
ghṛtamānaseneti ghṛtapūritena mānasābhidhānena rājatena sarasā | paścād iti, paścimadeśe dadhipūritasitodaṃ nāma rajatanirmitaṃ sara iti, vipulaśailaṃ vipulaṃ nāma parvataṃ mākṣīkabhadrasaraseti, mākṣikaṃ madhu madhupūritena rajatamayena bhadrābhidhānena sarasā yutam ity arthaḥ |
atra ca kāmadevasya pratyaṅmukhatvaṃ haṃsasya prāṅmukhatvaṃ kanakadhenor dakṣiṇāmukhatvaṃ ca śarkarācalasthitadigveśeṣasāpekṣyam daivateṣu sarvaśaileṣu veditavyam, carmavyavasthā kuto ‘pi śāstrādyavasthitir iti | ete ca kāmadevādayaḥ kadambādīnāṃ nijaparvatītavṛkṣāṇām adhastāt kartavyāḥ |
homaiś caturbhir atha vedapuāṇavidbhir
dāntair anindyacaritākṛtibhir dvijendraiḥ |
[353]        pūrveṇa hastamitam atra vidhāya kuṇḍaṃ
kāryas tilair yavaghṛtena samitkuśaiś ca ||
rātrau ca jāgaram anuddhatagītatūryair
āvāhanaṃ ca kathayāmi śiloccayānām ||
pūrveṇetyādi maṇḍapasya pūrvabhāge hastamātraṃ kuṇḍaṃ vidhāya tasya pūrvottaradigvibhāge tulāpuruṣoktalakṣaṇāṃ devatāvediṃ kṛtvā tatra vināyakādidevatābhyaḥ pūrvavat pūjāṃ vidadhyāt | anantaram ṛtvijo ‘gnisthāpanānte grahāṇāṃ lokapālānām ityādivakṣyamāṇa-devatābyas talliṅgamantrais tilādidravyeṇa homaṃ kuryuḥ | sahasre tv atha hotavye kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ karātmakam ity ukter atra hastaparimitakuṇḍopadeśād āhutisahasraṃ hotavyam iti dānavivekakāraḥ |
atra vināyakādayo dvātriṃśaddevāḥ, dvādaśādityāḥ, ekādaśarudrāḥ, daśalokapālāḥ, aṣṭau vasavaḥ, brahmaviṣṇuśivasūryāś catvāraḥ, kāmadhanadahaṃsakāmadhenavaś catvāraḥ, ity evam ekāśītisaṃkhyebho devebhyaḥ grahāṇāṃ pratidaivataṃ trayodaśāhutihome tripañcāśadadhikam āhutisahasraṃ saṃpadyate aṣṭaśataṃ tu hotavyam iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇe vakṣyati tilādīni catvāry eva | havirdravyāṇi ghṛtāktānīty avagantavyaṃ samidhaḥ, sādhāraṇyād udumbarasya homāntaraṃ puṣpopahārān ādāya vakṣyamāṇamantrair yathākramaṃ parvatān āvāhayet, tatra meror āvāhanamantraḥ |
tvaṃ sarvadevagaṇadhāmanidher viruddham
asmadgṛhe ‘py amaraparvataṃ nāśayāśu |
kṣemaṃ vidhatsva kuru śāntim anuttamāṃ naḥ
[354]                saṃpūjitaḥ paramabhaktimatā mayā hi ||
tvam eva bhagavān īśo brahma viṣṇur divākaraḥ |
mūrtāmūraparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātanaḥ ||
yasmāt tvaṃ lokapālānāṃ viśvamūtreś ca mandiram |
rudrādityavasūnāṃca tasmāc chāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
yasmād aśūnyam amarair nārībhiś ca samas tathā |
tasmān mām uddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāragāt |
evam abhyarcya taṃ meruṃ mandraṃ cābhipūjayet ||
atha mandarasya |
yasmāc caitrarathena tvaṃ bhadrāśvena varṣeṇa ca |
śobhase mandarakṣipramalaṃ puṣṭikaro bhava ||
atha gandhamādanasya |
tasmāc cūḍāmaṇir jambudvīpe tvaṃ gandhamādana |
gandharvanaśobhāvān ataḥ kīrtir dṛḍhās tu me ||
atha vipulaparvasya |
yasmāt tvaṃ ketumālena vaibhrājena vanena ca |
hiraṇmayāśvatthaśikhas tasmāt puṣṭir dhruvaḥ astu me ||
atha supārśvasya |
uttaraiḥ kurubhir yasmāt sāvitreṇa vanena ca |
supārśva rājase nityam ataḥ śrīrakṣayāstu me ||
evam āmantrya tān sarvān prabhāte vimale punaḥ |
snātvātha gurave dadyān madhyamaṃ parvatottamam ||
[355]        viṣkambhaparvatān dadyād ṛtvigbhyaḥ kramaśo nṛpa |
gāvo dadyāc caturviṃśad atha vā daśa pārthiva ||
śaktitaḥ sapta vāṣṭau vā pañca dadyād aśaktimān |
ekāṃ vā gurave dadyāt kapilāṃ ca payasvanīm ||
evam āmantryeti, dānadināt pūrvadivase sarvam idam āmantraṇādi vidhāya gītavāditrādibhir niśām ativāhya tataḥ prabhāte guruprabhṛtayo vihitasnānādikriyāḥ pūrṇāhutiparyantaṃ sakalakarmaśeṣaṃ samāpya kuṇḍasamīpasthāpitakalaśajalena pūrvavad yajamānaṃ snāpayeyuḥ | yajamāno ‘pi śuklāmbaraparidhānaḥ pradakṣiṇīkrtya vakṣyamāṇamantreṇa yathākramaṃ parvatāt pratipādayet | tatra prayogaḥ |
oṃ adya amukasmin kale amukasagotrāya amukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya etam amukapartaṃ sopaskaram amukasagotro ‘ham amukaśarmā amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade namaḥ, amukasagotrāya amukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya etat parvatadānapratiṣṭhārtham imāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade, atra ca dakṣiṇāpekṣāyām aśrutadakṣiṇāntara-kalpanānupapatter gavo dadyād ity śrutam eva dakṣiṇātvena saṃbadhyate vināpi dakṣiṇāsaṃśabdanam asty eva dakṣiṇātvam iti kecit, sahasradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvetyādi brahmāṇḍapurāṇe vakṣyamānadakṣiṇāgrahaṇaṃ tu yuktam iti |
parvatānām aśeṣāṇām eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
ta eva pūjane mantras ta evopaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
[356]        svamantreṇaiva sarveṣu homaḥ śaileṣu paṭhyate |
upavāsī bhaven nityam aśakto naktam iṣyate ||
sarvatrākṣāralavaṇam aśnīyād iti vakṣyamāṇatvād akṣāralavaṇaṃ naktaṃ veditavyam |
vidhānaṃ sarvaśailānāṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu pārthiva |
dānakāleṣu ye mantrāḥ parvateṣu ca yat phalam |
atha mantraḥ |
annaṃ brahma yataḥ proktam anne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
annād bhavanti bhūtāni jagad annena vartate ||
annam eva yato lakṣmīr annam eva janārdanaḥ |
dhānyaparvatarūpeṇa pāhi tasmān namo namaḥ ||
evam ācāryādīn saṃpūjya tadanujñayā anyebhyo ‘pi dadyāt | tato yajamāno vedyāṃ pūrvavad devatāḥ saṃpūjya namas kuryāt | gurus tān visarjayet | tato yathāśakti brāhmaṇabhojanam kṛtopavāsasya yajamānasya dānadine kṣāralavaṇavarjanaṃ sarvaparvatopaskarāṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇagṛhaprāpaṇaṃ śarkarācaloktaṃ sarvatre draṣṭavyam |
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyād dhānyamayaṃ girim |
manvantaraśataṃ sārdhaṃ devaloke mahīyate ||
apsarogaṇagandharvair ākīrṇena virājitaḥ |
vimānena divaḥ pṛṣṭham āyāti surasevitaḥ ||
karmakṣayād rājarājyaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ ||
atha brahmāṇdapurāṇāt |
[357]                śrībhagavān uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhānyaparvatam uttamam |
yaṃ datvā sarvadānānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
nadyās tire gṛhe vāpi devatāyatane tathā |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā ca vidhānaṃ parikalpayet ||
kārtikyām ayane caiva grahaṇe vāpi kṛtsnaśaḥ |
anyeṣv api ca kāleṣu yadā śraddhābhijāyate ||
mahāprītikaraṃ kuryāt parvataṃ śubhalakṣaṇam |
sāhasriko bhavec chreṣṭhas tadardhena tu madhyamaḥ ||
tribhiḥ śataiḥ kaniṣṭhas tu droṇānāṃ nṛpasattama |
alābhe vā yathāśaktyā kārayec chraddayānvitaḥ ||
madhye prakalpayen meruṃ mahāvrīhimayaṃ śubham |
viṣkambhaparvataṃ caiva yavaiḥ kuryāt tu pūrvataḥ ||
dakṣiṇenātha godhūmais tilaiḥ paścimatas tathā |
māṣaiś caivottaraṃ kuryāt turīyāṃśena parvatān ||
sauvarṇaśikharopetāṃs tān sarvān kārayed budhaḥ |
sarvaratnavicitrāṅgān ketuvṛkṣair alaṃkṛtān ||
nānādrumalatopetān surabhiṃ cāpy alaṃkṛtān |
vastraiḥ pracchāditān kṛtvā gandhair mālyais tu pūjayet ||
evaṃvidhaṃ giriṃ kṛtvā nānābhakṣyaiḥ samantataḥ |
pūjayet phalamūlaiś ca rasair nānāvidhais tathā ||
grāmyāraṇyais tathā dhānyaiḥ pūrayet sarvatas tathā |
brahmaviṣṇuśivāṃs tatra sauvarṇān viniyojayet ||
[358]        pūrvataḥ kārayet kuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam |
brāhmaṇās tatra hotāro aṣṭau catvāra eva ca ||
gṛhasthāḥ sādhavo dāntāḥ saṃpūrṇāvayavās tathā |
ādhautavāsasaś caiva kaṭakādibhir anvitāḥ ||
candanādigdhagātrāś ca tathā puṣpair alaṃkṛtāḥ |
evaṃvidhās tathā viprā homaṃ kuryur atandritāḥ ||
indrādyā lokapālāś ca teṣāṃ homo vidhīyate |
talliṅgaiś caiva mantraiś ca samidbhir atha vā tilaiḥ ||
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena brahmādīnāṃ vidhīyate |
tathā vyāhṛtibhir homaṃ tilair ājyena caiva hi ||
aṣṭaśataṃ tu hotavyaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhaye |
pūjayet parvataṃ paścād yajamānaḥ prasannadhīḥ ||
snātvā śuklāmbaro bhūtvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ |
annaṃ prāṇā hi bhūtānāṃ balaṃ tejas tathaiva ca ||
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ sarvaṃ jagad anne pratiṣṭhitam |
annād bhavanti bhūtāni annād vardhanti caiva hi ||
tac ca dhānyādhikāreṇa annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhavet |
ato dhānyagato meruḥ karotv abhimataṃ mama ||
namas te sarvalokānām ādhāraḥ surapūjitaḥ |
vittahīnāṃ mama kule mā bhavatv iha kaś can ||
atyucchinnaṃ tathaivānnaṃ mama janmani janmani |
mā pātu saṃkṣayaṃ caiva dīyamānam aharniśam ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya pūrvedū rātrau kuryān mahotsavam |
[359]        śaṅkhatūryaninādaiś ca geyamṅgalapāṭhakaiḥ ||
tataḥ sarvasamīpe tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
sahasradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā ca vibhavasya ca ||
dakṣiṇārahito yajñaḥ śatrūtvāyābhijāyate |
tasmāt sadakṣiṇaṃ deyaṃ yat kiṃcid dānasaṃjñitam ||
hotāras tatra ye teṣāṃ dadyād viṣkambhavān budhāh |
ācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād gobhir aśvair gajaiś tathā ||
alaṃkārais tathā mukhyair vastraiḥ puṣpānulepanaiḥ |
ācāryaṃ pūjayet taṃ ca bhojayitvā yathāvidhi ||
gāvaś cālaṃkṛtā deyā bahukṣīrā guṇānvitāḥ |
rūpavatyas taruṇyaś ca tuṣṭyarthaṃ juhvatāṃ nṛpa ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyād dhānyamayaṃ girim |
uddhṛtya cātmanā sārdhaṃ svargam āropayet param ||
manvantarāṇi ṣaḍviṃśan modate vibudhaiḥ saha |
divyaṃ vimānam āhuhya nārī vā puruṣo ‘pi vā ||
puṇyakṣayād ihāpy etya saptadvīpapatir bhavet |
daśajanmāni rājendra dvāpare jāyate yuge ||
daśavarṣasahasrāyuḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
yaś cedaṃ śṛṇuyād dānaṃ kīrtyamānaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
daridraḥ parayā bhaktyā so ‘pi sadgatim āpnuyāt ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhānyaparvatam uttamam |
[360]        vrīhibhiḥ kārayet taṃ tu godhūmair atha vā yavaiḥ ||
sahasreṇottamaṃ kuryāt tadardhena tu madhyamam |
tasyāpy ardhāt kaniṣṭhaṃ tu kuryād vibhavasārataḥ ||
teṣāṃ parvavidhānena sarvaṃ kuryād yathākramam |
phalaṃ vāpi tadā rājan pūrvam eva samaśnute ||
dhānyācalaṃ kanakavṛkṣavirājamānaṃ
viṣkambhaparvatayutaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭaṃ |
yacchanti ye sumatayaḥ praṇipatya vipra
te prāpnuvanti parameṣṭhipadābjayugmam ||
iti dhānyaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
atha lavaṇācaladānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi lavanācalam uttamam |
yatpradānān naro loke prāpnoti śivasaṃyutam ||
uttamaḥ ṣiḍaśadroṇaḥ kartavyo lavanācalaḥ |
madhyamaḥ syāt tadardhena catubhir adhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
vittahīno yathāśaktyā droṇād ardhaṃ tu kārayet |
caturthāṃśena viṣkambhaparvatān kārayet pṛthak ||
droṇalakṣaṇam uktam | caturthāṃśeneti mukhyaśailalavaṇāt pṛthak pratyekaṃ caturhāṃśaparimitena lavaṇenety arthaḥ |
vidhānaṃ pūrvavat kryād brahmādīnāṃ ca sarvadā |
[361]        tadvad dhematarūn sarvān lokapālaniveśanam |
sarāṃsi kāmadevādīṃs tadvac cātra niveśayet ||
tadvad iti dhānyaparvatavad ity arthaḥ |
kuryāj jāgaramātrāpi dānamantrān nibodhata |
saubhāgyarasasaṃbhūto yato yaṃ lavaṇo rasaḥ ||
tadātmakatvena ca māṃ pāhi pāpān nagottama |
yasmād annarasāḥ sarve notkaṭā lavaṇaṃ vinā ||
priyaṃ ca śivayor nityaṃ tasmāc chāntiṃ prayaccha me |
viṣṇudehasamudbhūtaṃ yasmād ārogyavardhanam ||
tasmāt parvatarūpeṇa pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt |
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyāl lavaṇaparvatam ||
umāloke vaset kalpaṃ tato yāti parāṃgatim ||
iti padmapurāṇokto lavaṇācaladānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi guḍaparvatam uttamam |
yatpradānān naraḥ svargam āpnoti surapūjitam ||
uttamo daśabhir bhārair madhyamaḥ pañcabhir mataḥ |
tribhir bhāraiḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāt tadardhenālpavittavān ||
bhāraḥ paribhāṣāyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ |
tadvad āmantraṇaṃ pūjā homavṛkṣasurārcanam |
viṣkambhaparvatāṃs tadvat sarāṃsi vanadevatāḥ ||
[362]        homaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tadval lokapālādhivāsanam |
dhānyaparvatavat kuryād imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
yathā deveṣu viśvātmā pravaro ‘yaṃ janārdanaḥ |
sāmavedas tu vedānāṃ mahādevas tu yoginām ||
praṇavaḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvatī yathā |
tathā rasānāṃ pravaraḥ sadaivekṣuraso mataḥ ||
mama tasmāt parāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadasva guḍaparvata |
yasmāt saubhāgyadāyinyā bhrātā tvaṃ guḍaparvata ||
nivāsaś cāpi pārvatyās tasmān māṃ pāhi sarvadā |
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyād guḍamayaṃ girim ||
pūjyamānaḥ sa gadharvair gaurīloke mahīyate |
punaḥ kalpaśatānte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ||
āyurārogyasaṃpannaḥ śatrubhiś cāparājitaḥ ||
iti padmapurānokto guḍaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi guḍaparvatam uttamam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ saubhāgyajananaṃ param ||
puṣṭidaṃ śāntidaṃ caiva sukhadaṃ dviyabhogadam |
bhārais taṃ daśabhiḥ kuryād yathāśaktyāpi vā bhavet ||
pūrvavat maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā sarvopakaraṇāni ca |
pūrvavad iti brahmāṇḍadānoktadhānyaparvatavad ity arthaḥ |
lokapālasamopetaṃ tathākāñcanaśṛṅgiṇam ||
[363]        muktāphalavicitrāṅgaṃ vastrālaṅkṛtavigraham |
pravālakalatopetaṃ ikṣukhaṇḍopaveṇukam ||
nitambaṃ rājataṃ tasya mekhalākārasaṃskṛtam |
kuryāt tāmramayaṃ skandhaṃ nānādhātuvibhūṣitam ||
kṛtvā tam īdṛśaṃ śailaṃ sarvadhānyasamāvṛtam |
sarvauṣadhisamopetaṃ saśṛṅgaṃ samahādrumam ||
kalpayitvā vidhānena savitānaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
kuṇḍam ekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā catuḥkoṇaṃ svalaṃkṛtam ||
niyojyās tatra vidvāṃso brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ |
pūjitās te yathānyāyaṃ homaṃ kuryur atandritāḥ ||
lokapālān grahāṃś caiva brahmādīṃś ca vidhānataḥ |
svaliṅgoktaiś ca mantraiś ca homayeyur dvijotamāḥ ||
mahāvyāhṛtibhiś caiva ayutaṃ tatra homayet |
ācāryaḥ saha viprais tair mānena susamāhitaḥ ||
brahmaghoṣaratas tasmin kārayitvā mahotsavam |
evaṃ vidhiṃ tadā kṛtvā pūrvedyuḥ [pra?] śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
dadyāt taṃ māghamāsasya tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
caitrasya vā vidhānena tṛtīyāyāṃ pradāpayet ||
anyeṣv api ca kāleṣu grahaṇādiṣu kārayet |
tvaṃ rasānāṃ varo nityaṃ devānāṃ ca sadā priyaḥ ||
sukhaṃ prayaccha me nityaṃ namas te parvatottma (?) |
[364]        yāvad bhūḥ sāgarā nadyo yāvac candrārkatārakāḥ |
tāvan me tvaṃ sukhaṃ yaccha saubhāgyam atulaṃ tathā ||
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā taṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ nivedayet |
ācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād dīnāndhakṛpaṇān api ||
visṛjya brāhmaṇāṃs tāṃs tu kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam |
tasmin dine ca bhoktavyaṃ madhuraṃ kṣāravarjitam ||
anagnālepanaṃ caiva kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ |
tasmād deyam idaṃ dānaṃ phalam uttamam icchatā ||
gatiṃ ca śāsvatīṃ loke saubhāgyaṃ rūpam eva ca |
anena vidhinā caiva dātavyo guḍaparvataḥ ||
viṃśadbhāras tu kartavyaḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret |
dānam etat praśastaṃ syāt strīṇāṃ rājan viśeṣataḥ ||
saubhāgyarājakāmasya sarvasyāpi vidhīyate |
pūrvoktaṃ ca phalaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate ||
iti brāhmāṇdpurāṇokto guḍaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
atha pāpaharaṃ vakṣye suvarṇācalam uttamam |
yasya pradānād bhavanaṃ viriñcir yāti mānavaḥ ||
uttamaḥ palasāhasro madhyamaḥ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ |
tadardhenādhamas tadvad alpavitto ‘pi śaktitaḥ ||
dadyād ekapalād ūrdhvaṃ yathāśaktyā vimatsaraḥ |
[365]        dhānyaparvatavat sarvaṃ vidadhyād rājasattama ||
viṣkambhaśailās tadvac ca ṛtvigbhiḥ pratipādayet |
namas te brahmabījāya brahmagarbhāya vai namaḥ ||
yadmād anantaphaladas tasmāt pāhi śiloccayañ |
yasmād agner aptyaṃ tvaṃ tasmāt puṇyaṃ jagatpate ||
hemaparvatarūpeṇa tasmāt pāhi nagottamaḥ |
etena vidhinā yas tu dadyāt kanakaparvatam ||
sa yāti paramaṃ brahmalokam ānandakārakam |
tatra kalpaśataṃ tiṣṭhet tato yāti parāṅgatim ||
atra yady api gurave madhyaśailaṃ dadyāt ṛtvigbhyo viṣkambhācanānītyuktaṃ, nāpi tulāpuruṣavad ityādi śrūyate, tathāpi palasahasrādiparimitasuvarṇadānārhasya ekasyāsulabhatvāt anyeṣv api ca bahusuvarṇakeṣu bahvbhyāṃ (?) dānadarśanāt, tatrāpi tulāpuruṣavad ardhacaturthabhāgādi gurave pradāya, tadanujñayā anyebhyo ‘pi dayād iti gamyate, prakṛtāv adarśanān naivam iti cet, mā bhūt prakṛtau tulāpuruṣādisthitam eva gṛhyata iti ko virodhaḥ, ekaś ca vidhyanto bhavatīty ekasya prakṛtidvyānpapattir iti cet, atha prakṛtāv apy evam eva vyavastheti brūmaḥ | lavaṇācalādisakalaśailadānaprakṛtibhūtasya dhānyaparvatasya katham anyadharmasaṃgraha iti cet, na prakṛter apy aṅgāṅgisāpekṣatayā dhānyaparvate ‘pi kuṇḍamaṇḍapācāryalakṣaṇāditulāpuruṣadharmagrahaṇadarśanāt |
tataś ca dravyabahutve bahubhyo, dravyālpatve brāhmaṇapañcakāya svapatamatve ācāryāryaiva deyam iti siddham |
[366]
iti padmapurāṇoktaḥ suvarṇācaladānavidhiḥ |
atha tilaśailadānavidhiḥ | padmapurāṇāt |
pulastya uvāca
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tilaśailaṃ vidhānataḥ |
yatpradānān naro yāti viṣṇulokam anuttamam ||
uttamo daśabhir droṇaiḥ pañcabhiḥ madhyamo mataḥ |
tribhiḥ kaniṣṭho viprendra tilaśailaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
pūrvac cāparaṃ sarvaṃ vṛkṣaviṣkambhakādikam |
dānamantrān pravakṣyāmi yathāvad rājasattama ||
yasmāt madhuvane viṣṇor dehasvedasamudbhavāḥ |
tilāḥ kuśāś ca māṣāś ca tasmāc chaṃ no bhavatv iha ||
havyakavyeṣu yasmāc ca vilair evābhilakṣaṇam |
bhavād uddhara śailendra tilācala namo ‘stu te ||
ity āmantrya ca yo dadyāt tilācalam anuttamam |

dīrghāyuṣyam avāpnoti iha cāmutra mānavaḥ |
pitṛbhir devagandharvaiḥ pūjyamāno divaṃ vrajet ||
atha brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt
bhagavān uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tilaparvatam uttamam |
yaddānaṃ sarvadānānāṃ paratra phaladāyi ca ||
[367]        tilāḥ pavitram atulaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ ca pāvanāḥ |
viṣṇor dehasamudbhūtās tasmād uttamatāṅgatāḥ ||
tilā bhavanti rakṣārthaṃ jagatāṃ tisṛṇām api |
śulapakṣe tu devānāṃ pradadyād yas tilodakam ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe pitṝṇāṃ tu snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
tilaiḥ saptāṣṭabhir vāpi samavetaṃ tilāñjalim ||
tasya devāḥ sapitaraḥ tṛptā yacchanti vācchatam |
śvakākopahataṃ yat tu patitādibhir eva ca ||
tilair abhyukṣitaṃ sarvaṃ pavitraṃ syān na saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃvidhis tilair yas tu kṛtvā parvatam uttamam ||
pradadyād dvijamukhyāya puṇyaṃ tasyākṣayaṃ bhavet |
vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi māhātmyam api cottamam ||
vyatīpāte ‘yane caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ |
janmarkṣe viṣuve caiva deyaṃ māghe viśeṣataḥ ||
tilair yat kriyate māghe dānahomādikaṃ tathā |
tad akṣayaṃ bhavel loke tarpaṇādikam eva ca ||
tathā nadyāṃ gṛhe vāpi kṛtvā maṇḍapam uttamam |
pūrvoktena vidhānena kuryāt sarvam aśeṣataḥ ||
pūrvokteneti brahmāṇḍapurāṇoktadhānyaparvatasthitenety arthaḥ |
śatatrayena droṇānāṃ śaktyā vāpi prakalpayet |
parvatasya caturthena bhāgena parikalpayet ||
[368]        diśādalān mandarādīṃs tilair eva vicakṣaṇaḥ |
brahmādilokapālāṃś ca sauvarṇān kārayet tathā ||
ikṣudaṇḍaiḥ samantāt tu bhūṣayed yāgamaṇḍapam |
kuṇḍam ekaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ pūrvataḥ kārayed budhaḥ ||
hastamātrapramāṇena mekhalānābhisaṃyutam |
saṃsthāpayed dvijāṃs tatra cātuścaraṇikān śucīn ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena tatra homo vidhīyate |
pūjayet parvataś caiva mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
maṇiratnapravālaiś ca prathame ‘hani yatnataḥ |
viṣṇudehasamudbhūtais tilais tvaṃ kārito mayā ||
devālaya mahāmero namas te bhūbhṛtāṃ vara |
sapta janmāni yat kiṃcin mayā pāpam anuṣṭhitam ||
kṣayaṃ prayātu tat sarvaṃ tvatprasādān nagottama |
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu prāpya caivāśiṣaṃ śubhām ||
rātrau mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā parvatasya samīpataḥ |
pūjayitvā dvijān samyak sopādhyāyān samāhitaḥ ||
sahasraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāc chaktyā vāpi pradāpayet |
atrāpi gāvo dātavyā aṣṭau catvāra eva ca ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā parvataṃ brāhmaṇāṃs tathā |
śirasā praṇipatyātha śrāddhāvāṃsum anuvrajet ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dānam etat prayacchati |
sa gacchet pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇulokam alaupamam ||
vimānavaram āruhya kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitam |
[369]        apsarogaṇasaṃvītaṃ gandharvair atiśobhitam ||
daśakoṭyas tu varṣāṇāṃ bhuṅkte bhogān yathepsitān |
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
nārī vā tasya patnī vā subhagā rūpasaṃyutā |
dakṣā kulodvahā caiva putrapautrasamanvitā ||
kṛte yuge ‘bhijāyeta paścān mokṣam avāpnuyāt |
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhundhumāreṇa vai purā ||
māndhātrā yavanāśvena kārttavīryeṇa caiva hi |
dānam etat purā dattaṃ tatpatnībhis tathaiva ca ||
prāptam aiśvaryam atulaṃ kīrttir loke ca śāśvatī |
tasmād deyaṃ sadā dānam etad rājavarottamāḥ ||
vidhānam idam ākarṇya nirdhanaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ |
kapilādānapuṇyasya samaṃ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti tilaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tilaparvatam uttamam |
pūrvoktasthānakāle tu kṛtvā saṃpūjayet tataḥ ||
atra pūrvaśabdena liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānam avagantavyam |
susame bhūtale ramie valmīkādivivarjite |
daśatālapramāṇena daṇḍaṃ saṃsthāpya vai mune ||
adbhiḥ saṃprokṣye paścād dhi tilās tasmin vinikṣipet ||
[370] “tālaḥ smṛto madhyamayā gokarṇaś cāpy anāmayā” ityādinā tālamānam uktaṃ paribhāṣāyām |
prokṣayet pañcagavyena taṃ diśaṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ |
maṇḍalaṃ kalpayed vidvān pūrvavat susamāhitaḥ ||
navavastraiś ca saṃsthāpya droṇapuṣpaṃ vikīrya ca |
tasmiṃs tu parvataṃ kuryāt tilabhārair viśeṣataḥ ||
daṇḍāt prādeśam utsedha uttame parikīrtitaḥ |
caturaṅgulahīnas tu madhyame parikīrtitaḥ ||
daṇḍatulyaḥ kaniṣṭhe syād daṇḍahīnena kārayet |
veṣṭayitvā navair vastraiḥ paritaḥ pūjayet kramāt ||
sadyādīni pratinyasya pūjayed vidhipūrvakam |
aṣṭadikṣu ca kartavyā devānāṃ mūrtayaḥ kramāt ||
triniṣkeṇa suvarṇena pratyekaṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
sadyādīni sadyojātaprabhṛtīni | devānāṃ lokapālānām |
dakṣiṇā vidhinā kāryā tulāpuruṣadānavat |
homaś ca pūrvavat prokto yathāvan munisattamaḥ ||
tulāpuruṣo ‘tra liṅgapurāṇokta eveti vijñeyam |
arcayed devadeveśaṃ lokapālasamāvṛtam |
tilaparvatamadhyasthaṃ tilaparvatarūpiṇam ||
śivārcanā ca kartavyā sahasrakalaśādibhiḥ |
darśayet tilamadhyasthaṃ devadevam umāpatim ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena krameṇa ca vimarjayet |
śrotriyāya daridrāya dāpayet tilaparvatam ||
[371]        evaṃ tilamayaṃ proktaṃ dānaṃ sarvādhikaṃ param |
yat kṛtvā mānavo nūnaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati ||
atraivaṃ kṛtiḥ, prāguktamaṇḍapavedīmaṇḍale gavyaiḥ prokṣya darbhān droṇapuṣpādi cāvakīrya ca vastrair ācchādya yajamāno daśatālamitaṃ daṇḍaṃ nidhāya yavākṣataśuddhatilair daṇḍam ācchādayan śailākṛtiṃ kuryāt uttame daṇḍāt prādeśādhikyam, madhame aṣṭāṅgulādhikyam, kaniṣṭapakṣe tu daṇḍasāmyam, tilarāśer iti | tato vastrair ācchādya taṃ merurūpaṃ dhyātvā tadupari śivaṃ palatrayāvarasvarṇanirmitaṃ saṃsthāpya sadyādīni nyaset, tatra prathamāvaraṇe pañca brahmāṇi, tadbāhye sarvādimūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya, tadbāhye bhūmyādimūrtiḥ, tadbāhye lokapālā iti | ete ca sarve niṣkatrayaparimitena hiraṇyena vidhāya tattanmantraiḥ pūjyāḥ, tatra śivalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
sadyojātādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ mayadīpikāyām |
sadyojātaṃ sitaṃ kuryād varadābhayahastakam ||
saumyaṃ maulīndusaṃpannaṃ bālākāraṃ trilocanam |
vāmadevaṃ suraktāṅgaṃ mālyavastropavītakam ||
tuṅganāsaṃ ca khaṭṭāṅgaṃ khaḍgalheṭakapāṇinam |
babhrubhrūśvaśrumaulīndudaṃṣṭrālambikṛtānanam ||
pāśakheṭeṣu khaṭvāṅgakāyayuktaṃ catuṣṭaye |
śūladaṇḍakuṭhārāsīn dadyād dakṣeṣu pāṇiṣu ||
pītāmbaraṃ susaumyaṃ ca naraṃ kuṅkumasaṃnibham |
kuryān maulīndusaṃpannaṃ pāśaśūladharaṃ dvayoḥ ||
sphaṭikābhaṃ jagaddhetuṃ trinetraṃ candramaulinam |
[372]        īśānaṃ pañcamaṃ kuryāt triśūlābhayapāṇinam || iti |
sarvādilakṣaṇam āha viśvakarmā |
sarvo bhaumo mahādevo rudraḥ paśupatir bhavaḥ |
ugreśānāv iti hy aṣṭau mūrtiṇāḥ śivasaṃnibhāḥ ||
mṛgāṅkacūḍāmaṇayo jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ |
trenetrā varakhaṭvāṅgatriśūlābhyapāṇayaḥ || iti |
mūrtyaṣṭakamadhye tu pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ rūpāṇi pañcamahābhūtaghaṭadāne nirūpitāni, candrārkayos tu varadānaprakaraṇe vakṣyante, yajamānamūrtir astu viśeṣānukter itarapuruṣatulyaiva veditavyā, lokapālalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brāhmāṇḍadāne, tataḥ pūjānantartattanmantraiḥ samidādi hutvā pṛthaksthasya śivasya sahasrakalaśābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvā yajamānāya śivādīn abhyarcya taṃ śailaṃ śrotriyāya pradāpayet | ācāryādidakṣiṇādi pūrvavat | atrādye yajamānam adhikṛtya kālottaratantreṣu |
atha vā parameśānam aṣṭottaraśatair api |
kalaśaiḥ snapayitvā tu samabhyarya yathāvidhi ||
kuryāt pradānamantreṇa gurur aṣṭottaraṃ sudhīḥ |
mahādevo mahārudraḥ śaṅgaro nīlalohitaḥ ||
īśāno vijayo bhomo (?) devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ |
kapālīśaś ca vijñeyo rudrā ekādaśas tv ime ||
samantāt sakaleśasya pūjanīyā yathākramam |
[373]        kṛṣṇājine saṃprapūjya tilānāṃ ṣoḍaśādhikaiḥ ||
suvarṇatrayasaṃyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭitam |
śobhitaṃ puṣpamālābhiḥ phalaiś ca samalaṃkṛtam ||
rudrān ekādaśa dhyātvā krameṇa paridāpayet |
śivabhaktāya śāntāya śrotriyāya dvijanmane ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vidhinānena saṃyutaḥ |
āyuḥ śriyaṃ jayaṃ kīrtim anubhūya śivaṃ vrajet ||
iti liṅgapurāṇoktas tilaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tilaparvatam uttamam |
yasya pradānāt sakalaṃ kṣaym eṣyati pātakam ||
saptajanmāntare yat syāt pāpaṃ bhrūṇavadhādikam |
tat sarvaṃ kṣayam abhyeti tilaparvatadānataḥ ||
puṇyakāleṣu sarveṣu uparāge viśeṣataḥ |
puṇyadeśe prayatnena dātavyaṃ tilaparvatam ||
devālayasya purato maṇḍapaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
pravibhaktacaturdvāraṃ catustoraṇasaṃyutam ||
daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā caturasraṃ susaṃsthitam |
vitānoparisaṃchannaṃ digvitīrṇavitānakam ||
dvāreṣu pūrṇakalaśān sthāpayitvā dvayaṃ dvayam |
pūrvasmin divase prātaḥ kuryāt puṇyāhavācanam ||
tataḥ saṃkalpayitvā tu guruṃ vedāṅgapāragam |
vaśinaṃ puṇyacaritaṃ yuvānāṃ kṛtalakṣaṇam |
ṛtvijaś cāṣṭa saṃgrāhyā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ |
[374]        teṣāṃ nivedayet kāryaṃ śva pradāsye tilācalam ||
tato guruṃ mahādevaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
vināyakam umāṃ caiva tataḥ sūtraṃ prapātayet ||
maṇḍape navakoṣṭhāni kalpayitvā samantataḥ |
aṣṭau kuṇḍāni kāryāṇi īśāne navamaṃ bhavet ||
madhyakoṣṭhaṃ praviśtīrya sitavastrāṇi sarvataḥ |
tilaiḥ śuddhair mahāmeruṃ madhye kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
uttamas tripalair bhārair dvyekābhyāṃ madhyamādhamau |
ṣaḍbhāgena tataḥ kāryāḥ samantād varṣaparvatāḥ ||
mālyavān niṣadhaś caiva himavān hemakūṭakaḥ |
gandhamādanaśailaś ca śṛṅgavān śvetaśailakau ||
aindrādiṣu nidhātavyā vasobhiś chādayed bahiḥ |
kalpadrumas tu sauvarṇaḥ sarvaratnopaśobhitaḥ ||
sarvapuṣpaphalopeto nyastavyo merumūrdhani |
haimān mṛgān khagāṃś cāpi drumāṃś cāpi vinirdiśet ||
sarvaśaileṣu mandāramṛgapakṣyādikaṃ ca yat |
nidhātavyaṃ prayatnena turīyāṃśena merutaḥ ||
sumeror dvādaśapalaṃ daśāṣṭau vāpy anukramāt |
suvarṇasya pramāṇaṃ syād uttamādhamamadhyamam ||
adhastāt kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ sauvarṇakamale haram |
sukhāsīnaṃ caturbāhuṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam ||
trinetraṃ saumyavadanaṃ sauvarṇaṃ nyasya pūjayet |
śivanāmā tu madhye syād bhavaḥ śambhus tilocanaḥ ||
[375]        sthānur īśo mahādevaḥ śaṅkaraś candraśekharaḥ |
pūrvādiṣu mahādevam ebhir nāmabhir arcayet ||
divāhaviṣyabhojī syāt sagurus te ca ṛtvijaḥ |
svena svena vidhānena gṛhyoktena viśeṣataḥ ||
hutvājyabhāgau juhuyād yathoktaṃ sarvam ācaret |
vastraiḥ prapūjyajet sarvān ṛtvijo gurum eva ca ||
dviguṇaṃ gurave dadyāt kuṇḍalīr aṅgulīyakaiḥ |
upānacchatraśayyābhir [?] āsanaiḥ pādukena ca ||
tato vimūla āditye puṇyakāla upasthite |
anujñātas tut air viprair yajamānaḥ prasannadhīḥ ||
sarvauṣadhijalasnātaḥ kṣaumavāsāḥ svalaṃkṛtaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ giriṃ kṛtvā viprān āhūya yatnataḥ ||
jñānino guṇasaṃpannān ātmaniṣṭhān alolupān |
vedavedāṅgaviduṣas taṃ ca devaṃ prakalpya ca ||
tasya tasya gireḥ pārśve tattannāmnā prapūjayet |
meruṃ tat prathamaṃ dadyāc chivaḥ saṃprīyatām iti ||
guṇotkṛṣṭāya viprāya bhāvayitvā tu taṃ śivam |
evaṃ pūrvādiśailāṃs tu tattannāmnā pradāpayet ||
prīyatām iti tān viprāṃs tattaddevaṃ prakalpya ca |
sarvaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ ca nivedya parameṣṭhinam ||
pūjayitvā dvijān agre dīnāndhakṛpaṇāṃs tataḥ |
āśīrmaṅgalasaṃyuktas tato bandhusamanvitaḥ ||
[376]        anena vidhinā yas tu dadyāt tilamayaṃ girim |
na tasya vidyate kiṃcit pāpaṃ saptajanodbhavam ||
vimānena śivaṃ gacchen niḥkāmo yaḥ samācaret |
sakāmo labhate kāmān yaṃ yam icchati cetasā ||
iti praśnottaratantroktatilaśailadānavidhiḥ |
atha kārpāsaparvatadānavidhiḥ | padmapurāṇāt |
karpāsaparvatas tadviṃśadbhārair ihottamaḥ |
daśabhir madhyamaḥ proktaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ pañcabhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
bhāreṇālpadhano dadyād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
dhānyaparvatavat sarvam āsādyaṃ rājasattama ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu sarvaryāṃ dadyād idam udīrayet |
tvam evācaraṇaṃ yasmāl lokānām iha sarvadā ||
karpāsācala tasmāt tvam aghoghadhvaṃsano bhava |
evaṃ karpāsaśailendraṃ yo dadyāt parvasaṃnidhau |
rudraloke vaset kalpaṃ tato rājā bhaved iha ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
bhagavān uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi karpāsācalam uttamam |
paramaṃ sarvadānānāṃ priyaṃ sarvadivaikasām ||
deśakālau samāsādya dhanaṃ śraddhāṃ ca yatnataḥ |
deyam etan mahādānaṃ tāraṇārthaṃ kulasya ca ||
[377]        parvataṃ kalpayet tatra kārpāsena vidhānataḥ |
pūrvoktena vidhānena kṛtvā sarvaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
viṃśadbhāras tu kartavya uttamaḥ parvato budhaiḥ |
madhyamaṃ daśabhiḥ kuryāj jaghanyaṃ pañcabhis tathā ||
sarvadhānyasamūhasya madhye hy oṣadhibhir vṛtam |
rasai ratnaiś ca saṃyuktaṃ lokapālāvṛtaṃ tathā ||
brahmādayas tathā śṛṅge kāñcanena vinirmitāḥ |
kulākulāṃś ca catvāraś caturbhāgena kalpayet ||
sauvarṇaśikharān sarvān sarvaratnopaśobhitān |
nānādhātuvicitrāṅgān bhakṣyabhojyasamāvṛtān ||
homo vyāhṛtibhiś caiva (?) agnau taddaivatair api |
gandhena sarpiṣā tatra tathā kṛṣṇatilair api ||
ayutaṃ homasaṃsthā ca pālāśasamidhas tathā |
śaṅkhatūryaninādaiś ca tathā maṅgalapāṭhakaiḥ ||
utsavaṃ kārayet tatra dinam ekam atandritaḥ |
parvakāle tato dadyāt pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
namaḥ sarvāmaravāsabhūtasaṅghair abhiṣṭutaḥ |
brahmādayo me varadā bhavantu vibudhāḥ sadā ||
ity uccārya naro dadyān nārī vā vidhipūrvakam |
pūjayitvā dvijān samyak vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dānam etat prayacchati |
[378]        sa gacchet tridaśāvāsaṃ vimānopari saṃsthitaḥ ||
apsarogaṇasaṃvīto gandharvair abhisaṃsthitaḥ |
tatra manvantaraṃ yāvad uktvā vibudhālaye ||
puṇyakṣayād ihābhyetya mahīm bhuṅkte sasāgarām |
rūpavān subhago vāgmī śrīmān atulavikarmaḥ ||
pañcajanmāni nāvī vā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
bhūyaś ca śṛṇu rājendra divyaṃ kārpāsaparvatam ||
taṃ ca bhāraśatenaiva kuryād ardhena vā punaḥ |
śeṣaṃ pūrvavidhānena sarvaṃ kuryād yathākramam ||
phalaṃ pūrvoditaṃ caiva jāyate nṛpasattama ||
iti kārpāsaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
atha ghṛtācaladāna vidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ghṛtaśailam anuttamam |
tejo ‘mṛtamayaṃ divyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
viṃśatyā ghṛtakumbhānām uttamaḥ syāt ghṛtācalaḥ |
daśabhir madhyamaḥ proktaḥ pañcabhir adhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
alpavittaḥ prakurvīta dvābhyāṃ meruvidhānataḥ |
viṣkambhaparvatāṃs tadvac caturbhāge na kalpayet ||
śālitaṇḍulapātrāṇi kumbhopari niveśayet |
kārayet saṃhatān sarvān yathāśobhaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
veṣṭayet śuklavāsobhir ikṣudaṇḍaphalādikaiḥ |
dhānyaparvatavac cheṣavidhānam iha paṭhyate ||
[379]        adhivāsaṃ ca kurvīta tadvad dhomaṃ surācanam ||
atra palasahasraparimitaṃ ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakumbhaḥ prasiddhaḥ kumbhagrahaṇe tasyāniyataparimāṇatvād anavasthitaśāstrārthaprasaṅgāt tac ca dravadravyatvād ādhāram apekṣata iti | śālitaṇḍulapātrāṇi kumbopari niveśayed ity anena tasya kalaśādhāratvāt pratipādyate taṇḍulapātrāṇīti parvatapañcakāpekṣayā bahuvacanam |
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ gurave vinivedayet |
viṣkambhaparvatāṃs tadvad ṛtvigbhyaḥ śāntamānasaḥ ||
saṃyogād ghṛtam utpannaṃ yasmād amṛtatejasaḥ |
tasmād ghṛtārcir viśvātmā prīyatām atra śaṅkaraḥ ||
yas tu tejomayaṃ brahma ghṛte tac ca vyavasthitam |
ghṛtaparvatarūpeṇa tasmān naḥ pāhi bhūdharaḥ ||
anena vidhinā dadyād ghṛtācalam anuttamam |
mahāpātakayukto ‘pi lokam āyāti śāṅkaram ||
haṃsasārasayuktena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā |
vimānenāpsarobhiś ca siddhavidyādharair vṛtaḥ |
viharet pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
iti padmapurāṇokto ghṛtaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
atha ratnācaladānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ratnācalam anuttamam |
muktāphalasahasreṇa parvataḥ syād ihottamaḥ ||
[380]        madhyamaḥ pañcaśatikas triśatenādhamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
caturthāṃśena viṣkambhaparvatāḥ syuḥ samantataḥ ||
pūrveṇa vajragomedair dakṣiṇe indranīlakaiḥ |
puṣparāgayutaiḥ kāryo vidvadbhir gandhamādanaḥ ||
vaidūryavidrumaiḥ paścāt saṃmiśro vipulācalaḥ |
padmarāgaiḥ sa sauparṇer uttareṇa tu vinyaset ||
vajragomedaiḥ samasaṃkhyaiḥ, samaṃ syād aśrutatvād iti nyāyāt evam uttaratrāpi vijñeyam | sauparṇaḥ garuḍātmajaḥ | sauvarṇer iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ |
dhānyaparvatavat sarvam atrāpi parikalpayet |
tadvad āvāhanaṃ kuryād dakṣān devāṃś ca kāñcanān ||
pūjayet puṣpapānīyaiḥ prabhāte ca visarjanam |
pūrvavad guruṛtvigbhya imān mantrān udīrayet ||
yathā devagaṇāḥ sarve sarvaratneṣv api sthitāḥ |
tvaṃ ca ratnamayo nityam ataḥ pāhi mahācalaḥ ||
yasmād ratnapradānena vṛṣṭiṃ prakurute hariḥ |
mahāratnapradānena tasmān naḥ pāhi parvata ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyād ratnamayaṃ girim |
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam amareśvarapūjitaḥ ||
yāvat kalpaśataṃ sārdhaṃ vased iha narādhipa |
rūpārogyaguṇopetaḥ saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ||
[381]        brahmahatyādikaṃ kiṃcid yad atrāmutra vā kṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti girir vajrahato yathā ||
iti padmapurāṇokto ratnaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rūpyācalam anuttamam |
yat pradānān naro yāti somalokaṃ dvijottamaḥ ||
daśabhiḥ palasāhasrair uttamo rājatācalaḥ |
pañcabhir madhyamaḥ proktas tadardhenādharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
aśaktau viṃśater ūrdhvaṃ kārayec chaktitaḥ sadā |
viṣkambhaparvatāṃs tadvat turīyāṃśena kalpayet ||
pūrvavad rājatān kuryān mandarādīn vidhānataḥ |
kaladhautamayāṃs tatra lokeśān arcayed budhaḥ ||
kaladhautaṃ kāñcanam |
brahmaviṣṇvarkavān kāryo nitambo ‘tra hiraṇmayaḥ |
rājataṃ syād yad anyeṣāṃ sarvaṃ tad iha kāñcanam ||
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat kuryāt homajāgaraṇādikam |
dadyāt tadvat prabhāte tu gurave raupyaparvatam ||
viṣkambhaśailān ṛtvigbhyaḥ pūjyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan dadyād darbhapāṇir vimatsaraḥ ||
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ yasmād dharmasya śaṅkarasya ca |
rajataṃ pāhi tasmān naḥ śokasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
itthaṃ niveśya yo dadyād rājatācalam uttamam |
[382]        gavāyutasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
somaloke sa gandharvaiḥ kinnaro ‘psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
pūjyamāno vased vidvān yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
iti padmapurāṇokto rūpyācaladānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śarkarācalam uttamam |
yasya pradānād viṣṇvarkarudrās tuṣyanti sarvadā ||
aṣṭabhiḥ śarkarābhārair uttamaḥ syān mahācalaḥ |
caturbhir madhyamaḥ prokto bhārābhyām adharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
bhāreṇa vārdhabhāreṇa kuryād yaḥ svalpavittavān |
viṣkambhaparvatān kuryāt turīyāṃśena mānavaḥ ||
dhānyaparvatavat sarvam āsādyāmarasaṃyutam |
meror upari tadvac ca sthāpya hematarutrayam ||
mandāraḥ pārijātaś ca tṛtīyaḥ kalpapādapaḥ |
etad vṛkṣatrayaṃ mūrdhniṃ(?) sarveṣv api niveśayet ||
haricandanasaṃtānau pūrvapaścimabhāgayoḥ |
niveśyau sarvaśaileṣu viśeṣāc charkarācale ||
mandāre kāmadevaś ca pratyagvaktraḥ sadā bhavet |
gandhamādanaśṛṅge ca dhanadaḥ syād udaṅmukhaḥ ||
prāṅmukho vedamūrtiś ca haṃsaḥ syād vipulācale |
haimī suparśve surabhī dakṣiṇābhimukhī bhavet ||
dhānyaparvatavat sarvam āvāhanamakhādikam |
[383]        kṛtvātha gurave dadyān madhyamaṃ parvatottamam ||
ṛtvigbhyaś caturaḥ śailān imān mantrān udīrayet |
saubhāgyāmṛtasāro ‘yaṃ paramaṃ śarkarā yataḥ ||
tan mamānandakārī tvaṃ bhava sailendra sarvadā |
amṛtaṃ pivatāṃ (?) ye tu nipetur bhuvi sīkarāḥ ||
devānāṃ tatsamaṃ somaṃ pāhi naḥ sarkarācalaḥ |
mama bhavatu madhyā yad udbhūtā śarkarā yataḥ ||
tanmayo ‘si mahāśaila pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt |
yo dadyāc charkarāśailam anena vidhinā naraḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti śivamandiram |
candrādityapratīkāśam adhiruhyānujīvibhiḥ ||
sahaiva yānam ātiṣṭhet sat u viṣṇupracoditaḥ |
tataḥ kalpaśatānte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ||
āyurārogyasaṃpanno yāvajjanmāyutatrayam |
bhojanaṃ śaktitaḥ kuryāt sarvaśaile vimatsaraḥ ||
sarvatrākṣāralavaṇam aśnīyāt tadanujñayā ||
bhojanaṃ kuryād iti, dānānantaraṃ yathāśakti brāhmaṇebhyo bhojanadānaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | svayam api akṣāralavaṇam aśnīyād iti |
parvatopaskarān sarvān prāpayed brāhmaṇālayam |
paśyed imān apy adhano ‘pi bhaktyā
spṛśen manuśyair iha dīyamānān |
śṛṇoti bhaktyātha matiṃ dadāti
niḥkalmaṣaḥ so ‘pi divaṃ prayāti ||
[384]        duḥsvapnapraśamam upaiti paṭhyamānaiḥ
śailendrair bhavabhayabhedanair manuṣyaḥ |
yaḥ kuryāt kim u munipiṅgaveha samyak
sattvātmā sakalagirīndra saṃpradānam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaḥ śarkarācaladānavidhiḥ |
atha śaivāni dvādaśamerudānāni nirūpyante | tatra kālottaraśaivaśāstrāt |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi merudānaṃ yathākramam |
ā kārttikāt samārabhya meruvrataṃ samācaret ||
kārttikyāṃ ratnameruś ca dātavyas tu śivāgrataḥ |
sarveṣāṃ caiva merūṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu ||
vajrapadmamahānīlanīlasphaṭikasaṃjñakaḥ |
puṣpaṃ marakataṃ muktā grāhyāḥ svavibhavena tu ||
prasthamātrās tu saṃgrāhyāḥ prasthād ardhārdham eva vā |
yathāśaktyātha vā deyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā suta ||
meror vibhāgaṃ vakṣyāmi śivasyāgre yathārcayet |
karṇikāyāṃ nyasen meruṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśabhūṣitam (?) ||
tat sarve mālyavān nāma parvataṃ pūjayet tadā |
tat pūrve bhadrasaṃjñaṃ tu aśvavṛkṣās tataḥ param ||
merutaḥ pūrvadigbhāge pūrvapūrvottaratrayam |
kathitaṃ sa viśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇasyāntataḥ param ||
niṣadho hemakūṭaś ca himavāṃś ca tathā trayam |
evam uttarabhāge tu nīlaḥ śvetaś ca śṛṅgavān ||
[385]        paścime gandhamādākhyaṃ ketuṃ vai ketumālyakam |
evaṃ dvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ meruparvatanāyakam ||
sopavāsaḥ śucir bhūtvā viśeṣāt pūjayec chivam |
mahāsnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ mahāpūjātha vā suta ||
pūnānte devadevāgre ratnameruṃ prakalpayet |
pradadyāc chivaviprāya śivamantram anusmaret ||
mahāsnānaṃ mahāpūjā ca liṅgapurāṇe |
mahāsnānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād ghṛtena vidhinaiva tu |
sa yāti mama sāyujyaṃ sthāneṣv eteṣu suvrate ||
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñryam abhyaṅgaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
palānāṃ dve sahasre tu mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtitam ||
snāpya liṅgaṃ madīyaṃ ca gavyenaiva ghṛtena ca |
viśodhya sarvadravyais tu yāvadbhir abhiṣiñcati ||
mahāsnāne prasakte tu snānam aṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam |
jalena kevalenaiva gandhatoyena śaktitaḥ ||
anulepanaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ pañcaviṃśatpalena vai |
śamīpatraṃ ca vidhinā bilvapatraṃ ca paṅkajam ||
athānyāni ca patrāṇi bilvapatraṃ na saṃtyajet |
daśadroṇais tu naivedyam aṣṭadroṇair athāpi vā ||
daśadrōṇasamaṃ puṇyam āḍhake tu vidhīyate |
vittahīnasya bhaktasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
bherīmṛdaṅgamurajatimilāpaṭahādibhiḥ |
[386]        vāditrair vividhaiś canyai rāndolair vividhair api ||
jāgaraṃ kārayet tatra prārthayet tu yathākramam |
svabhṛtyaputradāraiś ca tathā saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ ||
sārdhaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prārthayel liṅgam aiśvaram |
dravyahīnaiḥ kriyāhīnaiḥ śraddhāhīnaiḥ sureśvara ||
kṛtaṃ vāpy akṛtaṃ vāpi kṣantum arhasi śaṅkara |
ity uktvā caiva rudraṃ ca tvaritaṃ śāntim eva ca ||
maṃ ity eva mahābījaṃ tathā pañcākṣarasya vai ||
meror anumantraṇamantrās tu kālottara evoktāḥ |
namaḥ kāñcanadevāya dharādharāya vai namaḥ |
brahmaviṣṇvīśaśṛṅgāya dharānābhisthitāya ca ||
nagadvādaśanāthāya sarvapāpāpahāriṇe |
śivabhaktāya śuddhāya trāṇaṃ me kuru sarvadā ||
niṣpāpaḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ śivaṃ gacchāmi huṃ namaḥ |
tvaṃ śivas tu śivasyāgre śivo ‘haṃ ca śivāya ca ||
nivedayāmi bhaktyā tu pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇāya ca || iti |
tathā |
vastrāśvasahito merus tatra puṇyaphale śṛṇu |
lakṣayojanamānasya meror ye parmāṇavaḥ ||
tāvatkalpasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate |
uddharen narakāto so ‘pi trisaptakulasantatim ||
tadanvayagatā ye tu ḍimbhāḍimbhahatā narāḥ |
mahāpātakinaś cānye tathā viśvāsaghātakāḥ ||
gurudrohakṛtā ye tu bhrūṇahāḥ pitṛghātakāḥ |
[387]        prasave tu mṛtā nārī kumārī śīladūṣitā ||
tāṃ vā rudrasya sāmīpyaṃ sa nayen merudānakṛt |
merudānaṃ ca manasā yaḥ smaret tu śivāgrataḥ ||
yāty asau śivalokaṃ tu dehānte dhautakilbiṣaḥ |
hemamerupramāṇaṃ tu phalṃ caiva śṛṇuṣva tat ||
pālānāṃ tu sahasreṇa madhye meruṃ prakalpayet |
śṛṅgatrayasamāyuktaṃ brahmaviṣṇuharānvitam ||
ekaikaṃ parvataṃ tasya śataikaikena kārayet |
meruṇā saha pūrveṇa vikhyātās tu trayodaśa ||
evaṃ śivāgrato merur dātavyas tu prayatnataḥ |
anayeṣu ca sarveṣu grahaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
ācāryāya pradātavyaḥ saṃhitāpāragāya ca |
pūrvoktasya mahāmeroḥ sanagasya mahātmanaḥ ||
śivaloke vaset so ‘pi yāvat tatparamāṇavaḥ |
pitṝn pitāmahāṃś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahān ||
putrān pautrān prapautrāṃś ca tārayet kim ataḥ param |
bhogān bhuktvā mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ bhuṅkte ca śivabhāvinaḥ ||
daridro rūpyameruṃ tu hemamānena kārayet |
parvatā dvādaśa tathā saṃkalpyā racanānvitāḥ ||
uttare hy ayane deyaṃ deyaṃ vā grahaṇadvaye |
prāg utktaṃ tu phalaṃ tasya bhavaty atra na saṃśayaḥ ||
bhūmimerupramāṇaṃ tu kathyamānaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat |
viṣayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cātha grāmaṃ vā parvataṃ smaret ||
[388]        śeṣās tadaṣṭamāṃśena nagāḥ syū ravisaṃkhyayā |
bhūmiparvatapuṇyaṃ tu ko vā varṇayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||
parmāṇuvrajo yāvat kṣitīśo bhavati dhruvam |
tāvat koṭisahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
bhogān bhuktvā tato rājā jāyate yogināṃ kule |
jñānaṃ prāpya tadā tasya punarjanma na vidyate ||
hastimeruṃ tato vakṣye saṃkṣepāt pārvatīsuta |
na vṛddhaṃ na tathā bālaṃ ratnapucchasuśobhitam ||
śūlaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam |
nakṣatramālāsaṃyuktaṃ śastradhvajavibhūṣitam ||
divyavastrasamāyuktaṃ suvarṇaracanāyutam |
sūryasya grahaṇe deyaṃ gurave taṃ śivāgrataḥ ||
tena dattena dattaṃ tu lakṣayojanaparvatam |
puruṣatrayasamāyuktaṃ parvatadvādaśānvitam ||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivasāyujyatāṃ vrajet |
pitaras tasya modante rudraloke samantataḥ |
etat tava samākhyātaṃ hastidānaṃ samāsataḥ ||
athāśvamerur vā deyo yo datto raviṇā purā |
śvetair vinītaiḥ suvarṇaiḥ pratyagraiḥ pañcasaṃkhyayā ||
madhye meruḥ kalpitavyo ravisaṃkhyās tu parvatāḥ |
savastrahemadāraiś ca sapta vā dhvajabhūṣitāḥ ||
vaiśākhyāṃ vātha kārttikyāṃ dātavyas tu śivāgrataḥ |
viprāya śivabhaktāya saṃhitāpāragāya ca ||
[389]        tasmai deyo yathoktas tu hayamerur vidhānataḥ |
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā hemakaṅkaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ ||
rasanāmukuṭenaiva aṅgulīyadvayena ca |
sarveṣāṃ caiva dāne tu bhūṣaṇair bhūṣayet tadā ||
akṛtrimair bhūṣaṇais tu rājā meruṃ vibhūṣayet |
aśvamerupradānena rudraloke mahīyate ||
yāvanty aśveṣu romāṇi tāvadvarṣāyutāni ca |
mahākalpasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
aśvālābhe daridras tu gomerurṃ vā prakalpayet |
aśvasaṃkhyāpramāṇena phalaṃ caitat samaṃ bhavet ||
atha vā vastrameruś ca dātavyas tu śivāgrataḥ |
bhāramātreṇa padmais tu nānāvarṇaiḥ suparvataḥ ||
madhye meruḥ kalpanīyo vastaiḥ śeṣāṃs tu kalpayet |
meravas tasya mānena nānāvarṇaiḥ suśobhitaiḥ ||
pratyekaṃ parvatāḥ kalpyā hemaśṛṅgāḥ suvarṇakāḥ |
śivabhaktāya viprāya dātavyās tu śivāgrataḥ ||
divyaiśvaryapadaṃ yāti sahasrakratusaṃbhavam |
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ samyak kuryād bhogaṃ yathepsayā ||
cakravartitvam abhyeti jñānavān jāyate tadā |
śivālayaṃ tato yāti na bhūyo janma cāpnuyāt ||
atha vā ghṛtamerus tu dātavyaḥ kathyate mayā |
meruḥ palānāṃ madhye tu sahasraiḥ pañcabhir hitaḥ ||
śataiḥ pañcabhir ekaikaṃ parvataṃ tatra kalpayet |
[390]        triśṛṅgaṃ tripalaṃ meroḥ kāñcanaṃ devatārcanam ||
ekaikapalikaṃ śeṣaparvate vastrabhūṣite |
kṛtvā pūjāṃ viśeṣeṇa śivasyāgre prakalpayet ||
śivabhaktāya viprāya dātavyaḥ śivam icchatā |
kulam uddharate so ‘pi paitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ tathā ||
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sārdhaṃ rudraloke mahīyate |
bhārate pṛthivīkhaṇḍe patir bhavati nānyathā ||
evaṃ vai khaṇḍameruṃ tu sitakhaṇḍena kalpayet |
rudralokapadaṃ yāti pitṛbhiḥ saha modate ||
atha vā dhānyameruṃ tu śivasyāgre prakalpayet |
pañakhārīmitaṃ madhye meruṃ dhānyena kalpayet ||
ekaikaṃ khārimātreṇa parvataṃ śeṣam ādiśet |
pūrvavad dhemaśṛṅgaṃ tu savastraṃ parikalpayet ||
śivapūjāvasāne tu śivaviprāya dāpayet |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
pitaras tasya modante brahmaloke tathā ciram |
etadaṣṭāṃśamānena tilameruṃ prakalpayet ||
śṛṅgāṇi pūrvavat tasya tathācānyanageṣu ca |
tilamerurḥ pradātavyaḥ śivasyāgre guroḥ sadā ||
prayāti śivasāyujyaṃ bandhubhiḥ sahito naraḥ |
daśakoṭisahasrāṇi bhuktvā bhogān yathecchayā ||
samastamedinīṃ bhuṅkte śive paścāt pralīyate |
[391]        iti dvādaśasaṃkhyātāḥ parvatāḥ kathitās tava ||
atha mantraṃ tathākālaṃ jñātvā meruṃ pradāpayet |
ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu grahaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
merupradānaṃ kartavyam upoṣya suciraṃ sadā ||
iti śaivadvādaśamerudānāni |
haṃsa uvāca |
bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu dānaṃ mahāphalam |
yad datvā puruṣo ṛjan neha saṃjāyate punaḥ ||
merur hemamayaś caiva triśṛṅgo rājato ‘pi vā |
palatrayeṇa sauvarṇo viṃśatyā rājataiḥ palaiḥ ||
tāmraiḥ pañcaśatā proktā palānāṃ kāṃsyakas tathā |
lohaś ca bhāramātras tu sīsakasya tathā smṛtaḥ ||
lavaṇasyāpy evam eva vrīhīṇām eva me vaca |
bhāradvayena khātas tu gauḍaḥ syāt pañcabhārakaḥ ||
kāstūrikaḥ pañcapalaḥ kārpūraḥ palaviṃśateḥ |
kauṅkamaḥ (?) syāc chatapalaḥ kārpāsaḥ ṣaḍtriṃśabhārakaḥ ||
evaṃ dravyaviśeṣais tu meruḥ kāryo vijānatā |
yathā gamaṃ tathā kāryaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
vicāre kriyamāṇe ca hetukatvaṃ prasajyate |
hetupratiṣṭho vijñeyaḥ puruṣo rāgadūṣitaḥ ||
rāgādidoṣaduṣṭas tu puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tasmān meroḥ pramāṇas tu bhāṣitaṃ brahmaṇā svayam ||
[392]        āstikāya vinītāya procyate kṛpayā vibho |
nāstikāya na vaktavyaṃ vākyaṃ darmaṃ vijānatā ||
kṛtvā meruṃ triśṛṅgaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ rājatādikaṃ |
arcayet pītakusumair jāgaraṃ kalpayet tataḥ ||
brāhmaṇaṃ pātrabhūtaṃ tu kale tu grahaṇādike |
āhūya prakṣālya pādau āsane tūpaveśayet ||
meruṃ parvatarājaṃ tu gṛhāṇ tvaṃ dvijottama |
mamānukampayā brahmaṇ varāhaḥ prīyatām iti ||
ko dād iti tu mantreṇa grahaḥ kāryo vijānatā |
meruṃ samarpya viprāya dravyeṇa svecchayā kṛtam ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi koṭiṃ vāpi mahīyate |
vasanti svargalokeṣu yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
iti viṣṇudharmokto meridānavidhiḥ |
atha pañcaparvadānavidhiḥ |
tilaparvatadānaṃ ca tathā lavaṇaparvataḥ |
kārpāsaguḍayoś caiva tathā sarṣapaparvataḥ ||
dhānyaparvatadānasya vidhir atrāpi kīrtitaḥ |
phalaṃ puṇyaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tat pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ ||
āṣāḍhe kārttike caiva māghavaiśākhayor api |
pūrṇamāsyāṃ tu dātavyaṃ dānam etad yudhiṣṭhira ||
bhūpradeśe tu lipte tu puṣpakīrṇe suśobhite |
tilānāṃ bahuvarṇānāṃ kumbhaṃ kumbhārdham eva vā ||
[393]        viṃśatidroṇam atha vā ṣoḍaśadroṇam eva vā |
tiladroṇāṣṭakair vāpi caturbhir atha vā punaḥ ||
tribhir droṇair alābhe tu kurvīta tilaparvatam ||
kumbo ‘tra viṃśatidroṇaparimāṇaḥ tac ca droṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ khārīviṃśatyā kumbha ucyate ityādinā paribhāṣāyām upadarśitam, kumbho drōṇadvayam iti gṛhyamāṇe viṃśatidroṇādikaṃ prathamakalpād anukalpam anukalpya na samañjasaṃ syāt itaratra tu sārdhakumbhena prathamakalpaḥ viṃśatidroṇādir anukalpa iti yuktaṃ syāt |
suvarṇai rajatais tāmraiḥ kāṃsyaiḥ śauktaiś ca mauktikaiḥ |
ikṣudaṇḍasamākīrṇān vanakhaṇḍāṃś ca kārayet ||
guḍena vividhān kuryāt pāṣāṇaśikharāṃs tathā |
tāmbūlaphalapuṣpādyair alaṃkārādy anekadhāḥ ||
kuryāt mṛgapaśupakṣinas tāmrasauvarṇarājatān |
dvādaśa pūrṇakumbhāṃś ca phalaśākhyādiśobhitān ||
sthāpayitvā tu sarvatra pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ caiva jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ vrajet ||
lavaṇasya sarṣapāṇāṃ tatparmāṇaṃ tathaiva ca |
kārpāsaparvataṃ cāpi tulyasaṃkhyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
puṇyakāleṣu labhate nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
parvatasyottare pārśve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ||
sthāpayel lokapālāṃś ca diśāsu vidiśāsu ca |
arcayed arghapādyaiś ca gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ||
[394]        toraṇaiś ca patakābhiḥ śobhayitvā caturdiśam |
agnikāryaṃ ca kurvīta tilādyaiḥ pañcavāruṇaiḥ ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā śailadānam anuttamam |
krīḍāśaile mahāramye krīḍitvā kalam īpsitat ||
dharmeṇa pūjyamāno ‘tha śakralokaṃ sa gacchati |
śakralokaṃ nayed ante kulakoṭiśatatrayam ||
paścān mahodaye ramie somarājapurottame |
ramitvā varṣakoṭiṃ tu dviguṇaṃ parisaṃkhyayā ||
bhūyo janmatrayaṃ rājyaṃ bhuṅkte nihatakaṇṭakam ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaḥ pañcaparvatadānavidhiḥ |
atha śikharadānavidhiḥ |
rāma uvāca |
śikharāṇāṃ mamācakṣva dānaṃ tripuranāśanam |
yāni datvā tu daurbhāgyaṃ daurgatyaṃ na parjāpate ||
śaṅkara uvāca |
śṛṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi śikharāṇāṃ yathākramam |
dānaṃ deyaṃ yathā yena tat śṛṇuṣva sanātanam ||
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya vā punaḥ |
tṛtīyā vātha vaiśākhe śuklā yā rohiṇīyutā ||
prauṣṭhapadyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa tu bhārgava |
guṣekṣuvastralavaṇadhānyakājājiśarkarāḥ ||
kharjūratanduladrākṣākṣaudrair malayajana ca |
[395]        phalair manoharaiḥ ramyaiḥ śikharāṇi pradāpayet ||
eṣām anyatamaṃ dadyād yathāśraddhaṃ vidhānataḥ |
ātmapramāṇaṃ kurvīta prādeśābhyadhikaṃ śubham ||
bhuvai gomayaliptāyām ikṣupatrāṇi saṃstaret |
tataḥ kurvīta śikharaṃ gaurīsthānam anuttamam ||
dvihastaṃ mūlaṃ kartavyaṃ hastamātraṃ śiras tathā |
bhittir ikṣudalaiḥ kāryā veṣṭayed raktavāsasā ||
dānadravyeṇa tanmadhyaṃ pūrayed bhṛgunandana |
ikṣupatrakaṭe gaurīṃ tasyopari nivedayet ||
caturbhujāṃ hemamayīṃ pūjayet kuṅkumena tu ||
gaurīrūpam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
veṣṭayet sūkṣamavastreṇa devīṃ śikharam eva ca |
aṣṭāṅgaṃ pūjayed gaurīṃ mantrair etais tu bhaktitaḥ ||
namo bhavānyai pādau tu kāminyai jānunī tataḥ |
vāmadevyai tathā corū nābhiṃ caiva jagatpriye ||
ānandāyai tu hṛdayaṃ nandāyai pūjayet stanau |
subhadrāyai mukhaṃ pūjyaṃ lalitāyai namaḥ śiraḥ ||
evaṃ pūjya mahādevīṃ śikharān abhimantrayet |
yasmān nivāsaḥ pārvatyāḥ śikhara tvaṃ surair vṛtaḥ ||
tasmān mām pāhi bhagavaṃs tvaṃ gaurīśikharaḥ sadā |
evam āmantrya śikharaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ yatavrataḥ ||
tataḥ snātvā prabhāte tu dadyān mantreṇa bhaktitaḥ |
yasmāt tvaṃ sarvabhūtānām upariṣṭād avasthitaḥ ||
[396]        tasmāc chivaḥ prīyatāṃ me tava dānāt sadānaghaḥ |
ardhabhāgaṃ caturthaṃ vā pañcamaṃ vā tato guroḥ ||
datvā śeṣaṃ tu bandhūnāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ svajanasya ca |
anujīvisvabhṛtyānāṃ durgatānāṃ ca kāmataḥ ||
evaṃ datvā tu śikharaṃ gauryā bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
sa muktakeśaḥ saṃprāśya kṣīraṃ ghṛtam athāpi vā ||
vidhinānena yo dadyād gauryāḥ śikharam uttamam |
sa vased bhavane devyāḥ kalpakoṭiśatavratam ||
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya jāyate pṛthivīpatiḥ |
anena vidhinā deyaṃ vidhihīnaṃ na kārayet ||
vidhihīnaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ na dātuḥ phaladaṃ bhavet ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe parvatadānaprakaraṇam
[397]
saptamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
athātidānavidhānam ucyate |
athātidānāni satāṃ hitāya
hemādisūriḥ prakaṭī karoti |
dānena yeṣāṃ sakṛd apy analpa-
kalyāntasākṣī varabhogayogaḥ ||
kāni punas tānīty apekṣāyāṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
trīṇy āhur atidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī |
narakād uddharanty eva japavāpanadohanaiḥ || iti |
atra yady api dhenuśabdena svarūpato gaurevābhidīyate | tathāpi dhenuśabdasādhāraṇyādi-prakaraṇe guḍadhenvādīnām api saṃniveśo yuktaḥ tāsu ca krameṇa nirūpyamāṇāsu daśamī syāt svaūpata iti svarūpadhenor ante sthitatvād guḍadhenvādaya eva prathamato nirūpyante | tad uktaṃ matsyapurāṇe |
yās tu pāpavināśinyaḥ paṭhyante daśadhenavaḥ |
tāsāṃ svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi nāmāni ca narādhipa ||
[398]        prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syāt ghṛtadhenus tathāparā |
tiladhenus tṛtīyā tu caturthī jalasaṃjñitā ||
kṣīradhenuś ca vikhyātā madhudhenus tathāparā |
saptamī śarkarā dhenur dadhidhenur athāṣṭamī ||
rasadhenur navamī syād daśamī syāt svarūpataḥ |
etāvat tu vidhānaṃ ca tam ācakṣva jagatpate ||
kiṃ rūpaṃ kena mantreṇa dātavyā tad ihocyatām ||
matsya uvāca |
guḍadhenuvidhānasya yad rūpam iha yat phalam |
tad idānīṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpavināśanam ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ caturhastaṃ prāgrīvaṃ vinyased bhuvi |
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ darbhān āstīrya sarvataḥ ||
laghveṇakājinaṃ tadvad vatsasya parikalpayet |
prāṅmukhīṃ prāpayed dhenum udakpādāṃ savatsakām ||
eṇakājinaṃ kṛṣṇājinam, prāṅmukhīṃ prākśirasam ity arthaḥ | taduttareṇa vatso ‘pi tathaiva parikalpanīyaḥ |
uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syāt sadā bhāram anuttamam |
vatsaṃ bhāreṇa kurvīta bhārābhyāṃ madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ardhabhāreṇa vatsaḥ syāt gṛhavittānusārataḥ |
[399] bhārāḥ paribhāṣāyāṃ vyākhyātāḥ | gṛhavittānusārata iti iyam uttamamadhyamādikalpanā nijavittānusārataḥ kartavyety arthaḥ |
dhenuvatsau ghṛtāsyau tau sitasūkṣmāmbarāvṛtau |
śuktikarṇāv ikṣupādau śucimuktāphalekṣaṇau ||
sitasūtrasirālau tau sitakambalakambalau |
tāmrakadrūkapṛṣṭhau tau sitacāmararomakau ||
gadrūkaṃ (?) kakutpradeśaḥ |
vidrumabhrūyugopetau navanītastanānvitau |
kṣomapucchau kāṃsyadohāv indranīlakatārakau ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgābharaṇau rājatakhurasaṃyutau |
nānāphalamayair dantair ghrāṇagandhakaraṇḍakau ||
atra ca sārataḥ parimāṇataś ca phalaviśeṣa iti | yathāśakti suvarṇaśṛṅgāditvam avadheyam |
ity evaṃ racayitvā tu dhūpadīpair athārcayet |
athāmantraṇamantraḥ
oṃ yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deveṣv avasthitā |
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
dehasthā yā ca rudrāṇī śaṅkarasya sadā priyā |
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
viṣṇor vakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ |
candrārkaśakraśaktir yā dhenurūpās tu sā śriye ||
[400]        caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīr yā lakṣmīr dhanadasya ca |
lakṣmīr yā lokapālānāṃ sā dhenur varadās tu me ||
svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ tathā |
sarvapāpaharā dhenuḥ tasmāc chantiṃ prayaccha me ||
evam āmantrya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
atraiṣa dānavākyaprayogaḥ |
oṃ adya amukasmin kale amukasagotrāya amukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya imāṃ guḍadhenuṃ yathoktasarvopakaraṇavatīṃ yathoktakḷptavatsasahitāṃ viṣṇudaivatām amukasagotro ‘ham amukaśarmā amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade mama amukasagotrāya amukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya etad guḍadhenudānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā idaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti dakṣiṇā tu jñeyo niṣṅaśataṃ pārthetyādinā paribhāṣāyām uktā brāhmaṇas tu pucchadeśe praigṛhya svasti kuryāt |
vidhānam etad dhenūnāṃ sarvāsām iha paṭhyate |
tathā eta deva vidhānaṃ syāt ta evopaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
mandrāvāhanasaṃyuktāḥ sadā parvaṇi parvaṇi ||
yathāśraddhaṃ pradātavyā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ |
aśeṣayajñaphaladāḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ śubhāḥ ||
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte ‘tha vā punaḥ |
guḍadhenvādayo deyā uparāgādiparvasu ||
atra ghṛtādidhenudravyaparimāṇam api guḍadhenūktam eva,
vidhānam etad dhenūnāṃ sarvāsām api paṭhyate |
[401] iti sāmānyenātideśāt | kumbhāḥ syur dravadhenūnām itarāsāṃ tu rāśaya iti tu bhāracatuṣṭayādiparimitasya dravadravyasya kumbhādhāratayāvasthāpanaprakārakathanam | yat tu padmapurāṇādāv ekenaiva ghaṭena ghṛtādidhenukathanaṃ droṇamatreṇa ca tiladhenukathanaṃ tad etad dhenuprakārāt prakārāntarābhiprāyeṇeti kalpataruḥ | dānavivekena tu palasahasraparimāṇaḥ kumbha iti nirṇītam | kecit tu dvādaśapalādhikāni pañcapalaśatāni kumbham āhuḥ | tac ca paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtim ityādinā paribhāṣāyāṃ darśitam |
tataś ca yathādhikāraṃ vyavastheti | vahnipurāṇe tu
prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syāt,
ityādikam abhidhāya,
saptamī lavaṇadhenus tu dadhidhenur athāṣṭamī |
“ratnaiś cānye maharṣayaḥ” iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ |
kumbhāḥ syū ratnadhenūnāṃ droṇenaiva hi rāśayaḥ |
sarvāḥ samaphalāḥ proktā madhyamottamakanyasāḥ ||
svaśaktito nṛpaśreṣṭha daridrasya caturguṇām |
kanyasā seśvarāṇāṃ tu daridrāṇāṃ sadottamā ||
etad eva vidhānaṃ syāt sarvaśaś ca yaśaskaraḥ |
guḍadhenvādayo deyā uparāgādiparvasu ||
kārtikyāṃ tu tathā mādhyāṃ yugādiṣu ca parvasu |
samupoṣya naro dadyāt saptamyāṃ tu dine raveḥ ||
dinatrayaṃ tadāhāro yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam |
iha loke 'pi saubhāgyam āyur ārogyam eva ca ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āpnoti maraṇe smaraṇaṃ hareḥ |
[402]        daśārbudasahasrāṇi daśa cāṣṭau ca dharmavit |
na śokaduḥkham āpnoti daurgatyaṃ jāyate na ca ||
iti guḍadhenvādidānavidhiḥ |
atha tiladhenudānam | viṣṇudharmāt |
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi keśavaprīṇanāya ca |
datvā bhavati yasyāś ca narendra vidhir uttamaḥ ||
yāṃ datvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ |
agāradāhī garadaḥ sarvapāpayuto 'pi vā ||
mahāpātakayuktaś ca saṃyuktaś copapātakaiḥ |
mucyate hy akhilaiḥ pāpair viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe vastrājinakuśāvṛte |
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ kṛtvā sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtām ||
dhenuṃ droṇena kurvīta āḍhakena tu vatsakam |
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurīṃ gandhaghrāṇavatīṃ tathā ||
kuryāc ca śarkarājihvāṃ guḍāsyām avikambalām |
ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ śucimuktāphalekṣaṇām ||
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ phaladantavatīṃ śubhām |
sragdāmapucchāṃ kurvīta navanītastanānvitām ||
sitasūtraśirālāṃ ca sitasarṣaparomikām |
phalair manoharair bhikṣyair maṇimuktāphalānvitām ||
[403]        sitavastrayugacchannāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām |
īdṛksaṃsthānasaṃpannāṃ kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ datvā keśavaḥ prīyatām iti |
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvadevānāṃ yā ca deveṣv avasthitā ||
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
dehasthā yā ca rudrāṇī śaṅkarasya sadā priyā ||
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
viṣṇor vakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ ||
candrārkaśakraśaktir yā dhenurūpās tu sā śriye |
caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīr yā lakṣmīr dhanadasya ca ||

svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ tathā ||
sarvapāpaharā dhenur asmāc chāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
vahnipurāṇe tv ayaṃ mantraḥ |
tilāś ca pitṛdevatyā nirmitāś ceha gosave |
brahmaṇā tanmayī dhenur dattā prīṇātu keśavam || iti |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā praṇamya ca |
sadakṣiṇā mayā tubhyaṃ dattety uktvā visarjayet ||
anena vidhinā datvā tiladhenuṃ narādhipaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
yaś ca gṛhṇāti vidhivad dīyamānaṃ pramodayet |
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti ye ca saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||
[404]        te 'py aśeṣāghanirmuktāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim |
praśāntāya suśīlāya vedavratadharāya ca ||
denuṃ tilamayīṃ datvā na śocati kṛtākṛte |
trirātraṃ yas tilāhāras tiladhenuprado bhavet ||
ekāham atha tān atti tadgatenāntarātmanā |
dānād viśuddhapāpasya tasya puṇyakṛto nṛpaḥ ||
cāndrāyaṇād apy adhikaṃ kathitaṃ tilabhakṣaṇam ||
vāyupurāṇe |
hotā uvāca |
tiladhenuṃ jaladhenuṃ rasadhenuṃ ca pārthiva |
dehi śīghraṃ yena bhavān kṣuttṛṣāvarjito divi ||
ramate yāvad ādityas tapyate divi candramāḥ |
evam uktas tato rājā vidhānaṃ pṛṣṭavān idam ||
yathā bhavet tiladhenos tac chṛṇuṣva narādhipa |
caturbhiḥ setikābhis tu prastha ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
te ṣoḍaś bhaved dhenuś caturbhir vatsako bhavet |
ikṣudaṇḍamayāḥ pādā dantāḥ puṣpamayāḥ śubhāḥ ||
nāsā gandhamayī tasyā jihvā guḍamayī tathā |
pucche srakkalpanīyā syāt ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
īdṛśīṃ kalpayitvā tu svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ prakalpayet |
kāṃsyadohāṃ rūpyakhurāṃ pūrvadhenuvidhānataḥ ||
tiladhenuṃ tato datvā dvādaśyān niyataḥ śuciḥ |
[405]        ātmānaṃ tārayed durgān narakāt kāmabhāg bhavet ||
setikā kuḍavaḥ, sa ca dvādaśaprasṛtiparimitaḥ | mahābhārate |
sudakṣiṇāṃ kāñcanacāruśṛṅgīṃ
kāṃsyopadohāṃ draviṇottarīyām |
dhenuṃ tilānāṃ dadato dvijāya
lokā vasūnāṃ sulabhā bhavanti ||
tathā |
dhenvāḥ pramāṇena samapramāṇaṃ
dhenuṃ tilānām api ca pradāya ||
tathā |
pānīyavāpīṃ ca yamasya loke
na yātanāṃ kācid upaiti martyaḥ ||
tathā |
gomatyā vidyayā dhenuṃ tilānām abhimantrya yaḥ |
rasaratnamayīṃ dadyān nāpi śocet kṛtākṛte ||
gomatīvidyāpi tatraiva | tad yathā |
gāvo mām upatiṣṭhantu hemaśṛṅgyaḥ payomucaḥ |
surabhyaḥ saurabheyaś ca saritaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ||
gāvaḥ paśyāmy ahaṃ nityaṃ gāvaḥ paśyantu māṃ sadā |
gāvo 'smākaṃ vayaṃ tāsāṃ yato gāvas tato vayam ||
evaṃ rātrau divā vāpi sameṣu viṣameṣu ca |
mahābhayeṣu ca naraḥ kīrtayan mucyate bhayāt || iti |
ādityapurāṇe |
daridraḥ khalu yo dadyāt tiladhenuṃ vidhanataḥ |
gomayenopalipyātha tatra dhenuṃ samālikhet ||
[406]        tilair ākīrya sarvāṅgaṃ tiladhenuṃ prakalpya ca |
khureṣu caiva śṛṅgeṣu deyaṃ kanakam eva ca ||
sacelāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ caiva brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
tiladhenuṃ prayacchet tu svargalokaṃ gacchati ||
pāpaiḥ sarvaiḥ pramucyeta karmaṇā manasā kṛtaiḥ |
tilasaṃkhyā ca yāvad vai tāvān koṭiśatāni ca ||
modate tatra varṣāṇāṃ vasuloke na saṃśayaḥ |
atha mānuṣyamayāni kadācit kālaparyayāt |
dhanadhānyasamṛddhe vai jāyate mahatāṃ kule ||
iti tiladhenudānavidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
vidhānaṃ tiladhenor yat tac chṛṇuṣva narādhipa |
ṣoḍaśāḍhakamayī (?) dhenuś caturbhir vatsako bhavet ||
ikṣudaṇḍamayāḥ pādāḥ dantāḥ puṣpamayāḥ śubhāḥ |
nāsā gandhamayī tasyā jihvā guḍamayī tathā ||
pucche srak kalpanīyā syād ghaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitā |
īdṛśīḥ kalpayitvā tu svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ prakalpayet ||
raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ pūrvadhenuvidhānataḥ |
evaṃvidhānāṃ tāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya tu dāpayet ||
kṛṣṇājinasthitāṃ dhenuṃ vāsobhir bhūṣitāṃ śubhaiḥ |
sūtreṇa sūtritāṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnasamanvitām ||
sarvauṣadhisamāyuktāṃ mantrapūtāṃ tu dāpayet |
annaṃ me jāyatāṃ sadyaḥ pānaṃ sarvarasāṃs tathā ||
kāmān saṃpādayāsmākaṃ tiladhenor dvijārpitā |
[407]        gṛhṇāmi devi tāṃ bhaktyā kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ ||
bharasva kāmair māṃ sarvais tiladheno namo 'stu te |
evaṃ vidhānato dattā tiladhenur nṛpottamaḥ ||
sarvakāmasamāvāptiṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ |
jaladhenus tathaiveha kumbhe dhenuḥ prakalpitā ||
dattā tu vidhinā kāmān sadyaḥ sarvān prayacchati |
