pitṝṃs tārayate durgān narakāt kāmadā bhavet |
ghṛtadhenus tathā dattā vidhānena vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
sarvakāmaṃ samāpnoti kurute kāntidā bhavet |
rasadhenuṃ tathā datvā kārttike māsi pārthiva ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti nityaṃ sugantibhāg bhavet ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaḥ pañcadhenudānavidhiḥ |
agastya uvāca |
tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi durgā yena prasīdati |
api duṣkṛtakarmāpi yāṃ datvā nirṛṇo bhavet ||
pratyakṣā yena devī syād rājyaputrasukhāvahā |
bhavati na cireṇaiva tāṃ śṛṇuṣva nṛpottama ||
devadevīm anujñāpya susnāto vijitendriyaḥ |
pūjayet puṣpagandhādyair dīpadhūpavicitrakaiḥ |
hutvā hutāśane devīṃ tathā droṇamayīṃ kuru ||
hutvā hutāśane devīm iti pūrvoktahomaprakāreṇa devīṃ prīṇayitvā |
āḍhakena (?) bhaved vatsa sarvaratnavibhūṣitā |
[408]        hemaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurāṃ gandhaghrāṇāṃ suśobhanām ||
mukhaṃ guḍamayaṃ kāryaṃ jihvām annamayīṃ tathā |
kambalā sūkṣmasūtraṃ tu pādā ikṣumayās tathā ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhaṃ bhavet tasyā īkṣaṇe maṇimauktikaiḥ |
cārupatramayau karṇau dantāḥ phalamayās tathā ||
navanītastanīṃ kuryāt puṣpamālāmayīṃ kuru |
pucchaṃ tu maṇimuktābhiḥ phalais tāṃ ca samarcayet ||
subhagabhrūyugachannāṃ cāruvastravibhūṣitām |
īdṛksaṃsthānasaṃpannāṃ kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dadyād devī me prīyatām iti |
mantrābhimantritāṃ kṛtvā tadbhaktāya nivedayet ||
yāvanti tilavastrāṇāṃ dhātumūlaphalasya ca |
vidyante ca rajobindūn tāvat svarge vasen naraḥ ||
pitṝn vigatapāpāṃś ca kṛtvādhastād gatān api |
prāpya devyāḥ śubhān lokān sthāpayed avicāraṇāt ||
tasmiṃs tu ramate vatsa yāvad ācandratārakau |
tathā kālād ihāyāto jāyate pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
ihaiva tejaḥsaṃpanno bahuputraḥ sukhānvitaḥ |
punar devyāṃ rato nityaṃ pūjayed vidhinācalam ||
prāpya yogaśatair yat tat prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||
iti devīpurāṇoktas tiladhenudānavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tiladhenuvidhiṃ kramāt |
[409]        pūrvoktamaṇḍalaṃ kuryāc chivapūjāṃ ca paścime ||
tasyāgre madhyato bhūmau padmam ālikhya śobhanam |
vastrair āchāditaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye vinyased budhaḥ ||
pūrvoktamaṇḍalam, liṅgaṃ tulāpuruṣadānavihitamaṇḍalaṃ tasya maṇḍalasya paścime prāṅmukhaḥ śivaḥ pūjyaḥ śivasya purato maṇḍalasya madhyabhāge śālicūrṇādinā padmaṃ vilikhya vastrair ācchādya tatra tilapuṣpaṃ nyased ity anvayaḥ |
tilapuṣpaṃ tu kṛtvā tu haimaṃ puṣpaṃ vinikṣipet |
triṃśanniṣkeṇa kartavyaṃ tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ ||
pañcaniṣkeṇa kartavyaṃ tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
tilapuṣpaṃ droṇādiparimitatilarāśimayam | padminīṃ puṣpaṃ kṛtvā tatra vastrādyācchanne hemapadmaṃ nyaset,
tasyāgre kārayed vidvān padmaṃ tilamayaṃ śubham |
annaṃ droṇena kartavyam atha bhāreṇa kārayet ||
vastrair ācchādya tanmadhye svarṇapadmaṃ vinikṣiped iti kāmikokteḥ |
tam ārādhya vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
padmasyottaradigbhāge viprān ekādaśa nyaset ||
tān abhyarcya vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
ācchādya uttamaṃ śṛṅgaṃ viprebhyo dāpayet kramāt ||
uṣṇīṣaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ kuṇḍalaiś ca vibhūṣayet |
hemāṅgulīyakaṃ datvā brāhmaṇebhyo vidhānataḥ ||
ekādaśaiva vastrāṇi teṣām agre prakīrya ca |
[410]        teṣu pastreṣu nikṣipya tilakhārīṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
kāṃsyapātraṃ śatapalaṃ vibhidyaikādaśāṃśakam |
ikṣudaṇḍāś ca dātavyās tatra tatra pṛthak pṛthak ||
gośṛṅge ca hiraṇye ca dviniṣkeṇa tu kārayet |
rājatena tu kurvīta khuraṃ niṣkadvayena tu ||
evaṃ pṛthak pṛthak datvā tat tileṣu vinikṣipet |
ṣoḍaśadroṇā khārī, kāṃsyapātraṃ dohanam, śatasyaikādaśāṃśakapratyekaṃ pratyekaṃ navapalam ity arthaḥ | tat tileṣu vinikṣiped iti |
evaṃ hemaśṛṅgādīni pratyekaṃ tilakhāryām, nikṣipya svarṇaśṛṅgādyupetās tilamadhye dhenavaḥ kalpanīyā iti rudraikādaśakamantrair viprebhyo dāpayet | tathā padmasya pūrvadigbhāge dhenavaḥ kalpanīyā iti rudraikādaśakamantrair viprebhyo dāpayet |
tathā |
padmasya pūrvadigbhāge ravīn dvādaśa pūjitān |
etenaiva tu mārgeṇa tāṃśca śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
dvādaśādityamantreṇa dāpayed devam eva ca |
pūrvadikṣiṇadigbhāge dvijān ṣoḍaśa saṃsthitān |
mūrtividyeśair mantraiś ca dāpayet pūrvavat punaḥ ||
atra padmottardigbhāge ekādaśa viprā rudrarūpāḥ pūjyāḥ tebhyaḥ prāguktam ekādaśadhāsthitaṃ tilakhāryādi deyam | mantras tu ye devāso divy ekādaśasyetyādiḥ | tathā padmasya pūrvadigbhāge dvādaśa viprān ādityarūpān arcayet | tebhyo 'pi kāṃsyapātraṃ śatapalaṃ dvādaśadhā vibhajya pūrvavat suvarṇaśṛṅgādiyutāṃ pratyekaṃ tilakhārīṃ dadyāt | mantraś ca yajño devānām ity ādityaliṅgakaḥ | [411] tathā padmasya dakṣiṇe bhāge ṣoḍaśa viprān mūrtivighneśarūpān arcayet |
mūrtayo bhavādikā aṣṭau | tad yathā |
bhavaḥ śarvaś ca rudraś ca paśupatyugrasaṃjñakau |
mahādevaś ca bhīmaś ca īśānaś cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
vighneśanāmāni tu gaṇeśadāne vakṣyante | tebhyo 'pi śatapalaṃ kāṃśyapātraṃ ṣoḍaśadhā vibhajya pūrvavat pratyekaṃ suvarṇaśṛṅgādyupetāṃ tilakhārīṃ dadyāt | mantras tu bhavāya devāyetyādi | praṇavādinamo'ntena nāmnā kartavyaḥ |
yajamānena kartavyaṃ sarvam etad yathākramam |
kevalaṃ rudradānaṃ vā ādityebhyo 'tha vā punaḥ ||
mūrtyādīnāṃ ca vā deyaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram |
padmaṃ vinyasya rajasā śeṣaṃ vā kārayen nṛpaḥ ||
dakṣiṇā ca pradātavyā pañcaniṣkeṇa bhūṣaṇam |
etac ca padmadvārādi vighneśadānāntaṃ sarvaṃ rudrādyanyatamoddeśyakaṃ vā dānaṃ madhyapadmam ekam eva vā kāryam | sarvatra ca madhyapadmaṃ gurave deyam | evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena hemābjaṃ gurave daded ity vātulokteḥ | sarveṣv api pakṣeṣu bhūṣaṇaṃ pañcaniṣkahemnā kāryaṃ śivārcā snapanaṃ homādi ca prāgvat | dakṣiṇācāryartvigādeḥ | tad uktaṃ kāmike |
[412]        pūrvavan maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā kuryād vai maṇḍalānvitam |
tadvat pūjāṃ ca homaṃ ca snapanādyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
pañcāṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ pañcaniṣkeṇātra prakalpayet |
dakṣiṇāṃ pūrvavad dadyād anuktaṃ pūrvavad bhaved || iti |
iti liṅgapurāṇoktaḥ tiladhenudānavidhiḥ |
saptavrīhimayāḥ sapta dhenavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
yathā tilamayī dhenus tathaivaitās tu kārayet ||
yac ca vrīhimayī dhenur godhūmā satilā parā |
māṣamudgamayī caiva sapriyaṅguś ca saptamī ||
upaskaraṃ tu sarvāsu tiladhenuvad īritam |
etāsām eva dhenūnām aṅgāni tiladhenuvat ||
saptavrīhimayāḥ sapta yo dadātīha mānavaḥ |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān ||
brahmahā ca surāpaś ca taskaro gurutalpagaḥ |
dhenudānena pūto 'sau yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||
iti viśvāmitraproktaḥ saptavrīhidhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha ghṛtadhenudānavidhiḥ | vasiṣṭha uvāca |
tilābhāve tathā dadyād ghṛtadhenuṃ yatavrataḥ |
yena bhūpa vidhānena tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ||
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanāt |
saṃpūjya pūrvavat puṣpair gandhapuṣpādibhir naraḥ ||
ahorātroṣito nāmnā abhiṣṭūya ghṛtārciṣam |
ghṛtārciṣe jagannāthāya devāya nama iti manuḥ |
[413]        gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhaṃ puṣpamālādibhūṣitam |
kāṃsyāpidhānasaṃyuktaṃ sitavastrayugena ca ||
hiraṇyagarbhasahitaṃ maṇividrumamaiktikaiḥ |
atra palasahasraparimāṇaḥ kumbhaḥ | dvādaśapalādhikāni pañcapalaśatānīti kecit | tad etat paribhāṣāyām upavarṇitam | kāṃsyāpidhanasahitaṃ kāṃsyapātrāpihitam | hiraṇyagarbhasahitaṃ madhyavartinā hiraṇyena sahitam ity arthaḥ | maṇividrumamauktikaiḥ sahitam iti śeṣaḥ |
ikṣuyaṣṭimayān pādān khurān raupyamayāṃs tathā |
sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kuryāt śṛṅge cāgurukāṣṭhaje ||
atra suvarṇāder anuditasaṃkhyatayā yathāśakti vidhānam |
saptadhānyamaye pārśve pattorṇena ca kambalam |
kuryāt turuṣkakarpūrair ghrāṇaṃ phalamayāṃs tu tān ||
tadvac charkarayā jihvāṃ guḍakṣīramayaṃ mukhaṃ |
pattorṇaṃ dhautakauśayam, turuṣkaḥ sihlakaḥ (?) |
kṣaumasūtreṇa lāṅgūlaṃ romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ |
tāmrapātramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
īdṛksvarūpāṃ saṃkalpya ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipa |
tadvat kalpanayā vidvān ghṛtavatsaṃ prakalpayet ||
tadvd dhenuvat, khuraśṛṅgādiyuktam ity arthaḥ | sa ca dhenoś caturthabhāgena kartavyaḥ |
taṃ ca vipraṃ mahābhāga manasaiva ghṛtārciṣam |
[414]        kalpayitvā tatas tasmai prayataḥ pratipādayet ||
etāṃ mamopakārāya gṛhṇīṣva tvaṃ dvijottama |
prīyatāṃ mama deveśo ghṛtārciḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||
ity udāhṛtya viprāya dadyād dhenuṃ narādhipa |
skandapurāṇe | ayaṃ mantraḥ |
ghṛtaṃ gāvaḥ prasūyante ghṛtaṃ bhūmyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
ghṛtam agniś ca devāś ca ghṛtaṃ me saṃpradīyatām ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
ghṛtam agnir ghṛtaṃ somas tanmayāḥ sarvadevatāḥ |
ghṛtadhenupradānena sarvās tuṣyanti devatāḥ || iti |
ghṛtaratnaṃ suvarṇānāṃ samyak kalpanayā kṛtam |
datvaikarātraṃ sthitvā tu ghṛtāhāro narādhipaḥ ||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyas tathā dānaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ ||
teṣu sarveṣu lokeṣu supuṇyeṣūpajāyate |
pitur ūrdhvaṃ nayet sapta puruṣās tasya ye 'py adhaḥ ||
tāṃs teṣu nṛpa lokeṣu sa nayatyastakalmaṣaḥ (?) |
sakāmānām iyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ kathitā nṛpasattama ||
viṣṇulokaṃ narā yānti niṣkāmā ghṛtadhenudāḥ |
ghṛtam agnir ghṛtaṃ somas tamayāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||
ghṛtaṃ prayacchatā dattā bhavanty akhiladevatāḥ |
suvarṇam atra dakṣiṇā | anuktadakṣiṇeṣu tasya yathāśakti vihitatvāt |
iti viṣṇudharmokto ghṛtadhenudānavidhiḥ |
[415]                agastya uvāca |
tilābhāve pradātavyā sarpir dhenur vijānatā |
snāpayitvā bhavānīṃ ca ghṛtakṣīrair yathāvidhi ||
pūjayet puṣpamālābhir naivedyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ |
āharet sarvadravyāṇi upakalpeta tatra tāṃ ||
gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhe puṣpamālāvibhūṣite |
kāṃsyapātryā tayā vastraiś chādayīta vidhāya tām ||
hiraṇyagarbhasahitāṃ maṇividrumamauktikaiḥ |
pādān ikṣumayān kuryāt kuryād raupyamayān śaphān ||
hemaṃ cakṣus tathā śṛṅge kṛṣṇāgurumaye śubhe |
saptadānyaiś ca tatpārśve pattorṇena ca kambalam ||
ghrāṇaṃ tv agurukarpūraiḥ stanāḥ phalamayāḥ śubhāḥ |
mukhaṃ ca guḍakṣīreṇa sitāṃ jihvāṃ prakalpayet ||
sitā śarkarā |
pucchaṃ kṣaumamayaṃ kāryaṃ romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ |
tāmrapṛṣṭhaṃ vicitraṃ tu īdṛgrūpāṃ manoramām ||
vidhinā ghṛtavatsaṃ ca kuryāl lakṣaṇalakṣitam |
etaiḥ kṛtvā tathā natvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
tadbhaktāya pradātavyā maṅgalā śāstrapārage |
imāṃ mamopakārāya gṛhṇīṣva madanugrahāt ||
prīyatāṃ nandinī devī maṅgalā carcikā umā |
ity uktvā cārcayed dhenuṃ kṛtvā nandāṃ mano’nugām ||
anena vidhinā deyā sarpiṣo denur uttamā |
hiraṇyaratnadhenuś ca pradeyā vidhināmunā ||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
[416]        yatra kṣīravahā nadyo yatra sarpirvahā hradāḥ ||
pāyasāḥ kardamā yatra tasmiṃl loke mahīyate |
teṣāṃ svāmitvam āpnoti mudā paramayā yutaḥ ||
daśa pūrvāparāṃs tārya ātmānaṃ tv ekaviṃśakam |
bhūyaḥ pṛthvīśatāṃ yāti iha loke sa mānavaḥ ||
sakāmānām iyaṃ vyuṣṭir dhenos tāvad udāhṛtā |
devyā lokam āpnoti niṣkāmo ghṛtadhenudaḥ ||
iti devīpurāṇokto ghṛtadhenudānavidhiḥ |
gavābhāve tathā dadyād ghṛtadhenuṃ prayatnataḥ |
yena kāryā vidhānena tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ||
ādityaṃ tu jagannāthaṃ ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanaiḥ |
saṃpūjya pūrvavat puṣpair gandhapuṣpādibhir naraḥ ||
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā abhiplutya ghṛtārciṣā |
gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣītam ||
kāṃsyopadhānasaṃyuktaṃ sitavastrayugena ca |
hiraṇyagarbhasahitaṃ maṇividrumamauktikaiḥ ||
ikṣuyaṣṭimayāḥ pādāḥ khurā raupyamayās tathā |
sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kuryāt śṛṅge cāgurukāṣṭhaje ||

tāmrapātramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
[417]        īdṛksurūpāṃ saṃkalpya ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipaḥ |
tadvat kalpanayā dhenor ghṛavatsaṃ prakalpayet ||
taṃ ca vipraṃ mahābhāga manasaiva ghṛtārciṣam |
kalpayitvā tatas tasmai prayataḥ pratipādayet ||

prīyatāṃ mama deveśo ghṛtārcirmihirottamaḥ ||

datvaikarātraṃ sthitvā ca ghṛtāhāro narādhipaḥ ||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyas tasya dānaphalaṃ śṛṇu |

pitur ūrdhvaṃ nayet saptapuruṣāṃs tasya ye ‘py adhaḥ ||
iti śrī-ādityapurṇokto ghṛtadhenudānavidhiḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare |
ghṛtadhenuvidhānena navanītamayī śubhā |
dātavyā nṛpate dhenur nyūnādhikyavivarjitā ||
mantraḥ sa eṣa nirdiṣṭo ghṛtadhenau ca yaḥ smṛtaḥ |
śṛṇu pārtha mahābāho pradānaphalam uttamam ||
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ |
ghṛtadhenuprado yāti tatra kāmaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ||
pitur ūrdhvaṃ nayet sapta puruṣāṃs tasya ye ‘py adhaḥ |
tān śreṣṭheṣv iha lokeṣu sa nayatyastakalmaṣān ||
[418]        sakāmānām iyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ kathitā nṛpasattama |
niṣkalmaṣaṃ padaṃ yānti niṣkāmās tatpradāyinaḥ ||
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
alābhe yo gavāṃ dadyāt ghṛtadhenuṃ yathāvidhi |
durgāṇi tārito dhenvā devanadyāṃ pramodate ||
ghṛtālābhe tu yo dadyāt tiladhenuṃ samāhitaḥ |
sarvakāmavahā nadyas taṃ sevante divi sthitam ||
tilālābhe tu yo dadyāj jaladhenuṃ samāhitaḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
ghṛtadhenuṃ naro dadyāt tiladhenuṃ yathākramam |
jaladhenuṃ yathā yo vai śaśvan na vyavate (?) divaḥ ||
jitendriyāya śāntāya vaiṣṇavāya yathāvidhi |
dhenuṃ datvā ghṛtamayīṃ viṣṇusālokyam aśnute ||
pitaraṃ caiva dharmātmā pitāmaham athāpi vā |
ghṛtadhenvā paritrāti sapta sapta ca sapta ca ||
iti ghṛtadhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha jaladhenudānam | vasiṣṭha uvāca |
jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi prīyate dattayā yayā |
devadevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ||
jalakumbhaṃ naravyāghra suvarṇarajatānvitam |
ratnagarbham aśeṣais tu (?) grāmyair dhānyaiḥ samanvitam ||
[419]        sitavastrayugachannaṃ dūrvāpallavaśobhitam |
kuṣṭhamāṃsīmurośīravālakāmalakair yutam ||
priyaṅgupatrasahitaṃ sitavastropavītinam |
sa chatraṃ sa upānatkaṃ darbhaviṣṭarasaṃsthitam ||
caturbhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ bhūpa tilapātraiś caturdiśam |
sthāpitaṃ dadhipātreṇa ghṛtakṣaudravatā mukhe ||
upoṣitaḥ samabhyarcya vāsudevaṃ jaleśvaram |
puṣpadhūpopahārais tu yathavibhavam ādṛtaḥ ||
saṃkalpya jaladhenuṃ ca kumbhaṃ tam abhipūjya ca |
pūjayed vatsakaṃ tadvat kumbhaṃ jalamayaṃ budhaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ jaladhenuṃ savatsakām |
sitavastradharaḥ śānto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ ||
dadyād dvijāya rājendra prītyarthaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ |
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ mama keśava ||
iti coccārya bhūnātha viprāya pratipādyatām |
apakvānnāśinā stheyam ahorātram ataḥ param ||
jalakumbham ityādi, kumbo ‘tra kalaśaḥ | suvarṇarajatayor aniyataparimāṇatayā yathāśakti vidhānaṃ pañcaratnāni dhānyāni ca paribhāṣāyām uktāni | atha yady api sāmānyenopadeśaḥ tathāpi tatsāmānyāditareṣu tathā tvam iti nyāyād itaradhenuvad aviruddhadharmānuṣṭhānaṃ veditavyam | tataś ca suvarṇasya śṛṅgākṛtitvaṃ [420] rajatasya khurākṛtitvam, tilapātrāṇāṃ tāmrapātramayatvam, dadhipātrasya kāṃsyapātramayatvam, cānusaṃdheyam | tathā dhānyāni pārśvadvaye, kuṣṭhādīni ghrāṇadeśe, priyaṅgupatraṃ śravaṇe, yajñopavītaṃ śiraḥsthāne sthāpayet | vatso ‘pi caturthāṃśena dhenuvat kāryaḥ |
kvacit tu “pūjayed vatsaṃ taṃ tadvat kṛtaṃ ghṛtamayaṃ budhaḥ” iti pāṭhāt ghṛtajalayor vikalpo ‘vagamyate, dānavākyaṃ tu pūrvavad dakṣiṇā cātra yathāśakti suvarṇam iti |
anena vidhinā datvā jaladhenuṃ narādhipa |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ||
śarīrārogyam ābādhāpraśamaḥ sārvakāmikaḥ |
nṛṇāṃ bhavati dattāyāṃ jaladhenvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmokto jaladhenudānavidhiḥ |
bhānur uvāca |
jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi prīyate dattayā yayā |
devadevo mayūkheśaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ||
jalakumbhaṃ samānīyetyādi viṣṇudharmatulyārtham | viśeṣas tu |
tataḥ saṃpūjya cādityaṃ jaladhenuṃ savatsakām |
dadyād viprāya devāgre prītyarthaṃ mihirasya tu |
ādityasya jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ mihiraḥ sadā ||
iti coccārya tāṃ gāṃ tu viprāya pratipādayet |
anena vidhinā yas tu jaladhenuṃ mahāmune ||
pūrvāhṇadāna(ṃ?) avāpnoti yāṃś ca dhyāyati mānavaḥ |
[421]        sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitaraṃ sapitāmaham |
prapitāmahaṃ yathāpūrvapuruṣāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam ||
ātmānaṃ tanayaṃ pautraṃ tadadhastāc catuṣṭayam |
tārayet sa munīndreha jaladhenuprado naraḥ ||
yaś ca gṛhṇāti vidhivat tasyāpy evaṃvidhāḥ kule |
caturdaśa tathā caiva dadataś cānumodataḥ ||
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti jaladhenuṃ ca ye narāḥ |
te ‘py aśeṣādhanirmuktāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||
iti ādityapurāṇokto jaladhenudānavidhiḥ |
agastya uvāva |
toyadhenuṃ śṛṇu vastsa yathā devī prasīdati |
kumbhaṃ toyasusaṃpūrṇaṃ ratnavastrayugānvitam |
samastabījasaṃyuktaṃ dūrvāpallavaśobhitam ||
samastabījāni sarvadhānyāni |
dūrvākṣatadadhiśaṅkhakuṣṭhāmalakacandanaiḥ |
mālyachatrasamāyuktaṃ tilapātraiś ca saṃyutam ||
dadhikṣīraghṛtaṃ patraṃ vidhānenopakalpayet |
vatsakaṃ kalpayet tasyās tadvat toyamayaṃ budhaḥ ||
devīm abhyarcya vidhivat sopavāso ‘tha naktavān |
devībhakte pradadyād yaḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
jayārisūdanī devī devānāṃ bhayanāśinī |
vedamātarvare durge sarvage subhage namaḥ ||
[422]        anena vatsamantreṇa nandānāmnābhimantrayet |
devī me prīyatāṃ nityaṃ yathoditaphalā śivā ||
iti devīpurāṇokto jaladhenudānavidhiḥ | skandapurāṇe |
jaladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāt tasya dānaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
prapāṃ satraṃ taḍāgaṃ vā kūpaṃ vāpi supuṣkalam ||
kṛtvā kumbān suvarāṃś ca gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtān ||
prapā pāṇīyaśālā | satraśālā sabhājanasamāśrayā | suvarṇān śobhanavarṇān |
puṣpaiś ca vividhākārair abhyarcya dvijasattamān |
bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ sutṛptānāṃ tilapātrāṇi dāpayet |
dakṣiṇāṃ puṣkalāṃ dadyād ebhyas tvā śaṃsayet tataḥ ||
ebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ |
āpaḥ śivās tu saumyāś ca tarpayantu pitṝn mama |
kāmadāḥ kāmadānāya bhavantv ity ca vai vadet ||
evaṃ datvā tu tāṃ dhenuṃ punaḥ kṛtvā ca vai tadā |
āvāhayet prapāṃ devīṃ brahmalokasamarpiṇīm ||
tilapātrāṇi datvā ca tathā vastrayugaṃ śubham |
suvarṇasya ca sāṃnidhyaṃ phalāni vividhāni ca ||
tato dadyāc chuciḥ snāto brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi |
evaṃ vidhānato datvā brahmaloke mahīyate ||
[423]                viśvāmitraḥ |
śarīrārogyam ābādhāpraśamaḥ sārvakālikaḥ |
nṛṇāṃ bhavati dattāyāṃ jaladhenvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti jaladhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha kṣīradhenudānam |
vinītāśva uvāca |
kṣīradhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi tān nibodha narādhipa |
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe gomayena narottama ||
gocarmamātramānena kuśān āstīrya sarvataḥ |
tatropari mahārāja nyaset kṛṣṇājinaṃ budhaḥ ||
tatropari kuṇḍaḷīkāṃ gomayena kṛtām api |
kṣīrakumbhaṃ tataḥ sthāpya caturthāṃśena vatsakam ||
suvarṇamukhaśṛṅgāṇi candanāgurukāṇi ca |
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ tilapātropari nyaset ||
mukhaṃ guḍamayaṃ tasyā jihvā śarkarayā tathā |
phalapraśastadantāṃ ca muktāphalamayekṣaṇām ||
ikṣupādāṃ darbharomāṃ sitakambalakambalām |
tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ paṭṭasūtramayī tathā ||
pucchaṃ ca nṛpaśārdūla navanītamayastanīm |
svarṇaśṛṅgāṃ raupyakhurāṃ pañcaratnamayāṃ bhuvi ||
catvāri tilapātrāṇi caturdikṣv api sthāpayet |
saptavrīhisamāyuktāṃ dikṣu sarvāsu prakṣipet ||
[424]        evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kṣīradhenuṃ prakalpayet |
ācchadya vastrayugmena gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet ||
dhūpaṃ dīpādikaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
ācchādyālaṃkṛtaṃ kṛtvā mudrikākarṇamātrakaiḥ ||
pādukopānahaṃ chatraṃ datvā dānaṃ samarpayet |
anenaiva tu mantreṇa kṣīradhenuṃ prakalpayet ||
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānām ityādi narapuṅgava |
āpyāyasveti mantreṇa kṣīradhenuṃ prasādayet ||
gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ devi bhaktyā grāhako mantram uccaret |
evaṃ dhenuṃ pradāyātha kṣīrāhāro dinaṃ caret ||
trirātraṃ tu payobhakṣo brāhmaṇo rājasattama |
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim ||
etāṃ hemasahasreṇa śatenātha svaśaktitaḥ |
śatārdham atha vāpy ardhaṃ tathaivārdhaṃ yathecchayā ||
datvā dhenuṃ mahārāja śṛṇu tasyāpi tatphalam |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu rudraloke mahīyate ||
pitṛpitāmahaiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ vrajet |
divyaṃ vimānam ārūḍho divyagandhānulepanaḥ ||
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati |
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśair vinānairvaramaṇḍitaiḥ ||
gītavāditranirghoṣair apsatogaṇasevitaiḥ |
tatropaviṣṭo ‘sau rājā viṣṇusāyujyatāṃ vrajet ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād rājan paṭhed vā bhaktibhāvitaḥ |
[425]        sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaḥ kṣīradhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha dadhidhenudānam |
vinītāśva uvāca |
dadhidhenor mahārāja vidhānaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam |
anulipte mahībhāge gomayena narādhipa ||
gocarmamātraṃ tu punaḥ puṣpaprakarasaṃyutam |
kuśair āstīrya vasudhāṃ kṛṣṇājinakṛtāstarām ||
dadhikumbhaṃ ca saṃsthāpya saptadhānyasya copari |
caturthāṃśena vatsaṃ tu sauvarṇamukhasaṃyutam ||
praśastapatraśvaṇāṃ muktāphalamayekṣaṇām |
candanāguruśṛṅgāṃ ca mukhaṃ vai gandhamālim [-mālinam?] ||
jihvā śarkarayā rājan ghrāṇaṃ śrīkhaṇḍakaṃ tathā |
phalamūlamayā dantāḥ sitasūtrasya kambalā ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhā darbharomā pucchaṃ sūtramayaṃ tathā |
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ navanītamayastanīm ||
ikṣupādāṃ susaṃskṛtya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
ācchādya vastrayugmena puṣpagandhais tu pūjitām ||
brāhmaṇāya kulīnāya sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate |
samādhiyamayuktāya tādṛśāya pradāpayet ||
pucchadeśopaviṣṭāya mudrikākarṇamātrakaiḥ |
pādukopānahau chatraṃ datvā mantram anusmaret ||
[426]        dadhikrāvneti mantreṇa dadhidhenuṃ pradāpayet |
evaṃ dadhimayīṃ dhenuṃ datvā rājarṣisattama ||
ekāhāro dinaṃ tiṣṭhed dadhnā ca nṛpanandana |
yajamāno vased rājan tridinaṃ ca dvijottama ||
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te ‘pi yānti parāṃ gatim |
daśapūrvān daśaparān ātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam ||
viṣṇulokam avāpnoti yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
dātā ca dāpakaś caiva te ‘pi yānti parāṃ gatim ||
yatra madhuvahā nadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ |
munayo ṛṣayaḥ siddhās tatra gacchanti dhenudāḥ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā śrāvayed vāp mānavaḥ |
so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
iti skandapurāṇokto dadhidhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha madhudhenudānam |
madhudenuṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapranāśinīm |
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśottare ||
dhenuṃ madhumayīṃ kṛtvā saṃpūrṇaghaṭapūritām |
tadvac caturthabhāgena vatsakaṃ parikalpayet ||
sauvarṇaṃ tu mukhaṃ kṛtvā śṛṅgāṇy agurucandanam |
pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ tasya pucchaṃ sūtramayaṃ tathā ||
pādās tv ikṣumayāḥ kāryāḥ sitakambalakambalām |
mukhaṃ guḍamayaṃ kṛtvā jihvā śarkarānvitā ||
[427]        mauktikaṃ nayane tasyā dantāḥ phalamayās tathā |
darbharomadharā devī rūpyakhuravibhūṣitā ||
aśvatthapatraśravaṇāṃ navanītamayastanīm |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ saptadhānyāni dāpayet ||
catvāri tilapātrāṇi caturdikṣu ca vinyaset |
ācchādya vastrayugmena ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām ||
kāṃsyopadohanīṃ datvā gandhapuṣpais tu pūjitām |
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye ||
saṃkrāntāv uparāge ca sarvakālam atandritā |
dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃpattir dṛṣṭamātreṇa dāpayet ||
brāhmaṇāya dridrāya śrotriyāya kuṭumbine |
āryāvartasamutpanne vedavedāṅgapārage ||
tādṛśāya pradātavyā madhudhenur narottamaḥ |
pucchadeśopaviṣṭhāya gandhadhūpādipūjitām ||
ācchādya vastrayugmena mudrikāṃ karṇamātrikām |
svaśaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ datvā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
udakapūrvaṃ tu kartavyaṃ paścād dānaṃ samarpayet |
rasajñā sarvadevānāṃ sarvabhūtahite ratā ||
prīyantāṃ pitṛdevāś ca madhudheno namo ‘stu te |
evam uccārya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ devi kuṭumbārthaṃ (?) viśeṣataḥ |
kāmaṃ kāmadudhe kāmān madhudeno namo ‘stu te ||
madhuvāteti mantreṇa pradāpyā yatacetasā |
[428]        datvā dhenuṃ mahārāja chatrakopānahau tathā ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā madhudhenuṃ narādhipa |
datvā dānaṃ pāyasena madhunā ca dinaṃ nayet ||
brāhmaṇo ‘pi trirātaṃ tu madhupāyasasaṃyutaḥ |
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ taṃ nibodha narādhipa ||
yatra madhuvahā nadyā yatra pāyasakardamāḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhās tatra gacchanti dhenudāḥ ||
tatra bhogān varān bhuṅkte brahmaloke sa tiṣṭhati |
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ punar matyam (?) upāgataḥ |
sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogān viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati ||
daśapūrvān daśa parān ātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam |
nayeta viṣṇusāyujyaṃ madhudhenuprasādataḥ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā śrāvayed vāpi mānavaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
iti skandapurāṇokto madhudhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha rasadhenudānam |
vinītāśva uvāca |
rasadhenuṃ mahārāja kathayāmi samāsataḥ |
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśottare ||
rasasya tu ghaṭaṃ rājan saṃpūrṇam aikṣavasya ca |
tadvat saṃkalpayet prājñaś caturthāṃśena vatsakam ||
ikṣudaṇḍamayāḥ pādāḥ rājatakhurasaṃyutā |
suvarṇaśṛṅgābharaṇā vastrapucchā ghṛtastanī ||
[429]        puṣpakambalasaṃyuktā śarkarāmukhajihvikā |
dantāḥ phalamayās tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ śubham ||
puṣparomā tu rājendra muktāphalakṛtekṣaṇām |
saptavrīhisamāyuktāṃ sarvagandhavibhūṣitām |
catvāri tilapātrāṇi caturdikṣu niveśayet ||
brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣe śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye |
purāṇajñe viśeṣeṇa sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate ||
tādṛśāya pradātavyā rasadhenuḥ kuṭumbine |
dātā svargam avāpnoti sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ ||
dātā vā grāhako vāpi ekāhaṃ rasabhojanaḥ |
somapānaṃ bhavet tasya sarva eva phalaṃ bhavet ||
dīyamānāṃ tu paśyanti te ‘pi yānti parāṃ gatim |
dhenuṃ ca pūjayitvāgre gandhadhūpasragādibhiḥ ||
pūrvoktā ye ca mantrāś ca tān eva prayataḥ smaret |
evam uccārayitvā tu dīyate vai dvijottame ||
daśa pūrvān parāṃś caiva ātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam |
nayet paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ ||
eṣāṃ te kathitā rājan rasadhenur anuttamā |
dadasva ca mahārāja puṇyaślokān (?) avāpnuhi ||
ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyād vāpi bhaktitaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujatāṃ vrajet ||
iti skandapurāṇokto rasadhenudānavidhiḥ |
[430]
atha śarkarādhenudānam |
vinītāśva uvāca |
tadvac ca śarkarādhenuṃ rājan kuryāt yathārthataḥ |
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśottare ||
dhenuḥ śarkarayā rājan sadā bhāracatuṣṭayam |
uttamā kathyate sadbhiś caturthāṃśena vatsakaḥ ||
tadardhaṃ madhyamā proktā caturthāṃśena kanyasā |
tadvad vatsaṃ prakurvīta caturthāṃśena mānavaḥ ||
atha vā dhenutaḥ kuryād aṣṭāṃśena tu vatsakam |
svaśaktyā kārayed dhenuṃ yathātmānaṃ na pīḍayet ||
sarvabījāni saṃsthāpya caturdikṣu samantataḥ |
sauvarṇamukhaśṛṅgāṇi mauktikair nayanāni ca ||
guḍena ca mukhaṃ kāryaṃ jihvā piṣṭamayī tathā |
kambalaṃ paṭṭasūtreṇa ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitā |
ikṣupādā raupyakhurā navanītamayastanā ||
praśastapatraśravaṇā sitacāmarabhūṣitā |
pañcaratnasamāyuktā darbharomasamanvitā ||
kāṃsyopadohanā samyak gandhapuṣpaiḥ samanvitā |
īdṛkvidhānasaṃyuktā vastrair ācchāditopari ||
gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
śrotriyāya daridrāya sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate ||
vedavedāṅgaviduṣe viśeṣeṇāgnihotriṇe |
[431]        anusūyave pradātavyā na matsarayutāya vai ||
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatipāte ca ṣaṇmukha |
yeṣu puṇyeṣu kāleṣu yadvacchāvāpi (?) dāpayet ||
pūrvāmukhasthito dātā atha vā tu udaṅmukhaḥ |
dhenuṃ pūrvamukhīṃ kṛtvā vatsam uttarato nyaset ||
dānakāle tu ye mantrās tān paṭhitvā samarcayet |
ācchādya caiva taṃ vipraṃ mudrikākarṇaveṣṭakaiḥ ||
svaśaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād gandhapuṣpaṃ sacandanam |
dhenuṃ samarpayet tasya mukhaṃ ca na vilokayet ||
ekāhaṃ śarkarāhāro brāhmaṇas tridinaṃ vaset |
sarvapāpaharā dhenuḥ sarvakāmapradāyinī ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhas tu jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te ‘pi yānti parāṃ gatim ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā paṭhyate vāpi mānavaḥ |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaḥ śarkarādhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha kārpāsadhenudānavidhiḥ |
varāha uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhenuṃ kārpāsakīṃ śubhām |
viśvasya guhyaguptyarthaṃ brahmaṇā vāṃśukaṃ dhṛtam ||
[432]        kārpāsamūlaṃ tac cāpi tenāsāv uttamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sā ca kārpāsabhāreṇa dhenuḥ śreṣṭhā prakīrtitā ||
madhyamā ca tadardhena tasyāpy ardhena kanyasā |
pūrvavad vastradhānyaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca tathaiva ca ||
vatsakaṃ tu caturthāṃśe dānamantro vidhīyate |
kurvīta pūrvavad vatsaṃ vastradhānyādyupaskaram ||
pūrvavad iti varāhapurāṇoktatiladhenuvad ity arthaḥ |
hemakundendradeveśa (?) kṣīrārṇavasamudbhave |
somapriye sudhenvākhye saurabheyi namo ‘stu te ||
datteyam indranāthāya śaśāṅkāyāmṛtāya ca |
atrinetraprajātāya (?) somarājāya vai namaḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
yas tv evaṃ parayā bhaktyā brāhmaṇāya prayacchati |
sa yāti somalokaṃ tu somena saha modate ||
na rogī na jvarī kuṣṭhī kule tasya prajāyate |
putradārasamopeto jīvec ca śaradāṃ śatam ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktaḥ kārpāsadhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha lavaṇadhenudānam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho sarvaśāstraviśārada |
kathayasva hi dānānām uttamaṃ yat prakīrtitam ||
[433]        yena dattena dattāni sarvāṇy api bhavanty uta |
sarvakāmasamṛddhaś ca sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet |
prāyaścittaviśuddhaś ca tan me kathaya suvrata ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi lavaṇasyeha kalpitām |
gomayenopalipte tu darbhasaṃstarasaṃsthitām ||
āvikaṃ carma vinyasya pūrvāśābhimukhāṃ sthitām |
vastreṇācchāditāṃ kṛtvā dhenuṃ kurvīta madhyagām ||
āḍhakenaiva kurvīta bahuvitto ‘lpavān api |
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurām ikṣupādāṃ phalastanīm ||
kāryā śarkarayā jihvā gandhaghrāṇavatī tathā |
samudodarajāṃ śuktiṃ karṇau ca pariveṣṭayet ||
śṛṅge candanakāṣṭhābhyāṃ mauktike cākṣiṇī śubhe |
kapolau saktupiṇḍābhyāṃ yavān āsye pradāpayet ||
kambalaṃ paṭṭasūtreṇa grīvāyāṃ chatrikā tathā |
pṛṣṭhe vai tāmrapātraṃ tu apāne guḍapiṇḍakām ||
lāṅgūle kambalaṃ dadyād rasān kṣīrapradeśataḥ |
yonipradeśe ca madhu sarvatas tu phalānvitām ||
evaṃ samyak paristhāpya lavaṇasya kṛtāṃ ca gām |
sthāpayed vatsakaṃ cāpi caturbhāgena mānavaḥ ||
evaṃ dhenuṃ samabhyarcya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
[434]        snātvā devārcanaṃ kuryād brāhmaṇān abhipūjya ca ||
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ gāṃ tu putrabhāryāsamanvitaḥ |
brāhmaṇāya suśīlāya vṛttayuktāya vai nṛpa ||
dadyāt parvasu sarveṣu mantreṇānena mānavaḥ |
lavaṇe vai rasāḥ sarve lavaṇe sarvadevatāḥ ||
sarvadevīmayi devi lavaṇākhye namo ‘stu te |
evam uccārya mantrānte viprāya pratipādayet ||
samyak pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ nṛpa |
pradakṣiṇā mahī tena kṛtā bhavati bhārata ||
sarvadānāni dattāni sarvartukaphalāni ca |
sarve rasāḥ sarvamantrāḥ sarvam etac carācaram ||
saubhāgyaṃ ca parāṃ vṛddhiṃ śarīrārogyasaṃpadaḥ |
nṛṇāṃ bhavati datvā tu rasadhenuṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
svarge ca niyataṃ vāso yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
pattorṇakambalagalāṃ lavaṇodakena
kṛtvā phalastanavatīm avicarma pṛṣṭhe |
datvā dvijāya vidhivad rasadhenumatāṃ
lokaṃ gavāṃ sakalasaukhyayutaṃ prayāti ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto lavaṇadhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha karpūrādidhenudānam |
karpūradhenuṃ vakṣyāmi sarvagandhamayīṃ śubhām |
yān datvā sarvagandhās tu pradattāḥ syur mahīpate ||
[435]        candragrahe vātha bhānoḥ kārtikyāṃ viṣuvaty atha |
dvādaśyām ayane puṇye dadyāt karpūragāṃ vibho ||
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya śīlavṛttaparāya ca |
bhūmāv āstīrya netraṃ tu śaṅkhaśuklāmbaraṃ śubham ||
kāryā catuṣpalā dhenuḥ palamātras tu vatsakaḥ |
atha vā palikā dhenur vatsaḥ kāryas tu kārṣikaḥ ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgā raupyakhurā pucchaṃ kuṅkumasaṃbhavam |
mṛganābhimayā dantā granthiparṇamayaṃ mukham ||
akṣiṇī sihvakamaye (?) karṇau cāgurukāṣṭhajau |
devadārumayaṃ pucchaṃ gudaṃ guggulasaṃbhavam ||
kuṣṭhaṃ kapolakaṃ proktam uśīraṃ carma caiva tu |
udare candanaṃ dadyāt kurāgre nakham eva ca ||
evaṃ saṃkalpya karpūrāṃ dhenuṃ vastreṇa pūjitām |
vipraṃ saṃpūjya karpūrāṃ vastrayugmena caiva hi ||
karpūradhenuṃ vipreśa gṛhāṇa māṃ supūjitām |
puṣpagandhasthitā sā me kamalā prīyatām iti ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa dānaṃ viprāya dāpayet |
datvā denum imāṃ rājan gandharvāṇāṃ samo bhavet ||
kalpatrayaṃ vaset svarge rājarājo bhaved iha |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti gaurīloke mahīyate ||
tathā |
sarvakāmapradā dhenuḥ śarkarāyāḥ prakīrtitā. |
sarvapāpaharā caiva tasmād dadyāt samāhitaḥ ||
[436]        guḍadhenuvad atrāpi mantrāvāhanapūjanam |
datvā phalamayīṃ dhenuṃ kāmānāṃ phalabhāg bhavet ||
tathā kāstūrikāṃ dhenuṃ śraddhāvittasamanvitaḥ |
pātre dadyān nṛpaśreṣṭha mantram etam udīrayet ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaḥ karpūrādidhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha suvarṇadhenudānam |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
kathayāmi rahasyaṃ te dānadharmopabṛṃhitam |
suvarṇadhenusaṃbandhi sarvapāpopaśāntidam ||
yad brahmaṇāpi rājendra vihitaṃ viṣṇunā purā |
tat te vistarato rājan kathayāmy anupūrvaśaḥ ||
suvarṇasya suvarṇasya śuddhasya parikalpitām |
ekaḥ suvarṇaśabdaḥ hiraṇyavacanaḥ, paraḥ parimāṇavacanaḥ |
raupyavatsakasaṃyuktāṃ muktāphalavibhūṣitām |
pravālaśṛṅgopayutāṃ padmarāgākṣiśālinīm ||
ghṛtapātrastanavatīṃ karpūrāgurunāsikām |
śarkarārasanopetāṃ mṛṣṭānnamukhasaṃmitām ||
śaṅkhaśṛṅgāntarāṃ śuktilalāṭasthānakalpitām |
phaladantāṃ vastrayugmapārśvāṃ kṣaumasukambalām ||
ikṣupādāṃ nālikeraśravaṇāṃ guḍajānukām |
pañcagavyāpānavatīṃ kāṃsyapṛṣṭhasamanvitām ||
supaṭṭasūtralāṅgūlāṃ saptadhānyasamanvitām |
[437]        phalapuṣpasamopetāṃ chatropāntsamanvitām |
suvarṇadhenuṃ viprāya pratipādyedṛśīṃ naraḥ ||
hiraṇyaretāḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ |
taptahemachaviḥ sraṣṭā viśvātmā prīyatām iti ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa dhenor dānaṃ prakīrtitam |
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
kulānāṃ tu sahasraṃ tu svargaṃ nayati tad budhaḥ |
kim anyair bahubhir dānair paryāptaṃ hemadhenunā ||
suvarṇadhenuṃ datvā hi kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ |
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān prīyatām iti kīrtayet ||
upavāsaviśuddhātmā dadyāt somaravigrahe |
rakṣaḥpiśācās tadgehaṃ na paśyanti narādhipa ||
kārttikyaṃ prayato dadyād dvādaśyāṃ kārttikasya tu |
datvā tatpadam āpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaḥ suvarṇadhenudānavidhiḥ |
agastya uvāca |
manunā yaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā prāptā lokā anuttamāḥ |
bravīmi tad ahaṃ hemadhenudānavidhiṃ nṛpa ||
śubhāṃ hemamayīṃ gāṃ ca kārayed rājatān khurān |
śubhāṃ śuddhasuvarṇais tu ghaṭitān | atra suvarṇaparimāṇacaturthāṃśavatsanirmāṇādir anuktāṅgopasaṃhāraḥ, pūrvoktasuvarṇadhenor avagantavyaḥ |
tāṃ vastraprāvṛtāṃ kṛtvā prāpnuyāl lokam uttamam ||
[438]        vicitracitrapuṣpaiś ca gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
tathā kṣamāpayed devīṃ tāṃ gāṃ tatra samarpayet ||
devi tvadīyād ādeśāt tava bhakteṣu dīyate |
punas tāṃ viprarājāya dāpayec chivabhāvine ||
śivabhāvine śivadhyāyine |
akṣayyaphalakāmena prāyaścittaviśuddhaye |
manunā cīrṇam etad vai saṃpateyur narāḥ kila ||
saptapūrvāparān vaṃśān rudrakilbiṣasaṃsthitān |
udvatya vānayed vatsa devīlokam anuttamam ||
iti devīpurāṇokto hemadhenudānavidhiḥ | vahnipurāṇāt |
suvarṇadhenuś cāpy atra suvarṇāś ca caturdaśa |
sunirṇiktasuvarṇaiś ca saptabhir madhyamā smṛtā ||
caturbhiḥ kanyasā proktā caturthāṃśena vatsakaḥ |
guḍadhenuvidhānena dattā sarvaphalapradā ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
hiraṇyaretāḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ |
raktahemachaviḥ sraṣṭā viśvātmā prīyatām iti ||
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān prīyatām iti kīrtayet |
suvarṇadhenuṃ datvā ca kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ ||
iti suvarṇadhenudānavidhiḥ |
athāha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
dhenuṃ svarṇamayīṃ kuryāt pūrveṇa vidhinā tataḥ |
[439]        suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ ratnāḍhyāṃ tathā raupyakhurām api ||
tathā ca tarṇakaṃ kuryād aṣṭabhāgena pūrvavat |
brāḥmaṇaṃ śrutasaṃpannaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca kutumbinam ||
ācāravantaṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ dvijaśuśrūṣaṇodyatam |
gṛham āhūya vidhivat pūjayet pūrvavac ca tam ||
yathā vibhavato bhaktyā hemaḥ pūrvavad eva hi |
mantrais tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ samyak pālāśasamidhas tathā ||
homānte tāṃ pradadyāc ca mantreṇānena mehavān |
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ yasya rājatejas tathaiv hi ||
premehaṃ haratu kṣipraṃ (?) viṣṇur garuḍavāhanaḥ |
dānamantraḥ |
dānaṃ prameharogaghnam etat kāryaṃ manīṣibhiḥ |
kṛtenānena śāmyanti premehā dāruṇā api ||
atra pūrvavad iti rājatavṛṣabhadānavad iti jñeyam |
iti pramehaghnasuvarṇadhenudānavidhiḥ |
athāha baudhāyanaḥ |
sauvarṇīṃ gāṃ prakurvīta palenārdhena vā punaḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta kurvan naivaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ||
ratnaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ nānāvastrair alaṃkṛtām |
grahāṇām upari sthāpya nava dhānyāni vinyaset ||
homas tu pūrvavat kāryo govindaprītaye hitaḥ |
evaṃ viṣṇupratadviṣṇur viṣṇor nukam iti kramāt ||
samidājyacaruṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutyanta eva hi |
[440]        tatas tāṃ tu śucī rogī brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam ||
śrutavṛttopasaṃpannaṃ kulīnaṃ dharmavādinam |
vṛddhaṃ jñānopasaṃpannam anudvegakaraṃ nṛṇām ||
bhaktyā svayaṃ samānīya pūjayet prītipūrvakam |
aṅgulīyakapātrādyair upānacchatrakair api |
mantreṇānena tāṃ pātre dadyād rogī yathātmavān ||
govindaṃ manasā dhyāyan gavāṃ madhye sthitaṃ śuśum |
barhāpīḍakasaṃyuktaṃ veṇuvādanatatparam ||
gopījanaiḥ parivṛtaṃ vanyapuṣpāvataṃsakam |
govinda gopījanavallabheśa
kaṃsāsuraghna tridaśendravadya |
godānatṛptaḥ kuru me dayālo
arśovināśaṃ kṣayitārivargaḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
dānenānena niyatamarśasāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ |
tasmāt kuryāt prayatnena sukhārthaṃ hy etad arśaso ||
ity arśoghasuvarṇadhenudānavidhiḥ |
atha vāyupurāṇe |
caturvidhā ca yā vandhyā bhaved vatsaviyojanāt |
vakṣye tasyāḥ pratīkāraṃ tatsvarūpaṃ nibodha me ||
hiraṇyena yathā śaktyā savatsāṃ kāraye dṛḍhām |
dhenuṃ palena vatsaṃ ca pādena gurur abravīt ||
dhenuṃ raupakhurāṃ ratnaṃ tasyāḥ pucche niyojayet |
[441]        ghaṇṭāṅgale ca badhnīyāt savatsāṃ prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ ||
candanāgurukarpūrair gandhamālyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ bhavet ||
modakaṃ ca tathāpūpaṃ guḍaṃ lavaṇam eva ca |
jīrakaṃ tu suvistīrṇe sūrpe veṇumaye dṛḍhe ||
dhenor ekaṃ pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇastrīṣu caiva hi |
ṣaḍ aṣṭau daśa vā dadyāt tadanantaram eva ca ||
brāhmaṇaṃ sarvaśāstrārthakuśalaṃ dharmavedinam |
vidyādinayasaṃpannaṃ śāntaṃ caiva jitendriyam ||
alolupaṃ sarvajanapriyaṃ kalmaṣavarjitam |
āhūya bhaktyā saṃpūjya vastrādyair gandhapuṣpakaiḥ ||
tenaiva kārayet pūjām ādṛto dhenuvatsayoḥ |
homaṃ ca kārayet tatra samidājyacarūtkaṭam ||
somo dhenum iti mantraṃ samuccārya tataḥ punaḥ |
prāṅmukhāyopaviṣṭāya pradadyāt tām udaṅmukhaḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat pucche hastaṃ vidhāya ca |
dhenur yāṅgirasaḥ sā tu vaśiṣṭhe surabhī ca yā ||
duhitā yā tathā bhānor agneś ca varuṇasya ca |
yāś ca gāvaḥ pravartante vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca ||
prīṇantu tā mama sadā putrapautrapradāḥ sukham |
prayacchati divārātram avicchedaṃ ca santateḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu tad dānaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet ||
iti vandhyātvaharasuvarṇadhenudānavidhiḥ |
[442] tathā |
prasvinnapāṇipādaḥ syāt yo hareta rasādikam |
vakṣyāmi tat pratīkāraṃ dānahomādikarmaṇā ||
palārdhena tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
kuryād dhenuṃ suvarṇena vatsas tatpādato bhavet ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tu tāṃ dhanuṃ vastreṇāveṣṭya śobhanām |
guḍasyopari saṃsthāpya pūjayed gandhadhūpakaiḥ |
guḍasya ca parīmāṇaṃ catvāriṃśatpalaṃ bhavet ||
yad vā tadardham eva syād yathāvibhavam eva vā |
havyakavyādi ca ghṛtadadhikṣīracatuṣṭayam ||
pādeṣv ekaikaśaḥ sthāpya pūrvadakṣiṇataḥ kramāt |
śṛṅgāṇi ca punas tasyāḥ kuṅkumenānulepayet ||
evaṃ vidhāya tāṃ dhenum ācāryaḥ svarṇarūpiṇīm |
homaṃ samārabhet kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vātha pūjite ||
agnipraṇayanaṃ kṛtvā hy ācāryaḥ sarvavedavit |
dharmajño yajñavedas tu kuśalaḥ krōdhavarjitaḥ ||
anudvegakaro nṛṇāṃ purāṇārthavid aṅgavit |
samidājyatilaiś cāpi mantrair ebhiḥ krameṇa tu |
āyaṃ gaur iti mantreṇa samiddhomaḥ praśasyate ||
śaibhedyeyadi (?) mantreṇa ājyahomo budhaiḥ saha |
tilahomo vyāhṛtibhir aṣṭottarasahasrakam ||
evaṃ homaṃ ca nirvartya niryātasyābhiṣecanam |
agneḥ pūrvottare deśe sthāpayet kumbham avraṇam ||
śvetena vāsasā caiva mṛttikāṃ guggulaṃ tathā |
[443]        gorocanā saṃbhave ca pañcabhaṅgasamiddhute ||
mantrair athāpohiṣṭeti tisṛbhis taṃ tu rogiṇam |
hiraṇyavarṇa iti ca pāvamānena caiva hi ||
śannovātānuvākena śāṇtiṃ prathamam eva hi |
kṛtvābhiṣecanaṃ kuryāt śuklāmbaradharasya tu ||
āhutīnāṃ ca saṃpātaiḥ pāṇipādau ca lepayet |
tatas tāṃ pūjayed dhanuṃ rogī gandhākṣatādibhiḥ |
gāva eva surabhaya itimantreṇa bhaktitaḥ ||
ācāryāyātha tāṃ dadyāt prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
mantreṇānena vidhivat pūjitāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
ādityasya sutā yās tu devānāṃ yāś ca dhenavaḥ |
pitṝṇām api yakṣāṇāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
yakṣāṇāṃ guhyakānāṃ tu vaśiṣṭhasurabhis tathā |
etās tuṣṭā mama kṣipraṃ dhenor asyāḥ pradānataḥ ||
rasacauryeṇa yaj jātaṃ vairūpyaṃ pāṇipādayoḥ |
tat sarvaṃ nāsayanty āśu dhenavaḥ sarvatoṣitāḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
anena vidhinā svarṇadhenudānaṃ karoti yaḥ |
pūrvakarmavipākotthaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ praṇaśyati ||
dakṣiṇāṃ brāhmaṇe dadyād yathāśaktyātha bhaktitaḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi bandhūn api ca bhojayet ||
svayaṃ snātvā ca bhuñjīta mṛṣṭāhārais tu saṃyataḥ |
dānenānena niyataṃ pādaprasvedajāṃ rujam ||
jayanti rogiṇaḥ kāryaṃ pādaprasvedinā tataḥ ||
[444] iti pādaprasvedaghnasuvarṇadhenudānavidhiḥ (?) |
atha svarūpato godānaṃ mahābhārate |
dānānām iha sarveṣāṃ gavāṃ dānaṃ viśiṣyate |
gāvaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pavitrāś ca pāvanā jagaduttamāḥ ||
ṛte dadhighṛtābhyāṃ ca neha yajñaḥ pravartate |
tena yajñam aśeṣaṃ hi gomūlaṃ saṃpracakṣate ||
gāvo ‘dhikās tapasvibhyaḥ sadā sarvebhya eva ca |
tasmān maheśvaro devas tad etābhiḥ saha sthitaḥ ||
payasā haviṣā dadhnā śakṛtāpy atha carmaṇā |
asthibhiś copakurvanti vālaiḥ śṛṅgiś ca bhārata ||
gobhis tulyaṃ na paśyāmi dhanaṃ kiṃcid ihācyutam |
kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ dānaṃ darśanaṃ cāpi pārthiva ||
gavāṃ praśasyate vīra sarvapāpaharaṃ param |
gāvo lakṣmyāḥ sadā mūlaṃ goṣu pāpmā na vidyate ||
svāhākāravaṣṭkārau goṣu nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau |
gāvo yajñapraṇetryo vai tathā yajñasya gaurmukham ||
amṛtaṃ hy akṣayaṃ divyaṃ rakṣanti ca vahanti ca |
amṛtāyatanaṃ caitāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ ||
na godānāt paraṃ dānaṃ kiṃcid astīti me matiḥ |
sā gaur nyāyārjitā datvā kṛtsnaṃ tārayate kulam ||
amṛtaṃ vai gavāṃ kṣīram ity uvāca prajāpatiḥ |
tasmād dadāti yo dhenum amṛtatvaṃ sa gacchati ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
agnyāgārāṇi viprāṇāṃ devatāyatanāni ca |
[445]        pūjyante sakṛtā yāsāṃ kiṃ deyam ahikaṃ tataḥ ||
devalaḥ |
vimānavaram ārūḍho divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
yo gantuṃ vāñchati svargaṃ sa godānaṃ prayacchatu ||
dānam apy adhikaṃ denor vidyate vā samaṃ bhuvi |
niyataṃ tridaśair vyāsaḥ kalpito ‘syās tu vigrahe ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
ādityaduhitā gaur hi pṛthīyaṃ parikīrtitā |
śreyo ‘rthe sarvalokānām utpannā kratusiddhaye ||
brāhmaṇāś caiva gāvaś ca kulam ekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam |
ekatra mantrās tiṣṭhanti havir ekatra tiṣṭhati ||
gobhyo yajñāḥ pravartante gobhyo devāḥ samutthitāḥ |
gobhyo vedāḥ samudgīrṇāḥ saṣaḍaṅgapadakramāḥ ||
śṛṅgamūle gavāṃ nityaṃ brahmaviṣṇū samāśritau |
śṛṅgāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ||
śiromadhye mahādevaḥ sarvabhūtamayaḥ sthitaḥ |
lalāṭāgre sthitā devī nāsāv aṃśe ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ ||
kambaleśvatarau nāgau nāsāpuṭasupālitau |
karṇayor aśvinau devau cakṣuṣoḥ śaśibhāskarau ||
danteṣu vayavaḥ sarve jihvāyāṃ varuṇaḥ sthitaḥ |
sarasvatī ca huṃkāre yamayakṣau ca gaṇḍayoḥ ||
saṃdhyādvaye tathoṣṭhābhyāṃ grīvām indraḥ samāśritaḥ |
[446]        rakṣāṃsi kakṣadeśe tu sādhyāś corasi saṃsthitāḥ ||
catuṣpāt sakalo dharmaḥ svayaṃ jaṅghāsu saṃsthitaḥ |
khuramadhye tu gandharvāḥ kurāgreṣu ca pannagāḥ ||
khurāṇāṃ paścimāgreṣu gaṇā hy apsarasāṃ sthitāḥ |
rudrāś caikādaśa pṛṣṭhe vasavaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu ||
śroṇītaṭasthāḥ pitaraḥ somo lāṅgulam āśritaḥ |
ādityaraśmayo bālāḥ piṇḍībhūtā vyavasthitāḥ ||
sākṣād gaṅgā ca gomūtre gomaye yamunā sthitā |
kṣīre sarasvatī devī narmadā dadhisaṃsthitāḥ ||
hutāśanaḥ svayaṃ sarpir brāhmaṇānāṃ guruḥ paraḥ |
aṣṭāviṃśatidevānāṃ kōṭyo romasu saṃsthitāḥ ||
udare pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā |
catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ pūrṇā gavāṃ ye tu payodharāḥ ||
etadbhiḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā goṣu pratiṣṭhitam |
jagad vai devaśārdūla sadevāsuramānavam ||
skandapurāṇe |
tṛṇāni khādanti vasanty araṇye
pibanti toyāny aparigrahāṇi |
duhyanti vāhyanti punanti pāpaṃ
gavāṃ rasair jīvati jīvalikaḥ ||
tuṣṭās tu gāvaḥ śamayanti pāpaṃ
dattās tu gāvas tridivaṃ nayanti |
[447]        saṃrakṣitāś copanayanti vittaṃ
gobhir na tulyaṃ dhanam asti kiṃcit ||
śaṣpaṃ samaśnāti dadāti nityaṃ
pāpāpahaṃ mitravivardhanaṃ ca |
sa eva cāryaḥ paribhujyate ca
gobhir na tulyaṃ dhanam asti kiṃcit ||
tṛṇāni śuṣkāni vane caritvā
pītvāpi toyāny amṛtaṃ śravanti |
yad gomayādyāś ca punanti lokān
gobhir na tulyaṃ dhanam asti kiṃcit ||
hārītaḥ |
bahukṣīrāś ca yo gā vai brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
uttārayet sa ātmānaṃ sapta sapta kulāni ca ||
devalaḥ |
suśīlāṃ lakṣaṇavatīṃ yuvatiṃ vatsasaṃyutām |
bahududhavatīṃ snigdhāṃ dhenuṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
vedavyāsaḥ |
yaś cātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā gāḥ krītvā saṃprayacchati |
ātmavikrayatulyās tāḥ śāsvatīḥ vṛddhakauśikaḥ ||
tathā |
saṃprāmeṣv [saṃgrāmeṣv?] arjayitvā tu yo vai gāḥ saṃprayacchati |
yāvatīḥ sparśayed gāvaḥ sa tāvatphalam aśṇute ||
tāvad iti pūrvoktatāvadgoromasaṃmitam | saṃvatsaraṃ svargaphalam |
yo vaidyute dhanaṃ jitvā krītvā gāḥ saṃprayacchati |
sa divyam ayutaṃ śakra varṣāṇāṃ phalam aśnute ||
antarjātāḥ sukrayajñānalabdhāḥ | [448] paṇakrītā nirjitāś caukajāś ca | kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇābhyāgatāś ca dvārair etair goviśeṣāḥ praśastāḥ | antarjātā garbhiṇya iti bhāratapadaprakāśakāraḥ | sukrayalabdhāḥ yathāmūlyakrayaprāptāḥ, paṇakrītāḥ bhṛtilabdhāḥ, nirjitā yuddhādinā, okajāḥ gṛhajātāḥ, kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇābhyāgatā iti, vyādhyādikṛcchrākrāntāḥ satyaḥ svāminā yās tyaktāḥ svayaṃ ca poṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā labdhāḥ |
ruṣṭā duṣṭā durbalā vyādhitā ca
na dātavyā yā ca mūlyair adattaiḥ |
kleśair vipraṃ yā phalaiḥ saṃyunakti
tasyāvīryāś cāphalāś cāpi lokāḥ ||
mūlyair adattaiḥ svīkṛteti śeṣaḥ | tathā |
na kṛśāṃ pāpavatsāṃ vā vandhyāṃ rogānvitāṃ tathā |
na vyaṃgāmapariśrāntāṃ dadyād gāṃ brāhmaṇāya vai ||
yo dadyād upayuktārthāṃ jīrṇāṃ dhenuṃ ca niṣphalām |
tamaḥ saṃpraviśed dātā dvijaṃ kleśena yojayet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
pītodakāṃ jagdhatṛṇāṃ dugdhacoṣāṃ nirindriyām |
unmattām aṅgahīnāṃ ca mṛtavatsāṃ mahāśanām ||
keśavālapurīṣāsthikravyādāṃ saṃdhinīṃ khalām |
puṭadhenuṃ yamalasūṃ nityaṃ vraṇayitastanīm ||
na dadyād brāhmaṇebhyaś ca sadoṣaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā |
pītodakāṃ jagdhatṛṇām iti vṛddhatvopalakṣaṇaparām | [449] dugdhacoṣāṃ svakīyastanapāyinīm, mahāśanām bahubhakṣām, puṭadhenuṃ vālyāvasthaiva yā garbhiṇī |
viśvāmitraḥ |
naikaśṛṅgāṃ ca niśchṛṅgāṃ sphuṭitākṣīṃ calatkhurām |
na dadyāt tristanīṃ caiva gāṃ śubhāv eva dāpayet ||
mahābhārate |
ambarīṣo gavāṃ datvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pratāpavān |
arbudāni daśaikaṃ ca sarāṣṭro ‘bhyapatad divam ||
datvā śatasahasraṃ tu gavāṃ rājā prasenajit |
savatsānāṃ mahātejā gato lokān anuttamān ||
tathā |
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāḥ śayyā ratnojvalās tathā |
varāś cāpsaraso yatra tatra gacchanti gopradāḥ ||
goprado narakaṃ naiti payaḥ pītvāmbūjaṃ jalam |
vimānenārkavarṇena divi rājan virājate ||
taṃ cāruveṣāḥ susroṇyaḥ śataśo varayoṣitaḥ |
ramayanti vimānasthaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||
veṇūnāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca nūpurāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ |
hāsaiś ca hariṇākṣīṇāṃ suptaḥ san pratibudhyate ||
yāvanti romāṇi bhavanti dhenvās
tāvanti varṣāṇi mahīyate svaḥ |
svargāc cyutaś cāpi tatas triloke
kule samutpatsyati gomatāṃ saḥ ||
[450] viṣṇuḥ: “gopradānena svargam āpnoti daśadhenuprado golokaṃ śatapradaś ca brahmalokam” | jābālaḥ |
homārtham agnihotrasya yo dāṃ dadyād ayācitām |
trir vittapūrṇā pṛthivī tena dattā na saṃśayaḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
yathā kathaṃcid datvā gāṃ dhenuṃ vādhenum eva vā |
arogām aparikliṣṭāṃ dātā svarge mahīyate ||
aṅgirāḥ |
gaur ekasyaiva dātavyā śrotriyasya viśeṣataḥ |
sā hi tārayate pūrvān sapta sapta ca sapta ca ||
nandipurāṇe |
apātre sā tu gaur dattā dātāraṃ narakaṃ nayet |
kulaikaviṃśatyā yuktaṃ grahītāraṃ ca tārayet ||
vidhinā ca yadā dattā pātre dhenuḥ sadakṣiṇā |
tadā tārayate jantūn kulānām ayutaiḥ śaitaḥ ||
pātrāṇy ādhyātmikā mukhyā suśuddhāś cāgnihotriṇaḥ |
devatāś ca tathā mukhyā godānaṃ hy etad uttamam ||
mahābhārate |
vṛttiglānaṃ sīdati cātimātraṃ
kavyārthaṃ cāhomahetoḥ prasutyām |
gurvarthe vā bālasaṃvṛddhaye vā
dhenuṃ dadyād eṣa kālo viśiṣṭaḥ ||
[451] prasutyāṃ somayāge | tathā |
na vadhārthaṃ pradātavyā na kīnāśe na nāstike |
gojīve na ca dātavyā tathā gauḥ puruṣarṣabha ||
kīnāśo halavāhakaḥ | ātreyaḥ |
sīdate (?) bahubhṛtyāya śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye |
atithipriyāya dāntāya deyā dhenur guḍānvitā ||
akulīnāya mūrkhāya lubdhāya piśunāya ca |
havyakavyavyapetāya gaur na deyā kathaṃcana ||
atha dānavidhiḥ | viśvāmitraḥ |
prāṅmukhīṃ gām avasthāpya savatsāṃ tāṃ supūjitām |
pucchadeśe tu dātā vai snāto baddhaśikho bhavet ||
udaṅmukhas tu vipraḥ syāt pātralakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ |
ājyapātraṃ kare kṛtvā kanakena samanvitam ||
nikṣipye pucchaṃ tasmiṃs tu ghṛtadigdhaṃ pragṛhya ca |
satilaṃ viprapāṇiṃ tu prāgagraṃ tu nidhāpayet ||
satilaṃ sa kuśaṃ cāpi gṛhītvā dānam ācaret |
anenaiva tu mantreṇa pātrahasto jalaṃ kṣipet ||
yajñasādhanabhūtā yā viśvasyāghapranāśinī |
viśvarūpaḥ paro devaḥ prīyatām anayā gavā ||
anuvrajya tu tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇena samanvitām |
gomatīṃ tu tato vidyāṃ japeta prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
uddiśyātha vāsudevaṃ prīyatām iti cānagha |
[452]        pātraṃ manasi saṃcintya toyam apsu vinikṣipet ||
jalaśāyī brahmapitā padmanābhaḥ sanātanaḥ |
anantabhogaśayanaḥ prīyatāṃ pramaḥ pitā ||
gomatīm āha yamaḥ |
gāvaḥ surabhayo nityaṃ gāvo guggulagandhikāḥ |
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ mahat ||
annam eva paraṃ gāvo devānāṃ havir uttamam |
pāvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ rakṣanti ca vahanti ca ||
haviṣā mantrapūtena tarpayanty amarān divi |
ṛṣīṇām agnihotṝṇāṃ gāvo homapratiṣṭhikāḥ ||
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ maṅgalam uttamam |
gāvaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ gāvo maṅgalam uttmam ||
gāvaḥ sarvasya lokasya gāvo dhanyāḥ savāhanāḥ |
namo gobhyaḥ śrīmatībhyaḥ saurabheyībhya eva ca ||
namo brahmasutābhyaś ca pavitrābhyo namo namaḥ |
brāhmaṇāś caiva gāvaś ca kulam ekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ||
ekatra mantrās tiṣṭhanti havir ekatra tiṣṭhati ||
anyāpi gomatī mahābhāratoktā tiladhenudāne darśitā | tataś cānayor vikalpānuṣṭhānam iti | sarvagodānasādhāraṇaṃ mantram āha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
ghṛtakṣīrapradā gāvo ghṛtayonyo ghṛtodbhavāḥ |
ghṛtanadyo ghṛtāvartās tā me santu sadā gṛhe ||
[453]        ghṛtaṃ me hṛdaye nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
ghṛtaṃ me sarvataś caiva ghṛtaṃ me manasi sthitam ||
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca |
gāvo me sarvataś caiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham ||
ity ācamya japan sāyaṃ prātaś ca puruṣaḥ sadā |
yad ahnā kurute pāpaṃ tasmāt sa parimucyate ||
dakṣiṇā cātra suvarṇam | yad āha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇām āhur gopradāne mahāphale |
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ hy āyur dakṣiṇārtha na saṃśayaḥ ||
gopradānaṃ tārayate sapta pūrvān narāṃs tathā |
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā tāvad dviguṇam ucyate ||
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā |
suvarṇaṃ pāvanaṃ prāhuḥ parimāṇaṃ paraṃ tathā ||
atra suvarṇaśabdasya hiraṇyaparyāyatve yathāśaktyānuṣṭhānam | apare tv āhuḥ sakṛd uccaritasuvarṇaśabdāvagataparimāṇārthaparityāgānupapatteḥ suvarṇaśabdasya prāhur ityādikriyākarmabhūtatayā dvitīyāntatvena liṅgaviśeṣanirdhāraṇāc ca parimāṇārthathaiva nyāyyeti | evaṃ ca saty aniyatānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgabhaṅgaḥ tathāparimāṇaparaṃ tathety etad api samañjasaṃ syāt |
atra kecic codayanti —
etad eva vidhānaṃ syāt ta evopaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
[454]        vidhānam etad dhenūnāṃ sarvāsām api paṭhyate ||
iti vacanāt pratyakṣadhenor api sakalaguḍadhenudharmaprāptau śuktikarṇekṣupādāditvam ācaraṇīyam iti |
tad asat | daśamī syāt svarūpata iti svarūpaśabda eva savatsāṅgorūpadhāriṇīm upakaraṇādivihīnān dhenum avagamayan śuktyādimayīṃ karṇādipratikṛtikṛtiṃ nivārayati sarvaśabdaś ca prakṛtāpekṣo ‘pi svarūpadhenuvarjam avatiṣṭhate tasmāt tat svarūpadhenvā guḍadhenor itikartavyatā kartavyeti vakṣyamāṇasuvarṇaśṛṅgikāvidhis tu bhinna eveti sarvam anavadyam |
iti godānavidhiḥ |
atha skandapurāṇe |
savatsāṃ kāṃsyahohanāṃ hemaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurām |
dukūlakṣaumavāsitāṃ śayyāstaraṇasaṃpannām ||
bahupuṣpaphalair yutāṃ brāhmaṇān tarpayitvā tu |
yo naro gāṃ prayacchet tu gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtām ||
devair adhyāsitāṃ tāṃ tu sarvais tadvad dvayena tu |
mṛdubandhena badhnīyāt tataḥ ślakṣnena rajjunā ||
kuśān suvarṇabījāni tilāḥ siddhārtakās tathā |
pradadyāt tān tato ‘dbhiś ca mantreṇānena suvrata ||
sarvadevamayīṃ dogdhrīṃ sarvalokamayīṃ tathā |
sarvalokanimittāṃ tāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām ||
prayacchāmi mhāsattvām akṣayāya śubhām iti |
[455]        evaṃ sa datvā yo gāṃ tu yatra yatra prajāyate ||
tatra tatra gatā sā tān jantūṃs tārayate bhayāt |
sarvalokāntare gatvā ramate ca yathā naraḥ ||
sa tathā mānavo jāto gosahasrī mahābalaḥ |
rūpavān dhanavāṃś caiva bahuputraś ca jāyate ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
śīlopapannāṃ savanottarīyāṃ
kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakāntaśṛṅgīm |
viprāya datvā bhagavan priyāya
prayāti lokān amṛtān supuṇyān ||
saṃvartaḥ |
yo dadāti śaphair raupyair hemaśṛṅgīm arogiṇīm |
savatsāṃ vatsasaṃyuktāṃ suśīlāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm ||
yāvanti tasyā romāṇi savatsāyā divaṃ gataḥ |
tāvato vatsarām āste sa naro brahmaṇo ‘ntike ||
devalaḥ |
cāmīkaramaye śṛṅge kṛte rapuyamayāḥ khurāḥ |
kāṃsyajaṃ dohanaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmraṃ vastrayugānvitā ||
puṣpamālāvṛtā dhūpaghaṇṭācāmaramaṇḍitā |
dīyate pucchadeśena śraddhayā dakṣiṇānvitā ||
datvaivaṃ dattabhogāḍhyo divyastrīvṛndasaṃvṛtaḥ |
govatsaromatulyāni varṣāṇi divi modate ||
iti hemaśṛṅgīdānavidhiḥ |
[456]
nandipurāṇe |
yo gāṃ suparipūrāṅgīṃ hemaśṛṅgīm akopanām |
suśīlāṃ rājataiḥ pādaiś citravastrasusaṃvṛtām ||
salohapātrāṃ kutape niviṣṭacaraṇāṃ tathā |
kutapo ‘tra nepālakambalaḥ |
sadakṣiṇāṃ pradadyād gāṃ so ‘kṣayaṃ svargam āpnuyāt ||
gavi romāṇi yāvanti prasūtikulasaṃsthitaḥ |
tāvanty abdāni vasati svarge dātā na saṃśayaḥ ||
ity aparahemaśṛṅgīdānavidhiḥ |
etacchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kapilādānataḥ smṛtam ||
atha matsyapurāṇe |
daśasauvarṇike śṛṅge khurāḥ pañcapalānvitāḥ |
pañcāśatpalikaṃ kāṃsyaṃ tāmraṃ vāpi tathaiva ca ||
dātā syāt svargam āpnoti yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
pañcapalāni raupyasyeti vijñeyam | tāmraṃ pṛṣṭhe kāṃsyaṃ dohanam | ācchādanārthaṃ vāsoyugaṃ suvarṇadakṣiṇety api boddhavyam |
iti kanakaśṛṅgīdānavidhiḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
gāṃ dadyād vedapūrṇāya viprāya gṛhamedhine |
suvarṇālaṃkṛtaśrṅgīṃ vatsaghaṇṭāsamanvitām ||
[457]        pratyagrāṃ trisamṛddhāṃ tu lalāṭataṭatarpaṇām |
kāṃsyopadohāṃ tṛptāṃ ca lavaṇāditṛṇodakaiḥ ||
gavāṃ pucchaṃ gṛhītvā ca sasuvarṇena pāṇinā |
gṛhastho vedavidvipro dāpayet tatpratigraham ||
bhogasaukhyaprayāś caitā gomātā pāpanāśinī |
kṛṣṇā svargapradā jñeyā gaurī ca kulavardhanī ||
raktā rūpapradā jñeyā pītā dāridraghātinī |
putrapradā kṛṣṇasārī nīlā dharmavivardhanī ||
kapilā sarvapāpaghnī nānāvarṇā ca mokṣadā ||
pratyagrā navavaysakā, trisamṛddhā śīlakṣīraprasavaguṇayuktā, lavaṇāditṛṇodakais tṛpteti sarvadā lavanādiṣu tuṣṭety arthaḥ |
iti suvarṇaśṛṅgīdānavidhiḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ dadate yas tu paṭṭachannāṃ svalaṃkṛtām |
ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ kṛtvā puṣpaiś caivāpy alaṃkṛtām (?) ||
vidhivac ca dvijātibhyo yamalokaṃ na paśyati |
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ dātā kāṃāṃś ca mānasān ||
śvetāṅgāṃ dadate yas tu divyaṃ ratnair alaṃkṛtām |
ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ kṛtvā puṣpaiś caivāpy alaṃkṛtām (?) ||
mukhe dhūpaḥ pradātavyo ghṛtenāsyaṃ ca pūrayet |
suvarṇaśṛṅgābharaṇā tathā raupyakhurā śubhā ||
[458]        paṭṭachannā śubhā caiva dātavyā dhyānayogine |
yas tu dadyāc ca gāṃ svetāṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
janmaprabhṛti yat pāpaṃ mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ ca yat |
kuloddhatasya hastasya tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
gāṃ dadānīha ity eva vācā pūyeta sarvaśaḥ |
pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||
narakasthāḥ pramucyante somalokaṃ vrajanti te |
gaurīṃ caiva prayacchet tu yas tu gāṃ vai naraḥ śuciḥ ||
ahorātroṣitaś caiva kṛtaśauco naraḥ sadā |
suvarṇaśṛṅgī raupakhurāṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitām ||
ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ caiva gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtām |
kutapaṃ cāstaret prājño mukhe dhūpaṃ pradāpayet ||
bhakṣabhojyānnapānena brāhmaṇān bhojayec chubhān |
gāṃ dadānīha ity eva vācā pūyeta sarvaśaḥ ||
mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ caiva yac cānyad duṣkṛtaṃ bhavet |
pāpaṃ ca tasya tat sarvaṃ dahaty agnir ivendhanam ||
varṣakoṭisahasraṃ tu pumān sa divi modate |
dāsīdāsair alaṃkāraiḥ stūyate sarvajantubhiḥ ||
arogaś caiva jāyeta tejasvī ca bhaven naraḥ |
nīlvarṇāṃ ca gāṃ dadyād dogdhrīṃ śīlaguṇānvitām ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ mukālāṅgūlabhūṣitām |
paṭṭacchannāṃ subhāṃ saumyāṃ ghaṇṭādāmair alaṃkṛtām ||
pañcaraṅgeṇa sūtreṇa gaṇaveṣṭanaśobhitām |
[459]        rudrasya pramukhe deyā viṣṇoś ca brahmaṇaś ca ha ||
gāṃ dadānīha ity eva vācā pūyeta sarvaśaḥ |
pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||
narakasthāḥ pramucyante nīlāṃ gāṃ dadate tu yaḥ |
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi loke tiṣṭhati vāruṇe ||
dadhikṣīravahā nadyo vartante sarvataḥ sadā |
ghṛtaśailāḥ prapadyante navanītasya parvatāḥ ||
kṛṣibhāgī bahudhanī durbhakṣyaṃ na paśyati ||
iti nānāgodānavidhiḥ |
mahābhārate |
samānavatsāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm |
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃpannāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ||
samānavatsāṃ samānavarṇavatsām |
rohiṇīṃ tulyavatsāṃ ca dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm |
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītām indraloke mahīyate ||
samānavatsāṃ śabalāṃ dhanuṃ datvā pavasvinīm |
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ somaloke mahīyate ||
śabalā karvurā |
samānavatsāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ tu dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm |
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītām agniloke mahīyate ||
vātareṇusuvarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāmadohinīm |
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ vāyuloke mahīyate ||
[460]        samānavatsāṃ dhūmrāṃ tu dhanuṃ datvā payasvinīm |
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃyuktāṃ yamaloke mahīyate ||
arghyāṃ hemasavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāmadohanām |
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ vāruṇaṃ lokam aśnute ||
arghyā gauḥ, kāmadohanām anāyāsadohām |
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ piṅgākṣīṃ savatsāṃ kāmadohanām |
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ kauberaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
palāladhūmavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāmadohanām |
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ pitṛloke mahīyate ||
savatsāṃ pīvarīṃ datvā sitakaṇṭhīm alaṃkṛtām |
vaiśvadevam asaṃbādhaṃ sthānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prapadyate ||
sitakaṇṭhīṃ kṛṣṇagalām |
samānavatsāṃ gorīṃ tu dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm |
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītām vasūnāṃ lokam aśnute ||
suvratā sukhadohyā |
pāṇḍukambalavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāmadohanām |
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ sādhyānāṃ lokam aśnute ||
vatsopannāṃ nīlāṅgīṃ sarvaratnasamanvitām |
gandharvāpsarasāṃ lokān datvā prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||

vimānenārkavarṇena divi rājan virājate ||
[461]        taṃ cāruveṣāḥ suśroṇyaḥ sahasraṃ varayoṣitaḥ |
rasayanti naraśreṣṭhaṃ gopradānarataṃ naram ||
iti samānavatsagodānavidhiḥ
ādityapurāṇe |
kapilāṃ ye prayacchanti celacchannāṃ svalaṃkṛtām |

ghaṇṭāsvanaravaiḥ ghaṇṭāśabdakolāhalaiḥ |

samam eva pure prāha brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ ||
yāvanti romakūpāṇi kapilāṅge bhavanti hi |
tāvatkoṭisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ||
rukmaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ mulālāṅgūlabhūṣitām |
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dhenuṃ gastracchannām alaṃkṛtām ||
datvā dvijendrāya naraḥ svargaloke mahīyate |
daśadhenupradānena tulyaikā kapilā matā ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
hemaśṛṅgī śaphair raumyaiḥ suśīlāṃ vastrasaṃyutām |
sakāṃsyapātrā dātavyā kṣīriṇī gauḥ sadakṣiṇā ||

kapilāñ cet tārayati bhūyas tv āsaptamaṃ kulam ||
vyāsaḥ |
rukmaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakharāṃ vastrasāṃsyopadohanām |
[462]        savatsāṃ kapilāṃ datvā vaṃśān sapta samuddharet ||
yāvanti tasyā romāṇi savatsāyā bhavanti hi |

lokottare |
ghaṇṭācāmarasaṃyuktā kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitā |
divyavastrasamāyuktā hemadarpaṇabhūṣitā ||
payasvinī suśīlā ca taruṇī vatsakānvitā |
kapilaivaṃ pradātavyā śivasyāgre vidhānataḥ ||
dānamantras tu matsyapurāṇe (?) |
kapile sarvabhūtānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇi |
tīrthadevamayī yasmād ataḥ śāṇtiṃ prayaccha me ||
iti kapilādānavidhiḥ |
kūrmapurāṇāt |
daśasauvarṇike śṛṅge khurāḥ pañcapalānvitāḥ |
pañcāśatpalikaṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ caitāvad eva tu ||
vastraṃ tu triguṇaṃ dhenvā dakṣiṇā ca caturguṇā |

saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate daśasaṃyutāt ||
[463]        yān anyān prārthate kāmāṃs tāṃs tān prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
ante svargāpavargau ca phalam āpnoty asaṃśayaḥ ||
iti kapilādānavidhiḥ |
atha devatoddeśena godānam | liṅgapurāṇe |
devadakṣiṇadigbhāge dhenuḥ kāryā udaṅmukhī |
pāṅmukhaṃ vatsakaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ ca udaṅmukham ||
prāṅmukho yajamānas tu pūjayed brāhmaṇaṃ tataḥ |
ko dadāti ca mantreṇa gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇaḥ svayam ||
devo ‘tra maheśvaraḥ |
evaṃvidhān ato datvā yāti dātā śivālayam |
tatra bhuktvākṣayān bhogān ante brahaiti śāsvatam ||
devīpurāṇe |
nīlāṃ vā yadi vā śvetāṃ pāṭalāṃ kapilām api |
sadugdhāṃ vatsalāṃ caiva sukhadohāṃ sugāṃ nṛpa ||
ādāya vidhivad devīṃ pūjayec chubhapaṅkajaiḥ |
dhūmpaṃ tu pañcaniryāsaṃ turuṣkāgurucandanam ||
datvā tu mantrapūrvaṃ tu naivedyam upakalpayet |
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ kṣāmayec ca tathā tu tām ||
dvijāya śivabhaktāya savatsāṃ gāṃ nivedayet |
sahemavastrakāṃsyāṃ ca mahāpuṇyam avāpnuyāt ||
[464]        yāvat tadromasaṃkhyānaṃ tāvad devyā puraṃ vaset |
ihaiva gatapāpo ‘sau jāyate nṛpasattama ||
viṣṇudharme māndhātā uvāca |
brāhmaṇaḥ prīṇanārthāya keśavasya śivasya ca |
yāni dānāni deyāni tāny ācakṣva dvijottama ||
yena caiva vidhānena dānaṃ puṃsaḥ sukhāvaham |
aihikāmuṣmikāptiṃ ca karoti na vihanyate ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
godānam ādau vakṣyāmi pratyakṣakramayogataḥ |
yena caiva vidhānena dhenuṃ nādhikavistaram ||
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya snātvā tarpya pitṝṃs tathā |
kṛtopavāsaḥ saṃprāśya pañcagavyaṃ nareśvara ||
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca |
tam abhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ puṣpādibhir anukramāt ||
udaṅmukhīṃ prāṅmukhīṃ vā gṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā payasvinīm |
gṛṣṭiḥ sakṛtprasūtety arthaḥ |
saputrāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sitayajñopavītinīm |
svarṇaśṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ suvarṇopari saṃsthitām ||
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
gāvo me hṛdaye santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham |
[465]        pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhenuṃ dvijavaraṃ ca tam ||
imāṃ naḥ pratigṛhṇīṣva dhenur dattā mayā tava |
sa me pāpāpanodāya govindaḥ prīyatām iti ||
vahnipurāṇe tu ayam adhiko mantraḥ |
yā dhenuḥ kāśyapasyāsīd atrer vā gautamasya ca |
sābhikāmaphalā devi iha loke paratra ca || iti |
evam uccārya taṃ vipraṃ govindaṃ nṛpa kalpayet |
anuvrajet tu gacchantaṃ padāny aṣṭau narādhipa ||
anena vidhinā dhenuṃ yo viprāya prayacchati |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
saptāvarān sapta parān ātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ |
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mocayaty avanīpate ||
pade pade ‘śvamedhasya gosavasya ca mānavaḥ |
phalam āpnoti rājendra dakṣāyaivaṃ jagau hariḥ ||
sarvakāmadughā samyak sarvakāleṣu pārthiva |
bhavaty atho pāpaharā yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ kṛtānām avijānatā |
prāyaścittam idaṃ proktam anutāpo ‘tha bṛṃhitam (?) ||
sarveṣām eva devānām ekajanmānugaṃ phalam |
hāṭakakṣitigaurīṇāṃ saptajanmānugaṃ phalam ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś canyaiś ca mānavaiḥ |
[466]        lokāḥ kāmadughāḥ prāptā datvaitad vidhinā nṛpa ||
gobhyo ‘dhikaṃ jagati nāparam asti kiṃcid
dānaṃ pavitram iti śāstravido vadanti |
tāḥ saṃpradaiḥ surasadaś ca samīhamānair
deyā sadaiva vidhinā dvijapuṅgavebhyaḥ ||
iti devatoddeśena godānavidhiḥ |
atha devatābhyo godānam | skandapurāṇe |
śivāya viṣṇave cāpi yas tu dadyāt payasvinīm |
dhenuṃ snānopahārārthaṃ sa paraṃ brahma gacchati ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
saurīṃ sūryāya yo dadyāt taruṇīṃ ca payasvinīm |
tena dattaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam ||
saurī sūryasutā dhenur ity arthaḥ |
snānāgnikāryam uddiśya surūpāṃ supayasvinīm |
kulīnāṃ kapilāṃ datvā dattaṃ bhavati gośatam ||
ya evaṃ gām alaṃkṛtya dadyāt sūryāya mānavaḥ |
so ‘śvamedhasya yajñasya phalam aṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet ||
tathā |
yo dadyād ubhayamukhīṃ saurabheyīṃ divākare |
saptadvīpāṃ mahīṃ datvā yat phalaṃ tad avāpnuyāt ||
pādadvayaṃ śirordhaṃ ca yadā syād eva nirgatam |
tadā sā pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā ||
[467]
atha vṛṣabhaikādaśīdānam | śivadharmāt |
daśa gāvaḥ savṛṣabhā vṛṣabhaikādaśī smṛtā |
śivāya vinivedyaivaṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā ||
rudraikādaśatulyātmā balabhogādibhir guṇaiḥ |
śivādisarvalokeṣu yatheṣṭaṃ modate vaśī ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
daśa gāvaḥ savṛṣabhā vṛṣabhaikādaśaś ca tāḥ |
sūryāya vinivedyeha yat phalaṃ labhate śṛṇu ||
dvādaśādityatulyātmā aṇimādir guṇair yutaḥ |
saurādisarvalokeṣu yatheṣṭaṃ modate divi ||
atha vṛṣabhādhikagośatadānam | śivadharmottarāt |
vṛṣabhaṃ gośataṃ dadyāc chivāyātīva śobhanam |
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śṛṇu yat phalam āpnuyāt ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
anekayānasāṃkyānair asurāsurapūjitaiḥ ||
śatarudravalopeto vīrabhadra ivāparaḥ |
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyam aśeṣādhipatir bhavet ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
svṛṣaṃ gośataṃ gatvā bhāskarāya narādhipa |
[468]        triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śṛṇu yat phalam āpnuyāt ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair divākara ivāparaḥ |
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ krīḍate sūryavan nṛpaḥ ||
bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogān pralaye sarvadehinām |
mohakañcukam utsṛjya viśaty ādityamaṇḍalam ||
sarvajñaḥ sūryaparamaḥ śuddhasvātmani saṃsthitaḥ |
sarvagaḥ paripūrṇatvāt sūryavad dīptimān bhavet ||
iti devatāgodānavidhiḥ |
atha trirātragodānavidhiḥ | viṣṇudharmottare |
hemaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ muktālāṅgulabhūṣaṇām |
ahatāmbarasaṃvītāṃ tathā kāṃsyopadohanām ||
trirātraṃ sthaṇḍile suptvā trirātraṃ gorasāśanaḥ |
tṛptāṃ tu tarpate datvā vāsasā saṃvṛte dvije ||
sadakṣiṇā mahābhāga trirātraṃ gorasais tataḥ |
prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā śivaloke mahīyate ||

datvaivaṃ kapilāṃ viprāḥ prāpnoty abhyadhikaṃ phalam ||
mahābhārate |
[469]        tisro rātrīs tvadbhir upoṣya bhūmau
tṛptā gāvas tarpitebhyaḥ pradeyāḥ |
vatsaiḥ pītāḥ suprajāḥ sopacārās
tryahaṃ datvā gorasair vartitavyam ||
tathā |
dvijātim abhisatkṛtya śvaḥkalpam upavedya ca |
pradānārthe niyuñjīta rohiṇīṃ niyatavrataḥ ||
śvaḥkalpam upavedya prātaḥkāla upasthānaṃ kartavya iti jñāpayitvā, āhvānaṃ ca prayuñjīta samaṅge bahule iti | praviśya ca gavāṃ madhyam imāṃ śrutim udāharet |
gaur me mātā vṛṣabhaś ca pitā me
divaṃ śarma me pratiṣṭhā prapadye |
prapadyaikāṃ sarvarīmukhyagoṣu
munir vāṇīm utsṛje gopradāne ||
samatām eti vai gobhiḥ samasakhyaḥ samavrataḥ |
ekālpagamanāt sadyaḥ kalmaṣāt dvipramucyate ||
utsṛṣṭavṛṣavatsā hi pradeyā sūryadarśane |
utsṛṣṭau tyaktau vṛṣavatsau yayā sā tatha,
ūrjasvinya ūrjamedhāś ca yajño
garbho amṛtasya pratiṣṭhā kṣitau |
pravāhāḥ puṇyabhāvāḥ prājāpatyāḥ
sarvam ity arthavādaḥ śrutau hi saḥ ||
gāvo mamainaḥ pramudantu sauryās
tathā samyāḥ svargayānāya santu |
[470]        āhūtā me dadataś cāśrayantu
tathā muktāḥ santu sarvāśiṣo me ||
śeṣotsarge karmabhir dehamokṣe
sarasvatyaḥ śreyasi saṃpravṛttāḥ |
yūyaṃ nityaṃ puṇyakarmopavatyaḥ
diśa tvaṃ me puṇyakarmopavatyaḥ ||
yā vai yūyaṃ so ‘ham ādyaikabhāvo
yuṣmān datvā cāham ātmapradātā |
namaskṛtā mana evopapannāḥ
saṃrakṣadhvaṃ saumyarūpograrūpāḥ ||
evaṃ tasyāgre pūrvam ardhaṃ vaded vai
gavāṃ dātā vidhivat pūrvadṛṣṭya |
pratibhūyāc cheṣam ardhaṃ dvijātiḥ
pratigṛhṇan gopradāne vidhijñaḥ ||
pūrvam ardhaṃ yāvaiyūyam ityādikam |
gāṃ dadānīti vaktavyam arghayam uśrāvasu pradat |
udhasyā namitavyā ca vaiṣṇavīti ca codanāt ||
nāma saṃkīrtayet tasyā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathottaram |
phalaṣaṭtriṃśad aṣṭau ca sahasrāṇi ca viṃśati ||
evam etān gaṇān buddhvā gavādīnāṃ yathākramam |
gopradātā samāpnoti samastān aṣṭame krame ||
arghyaṃ arghārham, usrvasu godhanam pradat pradadat, udhasyaṃ kṣīraṃ tadyuktā udasyā | [471] aṣṭame krame, gavi dattāyāṃ gacchantyām aṣṭame pade |
godaḥ śīlāṃ nirbhayaś cārghadātā
nasyotau vai vasudātā ca kāmī |
uṣasyoḍhā bhāraṃ nayaś ca vidvān
vikhyātās te vaiṣṇavāś candralokāḥ ||
gāṃ vai datvā govratī syāt trirātraṃ
niśāṃ caikāṃ samvaseteha tābhiḥ ṃ
kāmyāṣṭamyāṃ vartitavyaṃ trirātraṃ
gavāṃ rasair vā śakṛtā prasravair vā ||
vedavratī syād vṛṣabhapradāne
vedāvāptir goyugasya pradāne
tathā gavāṃ vidhim āsādya yajvā
lokān agryān vindate nāvidhijñaḥ ||
vasudā dravyadāḥ | kāmī kāmyaphalavān | udhasyoḍhā uṣasyāvāhayitā gāyatryā ity arthaḥ | kāmyāṣṭamī rohiṇīyuktāṣṭamī | rasair dadhyādibhiḥ | prasravaiḥ kṣīraiḥ | vedavratī vedavrataphalavān | gavāṃ yajvā gopradātā |
kāmān sarvān pārthivān ekasaṃsthān
yo vai dadyāt kāmadugdhāṃ ca dhenum |
[472]        samyaktāsyarhavyakavyaughavatyas (?)
tāsām uktam āyasasaṃpradānam ||
na cāśiṣyāyāvratāyopakuryāt
nāśāntāya na ca vakrabuddhaye ||
guhyo hy ayaṃ sarvalokasya dharmā
nemān dharmān yatra tatra prakalpayet ||
iti trirātragodānavidhiḥ |
athāha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ hṛdyāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām |
hemaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ vāsobhir veṣṭitāṃ naraḥ ||
navadhānyaiḥ samāyuktām ekaikaṃ droṇapañcakam |
sahiraṇyāṃ tu tāṃ dadyād brāḥmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
alolupāya śāntāya dharmajñāya viśeṣataḥ |
