aṣṭottaraśatenāpi vṛṣabhaṃ dharmarūpiṇam ||
atra tu pātraparimāṇaviśeṣasya hiraṇyasya sahasrādisaṃkhyayā vyavacchedaḥ kartuṃ na śakyata iti pūrvaprakrāntaniṣkaśabdenākāṅkṣā pūraṇīyā liṅgapurānoktadāneṣu niṣkair eva vyavahāradarśanāc ca |
lalāṭe kārayet puṇḍram ardhacandraṃ kalākṛtim |
sphaṭikena tu kartavyāḥ khurāś ca rajatena ca ||
puṇḍraṃ tilakam, sphaṭikam, khurā rajatena vidheyāḥ |
[486]        grīvāṃ tu padmarāgeṇa kakud gomedakena ca |
grīvāyāṃ ghaṇṭāvalayaṃ ratnacitraṃ tu kāryayet ||
vṛṣāṅkaṃ kārayet tatra kiṅkiṇīkṛtapannagam |
pūrvoktadeśakāle ca vedikoparimaṇḍale ||
vṛṣāṅko maheśvaraḥ | tanmūrtilakṣaṇam āha viśvakarmā |
trinetras tu caturbāhur jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ |
śūlakhaṭvāṅgavaradābhayapāṇir maheśvaraḥ || iti |
pūrvoktadeśakāla ity atra, deśakālakuṇḍamaṇḍapavedikādiliṅgapurānoktaṃ tulāpuruṣadānavihitaṃ veditavyam |
vṛṣaṃ ca sthāpayet tatra paścimāmukham agrataḥ |
īśvaraṃ pūjayed bhaktyā vṛṣārūḍhaṃ vṛṣadhvajam ||
vṛṣendraṃ pūjya gāyatryā namaskṛtya samāhitaḥ ||
oṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgāya vidmahe dharmapādāya dhīmahi
tan no vṛṣḥ pracodayāt ||
iti vṛṣagāyatrī |
mantreṇānena saṃpūjyo vṛṣo dharmavivṛddhaye |
hotavyaṃ ca ghṛtādyaiś ca yathāvibhavavistaram ||
vṛṣaḥ saṃpūjya dātavyo brāhmṇebhyaḥ śivāya ca |
dakṣiṇā caiva dātavyā yathāvittānusārataḥ ||
etad yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vṛṣadānam anuttamam |
śivasyānucaro bhūtvā suciraṃ tatra modate ||
[487] pratyaṅmukhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ śivāgrataḥ sthāpayet, śivasya tatpaścime sthāpanāt | tad uktaṃ vātule |
vṛṣāṅge paritaḥ kāryaṃ kiṅkiṇīvalayaṃ śubham |
īśvaraṃ pūjayet paścāt paścimāṃ diśam āsthitam ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena vṛṣayāgaṃ tu kārayet || iti |
śivāya ceti cakāraḥ samuccaye | kāmike tv ekāgnipakṣo ‘pi |
samidājyacarūpetam ekam agnim athāpi vā | iti |
dakṣiṇādikaṃ prāgvat |
iti liṅgapurāṇokto hiraṇyavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
ambarīṣa uvāca |
yat sūryeṇa samākhyātaṃ dānaṃ sarvasukhāvaham |
īśvarāṇāṃ ca niḥsvānāṃ tan me vyākhyātum arhasi ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
yeneśvaro haridro vā karoti vidhinā nṛpa |
dānaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva yathā tathā ||
bhārādau tripalānāṃ ca vṛṣaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
yutaṃ dhenvātha vā dadyāc chaktito nṛpasattama ||
yā mayā dhenavaḥ proktā vṛṣās tāvanta eva hi |
haraye tā niyojyāḥ syur harāya ca tathā vṛṣāḥ ||
[488]        sarvabhāvāt tato rājan tilapātrāṇi nityaśaḥ |
sarvapāpavināśāya dīyate nṛpasattamaḥ ||
gomayena samālipte paṭṭavastrasamāvṛte |
vṛṣaṃ hemamayaṃ tatra raupyaṃ vā ratnasaṃyutam ||
tasya nīlamaye śṛṅge mauktike cakṣuṣī radāḥ |
dvātriṃśac chubhavastrāṇi vidrumauṣṭhau ca nāsikā ||
marakataṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ karṇau vai haritāśmake |
padmarāgasya vai pādā khurā rapyamayāḥ śubhāḥ ||
rājatāni ca romāṇi kṣaumavastreṇa kambalam |
pādena puccham uddiṣṭaṃ sarveṣām apy ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
vṛṣaṇau sphaṭikasyāpi liṅge maṇiḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
tathā dhenur yathānaḍvān suvarṇasya tu kārayet ||
abhīṣṭadevatāpūjāṃ kurvīta tadanantaram |
manreṇānena rājendra taṃ dvijāya nivedayet ||
yo vṛṣo yajñadāne ‘bhūc chatānīkasya niṣkalaḥ |
jātarūpamayaṃ so ‘yaṃ tāritā māṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
etasya vibhavād dānaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ pratipādayet |
pṛthule vāpy aśakte vā tad anantaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
niḥsvo vāpy evam evaṃ (?) hi kṛtvā dānam atandritaḥ |
tatphalaṃ samavāpnotisvalpadānān na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti vahnipurāṇokto hemavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
[489]
sanatkumāra uvāca |
āṣāḍhapaurṇamāsyāṃ tu kārtike vātha phālgune |
śraddadhānair jitakrodhair deyam etad yathāvidhi ||
jāmbūnadasya śuddhasya palais triṃśatibhis tathā |
tadardham ardhena tathā yathāśaktyā palais tribhiḥ ||
dvābhyām ekena vā kāryo vṛṣaḥ sarvāṅgaśobhanaḥ |
palād ūno na kartavyo duḥkhaśokabhayāvahaḥ ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed divyaṃ parārdhyapaṭṭanirmitam |
tanmadhye tandulaiḥ śuklair maṇḍalaṃ kārayec chubham ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale samutthāya jitendriyaḥ |
śuklāmbaradharaḥ snātaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuklamālāratnavibhūṣitaḥ |
naro vā yadi vā nārī divyabhogābhilāṣiṇī ||
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ sthāpayitvā tato vṛṣam |
sauvarṇamaṇḍape tasmin suvarṇair bahubhiś citam ||
candanāgurukarpūraiḥ sumanobhis tathā sitaiḥ |
saṃpūjayet tataḥ samyak mantraiḥ paurāṇasambhavaiḥ ||
namas te jagadādhār priyaḥ puṇyakṛtām asi |
tvadvihīne jagaty asmin na kaścic chubham aśṇute ||
namas te dharmarājāya vṛṣarūpadharāya vai |
tvaṃ mām uddhara deveśa durgasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
yaśaḥ kīrtir dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yad anyad api saṃsthitam |
tat tat prayaccha deveśa paratra ca śūbhāṃ gatim ||
[490]        iti saṃpūjya vidhivat taṃ devaṃ vṛṣarūpiṇam |
naivedyaṃ saṃstare tatra haviṣā nirmitaṃ śubham ||
kālodbhavaṃ mūlaphalaṃ sarvaṃ devasamantataḥ |
haviṣānnena bhuñjīta bhojayitvā tato dvijān ||
sāyāhne tu tataḥ kuryāt puṣpagṛham anuttamam |
sitapuṣpaiḥ śubhair gandhair lubdhanmadhukarākulaiḥ ||
phalamūlāni cānyāni dīpāḥ śukladaśānvitāḥ |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ devadevasya saṃnidhau ||
vāramukhyāḥ samā nāryo gāndharvān śrutisaukhyadān |
gītavāditraśabdena brahmaghoṣaraveṇa ca ||
narmālāpaiś ca nṛtyaiś ca gamayet tāṃ niśāṃ tataḥ |
aruṇodayelāyāṃ samutthāya jitendriyaḥ ||
pūjayitvā dvijāṃs tatra gohiraṇyair narottama |
vṛṣarūpaṃ tato dharmaṃ prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
ity uccārya paraṃ mantram ācāryāya nivedayet |
datvā dānam idaṃ samyak vidhinānena pārthiva ||
kuryād digvijayaṃ vipro vedakarma samācaret |
vaiśyaḥ samudragamanaṃ śūdraḥ karma yathepsitam ||
phālgunyām atha vā dadyād dānam etan narottama |
raudraṃ karma vinirdiṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā śaṅkarasya hi ||
[491]
iti gāruḍapurāṇoktaṃ suvarṇavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
atha rūpyavṛṣadānam |
atha kuṣṭhaharaṃ vakṣye vṛṣadānam anuttamam |
yat kāryaṃ kuṣṭharogārtaiḥ śarīrasukhakārakam ||
palais tribhis tu kurvīta dvābhyām ekana vā punaḥ |
rājataṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śubhraṃ hemaśṛṅgakhuraṃ tathā ||
maheśvareṇomayā ca kurvīta tamadhiṣṭhitam |
sauvarṇe pratime dve ca pūrvoktena krameṇa tu ||
yathā vibhavamānena vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet |
palāṣṭake kāṃsyapātre sthāpayet te vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
śvetapuṣpair akṣatābhiḥ śvetavastrair alaṃkṛtam |
brāḥmaṇaṃ vidyāsaṃpannaṃ svācāraṃ saṃyatendriyam ||
sarvaśāstrapravaktāraṃ pratigrahaparāṅmukham|
dāntaṃ kulīnaṃ dharmajñam anudvegakaraṃ nṛṇām ||
krodhalobhavihīnaṃ ca sarvaśāśtrārthakovidam |
gṛham āhūya bhaktyā taṃ yathāvidhi samarcayet ||
keyūrakaṭakair vastrair mālyaiś caivāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
homaṃ ca pūrvavat kuryān mantrair māheśvarais tathā ||
udaṅmukhopaviṣṭāya mahādevasya saṃnidhau |
prāṅmukho vyādhito dadyān mantreṇānena dharmavit ||
aṣṭamūrtir maheśānaḥ kṛpayā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
śvetam audumbaraṃ sarvam atha vā citram eva ca ||
[492]        tvagdoṣajanitaṃ yac ca maṇḍalāny atha vānagha |
sarvaṃ karmavipākotthaṃ pārvatīnātha sarvaga ||
kuṣṭhahā bhava sarveśa rakṣa māṃ pārvatīpate ||
iti vāyupurāṇokto rūpyavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
āha baudhāyanaḥ |
śuklapakṣasya cāṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśyām atha vā punaḥ |
palena kuryād vṛṣabhaṃ sāndralomasurājatam ||
hemaśṛṅgaṃ suvarṇākṣaṃ ratnapuṣpaśūbhānanam |
maheśvareṇomayā ca sauvarṇena hy adhiṣṭhitam ||
athāvibhavatas tatra parmāṇaṃ vidhīyat |
umāmaheśvararūpam atra nirantaroktavṛṣadānavad avadheyam |
palāṣṭake tāmrapātre vastreṇāveṣṭya bhaktataḥ ||
devasyaikaṃ vṛṣasyaikaṃ pārvatyāś caikam eva hi |
śvetapuṣpair akṣatābhiḥ kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ ||
pūjayen mūlamantreṇa tilahomaṃ ca kārayet |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ cājyamiśreṇa cāryakeṇa tu ||
ācāryo vittasaṃpannaḥ svācāraḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
sarvaśāstrārthavaktā ca śānto dāntaś tathaiva ca ||
dharmapravīṇo dhiṣaṇas tv anudvegakaro nṛṇām |
vṛṣadānaprayogajño haromābhyām adhiṣṭhitam ||
vṛṣabhaṃ ghaṇṭikopetaṃ dadyād graiveyabhūṣitam |
udaṅmukhopaviṣṭāya mahādevasya saṃnidhau ||
[493]        prāṅmukho vyādhito bhaktyā mantreṇānena saṃyataḥ |
aṣṭamūrte maheśāna kṛpayā vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
udumbaraṃ vājinaṃ vā daṇḍamaṇḍalakaṃ tathā |
tvagdoṣajanitaṃ yac ca pūrvakarmavipākinaḥ ||
ihakarmodbhavaṃ vāpi mātṛdoṣeṇa vā punaḥ |
pitṛdoṣeṇa vā sarvaṃ raktadoṣodbhavaṃ tathā ||
vināśaya śarīrottaṃ pārvatīpriya śaṅkara |
vṛṣabhasya pradānena umābhyādhiṣṭhitasya hi ||
dānamantraḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ |
kṛtenānena kuṣṭāni vrajanti vilayaṃ dhruvam ||
tasmāt kuṣṭābhibhūtānāṃ karaṇīyam idaṃ jaguḥ ||
ity apararaupyavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
gāruḍapurāṇe |
palāṣṭaken raupyeṇa kṛtvā vṛṣabham uttamam |
muktāphalair alaṃkuryāt padmarāgaiḥ śuśobhanaiḥ ||
suvarṇagilakopetaṃ cārucāmarabhūṣitam |
gatvā śivālayaṃ samyaṅ pūjāṃ kṛtvā śive tataḥ ||
rudrādhyāyaṃ japitvā tu saṣaḍaṅgarahasyakam |
homaś ca śivamantreṇa tilājyena vidhīyate ||
athāhūya dvijavaraṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam |
[494]        vastrāṃkāramālyādaiḥ pūjayitvā śivaṃ tataḥ ||
umāpate trilokeśa jagatkāraṇakāraṇam |
svavāhanapradānena prīto bhava namo ‘stu te ||
mantreṇānena taṃ dadyād dhemadakṣiṇayānvitam |
dānasyāsya pradānena śivaloke mahīyate ||
iti tṛtīyarūpyavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
raupyānaḍvāhadānena naro yānena gacchati |
akṣayān labhate lokān indreṇa saha modate ||
triṃśatpalāt samārabhya palatritayam antataḥ |
vṛṣaṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtam ||
kṣaumavastraparicchannaṃ dhānyavinyāsabhūṣitam |
yathoktakāle pātrāya pavitrāyopapādayet ||
evaṃ kṛtvā naro dānaṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
dānamantram imaṃ prājño dānakāle samuccaret ||
dharmas tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ |
aṣṭamūrter adhiṣṭānam ataḥ pāpi sanātanaḥ ||
evaṃ dadāti yo bhaktyā kaladhautamayaṃ vṛṣam |
sarvapāpavinirmukto devavad divi modate ||
iti caturtharūpyavṛṣadānavidhiḥ |
atha bhūmidānākhyam atidānam ārabhyate | tatra mahābhārate |
[495]                bhīṣma uvāca |
atidāneṣu sarveṣu pṛthivīdānam ucyate |
acalā hy akṣayā bhūmir dogdhu kāmān anuttamān ||
dogdhi vāsāṃsi ratnāni paśūn vrīhiyavāṃs tathā |
bhūmidaḥ sarvabhūteṣu śāśvatīr edhate samāḥ ||
yāvad bhūmer āyur iti tāvad bhūmida edhate |
na bhūmidānād astīha paraṃ kiṃcid yudhiṣṭhira ||
bhūmim evah daduḥ pūrvaṃ ye bhūmiṃ bhuñjate ‘dhunā |
svakarmaṇopajīvanti narā iha paratra ca ||
ya etāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
punaś ca jananaṃ prāpya sa bhavet pṛthivīptiḥ ||
saṃgrāme vā tunuṃ jahyāt dadyād vā pṛthivīm imām |
ity etāṃ kṣatrabandhūnāṃ vadanti parmāśiṣam ||
punāti dattā pṛthivī dātāram iti sattama |
api pāpasamācāraṃ brahmaghnam api vānṛtam ||
saiva pāpāt tārayati saiva pāpāt pramuñcati |
api pāpakṛtāṃ rājñāṃ praigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ ||
pṛthivīṃ nānyad icchanti pāvanaṃ hy etad uttamam |
nāmāsyāḥ priyadatteti guhyaṃ devyāḥ sanātanam ||
dānaṃ vā py atha vādānaṃ nāmāsyāḥ paramaṃ śivam |
yaḥ sādhor bhūmim ādatte na bhūmiṃ vindate hi saḥ ||
[496]        bhūmiṃ datvā tu śadhubhyo vindate bhūmim eva hi |
yasya viprānuśāsanti sādhor bhūmiṃ sadaiva hi ||
na tasya śatravo rājñaḥ praśāsanti vasundharāṃ |
yat kiṃcit kurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarṣitaḥ ||
api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate |
ye ‘pi saṃkīrṇakarmāṇo rājāno raudrakarmiṇaḥ ||
tebhyaḥ pavitram ākhyeyaṃ bhūmidānam anuttamam |
alpāntaram idaṃ śaśvat purāṇā menire janāḥ ||
yo yajetāśvamedhena dadyād vā sādhave maha |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ manimuktāvasani ca ||
sarvam etat mahīpāla dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat |
sāgarān saritaḥ śailān kānanāni ca sarvaśaḥ ||
sarvam etan naraśreṣṭha dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat |
oṣadhīḥ kṣīrasaṃpannā nagān puṣpaphalānvitān ||
kānanāny upaśailāṃś ca dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat |
agniṣṭomaprabhṛtibhir iṣṭvā ca svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ||
na tat phalam avāpnoti bhūmidānād yad aśnute |
tapo yajñaḥ śrutaṃ śīlam alobhaḥ satyavāditā ||
gurudaivatapūjā ca nātivartanti bhūmidam |
bhartur niḥśreyase yuktās tyaktāmāno raṇe hatāḥ ||
brahmalokagatāḥ san tu nātikrāmanti bhūmidam |
yathā janitrī kṣīreṇa svaputraṃ bharate sadā ||
anugṛhṇāti dātāraṃ tathā sarvarasair mahī |
[497]        mṛtyor vai kiṃkaro daṇḍas tāpo vahniḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||
ghorāś ca vāruṇāḥ pāśā nopasarpanti bhūmidam |
piotṝṃś ca pitṛlokasthān devaloke ‘tha devatāḥ ||
saṃtarpayanti śāntātmā yo dadāti vasundharāṃ |
kriśyamānāya cātyarthaṃ vṛttiglānāya sīdate ||
bhūmiṃ vṛttikarīṃ datvā sattrī bhavati mānavaḥ |
yathā dhāvati gaur vatsaṃ kṣaranti satataṃ payaḥ ||
evam eva mahābhāga bhūmir bharati bhūmidam |
phālakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ datvā sabījāṃ saphalām api ||
udyānaṃ śaraṇaṃ vāpi tathā bhavati kāmadam |
yathā candramaso vṛddhir ahany ahani jāyate ||
tathā bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye vivardhate |
atra gāthāṃ bhūmikṛtāṃ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ||
yāṃ śrutvā jāmadagnena dattā bhūḥ kaśyapāya vai |
nṛpā dadati mām eva māṃ datvā mām avāpsyatha ||
asmin loke pare caiva tataś cājanane punaḥ |
ya imāṃ vyāhṛtīṃ deva brāhmaṇīṃ brahmasaṃsthitām ||
śrāddhasya kriyamāṇasya brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati |
kṛtyayā vābhiśastānāṃ duriṣṭaśamanaṃ mahat ||
prāyaścittaṃ mahīṃ datvā punāty ubhayato daśa |
yo brāhmaṇa imaṃ veda vedavādaṃ tathaiva ca ||
prakṛtiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūmir vai śāsvatī matā |
abhiṣicyaiva nṛpatiṃ śravayed imam āgamam ||
[498]        yathā śrutvā mahīṃ dadyān nādadyāt sādhutaś ca tāṃ |
sa kulīnaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sa bandhuḥ sa ca puṇyakṛt ||
sa ca dātā ca vikrānto yo dadāti vasundharām |
ādityā iva dīpyante tejasā bhuvi mānavāḥ ||
dadanti vasudhāṃ sphītāṃ ye vedaviduṣe dvije |
yathā bījāni rohanti prakīrṇāni mahītale ||
yathākāmāḥ prarohanti bhūmidānasamārjitāḥ |
ādityo varuṇo viṣṇuḥ brahmā somo hutāśanaḥ ||
śūlapāṇiś ca bhagavān abhinandanti bhūmidam |
sauvarṇā yatra prāsādā vāsodhārāś ca kāmadāḥ ||
gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra gacchanti bhūmidāḥ |
atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam ||
bṛhaspateś ca saṃvādam indrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira |
iṣṭvā kratuśatenātha mahatā dakṣiṇāvatā |
maghavān vāgmināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ papracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim ||
indra uvāca |
bhagavan kena dānena svargataḥ sukham edhate |
yad akṣayyam ahāryaṃ ca taṃ brūhi vadatāṃ vara ||
ity uktaḥ sa surendreṇa tato devapurohitaḥ |
bṛhaspatir bṛhattejāḥ pratyuvāca purandaram ||
bṛhaspatir uvāca |
suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca vṛtrahan |
[499]        dadāti yo mahāprājñaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
na bhūmidānād devendra paraṃ kiṃcid iti prabho |
vasiṣṭham abhimanyāmi yathā prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
pañca pūrvādipuruṣāḥ ṣaṭ ye ca vasudhāṃ gatāḥ |
ekādaśa dadad bhūmiṃ pavitrātīha mānavaḥ ||
ratnopakīrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ yo dadāti purandara |
sa muktaḥ sarvakaluṣaiḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
mahīṃ sphītāṃ dadad rājā sarvakāmaguṇānvitām |
rājādhirājo bhavati tadvad dānam uttamam ||
sarvakāmasamāyuktāṃ kāsyapaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
sarvabhūtāni manyante māṃ dadātīti vāsava ||
sarvakāmadughāṃ bhūmiṃ sarvakāmapurogamām |
dadātīha sahasrākṣa sa svargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ||
madhu sarpiḥ pravāhinyaḥ payodadhivahās tathā |
saritas tarpayantīha surendra vasudhāpradam ||
bhūmipradānān nṛpatir mucyate sarvakilbiṣāt |
na hi bhūmipradānena dānam anyad viśiṣyate ||
puṇyāṃ mṛdurasāṃ bhūmiṃ yo dadāti purandara |
na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante bhūmidānaguṇārjitāḥ ||
sarvathā pārthiveneha satataṃ bhūtim icchatā |
bhūr deyā vidhivac chakra pātre sukham abhīpsatā ||
api kṛtvā naraḥ pāpaṃ bhūmiṃ datvā dvijātaye |
anutsṛjati tat pāpaṃ jīrṇāṃ tvacam ivoragaḥ ||
[500]        sāgarāḥ saritaḥ śailās tīrthāni vividhāni ca |
etāni bhūmidānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
tasmāt prāpyaiva medhāvī dadyād viprāya parthiva |
na bhūmipatinā bhūmir adhiṣṭheyā kathaṃcana ||
agniṣṭomaprabhṛtibhir iṣṭvā yajñaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ |
na tat phalam avāpnoti bhūmidānād yad aśnute ||
dātā daśānugṛhṇāti daśa hanti tathā kṣipan |
pūrvadattāṃ haran bhūmiṃ narkāyopagacchati ||
na dadāti pratiśrutya datvā vā harate tu yaḥ |
tau ca dvau varuṇaiḥ pāśais tapyete mṛtyuśāsanāt ||
vindhyāṭavīṣv atoyāsu śuṣkakoṭaravāsinaḥ |
kṛṣṇasarpās tu jāyante ye haranti vasundharām ||
patanty aśrūṇi rudatāṃ dīnānām avasīdatām |
brāhmaṇānāṃ hṛte kṣetre hanyus tripuruṣaṃ kulam ||
āhitāgniṃ samādāya kṛśabhṛtyaṃ priyātithim |
vasudhāṃ ye prayacchanti nopasarpanti te yamam ||
tathā |
ikṣubhiḥ satatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmaśālinīṃ |
goṣṭhāvāhanasaṃpūrṇāṃ bahuvīryasamārjitām ||
bījagarbhāṃ dadad bhūmiṃ sarvaratnaparicchadām |
akṣayāṃl labhate lokān bhūmisattraṃ his tasya tat ||
vidhūya kalmaṣaṃ sarvaṃ rājā syāt saṃmataḥ satām |
loke mahīyate sadbhir yo dadāti vasundharām ||
yathāpsu patitaḥ śakra snehabindavaḥ prasarpati |
[501]        tathā bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye ‘bhivardhate ||
nṛtyagītaparā nāryo divyamālāvibhūṣitāḥ |
upatiṣṭhanti devendra sadā bhūmipradaṃ naram ||
modate ca mukhaṃ svarge devagandharvapūjitaḥ |
yo dadāti mahīṃ samyag vidhineha dvijātaye ||
śatam apsarasāṃ caiva divyamālāṃ vibhūṣitām |
upatiṣṭhanti devendra brahmaloke dharāpradam ||
upatiṣṭhanti bhūtāni sadā bhūmipradaṃ naram |
śaṅkhaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ chatraṃ dharāśvā varavāraṇāḥ ||
bhūmidānasya puṇyāni hiraṇyanicayās tathā |
ājñā sadā pratihatā jayaśabdo bhavaty atha ||
bhūmidānasya puṣpāṇi phalaṃ svargaḥ purandara |
hiraṇyapuṣpāś cauṣadhyaḥ kuśakāñcanaśādvalāḥ ||
amṛtaprasavāṃ bhūmiṃ prāpnoti puruṣo dadat |
nāsti bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti yajñasamo guruḥ ||
nāsti satyaparo dharmo nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ |
etad āṅgirasīṃ kṛtvā vāsavo vasudhām imām ||
vasuratnasamākīrṇāṃ dadāv āṅgirase tadā ||
ya idaṃ śrāvayec chrāddhe bhūmidānasya saṃstavam |
na tasya rakṣasāṃ bhāgo nāsurāṇāṃ bhavaty uta ||
akṣayaṃ ca bhaved dattaṃ pitṛbhyaś ca na saṃśayaḥ ||
devalaḥ |
śreṣṭhāc chreṣṭataraṃ proktaṃ bhūmidānaṃ dvijātibhiḥ |
tad datvā puruṣaḥ svarge pūjyate tridaśottamaiḥ ||
[502]        vāñchanti pitaro ‘py evaṃ svargaloke vyavasthitāḥ |
yady asmatkulajaḥ kaścid bhavaty atra nidānakṛt ||
narakasthā marulloke svargasthāḥ paramaṃ padam |
yathā vayam atītā ye vrajāmas tatprabhāvataḥ ||
kim atra citraṃ dātāraṃ yat samuddharate dharā |
praigrahagrahītāram api tārayati dvijam ||
na tad yajñair vratair dānair dātṛbhiḥ phalam āpyate |
api yad dattayā bhūmyā daṇḍatritayamātrayā |
yad dānaṃ dīyate kiṃcit paratra syād ihaiva hi ||
bhūdānena punaḥ sarvadānānāṃ prāpyate phalam |
te dhanyās te sukṛtinaḥ kṛtārthās te na saṃśayaḥ ||
satpātrāya pradattaṃ yair bhūdānaṃ vidhinā naraiḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
haṃsa uvāca |
hastamātraṃ tu yo dadyād bhuvaḥ puruṣasattamaḥ |
tenaiva dhruvam āyāti bhūmidānaphalaṃ naraḥ ||
gocarmamātrāṃ tāṃ datvā vasūnāṃ lokam āpnuyāt |
śākabhūmiṃ naro datvā lokam āṅgirasaṃ labhet ||
ārāmabhūmiṃ datvā ca mārutaṃ lokam āpnuyāt |
jalāśayārthaṃ yo dadyād dāruṇaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
yasya devasya veśmārthaṃ tasya devasya so ‘śnute |
udyānabhūmiṃ datvā ca gandharvaiḥ saha modate ||
ratnākarabhavaṃ datvā śakraloke mahīyate |
[503]        anyeṣām ākarabhuvaṃ lokānāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ||
tasyāpi gatir uddiṣṭā loke hautāśane dvijāḥ |
dhānyakarabhuvaṃ datvā nāgapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ||
añjanākarabhūmiṃ ca yaḥ prayacchati vai dvijāḥ |
pitṛbhir yamalokasthaḥ pūjyate ‘sau narottamaḥ ||
lavaṇākarabhūmiṃ ca somaloke mahīyate |
oṣadhākarabhūmiṃ ca aśvaloke mahīyate ||
śisvīśasya prarohāṃ tu bhuvaṃ datvā narottamaḥ |
sādhyānāṃ lokam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
indhanākarabhūmiṃ ca vahniloke mahīyate |
sarvadānabhūmiṃ dharmajño yaḥ prayacchati dharmataḥ ||
mahatpuṇyam āpnoti brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati |
ikṣubhūmiṃ naro datvā śālibhūmim athāpi vā ||
somalokam āpnoti sarvakāmāṃś ca vindati |
gulmapuṣpalatākīrṇāṃ yo buvaṃ saṃprayacchati ||
vimāne nandane so ‘tha krīḍaty apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
puṣpadaṃ phaladaṃ vṛkṣaṃ dadantīṃ pṛthivīṃ dadat ||
svargalokaparibhraṣṭo nagarādhipatiṃ bhavet |
brāhmaṇāya gṛhaṃ datvā vasūnāṃ lokam aśnute ||
sārāmabhūmido vipraḥ krīḍate nandane vane |
grāmapradaḥ syān nṛpatiḥ samrāṭ nagarado bhavet ||
[504]        samagravasudheśaḥ syāc cakravartī ca rājyadaḥ |
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo harec ca vasundharām ||
apy ekāṅgulamātrāṃ vā pramādājñānamohitaḥ |
bahūny abdasahasrāṇi dharme ‘pi puruṣottamaḥ ||
viṣṭhāyām kṛmitām eti pitṛbhiḥ sahitas tathā |
sve rāṣṭre pararaṣṭre vā devabrāhmaṇasatkṛtām ||
ciraṃ narakam āpnoti hṛtvā bhūmipatir bhuvam |
bhūmiṃ kṛtvā tu yaḥ kuryād devabrāhmaṇasān (?) naraḥ ||
svargalokam avāpnoti puruṣo ‘pi sudāruṇaḥ |
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati bhūmidaḥ ||
ācchettā cānumantā ca tāvanti narakaṃ vaset |
pakvasasyāṃ vasumatīṃ yo ‘laṃkṛtya prayacchati ||
kāmagena vimānena brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
nivartanasahasrāyāṃ sarvasasyaprarohiṇīm |
dadyād bhūmiṃ phalopetāṃ bhūmidānaṃ tad ucyate ||
ekachatrāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā dvijebhyaḥ pratipādayet |
saṃpūrṇāṃ yo nṛpḥ kaścid bhūmidānaṃ tad ucyate ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
gocarmamātraṃ bhūkhaṇḍam adhikaṃ vā svaśaktitaḥ |
tridhā sadakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā datvā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
tridhā sadakṣiṇam iti, pūrvoktaikadvitrisuvarṇaiḥ saha dakṣiṇam ity arthaḥ |
[505] bṛhaspatiḥ |
api gocarmamātreṇa samyag dattena mānavaḥ |
dhautapāpo viśuddhātmā svargaloke mahīyate ||
daśahastena daṇḍena triṃśad daṇḍā nivartanam |
daśa tāny eva gocarma brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ ||
yat kiṃcit kurute pāpaṃ puruṣo lobhamohitaḥ |
tat sarvaṃ bhūmidānena kṣipram eva vinaśyati ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
mucyate brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ |
bhūmiṃ sarvaguṇopetāṃ datvā pāpāt pramucyate ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
daśahastena daṇḍena daśahastāt samantataḥ |
pañca cābhadhikāṃ dadyād etad gocarma kathyate ||
matsyapurāṇaṃ (?) |
saptahastena daṇḍena triṃśad daṇḍā nivartanam |
tribhāgahīnaṃ gocarmamānam āha prajāpatiḥ ||
mānenānena yo dadyān nivartanaśataṃ budhaḥ |
vidhnānena tasyāśa kṣīyate pāpasaṃhatiḥ ||
tadardham atha vā dadyād api gocarmamātrakam |
[506]        bhavanasthānamātrāṃ gāṃ so ‘pi pāpāt pramucyate ||
tathā |
yat kiṃcit kurute pāpaṃ janmaprabhṛti mānavaḥ |
api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena śudhyati ||
gavāṃ śataṃ vṛṣaś caiko yatra tiṣṭhed ayantritaḥ ||
tad dhi gocarmamātraṃ tu prāhur vedavido janāḥ ||
atra caiteṣu gocarmaprakāreṣu uttamamadhyamādhamabhāvena vyavasthā veditavyā suvarṇaṃ cātra dakṣiṇā | yad āha māṇḍavyaḥ |
na hi bhūmeḥ paraṃ vastu goḥ suvarṇāc ca kiṃcana |
ato bhuvi gavi prājñaiḥ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā matā || iti |
bhūmidānamantras tu matsyapurāṇe |
tathā bhūmipradānasya kalān nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm|
dānāny anyāni me śāntir bhūmidānād bhavatv iha ||
atraiva (?) prayogaḥ |
oṃ adya amukasmin kāle amukasmin deśe amukasagotrāya amukapravarāya amukaśarmaṇe amukasagotro ‘haṃ samukapravaraḥ amukaśarmā imāṃ bhūmiṃ priyadattāṃ viṣṇudaivatāṃ amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti sapuṣpaṃ kuśatilodakaṃ brāhmaṇahaste nikṣipet | tena ca manasā bhūmiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pratigrahaḥ kāryaḥ bhūmiḥ samīpe [507] cet sākṣāt pradakṣiṇīkuryāt | oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi etad bhūmidānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ etat suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
viśvāmitraḥ |
gocarmamātrāṃ yaḥ pṛthvīṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati |
sarvadaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śakravad divi modate ||
grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vāpi viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati |
kṣetraṃ vā sasyasaṃpannaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ pragalpanti pitāmahāḥ |
bhūmido ‘smatkule jātaḥ so ‘smākaṃ tārayiṣyati ||
nandīpurāṇe |
datvā ca bhūmiṃ puruṣaḥ saśreyāṃ sasyamedinīm |
sumedhyāṃ ramyasaṃsthānāṃ phalavṛkṣamanoramām ||
anūṣarām anābādhāṃ pātre bahuguṇānvite |
apy ekapuruṣādhārāṃ datvā bhūmiṃ mahātmane ||
daśakalpāni vasti svarge vigatapātakaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
śītavātātapasahāṃ gṛhabhūmiṃ susaṃskṛtām |
pradāya suralokasthaḥ puṇyānte (?) ‘pi na cālyate ||
[508] tathā |
prādeśamātrāṃ bhūmiṃ tu yo dadyād anupaskṛtām |
na sa sīdati kṛcchreṇa na ca durgāṇy apāśnute ||
mudito rājate prājñaḥ śakreṇa saha nandati |
yāvanti lāṅgalamukhena rajāṃsi bhūmer
bhāsampater druhitur aṅgajaromāṇi |
tāvanti śaṃkarapure sa yugāni tiṣṭhet
bhūmipradānam iha yaḥ kurute manuṣyaḥ ||
gandharvakinnarasurāsurasiddhasaṅghair
ādhūtacāmaram upetya mahad vimānam |
saṃpūjyate pitṛpitāmahabandhauyuktaḥ
śaṃbhoḥ puraṃ vrajati cāmaranāyakaḥ syāt ||
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo harec ca vasundharām |
sa viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmir bhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati ||
iti bhūdānavidhiḥ |
tatra śivadharmāt |
yaḥ śivāha halopetāṃ sarvasasyaprarohiṇīm |
mahīṃ mahīpatir dadyāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
yāvad daṇḍā bhaved bhūmir mīyamānā samantataḥ |
sa tāvat kalpasaṃkhyānaṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
evaṃ sarvatra vijñeyaṃ phalaṃ daṇḍapramāṇataḥ |
grāmaṃ kheṭaṃ puraṃ kṣetraṃ viṣayādi nivedayet ||
[509]        sarvasasyajalopetaṃ sarvabādhāvivarjitam |
grāmaṃ śivāya yo dadyād tasya puṇyaphalṃ śṛṇu ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ grāmadānena yat phalam |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair divyastrīkoṭisaṃyutaḥ ||
saṃyuktaḥ koṭiśo ‘nekaiḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ |
vimānair grāmadānena trisaptakulasaṃyutaḥ ||
yatheṣṭam aiśvare loke krīḍate kālam akṣayam |

deśadānena cātyantaṃ na śakyaṃ tat prakīrtitum |
ratnānnapānago’śvādyaṃ sarvaṃ bhūmau prajāyate ||

iti śivabhūmidānavidhiḥ |
varāhapurāṇe |
viṣṇave viṣayaṃ grāmaṃ grāmārdham api śaktitaḥ |
datvā krīḍati vaikuṇṭhopakuṇṭheṣu (?) niratyayam ||
rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmān arogaḥ subhagaḥ sukhī |

[510]        ap gocarmamātrāṃ yo dadāti haraye bhuvam |

bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yaḥ sūryāya phalopetāṃ sarvasasyaprarohiṇīm |
mahīṃ mahīpatir dadyāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
bhūbhāgāś caiva yāvanto bhūtale bhānti sattama |
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
evaṃ sarvatra vijñeyaṃ phalaṃ dravyānusārataḥ |
grāmakheṭapurakṣetraviṣayādinivedane ||
sarvasasyaphalopetaṃ sarvaśatruvivarjitam |
grāmaṃ sūryāya yo dadyāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvavrateṣu yat phalam |
sarvadāneṣu yat puṇyaṃ grāmadānena tal labhet ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair divyastrīkoṭisaṃkulaiḥ |
nānāratnasamākīrṇaiḥ nānākarasamanvitaiḥ ||

yatheṣṭaṃ sarvalokeṣu krīḍate kālam akṣayam ||

iti bhānubhūmidānam |
atha vidyādānākhyam atidānam ārabhyate | tatrādityapurāṇe |

uddiśya devatāṃ dattaṃ pradānaṃ yatra kutracit |
tasyāḥ samastapuṇyasya phalaṃ kena nirūpyate ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
dānānām uttamaṃ dānaṃ vidyādānaṃ vidur vadhāḥ (?) |
āhuḥ samastavidyānāṃ śriyam evādhidaivatam ||

yathā ca yoṣit pravarā kamalā paṅkajālayā ||
āhur valavatāṃ śreṣṭho yathājyotiṣmatāṃ raviḥ |
[512]        jalāśayānāṃ pravaro yathāyaṃ saritāṃ patiḥ |
tathā vidyāpradaḥ śreṣṭho garīyāṃś ca garīyasām ||
puṇyaś cāpi sa sarvatra yaś ca vidyāṃ prayacchati |
ihāmutrasukhakṣemam āhur vidyādhanaṃ dhanam ||

bhūmidānāt samaṃ nāsti vidyādānaṃ tato ‘dhiam ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
vidyā kāmadughā dhenur vidyā cakṣur uttamam |
vidyādānāt paraṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||
vidyāvān sarvakāmānāṃ bhājanaṃ puruṣo bhavet |
tasmād vidyā hi dadatā sarvaṃ dattaṃ bhaved iha ||
parādhyāpanaśakto hi puruṣas tu yad aśnute |
tapas tat paramaṃ tasya brahmalokasamaṃ smṛtam ||
dānānām uttamaṃ loke tapasaś ca tathottamam |
vidyādānaṃ mahābhāgaḥ (?) sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
[513] devīpurāṇe |
vidyāvivekabodhena śubhāśubhavicāraṇāt |
vindate sarmakāmāptiṃ yasmād vidyā parā matā ||
vidyādānāt paraṃ dānaṃ trailokye ‘pi na vidyate |
yena dattena cāpnoti śivaṃ paramakāraṇam ||
tathā |
siddhāntamokṣaśāstrāṇi vedāḥ svargādisādhakāḥ |
vedāṅgānītihāsāś ca deyā dharmavivṛddhaye ||
gāruḍaṃ vālatantraṃ ca bhūtatantrāṇi bhairava |
śāstrāṇāṃ pāṭhanād dānān mātaraḥ phaladā nṛṇām ||
jyotiṣaṃ vaidyaśāstrāṇi gāndharvaṃ labhate padam |
vidyayā vartate loko dharmādharmaṃ ca vindati ||
vidyā tadmāt sadā deyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalārthibhiḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
dharmaśāstrapradānena dharmeṇa saha modate |
siddhāntānāṃ pradānena mokṣaṃ prāpnoti vaidikam |
śāstrāṇi datvā cānyāni naraḥ svarge mahīyate ||
nandīpurāṇe |
vidyāś caturdaśa proktāḥ krameṇa tu yathāsthitiḥ |
[514]        ṣaḍaṅgāś caturo vedā dharmaśāstraṃ purātanam |
mīmāṃsā tarkam api ca etā vidyāś caturdaśa ||
dharmaśāstraṃ smṛtayaḥ | purātanaṃ purāṇam |
āsām evāntarotpannāḥ parā vidyāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
āyurvedaḥ sasyavedo bahubhedaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
sasyavedaḥ kṛṣiśāstram |
sarvātmā cātmavidyā ca saṃsārabhayanāśinī |
sarvaduḥkhāntakaraṇī sarvapāpapraṇāśanī ||
etā vidyāḥ samākhyātā bahubhedopabhedajāḥ |
kalāvidyās tathā cānyāḥ śilpavidyās tathāparāḥ ||
śilpavidyā pratimādinirmāṇaśāstram |
sarvā etā mahābhāgāḥ sarvāḥ sarvārthasādhakāḥ |
matāś ca tāratamyena viśiṣṭaphalasādhikāḥ ||
ātmavidyā pradhānā tu tathāyurvedasaṃhitāḥ |
dharmādharmapraṇayinī kalāḥ śilpārthasādhikāḥ ||
sasyavidyā ca vitatā etā vidyā mahāphalāḥ |
dharmādharmapraṇayinī dharmādharmaprasādhikāḥ ||
yayaiko jīvati prāṇī kayāpi kila kutracit |
apradhānāpi sā vidyā kulānāṃ śatam uddharet ||
[515] apradhānā avāntaravidyā |
yāpi sāpy avabodhatvād vidyā vai yatra kutracit |
prayāsyaty akṣayāl lokān vidhinā vāvidhānataḥ ||
avabodhatvād avabodhahetutvāt, prayāsyatīty antarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ tena prayāpayiṣyatīty
arthaḥ |
śilpavidyā naro datvā yānti vai brahmaṇo ‘ntikam |
kalāvidyāṃ naro datvā vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
kalpam ekaṃ na saṃdehaḥ svargabhogasamanvitaḥ |
sasyavidyāṃ naro datvā tṛptimān kāmasaṃyutaḥ ||
prajāpatipuraṃ gacchen narakāt tārayet pitṝn |
āyurvedaṃ naro datvā lokān prāpnoti nirmalān ||
aśvinor divyakāmādyān divyamanvantaraṃ naraḥ |
tarkavidyāṃ naro datvā vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
mīmāṃsāṃ tu budhe datvā śāstram indupure vaset |
dharmaśāstraṃ naro datvā svargaloke mahīyate ||
daśamanvantarān martyas tārayen narakāt pitṝn |
vedavidyāṃ naro datvā svargalokatrayaṃ vaset ||
ātmavidyāṃ ca yo dadyāt tasya saṃkhyā na śakyate |
puṇyasya gadituṃ samyag api varṣaśatāyutaiḥ ||
etāvac chakyate vaktuṃ yat kalpāyutam uttamam |
satyaloke vasen martyo yatra brahmā vaset prabhuḥ ||
[516]        apy ekaṃ nirujīkṛtya jantuṃ yādṛśatādṛśam |
āyurvedaprabhāvena kiṃ na dattaṃ bhaved bhuvi ||
sasyavedaprasādena saṃpannāḥ sasyaśālayaḥ |
kiṃ na nāma kṛtaṃ tatra puṇyaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ||
mīmāṃsāśāstramāhātmyaṃ buddhvā vai vedanirṇayam |
kiṃ na nāma śubhaṃ dātur yajñakarmapravartanāt ||
ātmavidyā ca paurāṇī dharmaśāstrātmikā ca yā |
etā vidyās trayīmukhyāḥ sarvadānakriyāphalaiḥ ||
dharmaśāstraṃ naro buddhvā yat kiṃcid dharmam āśrayet |
tasya dharmaṃ śataguṇaṃ dharmaśāstrapradasya ca ||
purāṇākhyānavidvāṃsaḥ pitṛdevārcane ratāḥ |
lokān sarvān kāmapūrṇān yānti sarvaśubhodayāt ||
purāṇavidyādātāras tv anantaphalabhāginaḥ |
ātmavidyāpradātāro narā dharmasamāśrayāt ||
na punar yoninirayaṃ praviśanti duratyayam |
uttīrṇāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ saputrapaśubāndhavāḥ ||
mucyante nirayair ghorair asaṃkyair yātanātmakaiḥ ||
tathā |
ślokaṃ prahelikāṃ gāthām anyathā vā śubhāṣitam |
datvā prītikaraṃ yāti lokam apsarasāṃ śubham ||
varāhapurāṇe |
rāmāyaṇaṃ bhārataṃ ca datvā svarge mahīyate |
purāṇaṃ tarkaśāstraṃ ca chando’laṃkāralakṣaṇam ||
[517]        vedamīṃāṃsikān datvā śivadharmaṃ ca vai nṛpa |
saptadvīpapṛthivyāṃ ca rājarājo bhavet tu saḥ ||
pāṇinīyaṃ niruktādi vedāṅgaṃ smṛtayas tathā |
datvā jñānam avāpnoti vedāntaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
nityaṃ deyāni rājendra gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī ||
iti vidyādānapraśaṃsā |
atha vedadānaṃ tāvan nirūpyate | ādityapurāṇe |
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ brahmadānaṃ viśiṣyate |
kāryaṃ na gomahīvāsatilakāñcanasarpiṣām ||
brahmadānaṃ vedadānam | yājñavalkyaḥ |
sarvadharmamayaṃ brahma pradānebhyo ‘dhikaṃ yataḥ |

mahābhārate |
yo brūyāc cāpi śiṣyāya dharmyāṃ brāhmīṃ sarasvatīm |
pṛthivīgopradānābhyāṃ sa tulyaṃ phalam aśnute ||
brāhmī vedārthānugamā | tathā |
adhītyāpi ca yo vedān nyāyavid yaḥ praycchati |
gurukarmapraśasto ‘yaṃ so ‘pi svarge mahīyate ||
[518] viṣṇudharmottare |
vedadānād avāpnoti sarvayajñaphalaṃ naraḥ |
upavedapradānena gandharvaiḥ saha modate ||
vedāṅgānāṃ ca dānena śakralokam avāpnuyāt ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
vidyānāṃ parā vidyā brahmavidyā samīritā |
atas taddānato rājan sarvadānaphalaṃ bhavet ||
āyuḥ [āhuḥ?] samastavidyānāṃ vedavidyām anuttamam |
atas taddātur asty eva lābhaḥ svargāpavargayoḥ ||
devīpurāṇe |
veda eva dvijātīnāṃ sādhanaṃ śreyasaḥ param |
ataḥ svādhyāpanābhyāsāt paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
tam eva śīlayaet prājñaḥ śiṣyebhyas taṃ pradāpayet |
tadabhyāsapradānābhyāṃ tat kiṃ yan nādhigacchati ||
aṅgopāṅgasamāyuktaṃ yo veda vedakṛtsnaśaḥ |
na sa lipyate pāpena dadan mokṣam avāpnuyāt ||
tathā |
manur uvāca |
kiṃ vedarūpaṃ mānaṃ ca upāṅgasaṃkhyābhedataḥ |
aṅgāni caiva vedānāṃ tan no brūhi sanātana ||
brahmovāca |
oṃkāraprabhavā vedā gāyatrī vedasaṃbhavā |
[519]        ṣaḍaṅgās te samākhyātā sahopāṅgās tathaiva ca ||
chandolakṣaṇasaṃyuktā mātṛkāgarbhajāḥ smṛtāḥ |
eka eva bhaved vedaś caturvedaḥ punaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
śākhāryam alpayuktānāṃ grahaṇāyātivistarāt |
saṃvibhaktā mayā vatsa ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvakāḥ ||
tatra bhedās tu ṛgvede daśa caiva prakīrtitāḥ |
āstayāḥ sāṃkyacarcāś ca āvakā carcakā tathā ||
āvaṇīyāvakramāṣāḥ ṣaṭkramāḥ ṣaḍanukramāḥ |
daṇḍāś ceti samāsena punar ekaiva pāraṇāḥ ||
śākhāś ca trividhā bhūpa śākalāyāṣkamāṇḍukāḥ |
teṣām adhyāpanaṃ proktaṃ maṇḍalāni ca saptatiḥ ||
carcānāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu caturviṃśacchatāni ca |
ṛcāṃ daśasahasrāṇi ṛcāṃ pañcaśatāni ca ||
ṛcām aśītiḥ pādaś ca etat pāraṇam ucyate |
ṛgvede tu bhavet saṃkhyā yajurvedasya śrūyatām ||
ṣaḍaśītir vibhedena mayā bhinnāḥ śivājñayā |
daśadhā carakās tatra kvarakāhāridravīyāḥ ||
kaṭhāḥ prācyaṭhāś caiva kapiṣṭhalakaṭhās tathā |
nārāyaṇīyāḥ śvetāḥ śvetāśvataramaitrāyaṇāḥ ||
punaḥ sapta vibhedena maitrāyaṇyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
mānavā dundubhā vārāhā chāgeyā hāridravīyāḥ ||
[520]        śyāmāḥ śyāmāyanīyāś ca teṣām adhyayanam ucyate |
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi pāṭhā vedavido ‘vidan (?) ||
dviguṇaṃ pādapārīyās triguṇaṃ kramapāragāḥ |
ṣaḍaṅgāni yadādhīte sa ṣaḍaṅgavid ucyate ||
śikṣākalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chandojyotiṣam |
ṣaḍaṅgāni bhavanty etān upāṅgāni śṛṇuṣva bho ||
pratipadam anupadaṃ chandobhāṣāsamanvitam |
mīmāṃsānyāyatarkaś ca upāṅgāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
pariśiṣṭāś ca saṃkhyātā aṣṭādaśa śṛṇuṣva tān |
yūpalakṣaṇaṃ chāgalakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣṭhānuvākasaṃkhyācaraṇavyūhaśrāddhakalpasūktāni pariṣadam ṛgyujuṣam iṣṭakāpūraṇaṃ pravarādhyāyoñchaśāstraṃ kratusaṃkhyā niyamā yajñapārśvahotṛkam |
vrataṃ ca prasavotthānakūrmalakṣaṇasaṃyutam |
kathitāḥ pariśiṣṭās tu dvyūnaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ||
kaṭhānāṃ punar yāny āhuś catvāriṃśac caturyutān |
prācyodīcyā niruhyāś ca vājasaneyās tu pañca ca |
daśabhedavibhinnāś ca draṣṭavyā munipuṅgava ||
jābālābaudheyākānvāmādhyandināśvaśāpethāḥ |
supāyinaḥ kapālākhyāḥ pauṇḍravasāvaṭikāḥ ||
paramā ravikāḥ parāśarā ṛddhyābaudhāyanīyāḥ |
āyodhyā āyodheyāś ca teṣām adhyayanāni ca ||
dvisahasre śatanyūne vede vājasaneyake |
ṛggaṇo ‘yaṃ prasaṃkhyātas tato ‘nyāni yajūṃṣi ca ||
[521]                etat pramāṇaṃ yajuṣāṃ hi kevalam |
sakhilaṃ sasukriyaṃ parisaṃkhyātaṃ brāhmaṇam |
caturguṇaṃ tu jānīyāt taittirīyā dvidhā punaḥ ||
ṛṣayāḥ khāṇḍikeyāś ca khaṇḍikāḥ pañcadhā punaḥ |
kāleyā baudhāyanīyā hiraṇyakeśās tathaiva ca ||
bhāradvājāpastambāś ca teṣāṃ bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
adhyayanaṃ sauptikaṃ caiva pravacanīyaṃ tathāparam ||
sāmavedas tu vistīrṇaḥ sahasrabhedaśaḥ purā |
anadhyāyeṣv adhīyante tadā indreṇa dhīmatā ||
vajreṇa nihatāḥ śeṣās tān vakṣye śṛṇu santrama |
rāmāyaṇīyāḥ kauthumās tatra bhedān punaḥ śṛṇu ||
rāmāyaṇīyāḥ saptaiva sugrāhyās tapatāṃ vara |
kālaveyā mahākālavayālāṅgalavaidyutāḥ ||
kauthumānām api sapta asurāvānarāyaṇāḥ |
prajālādvainabhṛtyāś ca pariyogyāḥ parikāyanāḥ ||
adhyayanam api teṣāṃ keṣāṃ tu yathāvat kathitaṃ śṛṇu |
aṣṭau sāmasahasrāṇi sāmāni ca caturdaśa ||
aṣṭau śatāni navatīḥ daśa savālakhilyakāḥ |
sasuparṇāś ca prakhyāśca etaṃ sāmagaṇaṃ viduḥ ||
atho atharvavedasya navabhedā bhavanti hi |
pippalādā vatsadāś ca bhūtāyanāḥ kātayas tathā ||
jajñalā brahmavedāś ca śaunakī kanakhī tathā |
vedaṛṣiś cautavidyā teṣām adhyayanaṃ śṛṇu ||
[522]                pañcakalpā bhavanti |
nakṣatrakalpo vaitānaḥ saṃhitāvidhiḥ āṅgirasaṃ |
śāntikalpaś ca atharvaṇo bhavanti ha |
sarveṣām eva vedānām upavedān śṛṇuṣva tān |
ṛgvedasyāyurvedo yajurvedo dhanus tathā ||
sāmavedasya gāndharva arthaśāstrāṇy artharvaṇaḥ |
ṛgvedasyātreyaṃ gotraṃ somaṃ devaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
kāśyapaś ca yajurvedaṃ rudravedaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ |
sāmavedo ‘pi gotreṇa bhāradvājaḥ purandaram ||
adhidaivaṃ vijānīyād vaitānaṃ tu artharvaṇe |
brahmadevaṃ vijānīyād rapāṇyasmat śṛṇuṣva bho ||
ṛgvedaḥ padmapatrākṣaḥ pralambajaṭharaḥ śuciḥ |
bhaktagrīvaḥ kuñcitakeśaśmaśruḥ pramāṇenāpi vitastī ||
pañcarājata moktikaho ‘tha pūjyo varaprado bhuktiyuto dvijāya | yajurvedaḥ piṅgalākṣaḥ kṛśamadhyasthūlagalakapolas tāmrāyatavarṇaḥ, kṛṣṇacaraṇaḥ prasādena padadīrghatvena,
citre liṅge ‘tha vā pūjyaḥ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt |
sāmavedo nityaṃ kṛṣṇacaraṇaḥ prasādena padadīrghatvena,
citre liṅge ‘tha vā pūjyaḥ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt |
sāmavedo nityasragvī suvrataḥ śuciḥ,
śucivāsā kṣamī dāntaś ca mahādaṇḍī kācaraṇanayanaḥ
ādityavarṇo varṇena ṣaḍaratimātraḥ,
tāmre vātha maṇau deyaḥ pūjitaḥ śubhado bhavet |
[523]         atharvavedas tīkṣmadaṇḍaḥ kāmarūpo viśvātmā viraktaūrddhvajvālaḥ |
kṣudrakarmā śāstrakṛtī sthāyī nīlotpala varṇo varṇena svadāratuṣṭaḥ |
parastrīṣv avaśaḥ padmarāge vātha prapūjayet |

ya etaṃ nāmarūpaṃ tu gotravedapramāṇajam |
varṇaṃ varṇaṃ ca yo vidyāt sa puṇyaphalabhāg bhavet ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
atha dānavidhiṃ vakṣye rahasyaṃ paramaṃ matam |
yaṃ nidhāya naro ghorān nirayān nopasarpati ||
āmnāyarūpāṇi vidhāya samyak
haimāni pūrvoditalakṣaṇāni |
viśuddhamānāmaṇibhūṣitāni
ṛgādivedakramato niveśya ||
ṛgvedādilakṣaṇam, mahābhūtaghaṭadāne darśitam |
vāsāṃsi deyāni yathākrameṇa

nīlāni caivaṃ kusumāni datvā
saṃpūjya gandhākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ ||
āmodimodakayataṃ ghṛtapāyasaṃ ca
[524]                sakṣaudram annam atha yūpaghṛtaṃ krameṇa ||
tebhyo nivedya prathitaṃ vidhivat praṇamya |
samyak pradakṣiṇavidhiṃ vidadhīta vidvān ||
teṣāṃ pūjāvidhiḥ kāryo gāyatryā dhīmatāṃ vara |
vyāhṛtya vyāhṛtīḥ kuryād āvāhanavisarjane ||
mantrair etais tataḥ kuryād amīṣām anumantraṇam |
ṛgveda padmapatrākṣa rakṣa rakṣa kṣipāśubham ||
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapanno ‘smi dehi me hitam adbhutam |
yajurveda namas te ‘stu lokatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||
tvatprasādena me kṣemāḥ nikhilāḥ santu santatam |
sāmaveda mahābāho tvaṃ hi sākṣād adhokṣajaḥ ||
prasādasumukho bhūtvā kṛpayānugṛhāṇa mām ||
atharvan sarvabhūtānāṃ tvadāyatte hitāhite |
śāntiṃ kuruṣva deveśa puṣṭim iṣṭāṃ prayacchata ||
iti saṃprārthya deveśān viprebhyaḥ pratipādayet |
pradadyād ekam ekasmin suvarṇatripalānvitam ||
dadyād ekapalopetam ekaikam iha durbalaḥ |
atha svaśaktito vāpi dānam eṣāṃ vidhīyate ||
etad eva pramāṇaṃ syāt teṣāṃ mūrtivinirmitau |
anadhītavato vedān vedadānavidhis tv ayam ||
sadādhyayanayuktasya śiṣyādhyāpakam eva hi |
svayaṃ śuciḥ śucīn viprān prātaḥ snāto yatendriyaḥ ||
darbhān ādāya pāṇau tu pāṭhayet tāṃ tathāvidhān |
[525]        anadhyāyān pariharan nīcān aśrāvayann api ||
evaṃ vidhānato yas tu ṛcam ekāṃ prayacchati |
trivittapūrṇasaṃpūrṇā tena dattā mahī bhavet ||
na tat kalpasahasreṇa gadituṃ śakyate phalam |
yad vedadānād āpnoti svalpād api mahāmate ||
yāvanti vedagītāni puṇyavedavratāni ca |
tāvanti vedadānena prāpnuyād bhaktibhāvitaḥ ||
upādhyāyasya yo vṛttiṃ datvādhyāpane janam |
kiṃ na dattaṃ bhavet tena dharmakāmārthadarśitam ||
chātrāṇāṃ [gātrāṇāṃ?] bhojanābhyaṅgaṃ vastraṃ bhikṣām athāpi vā |
datvā prāpnoti puruṣaḥ sarvakāmān na saṃśayaḥ ||
viveko jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ darmakāmārtham āpnuyāt |
sarvam eva bhaved dattaṃ chātrāṇāṃ [?] bhojane kṛte ||
vahnipurāṇe |
prātar utthāya yo vedān vedāṅgam api pāṭhayet |
pṛthivīdānatulyaṃ syāt phalaṃ tasya nṛpottama ||
yo vṛttiṃ paṭhamānānāṃ karoty anuditaṃ nṛpa |
sa yajñaphalam ādatte dānācchādanabhojanaiḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
aputro labhate putrān nirdhano dhanam āpnuyāt |
avidvān vidyāṃ prāpnoti duḥkhī duḥkhāt pramucyate ||
sadādhyayanayuktas tu pare brahmaṇi līyate |

iti vedadānavidhiḥ |
atha śāstradānam | tatra nandipurāṇe |
śāstre yasmāj jagat sarvaṃ saṃśritaṃ ca śubhāśubham |
tasmāc chāstraṃ prayatnena dātavyaṃ śubhakarmaṇe ||
yamaḥ |
ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ dadyāt sarvaratnopaśobhitām |
dadyāc chāstraṃ ca viprāṇāṃ tac caitāni ca tatsamam ||
tat sarvaratnopaśobhitaṃ pṛthivīdānam | etāni pūrvoktāni dānāni tad ubhayaṃ vidyādānasamam ity arthaḥ |
śāstraṃ cakṣur hi lokānāṃ svargamārgaprakāśakam |
śāstreṇa dhāryate nūnaṃ trailoyaṃ sacarācaram ||
yojanānāṃ sahasre ‘pi varṣakoṭiśatena ca |
sadyas tirohitaṃ vastu śāstraṃ darśayituṃ kṣamam ||
ataḥ śāstrāt paraṃ nāsti triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana |
saṃsāraniviḍadhvāntataraṇis tat prakīrtitam ||
dadyād etatprayogeṇa naraḥ santatam ādṛtaḥ |
kiṃ na dattaṃ bhavet tena śāstraratnaṃ dadāti yaḥ ||
tatra sakalaśāstrapradhānatayā dharmaśāstrapradānam eva tāvad ucyate |
nandipurāṇe |
śrutiḥ smṛtiś ca viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī dve prakīrtite |
kāṇas tatraikayā hīno dvābhyām andhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
[527] tathā |
dharmaśāstraṃ naro datvā nākapṛṣṭhae mahīyate |
daśamanvantarān martyas tārayen narakāt pitṝn ||
ātmavidyā ca paurāṇī dharmaśāstrātmikā ca yā |
tisro vidyā imā mukhyāḥ sarvadānakriyāphale ||
dharmaśāstraṃ naro buddhvā yat kiṃcid dharmam āśrayet |
tasya dharmaḥ śataguṇo dharmaśāstrapradasya ca ||
ataḥ sadā budhair jñeyaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
na tasya puṇyasaṃkhyānaṃ brahmāpi gadituṃ kṣamaḥ ||
agnipurāṇe |
kapilānāṃ sahasreṇa samyag dattena yat phalam |
tad rājan sakalaṃ lebhe dharmaśāstrapradānakaḥ ||
tatra dharmaśāstrapraṇetṛkathanadvārā tadanukramam āhatuḥ śakhalikhitau:
smṛtayo dharmaśāstrāṇi | teṣāṃ praṇetāro manuḥ viṣṇur yamadakṣāṅgiro’tri-bṛhaspatyuśanaāpastambavaśiṣṭhakātyāyanaparāśaravyāsaśaṅkhalikhitasaṃvarta-gautamaśātātapahārītayājñavalkyapracetasādayaḥ |
ādiśabdāc ca budhadevalasomaprajāpativṛddhaśātātapapaiṭhīnasichāgaleyacyavanamarīci-vatsapāraskarapulastyapulahakratuṛṣyaśṛṅgātreyāṇāṃ grahaṇam | āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
teṣāṃ manvaṅgirovyāsagautamolikhitāyamaḥ |
[528]        vasiṣṭhadakṣasaṃvartaśātātapaparāśarāḥ ||
viṣṇvāpastambahārītāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kātyāyano guruḥ |
pracetā nārado yogī baudhāyanapitāmahau ||
sumantuḥ kāśyapo babhruḥ paiṭhīno vyāghra eva ca |
satyavrato bharadvājo gārgyaḥ kārṣṇājinis tathā ||
jābālir jamadagniś ca laugākṣiḥ brahmasaṃbhavaḥ |
iti dharmapraṇetāraḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ṣaṭtriṃśadatiriktāḥ smṛtayaḥ santīti darśitam |
aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu yāni vākyāni putraka ||
tāny ālocya mahābāho tathā smṛtyantareṣu ca |
manvādismṛtayo yāś ca ṣaṭtriṃśat parikīrtitāḥ ||
tāsāṃ vākyāni kramaśaḥ samālocya bravīmi te || iti |
āha manuḥ |
viṣṇuḥ parāśaro dakṣaḥ saṃvartavyāsahāritāḥ |
śātātapo vaśiṣṭhaś ca yamāpastambagautamāḥ ||
devalaḥ śaṅkhalikhitau bharadvājośanotrayaḥ |
śaunako yājñavalkyaś cadaśāṣṭau smṛtikāriṇaḥ ||
tathā |
bhārgavo nāradīyā ca bārhaspatyāṅgirasy api |
svāyaṃbhuvasya śāstrasya catasraḥ saṃhitā matāḥ ||
aṅgirāḥ |
jābālir nāciketaś ca skando laugākṣikaśyapau |
vyāsaḥ sanatkumāraś ca śatarjur janakas tathā ||
[529]        vyāghraḥ kātyāyanaś caiva jātūkarṇyaḥ kapiñjalaḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ kaṇādaś ca viśvāmitras tathaiva ca ||
upasmṛtaya ity etāḥ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
yamaḥ |
etair yāni praṇītāni dharmaśāstrāṇi vai purā |
tāny evātipramāṇāni na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
smṛtayor dharmamūlaṃ hia dharmaḥ sarvārthasādhanam |
ataḥ smṛtiṣu dattāsu sarvadānaphalaṃlabhet ||
ekam eva samuddhṛtya prāṇinaṃ duḥkhasāgarāt |
anantaphalam āpnoti kiṃ punar jñānador bahūn ||
kim ataḥ sa hi dharmo ‘sti kiṃ vā jñānaṃ tathāvidham |
anyad vā tat kim astīha yad vā smṛtiṣu dṛśyate ||
atas tāsu pradattāsu jñānavān abhijāyate |
pāraṃ prāpya ca śāstrāṇāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ||
iti smṛtidānam |
atha purāṇadānam | tatra nāradīye |
vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitā devi purāṇair nātra saṃśayaḥ |
bibhety alpaśrutād vedo mām ayaṃ pratariṣyati ||
itihāsapurāṇaiś ca kṛto ‘yaṃ niścalaḥ purā |
yan na dṛṣṭaṃ hi vedeṣu tad dṛṣṭaṃ smṛtibhiḥ kila ||
ubhābhyāṃ yan na dṛṣṭaṃ hi tat purāṇeṣu gīyate ||
[530] matyapurāṇe |
purāṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ prathamaṃ brahmaṇā smṛtam |
anantaraṃ ca vaktrebhyo vedās tasya vinirgatāḥ ||
purāṇam ekam evāsīd asmin kilāntare ‘nagha |
trivargasādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram ||
nirdagdheṣu ca lokeṣu vājirūpeṇa vai mayā |
aṅgāni caturo vedāḥ purāṇanyāyavistarāḥ ||
mīmāṃsā dharmaśāstrāṇi parigṛhyātmasāt kṛtam |
matsyarūpeṇa ca punar kalpādāv udakārṇave ||
aśeṣam etat kathitam udakāntargatena ca |
śrutvā jagāda ca munīn prativedaś caturmukhaḥ ||
pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇasyābhavat tataḥ |
kālena grahaṇaṃ drṣṭvā purāṇasya tato ‘nṛtam ||
vyāsarūpam ahaṃ kṛtvā saṃharāmi yuge yuge |
caturlakṣapramāṇena dvāpare dvāpre sadā ||
tad aṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā bhūrloke ‘smin prabhāṣyate |
adyāpi devaloke tat śatakoṭipravistaram ||
tad artho ‘tra caturlakṣaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa niveditaḥ |
purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca sāṃprataṃ tad ihocyate ||
nāmatas tāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvam ṛṣisattamāḥ ||
[531] vārāhapurāṇe |
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā |
tathānyan nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca saptamam ||
āgneyam aṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ bhaviṣyan navamaṃ tathā |
daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ liṅgam ekādaśaṃ tathā ||
vārāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ proktaṃ skāndaṃ cātra trayodaśam |
caturdaśaṃ vāmanaṃ ca kaurmaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tathā ||
mātsyaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ caiva brahmāṇḍam aṣṭādaśaṃ tathā ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
śaivaṃ yad vāyunā proktaṃ vairiñcaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā |
yad idaṃ kālikākhyaṃ ca mūlaṃ bhāgavataṃ smṛtam ||
sauraṃ ca nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍīyaṃ ca vahnijam |
vāmanaṃ kaurmaṃ mātsyaṃ ca saptadaśaṃ ca gāruḍam ||
brāhmāṇḍam aṣṭādaśaṃ jñeyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ ||
saurapurāṇāt |
yad uktaṃ bhānunā pūrvaṃ putrāyamanave dvijāḥ |
tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ vadato mama ||
sargaś ca pratisargaś ca vaṃśamanvantarāṇi ca |
vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam ||
yatnatopapurāṇānāṃ likhitvā lakṣaṇaṃ smṛtam |
brāhmaṃ purāṇaṃ tatrādyaṃ saṃhitābhyāṃ vibhūṣitam ||
[532]        ślokānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ nānāpuṇyakathāyutam |
pādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ kathitaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ smṛtam ||
caturthaṃ vāyunā proktaṃ vāyavīyam iti smṛtam |
tato bhāgadvayaṃ proktaṃ bhāgadvayavibhūṣitam ||
caturbhiḥ parvabhiḥ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tadanantaram |
mārkaṇḍeyam athāgneyaṃ nāradīyam ataḥ param ||
daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ liṅgam ekādaśaṃ smṛtam |
bhāgadvayena liṅgaṃ ca tato vārāham uttamam ||
saṃyuktam aṣṭabhiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ skāndaṃ caivātra vistaram |
tatas tu vāmanaṃ kaurmaṃ bhāgadvayavirājitam ||
mātsyaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ proktaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ ca tataḥ param |
bhāgadvayena kathitaṃ brahmāṇḍam abhisaṃjñitam ||
khilāny upapurāṇāni yāni coktāni sūribhiḥ |
idaṃ brahmapurāṇasya khilaṃ sauram anuttamam ||
saṃhitādvayasaṃyuktaṃ puṇyaṃ śivakathāśrayam |
ādyā sanatkumāroktā dvitīyā sūryabhāṣitā ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
anyāny upapurāṇāni munibhiḥ kathitāni tu |
ādyaṃ sanatkumāroktaṃ nārasiṃham ataḥ param ||
tṛtīyaṃ nāradam uddiṣṭaṃ kumāreṇa tu bhāṣitam |
caturthaṃ śivadharmākhyaṃ sākṣān nandīśabhāṣitam ||
[533]        durvāsasoktam āścaryaṃ nāradoktam ataḥ param |
kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam ||
brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ cātha kāpilāhvayam eva ca |
māheśvaraṃ tathā śāmbaṃ sauraṃ sārvarthasaṃcayam ||
parāśaroktaṃ pravaraṃ tathā bhāgavataṃ dvayam |
idam aṣṭādaśaṃ proktaṃ purāṇaṃ kaurmasaṃjñitam ||
caturdhā saṃsthitaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃhitānāṃ prabhedataḥ |
matsyapurāṇe |
pādme purāṇe yā proktā narasiṃhopavarṇanā |
tatrāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ nārasiṃham ihocyate ||
nandāyā yatra māhātmyaṃ kārtikeyena varṇyate |
nandīpurāṇaṃ tallokair vyākhyātam iti kīrtyate ||
yatra sāmyaṃ puraskṛtya bhaviṣyati kathā na kam |
procyate tat punar loke sāmyam eva munivratāḥ ||
evam ādityasaṃjñaś ca tatraiva paripaṭhyate |
aṣṭādaśabhyas tu pṛthak purāṇaṃ yat pradṛśyate ||
vijānīdhvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhās tad etebhyo vinirmitam |
pañcāṅgavat purāṇaṃ syād ākhyānam itarat smṛtam ||
sargaś ca pratisargaś ca vaṃśamanvantarāṇi ca |
vaṃśānucaritaṃ ceti purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam ||
brahmaviṣṇvarkarudāṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ bhuvanasya ca |
[534]        sa saṃhāraṃ pradṛśyeta purāṇaṃ pañcavarṇatā ||
dharmaś cārthaś ca kāmaś ca mokṣaś ca parikīrtyate |
sarveṣv api purāṇeṣu tadviruddhe ca yat phalam ||
sātvikeṣu ca kalpeṣu māhātmyam adhikaṃ hareḥ |
rājaseṣu ca māhātmyam adhikaṃ brahmaṇo viduḥ ||
tadvad agneś ca māhātmyaṃ tāmaseṣu śivasya ca |
saṃkīrṇeṣu sarasvatyāḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca nigadyate ||
tathā |
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni kṛtvā satyavatīsutaḥ |
bhāratākhyānam akhilaṃ cakre tad upabṛṃhitam ||
lakṣaṇaikena tat proktaṃ vedārthaparibṛṃhitam |
vālmīkināpi yat proktaṃ rāmāyaṇākhyam uttamam ||
brahmaṇābhihitaṃ yac ca śatakoṭipravistarāt |
āhṛtya nāradenaiva vālmīkāya punaḥ punaḥ ||
vālmīkinā ca lokeṣu dharmakāmārthasādhanam |
evaṃ sapādāḥ pañcaite lakṣyās teṣu prakīrtitāḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
purāṇasaṃkhyām ācakṣva sūta vistarataḥ kramāt |
dānaṃ dharmam aśeṣaṃ ca yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
sūta uvāca |
imdm eva purā praśnaṃ noditaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
yad uvāca saviśvātmā munayas tan nibodhata ||
[535]        purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca sāṃprataṃ tad ihocyate |
nāmatas tāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvam ṛṣisattamāḥ ||
brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ yāvanmātraṃ marīcaye |
brāhmaṃ tad daśasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ parikīrtyate ||
likhitvā tac ca yo dadyāj jaladhenusamanvitam |
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu brahmaloke mahīyate ||
etad eva yadā padmam abhūd dhairaṇmayaṃ jagat |
tadvṛttāntāśrayaṃ tadvat pādmam ity ucyate budhaiḥ ||
pādmaṃ tat pañcapañcāśat sāhasrāṇīha paṭhyate |
tat purāṇaṃ ca yo dadyāt suvarṇakamalāṇvitam ||
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tilair yuktaṃ so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
vārāhakalpavṛttāntam adhikṛtya parāśaraḥ ||
yatrāha dharmān akhilān tadyuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ |
tadāṣāḍhe ca yo dadyād ghṛtadhenusamanvitam ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ vipūtātmā sa padaṃ yāti vāruṇam |
trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ tat purāṇaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
śvetakalpaprasaṅgena dharmān vāyur ihābravīt |
yatra tad vāyavīyaṃ syād rudramāhātmyasaṃyutam ||
caturviṃśatsahasrāṇi purāṇaṃ tad ihocyate |
śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi guḍadhenusamanvitam ||
yo dadyād dadhisaṃyutaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine |
śivaloke sa pūtātmā kalpam ekaṃ vasen naraḥ ||
yatrādhikṛtya gāyatrīṃ varṇyate dharmavistaraḥ |
[536]        vṛtrāsuravadhopetaṃ tad bhāgavatam ucyate ||
sārasvatasya kalpasya madhye ye syur narāmarāḥ |
tadvṛttāntodbhavaṃ loke tad bhāgavatam ucyate ||
likhitvā tac ca yo dadyād dhemasiṃhasamanvitam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi purāṇaṃ tat prakīrtitam |
yatrāha nārado dharmān bṛhatkalpāśritāṃs tv iha ||
pañcaviṃśatsahasrāṇi nāradīyaṃ tad ucyate |
tad idaṃ pañcadaśyāṃ tu yo dadyād dhemasaṃyutam ||
uttamāṃ siddhim āpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham |
yatrādhikṛtya śakunīn dharmādharmavicāraṇam ||
purāṇaṃ navasāhasraṃ mārkaṇḍeyam ihocyate |
parilikhya ca yo dadyāt sauvarṇakarisaṃyutam ||
kārttikyāṃ pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalabhāg bhavet |
yat tad īśānakalpasya vṛttāntam adhikṛtya ca ||
vaśiṣṭhāyāgninā proktam āgneyaṃ tat pracakṣate |
likhāpayitvā yo dadyād hemapadmasamanvitam ||
mārgaśīrṣe vidhānena tiladhenvānvitaṃ tathā |
etat ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ sarvakratuphalapradam ||
yatrādhikrtya māhātmyam ādityasya caturmukhaḥ |
aghorakalpavṛttāntaprasaṅgena jagatpatiḥ ||
[537]        navame kathayāmāsa bhūtagrāmasya lakṣaṇam |
caturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca ||
bhaviṣyaccaritaprāyaṃ bhaviṣyat tad ihocyate |
tat pauṣe māsi yo dadyāt paurṇamāsyāṃ vimatsaraḥ ||
guḍakumbhasamāyuktam agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
rathantarasya kalpasya vṛttāntam adhikṛtya ca ||
sāvarṇinā [?] nāradāya kṛṣṇamāhātmyasaṃyutam |
yatra brahmavarāhasya caritaṃ varṇyate muhuḥ ||
tad aṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ brahmavaivartam ucyate |
purāṇaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ yo dadyān māghamāsi ca ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ sa bhavanaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate |
yatrāgniliṅgamadhyasthaḥ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārtham āgneyam adhikṛtya ca |
kalpaṃ tal laiṅgam ity uktaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmaṇā svayam ||
tad ekādaśasāhasraṃ phālgunyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
tiladhenusamāyuktaṃ sa yāti śivasātmatām ||
mahāvarāhasya punar māhātmyam adhikṛtya ca |
mānavasya prasaṅgena kalpasya munisattama ||
caturviṃśatsahasrāṇi tat purāṇam ihocyate |
viṣṇunābhihitaṃ kṣauṇyai tad vārāham ihocyate ||
kāñcanaṃ garuḍaṃ kṛtvā tiladhenusamanvitam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ madhau datvā brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
[538]        varāhasya prasādena padam āpnoti vaiṣṇavam |
yatra māheśvarān dharmān adhikṛtya ca **** ||
kalpe tat puruṣe vṛtte caritair upabṛṃhitam |
skāndaṃ nāma purāṇaṃ tad ekāśītir nigadyate ||
sahasrāṇi śataṃ caikam iti martyeṣu paṭhyate |
parilikhya ca yo dadyād dhemaśūlasamanvitam ||
śaivaṃ ca padam āpnoti makaropagame raveḥ |
trivikramasya māhātmyam adhikṛtya caturmukhaḥ ||
trivargam abhyadhāt tatra vāmanaṃ parikīrtitam |
purāṇaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kūrmakalpānugaṃ śivam ||
yac charadviṣuve dadyād vaiṣṇavaṃ yāty asau padam |
yatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasya ca rasātale ||
māhātmyaṃ kathayāmāsa kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ |
indradyumnaprasaṅgena ṛṣīṇāṃ śakrasaṃnidhau ||
saptadaśasahasrāṇi lakṣmīkalpānusaṅgikam |
yo dadyād ayane kumbhaṃ hemakumbhasamanvitam ||
gosahasrapradānasya sa phalaṃ prāpnuyān naraḥ |
śrutīnāṃ yatra kalpādau pravṛttyarthaṃ janārdanaḥ ||
matsyarūpī ca manave narasiṃhopavarṇanam |
adhikṛtyābravīt saptakalpavṛttaṃ munivratāḥ ||
tanmāhātmyam iti jānīdhvaṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa |
viṣṇave hemamatsyena dhenvā caiva samanvitam ||
[539]        yo dadyāt pṛthivī tena dattā bhavati vākhilā |
yadā ca gāruḍe kalpe viśvāṇḍād garuḍodbhavam ||
adhikṛtyābravīt kṛṣṇo gāruḍaṃ tad ihocyate |
tad aṣṭādaśa caikaṃ ca sahasrāṇīha paṭhyate ||
sauvarṇahemamithunasaṃyuktaṃ viduṣe naraḥ |
yo dadāti parāṃ siddhim āpnoti śivasaṃnidhim ||
brahmā brahmāṇḍamāhātmyam adhikṛtyābravīt punaḥ |
tac ca dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāṇdaṃ dviśatādhikam ||
bhaviṣyāṇāṃ ca kalpānāṃ śrūyate yatra vistaraḥ |
tad brahmāṇḍapurāṇaṃ tu brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam ||
yo dadyāc ca vyatīpāte pattorṇayugasaṃyutam |
rājasūyasahasrasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
hemadhenvā yutaṃ tac ca brahmalokaphalapradam ||
saurapurāṇe | tad eva purāṇam adhikṛtyāha |
iyaṃ puṇyatamākhyātā saṃhitā pāpanāśinī |
vaivaśvatāya manave kathitā raviṇā purā ||
dānam asya purāṇasya dānānām uttamaṃ dvijāḥ |
yo dadyāc chivabhaktāya brāhmaṇāya tapasvine ||
yāni dānāni lokeṣu prasiddhāni dvijottamāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ phalam āpnoti caturdaśyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
anyāny upapurāṇāni sahiraṇyāni parvaṇi |
[540]        likhitvā yaḥ prayacchet tu sa vidyāpārago bhavet ||
śivadharmādiśāstrāṇi yaḥ prayacchati puṇyadhīḥ |
so ‘nantaphalam āpnoti śivadharmaprakāśanāt ||
brahmapurāṇe |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sāraṃ bhāratam ucyate |
tadekasya pradānena vedaśāstraprado bhavet ||
rāmāyaṇaṃ likhitvā tu yaḥ samagraṃ prayacchati |
tasya prasannā bhavati padmabandhaiḥ sarasvatī ||
vahnipurāṇe |
purāṇaṃ bhārataṃ vāpi rāmāyaṇam athāpi vā |
datvā yat phalam āpnoti na tat sarvair mahāmakhaiḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe | tad eva purāṇam adhikṛtyāha |
brāhmī paurāṇikī ceyaṃ saṃhitā pāpanāśinī |
likhitvemāṃ ca yo dadyād vaiśākhe māsi suvrata ||
viprāya vedaviduṣe tasya puṇyaṃ nibodhata |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ||
bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogān vidyāvān dhanavān bhavet |
iti purāṇadānavidhiḥ |
atha purāṇaśravaṇadānam | tatra mahābhārate |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yāni deyāni bhārata |
vācyamāne tu viprebhyo rājan parvaṇi parvaṇi ||
[541]        svati vācya vidhānādau tataḥ kāryaṃ pravartate |
samāpte parvaṇi tataḥ svaśaktyā tarpayed dvijān ||
ādau tu vācakaṃ pūjya rasagandhasamanvitam |
vidhivad bhojayed rājan madhupāyasam uttamam ||
tato mūlaphalaprāyaṃ pāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣī |
āstike bhojayed rājan dadyāc caiva guḍodanam ||
atha dhūpaiś ca pūpaiś ca modakaiś ca samanvitam |
sabhāparvaṇi rājendra haviṣyaṃ bhojayed dvijān ||
āraṇyakair mūlaphalais tarpayec ca dvijottamān |
āraṇyaparvaṇy āsādya jalakumbhān pradāpayet ||
tarpaṇāni ca mukhyāni dhānyamūlaphalāni ca |
sarvakāmaguṇopeto viprebhyas taṃ pradāpayet ||
virāṭaparvaṇi tathā vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca |
udyoge bharataśreṣṭha sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ ||
bhojanaṃ bhojayed viprān gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtān |
bhīṣmaparvaṇi rājendra datvā pānam anuttamam ||
tataḥ sarvaguṇopetam annaṃ dadyāt susaṃskṛtam |
droṇaparvaṇi viprebhyo bhojanaṃ paramārjitam ||
śarāś ca deyā rājendra cāpāny asivarās tathā |
karṇaparvaṇy api tathā bhojanaṃ sārvakāmikam ||
viprebhyaḥ saṃskṛtaṃ samyag dadyāt saṃyatamānasaḥ |
śalyaparvaṇi rājendra modakaiḥ saguḍodanaiḥ ||
sadhūpais tarpaṇaiś caiva sarvam annaṃ pradāpayet |
[542]        gadāparvaṇy api tathā mudgamiśraṃ pradāpayet ||
strīparvaṇi tathā ratnais tarpayed vidhivad dvijān |
kṛtodanaṃ purastāt tu aiṣīke dāpayet punaḥ ||
tataḥ sarvaguṇopetam annaṃ dadyāt susaṃskṛtam |
śāntiparvaṇi ca tathā haviṣyaṃ bhojayed dvijān ||
āśvamedhikam āsādya bhojanaṃ sārvakāmikam |
tathāśramanivāse tu haviṣā bhojayed dvijān ||
mauśale sārvaguṇikaṃ gandhamālyānulepanam |
harivaṃśe tathā pārtha pāyasaṃ cārubhojanam ||
pāraṇe pāraṇe rājan yathāvad bharatarṣabha |
samāpya sarvāṃ prayataḥ saṃhitāṃ śāstrakovidaḥ ||
śubhe deśe niveśyātha kṣaumavastrādisaṃvṛtam |
śuklāmbaradharas tatra śucir bhūtvā svalaṃkṛtaḥ ||
arcayet tu yathānyāyaṃ gandhamālyaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
saṃhitāpustakān rāgāt prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
bhakṣyair bhojyaiś ca peyaiś ca kautukair vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
hiraṇyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ tatra dāpayet ||
devatāḥ kīrtayet sarvān naranārāyaṇau tathā |
tato gandhaiś ca mālyaiś ca svalaṃkṛtya dvijottamān ||
tarpayed vividhaiḥ kāmair dānai ratnādikais tathā |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu yathāvat saṃpracārayet ||
vācakaṃ bharataśreṣṭha bhojayitvā svalaṃkṛtam |
brāhmaṇeṣu prasanneṣu prasannās tasya devatāḥ ||
[543]        vācake parituṣṭe tu śubhā prītir anuttamā |
tato vivaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ saṃhitānāṃ bharatarṣabha ||
itihāsasamaṃ śrutvā yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
saṃyatātmā śucir bhūtvā pāraṃ gatvā tu bhārate ||
teṣāṃ śraddhāni deyāni śrutvā bhārata bhāratam |
brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśakti bhaktyā ca bharatarṣabha ||
mahādānāni deyāni yānāni vividhāni ca |
gāvaḥ kāṃsyopadohāś ca kanyāś ca sumanoharāḥ ||
sarvakāmaguṇopetā yānāni vividhāni ca |
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi bhūmivāsāṃsi kāñcanam ||
vāhanāni ca deyāni hṛdyā mattāś ca vāraṇāḥ |
śayanaṃ śivikāś caiva spandanāś ca svalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
yad yad gṛhe varaṃ kiṃcit kiṃcid asti mahad vasu |
tatra deyaṃ dvijātibhya ātmā dāsāś ca sūnavaḥ ||
śraddhayā parayā hṛdyā kramaśaḥ pāṭhapāragāḥ |
śaktitaḥ sumanā bhūtvā suśrutaś ca vimatsaraḥ ||
evaṃ karoti yo vidvān dānaṃ parvapratiṣṭhitam |
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya sa devaiḥ saha modate ||
yaś cānena prakāreṇa bhārataṃ śrāvayen naraḥ |
tadvidyādānamāhātmyāl lokān uddharati hy asau ||
iti purāṇaśravaṇadānavidhiḥ |
atha sarvaśāstrasādhāraṇadānavidhiḥ |
[544] tatra devīpurāṇe |
vidyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena tuṣyanti mātaraḥ |
likhyate dīyate yena vidhinā taṃ śṛṇu prabho ||
tathā |
śṛṇvatāṃ jāyate bhaktis tato gurum upāsate |
sa ca vidyāgamān vakti vidyāyus tv āśrito nṛpa ||
śrītāḍapatrake sañce same patrasusañcite |
vicitrakañcikā pārśve carmaṇā saṃpuṭīkṛte ||
raktena vātha kṛṣṇena mṛdunā raṅgitena ca |
dṛḍhasūtranibaddhena evaṃ vidhikṛtena ca ||
yas tu dvādaśasāhasrīṃ saṃhitām upalekhayet |
dadāti cābhiyuktāya sa yāti parmāṃ gatim ||
pūrvottaraplave deśe sarvabādhāvivarjite |
gomayena śubhenaiva kuryān maṇḍalakaṃ budhaḥ ||
dharnurhastapramāṇena subhaṃ ca caturasrakam |
tasya madhye likhet padmaṃ sitaraktasitādibhiḥ ||
sarvartukāmajaiḥ puṣpair bhūṣayet sarvato diśam |
vitānaṃ dāpayen mūrdhni śubhaṃ citravicitritam ||
pārśvato (?) sitavastraiś ca samyak śobhāṃ prakalpayet |
kandukair ardhacandraiś ca darpaṇaiś cāmarais tathā ||
ghaṇṭākiṅkiṇiśabdaiś ca sarvataś copakalpayet |
tasya madhye nyased yantraṃ nāgadantamayaṃ śubham ||
adhaḥ kiṃcin nibaddhaṃ tu ūrdhvato ‘pi susaṃyutam |
śobhitaṃ dṛḍhabandhena baddhaṃ sūtreṇa buddhimān ||
[545]        tasyordhvaṃ vinyased vidvān pustakaṃ likhitaṃ śubham |
ālekhyam api tatraiva pūjayed vidhinā tataḥ ||
nirūdakais tathā puṣpaiḥ kṛmikīṭavivarjitaiḥ |
candanena sadarpeṇa bhasmanā vāvadhūlayet ||
sadarpeṇa mṛgamadasahitena |
dhūpaś ca guggulur deyas turuṣkāgurumiśritaḥ |
dīpamālā tathā cāgre naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ punaḥ ||
svādyaṃ peyaṃ sitaṃ lehyaṃ cūṣyambā vinivedayet |
pūjayec ca diśāṃ pālān lokapālān yathākramam ||
kanyā striyaś ca saṃpūjya mātaraḥ kalpayec ca vā |
pustakaṃ devadevīś ca viprāṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||
svaśaktyā caiva dātavyā nṛpaḥ paurāṃś ca pūjayet |
tathā saṃpūjayed vatsa lekhakaṃ śāstrapāragam ||
chandolakṣaṇatattvajñaṃ satkaviṃ madhurasvaram |
pranaṣṭaṃ smarati granthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pustakalekhakam ||
nābhisantativicchinnaṃ na ca ślakṣṇair na karvaṭaiḥ (?) |
nandināgarakair varṇair lekhayec chivapustakam ||
prārabhya pañca vai ślokān punaḥ śāntiṃ tu kārayet |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sarvaprekṣāṃ prakalpayet ||
naṭacāraṇanagnaiś ca devyāḥ kathanasaṃbhavaiḥ |
sarvaprekṣāṃ sarvaprakāraprekṣaṇakam |
pratyūṣe pūjayel lokāṃs tataḥ sarvān visarjayet ||
[546]        ekānte sumanaskena viśuddhena dine dine |
niṣpādya vidhināne (?) svṛkṣe na ca śubhavāsare ||
svṛkṣe śubhanakṣatre |
tataḥ pūrvoktavidhinā punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet |
tathā vidyāvimānaṃ tu saptapañcatribhūmikam ||
vicitravastraśobhāḍhyaṃ śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitam |
kārayet sarvatobhadraṃ kiṅkiṇīravakānvitam ||
darpaṇair ardhacandraiś ca ghaṇṭācāmaramaṇḍitam |
tasmin dhūpaṃ samutkṣipya sugandhacandanāgurum ||
turuṣkaṃ guggulaṃ vatsa śarkarāmadhumiśritam |
pūjayet pūrvavat sarvān kanyāstrīdvijaduḥkhitān ||
tathā tat pustakaṃ vatsa vinyased vidhipūrvakam |
evaṃ kṛtvā yathā vidyāḥ prīyantāṃ mātaro mama ||
yasyaiva saktaṃ tac chāstraṃ taṃ pustaṃ parikalpayet |
yasyaiva saktaṃ yasyaiva devasya saktam, saṃbandhitaṃ pustaṃ parikalpayet pustakaṃ taṃ deyaṃ parikalpayet bhāvayed ity arthaḥ |
tathā tapasvinaḥ pūjyāḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragāḥ |
śivavratadharā mukhyā viṣṇudharmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
mahatā janasaṅghena rathasthaṃ dṛḍhavāhanaiḥ |
yuvabhiś cābhito neyaṃ yasya devasya cāgamam ||
[547]        sāmānyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu mātṝṇāṃ bhavaneṣu ca |
tasmin pūjāṃ tathā kṛtvā devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
samarpayet praṇamyeśaṃ prīyantāṃ mātaro mama |
sadādhyayanayuktāya vidyādānaratāya ca ||
vidyāsaṃgrahayuktāya kṛtaśāstrāśramāya ca |
tenaiva vartate yas tu tasya taṃ vinivedayet ||
jagaddhitāya vai śāntiṃ saṃdhāya vācayet tathā |
tena toyena dātāraṃ mūrdhni samyaṅ niṣecayet ||
śivaṃ vande tataḥ śabdam uccārya jagatas tathā |
evaṃ kṛte mahāśāntir deśasya nagarasya ca ||
jāyate nātra saṃdehaḥ sarvabādhāḥ śamanti ca |
anena vidhinā yas tu vidyādānaṃ prayacchati ||
sa bhavet sarvalokānāṃ darśanād aghanāśanaḥ |
mṛto ‘pi gacchati sthānaṃ brahmaviṣṇunamaskṛtam ||
saptapūrvāparān vaṃśān ātmanaḥ sarvam eva ca |
uddhṛtya pāpakalilād viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
yāvanti patrasaṃkhyāni akṣarāṇi bhavanti hi |
tāvat sa viṣṇulokeṣu krīḍate vividhaiḥ sukhaiḥ ||
tataḥ kṣitiṃ samāyāto devyā bhaktiparo bhavet |
samastabhogasaṃpanno viduṣāṃ jāyate kule ||
nandipurāṇe |
yad etat puṇyam ākhyātaṃ vidyādānasya sāṃpratam |
[548]        deśakālavidhiśraddhāpātrayogāt tathā budhaḥ ||
prāpnoti koṭiguṇitaṃ phalaṃ vidyāpradānataḥ |
gurum ārādhya yatnena vidyāvyākhyānapāragam ||
śaktyā bhaktyā praṇāmena vidyādānaṃ samārabhet ||
tathā |
vidyā ca mukhyā dānānāṃ guruto ‘sya vidhiṃ budhaḥ |
śrutvā vidyāṃ ca vidhivat śraddayā bhāvitātmanā ||
satpātrebhyas tu tān dadyād viśeṣād guṇaśāliṣu |
upayogyaṃ ca yad yasya tat tasya pratipādayet ||
surālayeṣu siddheṣu yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ |
dātavyās tu prayatnena mahāpuṇyaphalārthibhiḥ ||
śubhe nakṣatradivase śubhe vāpi dinagrahe |
lekhayet pūjya deveśāṇ rudrabrahmajanārdanān ||
pūrvadigvijito bhūtvā lipijño lekhakottamaḥ |
nirodhihastabāhuś ca maṣīpātrāvadhāraṇāt ||
ekāntaś copakaraṇaṃ yasyāsau lekhakottamaḥ |
vidyādhāraṃ prakurvīta hemarūpyamayaṃ śubham ||
nāgadantamayaṃ vāpi śubhadārumayaṃ tathā |
manojñam aguruṃ ramyaṃ ślakṣṇayantraprayogajam ||
saṃkocapatrasaṃyuktaṃ vikāsena samanvitam |
nāgadantamayaḥ hastidantanirmita ity arthaḥ |
tatra vidyāṃ vinihitāṃ kuryāt pustakasaṃsthitām ||
kuryāc ca pustakaṃ tasya likhed dvyaṅgulavistṛtam |
śubhaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ ca ramyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ mecakitaṃ ca vā ||
[549]        atha vā raktapadmābhaṃ mecakālaṃkṛtaṃ śubham |
kārpāsasūtragrathitaṃ nānāgandhādhivāsitam ||
mecakālaṃkṛtaṃ mayūrārdhacandrālaṃkṛtam |
maṣībhiś cāpi nekābhiś caturvarṇābhir eva ca |
dṛḍhastambhanayuktābhir mecakaiś cāpy anekaśaḥ ||
stambhanaṃ maṣīsthairyahetu |
lekhanībhiś ca divyābhir hemacitrābhir eva ca |
bahiś ca varṇaṃ kurvīta pustakasya manoramam ||
pītaiḥ raktaiḥ kaṣāyair vā sunibaddhaṃ vicitritam |
ramyaṃ laghu suvistīrṇaṃ nigranthigranthisaṃyutam ||
vidyādhāraṃ tato yantrasaṃsthitaṃ pūrvapustakam |
gṛhe manorame gupte sudhālepitabhittike ||
nānārāgāṅkuropete śuddhabimbamanorame |
dhūpāmodamanojñe tu vitānakaparistṛte ||
lekhako buddhimān snātaḥ suklapuṣpāmbarojjvalaḥ |
suvarṇamuktākeyūto mudrikāśobhitāṅguliḥ ||
susamiddhe maṣībhāṇḍe lekhanīśastrasaṃyute |
ārabhet tūryaghoṣeṇa pūjāṃ devān pitṝṃs tathā ||
brāhmaṇān svastivācyādau śāstraṃ ca śrāvayed budhaḥ |
śrīkapañcakam ādau tu daśakaṃ vāpi lekhayet ||
tato nakṣatrayogena dvitīye ‘hani tal likhet |
tādṛśenaiva vidhinā puṇyāhaiḥ śubhasaṃyutaiḥ ||
tataḥ samāpte śāstre tu punaḥ puṇyāhasaṃyutam |
[550]        kuryāt tadahorātre ca pānabhojanavastubhiḥ ||
ubhayaṃ vāpi tal lekhyaṃ samīkuryāc ca vācakam |
ubhayaṃ lekhyaṃ vācayan samīkuryād ity arthaḥ |
ūnādhikaiś ca saṃyuktaṃ varṇair mātrādibhis tathā ||
anusvāravisargaiś ca yuktāyuktair vicārayet |
śāstraṃ prakṛtayā yuktyā punaruktyaṃ viśodhayet ||
ūnārthoktyā prasaṅgaś ca chandayogyatayā tathā |
sūtrāntarārthabodhena praśnottaravivekataḥ ||
asūtratvāc ca śāstrasya samudāyārthabodhataḥ |
prakrāntasūcanoddeśair gaditaiś coditair api ||
bahvarthānāṃ ca śabdānāṃ yogyāsattiṃ parīkṣya tu |
sarvaśāstrāvabodhena kārakādyair aviplutaiḥ ||
kvacic ca śabdaṃ varjyaiva prakṛtārthaṃ nirūpayet |
chandasāṃ cāpi buddhvā taṃ vṛttasaṃyogam īpsitam ||
evaṃ vidyāṃ tu medhāvī śāstraṃ satkṛtya kṛtsnaśaḥ |
pradadyād vibhavair (?) divyaiḥ surāyatanaveśmasu ||
vyaktādeśalipinyāsaṃ vyaktaṃ nāgaram ucyate |
vyaktadeśalipinyāsavyaktoddeśānusāriṇī ||
lipipatranyāse akṣaranirmāṇe sa tathā |
āropya yāne ratnāḍhye śubhavastrapariṣkṛte |
ghaṇṭācāmaraśobhāḍhye ratnadaṇḍātapatriṇi ||
gajavājirathasthaṃ vā mahāśobhasamanvitam |
purato gītanṛtyena nānāvādyaraveṇa ca ||
[551]        maṅgalair vedanirghoṣair devāya vinivedayet |
nānārūpopahāraiś ca saṃpūjya tu divaukasaḥ ||
datvā ca pustakaṃ tatra pitṝṇāṃ dharmam uddiśet |
bāndhavānāṃ ca hṛdyānām anantaphalam icchayā ||
tato datvā vidhānena tāṃ vidyāṃ śivamandire |
tataś ca bhakṣayed viprān rudrabhaktāṃś ca mānavān ||
yathāśakti ca kartavyā utsavāḥ sveṣu veśmasu |
rājñā tu nagare kāryā grāme grāmādhipais tathā ||
gṛhe gṛhasthaiḥ kartavya utsavo bandhubhiḥ saha |
snātaiḥ śuklaiḥ samālabdhaiḥ sragvibhiḥ susamāhitaiḥ ||
prītiyuktais tataḥ śrāvyaṃ śāstraṃ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ |
vācakaṃ dakṣayet tatra yathāvibhavavistṛtaḥ ||
guruṃ ca bhaktyā matimān yathāśakti hy amāyayā |
tataḥ puṣpaiś ca dhūpaiś ca śrāvakān saṃprapūjayet ||
yācako brāhmaṇaḥ prājñaḥ śrutaśāstro mahāmanāḥ |
abhyastākṣaravinyāso vṛttaśāstraviśāradaḥ ||
śabdārthavit pragalbhaś ca vinīto medhayā punaḥ |
gītajño vākyasuśrāvyaḥ svaronāvilabhāṣakaḥ ||
guruś ca dharmavān prājñaḥ śrutaśāstro vimatsaraḥ |
vipraḥ prakṛtisaṃśuddhaḥ śuciḥ smitamukhaḥ sadā ||
suvṛtto vṛttaśāstrajñaḥ śabdaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
[552]        abhyastaśāstrasaṃdohaḥ prakṛtārthapravartakaḥ ||
prastutārthābhidhāyinā prakramakṛtavyākhyāpaurvāparyārthaviṣṭambhī |
adhyāyasargavicchedavibhaktyarthaprayojakaḥ |
śāstrārthapadavid dhīmān padaślokārthabodhakaḥ ||
samudāyaprakīrṇārthamukhyaśāstrānuṣaṅgajam |
anakṣaraṃ ca hṛdvastuvyapadiśyārthabodhakaḥ ||
prakrāntādiś ca śāstrārthavibhāgapariniṣṭhitaḥ |
kaṣṭhābhimānagūḍhārthabhaṅgena ca virodhakaḥ ||
śraddheyavāg anālasyaḥ śrotṛvṛttaprabodhakaḥ |
saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtāṃ vidyāṃ prākṛtaiḥ prākṛtām api ||
ālāpamātrair vyākhyānair yaś ca śiṣyān prabodhayet |
daśābhidhānavinyāsair bodhayec cāpi yo guruḥ ||
sa guruḥ sa pitā mātā sa tu cintāmaṇiḥ smṛtaḥ |
yaḥ śāstropāyam ākhyāya narakebhyaḥ samuddharet ||
kas tena sadṛśo loke bāndhavo bhuvi vidyate |
yasya vāgraśmivṛndena hṛdayān mathyate tamaḥ ||
mahāsaṃsārarajanībhavaṃ so ‘rko mahādyutiḥ |
noddhatenāsya pāruṣyena ca vailomyam āvahet ||
na cāsya vyādhiduḥkheṣu maleṣv aprītikṛd bhavet |
prasādayet tu kupitaṃ duḥkhamagnaṃ samuddharet (?) ||
[553]        rogebhyaś cāpi yatnena paritrāṇena coddharet |
evaṃ vyākhyāṃ subhāṃ śrutvā guruvaktrān narottamaḥ ||
vidheyaṃ cintayed yas tu paratra hitakāraṇāt |
śṛṇuyāt śraddhayā yuktaḥ prayato ‘bhimukho guroḥ ||
ananyasatkathākṣepī niṣpramādo hy atandritaḥ |
mṛduś ca saṃśaye jāte pṛcched vākyam udīrayet ||
guruṇā coktam ekānte śraddhāvān vākyam āśrayet |
etat kṛtaṃ svayaṃ kuryāt sasamiddhyañjalānvitaḥ (?) ||
etat kṛtaṃ guruceṣṭitam |
aprastutakathākṣepaṃ yaḥ kuryād agrato guroḥ |
sa brahmahatyām āpnoti guruvākyeṣv aniścayaḥ ||
yaś ca śrutvānyataḥ śāstraṃ saṃskāraṃ cāpya vāśubham |
anyasya janayet kīrtiṃ sa guror brahmahā bhavet ||
vismārayec ca vyāmohād yo ‘pi śāstrārtham uttamam |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram akṣayaṃ bhīmadarśanam ||
yas tu buddhvā naraḥ śāstraṃ kiṃcit kuryāt śubhāśubham |
bhavec chataguṇaṃ tad vai vijñānebhyo ratasya ca ||
evaṃ vidhānato vācyaṃ vācakena vipaścitā |
tapaḥ samātmakaṃ sarvaṃ svargādiphalasādhakam ||
śanair vibodhya vai vācyam adhyātmādi ca yad bhavet |
kruddhoktiyuddhasaṃkṣobhaṃ dhārāvartena vācayet ||
[554] dhārāvartena vegena |
sarāgaṃ lalitair vākyair vācayed baddhasaṃgame |
nānāvṛttānurūpeṇa lālityena ca vācayet ||
sargādhyāye samāpte ca kathāparyanta eva vā |
praśabdaśabdasaṃyoge kuryād iti virāmaṇam ||
samāpte vācake bhīṣma brūyād evaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
avadhārya jagacchāntim ante śāntyudakaṃ sṛjet ||
suśrutaṃ suśrutaṃ brūyād astu vākyātam [vyākhyātam?] ity adaḥ |
lokaḥ pravartatāṃ dharme rājāvāstu (?) sadā jayī ||
dharmavān dhanasaṃpanno guruś cātra nirāmayaḥ |
iti procya yathājātaṃ gantavyaṃ ca vibhāvitaḥ ||
śiṣyaiḥ parasparaṃ śāstraṃ cintanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
kathāvastuprasaṅgena nānāvyākhyānabhāvanaiḥ ||
yuktibhiś ca cared vyākhyāṃ cihnaiś cāpi svayaṃkṛtaiḥ |
evaṃ dine dine vyākhyāṃ śṛṇuyān niyato naraḥ ||
samagraśāstraśravaṇena puṃsaḥ
śraddhāpradhānaṃ bhavatīha cetaḥ |
rāgaṃ ca śāstrātmakam abhyupaiti
doṣāś ca nāśaṃ nimiṣeṇa yānti ||
yathā kathaṃcit śṛṇuyān na śāstram
aśraddhayāceṣṭitadharmasaṅgaḥ |
tataḥ samāptāv atha śāstrasarge
kathodaye cāpi vitītabuddhiḥ ||
[555]        śaktyārcayed dvādaśakalpam evaṃ
guruṃ ca bhaktyā pitṛvatrikārthī (?) ||
eṣa vidyāpradānasya pradhāno vidhir ucyate |
anenaiva vidhānena brāhmaṇaḥ śīlaśālini ||
prabodhayati dhīyukte yuktajñe vedavādini |
vinyaset tu śubhaṃ śāstraṃ mahāpuṇyajigīṣayā ||
dhanairṣyā vipulair dakṣair guruṃ kṛtvā sutarpitam |
adhyāpayec chubhān śiṣyān abhijānān sumedhasaḥ ||
evaṃ vidyāpradānaṃ tu sarvadānottamaṃ smṛtam |
sarvadā sarvavarṇānāṃ narakaplavam uttamam ||
anena vidhinā datvā vidyāṃ puṇyaparo naraḥ |
yat phalaṃ cāśvamedhānāṃ śatasya sukṛtasya ca ||
rājasūysahasrasya samyag iṣṭasya yat phalam |
tat phalaṃ labhate martyo vidyādānena bhāgyavān ||
sarvasasyasusaṃpūrṇo sarvaratnopaśobhitām |
brāhmaṇebhyo mahīṃ datvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
yat phalaṃ labhate martyo vidyādānena tat phalam |
yāvad akṣarasaṃkhyānaṃ vidyate śāstrasaṃśraye ||
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi svarge vidyāprado bhavet |
yāvantyaḥ paṅktayas tatra pustake kṣarasaṃśritāḥ ||
yāvac ca patrasaṃkhyānaṃ pustake vidyate śubham |
tāvad yugasahasrāṇi sakulo modate divi ||
tāvato narakāt kuryān uddhṛtya nayate divi |
[556]        yāvac ca pātakaṃ tena kṛtaṃ janmaśatair api ||
tat sarvaṃ naśyate tasya vidyādānena dehinaḥ |
sa jāto manujo loke sa dhanyaḥ sa ca kīrtimān ||
yo vidyādānasaṃparkaprasaktaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
yathāvibhavato dadyād vidyāṃ śāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
yāti puṇyatamān lokān akṣayān bhogabhūṣitān ||
vahnipurāṇe |
ambarīṣa uvāca |
gavāṃ subahudhā dānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tathā mune |
brahmāṇḍādīni sarvāṇi kathitāni tvayā mama ||
idnīṃ śrotum icchāmi vidyādānaphalaṃ mahat |
vidhivad vividhaṃ tadvat kathayasva mahāmune ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
vidyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathātathyaṃ tavādhunā |
yathā deyaṃ phalaṃ yac ca tat śṛṇuṣva nṛpottama ||
śubhe ‘hni śubhanakṣatre maṇḍapaṃ śubhavedikam |
caturasraṃ vitānaṃ vā kṛtvā tatropalepayet ||
gomayenopalipte tu puṣpaprakaraśobhite |
tatra nyasyāsanaṃ divyaṃ divyagandhādhivāsitam ||
saṃsthāpya pustakaṃ tatra dharmaśāstrasya dhīmataḥ |
brāhmaṇān vedasaṃpūrṇāṃś chandolakṣaṇapāragān ||
likhāpayitvā yatnena tatsamagraṃ śubhākṣaraiḥ |
[557]        candrasūryoparāge vā saṅkrāntyayanavāsare ||
puṇye ‘hni tat susaṃpūjya vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
ghṛtadhenvāyutaṃ ratnair dadyād guṇavate tataḥ ||
śāstrasadbhāvaviduṣe vācaketi priyaṃvade |
tac chāstraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nityaṃ janānāṃ nāśayaty agham ||
dātus tasmād bhaven nekaphalaṃ tac chṛṇu bhūpate |
yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vidhivad yajvanāṃ tathā ||
tat puṇyaṃ samavāpnoti vidhivac chāstradaḥ pumān ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
vidyādānavidhiṃ vakṣye yathātatvena te punaḥ |
dattena tat phalaṃ tasya dātur asya samāsataḥ ||
ukte samārabhet kāle nimnonnatavivarjite |
susame bhūpradeśe ca gomayenopalepayet ||
puṣpaprakarasaṃpanne gītavādyasamākule |
amalāṃ caturasrāṃ vā candanenaiva kārayet ||
pustakaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet |
sauvarṇalekhanī kāryā maṣībhāṇḍaṃ ca raupyakam ||
jayaśabdaṃ samudghoṣya ārabhel lekhakaḥ sudhīḥ |
vinītaś cāpramattaś ca śāstraniṣpattim ānayet ||
brāhmaṇasya suvṛttasya vācakasya vijalpataḥ |
anena vidhinā datvā dāturatnasya yat phalam ||
tat phalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ pustakaikapradāyakaḥ |
[558]        yat puṇyaṃ tīrthayātṝṇāṃ yat puṇyaṃ yajvanāṃ nṛṇām ||
tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ vidyādāne na saṃśayaḥ |
kapilānāṃ sahasreṇa samyag dattena yat phalam ||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti pustakaikapradānataḥ ||
athālpavittasya śraddhāvato vidyādānam abhidhīyate | tatra devīpurāṇe |
ātmavittānusāreṇa vidyādānaṃ karoti yaḥ |
asādhyaṃ phalam āpnoti āḍhyatulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
strī vānenaiva vidhinā vidyādānaphalaṃ labhet |
bhartrā caivānanujñātā vidhavā ca tam uddiśet ||
vidyārthine sadā dadyād vastrābhyaṅgaṃ ca bhojanam |
chatrikām udakaṃ dīpaṃ yasmāt tena vinā mahīm ||
lekhanīghaṭitaṃ tīkṣṇā maṣīpatraṃ tu lekhanīm |
datvā tu labhate vatsa vidyādānam anuttamam ||
pustakastaraṇaṃ datvā supramāṇaṃ suśobhanam |
vidyādānam avāpnoti sūtrabaddhaṃ ca buddhimān ||
yantrakaṃ tv āsanaṃ caiva daṇḍāsanam athāpi vā |
vidyāvācanaśīlāya dattaṃ bhavati rājyadam ||
añjanaṃ netrapādānāṃ dattaṃ vidyāparāyaṇe |
bhūmīr [bhūmīṃ?] gṛhaṃ ca kṣetraṃ ca svargarājyaphalapradam ||
yasya bhūmyāṃ sthito nityaṃ vidyādānaṃ pravartayet |
tasyāpi bhavati svargas tatprabhāvān na saṃśayaḥ ||
[559] nandīpurāṇe |
ye ‘pi patraṃ maṣīpātraṃ lekhanī saṃpuṭādikam |
laghuśāstrābhiyuktāya te ‘pi vidyāpradāyinām ||
yānti lokān śubhān martyāḥ puṇyabhājo narādhipa ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
vidyādānam avāpnoti pradānāt pustakasya ca |
śilpāni śikṣayed yas tu pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ||
śilpabhāṇḍapradāne ‘pi tad vidyādānajaṃ phalam |
ahiteṣu pravṛttasya tathā kṛtvā nivāraṇam ||
vidyādānaphalaṃ proktaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
pāpavṛttasya ca tathā datvā caiva parāṃ matim ||
vidyādānaphalaṃ prāpya svargaloke mahīyate |
yena jīvati bhāṇḍena tasmai tadbhāṇḍadāyakaḥ ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute ||
skandapurāṇe |
daridraḥ svānusāreṇa vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
kṛtvā vidhim imaṃ bhaktyā vidyādānaphalaṃ labhet ||
yasya yāvad bhaved vittaṃ sa tasyehānusāritaḥ |
nivedya sumahābhāgaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||
pustakāstaraṇaṃ datvā sahasraṃ tatpramāṇataḥ |
tad āsanaṃ vitānaṃ vā śivaloke mahīyate ||
[560]        yāvat tad vastrasūtrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyā samantataḥ |
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi mahābhogān avāpnuyāt ||
yaḥ śrīparṇasamudbhūtaṃ nimnakhātaṃ susaṃcayam |
dadyāt saṃpuṭakaṃ kṛtvā carmaṇā vāpi nirmitam ||
śivajñānābhiyuktāya tadadhyayanahetunā |
suślakṣṇaṃ phalakaṃ vāpi vidyādānaphalaṃ labhet ||
yaḥ sauvarṇaṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam |
sapidhānasumañjūṣaṃ vidyākośasamāśrayam ||
kārayed vāpi raupyeṇa tāmreṇa caturasrakam |
kāṃsyārakūṭalohaṃ vā dāruvaṃśādinirmitam ||
sukaṣāyātiraktena varmaṇābhinavena ca |
antar bahiś ca maṭhayed vidyādānanavaṃ gṛham ||
sudṛḍhaṃ kaṭakopetaṃ dṛḍhastambhanivedanam |
kuryāt tālakasaṃyuktaṃ vidyāratnakaraṇḍakam ||
evaṃ vittānusāreṇa kārayitvā tu taṃ nṛpa |
vidyāsiṃhāsanaṃ tatra saṃpūjya vidhivad budhaḥ ||
tasmin puṇyāhaśabdena vidyākośagṛhaṃ nyaset |
evaṃ yaḥ śivavidyāyāḥ kuryād āyatanaṃ śubham ||
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvair vidyādānaphalaṃ labhet |
vidyāmaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā vidyāvyākhyānamaṇḍape ||
tatrābhyarcya śivāṃ vidyāṃ tadvyākhyāṃ śṛṇuyāt tataḥ |
so ‘pi yāti śivasthānaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam ||
anena vidhinā jñānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti pravakti ca |
[561]        sa saṃprāpya śriyaṃ saukhyaṃ dehānte muktim āpnuyāt ||
nandipurāṇe |
iti vidyāpradānasya mahābhāgyaṃ prakīrtitam |
śrutvaitat pātakair mukhyair niyataṃ saptajanmajaiḥ ||
devīpurāṇe |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vidyā deyā sadā naraiḥ |
ihaiva kīrtim āpnoti mṛto yāti parāṃ gatim ||
yas tu devyā gṛhe nityaṃ vidyādānaṃ pravartayet |
sa bhavet sarvalokānāṃ pūjyaḥ pūjyapadaṃ vrajet ||
vārāhapurāṇe (?) |
brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā vidyādāne pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
dharmādharmaṃ na jānanti vidyādānabahiṣkṛtāḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vidyādānaṃ prayacchati |
caturyugāni rājendra ekasaptatiyāvatā ||
tāvad viṣṇupure rājan krīḍate kālam akṣayam |
kṣitiṃ cāgatya kālānte rājarājo bhaviṣyati ||
tretāyuge dharmaparo jāyate ca punaḥ punaḥ |
kule mahati jātaś ca sa rājā dhārmiko bhavet ||
hastyaśvarathadānānāṃ dātā bhoktā vimatsarī |
bhoktā puravarāṇāṃ ca deśānāṃ caiva koṭiśaḥ ||
[562]        rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyur nirujo bhavet |
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto jīvec ca śaradāṃ śatam ||
lekhake dakṣināṃ dadyād vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇam |
śaktaś ca vastrayugmaṃ ca dadyāc chāstrasamanvitam ||
likhāpayitvā tac chāstraṃ deyaṃ guṇavate sadā |
tapasvine dharmarate paripālanatatpare ||
vastrayugmena saṃvītaṃ pustakaṃ pratipādayet |
vācakaṃ pūjayec caiva vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
kṣamyatām iti vaktavyaṃ lekhakaḥ susamāhitaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena vidyādānāt phalaṃ labhet ||
vahnipurāṇe |
vājapeyasahasrasya samyag iṣṭasya yat phalam |
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti vidyādānān na saṃśayaḥ ||
tasmād devālaye nityaṃ dharmaśāstrasya vā śruteḥ |
paṭhanaṃ kārayed rājan yadīcched dharmam ātmanaḥ ||
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi śayanāny āsanāni ca |
pratyahaṃ tena dattāni bhavanti nṛpasattamaḥ ||
dharmādharmaṃ na jānāti loko ‘yaṃ vidyayā vinā |
tasmāt sadaiva dharmātman vidyādānarato bhavet ||
vedaśāstre rahasyānāṃ yadi naiva nṛpottama |
tato ‘jñānatamo’ndhasya kāvasthā jagato bhavet ||
brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve ṛṣayo dagdhakilbiṣāḥ |
[563]        manuṣyāḥ pitaraś caiva vidyādāne pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
caturyugānāṃ rājendra ekasaptatisaṃkhyayā |
vedaśāstrapradaḥ svarge pūjyate surasattamaḥ ||
sa tu kālād ihāgatya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
hastyaśvarathayānāḍhyo dātā bhoktā tv amatsarī ||
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyur nirujaḥ sukhī |
putrapautrair vṛtaḥ kālān mokṣaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
dānaṃ viśeṣaphaladaṃ jagatīha nānyad
vidyāṃ vihāya vadanābjakṛtādhivāsām |
gobhūhiraṇyagajavājirathādisarvaṃ
tad yacchatāṃ kim iti bhūpa bhaven na dattam ||
iti vidyādānavidhiḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe atidānaprakaraṇam
[564]
dānakhaṇḍam aṣṭamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha daśamahādānāny ucyante |
tat tādṛg vimalaṃ kulaṃ niravadhividyānavadyākṛtiḥ
sampatkampitadainyasainyanivahāmāduryadhuryāgiraḥ |
ity anyonyajigīṣayeva gurutāṃ yasmin bhajante guṇās
tenāyaṃ vidhir ucyate daśamahādāneṣu hemādriṇā ||
tatsaṃgrahaślokās tu kūrmapurāṇe |
kanakaṃ ca tilānāgādāsīrathamahīgṛhāḥ |
kanyā ca kapilā dhenur mahādānāni vai daśa ||
tatra prathamanirdiṣṭatayā suvarṇadānam eva tāvad ucyate | vahnipurāṇe |
rāma uvāca |
krodhād idaṃ mayā karma kṛtaṃ munivarottamāḥ |
kathaṃ tasmād vimucye ‘haṃ pāpāt prāṇivadhādikāt ||
ity uktāḥ dharmatatvajñāḥ pāpānāṃ pāvanaṃ param |
dānaṃ ceha suvarṇasya te tam ūcur maharṣayaḥ ||
[565]        etat pavitram atulaṃ saṃbhūtam iha suśruma |
śambhor bījaṃ paraṃ tejo apatyaṃ jātavedasaḥ ||
sahasraṃ kārtikeyasya rudraśukrasamudbhavam |
pavitratvāt suraiḥ sarvair dhāryate mukuṭādiṣu ||
agnis tu devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tadātmakam |
tasmāt suvarṇaṃ dadatā prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||
daśa pūrvān parāṃś caiva narakāt tārayanti te |
suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti provācedaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ||
sarvān kāmān prayacchanti ye prayacchanti kāñcanam |
marīcir bhagavān pūrvaṃ pitāmahasuto ‘bravīt ||
yaḥ suvarṇaṃ naro nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
sa ciraṃ virajā vidvān devavad divi modate ||
sarveṣām eva dānānām ekajanmānugaṃ phalam |
hāṭakakṣitigaurīṇāṃ saptajanmānugaṃ phalam ||
vidyādānaṃ suvarṇaṃ tu yo lobhān na prayacchati |
sa sīdati ca pāpena veṣṭito narakaṃ vrajet ||
kṛtvāpi sumahat pāpaṃ jātarūpaṃ dadāti yaḥ |
sa sadyas tena pāpena mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
etat kṛtvā tu śuddhyarthaṃ suvarṇaṃ dehi bhārgava |
ity ukto munibhis tais tu rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ||
prādāt suvarṇaṃ viprebhyas tataḥ pāpād vimucyate |
tasmāt tvam api rājendra dvijebhjyo dehi kāñcanam ||
viṣvaksenaṃ samuddiśya yadīcchec chāśvatīṃ gatim |
[566] brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā |
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca dānānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
himavadduhitā pūrvam umā nāma pativratā |
pūrvajanmani sā cāsīd dakṣasya tanayā satī ||
dakṣakopāc ca tatyāja satī cātmakalevaram |
himavadduhitā jajñe loke gaurīti viśrutā ||
dattā tenāpi sā tasmai praṇipatya pinākine |
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vidhivad duhitus tadā ||
vaivāhikena vidhinā juhāvāgniṃ pitāmahaḥ |
homaĕ ca kurvatas tasya vikārī manmathī bhavet ||
rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā devyā retaskannaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
padbhyāṃ ca mṛditaṃ tena bahudhā samapadyate ||
tatrotpannā mahātmāno vālakhilyā marīcayaḥ |
agnau ca śeṣam apatac cābhūd vānalaprabham ||
jājvalyamānaṃ dīptyā dṛṣṭvā putraṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
jagṛhuḥ śirasā caiva puṇyatvāt te puṭānvitāḥ ||
ūcuś ca devagandharvā munayaś ca yatavratāḥ |
vibhūṣaṇaṃ ca te devā iṣṭāpūrtaṃ vibhāvasoḥ ||
devapatnyas tathā caitad bhūṣaṇeṣu nyayojayan |
evaṃ suvarṇam utpannam āgneyaṃ brāhmam eva ca ||
[567]        pavitram aparaṃ loke suvarṇena samaṃ kvacit |
na vidyate dravyajātaṃ dānaṃ vā bhūṣaṇaṃ tathā ||
atrāha bṛhaspatiḥ |
gṛhādike puṇyaphalaṃ bhaven mūlyānusārataḥ |
tasmāt sarvapradānānāṃ hiraṇyam adhikaṃ smṛtam ||
yathā sāntanikādīnāṃ hemnā saṃpadyate kriyā |
tathā na gṛhadānena hiraṇyam adhikaṃ tataḥ ||
vedavyāsaḥ |
sarvān kāmān prayacchanti ye prayacchanti kāñcanam |
etad dhi bhagavān atriḥ pitāmahasuto ‘bravīt ||
pavitram atha vā puṇyaṃ pitṝṇām akṣayaṃ ca yat |
suvarṇaṃ manujendreṇa manunā saṃprakīrtitam ||
manuḥ |
bhūmidaḥ sarvam āpnoti dīrgham āyur hiraṇyadaḥ |
saṃvartaḥ |
hiraṇyado mahāvṛddhiṃ dīrgham āyuś ca vindati |
viṣṇuḥ |

bṛhaspatiḥ |

viśvāmitraḥ |
