devīpurāṇe |

vasiṣṭhaḥ |
tasmād agnimukhāḥ sarvadevatā iti śuśrumaḥ |

suvarṇam ity anuvṛttau kālikāpurāṇe |
pūtam etat paraṃ puṇyaṃ purā kāyeṣu nityaśaḥ |
dhārayanti yataḥ sarve maṅgalārtham arogataḥ ||
ataḥ pāpāni sarvāṇi pātrebhyo vidhipūrvakam |
dattaṃ punāti kāle ca deśe ca harasaṃnidhau ||
śrūyatāṃ yena rāmeṇa vidhinā prāk tapodhana |
pradattaṃ kāñcanaṃ pūrvaṃ raicīkyena mahātmanā ||
sarvahemamayaṃ yajñam iṣṭvā viprāḥ pratarpitāḥ |
hemair ābharaṇaiḥ pūjya dattaṃ phalaśataṃ tathā ||
bhūya evaṃ tulāntena svayam āropya yatnataḥ |
hemadvitīyapārśve ca dvijātibhyo dadau svayam ||
bhūyo ‘pi tanmayāny eva sūryapātrāṇi tena ca |
[569]        prabhāṣādiṣu tīrtheṣu brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tadā ||
gavāṃ ca daśavarṇānāṃ viprakṛtvā pṛthak pṛthak |
sahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ ca savatsānāṃ surūpiṇām ||
baddhvā kambalam ākramya palāny ekādaśaiva tu |
ekaikasya pṛthaktvena dattaṃ hemaṃ tu tena vai ||
kārayitvā sapadmāni jātarūpamayāni ca |
bhramatā tīrthaliṅgānāṃ mūrdhni dattāni te nava ||
tanmayābharaṇaiḥ pūjya śataśo ‘tha sahasraśaḥ |
saṃpūjya tarpitā viprā bhūyas tenaiva mānada ||
padmāś caiva patākāś ca mālāś caiva viśeṣataḥ |
rudrādīnāṃ niyuktāś ca kārayitvā gṛhe gṛhe ||
upavītaṃ ca yaṣṭiś ca mekhalāpāduke tathā |
lekhanīṃ maṣīpātraṃ ca datvā vipreṣu tena vai ||
mānasopaskaraṃ kṛtsnam āsanaṃ dhānatanmayam [?} |
dvijebhyaś caiva dattāni kārayitvā sahasraśaḥ ||
grahāṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtvā rūpāṇi bhūriśaḥ |
nyastāni vidhivat pūjya dvijānāṃ caiva mandire ||
kāñcanīṃ rodasīṃ pṛṣṭvā nagodadhisamanvitām |
puṇyauṣadhivanair yuktāṃ dadau viprebhya eva saḥ ||
evamādyair anekaiś ca prakāraiḥ kanakaṃ purā |
pāpāpanuttaye dattaṃ pātram āsādya bhūyaśaḥ ||
śrīmahābhārate piṇdadānaparituṣṭasvapnadṛṣṭasvapitṛdattopadeśa[570]kathane yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prati bhīmavākyāni |
vedopaniṣade caiva sarvakarmasu dakṣiṇā |
sarvakratuṣu coddiśya bhūmir gāvo ‘tha kāñcanam ||
tataḥ śrutis tu paramā suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇeti vai |
tad idaṃ samyag ārabdhaṃ tvayādya bharatarṣabha ||
kiṃ tu bhūmer gavāś cārthe suvarṇaṃ dīyatām iti |
evaṃ vayaṃ ca dharmajña sarve cāsmatpitāmahāḥ ||
tāritā vai tariṣyanti pāvanaṃ paramaṃ hi tat |
daśa pūrvān daśaivānyāṃs tathā tān tārayanti te ||
suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchantīty evaṃ māṃ pitaro ‘bruvan |
rāmaṃ prati vasiṣṭhavākyāni |
sarvaratnāni nirmathya tejorāśisamanvitam |
suvarṇam ebhyo viprendra ratnaṃ paramam uttamam ||
etasmāt kāraṇād devā gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ |
manuṣyāś ca piśācāś ca prayatā dhārayanti tat ||
mukuṭair aṅgadayutair alaṃkāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
suvarṇavidhṛtair atra virājante bhṛgūttama ||
tasmāt sarvapavitrebhyaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam |
pṛthivīgāṃ ca datvāhaṃ tathānyad api kiṃcana ||
viśiṣyate suvarṇasya dānaṃ paramakaṃ vibho |
akṣayaṃ pāvanaṃ caiva suvarṇam anurājate ||
prayaccha dvijamukhyebhyaḥ pāvanaṃ hy etad uttamam (?) |
[571]        suvarṇam eva sarvatra dakṣiṇāsu vidhīyate ||
suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti sarvadāste bhavanty uta ||
nandipurāṇe |
kṛṣṇalāḥ pañcamāṣās tu māṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ smṛtam |
suvarṇam ekaṃ taddānānd dātā svargam avāpnuyāt ||
tathā |
tasmāt sa sarvathā pātre dadyāt kanakadakṣiṇām |
apātre pātayed dattaṃ suvarṇaṃ narakārṇave ||
pramādatas tu tan naṣṭaṃ tāvanmātraṃ niyojayet |
anyathā steyayuktaḥ syād dhemny adatte vināśini ||
dānārtham eva tat sṛṣṭaṃ hy akliṣṭaṃ svargasādhanam |
dānāt paraṃ suvarṇasya vidhir eva na vidyate ||
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā |
etat pavitraṃ paramam etat svastyayanaṃ mahat ||
daśa pūrvān parān vaṃśān ātmānaṃ ca viśāṃpati |
api pāpaśataṃ kṛtvā datvā vipreṣu tārayet ||
suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti narāḥ śuddhena cetasā |
devatās tena saṃdehaḥ samas tā iti naḥ śrutam ||
agnir hi devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca hutāśanam |
tasmāt suvarṇaṃ dadatā dattāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||
agnyabhāve ca kurvanti vahnisthāneṣu kāñcanam |
sarvavedaḥ pramāṇajñāḥ śrutiśāstranidarśanāt ||
ye tv enaṃ jvālayitvāgnim ādityodayanaṃ prati |
[572]        dadyur vai vratam uddiśya sarvakāmān avāpnuyuḥ ||
vratam uddiśya vratam anusaṃdhāyety arthaḥ |
suvarṇadaḥ svargaloke kākān iṣṭān samaśnute |
virājovarasaṃvītaḥ pariyāti yatas tataḥ ||
vimānenārkavarṇena bhāsvareṇa virājitaḥ |
apsarogaṇakīrṇena bhāsvanā svena tejasā ||
haṃsavahiṇayuktena vimānena narottama |
divyagandhavahaḥ svarge parigacchann itas tataḥ ||
tasmāt svaśaktyā dātavyaṃ kāñcanaṃ mānavair bhuvi |
nātaḥ parataraṃ loke sadyaḥ pāpavimocanam ||
suvarṇasy atu śuddhasya svarṇaṃ yas tu prayacchati |
bahūny abdasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
skandapurāṇe |
suvarṇasya suvarṇasya sūvarṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
suvarṇadvitayaṃ datvā akṣayāṃ gatim āpnuyāt |
datvā suvarṇasya śataṃ dvijebhyaḥ śraddayānvitaḥ ||
brahmalokam anuprāpya brahmaṇā saha modate |
prathamaṃ suvarṇaśabdena hiraṇyam abhidhīyate, apareṇa tu tasyaiva śuddhavarṇatvaṃ pratipādyate, parimāṇaviśeṣaḥ tṛtīya iti | atra cāyaṃ dānavākyaprayogaḥ |
[573]
oṃ adya amukasmin deśe amukasmin kāle amukasagotrāya amukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya amukasagotraḥ amukaśarmā idaṃ suvarṇaṃ agnidaivatyam amukāya tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mama | oṃ amukasagotrāyetyādi etat suvarṇadānapratiṣṭhārtham idaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
suvarṇadāne rajataṃ dakṣiṇeti kecit | ayaṃ ca dānamantraḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hema bījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
anantaṃ puṇyaṃ phaladam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
palaikaṃ dviguṇaṃ vāpi triguṇaṃ śaktyanukramāt |
kanakaṃ syāt suvarṇena dvābhyāṃ tribhiḥ sadakṣiṇam ||
palād adho vā tat kuryād dakṣiṇā syād yathāruci |
vittādhikyāt palādhikyam iti nyāyanidarśanāt ||
iti suvarṇadāna vidhiḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
ādityodayasaṃprāpte vidhimantrapuraskṛtam |
dadāti kāñcanaṃ yo vai duḥsvapnaṃ pratihanti saḥ ||
dadāty uditamātre yas tasya pāpmā vilīyate |
madhyāhne dadate rukmaṃ hanti pāpam anāgatam ||
[574]        dadāti paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ yaḥ suvarṇaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ |
brahmavāyvagnisomānāṃ sālokyam upayāti saḥ ||
suvarṇam akṣayān datvā lokāṃś cāpnoti puṣkalān |
yas tu saṃjvalayitvāgnim āditodayanaṃ prati ||
dadyād vai vratam uddiśya sarvān kāmān samaśnute |
yaṃ devam arcayet tena yasya caiva prayacchati ||
tasya loke nivasati nityaṃ caiva dadāti yaḥ ||
vratam uddiśya vratam anusaṃdhāyety arthaḥ |
suvarṇadaḥ svargaloke kāmān iṣṭān samaśnute |
virajo varasaṃvītaḥ pariyāti yatas tataḥ ||
vimānenārkavarṇena bhāskareṇa virājitaḥ |
apsarogaṇakīrṇena bhāsvanā svena tejasā ||
haṃsabarhiṇayuktena kāmagena narottamaḥ |
divyagandhavahaḥ svarge parigacchann itas tataḥ ||
tasmāt svaśaktyā dātavyaṃ kāñcanaṃ mānavair bhuvi |
nātaḥ parataraṃ loke sadyaḥ pāpavimocanam ||
suvarṇasya tu śuddhasya suvarṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
bahūny. abdasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
iti nityasuvarṇadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇe |
hemadānam atho vakṣye yad bhūtaṃ retasā mama |
[575]        agnigarbhaṃ pavitraṃ ca āyur ārogyavardhanam ||
niṣkamātraṃ pavitraṃ vā tadardhaṃ pādam eva ca |
taṇḍulāḍhakasaṃpūrṇaṃ pātre pātrāntare nyaset ||
ardhāḍakatilaiḥ pūrṇaṃ tasyopari ghṛtānvitam |
tilārdhamānataḥ pātraṃ ghṛte tad dhema vinyaset ||
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau tattritayaṃ nyaset |
vipraṃ ca tad dhiraṇyaṃ ca śaṃbhuṃ smṛtvā prapūjayet ||
ātmacchāyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tilataṇḍulam eva ca |
vilokya dadyād viprāya śivaḥ saṃprīyatām iti ||
dadyād anena vidhinā nityaṃ māsy ayane ‘pi vā |
saṃvatsare cāmāvāsyāṃ matsāyujyaṃ paraṃ yataḥ ||
āyurārogyasaṃprītis tasmin kāle bhaviṣyati |
evaṃ suvarṇadānena nityaṃ dadyād anantakam ||
iti hemadānavidhiḥ |
kālikāpurāṇe |
athāyāsavinirmukto rudromākalitaṃ padam |
anena vidhinā dehī gadato yāni me śṛṇu ||
guñjān guñjārdhamātraṃ vā niyataḥ prativāsaram |
kanakaṃ nyasya liṅge tu vrajet tat padam uttamam ||
sarvasasyavatīṃ dadyād rodasīṃ vā jalānvitām |
rohiṇīṃ yo harāyaiva gacchet so ‘pi padaṃ ca tat ||
mahādānāni ca tathā pātrayuktāny asaṃśayaḥ |

agner apatyaṃ prathamaṃ suvarṇaṃ

brahmā uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito dānaṃ bravīmi tava nārada |
śatamānam iti proktaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ puṇyam ārogyaṃ santatipradam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ sarvaṃ sarvamāṅgalyakāraṇam ||
puṇyakāleṣu sarveṣu candrasūryagrahādiṣu |
[577]        nityaṃ vā kārayed dānaṃ janmarkṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
puṇyadeśeṣu sarveṣu gṛhe devālayādiṣu |
yatra sādhanasaṃpattis tatra dānaṃ samācaret ||
gavyena bhūmiṃ śakṛtā jalena
ālikhya madhye sitataṇḍulaiś ca |
saroruhaṃ kesarabhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ
sakarṇikaṃ cāṣṭadalaṃ vilekhya ||
tasmin hiraṇyaṃ śatamānamātraṃ
nidhāya tasyopari taṃ vicintya |
brahmāṇm īśaṃ kamalāsanastham
rārādhya gandhādibhir ādareṇa ||
priyaṃ tathā vedavidaṃ vicintya
viriñcibuddhyā tu samarcayitvā |
dadyāt suvarṇaṃ śatamānam asmai
saṃprīyatām ātmabhūr ity udīrya ||
yo ‘sau dānaṃ śatamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ
dadyād āyuḥ sarvam evaiti coktam |
ataḥ kuryān nāradaitat sakṛd vā
nityaṃ māsaṃ hāyanaṃ śaktito vā ||
jāmbūnadaṃ jātarūpaṃ suvarṇaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā |
hiraṇyaṃ ceti śaktyā tu kramād etāni nārada ||
iti śatamānadānavidhiḥ |

athāha baudhāyanaḥ |
śatamānam akṣayeṇa suvarṇena mitaṃ ca yat |
tat kāṃsye nikṣipet samyak tilāḍhakasamanvite ||

dānamantraḥ |
