tat prasīdākhilaṃ dānaṃ tat tvam ācakṣva me guro ||
brahmovāca |
ānando brahmaṇo rūpaṃ nityaṃ vedeṣu gīyate |
sarvāvāso vibhuḥ sākṣād ānandena vyavasthitaḥ ||
tasmād dānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ dehy ānandanidhiṃ param |
[580]        viprāyācyutarūpāya vardhayānandam uttamam |
dānenānena te śakra dhātutrayayutena ca ||
indra uvāca |
vidhānaṃ brūhi me brahman dānasyāsya mahānidheḥ |
yathā deyaṃ viśeṣeṇa viṣṇor ānandakārakam ||
brahmovāca |
puṇyāṃ tithiṃ prāpya tu paurṇamāsyāṃ
tathoparāge śaśisūryayor vā |
caturyugādiṣv ayanadvaye vā
prabodhane prasvapane ‘tha viṣṇoḥ ||
kuryād athaudumbaram eva kumbhaṃ
hiraṇyabhāreṇa yathātmaśaktyā |
tathā vidhānaṃ ca surājataṃ syād
dhiraṇyabhāreṇa na tu pūrayet tat ||
tadardhato ‘rdhena tadardhato vā
svaśaktitaḥ svarṇapalaiḥ śatena |
tadardham ardhena tu vittaśaktyā
palatrayād ardham api prakuryāt ||
tat tāmrabhāṇḍe kanakaṃ nidhāya
savajranīlotpalapadmarāgam |
samuktavaidūryasavidrumaṃ ca
tad rājataṃ pātram adhomukhaṃ syāt ||
[581]        evaṃ tu taṃ bhadranidhiṃ suvidvān
kṛtvāsane prāvaraṇopayukte |
kuśottare darpaṇacāmarāḍhya-
sapādukopānahachatrayuktam ||
tat kṣaumavastrottamayugmayuktaṃ
saṃpūjayen mantravarair athaitaiḥ |
ādau tu pañcāmṛtam ādyaviṣṇuṃ
saṃsnāpya saṃsāraharaṃ samarcya |
tatheśvaraṃ pāvakam eva hutvā
āmantrayed bhadranidhiṃ tatas tam ||
śrīkhaṇḍakarpūrasakuṅkumena
pañcākṣaraṃ nāma śriyaḥ pralikhya |
namas tathoṅkārayutaṃ ca pātre
tad rājate ‘py evam athārcayeta ||
tvayā samastāmarasiddhayakṣa-
vidyādharendroragakiṃnarendraiḥ |
gandharvavidhyādharadānavendrair
yutaṃ vṛtaṃ viśvam idaṃ namas te ||
samastasaṃsārakarī tvam eva
vibhoḥ sadānandamayī ca māyā |
samastakalyāṇanidhiḥ samādhiḥ
haripriye bhadradhir namas te ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena tato vipram athārcayet |
[582]        krīṭāṅgadaniṣkāgryakuṇḍalāṅgulibhūṣanaiḥ ||
alaṃkṛtya hariṃ yadvat pītāmbaradharaṃ tataḥ |
pūjayed acyutaṃ dhyātvā mantreṇānena bhaktimān ||
bhūdevo ‘sīty ato nityaṃ nityānandamayo hare |
hara me duṣkṛtaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛpākara namas tu te ||
bhūdeva bhagavad dharma bhavabhaṅgakareśvara |
bhavabhūtikaro jiṣṇo prabhaviṣṇu namo ‘stu te ||
evaṃ pūjya hṛdi dhyātvā taṃ dvijaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam |
tato bhadranidhiṃ dadyān mantreṇānena mānavaḥ ||
svagotroccāraṇenādau vapur nāma mahātmanaḥ |
yavadarbhatilaiḥ sārdham udakaṃ saṃparityajet ||
pitṛsaṃtāraṇārthāya nityānandavivṛddhaye |
sarvāghaughavināśāya viṣṇor dānaṃ mayā kṛtam ||
tad anena saratnena dhātutrayayutena ca |
sakṣaumāmbarayuktena sādarśapādukena ca ||
āsanena sachatreṇa cāmaropānahena ca |
sadānandavidhānena prīyatāṃ viṣṇur īśvaraḥ ||
evam uccārya taṃ dadyād dvijāya harirūpiṇe |
gopyena vidhinā dadyād dhemasaṃkhyā na kīrtayet ||
prakīrtite koṭiguṇāyutaṃ phalaṃ
pragopite kalpaguṇair na saṃśayaḥ |
itīdaṃ mānyāya (?) na kīrtayet sudhī
nidhāya madhye nihataṃ ca yad vasu ||
[583]        evaṃ kṛte syān manujaḥ kṛtātmā
tapennacā (?) syān maraṇaṃ kadācit |
prayāti viṣṇoḥ padam avyayaṃ tat
śivātmakānandamayaṃ sasaṃkhyā ||
iti bhadranidhidānavidhiḥ |
tasminn eva purāṇe |
garuḍa uvāca |
prabho prasīdācyuta viśvabhāvana
pratāpanityo ‘si surāritāpana |
prayaccha me praśnam ahaṃ karomi yat
mukunda tasyottaram uttamaṃ vibho ||
kathaṃ jagannātha jane nirantaraṃ
mahotsavī syād vijayī sukhī sadā |
susaṃpadānandapado ‘jaro ‘maro
nirāmayo yena śubhena taṃ vada ||
vibhus tathākarṇya vaco garutmataḥ
prasannarūpaḥ prativākyam āha tam |
suparṇa yat praṣṭum idaṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ
śṛṇuṣva tat sādhu na dānataḥ param ||
ihāpy amuṣminn api saṃbhṛto nidhiḥ
kvacin na kenāpi kadācid āpyate |
yugāyutaiḥ kalpaśatāyutair api
[584]                prabhuñjato dātur ahīna hīyate |
gatiṃ ca yāṃ yām api yāti dātā
yoniṃ tathāmutra tatheha vāpi ||
tāṃ tām anupraiti tu dattam ante
suśraddhayā yad dvijapuṅgavebhyaḥ |
tasmān nidhānaṃ śṛṇu sarvadānataḥ
prabhāvadaṃ nityaphalapradaṃ ca ||
aiśvaryadaṃ mokṣadam akṣayaṃ yad
dātus trayobhūtam anekaratnam ||
kārayet kārtikānte vā māghyāṃ vā mādhave ‘pi vā |
ayane viṣuve vāpi manvādiṣu yugādiṣu ||
candrasūryoparāge vā svaśaktyodumbaraṃ ghaṭam |
pidhānaṃ rājataṃ tadvat madhye sauvarṇam utsṛjet ||
nānāratnavarāpūrṇaṃ nānānānābhir āvṛtam |
hemarājatatāmrotthaiḥ savittair api pūraitam ||
nānānānaśatām ūrdhvam ayutād api śaktitaḥ |
eko nānāśabdo bahuprakāravacanaḥ, dvitīyaṃ nāneti mahārāṣṭrabhāṣāyāṃ nāṇakaṃ | tataś ca nānārūpanāṇakaiḥ pūrayed ity arthaḥ |
śaktyā palasahasreṇa śatenārdhaśatena vā |
tadardhārdhena vā rājan palād dhīnaṃ na kārayet ||
kāryaṃ tadvijitaṃ hemnā vitaśāṭhyam akurvatā |
rājatenātha tāmreṇa ratnair vyāvastrasaṃvṛtam ||
[585]        dhānyaṃ nānopari sthāpya kalpoktair arcayet padaiḥ |
paurāṇikaṃ puraskṛtya svayaṃ vā tadanujñayā ||
kṛtakriyo ‘gnisāṃnidhye viṣṇor īśasya vāṇḍaja |
imaṃ samuccaren mantraṃ kuśapāṇiḥ prasannadhīḥ ||
oṃ namaḥ sarvadānandasarvasaṃpattivardhana |
vardhayāsmān samṛddhyeha āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ||
namas te ‘nantasantāna sadānanda sadodaya |
sadoditaṃ kuruṣveha santatyā māṃ dhanāyuṣā ||
namo namaḥ padmanidhe dhaneśa
śatakrato śaṃkara nairṛteśa |
śamannayāsmadduritaṃ duriṣṭam
abhīṣṭado me bhava śaṃkareśa ||
namo namaḥ pāśadharāprameya
namo ‘stu rāmāya sunāmadheya |
namaḥ samīrāya hutāśanāya
namo ‘stv anantāya kajāsanāya ||
namaḥ sureśreṣṭha harīśvarāya
namo ‘stu sāvitri śive śriyeti |
sarasvati prītiratikriyeti
satuṣṭiḥpuṣṭismṛtiśāntikīrte ||
sarvāmarāṇāṃ nidhir aprameya
tvam eva pitṛmunirīśvarāṇām |
[586]        ādhārabhūto ‘si carācarasya
viśvasya yasmāt praṇato hy atas tvām ||
namo ‘stu saundaryanidhiḥ surendraḥ
namo ‘stu gāmbhīryanidheḥ samudra |
namo namaḥ kāntinidhāna indos
tejonidhe tvāṃ praṇato ‘smi bhāno ||
namaḥ padmāya bhadrāya namas te svastikāya ca |
namaḥ śaṅkhāya maṇaye maṇibhadrāya te namaḥ ||
namo nandivivartāya nandāvartāya vartine |
namaḥ kaṭakakarṇāya kaṇṭhāvartāye te namaḥ ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena nityānandanidhiṃ sudhīḥ |
sasiddhārthadūrvābhiḥ sakuśākṣatacandanaiḥ ||
tilalājaiḥ samaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūmāv udakam utsṛjet |
mantreṇānena vidhivat kalpoktena khageśvara ||
adyeha puṇyakāle ‘smin dvijadevāgnisaṃnidhau |
yaśaḥśreyo’bhivṛddhyarthe mātāpitros tathātmanaḥ ||
purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsāvedavādibhya eva ca |
namo vidyāvidhāyibhyo nānāgotrebhya eva ca ||
viprebhyo ‘nekaśarmabhyo nityānandakaraṃ param |
[587]        ahaṃ saṃpradade tebhyo nānānānāvṛtena ca ||
sasvarṇaraupyatāmreṇa saratnena savāsasā |
sopaskareṇa puruṣo brahmaviṣnuśivātmakaḥ ||
prīyatāṃ nidhidānena śrīyajñapuruṣo ‘cyutaḥ |
evam utsṛjya udakaṃ viprebhyaḥ pratipādayet ||
saṃvibhajya yathāśāstraṃ na kaṃcid apamānayet |
mahādānam idaṃ yasmāt tasmād eko ‘pi nārhati ||
athānye kecid icchanti samastavidhipāragāḥ |
yajñadānavratānāṃ vā so ‘py eko ‘rhati tadgṛhe ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute dānaṃ nityānandanidheḥ param |
evaṃ saṃpadam āpnoti sa saṃsāre nirantaram ||
dānānām apy aśeṣāṇām anantaphalam ucyate |
nityānandavidhānasya pradānād apavargabhāk ||
yaś caivaṃ sakṛd atraiva sadānandavidhānakṛt |
sa karoty asakṛd rājyam akṣaye vedhasaḥ pade ||
yathā kathaṃcid atreti svakarmaguṇasaṃkṣayaḥ |
tadākhilamahīrājyaṃ prāpnoti vratasaṃjñake ||
punaḥ svadharmasaṃyukto rājyaṃ kṛtvā sahānugaḥ |
prāpnoti padam aiśānaṃ nityam akṣayam avyayam ||
tasmād etya punā rājyaṃ labhet vaidyādhare pade |
ākalpam apy analpaśrīḥ śrīnidhānapradānataḥ ||
[588]        punaḥ prayāti kalpānte vaiṣṇavaṃ padam avyayam |
gatāpi yogino yatra prāpnuvanti punaḥ param ||
etad bhadranidhānākhyam ākhyātaṃ vainateya te |
mayā prītyā prayatnena kim anyat kathayāmi te ||
nityānandanidher dānān nityānando ‘bhijāyate |
yaḥ kuryāt so ‘cyutāyuḥ syād dīrghasantānam āpnuyāt ||
yas tu saṃkīrtayed bhaktyā yaḥ śṛṇōti samāhitaḥ |
sa dīrgham āyur āpnoti mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
imaṃ khagendra gaditaṃ dayitaṃ sahatāṃ
tava mayādbhutatamaṃ śamanaṃ tv adhasām |
sulabham avāpya kāñcanamihācarate
padam upaiti caiṣṇavam aho sulabham ||
ity ānandanidhidānavidhiḥ |
atha skandapurāṇe |
yaḥ prayacchati viprāya rajataṃ vāpi nirmalam |
sa vidhūyāśu pāpāni svargaloke mahīyate ||
rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān iha loke sa jāyate |
matsyapurāṇe |
pitṝṇāṃ rājataṃ pātram atha vā rajatānvitam |
śivanetrodbhavaṃ yasmāt tasmāt tatpitṛvallabham ||
[589]        amaṅgalaṃ ca yajñeṣu devakārye ca varjitam |
rajataṃ dakṣiṇām āhuḥ pitṛkāryeṣu sarvadā ||
iti rajatadānavidhiḥ |
athāśvadānavidhiḥ | tatra skandapurāṇe |
aśvaṃ yas tu prayacched vai hemacitraṃ sulakṣaṇam |
sa tena karmaṇā devi gāndharvaṃ lokam aśnute ||
mahābhārate |
sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ yuvānaṃ doṣavarjitam |
yo ‘śvaṃ dadāti viprāya svargaloke mahīyate ||
tathā |
yāvanti romāṇi haye bhavanti hi nareśvara |
tāvanto vājidā lokān prāpnuvantīha puṣkalān ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
aśvaṃ vā yadi vā yugmaṃ śobhane vātha pāduke |
dadāti yaḥ pradānaṃ vai brāhmaṇebhyaḥ susaṃyataḥ ||
tasya divyāni yānāni rathā dhvajapatākinaḥ |
duṣṭaḥ panthā na caiveha bhaviṣyati kadācana ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
aśvaṃ tanmūlyam atha vā kanīyo madhyamottamam |
dadyād vittānusāreṇa tārāgaṇaparicchadam ||
tārāgaṇa iti tārānukāryaśvālaṃkāraviśeṣaḥ |
śaphaiḥ pañcapalai raupyaiḥ suvarṇālaṃkṛtaṃ kramāt |
[590]        sadakṣiṇaṃ savastraṃ ca brāhmaṇāyāgnihotriṇe ||
svarsadaḥ prāpnuyāt svargam aśvasālokyam aśvadaḥ |
śraddhā deśaś ca kālaś ca sarvadāneṣu śasyate ||
dānamantras tu matsyapurāṇe |
uccaiḥśrvās tvam aśvānāṃ rājñāṃ vijayakārakaḥ |
sūryavāhaṃ namas tubhyam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
kanīyastvāditraividhyaṃ suvarṇadānavad avadheyam |
ity aśvadānam |
gāruḍapurāṇe |
brahmahatyādipāpāni upapāpāni yāni ca |
tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti hayamedhena niścitam ||
na kalau kriyate yajño hy aśvamedho ‘pi gosavaḥ |
naramedho ‘kṣatā nārī devarāt putrasantatiḥ ||
garhitaṃ saptakaṃ hy etad rājasūyaṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ |
aśvamedhamakhaṃ yas tu kalau kartum anīśvaraḥ ||
aśvadānaṃ tu teneha kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam |
vidhiṃ tasya pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā ||
śvetam aśvaṃ śubhaṃ snātaṃ hemaparyāṇabhūṣitam |
raupyais tu kaṭakaiḥ śuddhaiḥ karidantopaśobhitam ||
vajranetraṃ kurais tāmraiḥ kṣaumapucchaṃ suvāsasam |
śubhreṇa paṭakenaiva saṃvṛtaṃ svāyadhānvitam [svadhyāyānvitam ?] ||
[591]        dhānyaratnoparisthaṃ tu baddhakakṣaṃ supaṭṭakam |
evaṃ sutejasaṃ cāśvaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
surūpāya suvṛttāya viduṣe ca subuddhaye |
dātavyo mantramukhyāya dātavyo bhāṣkarāya ca ||
manvādau ca yugādau ca ayane viṣuve tathā |
candrasūryagrahe caivam aśvaṃ datvā sukhī bhavet ||
atha pūjāmantraḥ |
mārtaṇḍāya suvegāya kāśyapāya trimūrtaye |
jagaddvijāya sūryāya trivedāya namas tu te ||
atra amukasagotrāyetyādi imaṃ aśvaṃ suvarṇantikālaṃkṛtaṃ lalāṭaṃ graiveyakasuparyāṇānvitaṃ gandhapuṣpādyalaṅkṛtaṃ raupyakaṭakaratnopaśobhitaṃ vajranetraṃ tāmrakhuraṃ kṣaumapucchaṃ suvāsasaṃ śubhrapaṭṭakasaṃvṛtaṃ svāyudhānvitaṃ dhānyaratnoparisthitaṃ baddhakakṣaṃ supaṭṭakaṃ svargakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade amukagotrāyetyādi etad aśvadānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dakṣiṇām idaṃ suvarṇaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade |
evaṃ samuccaren mantraṃ karṇe dadyāt tilodakam |
mahārṇave samutpanne uccaiḥśravasaputraka ||
mayā tvaṃ vipramukhyāya datto haya sukhī bhava |
imaṃ vipra namas tubhyaṃ aśvaṃ te pratipāditam ||
pratigṛhṇīṣva viprendra mayā dattaṃ suśobhanam |
karṇe samarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā viprahaste jalaṃ kṣipet ||
paścād aśvapuro gacchet padānāṃ saptasaptatim |
[592]        bhāskaraṃ manasi dhyātvā ālokya svagṛhaṃ vrajet ||
śvetam aśvaṃ tu yo dadyāt phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet |
evaṃ kṛte naravyāghra sūryalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni tathānyāni bahūny api |
tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti datvā hy aśvaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
triṃśat pūrvāṃs triṃśad aparāṃs triṃśac caiva parāvarān |
samyak datvāśvadaḥ putro narakād uddharet pitṝn ||
nṛtyanti pitaraḥ svarge valanti ca hasanti ca |
vājipradaḥ kalau jātas tato vaimānikā vayam ||
vājipradena putreṇa uddhṛtā narakārṇavāt |
hayadānaphalaṃ hy etad yal lokā akṣayā nṛṇām ||
iti śvetāśvadānavidhiḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
durvāsā uvāca |
dānadharmās tvayā deva proktā vistarato mama |
aśvānāṃ caiva nāgānāṃ dānaṃ caiva divākara ||
bhānur uvāca |
tapaḥśīlaguṇopete pātre vedasya pārage |
subhage paripūrṇāṅge agnihotraparāyaṇe ||
paripūrṇāṅgam uditam udāsīnasamaprabham |
[593]        suvibhaktaṃ sukeśaṃ taṃ mukhakṣāmaṃ suśobhanam ||
sarvālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ divyasraganulepitam |
sarvopakaraṇair yuktaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||
danteṣu muktikās tasya pravālam adharoṣṭhayoḥ |
dadyād vajraṃ tu netrābhyāṃ vaidūryaṃ cāpy asaṃbhave ||
hemarūpyaṃ ca hastābhyāṃ tāmraṃ pādeṣu vinyaset |
aṇḍajair nāṇḍajair vyastair vicitraiḥ pariveṣṭayet ||
sugandhaiś caiva gandhaiś ca puṣpaiś cāpi vibhūṣayet |
vāhanādhipatiṃ śrīmān yatheṣṭaṃ vinivedayet ||
ādityābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet |
vividhair bhakṣyabhojyaiś ca baliṃ tatropakalpayet ||
bhojayet tatra viprāṃs tu sūryabhaktān viśeṣataḥ |
prīyatāṃ mihiro nityaṃ bhuktvā cotthāpayed dvijān ||
anena vidhinā kuryād aśvadānaṃ mahāmune |
yāvanti deharomāṇi tasya sūtiś ca yāvatī |
tāvad yugasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
ity aparo ‘śvadānavidhiḥ |
atha śivadharmāt |
śivāyāśvam alaṃkṛtya yaḥ parvaṇi nivedayet |
so ‘śvamedhasya yajñasya phalam aṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet ||
iti śivāśvadānavidhiḥ |
[594]
atha tiladānam ucyate |
ādityapurāṇe |
durvāsā uvāca
kathaṃ tilā samutpannāḥ kathaṃ ca avatāritāḥ |
evaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva chettum arhasy aśeṣataḥ ||
bhānur uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito vipra sarvaṃ vakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ |
purā kṛtayuge vipra pitaraḥ sarva āgatāḥ ||
tapaś caranti vipulaṃ tilārthe nātra saṃśayaḥ |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu nirāhārās tapasvinaḥ ||
tapaḥ kurvanti vipuraṃ tilārthe munisattamāḥ |
tadā parivṛtāḥ sarvair devaiś caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
prajāpatiḥ pitṛpatiḥ sākṣād eva pitāmahaḥ |
parituṣṭo ‘smi vo dadmi brūta yac ceṣṭitaṃ hi vaḥ ||
pitara ūcuḥ |
tilān dada mahābhāga kāṅkṣitān vai na saṃśayaḥ |
tilair vinā na jīvāmo nātilas tiṣṭhate divi ||
pitāmaha uvāca |
gacchadhvaṃ vai tilā dattāḥ sarveṣāṃ vo dvijottamāḥ |
parituṣṭāś ca pitaras tilalābhāt prajāpate ||
[595]        tilān yas tu prayaccheta pitṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
agniṣṭomasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā tilān kṣaudreṇa saṃyutān |
yaḥ prayacched dvijāgrebhyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dharmarājāya ca tilān datvā caiveha mānavaḥ ||
yamalokaṃ na paśyanti brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tilān datvā paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
mādhe māsi tilān yas tu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ||
sarvasatvasamākīrṇaṃ narakaṃ na sa paśyati |
sarvakāmaiḥ sa yajate yas tilair yajate pitṝn ||
na cākāmena dātavyaṃ tilaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kathaṃcana |
maharṣeḥ kasyapasyaite gātrebhyaḥ prasṛtās tilāḥ ||
tato divyaṅgatābhāvaṃ pradāneṣu tilāḥ prabhoḥ |
pauṣṭikā rūpakāṃ caiva tathā pāpavināśanāḥ ||
tasmāt sarvapradānebhyas tiladānaṃ viśiṣyate |
āpastambaś ca medhāvī śaṅkhaś ca likhitas tathā ||
maharṣir gautamaś cāpi tiladāne sadā ratāḥ |
tilahomaratā viprāḥ sarve saṃyatamaithunāḥ ||
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
akṣayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ tiladānam ihocyate ||
[596]        tilāḥ pavitram atulaṃ pravadanti maharṣayaḥ |
pradāne yat phalaṃ teṣāṃ tan me brūhi pitāmaha ||
bhīṣma uvāca |
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ tad dhi pavitraṃ svargam eva ca ||
matsyapurāṇe |
viṣṇor dehasamudbhūtāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇatilās tathā |
dharmasya rakṣaṇāyālam etat prāhur divaukasaḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
maharṣeḥ kasyapasyaite gātrebhyaḥ prasṛtāḥ purā |
te ca divyaṃ gatā bhāvaṃ pradāneṣu tilāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tilā bhakṣayitavyāś ca hotavyāś ca vidhānataḥ |
viprebhyaś ca pradātavyāḥ śreyaskāmair narair iha ||
saṃvartaḥ |
nitye naimittke kāmye tilān datvā svaśaktitaḥ |
prajāvān putravān nityaṃ dhanavān jāyate naraḥ ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
nityaṃ dātā tilānāṃ ca naraḥ svarge mahīyate |
mahābhārate |
[597]        dadato juhvataś caiva harataḥ pratigṛhṇataḥ |
tile tile tiladroṇasauvarṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam |
brāhmaṇasya ca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ ||
madhyadeśe mahāgrāmo brāhmaṇānāṃ babhūva ha |
gaṅgāyamunayor madhye yāmunasya girer adhaḥ ||
vidvāṃsas tatra bhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇāś cāvasan sadā |
atha prāha yamaḥ kaścit puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam ||
rakākṣam ūrdhvaromāṇaṃ kālajaṅghākṣināsikam |
gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ grāmaṃ gatvā brāhmaṇam ānaya ||
agastigotraṃ taṃ vipraṃ nāmataś cāpi śālmalim |
same niviṣṭaṃ vidvāṃsam adhyāpakasamāvṛtam ||
sāmānyam ānayethās tvaṃ sagotraṃ tasya pārśvataḥ |
sa hi tādṛgguṇitvena tulyo ‘dhyayanajanmanā ||
ākṛtyā ca tathā vṛttaiḥ samastenaiva dhīmatā |
tam ānaya yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūjā kāryā hitasya me ||
sa gatvā pratikūlaṃ tac cakāra yamaśāsanam |
tam ākṛṣyānayāmāsa pratiṣiddho ‘yaṃ me nayaḥ ||
tasmai yamaḥ samuthāya pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca dharmavit |
provāca nīyatām eṣa sabhām ānīyatām iti ||
evam ukte tu vacane dharmarājena sa dvijaḥ |
uvāca dharmarājaṃ taṃ niviṣṭo gamanena vai ||
yo me kālo bhavec cheṣas te vaseyaṃ tvayā saha |
[598]
yama uvāca |
gaccha vipra tvam adyaiva nilayaṃ tvaṃ mahāmune |
brūhi vādaṃ yathāsvairaṃ karavāṇi kimatyuta (?) ||
brāhmaṇa uvāca |
yat kṛtvā sumahat puṇyaṃ svarge syām brūhi tan mama |
sarvasya hi pramāṇaṃ tvaṃ dharmādharmaviniścaye ||
śṛṇu tattvena viprarṣe pradānavidhim uttamam |
tilāḥ paramakaṃ dānaṃ puṇyaṃ caiveha śāśvatam ||
tilāḥ pavitram atulaṃ pravadanti maharṣayaḥ |
tān prayacchasva viprebhyo vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca ayane cottarāyane |
tilā bhakṣayitavyāś ca sadātmālambhanaṃ ca taiḥ ||
kāryaṃ satatam adbhir vai śreyaḥ sarvātmanā gṛhe |
tilān śrāddhe praśaṃsanti dānam etad anuttamam ||
tilā nityaṃ pradātavyā yathāśakti dvijarṣabha |
nityadānāt sarvakāmaphalaṃ nirvartayet punaḥ ||
śṛṇu dharmarahasyaṃ ca yad adya kathayāmi te |
tilāḥ pavitram atulaṃ mā te ‘bhūd atra saṃśayaḥ ||
tilebhyaḥ prāpyate svargaḥ svargān mokṣas tathaiva ca |
viṣṇudharme |
tilā gāvo hiraṇyaṃ ca annaṃ kanyā vasundharā |
[599]        dattāny etāni vidhivat tārayanti mahābhayāt ||
tathā |
mularkṣage śaśadhare māghe māsi prajāpate |
ekādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ tu tilān datvā sarvapāpāt pramucyate |
tilodvartī tilasnāyī tilahomī tilodakī |
tiladātā ca bhoktā ca ṣaṭtilāḥ pāpanāśanāḥ ||
asakṛt ṣaṭtilī bhūtvā sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ |
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇājine tilān datvā suvarṇaṃ madhusarpiṣī |
droṇaikaṃ vāsasāchannaṃ tridhā tadvat sadakṣiṇām ||
tridheti hīnamadhamottamabhedena droṇaikaṃ droṇadvitayaṃ drōṇatritayaṃ ceti tadvat sadakṣiṇam iti kramād ekadvitrisuvarṇadakṣiṇāsahitam ity arthaḥ |
āhitāgnau dvije datvā sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam |
idaṃ cātra dānavākyam |
oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi evaṃ kṛṣṇājinasthitaṃ suvarṇaṃ madhusarpiryutaṃ vastrachannaṃ titadroṇaṃ [tiladroṇaṃ?] sarvapāpakṣayakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti | oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi etat tiladānapratiṣṭhārtham idaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
iti tiladānavidhiḥ |
[600]
tasminn eva purāṇe |
mṛgaṃ tilamayaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇarajatānvitam |
dadyāt kambalasaṃstīrṇaṃ kṛṣṇamārgājinena vā ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhena vimānena divaṃ vrajet |
kālakṣayād ihāgatya rājarājo bhavet punaḥ ||
iti tilamṛgadānavidhiḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
tilapātrāṇi yo dadyād viprebhyaḥ śraddhyānvitaḥ |
amāvāsyāṃ samāsādya niyataḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
sa pitṝṃs tārayitvāśu narakān narapuṅgava |
pitṛlokaṃ samāpnoti sa ciraṃ sukham aśṇute ||
atriḥ |
tilapātraṃ tu saṃpūrṇaṃ yo dadyāt susamāhitaḥ |
dhruvaṃ sa gacchati svargaṃ naro vai nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yamaḥ |
tilapātraṃ ca yo dadyāt pratyahaṃ vātha parvaṇi |
sadakṣiṇaṃ satyabhāvād hṛdi kṛtvā janārdanam ||
nāśayet trividhaṃ pāpaṃ dharmasya vacanaṃ tathā ||
brahmapurāṇe |
tāmrapātraṃ tilaiḥ pūrṇaṃ prasthamātrair dvijāya tu |
sahiraṇyaṃ ca yo dadyāc chraddhāvittānusārataḥ ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā labhate tu parṃ gatim |
[601] atredaṃ dānavākyam |
oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi idaṃ tilapūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ sasuvarṇaṃ aśeṣapāpakṣayakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mama |
oṃ adya amukasagotrāyety ādi etat tilatāmrapātradānapratiṣṭhārtham idaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
iti tilapātradānavidhiḥ |
athāha viṣṇuḥ |
tāmrapātre tilān kṛtvā pale ṣoḍaśakalpite |
sahiraṇye svaśaktyā vā viprāya pratipādayet |
nāśayet trividhaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavam ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
tilapūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ dvijātaye |
prātar datvā tu vidhivad duḥsvapnaṃ pratihanti saḥ ||
tilapātraṃ tridhā proktaṃ kaniṣṭottamamadhyamam |
tāmrapātraṃ daśapalaṃ jaghanyaṃ ca prakīrtitam ||
dviguṇaṃ madhyame proktaṃ triguṇaṃ cottare smṛtam |
svarṇam ekaṃ jaghanyaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ madhyame kṣipet ||
triguṇaṃ cottame tadvat suvarṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet ||
iti mahātilapātradānavidhiḥ |
[602]
pitāmaha uvāca |
śṛṇudhvaṃ devatāḥ sarvā ṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ |
muktā bhavanti yeneha mānavā mātṛjād ṛṇāt ||
yajñaṃ sautrāmaṇiṃ kartuṃ yadi śaktir na vidyate |
mahāsaras tathā vāpīṃ kūpaṃ kartuṃ ca dīrdhikām ||
evaṃ kṛte mātṛrṇān mukto bhavati mānavaḥ |
sadakṣiṇaṃ kāṃśyapātram atha datvā pramucyate ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
bhagavan kāṃsyapātrasya vidhiṃ samyak prakīrtaya |
yat pramāṇaṃ yat svarūpaṃ yasmin kāle ca dīyate ||
yādṛśāya ca dātavyaṃ dānam etad dvijātaye |
yādṛśena ca dātavyaṃ na dadyād yādṛśāya ca ||
pitāmaha uvāca |
śuddhakāṃsyasya pātrasya pramāṇaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
palānām atra nirdiṣṭaṃ tilānāṃ prasthasaptakam ||
suvarṇamāṣāś catvāraḥ pātropari vidhārayet |
vastreṇa veṣṭayet pātraṃ pradhānena subhaktitaḥ ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā nimnagādau pitṝn devāṃś ca tarpayet |
tato ‘bhipūjayec chambhuṃ śaṅkaraṃ harim eva ca ||
gomayenātha saṃlipya gṛhamadhyaṃ ca sarvataḥ |
likhet padmaṃ dvādaśāraṃ kuṅkumenātha candanaiḥ ||
[603]        tato vahniṃ sthāpayitvā homaṃ kuryād yavais tilaiḥ |
tatra pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayed bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||
gandhacandanapuṣpādyair dhūpadīpaiś ca śobhitam |
tato brāhmaṇam āhūya bahubhṛtyaṃ susaṃyatam ||
parastrīvarjakaṃ śāntam alaṃkṛtya yathāvidhi |
dāmbhikaṃ varjayen nityaṃ parastrīratilālasam ||
kṣudraṃ matsaraśīlaṃ ca brahmabhraṣṭaśaucakam |
pādau prakṣālya vidhivan mātṛśrāddhaṃ samācaret ||
tatra saṃpūjayed vipraṃ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
vastrāṇi paridhāpyo ‘sau saṃbhavyāni mṛdūni ca ||
alaṃkṛtya yathāśaktyā māghyāṃ vā mṛtavāsare |
mṛtavāsara iti, yasmin dine mātā mṛtā bhavati sa mṛtavāsaraḥ |
grahaṇe ravisomābhyāṃ saṃkrāntiṣu yugādiṣu ||
tathānyad api yad (?) dattaṃ māghyām uddiśya mātaram |
tad akṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ purā prāha maheśvaraḥ ||
jīvantīṃ bhūṣyed vastrair bhojyair ap vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
mṛtām uddiśya dātavyaṃ mādhyāṃ sarvaṃ svaśaktitaḥ ||
amāvāsyāṃ yathā dattaṃ (?) pitṝṇāṃ ca purā mayā |
yathā māghyām mayā dattā mātṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ snānaṃ vidhivat tarpaṇaṃ kṛtam |
tad akṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate muktir eva ca ||
[604]        vipraṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu tat pātraṃ tasya dāpayet |
praṇamya vidhivad bhaktyā mantram etam udīrayet ||
kāṃsyapātraṃ mayā dattaṃ mātur ānṛṇyakāṅkṣayā |
bhagavanvacanāt tubhyaṃ yathā muktis tathā vada ||
daśamāśāṃś ca udare jananyāḥ saṃsthitena me |
kleśitā bālyabhāve ca stanapānād dvijottamaḥ ||
gūthamūtrādisaṃlepaliptā yac ca kṛtā mayā |
bhavato vacanād adya mama muktir bhaved ṛṇāt ||
kāṃsyapātraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tilān vastrāṇi dakṣiṇāṃ |
saptadānyaṃ mayā dattam ṛṇān muktir bhaven mama ||
kāṃsyapātrapradānena tattvajñānaṃ śarīrakam |
tathā hemapradānena paramātmānam avyayam ||
ācchādanaṃtu brahmāṇḍaṃ guhyam etat sanātanam |
viprācchādanadānena paramātmā supūjitaḥ ||
tilasaṃkhyākṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ jananyā mama sevitam |
tiladānaprabhāvena kṛtamukto bhavāmy aham ||
phalādikhacitaṃ kṛtvā tajjalena vibhūṣitam |
evam utkrāmataḥ patraṃ pradadyād brāhmaṇāya ca ||
brāhmaṇena tato vācyaṃ jananīsaṃbhavād ṛṇāt |
muktas tvaṃ pātradānena maheśvaravaco yathā ||
datvā viprasya pātraṃ tu homaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
sopaskaraṃ satāmbūlaṃ kṣamāpya vipraṃ visarjayet ||
anyeṣām ap viprāṇāṃ bhojanādi pradāpayat |
[605]        bhaktyā śaktyā sasaṃmānaṃ pūjya viprān prayatnataḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte tato devād ṛṇān muktir na saṃśayaḥ |
jananīsaṃbhavād asmān nānyathā kvacid eva hi ||
purā mātṛvadhodbhūtapāpaśaṅkitacetasā |
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa pradattaṃ kāṃsyabhājanam ||
vaśiṣṭhas tanayān hatvā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā |
purā dānam idaṃ dattaṃ pātakavrataśāntaye ||
akṛtvā mātṛvacanaṃ pannagaiḥ śāpasaṃyutaiḥ |
kaiścic chaṅkāparair bhūtvā mātā paścāt prasāditā ||
śāpato niṣkṛtiṃ brūhi na vākyaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tava |
śāpo ‘bhibhavate devi nānṛṇānāṃ durātmanām ||
kathayāmāsa sā tebhyaḥ kāṃsyapatraṃ savistaram |
datvā dānaṃ vinirmukto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
bhujaṅgais tat kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mātṛvākyena garhitaiḥ |
kāṃsyapātrapradānaṃ tu pāpamuktas tato ‘bhavan ||
vidhānaṃ kāṃsyapātrasya sarvam etan mayoditam |
anyathā kiṃ tariṣyanti ṛṇān mātṛsamudbhavāt ||
vaśiṣṭha uvāca |
iti śrutvā tato devā kaśyapādyā maharṣayaḥ |
prajagmuḥ svāny adhiṣṭhāni harṣayuktā mahaujasaḥ ||
iti te sarvam ākhyātaṃ pātradānaṃ mahīpate |
kuru sarvaprayatnena māvajñāṃ kvacid eva hi ||
[606] ity ādityapurāṇoktaṃ kāṃsyapātradānavidhiḥ |
āha yamaḥ |
sarvapātakasaṃghātaḥ kāmato vāpy akāmataḥ |
śuddhiṃ tasya pravakṣyāmi svargasādhanam eva ca ||
śuklaiḥ kṛṣṇair yathā laghvair dvātriṃśadaṅgulotthitaḥ |
rāśis tilaiḥ same deśe kartavyaḥ puruṣāyataḥ ||
yathāvibhavavistāraṃ yadi vā śaktito naraiḥ |
pratimāṣṭāṅgulā sthāpyā sauvarṇo tatra mādhavī ||
mādhavamūrtis tu nāradīye |
ārabhya vāmorddhakarād apasavyakrameṇa tu |
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ dadhāno mādhavaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
kṣaudreṇa payasā dadhnā ghṛtenāpūrayed ghaṭān |
sthāpayet tatra taṃ rukmaṃ puṣpasragvastrabhūṣitān ||
bhaktyā vābhyarcya tat sarvaṃ brāhmaṇe śrotriye ‘rghini |
dadyāt māghe ‘tha vaiśākhe viṣuve cottarāyaṇe ||
ajñānād yadi vā mohāl lobhād vā janmajanmani |
arjitaṃ yan mayā kiṃcid duṣkṛtaṃ madhusūdana ||
evam uccārya tat sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tat kṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
iti tilarāśidānavidhiḥ |
[607]
atha mahābhārate |
yama uvāca |
sarvayajñeṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yat phalam |
yad datvā labhate vipra tad dānaṃ kathayāmi te ||
rahasyaṃ sarvadānānāṃ kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu |
puṇye ‘smin bhārate varṣe devānām ap durlabham ||
tilapadmam iti khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam |
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte śuklapakṣe dvijottama ||
gomayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ mahāmate |
navaṃ vastraṃ samāstīrya kṛṣṇājinasamanvitam ||
droṇāvarāṃs tilāṃs tatra nidhāya vasanopari |
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā śubhaṃ tat karṇikopari ||
niṣkatrayaṃ suvarṇasya sthāpayec ca tatopati |
śrīnivāsaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam ||
dhyāyec caturbhujaṃ devaṃ praṇatārtiharaṃ harim |
hiraṇyagarbham amṛtaṃ śrīgarbhaṃ parataḥ param ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītavāsasam acyutam |
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ jagadbījaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ||
kaviṃ purāṇaṃ viśveśaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam |
āsīnaṃ karṇikāmadhye sarvaśaktisamanvitam ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā namaskṛtya punaḥ punaḥ |
pūjayet parameśānaṃ śraddhāvittānusārataḥ ||
[608]        indranīlamahānīlamaṇimuktāphalādibhiḥ |
ārādhaya yathāśaktyā devadevaṃ janārdanam ||
gandhapuṣpais tathā dīpair naivedaiś ca manoramaiḥ |
kṣīrānnair ghṛtapakvaiś ca phalair divyair anekadhā ||
puṣpānāṃ prakaraś caiva gītanṛtyādibhis tathā |
ittham ārādhya deveśaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vinivedayet ||
pañcasaugandhikopetaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā |
tailaprasthaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ dadhyāḍhakam ataḥ param ||
sthāpayet pārśvatas tasya dhānyapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa |
evam ārādhya tat padmaṃ tiladroṇamayaṃ śubham ||
ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ vā trirātram atha vā dvija |
tilāhāro bhavet pūrvam upavāsam athāpi vā ||
kuryāt svakāryaśuddhyarthaṃ vāsudevam anusmaran |
tato dadyāc ca tat padmaṃ śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ ||
vijñatakulaśilāya brāhmaṇāya kuṛumbine |
jitendriyāya śāntāya prasannānyātmavedine ||
rāgadveṣavihīnāya vaiṣnavāya viśeṣataḥ |
etadguṇānvitāyaivaṃ yathāyogaṃ yathākramam ||
dātavyaṃ tat prayatnena tilapadmaṃ vidhānataḥ |
prīyatāṃ mādhavo deva ity uktvā tam anusmaran ||
hiraṇyagarbha deveśa padmanābha janārdana |
hiraṇyākṣa guṇādhāra sarvādhāradhareśvara ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhaṃ ca sarvasaṃpatsamanvitam |
[609]        putrapautrādisaṃyuktaṃ dāsodāsasamanvitam ||
ārogyaṃ ca sumantraṃ ca sarvaduḥkhavivarjitam |
kuru māṃ paramādāraṃ bhakāyam iti cintayan ||
itthaṃ prasādya deveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam |
dadyāt tilamayaṃ padmaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||
brāhmaṇaś cāpi gṛhṇīyād vācayet tu pratigraham |
ko ‘dāt kasmā adād iti vaidikaṃ mantram uccaret ||
evaṃ tilamayaṃ padmaṃ yo dadāti vidhānataḥ |
sarvasatvasamākīrṇaṃ narakaṃ sa na paśyati ||
svayaṃ bhavati pūtātmā pitṝn atha pitāmahān |
prapitāmahāṃś ca dharmātmā tārayaty akhilaṃ kulam ||
dharmārthī dharmam āpnoti dhanārthī dhanam āpnuyāt |
mokṣārthī mokṣam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
pātakī mucyate pāpāt pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ |
sarvapāparato vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
icchanti pitaraḥ putrān pautrāṃs tadvaṃśasaṃbhavān |
asmadvaṃśabhavaḥ kaścit tilapadmaṃ pradāsyati ||
yas tu rājā dhanapatiḥ samṛddho ‘tīvadhārmikaḥ |
ārādhya vipraṃ vidhinā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
vāhanādibhī ratnaiś ca grāmakṣetrādikais tathā |
yat phalaṃ jāyate tasya dvija dānaparasya ca ||
paricchannaṃ bhavet taṃ tu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
yas tv imaṃ vividhad [vidhivad?] dadyāt tilapadmaṃ ca dhārmikaḥ |
[610]        tasya dānaphalaṃ yat syān na tasyānto ‘tra vidyate ||
iti tilapadmadānavidhiḥ |
liṅgapurāṇe |
athānyat paramaṃ vakṣye alpadravyaṃ mahāphalam |
dravyamantropasaṃyukte kāle hy asya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
kāla iti deśasyāpy upalakṣaṇam | tena yatra yadā ca dravyasatpātrayogau (?) tāv evaitasya deśakālau na pūrvoktāv ity arthaḥ,
sarvatra sarvakāle ca kartavyam iha kathyate |
iti kāmikoktatvāt |
gomayālepite deśe ambarāṇi prakīrya ca |
tanmadhye nikṣiped dhomāṃs tilabhāratrayaṃ śubham ||
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikākesarānvitam |
daśaniṣkeṇa tat kāryaṃ tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ ||
tilamadhye nyaset padmaṃ padmamadhye maheśvaram |
ārādhya vidhivad devaṃ vāmādīni prapūjayet ||
śaktirūpaṃ suvarṇena triniṣkeṇa tu kārayet |
tāsāṃ ca purataḥ kāryā vidyeśāḥ pravibhāgaśaḥ ||
pūrvoktahemamānena vidyeśān api kārayet |
tān abhyarcya (?) vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ||
padmamadhye maheśvaram iti, sahasraśatādiniṣkanirmitaṃ śivaṃ [611] padmamadhye vinyasya tadardhamānahemakṛtāṃ manonmanīṃ śivasya vāmabhāge nyaset,
taduttare tadardhena kārayet manonmanīm |
iti kāmikokteḥ |
tatparito ‘ṣṭau vāmādiśaktīḥ pūjayet tad yathā |
vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālā vikaraṇī tathā |
bālaprathamanī devī damanī ca yathākramam || iti |
tadbāhye vidyeśān arcayet | te ca yathā |
athānantaś ca śūkṣmaś ca śivaś cāpy ekanetrakaḥ |
ekarudras trimūrtiś ca śrīkaṇṭhaś ca śikhaṇḍikaḥ || iti |
pūrvoktahemamānena triniṣkeṇety arthaḥ | pravibhāgaśa iti pūrvatrāpi saṃbadhyate tena vāmādiśaktīnāṃ vidyeśānāṃ ca rūpaṃ pratyekaṃ niṣkatrayeṇa kāryam | tatra maheśarūpam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne | manonmanīvāmādīnāṃ tu liṅge |
sarvāś ca dvibhujā devyo bālabhāskarasaṃnibhāḥ |
padmaśaṅkhadharāḥ śāntā raktasragvastrabhūṣitāḥ || iti |
vidyeśānāṃ tu gaṇeśadāne vakṣyate |
iti aparatilapadmadānam |
vāyupurāṇāt |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tilapadmasya lakṣaṇam |
yat kṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
[612]        viṣuve grahaṇe vāpi vyatīpāte dinakṣaye |
ayane janmanakṣatre kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī ||
eṣu kāleṣu deśeṣu puṇyeṣv āyataneṣu ca |
tilānāṃ droṇamātreṇa navavastraiḥ suśobhane ||
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ kuryāt karṇikādalaśobhite |
tasmin padmaṃ suvarṇena palamātreṇa kalpitam ||
palārdhenārdhapādena karṇikopari śobhitam |
vinyaset tatra deveśam āvāhya śaśiśekharam ||
pāṇḍurāṅgaṃ caturbāhuṃ kṛttivāsasam īśvaram |
arcayet puṇḍarīkaiś ca padmair vā śatapatrakaiḥ ||
dhūpaṃ ca guggulaṃ dadyād ghṛtāktaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ||
tato vipraṃ samāhūya puṇyakāla upasthite |
yathā devaṃ tathā vipram arcayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
mūlamantreṇa kartavyaṃ sarvam evārcanādikam |
imaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ proktvā tasmai viprāya dāpayet ||
etat tilamayaṃ padmam atra saṃnihito haraḥ |
etat pradānād aniśaṃ śivaḥ saṃprīyatām iti ||
yathāsau bhagavān devaḥ sarvabhūtāntarasthitaḥ |
tena satyena me pāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu sarvataḥ ||
evaṃ yas tilapadmasya vidhānaṃ samyag ācaret |
[613]        sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti śivamandiram ||
tatra kalpaśataṃ sārdhaṃ śivavan modate sukham |
yat kiṃcit kurute pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā |
tilapadmapradānena tat sarvaṃ kṣayam eṣyate ||
iti tṛtīyaṃ tilapadmadānam |
āha baudhāyanaḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ kārayet padmaṃ palenārdhapalena vā |
yathā svaśaktyā matimān ghaṭam aṣṭadalaṃ śubham ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta bhaven niṣphalam anyathā |
droṇe tilādhike vāpi tāmrapātraṃ jalāvṛtam ||
tasya madhye tu taṃ padmaṃ nidadhyāt kuṅkumānvitam |
brāhmaṇaṃ śrutasaṃpannaṃ daridraṃ cāgnihotriṇam ||
āhūya gandhamālyādyair vidhinā cātibhaktitaḥ |
tataḥ svarṇamayaṃ padmaṃ dadyān mantreṇa saṃyutam ||
khagaḥ pūṣā pataṅgo ‘sau dvādaśātmā trayītanuḥ |
padmenānena dattena prītas taraṇir astu me ||
dānamantraḥ |
kṛtenānena manujo mūtrakṛcchrāt pramucyate |
mūtrakṛcchrāturas tasmād etat kuryāt prayatnataḥ ||
mūtrakṛcchrarogaharaṃ tilapadmadānam |
[614]
vāyupurāṇe |
kṣaye tu rājataṃ padmaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
tilāḍhakopari yat taj jalaṃ kāṃsyamaye ghaṭe ||
palenātha tadardhena yathāśaktyātha vā krtam |
nidhāya tatra padmaṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
padmena rājateneha pradānād atrinetraja |
jātaṃ karmavipākena kṣayaṃ nāśaya me ‘nagha ||
dānamantraḥ |
kṛtvaivaṃ kṣayarogī tu śīghraṃ rogāt pramucyate |
iti kṣayarogaharaṃ tilapadmadānavidhiḥ |
āha baudhāyanaḥ |
suvarṇena tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
padmaṃ tu kārayec chvabhraṃ (?) vyaktam aṣṭadalaṃ śubham ||
madhye tu karṇikāṃ kuryād rājatena ca nālakam |
padmam evaṃvidhaṃ kuryāt sthāpyaṃ droṇatilopari ||
vastreṇāveṣṭya parayā bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ |
brāhmaṇaṃ jñānavṛttasthaṃ svācāraṃ saṃyatendriyam ||
padmadānaprayogajñam āditye ‘hani kārayet |
āhūya vipraparyantaṃ pūjayed vastapūrvakam ||
ājyena ca tilair homaḥ kāryaś cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
padmenāvāhayed devaṃ bhāskaraṃ grahanāyakam ||
[615]        ehy ehi bhagavan deva padme ‘smin saṃnidhiṃ kuru |
trayotano dvādaśātman sarvaprāṇihitāya ca ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
āvāhya tasmin deveśaṃ pūjayed raktacandanaiḥ |
puṣpaiś ca raktaraparaiḥ kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ ||
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyād alābhe kṣīram eva ca |
mantreṇānena vidhivad dadyāt padmaṃ sitāmbaram ||
bhagavan sūrya bhūteśa dyumaṇe lokanāyaka |
raktavarṇaḥ pratāpendraraktas trailokyapāvanaḥ ||
satpātrāya mayā dattaṃ mama janmanicaivahi |
auṣadhādi tu tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāt tu dānataḥ ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ vinayānvitaḥ |
pāyasaṃ guḍasaṃmiśraṃ bhojanāya pradāpayet ||
tataḥ snātvā maṅgalena puṇyāhena tu bhaktataḥ |
bhartāraṃ devavan manye bhuñjīta ghṛtapāyasam ||
evaṃ kṛtena dānena nāśaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ |
saṃpatnyauṣadhadānena raktaśūlam upārjitam ||
raktaśūlayujā nāryā dānaṃ kāryam idaṃ tataḥ |
iti raktaśūlaghnaṃ tilapadmadānam |
āha gautamaḥ |
gavāṃ yaḥ pīḍanaṃ kuryān naro rodhanabandhanaiḥ |
[616]        dadrurogī sati kaṇḍayukto bhavati sarvadā ||
vakṣyāmi tat pratīkāraṃ padmadānādikarmaṇā |
vyāvahārikaniṣkeṇa padmaṃ kuryāt suśobhanam ||
nālaṃ ca rājataṃ kuryāt tadardhenāpi kaṇṭhakam |
madhye ratnaṃ pradātavyaṃ tadalābhe ca mauktikam ||
śrīgandhakuṅkumābhyāṃ ca prakṣālya hy anulepayet |
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāpy vastrayuktaṃ tileṣu vā ||
teṣām api parimāṇaṃ droṇatritayam iṣyate |
tadalābhe dvayaṃ grāhyam atha vā svasya śaktitaḥ ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir arcayet mūlamantrataḥ |
āvāhayec ca deveśaṃ bhāskaraṃ sūryamaṇḍalāt ||
deva deva jagannātha dyumaṇe lokapāvana |
lokānāṃ cakṣuḥ sūrya tvaṃ padme ‘smin saṃnidhiṃ kuru ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
evam āvāhya sūryaṃ taṃ bhānum sarvajanapriyam |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir arcayen mūlamantrataḥ ||
homaṃ cāpi prakurvīta āgneyyān diśi tasya tu |
samidājyatilaiḥ samyag ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstravit ||
sūryaṃ te cakṣur mantreṇa samiddhomaṃ prakalpayet |
ājyahomaṃ prakurvīta haṃsaḥ śucisad ity api ||
vyāhṛtyā ca tilaiḥ homaṃ kuryāt tv ayutasaṃkhyayā |
samidājyaiś cāṣṭaśatam aṣṭāviṃśatim eva vā ||
[617]        hutvā cāhutisaṃpātān pātre cāsmin vinikṣipet |
tena gātrāṇi cābhyajya dadrurogārditasy atu ||
akṣibhyām anuvākena yathā liṅgaṃ ca vāsasā |
mārjayītāhatenātha dadruṇo muṣṭinā tathā ||
saṃpūjyānantaraṃ bhaktyā naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ kṣipet |
dadyād rogī tu taṃ padmaṃ prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat pūjitāyātibhaktitaḥ |
devadeva jagannātha devarūpa parātpara ||
jagatāṃ paramānandakāraka dyumaṇe prabho |
prabhākara susaptāśva deveśāruṇasārathe ||
rodhanair bandhanaiś caivaṃ vairūpyaṃ yac charīrake |
pūrvakarmavipākena dadrukalkādikaśmalam |
padmadānena tuṣṭas tvaṃ nāśayāśu śarīrake ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu taṃ padmaṃ dadrurogavivarjitaḥ |
vinā kaṇḍuṃ vinā kuṣṭhaṃ tvagdoṣaiś ca vivarjitaḥ ||
jāyate rūpavān sadya ādityasya prabhā yathā |
jīved varṣaśataṃ martyo dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ||
anantaraṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ ca nivedayet |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute dānaṃ gautamoktavidhānataḥ ||
rogair anyair vimuktaś ca modate bhānuvad bhuvi |
iti dadrurogaghnatilapadmadānavidhiḥ |
[618]
atha vāyupurāṇe |
svaropaghātī vācāṃ ca hartā mūkaḥ prajāyate |
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ yena saṃpadyate sukham ||
kuryāt svarṇamayaṃ padmaṃ palārdhārdhatadardhataḥ |
yathāvibhavataḥ samyag vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ||
raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya tāmrapātropari nyaset |
tāmrapātraparīmāṇaṃ palānām aṣṭakaṃ viduḥ ||
yad vā svavibhavenaiva pūjayed raktacandanaiḥ |
tilāḍhakopari sthāpya pītavastreṇa veṣṭayet ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstravit |
dharmajñaś ca vinītaś ca dayāluḥ satyavāk śuciḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukho ‘laṃkṛtaḥ śuciḥ |
brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ tvaṃ hi viṣṇor abhijanābhijaḥ ||
abhiprītikaraṃ bhānor agne rudrasya caiva hi |
gṛhāṇa pūjām etāṃ tvaṃ sarvakleśavināśakaḥ ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
āgneyyāṃ diśi vai homaḥ kartavyo mantrapūjakaḥ |
samidājyatilaiś caiva sāvitryāṣṭākṣareṇa tu ||
samiddhomaṃ prakurvīta sarvarogapraśāntaye |
ājyahomaś ca kartavyaś citram ity anayā ṛcā ||
tilān āyāti indreti vyāhṛtībhir athāpi vā |
agner uttarato bhāge kalaśasthāpanaṃ bhavet ||
[619]        pūrvoktena vidhānena cābhiṣekādi kārayet |
pranītāmokṣaparyantaṃ karma kṛtvā prayatnataḥ ||
ataḥ snātaḥ śuciḥ śvetavastro rogo tu bhūṣitaḥ |
tasmai hutavate padmaṃ dadyāt smṛtvā caturmukham ||
devānām atha sarveṣāṃ padma tvaṃ prītikāraṇam |
viśeṣato brahmaṇaś ca sarasvatyā harer api ||
yat prāg vācām nirodhena vairūpyaṃ mama dehajam |
aghabhedabhavaṃ tīvraṃ duḥkhaṃ rogākaraṃ tathā ||
tat sarvaṃ nāśayantv atra brahmasūryaśivāgnayaḥ |
tridaśādayo ye ca devā haviṣmantas tathā bhuvi ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu taṃ padmam ācāryāyātibhaktitaḥ |
pṛṣṭhatas tad anuvrajya hy aghabhedād vimucyate ||
evaṃ padmodbhavaḥ prāha nāradāya mahātmane ||
iti mūkatvaharatilapadmadānavidhiḥ |
atha tripadmapañcakadānavidhiḥ |
atha dānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tripadmam iti viśrutaṃ |
āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ puṇyam ārogyaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
māghamāse viśeṣeṇa janmarkṣeṣu ca kārayet |
vyādhigraste ca dātavyaṃ duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ||
[620]        athānyad bhayaṃ paśyet sarvadoṣapraśāntaye |
bhūmau gomayaliptāyāṃ tilair āḍhakasaṃmitaiḥ ||
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikākesarānvitam |
tasmin vidhāya sauvarṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saroruham ||
vastreṇāveṣṭya gandhādyair arcayet parameṣṭhinam |
vipraṃ vaitānikaṃ dharmaśāstrajñaṃ śāntamānasam ||
abhyarcya dāpayet tasmai mantram etad udīrayet |
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhavagān ātmabhūś caturānanaḥ ||
dānenānena sarvātmā jagatsraṣṭā jagatpatiḥ |
tathānyat taṇḍulair eva tṛtīyaṃ lavaṇena tu ||
viṣṇave sthāṇave ceti dānamantrair vibodhayet |
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhagavān paramātmā jagatmayaḥ ||
dānenānena viśvātmā paramaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhagavān śaṅkaraḥ śaṅkarotu me ||
dānenānena viśvātmā candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ |
iti mantrān samuccārya dadyād etān pṛthak pṛthak ||
jātarūpamayān kṛtvā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān |
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ jāyate dvijapuṅgavāḥ |
na tad varnayituṃ śakyaṃ kalpakoṭiśatair api ||
ity āha bhagavān brahmā nāradāya mahātmane |
uktaṃ mayāpi tat sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
atra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāṇāṃ rūpanirmāṇaṃ dhānyaparvatavad draṣṭavyam |
[621]
iti tripadmadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇāt |
tiladānamayo vakṣye daśadhā devi sāṃpratam |
rahasyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvakalyāṇakārakam ||
janmarkṣeṣu caturdasyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ ca samācaret |
saṃnidhau devadevasya śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
cakre pañcarajaḥklipte dvādaśāraṃ saroruham |
dalair dvādaśabhir yuktaṃ kṛtvā tasminn arañjakam ||
avraṇaṃ tilasaṃpūrṇaṃ vinyasyābhyantaraṃ śivam |
candrākāraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ maṇḍale śakradaivate ||
pūjayed gandhanaivedyadīpapuṣpaiḥ phalais tathā ||
śakralakṣaṇaṃ lokapālaprasaṅgena brahmāṇḍadāne darśitaṃ śakradaivatamaṇḍalaṃ pārthivamaṇḍalaṃ ca taccatuṣkoṇaṃ vidheyam |
dhūpaṃ sarjarasaṃ kṛtvā dadyāt taṃ śivayogine |
bhūgandhapatir īśānaḥ śakrarūpī tilāśayaḥ ||
nyāsotthaṃ pṛthivījātaṃ sa matpāpaṃ vyapohatu |
iti kṛtvā vinaśyanti pāpāni kṣitijāni ca ||
bhojane yāni hiṃsyante sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
kaṇḍūtivamane yāni śavamadyādigandhayoḥ ||
[622]        ghrāṇe ghrāṇe gandhe śrotriyasyāturasya ca |
punaḥ śivapure tiṣṭhed yāvad indrāś caturdaśa (?) ||
itareṣv api sarveṣu vidhiḥ sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
viśeṣeṇa ca vakṣyāmi tatra tatra śucismite (?) ||
iti tilārañjakadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇāt |
tilapīṭham atho vakṣye sāradārumaye śubhe |
pīṭhe ‘ratnidvayāyāme tilapūrṇe sabhittike |
vyomādhipaṃ gaṇeśānarūpiṇaṃ śivam arcayet ||
gaṇeśarūpam āhātreyaḥ |
caturbhujo gajamukho mūṣakasthaś ca tuṇḍilaḥ |
viṣāṇaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca paraśuṃ mātulāṅgakam ||
dadhāno vighnarājaḥ syād iti |
śuklair gandhaiś ca dhūpaś ca karpūraṃ dhūpayet tathā |
kṣaume ca vāsasī dadyāt pustakaṃ tatra vinyaset ||
vyomadhvanipatiḥ śubhro gaṇanātha tilāśrayaḥ |
vyomaśabdaśrutiprāptaṃ pāpam īśa vyapohatu ||
[623]        iti datte ‘sya naśyanti pāpāny ākāśajāni ca |
anibaddhakathotthāni paranindākathāni ca ||
kūṭasākṣisamutthāni paiśunyajanitāni ca |
vedanindā guror nindā tayoś ca śraveṇena ca ||
hanti pāpāny aśeṣāṇi tilapīṭhapradānataḥ |
śivaloke ca kalpāṃś ca modate daśa pañca ca ||
iti tilapīṭhadānavidhiḥ |
tasminn eva purāṇe |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi tiladānam anuttamam |
pūrvoktakalpite pīṭhe catuḥkumbhapariṣkṛte ||
ādarśaṃ vimalaṃ nyasya tatra devaṃ manomayam |
viṣṇurūpadharaṃ śumbhuṃ vinyasya parito nyaset ||
viṣṇurūpam uktam nāradena | tad yathā |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharo vāmordhvabāhutaḥ |
viṣṇur vidheyo bhagavān viśeṣo nyāsamūrtiṣu || iti |
pītavastrayugaṃ dikṣu cakrādīny āyudhāni ca |
pañcalohapratiṣṭhāni tulasībhiḥ samarcayet ||
manomaya namas te ‘stu saumyarūpa vṛṣadhvaja |
manaskṛtyāni pāpāni sarvāṇy āśu vināśaya ||
iti datte ‘sya nasyanti mānasāni kṛtāni vai |
[624]        paradrohapravṛttāni kāmalobhodbhavāni ca ||
krodhajāni ca sarvāṇi pāpāni ca viśeṣataḥ |
avācyavācane yāni adhyeyadhyānajāni ca ||
dhyeyāny āvṛttavṛttāni naśyanti sakalāny api |
śivaloke vased varṣāṇy arbudān daśa kāmataḥ ||
iti tilādarśadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇāt |
tilakumbham atho vakṣye kumbhe pūrvavad āsthite |
vāruṇe maṇḍale devaṃ varuṇākāram arcayet ||
śvetaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalair gandhaiḥ karpūreṇa tu pūjayet ||
varuṇalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne | “vāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ prāpya maṇḍalaṃ” tac ca ardhacandrākāraṃ kartavyam |
ṣaḍ rasān parito nyasya tato mantram imaṃ japet |
namo varuṇarūpāya rasāmbupataye namaḥ ||
rasavārinimittāni yāntu nāśam aghāni me |
tilakumbhapradānena prasīda parameśvara ||
iti datte vinaśyanti pāpāni jalacāriṇām |
hiṃsodbhavāni snāneṣu pānapāke ‘vagāhane ||
rasopādānabhakṣāṇāṃ apeyānāṃ ca vāñchayā |
[625]        auṣadhaṃ cāpi deveśa sarvaṃ medhyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
śivaloke vaset kalpān śatapañcadaśāvarān ||
iti tilakumbhadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇāt |
karakaṃ tilasaṃpūrṇaṃ maṇḍale vahnidaivate |
śivaṃ vahnivad ādhāya pūjayet karavīrakaiḥ |
raktacandanagandhena niryāsena ca dhūpayet ||
vahnidevatamaṇḍalaṃ trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalam ity arthaḥ | “śivaṃ vahnivad” iti vahnirūpiṇaṃ śivam ādhāyety arthaḥ | tadrūpam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne | niryāsaḥ sarjarasaḥ |
ādarśaṃ ca tato dadyād dīpānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam |
vahnirūpapatiḥ śaṃbhur vahnirūpo tilāśrayaḥ ||
tejorūpakrtaṃ pāpaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ ca vyapohatu |
iti datte ‘sya naśyanti pāpāny agnikṛtāni ca ||
pākahomeṣu kāṣṭheṣu hiṃsyante yāni vahninā |
aṅgāravanadāhādisaṃbhavāni ca yāni vai ||
viruddhakaraṇotthāni rūpayogodbhavāni ca |
paradāraparadravyaputradarśanajāni ca ||
[626]        śavādidarśanotthāni netradoṣakṛtāni ca |
ya evaṃ kurute dānaṃ śivabhaktyā yatavrataḥ |
śivaloke vased bhūpa kalpatrayam aśaṅkitaḥ ||
iti tilakarakadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇāt |
ataḥ param ahaṃkāraṃ nāma dānaṃ vadāmi te |
pūrvavat kalpite pīṭhe tilānām upari nyaset ||
rājataṃ maṇḍalaṃ śuddhaṃ viśvag aṣṭāṅgulāyatam |
tatra devam ahaṃkāraṃ paviśaktidharākṛtim ||
vinyasya rājatān anyān kumārān parito nyaset |
naigameśaṃ viśākhaṃ ca kumāraṃ guham eva ca ||
pūrvavad iti tilapīṭhadānavad ity arthaḥ | paviḥ vajram, ahaṃkāraś ca puruṣākṛtiḥ dvibhujo vajraśaktidharo vidheyaḥ | naigameṣādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
tataḥ skandagrahā jātā dāruṇā vikrtānanāḥ |
naigameṣamukhāḥ śaktidharā dvivāhavas tathā || iti |
kausumbhe vāsasī dadyād ghaṇṭāṃ ca parito nyaset |
kuṅkumaṃ gandhakārye syāt puṣpaṃ ca karavīrajam ||
ahaṃkārapate deva guharūpa durantaka |
abhimānakṛtād doṣāt sarvasmāt pāhi māṃ prabho ||
[627]        iti datte ‘sya naśyanti yāny ahaṃkārajāni tu |
pāruṣyastrīniṣedhyādiviprakṣatriyajāni ca ||
tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti yāni kṛtyvilaṅghanaiḥ |
anātmany ātmabuddhyā tu gṛhakṣetrādisaṅgame |
anyāni yāni pāpāni tāni naśyanti sarvataḥ ||
pāpāni tāni naśyanti śivaloke vasen naraḥ |
kalpānāṃ śatam ekaṃ ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti ahaṃkāradānavidhiḥ |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tiladānam anuttamam |
yad datvā puruṣaḥ strī vā vairiñciṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
āyur ārogyadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
śivaprītikaraṃ nṝṇāṃ putravṛddhikaraṃ śubham ||
rudraikādaśabuddhyā tu viprān ekādaśān sudhīḥ |
prāṅmukhaḥ pratyag āsīnān gandhādibhir athārcayet ||
tilaprasthadvayaṃ pātre pratyekaṃ nikṣipet tathā |
pratyekaṃ maṇḍālaṃ haimaṃ pātreṣu vinivedayet ||
pātrāṇi caivam ārādhya śivabuddhyā yathākramam |
rudraikādaśamantraiś ca dadyād udakapūrvakam ||
raudraikādaśamantrāḥ, vakṣyamāṇair nāmabhir namo’ntair jñātavyāḥ |
[628]        mṛgavyādhaś ca sarvaś ca nairṛtiś ca mahāyaśāḥ |
ajaikapād ahirbudhnaḥ pinākī ca paraṃtapaḥ ||
vahano ‘theśvaraś caiva kapālī ca mahādyutiḥ |
sthānur bhavaś ca bhagavān rudrā ekādaśā viduḥ ||
iti rudraikādaśatiladānavidhiḥ |
tasminn eva purāṇe |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tilagarbham anuttamam |
yatsaṃpradānān manujo dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt ||
apamṛtyujayopāyo vyādhinirmokṣaṇakṣamaḥ |
tilagarbha iti khyāto rahasyaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ||
yadā grahoparodhaḥ syāj janmarkṣasyātidāruṇaḥ |
vyādhīnāṃ ca samutthānam utpātasyāpi codayaḥ ||
tilagarbhas tadā kāryaḥ sarvadoṣopaśāntaye |
nimittānantaraṃ kuryān naimittikavidhikramam ||
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ kṣitāv āstīrya vāsasī |
śālīnām āḍhakaṃ madhye tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyaset ||
teṣu padmaṃ pravistīryam aṣṭapatraṃ sukarṇikam |
karṇikāyāṃ nyaset padmaṃ sauvarṇaṃ śaktitaḥ kṛtam ||
navaratnāni tadpadme nidhātavyāni yatnataḥ |
tatas tadbāhyataḥ śuddhān tilān kuryāt samantataḥ ||
garbhavad vāsasā bhūyaḥ samāstrīya tataḥ śanaiḥ |
garbhaṃ taṃ yonimantreṇa samādhāya yathāvidhi ||
[629]        tata upaveśya puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇakṛtasumuṣṭikam |
tasyāṅgeṣu nyasen mantraṃ mṛtyuṃjayam anukramāt ||
taṃ ca devaṃ virūpakṣaṃ ardhacandravibhūṣaṇam |
kalpayitvārcayet mantraṃ pañcabrahmabhir ādarāt ||
yonimantraḥ | yasyai yajñiyo garbho yasyai yonir hiraṇyamayītyādivājasaneyānāṃ prasiddhaḥ |
mṛtyuṃjayanyāsam āha śāunakaḥ |
tryambakaṃ yajāmahe śikhāyām, nyaset sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam iti hṛdaye, urvārukam iva bandhanād iti bāhvoḥ | mṛtyor mukṣīya mām ṛtād iti nābhau |
pāde gulphe ca gaṅghorujaghane kaṭimeḍhrayoḥ |
nābhau kukṣidvaye pārśve kakṣayoḥ kucayor hṛdi ||
skandhe kṛkāṭikāyāṃ ca kūrpare maṇibandhake |
kaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyātarjanyaṅguṣṭhapāṇiṣu ||
kaṇṭhe ‘tha cibuke vaktre nāsikākarṇacakṣuṣi |
lalāṭe mūrdhni cūḍāyāṃ varṇān mantrasya vinyaset ||
iti devīpurāṇokto vā mṛtyuṃjayamatranyāso gṛḥyate, [630] sa ca gāruḍapurāṇoktanānārogaghna-tulāpuruṣadāne draṣṭavyaḥ | pañca brāhmaṇās tatpuruṣādimantrāḥ |
tasya mūrdhni punaḥ padmaṃ sauvarṇaṃ pūrvavat kṛtam |
vinyased vastram āveṣṭya tilair āpūrayet punaḥ ||
taṃ garbham arcayed bhūyaś cintayitvāmṛtodbhavam |
amṛtaśrāviṇaṃ candraṃ svena mantreṇa mantravit ||
tataḥ śatāvṛtaṃ mantraṃ mṛtyuṃjayam anuttamam |
tata utthāpayet tasmād garbhasthānāt samāhitaḥ ||
punaḥ saṃprokṣya vāruṇyā pāvamānībhir eva ca |
pūrvadehavinirmuktaḥ śaṃkaro ‘smīti cintayet ||
brāhmaṇāya vinītāya jñānine vītamanyave |
brahmaniṣṭhāya tat sarvaṃ saṃpradadyāt tilādikam ||
prīyatāṃ bhagavān śaṃbhuś candramaulir iti bruvan ||
tatra tilagarbha-upaveśanam | śaṃkaro ‘smīti ca dhyānam utthānam, samantrakam | tilādidānaṃ yajamānakartṛkam | anyat sarvam ācāryaḥ kuryāt |
anena vidhinā yas tu tilagarbhaṃ samārabhet |
akālamṛtyur na bhavet tasya nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||
vyādhīnāṃ vipramokṣaḥ syān mahatām api niścayaḥ |
grahadoṣāś ca naśyanti prasīdanti grahāḥ punaḥ ||
utpātānāṃ praśāntiś ca trividhānām api kṣaṇāt |
[631] trividhānām api bhaumāntarikṣadivyānāṃ |
tilagarbhadānavidhiḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe tilagarbhadānāntāni dānāni samāptāni ||
[632]
dānakhaṇḍam navamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
prathamam ārabhyate
atha gajadānam | kūrmapurāṇe |
dadyād gajaṃ purāṇoktamūlyaṃ pañcaśatāni vā |
vittānusārāt tatrāpi kaniṣṭhottamamadhyamam ||
purāṇoktaṃ mūlyamantraṃ hemamāṣaśatadvayaṃ tathāsvarūpagajadānena saha vittānusārāt traividhyaṃ tatra svarūpagajadānam uttamaḥ pakṣaḥ pañcaśatānīti madhyamaḥ, śatadvayaṃ kanīyān iti pañcaśatānīty atrāha haimamāṣāḥ saṃbadhyante |
rūpyasthūṇālaṃkaraṇaṃ tārāgaṇavibhūṣaṇam |
sadakṣiṇaṃ vittaśaktyā datvā viṣṇpuraṃ vrajet ||
sthūṇā rajjuḥ | tārāgaṇo mauktikādikṛto gajaḥ | bhūṣaṇaviśeṣaḥ |
iti gajadānavidhiḥ |
[633]
atha liṅgapurāṇe |
gajadānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
dvijāya vātha dātavyaṃ devadevāya vā punaḥ ||
gajaṃ tu lakṣaṇopetaṃ haimaṃ vā rājataṃ tu vā |
sahasraniṣkamātreṇa tadardhenāpi kārayet ||
tadardhārdhena vā kuryāt sarvalakṣaṇabhūṣitam |
pūrvoktadeśakāle ca devāya vinivedayet ||
aṣṭamyāṃ vā pradātavyaḥ śivāya parameṣṭhine |
brāḥmaṇāya daridrāya śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ||
śivam uddiśya dātavyaḥ śivaṃ saṃpūjya pūrvavat ||
pūrvavad iti liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavad ity arthaḥ |
etad yaḥ kurute dānaṃ śivabhaktisamanvitaḥ |
sthitvā svarge ciraṃ kālaṃ rājā gajapatir bhavet ||
ity aparo gajadānavidhiḥ |
viṣṇusaṃhitāyām |
kakṣārajjubhir āyattaṃ śubhāsanasamanvitam |
maṇikāñcanamālābhir bhūṣitaṃ karṇacāmaraiḥ ||
sūtrakhaṇḍaiś ca puṣpaiś ca bhūṣitaṃ dīpavarjitam |
yathālābopapannaṃ vā yaḥ prayacchati dantinam ||
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya svargaloke mahīyate |
karmakṣayād ihāgatya mahārājo gaṇādhipaḥ |
[634]        sarvapāpavinirmukto jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
atha vātulaśāśtre |
gajadānam atho vakṣye saṃkṣepād vidhinā śṛṇu |
dvijānām eva dātavyaṃ devānāṃ prītikārakam ||
śrīkaraṃ paramaṃ dhanyaṃ balapuṣṭivivardhanam |
rogaghnaṃ santatikaraṃ jagadāpadvināśanam ||
gajaṃ sulakṣaṇopetaṃ śuddhadeśasamudbhavam |
yuvānaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
pūrvoktadeśakāle ca devālayasamīpake |
ānīya gajarājānam airāvatakulodbhavam ||
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyair vipramukhyāya dāpayet |
puṇyāhaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śivapūjāṃ tathaiva ca ||
ācāryapūjanaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
atha māhābhārate |
hastyaśvaśakaṭādīni yaḥ prayacchati śaktitaḥ |
dvijāya suviśiṣṭāya śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ||
yat phalaṃ samavāpnoti tan me nigatataḥ śṛṇu |
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭir varṣaśatāni ca |
bhogān bhuktvāmarapure rājā kālakṣayād iha ||
idaṃ cātra dānavākyam – oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi |
[635] imaṃ hastinaṃ akṣārajjusthirāsanasahitaṃ kāñcanamālākīrṇaṃ cāmaragandhapuṣpālaṃkṛtaṃ prajāpatidaivatam akṣayasvargakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade, na mameti, oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi | etaddhastidānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dakṣiṇām idaṃ suvarṇaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
iti hastidānavidhiḥ |
athāha baudhāyanaḥ |
vāgvirodhaṃ guroḥ kṛtvā mukharogī bhaven naraḥ |
tasya dānena vihitaḥ pratīkāro ‘yam ucyate ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ palenārdhapalena vā |
kārayet kariṇaṃ saumyaṃ yathāvibhavato ‘tha vā ||
tasyaiva kārayed dantau śubhreṇa rajatena tu |
pucchaṃ vā mauktikaiḥ kuryād ratnābhyām akṣiṇī tathā ||
saṃveṣṭya pītavastreṇa gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
arcayed dhānyarāśisthaṃ dhānyaṃ droṇāṣtakaṃ matam ||
śrutavṛttopasaṃpannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ saṃyatendriyam |
dāntaṃ kulīnaṃ dharmiṣṭham anudvegakaraṃ nṛṇām ||
āhūya parayā bhaktyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣanaiḥ |
pūjayet prayato bhūtvā tenaitat karma kārayet ||
samidājyatilais tena homaṃ cāpi pravartayet |
agnināgniṃ tathādhāya śuktaṃ carati ca kramāt ||
mantrā ete vinirdiṣṭā idhma āśvattha iṣyate |
kṛtvā caivāpraṇomyas tato hastyarcanaṃ bhavet ||
[636]        svācāntaḥ karma kṛtvātha praṇītāmokṣaṇaṃ tathā |
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
tasmai hutavate dadyāt kariṇaṃ taṃ sadakṣiṇam |
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya viśeṣataḥ ||
supratīkagajendra tvaṃ sarasvatyābhiṣecanam |
indrasya vāhanaṃ śaśvat sarvadevaiś ca pūjitam ||
dānenānena dattena mukharogaṃ vināśaya ||
dānamantraḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed ante sārdhaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ |
iti mukharogaharagajadānavidhiḥ |
athāha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
palena vā tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
kārayed vāhanaṃ haimaṃ caturdantaṃ tu vāraṇam ||
dantāḥ svarṇamayāḥ kāryā ratnair nānāvidhair yutāḥ |
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kariṇaṃ copakārakam ||
yat tat sarvapradāne tu tasya pārśve samāhitaḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir arcayed gandhapuṣpakaiḥ ||
tato brāhmaṇam āhūya sarvaśāstrārthakovidam |
śrutavṛttopasaṃpannam anudvegakaraṃ nṛṇām ||
bhaktyā saṃpūjya vastrādyair homaṃ tena ca kārayet |
mantraiḥ paurāṇikaiḥ samyak saṃhitāśāstracoditaiḥ ||
[637]        catvāro diggajā ye ca puṣpadantādayaś ca ye |
sārvabhaumādayo ye ca āhṛtyātoṣayāmi tān ||
samidājyatilair homo gajasya prītaye bhavet |
tasmai hutavate samyak ghṛṇiprītyartham ādṛtaḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivad dadyād bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
prāṅmukhasya vraṇī codaṅmukhāyendrasya vāhanam ||
airāvatam anuvrajya tam ācāryo mudānvitaḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte vranābādhāt tat kṣaṇād eva sarpati |
tenaiva vranibhir nūnaṃ kāryam ārogyahetave ||
iti vraṇaghangajadānavidhiḥ |
atha devatābhyo gajadānam | śivadharmāt |
nivedayati yo nāgaṃ bhaktyā svarṇādyalaṃkṛtam |
śivāya parvadivase tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
sa mattairāvataprakhyair gajair yuktaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
prakīḍati mahāyānaiḥ śatasaṃkhyair anekaśaḥ ||
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca |
[638]        rudraloke gataś cānte bhaved iha surādhipa ||
caturyugasahasrānte svargaṃ prāpya narādhipaḥ |
bhaved indrasamaḥ śrīmān rūpavīryasamanvitaḥ ||
iti śivagajadānam |
gāruḍapurāṇe |
yo jagannidhaye nāgaṃ prayacchati mahāmatiḥ |
bhadrajātisamudbhūtaṃ padmanābhāya śaktitaḥ ||
kupyakaṃ balaśobhāḍhyaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam |
varatrāṅkuśasaṃyuktam anekasvarṇabhūṣaṇam ||
nānāmaṇḍanabhūyiṣṭaṃ cāruḍiṇḍimaḍamburam |
kṛtvā viṣṇor mahāpūjāṃ kārttikaikādaśīdine ||
dvādaśyām arpayet taṃ tu devadevāya cakriṇe |
trilokīnātha deveśa sarvabhūtakṛpānidhe ||
gajadānena tuṣṭas tvaṃ prayaccha mama vāñchitam |
ity uccāryātha datvā taṃ praṇipatya jagatprabhum ||
surendralokam āsādya krīḍate kālama akṣayam |
varṣārbudasahasrāṇi krīḍitvā suciraṃ divi ||
tato bhūlokam āsādya sārvabhaumī nṛpo bhavet ||
iti viṣṇugajadānavidhiḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
nivedayati yo nāgaṃ bhaktyā svarṇādyalaṃkṛtam |
[639]        sūryāya parvadivase tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
sa mattairāvataprakhyair gajayuktaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
prakīḍati mahāyānaiḥ śatasaṃkhyair anekaśaḥ ||
saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ kṣitau narapatir bhavet |
bhuktvā tu vipulān gogān pralaye samupasthite ||
sūryayogaṃ samāsādya sa tatraiva pralīyate ||
iti sūryagajadānavidhiḥ |
atha dāsīdānam | tatra vahnipurāṇe |
gṛhadānaṃ śrutaṃ rājan dāsīdānaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu |
tava bhaktyā pravakṣyāmi mahāsaukhyapradāyakam ||
caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ hi gṛhasthaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate |
gṛhasthāc ca gṛhaṃ rājan sugṛhe tu varastriyaḥ ||
ahiraṇyam adāsīkam alpānnādyam agorasam |
gṛhakṛpaṇavṛttīnāṃ narakasyāparo vidhiḥ ||
adaṇḍavāsikaṃ grāmam adāsīkaṃ ca yad gṛham |
anājyabhojanaṃ yac ca vṛthā tad iti me matiḥ ||
vibhramābharaṇā dāsyo yad gṛhaṃ samupāsate |
tatrāste paṅkajakarā lakṣmīḥ kṣīrodaśāyinī ||
na tatrāsti gṛhe śaucaṃ na sukhaṃ vyāvahārajam |
yatra karmakarī nāsti sarvakarmakarī sadā ||
kiṃkarāṇāṃ kṛtaṃ karma na karotīha yad bhṛtam |
[640]        yad ekā kurute dāsī gṛhasthena bhṛtā satī ||
bahulokākuko grāmo dāsīdāsākulaṃ gṛham |
buddhir dharmākulā yasya tasya cataḥ kim ākulam ||
yasya bhāryā gṛhe dakṣā dāsī karmaṇy anuvratā |
bhṛtyāḥ satvodyatakarās trivargas tatra sidhyati ||
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ loke yac cāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe |
tat tad guṇavate deyaṃ tad evākṣayam icchatā ||
etad vicārya hṛdaye dāsīṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
sthiranakṣatrasaṃyukte saumye saumyagrahānvite ||
dānakālaṃ praśaṃsanti santaḥ parvaṇi vā punaḥ |
alaṃkṛtya yathāśaktyā vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā ||
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā mantreṇa bhaktitas tathā |
iyaṃ dāsī mayā tubhyaṃ śrīmatī pratipāditā ||
sadā karmakarī bhogyā yatheṣṭaṃ bhadram aśnute ||
idam iha dānavākyam |
oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi imāṃ dāsīṃ suvarṇālaṃkāravatīṃ gandhapuṣpādyalaṃkṛtām akṣayasukhaprāptikāmas tubhyam ahaṃ sampradade, na mameti |
oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi etad dāsīdānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dakṣiṇām etat suvarṇaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade, na mameti |
pañcavarṣādhikā sā tu catvāriṃśatsamāvadhiḥ |
[641]        dāsī dvijāya dātavyā dāsadāne ‘py ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
datvā kṣamāpayet paścād brāhmaṇaṃ vastrakāñcanaiḥ |
anugatvā tu sīmāyāṃ dvijaṃ visarjayet tataḥ ||
evaṃ datvā mahārāja kṛtakṛtyo bhavet pumān |
iha loke pare caiva saptajanmāny akhaṇḍitaḥ ||
gṛhakarmakarīṃ dadyāt taruṇīṃ rūpaśālinīm |
bahudravopasaṃyuktāṃ grāmaveśmasamanvitām ||
dāsīṃ samīkṣya bahuśo gṛhakarmadakṣāṃ
yo brāhmaṇāya kulaśīlavate dadāti |
vidyādarādhipatibhis tv abhipūjito ‘sau
martyaḥ prayāti svajanaiḥ saha viṣṇulokam ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
dāsīṃ dadyād yathāśakti mūlyenālaṃkṛtāṃ śubhām |
suvarṇarajataiḥ sārdhaṃ vidhivad dakṣiṇāyutām ||
vittānusārāt tāṃ datvā viprāya gṛhamedhine |
modate ‘psarasāṃ loke yāvat kalpaśatatrayam ||
iti dāsīdānavidhiḥ |
atha kālottare |
yo ‘laṃkṛtya striyaṃ śaṃbhor uttamāṃ vinivedayet |
so ‘śvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet ||
[642]        suvinītāṃ striyaṃ dāsīṃ bhṛtakāryaṃ nivedayet |
naramedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet ||
iti śivāya dāsīdānavidhiḥ |
atha rathadānam | kūrmapurāṇe |
rathaṃ caturbalīvardai rūḍhaṃ dhānyāvṛtaṃ tridhā |
vittānusārāt sarvaiś ca rathopakaraṇair yutam ||
sadakṣiṇaṃ ca viprāya datvā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
dhānyavṛtam iti – aṣṭādaśadānyāni paribhāṣāyāṃ vyākhyātāni | tridheti tridvyekasuvarṇadakṣiṇānusārād uttamamadhyamakaniṣṭhabhedena traividhyaṃ rathopakaraṇāni yugayoktrapratodavaratrādīni |
tara dānavākyam |
adya amukasagotrāyetyādi caturbalīvardair yuktaṃ aṣṭādaśadhānyaparivṛtaṃ sakalasvopaskarayutam etaṃ rathaṃ viśvakarmadaivataṃ niratyayasvargādisukhakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
amukasagotrāyetyādi etadrathadānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dakṣiṇām idaṃ suvarṇaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
[643]
skandapurāṇe |
rathāya rathanāthāya namas te viśvakarmaṇe |
viśvabhūtāya nāthāya aruṇāya namo namaḥ ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
gantrīṃ turaṅgasaṃyuktāṃ yo dadāti dvijātaye |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sa rājā jāyate bhuvi ||
gantrī nāma rathaviśeṣaḥ |
sacakrākhyāṃ yugopetāṃ mattavāraṇabhūṣitām |
āstīrṇavṛkṣāstaraṇāṃ yoktrayuktāṃ sakūvarāṃ ||
yuktāṃ caturbhis turagair dvābhyāṃ vā śaktito yutām |
balivardayutāṃ cāpi dvijāya pratipādayet ||
puṇye ‘hni vipram āhūya kṛtvā vastrādibhūṣitām |
sadakṣiṇāṃ yathāśaktyā dadyāt prayatamānasaḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
gantrīm imāṃ prayacchāmi viśvakarmādhidaivatām |
dānenānena bhagavān prīyatāṃ me paraḥ pumān ||
evaṃ pradāya vidhivad gantrīṃ mantreṇa mānavaḥ |
vimānenārkavarṇena devavad divi modate ||
iha loke bhaved rājā balavān dharmavatsalaḥ |
[644] mahābhārate |
pradānaṃ sarvadānānāṃ śakaṭasya viśiṣyate |
evam āha mahābhāgaḥ śāṇḍilyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ ||
śakaṭaṃ damyasaṃyuktaṃ yo dadyāt tu dvijātaye |
tasya svarge vimānaṃ tu sarvahemamayaṃ śubham ||
divyāṅganābhir ākīrṇaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam |
upatiṣṭhati viprendra sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
iti rathadānavidhiḥ |
atha rathadānaprasaṅgena śivikādānam ucyate | vahnipurāṇe |
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
śṛṇu cānyat mahīpāla mahādānam anuttamam |
yena vai dattamātreṇa mucyate narakārṇavāt ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe pakṣe samupoṣya harer dinam |
māghaphālgunayor vāpi vaiśākhasya śaratsu ca ||
dvādaśyāṃ harim abhyarcya kalaśoparisaṃsthitam |
śaṅgaśārṅgagadācakradharaṃ śaktyā hiraṇmayam ||
śivikāṃ vakravaṃśotthām ṛjudārumayīm atha |
ānīya saṃnidhiṃ viṣṇoḥ śubhachatrasamanvitām ||
saṃbhūṣya ca sa tāṃ bhūṣāṃ jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
[645]        vidyābhijanasaṃpannaṃ vidagdhaṃ śāstravittamam ||
ājñāsāraṃ śuciṃ dakṣaṃ kalatrāpatyabhūṣitam |
prātaḥ sabhāryam abhyarcya vāsobhiḥ karṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
upānacchūrikākhaḍgapaṭṭakañcukaveṇikā |
ādarśasthagikāpānapātraṃ ca kāṃsyabhājanam ||
catvāro vṛṣabhā deyā dhenavaś ca sulakṣaṇāḥ |
śivikāvāhanānāṃ tu tathaiva chatradhāriṇaḥ ||
vṛttir deyā tathānnaṃ ca varṣārhaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca |
varṣe varṣe punar deyaṃ brāḥmaṇasyaitad eva tu ||
vṛttir eva tv asampattau varṣe varṣe ‘pi vārṣikī |
ihāmutrātapatrāṇaṃ kuru keśava me prabho ||
chatraṃ tvatprītaye dattaṃ brāhmaṇāya mayā śubham |
deva deva jagannātha viśvātman dattayānayā |
prabho śivikayā deva prīto bhava janārdana ||
iti dānamantraḥ |
datvā tu jñānaviduṣe sapatnīkāya putriṇe |
surāpaḥ stenakṛt saṅgī brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ ||
śivikādānamāhātmyāt mucyate pāpakāt sphuṭam |
pitṛpakṣaṃ mātṛpakṣaṃ patnīpakṣaṃ tathaiva ca |
ātmānaṃ bandhupakṣaṃ ca tārayen narakārṇavāt ||
[646]        bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogān ihāmutrasukhapradān |
sapatnīkaḥ sapitṛko viṣṇusāyujyam aśnute ||
iti śivikādānavidhiḥ |
atha kramaprāptasya mahādānasyātidānaprakaraṇe nirūpitatvāt rathadānānantaraṃ gṛhadānam ārabhyate | tatra saṃvartaḥ |
gṛhadātā sukhī prājño vitṛṣṇaḥ sarvavastuṣu |
prajñāsukhavivṛddhyarthaṃ pātre deyam ato gṛham ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
rasānnopaskarayutaṃ gṛhaṃ viprāya yo ‘rpayet |
na hīyate tasya vaṃśaḥ svargaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam ||
vedavyāsaḥ |
sarvakāmaiḥ susaṃpūṛnaṃ datvā veśma hiraṇmayam |
mudgalāya gataḥ svargaṃ śatadyumno mahāmatiḥ ||
sarvaratnaṃ vṛṣāḥ darbhā yuvāno ‘śvāḥ priyāḥ striyaḥ |
ramyāvasathaṃ caiva datvāmuṃ lokam āsthitaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
naiveśikaṃ sarvaguṇopapannaṃ
dadāti yaś caiva naro dvijāya |
[647]        svādhyāyacāritryaguṇāya rājaṃs
tasyāpi lokāḥ kurujāṅgaleṣu ||
bījair aśūnyaṃ śayanair upetaṃ
dadyād gṛhaṃ yaḥ puruṣo dvijāya |
mukhyābhirāmaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ
labhed adhiṣṭhānavaraṃ sa rājan ||
tathā |
yas tu naiveśikaṃ śuddhaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati |
triṃśatkoṭyo ‘tha varṣāṇāṃ svargaloke mahīyate ||
tato ‘vatīrṇaḥ kālena mānuṣaṃ lokam āgataḥ |
nagarādhipatiḥ śrīmān rājarājo bhavet dhruvam ||
āha vyāsaḥ |
gṛhaṃ dīpaprabhodyotaśayanāsanabhājanaiḥ |
upaskaraiś ca saṃpūrṇaṃ sarvadhānyaprapūritam ||
sarvadhānyāny uktāni | upaskarāḥ mañcakatūlikopadhānāsanakāṃsyādibhājanadīpikāpeṣaṇayantra-dhānyādimānabhāṇḍadaṇḍolūkhalamuṣalamṛṇmayasthālīkalaśavāridhānīśūrpavyajanachatropānaha-khaḍgāsiputrikāsaṃmārjanīgobalīvardāś ca mahiṣītaṇḍulaghṛtatailapūrṇapātradātravastracandanādi-gandhadravyatāmbūlopaskaraṇakāṣṭhacullīdāsadāsīprabhṛtayaḥ |
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya suśīlāya dadāti yaḥ |
tathādhyayanaśīlāya śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam ||
devaiḥ pitṛgaṇair yukto brahmarṣimanujarṣibhiḥ |
[648]        tṛptā varṣaśatāny eva daśatiṣṭhanty anāmayāḥ ||
tasmād iha samāgatya saptadvīpādhipo bhavet |
bahuprado bahudhano dvujo vā vedapāragaḥ ||
garuḍapurāṇe |
aiṣṭakaṃ dāravaṃ vāpi mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ |
sarvopaskaraṇopetaṃ yo dadyād vipulaṃ gṛham ||
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya viduṣe ca kuṭumbine |
krīḍitvā suciraṃ svarge mānuṣyaṃ lokam āgataḥ |
bhavaty avyāhataiśvaryaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
śaktitaḥ sarvavittena pūrṇaṃ gṛham api tridhā |
sadakṣiṇaṃ dvije datvā brahmalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
sarvavittena, sarvopaskareṇety arthaḥ | tridhā, pūrvavad uttamamadhyamādibhedena |
brahmavaivatra-vahanipurāṇayoḥ |
na gārhasthyāt paro dharmo naiva dānaṃ gṛhāt param |
nānṛtād adhikaṃ pāpaṃ na pūjyo brāhmaṇāt paraḥ ||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaṃ kalatrāpatyasaṃkulam |
gogajāśvagaṇākīrṇaṃ gṛhaṃ svargād viśiṣyate ||
yathā mātaram āśritya sarve jīvanti jantavaḥ |
evaṃ gṛhastham āśritya sarve jīvanti cāśramāḥ ||
[649]        dharmam arthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca miśrāś ca prathitaṃ yaśaḥ |
prāptakāmair narai rājan sadā sevyo gṛhāśramaḥ ||
na gṛheṇa vinā dhārmān nārthakāmau sukhaṃ na ca |
lokayātrā yaśaḥ svargaḥ prāpyate rājasattama ||
na svarge nāpavargeṣu na cānyeṣv api dhāmasu |
prasārya pādau yad rātrau svagṛhe svapatāṃ sukham ||
dināni tāni gaṇyante yāni yānti gṛhāśrame |
api śākaṃ pacānasya svagṛhe paramaṃ sukham ||
iti matvā mahārāja kārayitvā suśobhanam |
bhavanaṃ brāhmaṇe deyaṃ mahatīṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
gṛhaṃ kṛtvā śubhastambhaṃ bahucitraṃ suśobhanam |
saprākārapratolīlaṃ kapāṭārgalayantritam ||
sudhāvaliptaṃ caturaṃ vistīrṇagaṇaśobhitam |
śubhapraveśaniṣkāśam upakāryādisaṃyutam ||
mattavāraṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ gavākṣādivibhūṣitam |
datvā dvijātimukhyāya na śocati kṛtākṛte ||
matsyapurāṇe |
pakveṣṭakāmayaṃ kṛtvā śailajaṃ vāpi dārujam |
mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi bhavanaṃ śubhalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||
prabhūtabalipuṣpāḍyaṃ dhenvā caiva samanvitam |
[650]        arjunaiḥ saralaiḥ sālair anyaiś caiva manoramaiḥ ||
timiṣaiḥ sarjavṛkṣaiś ca kadambaiḥ saha vañjulaiḥ |
śubhasthānasamutpannair vāstulakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||
sthāpanaṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ bhūmeś caiva tu śobhanam |
mārjanaṃ siñcanaṃ caiva santānīyena kārayet ||
maṅgalyānupahārāṃś ca vāstuvidyoditāṃs tathā. |
devatāpañcakaṃ tatra catvāriṃśatsamanvitam |
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ tato dadyād gṛhaṃ gṛhī ||
vāstulakṣaṇaṃ pañcacatvāriṃśaddevatāḥ | kramaś ca tasminn eva purāṇe |
ekāśītipadaṃ kṛtvā reṇubhiḥ kanakena ca |
paścāt piṣṭenānulimpet sūtreṇāloḍya sarvataḥ ||
daśapūrvāparā rekhā daś caivottarāyatāḥ |
sarvavāstuvibhāgeṣu vijñeyā navakā na ca ||
ekāśītipadaṃ kṛtvā vāstuvit sarvavāstuṣu |
padasthān pūjayed devāṃs triṃśatpañcadaśaiva tu |
dvātriṃśad bāhyataḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyāś cāntas trayodaśa ||
atraivaṃ prayogaḥ |
pūrvaṃ tāvad amedhyaśmaśānādirahitām anūṣarāṃ śubhavarṇagandhādilakṣaṇānvitāṃ caturasrāṃ prāgudakpravaṇāṃ bhūmiṃ parīkṣya gomayādi[651]nopalipya tatra sudhāliptāni samāntarālāni daśasūtrāṇi pātayet | tathaiva daśa dakṣiṇottarāyatāni tataś ca navakoṣṭhakāsu navapaṅktiṣu sarvam ekāśītipadaṃ maṇḍalaṃ saṃpadyate (?), tatra madhyamakoṣṭhanavakam utsṛjya navakam eva padaṃ vidadhyāt tatpūrvasthitaṃ ca pārśvasthitakoṣṭhadvayābhyām ekīkuryāt | āgneyyaṃ tv ekam eva | evaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimottarāṇi trīṇi trīṇy ekīkṛtya koṇeṣv ekaikaṃ pariśiṣya brahmasthānasya paridhiṃ niṣpādayet | bāhyataś ceśānādikoṇeṣv ekakoṣṭhakāny eva catvāri catvāri padāni pariśiṣya prācyādidikṣu loṣṭhakāni śreṇībhūtāni pañca pañca padāni vidadhyāt | tataś ca pañca catvāriṃśat padāni niṣpadyante |
madhye navapadas tv ekaḥ catvāras tripadāḥ smṛtāḥ |
viṃśatis tv ekapadikās tāvanto dvipadāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
evaṃ pratiṣṭhitā devāś catvāriṃśac ca pañca ca |
nāmatas tān pravakṣyāmi sthānāni ca nibodhata ||
īśānakoṇādisurān pūjayet kramaśo na ca |
śikhī caivātha parjanyo jayantaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ ||
sūryaḥ satyobhṛśaś caiva ākāśo vāyur eva ca |
pūṣāya vitathaś caiva gṛhakṣatayamāv ubhau ||
gandharvo bhṛṅgarājaś ca mṛgaḥ pitṛgaṇas tathā |
dauvāriko ‘tha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadantaś ca vāruṇaḥ ||
āsuraś caiva śoṣaś ca pāpayakṣmāvarogakaḥ |
[652]        bhallāṭhasomanāgau ca aditiś ca ditis tathā ||
phaṇāvān mukhyabhalvāṭau somanāgau tathāparau |
aditiś ca ditiś caiva sthāpyāḥ praṇavanābhibhiḥ ||
bahir dvātriṃśad ete tu tadantaś caturaḥ śṛṇu |
āpaś caivātha śāvitro jayo rudras tathaiva ca ||
aryamā savitā caiva vivasvān vibudhādhipaḥ |
mitro ‘tha rājayakṣmā ca tathā pṛthvīdharaḥ kramāt ||
aṣṭamas tv āpavatsas tu parito brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
atra tāvad dvātriṃśatpade bahiḥparidhau prathamam īśānakoṇe śaśinaṃ saṃsthāpya pradakṣiṇakrameṇa parjanyādidevāṃ sthāpayet | tadantaś catura iti, parjanyāt paścime ekakoṣvake pade āpaḥ, ākāśāt paścime sāvitraḥ dauvārikāt pūrvasmin jayaḥ, āpaḥ pūrvasmin rudra iti bahiḥ paridhir antaś caturo devān sthāpayet parito brahmaṇa iti, madhyapadasthitasya brahmaṇaḥ purastād arymaṇaṃ saṃsthāpya pradakṣiṇakrameṇāṣṭau devān sthāpayet |
athopasaṃharati |
āpaś caivāpavatsaś ca parjanyo ‘gnir ditis tathā |
padikānāṃ tu vargo ‘yam evaṃ koṇeṣv aśeṣataḥ ||
tanmadhye tu barhir viṃśad vipadās te tu sarvataḥ |
aryamā ca vivasvāṃś ca mitraḥ pṛthvīdharas tathā ||
brahmaṇaḥ parito dikṣu tripadāś caiva sarvataḥ |
[653]
padikānām ityādi | ayam ekapadānāṃ pañcānāṃ devānām īśānakoṇe vargaḥ saṃpadyate | evam āgneyādikoṇeṣv api ekapadāḥ pañcadevatā bhavanti tanmadhye barhir iti | koṇamadhye bāhyaparidhau viṃśatidvipadā bhavanti avamādayaś catvāras tripadā madhye brahmā navapada iti evaṃ pañcacatvāriṃśad devān gandhmālyādibhiḥ pūjya vāstuvidyoktaprakāreṇa gṛhārambhaṃ kuryāt | tasminn eva purāṇe |
vāstau parikṣite samyag vāstugehe vicakṣaṇaḥ |
vāstūpaśamanaṃ kuryāt samidbhir balikarma ca ||
jīrṇoddhāre tathādhāne tathā ca navaveśmani |
navaprāsādabhavane prāsādaparivartane ||
dvārābhivartane tadvat prāsādeṣu gṛheṣu ca |
vāstūpaśamanaṃ kuryāt pūrvam eva vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
ekāśītipadaṃ likhya vāstumadhye tu piṣṭakaiḥ |
homas trimekhale kāryaḥ kuṇḍe hastapramāṇake ||
yavaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaiś caiva samidbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣajaiḥ |
pālāśaiḥ khādirair vāpāmārtodumbarasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
kuśadūrvāmayair vāpi madhusarpiḥsamanvitaiḥ |
kāryas tu pañcabhir viprair bilvabījair athāpi vā ||
homānte bhakṣyabhojyais tu vāstudeśe baliṃ haret |
tadvad viśeṣanaivedyam idaṃ dadyāt krameṇa tu ||
īśakoṇe ghṛtāktaṃ tat śikhine vinivedayet |
[654]        odanaṃ sotpalaṃ dadyāt parjanyāya ghṛtānvitam ||
jayantāya dhvajaṃ pītaṃ paiṣṭaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vinyaset |
indrāya pañcaratnāni paiṣṭaṃ ca kuliśaṃ tathā ||
vitānakaṃ ca sūryāya dhūpaṃ saktuṃ tathaiva ca |
satyāya ghṛtagodhūmaṃ matsyān dadyād bhṛśāya ca ||
saṣkulyaṃ cāntarikṣāya dadyāt saktūṃś ca vāyave |
lājāḥ pūṣṇe tu dātavyā vitathe caṇakodanam ||
gṛhakṣatāya madhvannaṃ yamāya piśitaudanam |
gandhaudanaṃ ca gāndharve ghṛṅge meṣasya jihvikām ||
dauvārike dantakāṣṭhaṃ paiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇabaliṃ tathā |
mṛgāya yāvakaṃ dadyāt pitṛbhyaḥ kṛśarāṃs tathā ||
sugrīve pūpakān dadyāt puṣpadantāya pāyasam |
kuśastambena saṃyuktaṃ tathā padmaṃ ca vāruṇe ||
paiṣṭaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ dadyād asurāya surāsavam |
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca śoṣāya yavān vai pāpayakṣmaṇe ||
ghṛtalaḍḍukāṃs tu rogāya nāgapuṣpaṃ phaṇāvate |
bhakṣaṃ mukhyāya dātavyaṃ mudgaudanam ataḥ param ||
bhallāṭasthānake dadyāt somāya madhupāyasam |
nāgāya śālikaṃ piṣṭam aditye lopikās tathā ||
dites tu pūrikāṃ dadyād ity evaṃ bāhyato baliḥ |
kṣauram āpāya dātavyaṃ āpavatsāya vai dadhi ||
sāvitre laḍḍukān dadyāt samarīcaṃ kuśodakam |
savitur guḍapūpāṃś ca jayāya ghṛtacandanam ||
[655]        vivasvate punar dadyād raktacandanapāyasam |
haritālolvanaṃ dadyād indrāya ghṛtasaṃyutam ||
guḍodanaṃ tu mitrāya rudrāya ghṛtapāyasam |
āmapakvaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ deyaṃ syād rājayakṣmaṇe ||
pṛthvīdharāya māṃsāni kūṣmāṇḍāni ca dāpayet |
śarkarāpāyasaṃ dadyād aryamne pānam eva tu ||
pañcagavyaṃ yavāṃś caiva tilākṣatahaviścarum |
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vividhaṃ brahmaṇe vinivedayet ||
evaṃ sampūjitā devāḥ śāntiṃ kurvanti te sadā |
sarveṣāṃ kāñcanaṃ dadyād brahmaṇe gāṃ payasvinīm ||
rākṣasānāṃ balir deyo māṃsodanasamanvitā |
īśāne nāgamātṛbhyaś caruṃ ca vinivedayet ||
māṃsaudanaṃ sarudhiraṃ haridrodanam eva ca |
āgneyīṃ diśam āśritya vidāryai vinivedayet ||
dadhyodanaṃ sarudhiraṃ matsyakaṇḍaiś ca saṃyutam |
pītaraktaṃ baliṃ dadyāt pūtanā yā tu rākṣasī ||
vāyavye pāparākṣasyai matsyaṃ māṃsṃ surāsavam |
pāyasaṃ cāpi dātavyaṃ svanāmnā sarvataḥ kramāt ||
namaskārānuyuktena praṇavādyena sarvataḥ |
prākmāṃsyaudanaṃ skandāya dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathāpara (?) ||
kṛśarāpālikādānam aryamne mūlamantrataḥ |
māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ dadyāj jṛmbhakāya tu paścime ||
pilipicchaye raktāktapiṣṭān antarato ‘pi ca |
[656]        bhakṣyabhojyair digīśānāṃ tanmantraiś ca baliṃ haret ||
sarvāsāṃ pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ yathoktabalyasaṃbhave |
tadabhāve darbhapuṣpair dadhyakṣataghṛtair baliḥ ||
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ maṇḍalān pūrvataḥ kṣitau |
gandhādipūrvakaṃ sarvaṃ bhautikaṃ ca baliṃ haret ||
bhūtebhyo ‘tha pitṛbhyaś ca rākṣasebhyo namo namaḥ |
piśācebhyo ‘tha mātṛbhyo gaṇebhyaś ca pṛthak pṛthak ||
divyāntarikṣabhaumebhyaḥ praṇavādyanamontakaiḥ |
tataḥ sarvauṣadhisnānaṃ yajamānasya kārayet ||
dvijāṃs tu pūjayed bhaktyā ye cānye gṛham āgatāḥ |
etad vāstūpaśamanaṃ kṛtvā karma samācaret ||
prāsādabhavanodyānaprārambhe parivartane |
puraveśmapraveśe ca sarvadoṣopaśāntaye ||
vāstūpaśamanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sūtreṇa veṣṭayet |
rakṣoghnapāvamānena sūktena bhavanādikam ||
nṛtyamaṅgalavādyaiś ca kuryād brāhmaṇavācanam |
anena vidhinā yas tu pratisaṃvatsaraṃ budhaḥ ||
gṛhe vāyatane kuryān na sa duḥkham avāpnuyāt |
na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tasya na ca bandhudhanakṣayaḥ |
jīved varṣaśataṃ svarge kalpam ekaṃ vasen naraḥ ||
atha brahmavaivarte |
kārayitvā gṛhān ramyān ṛtuvasvarkasaṃkhyayā |
[657]        bhuvanāṣṭādaśatriṃśat tattannakṣatrasaṃkhyayā ||
śaktyā taddviguṇāny eva śataṃ yāvat sahasrakam |
kuḍyastambhagavākṣyādyān vicitrān bahubhūmikān ||
saprākārapratolīkān kapāṭārgalayantrakān |
sudhādhavalitān ramyān vistīrṇāṅgaṇavāṭakān ||
saptadhātumayair bhāṇḍaiḥ pañcaratnaiḥ samanvitaiḥ |
carmakāṣṭhamayair hastidantavastramayais tathā ||
mṛṇyayopaskarākīrṇān vastropakaraṇānvitān |
sarvopaskarasaṃbhāraśaṇavalkalarājitān ||
rājitāṃs tṛṇapāṣāṇaiḥ kāṣṭhasaṃcayasaṃyutān |
sarvadhānyasamāyuktaiḥ kuśūlaiś ca virājitān ||
gomahiṣyāśvavṛṣabhapreṣyadāsījanānvitān |
kṣetrārāmajalāsannān dṛḍhān harmyavarān śubhān ||
saṃpūrṇān saptadhānyaiś ca ghṛtatailaguḍādibhiḥ |
tilataṇḍulaśālīkṣumāṣagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ ||
priyaṅguyavanīvāraniṣpāvarājamudgakaiḥ |
masūracaṇakāvartasakuṣṭhakakulotthakaiḥ ||
lavaṇārdrakakharjūradrākṣājīrakadhānyakaiḥ |
hiṅgukuṅkumakarpūrasnānadravaiḥ sacandanaiḥ ||
rūpyopaskaraparyaṅkatūlīgaṇḍopadhānakaiḥ |
cullīcchedanamanthānabhadrāsanakadutthakaiḥ ||
piṭharolūkhalasthālīsūrpadarpaṇayantrakaiḥ |
muṣalāsikṛpāṇīṣudaṇḍakodaṇḍamudgaraiḥ ||
[658]        gṛhaṭatāpikādarvīdṛṣalloṣṭakahastakaiḥ |
carakālakalohīndradīpikāgniṣṭikā ghaṭī ||
kuṇḍanī peṣaṇi tadvad udakumbhapramārjanī |
mañjūṣāliñjarān dolamukhyopasparasaṃyutān ||
śaktyā svarṇasahasreṇa śatenārdhārdhasaṃyutān |
yathāśaktyā rūpyayutān kṛtān nirmalacetasā ||
ityevamādisaṃpūrṇān gṛhān dadyād dhitādiṣu ||
vahnipurāṇe |
kartuś candrabalopete sthiranakṣatrasaṃyute |
śubhe ‘hni viprakathite dānakālaḥ praśasyate ||
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ pūrṇimāyām athāpi vā |
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā dvijottamān ||
kulaśīlasamāyuktān śatasaṃkhyān nimantayet |
adhītavedaśāstrajñān purāṇasmṛtipāragān ||
gṛhadharmaratān dāntān nisvān bahukuṭumbinaḥ |
nirāśrayāṃs tathā rājaṃs tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ||
alaṃkṛtya sapatnīkān vastrābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ |
kṛtvāgniyajanaṃ bhūyo vāstuṃ pūjya vidhānataḥ ||
samuccarann idaṃ dātā vidadhīta gatasmayaḥ |
jagadīśo gṛhāvāso govindaḥ prīyatām iti ||
brahmavaivarte |
gṛhāṅgaṇe kārayitvā kuṇḍam ekaṃ samekhalam |
[659]        gṛhayajñaḥ prakartavyas tuṣṭipuṣṭikaraḥ sadā ||
gṛhayajñavidhānaṃ tu vrakhaṇḍe vilokanīyam |
rakṣoghnāni ca sūktāni paṭheyur brāhmaṇās tataḥ |
vāstoḥ pūjā prakartavyā dikpālānāṃ baliṃ kṣipet ||
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa brāhmaṇās teṣu veśmasu |
praveśayitvā śayyāsu sabhāryāsūpaveśayet ||
yajamānas tataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ |
yad yasya vihitaṃ pūrvaṃ tat tasmai pratipādayet ||
atredaṃ dānavākyam |
oṃ adya amukasagotrāyetyādi idaṃ gṛhaṃ śayanāsanabhājanopaskarayutaṃ sarvadhānyaprapūritaṃ sarvadaivatam amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mamety uktvā idaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhāṇetyādivakṣyamāṇamantraṃ paṭhet |
oṃ adyāmukasatorāyetyādi etad gṛhadānapratiṣṭḥārthaṃ dakṣiṇām idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
dakṣiṇāsaṃkhyā tu śaktyā svarṇasahasreṇetyādinā darśitaiva | pratigrahītā svastīty uktvākodād iti yajurvedaprasiddhaṃ mantram udāharet |
idaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
tava vipra prasādena mamāstv abhimataṃ phalam ||
evam ekaikaśo datvā praṇipatya samarpayet |
svastīti brāhmaṇair vācyaṃ kodād iti ca pūjitaiḥ ||
bṛhaspatismṛtau punar ayaṃ mantraḥ |
gṛhaṃ mama vibhūtyarthaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dvijottama |
[660]        prīyatāṃ me jagadyonir vāsturūpī janārdana ||
matsyapurāṇe |
prāpte dānadine kāryam aiśānyāṃ hastasaṃmitam |
caturasraṃ samaṃ kuṇḍamekhalāyonibhūṣitam ||
pūrvottare hastimitā ca vedī
gṛhādideveśvarapūjanāya |
arcorcanaṃ brahmaśivācyutānāṃ
sūryasya kāryaṃ phalapuṣpagandhaiḥ ||
brahmādipratimālakṣaṇam uktaṃ tulāpuruṣe |
dvāreṣu kāryāṇi ca toraṇāni
patrair api kṣīravanaspatīnām |
madhye ca saṃsthāpya ca pūrṇakumbhaṃ
sraggandhadhūpāmbararatnayuktam ||
gṛhyoktena vidhānena kṛtvā cāgnimukhaṃ tataḥ |
gavyena payasā divyaṃ sthālīpākaṃ caruṃ śrapet ||
tataś ca tām caiva caruṃ juhomi
madhyasthitābhyo gṛhadevatābhyaḥ |
baliṃ ca samyag vidhisaṃprayogāt
kṣīreṇa dhārāparitas tu dadyāt ||
brāhmaṇam arcayet pūrvaṃ parituṣṭaṃ kṣamāpayet |
śayyāṃ dakṣiṇābhāge tu sopadhānāṃ sadīpikām |
sitavastraiś ca saṃchannāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇānvitām ||
[661] lakṣmīnārāyaṇalakṣaṇaṃ devatādānaprakaraṇe lakṣmīnārāyaṇadāne vakṣyate, tadrūpaṃ ca suvarṇamayaṃ yathāśakti nirmāya,
sitāmbaraṃ kuṇḍalahemabhūṣitaṃ
keyūrakaṇṭhābharaṇābhirāmam |
patnīsametaṃ ca kare gṛhītvā
dātā paṭhen mantram imaṃ gṛhasthaḥ ||
ehy ehi nārāyaṇa divyarūpa
sarvāmarair vanditapādapadma |
śubhāśubhānandasudhāma dhīra
lakṣmīyutas tvaṃ hi gṛhaṃ gṛhāṇa ||
namaḥ kaustubhanāthāya hiraṇyakavacāya ca |
kṣīrodārṇavasuptāya jagaddhātre namo namaḥ ||
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya jagannāthāya vai namaḥ |
carācarasya jagato gṛhabhūtāya vai namaḥ ||
bhūrlokapramukhālokās tava dehe vyavsthitāḥ |
nandanti yāvat kalpāntaṃ tathā tasmin bhavān gṛhī ||
tvatprasādena deveśa putraiḥ pautrair yuto gṛhī |
pañcayajñakriyāyukto vased ācandratārakam ||
evam uktvā tu deveśaṃ sapatnīkaṃ dvijottamam |
tilaprasthoparisthāyāṃ śayyāyām upaveśya ca ||
vaded idaṃ tato vākyaṃ sarvadhānyayutaṃ tv idam |
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhṇa dvijottama ||
tatropaskaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ dāmpatyasya nivedayet |
[662]        pādukopānahachatrabhūṣaṇāsanabhājanaiḥ ||
saṃpannaṃ cārthasaṃpannaṃ gṛhyopaskarabhūṣaṇam |
sarvasaṃpūrṇam evāstu paṭhitvaivaṃ nivedayet ||
brahmavaivarte |
gṛhopaskaraṇais tulyāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ bhavanaṃ vinā |
upadeṣṭur apīcchanti tanmūlatvān maharṣayaḥ ||
suyatīn pūjayitvā tu tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet |
dadyād anena vidhinā bahūny ekam atho gṛham ||
sasaṃkhyāniyamaḥ kāryaḥ śaktir atra niyāmikā |
śītavātātapaharaṃ datvā tṛṇakūṭorakam ||
iṣṭān kāmān avāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate |
ṛgnitaṃ (?) vā yajurmadhyasāmasvaravibhūṣitā ||
atyantasukhalabdhena deyā brahmapurī priyā |
gobhūhiraṇyadānāni niyamāḥ saṃyamās tathā |
gṛhadānasya kaunteya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
vahnipurāṇe |
evaṃ datvā gṛhaṃ rājan sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
naro viṣṇupuraṃ yāti sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ ||

kālād iha samāyāto rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
punar viṣṇupuraṃ labdhā saptajanmani pārthivaḥ |
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyur nirupadravaḥ ||
[663]        putrapautrato lakṣmyā viyogarahitaḥ sukhī |
bhaven naro mahārāja gṛhaṃ tasmāt pradīyate ||
matsyapurāṇe |
ya evaṃ sarvasaṃpannaṃ pakveṣṭaṃ vinidayet (?) |
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvad brahmaloke mahīyate ||
śailajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi yo dadyād vidhipūrvakam |
vaset kṣīrārṇave ramye nārāyaṇasamīpataḥ ||
mṛṇmayaṃ caiva yo dadyād gṛhaṃ copaskarānvitam |
pureṣu lokapālānāṃ prītyā manvantaraṃ vaset ||
kalikaluṣavimuktaḥ pūjitaḥ saiddhasaṅghair
amaracarasālāvījyamāno ‘psarobhiḥ |
pitṛśatam api bandhūn putrapautraprapautrān
api narakanimagnāṃs tārayed eka eva ||
divyabhogāṃs tato bhuktvā rājrājo bhaved bhuvi |
nārāyaṇabalopeto nārāyaṇaparāyanaḥ |
nārāyanakathāsakto jīved varṣaśataṃ sukhī ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |

divyāpsarobhir abhinanditacittavṛttiḥ
prāpnoty asāv anupasaṃpadam indumauleḥ ||
[664]
iti gṛhadānavidhiḥ |
sumantur uvāca |
mṛṇmayaṃ dārujaṃ śailaṃ pakveṣṭakam athāpi vā |
kṛtvānantagṛhaṃ vāpi yathāvibhavasaṃbhavāt ||

bhakṣyaprakalpitānekatṛṇādhāravadaṇḍakam ||
