kṛtakūpanipānādijalāśayaniveśanam |
avakaratiraskārakārikarmakarānvitam ||
[665]        tṛṇodakādinirvāhakṣamakalpitavṛttikam |
evaṃvidhaṃ mahāramyaṃ prākāradvārabhūṣitam ||
kṛtvā gṛhaṃ gavām arthe yaḥ parvaṇi nivedayet |
sa rājarājo bhavati bhāgyārogyasamanvitaḥ ||
surabhīlokam āsādya divyabhogasamanvitam |
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ tato mānuṣyam āgataḥ |
dhanarūpasamāyuktaḥ kule mahati jāyate ||
iti gogṛhadānam |
athāśrayadānam | tatra kālikāpurāṇe |
śaṅkarāt paramaṃ nānyad atas tasmai vikalpayet |
yatīnām āśrayaṃ vāpi kṛtvā pakveṣṭakāmayam ||
vikalpaḥ | saṃkalpaḥ |
suśīlaṃ cārunirvātaṃ paricārasamanvitam |
vyākhyāmaṇḍapasaṃyuktam āsanair vividhair yutam ||
puṣpodyānasamāyuktaṃ sodakaṃ śaṅkarālayam |
grāmaṃ dīpendhanādyarthaṃ preṣyāṇāṃ caiva cetane ||
kaupīnopānahādyartham āśraye viniyojayet |
tato ‘bhyarcya yatīn bhaktyā bhojayitvā viśeṣataḥ ||
vajraiś caiva prapūjyeśaṃ bhaktyā tebhyo nivedayet |
[666]        prīyatāṃ me mahādevaś candramaulir maheśvaraḥ ||
ity uktvā puṇyadivase datvā caivātra dakṣiṇām |
anenāśrayadānena sarvakāmayuto naraḥ |
tasmiṃs tv amaralokānāṃ bhogān gacchet tadalayam ||
tadālayaṃ śaṅkarālayam | śaivapurāṇe |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ liṅgam ucyate |
prāsāde sthāvaraṃ karyaṃ jaṅgamaṃ tu maṭhe hitam ||
sthāvarāj jaṅgamaṃ śreṣṭham iti prāhur maharṣayaḥ |
dikṣādisthāpanaṃ caiva jñānakriyāprakāśanam ||
jaṅgamāt tu pravarteta tenādhikyaṃ tu jaṅgame |
tasmāj jaṅgamaliṅgebhyo vidyāpīṭhasya guptaye ||
kārayitvā maṭhaṃ divyaṃ śuddhaśaileṣṭakāmayam |
śayanāsanasaṃyuktaṃ puṣpārāmādiśobhanam ||
śraddhayā parayopetaṃ puṇyakāle samutsṛjet ||
brahmavaivarte maṭhadānam adhikṛtyāha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
yāvat saṃtiṣṭhate bhūmau sa maṭhe janasevite |
tāvadvarṣapramāṇena kartā ca śubhabhāg bhavet ||
yaḥ kārayen maṭhaṃ śailaṃ śivāyatanasaṃnidhau |
[667]        sa śaivaṃ padam āsādya kalpāyutaśataṃ vaset ||
tasmāt puṇyakṣayād etat pṛthivīm īśvarapriyaḥ |
labhed dīrghātur ārogyaṃ saṃpad aiśvaryasantatim ||
tretāyuge nṛpādhīśaḥ sahasrakratukṛd bhavet |
viṣṇor āyatane puṇye saṃnidhau kārayen maṭham |
yaḥ saḥ syāt sakalaiśvaryasaṃpadām ālayaḥ sadā ||
bhagavatīpurāṇe |
vijayāyaiva kartavyaṃ puṇyārāmamaṭhādikam |
sajalaṃ kārayet tasmān maṭhārāmādikaṃ naraḥ ||
kṛtvā maṭhaṃ prayatnena śayanāsanasaṃyutam |
puṇyakāle dvijebhyo ‘tha yatibhyo vā nivedayet ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti niṣkāmo mokṣam āpnuyāt ||
brahmaprokte |
maṭhaṃ pratiśrayaṃ vāpi sarvopakaraṇair yutam |
kārayitvā dvijātibhyaḥ puṇyakāle samutsṛjet ||
tasya puṇyakṛtā lokā kṣīyante na kadācana ||
agastyaḥ |
sarvakāmam avāpnoti tasya saṃpadyate sadā |
devāyatanakartā ca yatīnām āśrayasya ca ||
sattramaṇḍapakārī ca krīḍan vāpi gṛhottamaiḥ ||
[668] devīpurāṇe |
prāsādamaṇḍapagṛhe maṭhe citraśilātale |
uḍhato paṭṭaśālāyāṃ sarve saṃpūjayanti ye ||
svarāmāntarjalopetaṃ maṭhaṃ bhūmitrayocchritam |
śāntidhāmāgniprakhyena vidyākośajapādibhiḥ ||
yuktaṃ devāya dātavyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam |
mahāpāpāriśamanaṃ samastabhūmalāpaham ||
rājyāyuḥsutasaubhāgyavardhanaṃ kīrtanaṃ tathā |
vijalaṃ naiva kurvanti maṭhārāmavivarjitam ||
sarveṣāṃ vidhnadaṃ kartuṃ nṛpa lokabhayāvahaṃ |
tathā |
devāyatanakoṭisthaṃ kuryād dhemāṇḍabhūṣaṇam |
ekaṃ sarveśvaraṃ dhāma kṛtaṃ tasyādhikaṃ phalam ||
gaṅgodake ca yat puṇyaṃ snātvā ca parikīrtitam |
tat puṇyaṃ svajanaiḥ snāpya tām īśānagatiṃ labhet ||
skandapurāṇe maṭhadānam adhikṛtyāha |
yaḥ kārayen mahad ramyaṃ suvedīsaṃsthitaṃ maṭham |
pañcabhaumaṃ tribhaumaṃ vā śivajñānaratātmanām ||
guhyāpavarakair yuktaṃ mantrasthānasamanvitam |
vāstuvidyāvibhaktaṃ ca prākāraparivāritam ||
dhūmanirgamanopetaṃ pūrvataḥ satramaṇḍalam |
gandhapuṣpagṛhaṃ kāryam aiśānyāṃ maṭhasaṃyutam ||
bhāṇḍāgāraṃ ca kauveryāṃ koṣṭhāgāraṃ ca vāyave |
[669]        jalāśayaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ vātāyānasamanvitam ||
samitkuśendhanasthānam āyudhānāṃ ca naiṛtau |
abhyāgatālayaṃ caiva ramyaṃ śayyāsamanvitam ||
toyāgnidīpasaṃbhutair yuktaṃ dakṣiṇato bhavet |
gṛhāntarāṇi sarvāṇi sajalaiḥ kadalīgṛhaiḥ ||
pañcavarṇaiś ca kusumaiḥ śobhitāni prakalpayet |
prākāraṃ ca bahir dadyāt pañcahastapramāṇataḥ ||
prākārāc ca bahiḥ kuryāt sarvadikṣu samantataḥ |
divyaṃ śivāśrayaṃ rāmaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam ||
sarvartukusumopetaṃ nānāvṛkṣasamanvitam |
priyaṅguśikharāśokaputrajīvakariṣṭakaiḥ ||
punnāgavakulaiś caiva pāṭalābilvacampakaiḥ |
śvetamandāravijayair jātītagarakuṣṭhakaiḥ ||
suvarṇaśvetayūthībhir varṇāmlānakuraṇṭakaiḥ |
karavīraiḥ karṇikārair nānāvarṇair anekaśaḥ ||
sthānavinyāsacaritaiḥ sanmārgādhārasaṃyutaiḥ |
vṛkṣair bahuvidhair yuktaṃ digvidikṣu jalānvitam ||
sitaratnāñjakusumair nīlaraktotpalair yutam |
latāvitānagṛhakaiḥ kvacit kvacid avasthitaiḥ ||
kadalaiḥ stambhakhaṇḍaiś ca dāḍimādyair virājitam |
iti kṛtvāvahistasya prākāraṃ kārayen mahat ||
kapāṭgopuropetaṃ parikhāvaṭasaṃyutam |
tṛtīyāc ca purād ūrdhvaṃ vidyāvyākhyānamaṇḍapam ||
[670]        gavākṣinirgamopetaṃ vicitraṃ parikalpayet |
purāc ca pañcamaṃ kāryaṃ śivasya vasato gṛham ||
ṣaṭhastam aṣṭahastaṃ vā dārupaṭṭavinimitam |
tatra mṛddāruśailaṃ vā sthāpayed vidhivac chivam ||
sarvavidyāvidhātāraṃ sarvajñaṃ kulam īśvaram |
vṛtaṃ śiṣyapraśiṣyaiś ca vyākhyānodyatapāṇikam ||
padmāsanasthaṃ suśvetaṃ prasannavadanaṃ guruṃ |
evaṃ śivāśramaṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ ||
tatpratiṣṭhāṃ tataḥ kuryāt pūjālaṃkāralakṣaṇām |
vidyādānoktavibhavaiḥ śobhāṃ kṛtvā maṭhāgrataḥ ||
pañcabhiḥ pañcagavyais taṃ sthāpyaiśānyāṃ diśi kramāt |
snāpayed gandhatoyādyaiḥ śivaśāstrapariśrutaiḥ ||
tūryaghoṣais tam ānīya sthāpayet puṣpamaṇḍape |
tataś candanapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvādhivāsayet ||
japtvā pañcavidhaṃ stotraṃ śivaṃ vijñāpayet tataḥ |
adyādhivāsanaṃ deva śvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhavet tava ||
bhaktānām anukampārthaṃ sāṃnidhyam upakalpayet |
prātaḥ saṃsnāpya deveśaṃ pūjayitvā praveśayet ||
pavitraiḥ sthāpayed vedyāṃ pādād ārabhya pañcabhiḥ |
tataḥ sagandhagandhādyair nityaṃ śodhyaṃ śivālayam ||
śivaṃ ca pūjayet puṣpaiḥ snānavastrayugānvitaiḥ |
saśiyastaṃ praṇamyeśaṃ gurur vyākhyāṃ pravartayet ||
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi puṇyāhārthaṃ śivāgrataḥ |
[671]        tataḥ saṃpūjayed bhaktyā yajamānaḥ svayaṃ gurum ||
dakṣiṇābhir vicitrābhir bhojanādyaiś ca pūjayet |
nivedayet tataḥ sthānaṃ sarveṣāṃ śivayoginām ||
sarvopakaraṇo ‘py etaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kārayed āḍhyaḥ śrīmacchivapuraṃ mahat ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate |
svagotraviṃśakopetaḥ sabhṛtyaparivāritaḥ ||
putramitrādisaṃyuktaḥ śāntaḥ puraparicchadaḥ |
suvicitrair mahāyānair asāṃkhyaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ ||
śivavat krīḍate bhogair aṇimādiguṇair yutaḥ |
tataḥ kālena mahatā vidyādānaprabhāvataḥ ||
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya tatraiva pratimucyate |
sthapatisthāpakā vṛkṣā balīvardāś ca karmiṇaḥ ||
yānti rudrapuraṃ sarve tadadhyakṣāś ca ye narāḥ |
ye cānye vṛttibhṛtakāḥ śivāyatana karmiṇaḥ |
te ‘pi yāti mṛtāḥ svargaṃ śivakarmānubāvataḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
kārayitvā dṛḍhasstmbhaṃ śubhaṃ pakveṣṭakāmayam |
maṭhaṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhābham ābhāsitadigantaram ||
sudhāniliptaṃ guptaṃ ca sukhaśālāvirājitam |
dadyād anantaphaladaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām ||
[672] vārāhapurāṇe |
tribhaumaṃ vā dvibhaumaṃ vā kuryād athekabhūmikam |
maṭhaṃ vicitraśālāḍhyaṃ virājaṃ mattavāraṇam ||
dhyānādhyayanahomādivyākhyānasthānabhūṣitam |
sudhayā vā śilābhir vā samam akliptabhūmikam ||
vinyastapustakādhārabhūtanūtanasaṃkulam |
nānāphalākulodyānarājimaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ||
nirmalasvādupānīyasusaṃbhṛtajalāśrayam |
yatīnāṃ pathikānāṃ ca nivāsam upaseduṣām ||
pādukopānahachatrakaupīnendhanavāsasām |
upayogipadārthānām anyeṣām api labdhaye ||
grāmaṃ vā vipulāṃ bhūmiṃ pradadyāc chraddhayānvitaḥ |
evaṃ samāśrayaṃ kṛtvā tāpasānāṃ hitāvaham ||
anyeṣām api lokānāṃ duḥkhinām āśrayārthinām |
samāśrayaṃ prayacchāmi prīyatāṃ me jagannidhiḥ ||
evaṃ datvā mahārājan suvicitraṃ samāśrayam |
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
śivaṃ viṣṇupure sthitvā tadrūpabalavikramaḥ |
bhogān api bahūn bhuktvā paraṃ nirvāṇam ṛcchati ||
yaḥ kārayed iti vicitraviśālaśāla
mālākulaṃ rucirakuḍyavitānayuktam |
divyāṅganāparivṛto ‘tha bhaven murāreḥ
pāre bhavārṇavajalasya sa saukhyam eti ||
[673]
ity āśrayadānam |
atha pratiśrayadānam | tatra bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pratiśraye suvistīrṇe kārite sajalendhane |
dīnānāthajanārthāya tataḥ kiṃ na kṛtaṃ bhavet ||
vahnipurāṇe |
kārayitvā dṛḍhastambhaṃ śubhaṃ pakveṣṭakāmayam |
pratiśrayaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ subhūmiṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ||
sudhānuliptaṃ guptaṃ ca sukhaśālāvirājitam |
dadyād anantaphaladaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām ||
pratiśrayaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ sadannaṃ sujalānvitam |
dīnānāthajanārthāya kārayitvā gṛhaṃ śubham |
nivedayet pathisthebhyaḥ śubhadvāraṃ manoharam ||
devīpurāṇe |
śakra uvāca |
purasya paścime bhāge dakṣiṇe cottare ‘tha vā |
pūrve vā madhyato vāpi ye kurvanti pratiśrayam ||
devatās tatra kāḥ sthāpyāḥ kā na sthāpyā dvijottama |
digvibhāgagatāṃ brūhi sa bhaved yena śāntidaḥ ||
brahmovāca |
dakṣinottarapūrveṇa paścimena sureśvaraḥ |
atha madhyagataḥ śakraḥ kāryo ‘yaṃ tatpratiśrayaḥ ||
[674]        yatra śrāntāś ca khinnāś ca viśrāmyanti dvijātayaḥ |
pratiśrayasya kartāraḥ svarge tiṣṭhanti te ciram ||
tasmāt pratiśrayaḥ kāryo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalārthibhiḥ |
devatādhiṣṭhitaḥ śakraḥ sarvasaukhyaprado bhavet ||
devatānāṃ trayaṃ proktaṃ caturthī nopapadyate |
mahipaghnīṃ tathā yakṣaṃ nāyakaṃ cātra kārayet ||
mahiṣaghnī bhaven madhye jyeṣṭhasthāne na cānyathā |
vāmato diggatā kāryo dakṣiṇe yakṣarāṭ tathā ||
atha vā diggatā kāryā tatrāpi kathayāmi te |
yad dvāraṃ saṃmukhaṃ tasya devīṃ tatra pratiṣṭhayet ||
na yakṣaṃ nāyakaṃ kāryaṃ dvārābhyāṃ madhyataḥ sthitam |
evaṃ kṛte phalaṃ yat tu vaktuṃ tat kena śakyate |
kevalaṃ phalam etasya sukhaṃ rājyaṃ yaśaḥ śriyam ||
yamaḥ |
āsanaṃ pādaśaucaṃ ca dīpam annaṃ pratiśrayam |
dadāty etāni yaḥ pañca sa yajñaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ ||
annadaḥ prāṇado jñeyo rūpado vastradaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sa hi sarvaprado nāma yo dadāti pratiśrayam ||
aśvamedhasahasrasya rājasūyaśatasya ca |
puṇḍarīkasahasrasya yogiṣv avasathī naraḥ ||
viṣṇuḥ |
pratiśrayaṃ tathā śayyāpādābhyaṅgaś ca dīpakam |
pratyekadānenāpnoti gopradānasamaṃ phalam ||
dakṣaḥ |
āśrame ca yatir yasya viśāmyati muhūrtakam |
[675]        kiṃ tasyānyena dharmeṇa kṛtakṛtyo hi sa smṛtaḥ ||
janmaprabhṛti yat pāpaṃ gṛhasthena tu saṃcitam |
nirmārjayati tat sarvam ekarātoṣito yatiḥ ||
tathā |
tapojapaiḥ kṛśībhūto vyādhito ‘vasthārhakaḥ |
vṛddho grahagṛhītaś ca tathānyo vikalendriyaḥ ||
nīrujaś ca yuvā caiva bhikṣur nāvasathārhakaḥ |
nīrujaś ca yuvā caiva brahmacaryād vinaśyati ||
brahmacaryād vinaṣṭas tu kulaṃ gotraṃ ca nāśayet |
vasann avasathe bhikṣur maithunaṃ yadi sevate ||
tasyāvasathanāśasya mūlāny api nikṛntati ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
āgatasyāsanaṃ dadyāc chāntasya śayanaṃ tathā |
tṛṣitasya tu pānīyaṃ kṣudhitasya tu bhojanam ||
cakṣur dadyān mano dadyād vācaṃ dadyāc ca sūnṛtām |
eṣa sādhāraṇo dharmaś cāturvarṇyo ‘bravīn manuḥ ||
prīyate svāgatenāgnir āsanena śatakratuḥ |
pitaraḥ pādaśaucena bhojanena prajāpatiḥ ||
manu-viṣṇu-śātātapāḥ |
yeṣām anaśnann atithir viprāṇāṃ vrajate gṛhāt |
te vai kharatvam uṣṭratvam aśvatvaṃ pratipedire ||
yasya caiva gṛhe vipro vaset kaścid abhojitaḥ |
na tasya devāḥ pitaraḥ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca bhuñjate ||
[676]        atithir yatra vai grāme bhikṣamāṇaḥ prayatnataḥ |
śete niraśanas tatra brahmahatyā vidhīyate ||
api śākaṃ pacānasya śiloñchenāpi jīvataḥ |
svadeśe paradeśe vā nātithir vimanā vaset ||
ekarātraṃ tu nivasann atithir brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāt tasmād atithir ucyate ||
yamaḥ |
tithiparvotsavāḥ sarve tyaktā yena mahātmanā |
so ‘tithiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śeṣān abhyāgatān viduḥ ||
vratī yatir vaikarātraṃ nivasann ucyate ‘tithiḥ |
yasmān nityaṃ na vasati tasmāt tam atithiṃ viduḥ ||
parvāṇy amāvāsyādīni utsavā vivāhādayaḥ | tithir tadvyatiriktā dīpālikāpratipadādiḥ | etāny annaviśeṣaprāptihetūni yena dharmapareṇa tyaktāni so ‘tithir ity arthaḥ |
gautamaḥ |
asamānagrāmo ‘tithir ekarātriko ‘dhivṛkṣasūryopasthāyī | iti |
ekarātrikaḥ ekarātravasanaśīlaḥ | adhivṛkṣaḥ sūryaśabdaḥ sāyaṃkālaparaḥ |
dakṣaḥ |
sudhāvastūni vakṣyāmi śiṣṭe ca gṛham āgate |
manaś cakṣur mukhaṃ vācaṃ saumyaṃ dadyāc catuṣṭayam ||
sudhāvastūni anāyāsasaṃpadyāni |
abhyutthānam ihāgaccha pūrvālāpaḥ piryānvitaḥ |
[677]        upāsanam anuvrajyā kāryāṇy etāni yatnataḥ ||
upāsanaṃ samīpe sthitiḥ |
īṣadvastūni cānyāni bhūmir āpas tṛṇāni ca |
pādaśaucaṃ tathābhyaṅgam āśrayaḥ śayanaṃ tathā ||
īṣadvastūni cālpāyāsasādhyatvāt |
kiṃcid rātrau yathāśakti nāsyānaśnan gṛhe vaset ||
manuḥ |
āsanāśanaśayyābhir adbhir mūlaphalena vā |
nāsya kaścid vased gehe śaktito ‘narcito ‘tithiḥ ||
śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
kuryāt pratiśayagṛhaṃ pathikānāṃ hitāvaham |
nijagehaikadeśe vā sādhūn pānthān nivāsayet ||
akṣayaṃ puṇyam uddiṣṭaṃ tasya svargāpavargadam |
sarvakāmasamṛddho ‘sau devavad divi modate ||
iti pratiśayadānam |
atha kayādānam ucyate | bṛhaspatiḥ |
sahasram eva dhenūnāṃ śataṃ cānaḍuhāṃ samam |
daśānaḍutsamaṃ yānaṃ daśayānasamo hayaḥ ||
daśayānasamā kanyā bhūmidānaṃ ca tatsamam |
[678]        tasmāt sarveṣu dāneṣu kanyādānaṃ viśiṣyate ||
atriḥ |
vālukāyāḥ kṛto rāśir yāvat saptarṣimaṇḍalam |
gate varṣasahasre tu palam ekaṃ viśīryate |
kṣayaś ca dṛśyate tasyāḥ kanyādāne na vidyate ||
mahābhārate |
karandhamasya putras tu maruto nṛpatis tathā |
kanyām aṅgirase datvā divam āśu jagāma ha ||
rājā mitrasahaś cāpi vaśiṣṭhāya mahātmane |
damayantīṃ priyāṃ datvā tayā saha divaṃ gataḥ ||
madirāśvaś ca rājarṣir datvā kanyāṃ sumadhyamām |
hiraṇyahastāya gato lokān devair abhiṣṭutān ||
lomapādaś ca rājarṣiḥ śāntāṃ datvā sutāṃ prabhuḥ |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgāya vipulāṃ sarvakāmair ayujyata ||
kaśyapaḥ |
agniṣṭomātirātrāṇāṃ śataṃ śataguṇaṃ śatam |
labhate kanyakāṃ datvā mantrahomair alaṃkṛtām ||
anaḍuhāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ daśānāṃ dhuryavāhināṃ |
supātre vidhivad dānaṃ kanyādānaṃ ca tatsamam ||
devalaḥ |
tisraḥ kanyā yathānyāyaṃ pālayitvā nivedya ca |
na pitā narakaṃ yāti nārī vā strīprasūyinī ||
[679] vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
sarveṣām eva dānānām ekajanmānugaṃ phalam |
hāṭakakṣitigaurīṇāṃ saptajanmānugaṃ phalam ||
saṃvartaḥ |
alaṃkṛtya tu yaḥ kanyāṃ bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ |
datvā svargam avāpnoti pūjyate vāsavādibhiḥ ||
vahnipurāṇe |
kanyāṃ ye tu prayacchanti yathāśaktyā svalaṃkṛtām |
brahmadeyāṃ dvijaśreṣṭha brahmalokaṃ varjanti te ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
kanyām alaṃkṛtāṃ vittaśaktyā datvā sakautukam |
gaurīlokam avāpnoti viprāya guṇaśāline ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ tu gṛhasthaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate |
gṛhasthāc ca gṛhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhāc chreṣṭhā varastriyaḥ ||
tasmāt kanyāpradānasya nānyadānais tulā smṛtā |
ataḥ pradeyā vidvadbhiḥ kanyā sarvārthakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
pitā pitāmahao bhrātā sakulyo jananī tathā |
kanyāpradaḥ pūrvanāśe prakṛtisthaḥ paraḥ paraḥ ||
nāradaḥ |
pitā dadyāt svayaṃ kanyāṃ bhrātā vānumate pituḥ |
mātāmaho mātulaś ca sakulyā bāndhavās tathā ||
mātā tv abhāve sarveṣāṃ prakṛtau yadi vartate |
[680]        tasyām aprakṛtisthāyāṃ dadyuḥ kanyāṃ svajātayaḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
ātmīkṛtya suvarṇena parakīyāṃ tu kanyakām |
dharmeṇa vidhinā dātum asagotro ‘pi yujyate ||
vivāhādhikāriṇam āha manuḥ |
vedān adhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vāpi yathākramam |
aviplutabrahmacaryo gṛhasthāśramam āvaset ||
guruṇānumataḥ snātvā samāvṛtto yathāvidhi |
udvaheta dvijo bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām ||
yājñavalkyo ‘pi |
vedaṃ vratāni vā pāraṃ nītvāpy ubhayam eva vā |
aviplutabrahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṃ striyam udvahet ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
kanyām alaṃkṛtāṃ datvā samāhūya narādhipa |
vidyārthine brāhmaṇāya kanyādānaṃ tad ucyate |
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
kanyām alaṃkṛtāṃ dadyād anādāya narādhipa |
dvijāya vedaviduṣe kanyādānaṃ tad ucyate ||
dadyād guṇavate kanyāṃ nagnikāṃ dharmacāriṇīm |
api no guṇahīnāya noparudhyād rajasvalām ||
tathā |
kanyā deyā śrotriyāya brāhmaṇāya tapasvine |
[681]        sākṣād adhītavedāya vidhinā brahmacāriṇe ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
kanyāṃ tu parayā bhaktyā alaṃkṛtya prayatnataḥ |
kulīnāya surūpāya guṇajñāya viśeṣataḥ ||
kanyāṃ varayamāṇāya dadyād eṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
gāruḍapurāne |
suśīlāya suvṛttāya suvidyāya tapasvine |
kanyā deyā prayatnena netarasmai kathaṃcana ||
pariṇeyakanyālakṣaṇāni tu skandapurāṇe |
surūpāṃ lakṣaṇopetām avyaṅgāṅgīṃ kulodbhavām |
kanyāṃ bhrātṛmatīṃ caiva dharmārthārthī samudvahet ||
viśālanetrāṃ sumukhīṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām |
ātāmrapāṇipādāgrāṃ kambugrīvāṃ sumadhyamām ||
viśālajaghanāṃ cārunitambasthalabhūṣitām |
asthūlagulphadaśanām āśyāmādharatālukām ||
apiṅgākṣīm akapilām asphuraccaraṇāṃ śubhām |
asthūlagaṇḍanāsāgrāṃ śastām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
udvahet tādṛśīṃ kanyāṃ rogadoṣavivarjitām ||
varjanīyakanyānirūpaṇaṃ vahnipurāṇe |
mahānty api samṛddhāni go’jāvidhanadhānyataḥ |
[682]        strīsaṃbandhe daśemāni kulāni parivarjayet ||
hīnajātisupāṣaṇḍasujanodvegakāriṇām |
chadmāmayasadāvācyasvitrikuṣṭhikulāni ca ||
yasyās tu na bhaved bhrātā na ca vijñāyate pitā |
nopayaccheta tāṃ prājñaḥ putrikādharmaśaṅkayā ||
yathāha saṃvartaḥ |
aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navame nagnikā bhavet |
daśame kanyakā proktā dvādaśe vṛṣalī smṛtā ||
āhāṅgirāḥ |
aprāptarajasā gaurī prāpte rajasi rohiṇī |
avyañjanakṛtā śyāmā kucahīnā tu nagnikā ||
kāśyapaḥ |
saptavarṣā bhaved gorī daśavarṣā tu kanyakā |
prāpte tu dvādaśe varṣe kumārīty abhidhīyate ||
romakāle tu saṃprāpte somo bhuñjīta kanyakām |
rajaḥkāle tu gandharvāḥ śakras tu kucadarśane ||
tadmād udvāhayet kanyāṃ yāvan nartumatī bhavet |
vivāhas tv aṣṭavarṣāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ śasyate budhaiḥ ||
atrāha manuḥ |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ pratyeha ca hitāhitān |
aṣṭāv imān samāsena strīvivāhān nibodhata ||
brāhmo devas tathā cārṣaḥ prājāpatyas tathāsuraḥ |
[683]        gāndharvo rākṣasaś caiva paiśācaś cāṣṭamo mataḥ ||
caturo brāhmaṇasyādyān praśastān kavayo viduḥ |
rākṣasaṃ kṣatriyasyaivam āsuraṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ ||
pañcāṇāṃ ca trayo dharmyā dvāv adharmau sthitāv iha |
paiśācaś cāsuraś caiva na kartavyau kathaṃcana ||
pṛthak pṛthak vimiśrau vā vivāhau pūrvanoditau |
gāndharvo rākṣasaś caiva dharmyau kṣatrasya tau smṛtau ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
gāndharvāsurau rājanyasya, rākṣaso vaiśyasya, paiśācaḥ śūdrasya, sarveṣām ārṣaḥ pramāṇam |
āha pracetāḥ |
paiśācaḥ saṃskṛtaprasūtānāṃ pratilomajānāṃ ca |
manuḥ |
yo yaś caiṣāṃ vivāhānāṃ manunā kīrtito guṇaḥ |
samyak śṛṇuta taṃ viprāḥ sarvaṃ kīrtayato mama ||
daśa pūrvān parān vaṃśyān ātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam |
brāhmīputraḥ sukṛtakṛn mocayaty enasaḥ pitṝn ||
daivoḍhājaḥ sutaś caiva sapta sapta parāvarān |
ārṣoḍhājaḥ sutas trīṃs trīn ṣaṭkaṃ kāyoḍhajaḥ sutaḥ ||
brāhmādiṣu vivāheṣu caturṣv evānupūrvaśaḥ |
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrā jāyante śiṣṭasaṃmatāḥ ||
[684]        rūpasatvaguṇopetā dhanavantō yaśasvinaḥ |
paryāptabhogā dharmiṣṭhā jīvanti ca śataṃ samāḥ ||
itareṣu ca śiṣṭeṣu nṛśaṃsānṛtavādinaḥ |
jāyante durvivāheṣu brahmadharmadviṣaḥ sutāḥ ||
aninditaiḥ strīvivāhair anindyā bhavati prajā |
ninditair ninditā nṝṇāṃ tasmān nindyān vivarjayet ||
atha teṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni | tatra viṣṇuḥ |
āhūya guṇavate kanyāṃ kanyādānaṃ sa brāḥmaḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
śrutaśīle vijñāya brahmavāriṇe ‘rthine deyeti sa brāḥmaḥ |
pracetāḥ |
savarṇāya nagnikām udakena dadyāt sa brāhmo vivāhaḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
ācchādyālaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā triḥ parikramya pāvakam |
nāmagotre samuddiśya dadyād brāhmao vidhis tv ayam ||
manuḥ |
yajñe tu vitate samyak karma kurvati ṛtvije |
alaṃkṛtya sutādānaṃ daivaṃ dharmaṃ pracakṣate ||
ekaṃ gomithunaṃ dve vā varād ādāya dharmataḥ |
kanyāpradānaṃ vidhivad ārṣo dharmaḥ sa ucyate ||
[685] hārītaḥ |
anindyam anyair avitarkayan vidhivad vastrayugaṃ datvā anayā saha dharmaś caryatām ti prājāpatyaḥ |
manuḥ |
sahobhau caratāṃ dharmam iti vācānubhāṣya tu |
kanyādānaṃ samabhyarcya prajāpatyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
jñātibhyo draviṇaṃ datvā kanyāyai caiva śaktitaḥ |
kanyāpradānaṃ svācchandyād āsuro dharma ucyate ||
icchayānyonyasaṃyogaḥ kanyāyāś ca varasya ca |
gāndharvaḥ sa ca vijñeyo maithunyaḥ kāmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
hatvā chitvā ca bhitvā ca krośantīṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt |
prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ rākṣaso vidhir ucyate ||
suptāṃ mattāṃ rahaś chadma kṛtvā yatropanīyate |
sa pāpiṣṭho vivāhānāṃ paiśācaḥ prathito ‘ṣṭamaḥ ||
atha vahnipurāṇe |
brāhmeṇa tu vivāhena yas tu kanyāṃ prayacchati |
brahmalokaṃ vrajet kṣipraṃ brahmādyaiḥ pūjitaḥ suraiḥ ||
daivena tu vivāhena yas tu kanyāṃ prayacchati |
bhitvā dvāraṃ tu sūryasya svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
gāndharveṇa vivāhena yas tu kanyāṃ prayacchati |
gandharvalokam āsādya krīḍate devavac ciram ||
[686]        śulkena datvā yaḥ kanyāṃ tāṃ paścāt samyag arcayet |
sa kinnaraiś ca gandharvaiḥ krīḍate kālam akṣayam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
vilokya gotranakṣatre rāśikūṭādikaṃ śubham |
sulagne sumuhūrte ca dadyāc caiva yathāvidhi ||
ubhayasyāpi pakṣasya mano’bhyudayapūrvakam |
kumāryās tv aṣṭavarṣāyāḥ śasyate pāṇipīḍanam ||
āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
pāṇigrahaṇasaṃskāraḥ savarṇāsūpadiśyate |
asavarṇāsv ayaṃ jñeyo vidhir udvāhakarmaṇi ||
śaraḥ kṣatriyayā grāhyaḥ pratodo vaiśyakanyayā |
vasanasya daśā grāhyā śūdrayotkṛṣṭavedane ||
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
varagotraṃ samuccārya prapitāmahapūrvakam |
nāma saṃkīrtayed vidvān kanyāyāś caiva maiva hi ||
tiṣṭhet pūrvamukho dātā varaḥ pratyaṅmukho bhavet |
madhuparkārcitāṃ caināṃ tasmād dadyāt sadakṣiṇām ||
udapātraṃ tato gṛhya mantreṇānena dāpayet |
gaurīṃ kanyām imāṃ vipra yathāśakti vibhūṣiām ||
gotrāya śarmaṇe tasmai dattāṃ viprasamāśrayām || iti |
idam iha dānavākyam |
om adya amukasagotrasya amukapravarasya amukaśarmaṇaḥ prapau[687]trāya, amukasagotrasya amukapravarasya amukaśarmaṇaḥ pautrāya, amukasagotrāya amukapravarāya amukaśarmaṇe varāya, amukasagotrasya amukapravarasya amukaśarmaṇaḥ prapautrīm, amukasagotrasya amukapravarasya amukaśarmaṇaḥ pautrīm, amukasagotrasya amukapravarasya amukaśarmaṇaḥ putrīm, amukasagotrāṃ amukapravarāṃ amukābhidhānām imāṃ kanyāṃ sālaṃkārāṃ prajāpatidaivatām amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpadade | etat kanyādānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dakṣiṇām idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ saṃpradade na mamety uccārya dānamantraṃ paṭhet, pratigrahītā tu praṇavapūrvaṃ svastīty uktvā kodād iti mantram udāharet |
bhūmiṃ gāvaś ca dāsīś ca vāsāṃsi ca svaśaktitaḥ |
mahiṣyo vājinaś caiva dadyāt svarṇamaṇīn api ||
tataḥ svagṛhyavidhinā homādyaṃ karma kārayet |
yathācāraṃ vidheyāni maṅgalyakutukāni ca ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
kanyāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitām |
mātāpitros tu saṃvādaṃ kṛtvā datvā dhanaṃ mahat ||
ātmīkṛtya tu saṃsthāpya vastraṃ datvā navaṃ śubham |
bhūṣaṇair bhūṣayitvā ca gandhamālyair athārcayet ||
nimittāni samīkṣyāth gotranakṣatrakādikam |
ubhayoś cittam ālocya ubhau saṃpūjya yatnataḥ ||
dātavyā śrotiryāyaiva brāhmaṇāya tapasvine |
[688]        sākṣād adhītavedāya vidhinā brahmacāriṇe ||
dāsīdāsāsanādyaṃ ca bhūṣaṇāni viśeṣataḥ |
kṣetrāṇi ca dhanaṃ vāpi tathānyāni pradāpayet ||
yāvanti santi romāṇi kanyāyāś ca tanau punaḥ |
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
vahnipurāṇe |
evaṃ yacchanti ye kanyāṃ yathāśaktyā svalaṃkṛtām |
vivāhakāle saṃprāpte yathokte sadṛśe nare |
kramāt kramaṃ kratuśatam anupūrvaṃ labhanti te ||
śrutvā kanyāpradānaṃ ca pitaraḥ prapitāmahāḥ |
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyo brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te ||
tathā |
na manyuṃ kārayet tāsāṃ pūjyāś ca satataṃ gṛhe |
brahmādayo viśeṣeṇa brahmabhojyaṃ sadā bhavet ||
aprajāyāś ca kanyāyā na bhuñjīyāt kadācana |
dauhitrasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kim artham anuśocasi ||
mahāsattvasamākīrṇān nāsti te narakād bhayam |
tīrṇas tvaṃ sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ paraṃ svargam avāpsyasi ||
dauhitrasya tu dānena nandanti pitaraḥ sadā |
yat kiṃcit kurute dānaṃ tad ānantyāya kalpate ||
datvā kanyāṃ na śoceta kṣudhitā tāḍitāpi vā |
nānāduḥkhābhibhūtā vā tathaivāśaraṇā kṛśā ||
kuryān manyuṃ na caivāsyā āgatān caiva poṣayet |
[689]        śocanti yāmayo yatra vinaśyaty āśu tatkulam ||
na bhuñjanti ca yatraiva nirdahanty aprapūjitāḥ |
tasmād etāḥ sadābhyarcyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ ||
bhūtikāmair narair nityaṃ sutāputras tu sarvadā |
saṃtuṣṭaḥ syāt tathā pūjyaḥ sa śrāddeṣūtsaveṣu ca ||
yasminn evaṃ kule nityaṃ kalyāṇaṃ tatra vai dhruvam |
iha kīrtir bhavat svargaḥ paratra dvijasattama ||
tilarāśiḥ kṛto yāvad divākarasamucchritaḥ |
varṣānte gṛhyate tasmāt tila ekas tu yāvatā ||
saṃkṣayaṃ labhate tāvad brahmalokasya niścitam |
śatagavyūtimānena saṃcitair vṛṣaromabhiḥ ||
viśīryate turāliṅgaṃ varṣe kanyāpradas tathā |
tāvat svargaṃ labhed yāvat sarvalomnāṃ tu saṃkṣayaḥ ||
mahīdātuś ca godātuḥ kanyādātuś ca ye rathāḥ |
kanyādānānugāḥ paścāt samaṃ yānti trayo rathāḥ ||
athācitapradātuś ca satyavādina eva ca |
nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlasya samaṃ yānti trayo rathāḥ ||
kūkudaś cāśvamedhī ca prāṇadātā dvijeṣu ca |
samaṃ yānti tathā hy ete trayo vai nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
alaṃkṛtya kanyāpradādā kūkudaḥ |
kanyādānaṃ daridrasya yo dadāti pariṣkṛtam |
pūrtaṃ dharmam avāpnoti yathāvad vidhikalpitam |
[690]        tasmāt kanyā prayatnena dātavyā śreya icchatā ||
skandapurāṇe |
vaivāhikapradānaṃ vā yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
vimānena vicitreṇa kiṅkiṇījālamālinā |
mahendrabhavane yāti sevyamāno ‘psorogaṇaiḥ ||
iti kanyādānavidhiḥ |
atha dvijasthāpanam | tatra dakṣaḥ |
mātāpitṛvihīnaṃ tu saṃskārodvahanādibhiḥ |
yaḥ sthāpayati tasyeha puṇyasaṃsthā na vidyate ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
kārayitvā tathodvāhaṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ kuleṣu ca |
vedavacchīlavṛtteṣu dvijeṣv ekādaśas tathā ||
vātāgṛhāṇi ramyāṇi kuryād ekādaśaiva tu |
kārayitvā tu dānyaiś ca vividhaiś ca prapūrayet ||
dāsīgomahiṣīś cāpi śayanāsanapādukāḥ |
bhājanāni vicitrāṇi tāmramṛṇmayakāni ca ||
pātrāṇi bhojanārthe ca kṛtsnaṃ copaskaraṃ ca yat |
lohaṃ ca kanakaṃ caiva vastrāṇi tu viśeṣataḥ ||
saṃbhṛtyaitaṃ susaṃbhāraṃ tadgṛheṣu niyojayet |
yojayec caiva vṛttyarthaṃ śaktito vā śataṃ śatam ||
pṛthak pṛthag lāṅgalānāṃ nivartanaśatārdhataḥ |
viṣayaṃ karvaṭaṃ kheṭaṃ grāmaṃ grāmārdham eva vā ||
[691]        yojayet somamūrtiṃ ca cintiteṣu dvijeṣu vai |
ekādaśaiva tās tatra dāmpatyomāharātmakāḥ ||
vicintya parayā bhaktyā tadgṛheṣu praveśayet |
grāhayed agnihotrāṇi praveśyaitān dvijottamān ||
vidhipūrvaṃ yathānyāyam ātmanaḥ śreyase naraḥ |
aduṣṭakulajānāṃ ca vidhir eṣāṃ cirantanaḥ ||
śivabhaktyā vibhaktānāṃ dvijānāṃ kārayet sadā |
yaś ca preṣyāṇ dvijān mūḍho yojayed dhavyakavyayoḥ ||
na bhavet tatphalaṃ tasya caidikīyaṃ śrutir dhruvā |
yajñadānaṃ vratādyaṃ ca tīrthayātrādikaṃ ca yat ||
yas tv evaṃ kārayej jantuṃ tena sarvam anuṣṭhitam |
sa yāty arkasamānābhaṃ vimānaṃ ratnamālinam ||
āruhya tat padaṃ puṇyaṃ surastrībhir alaṃkṛtam |
vimānaiś cāparair divyaiḥ sahasraiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
sarvalokagatān bhogān bhuktvā tasmin prapadyate |
jñātvā svavittasāmarthyam ekaṃ codvāhayed dvijam ||
tena prāpnoti tat sthānaṃ śivabhakto naro dhruvam |
sthānena sthānasaṃprāptir vidhidattena jāyate ||
atha rājasthāpanam | ādityapurāṇe bṛhaspatiśrutau ca |
bhūmpālaṃ cyutaṃ rājyād yas tu saṃsthāpayet punaḥ |
tasya vāso munīndreha nākapṛṣṭhe na saṃśayaḥ ||
[692] viṣṇudharmottare |
bhūpālaṃ yaṃ cyutaṃ rājyāt svarājye sthāpayet punaḥ |
sa yāti śakrasālokyaṃ yāvac chakrāś caturdaśa ||
tato mānuṣyam āsādya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
tasmād dānaṃ śrīvihīne dātavyaṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
śrīvihīneṣu yad dattaṃ tad anantaṃ prakīrtitam ||
tathā |
sthānabhraṣṭasya yaḥ kuryād bhūyas tv āropaṇaṃ naraḥ |
nākalokam avāpnoti ciraṃ teneha karmaṇā ||
kanyādānaprasaṅgena dvijātisthāpanam uktaṃ kramaprāptasya kapilādānasy godānaprakaraṇe nirūpitatvāt paryavasitāni, daśamahānānīti |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe daśamahādānaprakaraṇam ||
[693]
atha daśamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha kṛṣṇājinadānāny abhidhīyante |
yo manyate satatam adhvaradīkṣaṇeṣu
kṣaumāmbarād api mṛdūni mṛgājināni |
hemādrir eṣa tad aśeṣam aśeṣam uktaṃ
kṛṣṇājinapramukhadānavidhānam āha ||
tatsaṃgrahaślokās tu | saurapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca mahiṣīṃ meṣīṃ ca daśadhenavaḥ |
brahmalokapradāyīni tulāpuruṣa eva ca ||
tatra kṛṣṇājinadāne yamaḥ |
gobhūhiraṇyasaṃyuktaṃ mārgam ekaṃ dadāti yaḥ |
sarvaduṣkṛtakarmāpi sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo vrajet ||
marīciḥ |
kṛṣṇājinobhayamukhīṃ yo dadyād āhitāgnaye |
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
[694] kātyāyanaḥ |
kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛtvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī |
ye prayacchanti viprāya na te śocyāḥ kṛtākṛte ||
sarvāṃś ca lokāṃś carati kāmacāravihaṃgamaḥ |
āhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvat svargaloke mahīyate ||
kṛṣṇājinasamaṃ dānaṃ na cāsti bhuvanatraye |
pratigraho ‘pi pāpīyān iti vedavido viduḥ ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇāya prayacchati |
sa tiṣṭhed vaiṣṇave loke yāvac candrārkatārakam ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ tu yaḥ paśyed dīyamānaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |
so ‘pi pāpaiḥ pramucyeta ājanmajanitair api ||
brahmaṇā pūrvarūpaṃ tu kṛṣṇājinaṃ vinirmitam |
saṃsiddhaye ca yogānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ ca susiddhaye ||
ahno rūpaṃ sitaṃ tasya kṛṣṇaṃ rātrimayaṃ vapuḥ |
bahurūpaṃ tu saṃdhyāyā vijñeyaṃ taṃ narādhipa ||
kṛṣṇājinasya sāmāni śuklāni ca ṛcas tathā |
yajūṃṣi bahurūpāṇi śrutidehaś caren mṛgaḥ ||
svecchayā ramate yatra sa deśo yājñikaḥ smṛtaḥ |
itare mlecchadeśās tu śrutidharmavivarjitāḥ ||
na kṛṣṇena vinā yajño na śrāddhaṃ na kriyā kvacit |
bhavanti dharmaśāstrāṇi vedakāryāṇi pārthivaḥ ||
[695]        taddānaṃ sarvadānānām adhikaṃ śrutikarmaṇām ||
āha viṣṇuḥ |
atha vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kṛṣṇamṛgājinaṃ sakhuraṃ saśṛṅgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitaṃ kṛtvā āvikena ca vastreṇa prasārite prasārayet | tatas tilaiḥ pracchādayet | suvarṇanābhaṃ ca kuryād ahatena vāsoyugena pracchādayet | sarvaratnagandhaiś cālaṃkuryāt | catasṛṣu ca dikṣu catvāri taijasāni pātrāṇi kṣīradadhimadhusarpiḥpūrṇāni nidhāyāhitāgnaye brāhmaṇāya vāsoyugapracchāditāya dadyāt |
atha ca gāthā bhavanti |
yas tu kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadyāt sakhuraṃ śṛṅgasaṃyutam |
tilaiḥ pracchādya vāsobhiḥ sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtam ||
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā |
caturantā bhaved dattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛtvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī |
dadāti yas tu viprāya sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam ||
matsyapurāṇe |
manur uvāca |
kṛṇājinapradānasya vidhiṃ gālaṃ mamānagha |
brāhmaṇaṃ ca samācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān ||
[696]                 matsya uvāca |
vaiśākhī paurṇamāsī ca grahaṇaṃ śaśisūryayoḥ |
paurṇamāsī tu yā māghe āṣāḍhī kārtikī tathā ||
uttarāyaṇadvādaśī vā tasyāṃ dattaṃ mahāphalam |
āhitāgnir dvijo yaś ca tad deyaṃ tasya pārthiva ||
yathā yena vidhānena tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu |
gomayenopalipte tu śucau deśe ca pārthiva ||
ādāv eva samāstīrya śobhanaṃ vastram āvikam |
tataḥ saśṛṅgaṃ sakhuram āstaraṃ kṛṣṇamārgaṇam ||
kartavyaṃ rukmaśṛṅgaṃ ca raupyaṃ dantaṃ tathaiva ca |
lāṅgūlaṃ mauktikair yuktaṃ tilacchannaṃ tathaiva ca ||
tilair ātmasamaṃ kṛtvā vāsasācchādayed budhaḥ |
tilais tu śikharaṃ kṛtveti kvacit pāṭhaḥ |
suvarṇanābhaṃ tat kuryād alaṃkuryād viśeṣataḥ ||
ratnair gandhair yathāśaktyā tasya dikṣu ca vinyaset |
kāṃsyapātrāṇi catvāri dikṣu dadyād yathākramam ||
mṛṇmayeṣu ca pātreṣu pūrvādiṣu krameṇa tu |
ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi kṣaudram evaṃ datvā yathāvidhi ||
atra saratnāni kāṃsyapātrāṇi catasṛṣu dikṣu vinyaset, anyāni ca mṛṇmayāni pātrāṇi ghṛtakṣīradadhimadhupūrṇāni yathākramaṃ pūrvādidikṣu sthāpanīyānīti |
pañcaksy tathā śākhām avraṇaṃ kumbham eva ca |
[697]        brāhmopasthānakaṃ kṛtvā śubhavitto niveśayet |
jīrṇavastreṇa pītena sarvāṅgāni ca mārjayet ||
brāhmopasthānakam iti dānapradeśād bāhye, upa samīpe sthānaṃ yasya sa tatheti kumbhaviśeṣaṇam, mārjayed iti dānānantaraṃ snātvā jīrṇavastreṇa pracchādayed ity arthaḥ |
dhātumayāni pātrāṇi pādeṣv asya pradāpayet |
yāni kāmyāni pāpāni mayā lobhāt kṛtāni vai ||
lohapātrapradānena praṇaśyantu mamāśu vai |
tilapūrṇaṃ tu tat kṛtvā vāmapāde niveśayet ||
yāni pāpāni kāmyāni karṇotthāni kṛtāni ca |
kāṃsyapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu me sadā ||
madhupūrṇaṃ tu tat kṛtvā pāde vai dakṣiṇe nyaset |
etat pātradvayam, paścimapādayoḥ sthāpanīyam |
parāpavādapaiśūnyāt pṛṣṭhamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt ||
tatrotthitaṃ ca me pāpaṃ tāmrapātrāt praṇaśyatu |
kanyānṛtaṃ gavāṃ caiva paradārapragharṣaṇam ||
raupyapātrapradānena kṣīpraṃ nāśaṃ prayāṇtu me |
ūrdhvapāde tv ime kārye tāmrasya rajatasya ca ||
ūrdhvapāde, agrapādayoḥ ekavacanam atrāvivakṣitam | atra tāmrapātraṃ madhupūrṇam, dakṣiṇapāde rajatapātram, tilapūrṇaṃ vāmapāde sthāpanīyam |
janmajanmasahasreṣu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kubuddhinā |
suvarṇapātradānāt tan nāśayāśu janārdana ||
[698] etac ca suvarṇapātram akṣatapūrṇaṃ madhyadeśe sthāpayet |
hemamuktāvidrumaṃ ca dāḍimaṃ bījapūrakam |
praśastapatraṃ śravaṇe khure śṛṅgāṭakāni ca ||
evaṃ kṛtvā yathoktena sarvaśākaphalāni ca |
tatpratigrahavid vidvān āhitāgnir dvijottamaḥ ||
snāto vastrayugachannaḥ svaśaktyā cāpy alaṃkṛtaḥ |
pratigrahaś ca tasyoktaḥ pucchadeśe mahīpate ||
suvarṇanābhikaṃ dadyāt prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
idam iha dānavākyam |
om adya amukasagotrāyetyādi idaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ kuśoparigatakambalopari sthitam, vastrayugapracchāditatilarāśim, suvarṇaśṛṅgam, raupyakhuram, raupyadantaṃ muktāphalaśāṅgūlam, suvarṇanābhaṃ pañcaratnālaṃkṛtaṃ gandhapuṣpānvitaṃ caturdigavasthitaghṛtakṣīradadhimadhupūrṇapātracatuṣṭhayasahitaṃ sakāṃsyapatraṃ śivadaivatam amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade, na mameti, adya amukasagotrāyetyādi etat kṛṣṇājinadānapratiṣṭḥārthaṃ dakṣiṇām idaṃ suvarṇaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
anena vidhinā dadyād yathāvat kṛṣṇamārgaṇam |
na spṛśyaḥ sa dvijo rājan citiyūpasamo hi saḥ ||
dāne ca śrāddhakālena dūrataḥ parivarjayet |
svagṛhāt preṣya taṃ vipraṃ maṇḍale snānam ācaret ||
tad vastraṃ kumbhasahitaṃ nītvā kṣepyaṃ catuṣpathe ||
ahatam aparihitam aprakṣālitaṃ ca vītaḥ, kṛtaparidhānaḥ |
[699] dakṣiṇāsaṃkhyā tu garuḍapurāṇe |
śataniṣkasamopetaṃ tadardhārdham athāpi vā |
ato nyūnaṃ na dātavyam adhikaṃ phalam arjitam ||
uttamaṃ tu śatenaiva madhyamaṃ tu tadardhataḥ |
tadardhena kaniṣṭhaṃ tu deyaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgājinam ||
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta phalahānes tu kāraṇāt ||
matsyapurāṇe |
kṛtenānena yā tuṣṭir na sā śakyā surair api |
vaktuṃ ca nṛpatiśreṣṭha tathāpy uddeśataḥ śṛṇu ||
samagrabhūmidānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
sarvāṃs tu lokāṃś carati kāmacārī vihaṅgamaḥ ||
āhūtasaplavaṃ yāvat svargam āpnoty asaṃśayam |
na pitṛputramaraṇaṃ viyogaṃ bhāryayā saha ||
dhanadeśaparityāgaṃ na caivehāpnuyāt kvacit ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgasya carma
datvā dvijendrāya samāhitāya |
yathoktam etan maraṇaṃ na śocet
prāpnoty abhīṣṭaṃ manasaḥ phalaṃ tat ||
vaiṣṇavapadādhikāre |
kālikāpurāṇe |
ye ‘pi rukmādipatre ca hutvā vahniṃ dadanti ca |
tiladroṇasamāyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭitam ||
[700]        palārdhārdham athārdhaṃ vā vittamān hemasaṃyutam |
sūkṣmayugmena vastreṇa anyenācchādayed dvijam ||
sodakaṃ cāparaṃ rukmaṃ satilaṃ nyasya tatkare |
tataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadyāt tiladroṇānvitaṃ ca yat ||
datvā tu bhojayet tatra natvā caiva visarjayet |
ayane viṣuve caiva candrasūryagrahe tathā ||
yugādau vā prayacchanti vidhinā ye tu vai dvije |
te ‘pi tatpadam āsādya daśāṃśaṃ brāhma āyuṣaḥ ||
krīḍanti vividhair bhogaiḥ kalārūpaguṇānvitāḥ |
anena ca vidhānena daśadroṇapradāyakaḥ ||
ābrahmāṇḍabhavaṃ kālaṃ modate sa purottame |
yo ghaṭaṃ payasā pūrṇaṃ hemapadmaniyojitam ||
saṃpūjya vastrayugmena dadyāt so ‘pi vrajed dhruvam ||
ādityapurāṇe |
vaiśākhyāṃ pūrṇamāsyāṃ ca tiladānaṃ dadanti ye |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ pracchādyāṣṭau tilasya vai ||
svarṇaśṛṅgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitam |
śvetavastrayugopetaṃ kṛṣṇacailādyalaṃkṛtam ||
lohabhājanacatuṣkaṃ ca ghṛtakṣaudreṇa pūritam |
dadhikṣīraṃ tathā caiva saṃpūrṇaṃ ca tataḥ param ||
parikṣite guṇādhāre brāhmaṇe susamāhite |
agnihotrarate śānte devadvijaparāyaṇe ||
[701]        nityasnāte śaucapare sarvaśāstrādyalaṃkṛte |
tasmai tad dīyate dānaṃ kṛṣṇājinam anuttamam ||
saptadvīpasāgarāṃ vai saśailavanakānanām |
pṛthivīṃ ratnasaṃpūrṇāṃ datvā bhavati yat phalam ||
uddhṛtya narakād ghorāt kulāny ekottaraṃ śatam |
gacchati brahmalokaṃ ca vimānaiś candrasaṃnibhaiḥ ||
cāmarair dhūyamānasya gītavaṃśamanoramaiḥ |
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtaḥ patākādhvajasaṃkulaḥ ||
jayaghoṣaś ca kriyate tasyāgre surakinnaraḥ |
brahmalokaṃ tataḥ prāpya praviśya ca purīm imām ||
sarvaratnojvalāṃ divyāṃ muktājālavibhūṣitām |
pravālastambhaśobhāḍhyāṃ sauvarṇālaṃkṛtāṃ mune ||
triṃśatkoṭyas tu lakṣāṇi aśītyabhyadhikā purā |
siṃhāsanopaviṣṭas tu śvetavastraparichadaḥ ||
vasate tatra vai kālaṃ yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
yadi mānuṣyam āyāti kadācit kālaparyaye ||
caturvedagṛhaṃ janma jāyate mahatāṃ kulam |
rūpavān balavāṃś caiva dīrghāyuḥ priyadarśanaḥ ||
vallabhaḥ sarvanārīṇāṃ dātā bhoktā tathaiva ca ||
iti kṛṣṇājinadānavidhiḥ \
atha vahnipurāṇe |
brahmā uvāca |
vidhinā kena dātavyā kṛṣṇājinayutās tilāḥ |
[702]        etan me sarvam acakṣva yadi tuṣṭo ‘si me prabho ||
yama uvāca |
grahaṇe ayane caiva saṃkrāntau sarvaparvasu |
yugādiṣu yugānteṣu dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
samupoṣya samabhyarcya keśavaṃ kalmaṣāpaham |
dvādaśyāṃ tu caturdaśyṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||
saṃlipya gomayenātha caturhastapramāṇataḥ |
vastrāṇi prastared bhūmyām ajinaṃ tatra vinyaset ||
kṛṇais tilais tu saṃchannaṃ kṛtvā tatropari nyaset |
madhusarpiryutaṃ pātraṃ haimaṃ caudumbaraṃ tathā ||
suvarṇaṃ prakṣipet tatra palaṃ vā tripalaṃ śatam |
śaktito dānam evaṃ hi bhaktir evātra kāraṇam ||
saṃchādya tac chubhair vastraiḥ pātraṃ yajñopavītinam |
kumbhāś cāṣṭau tathā dikṣu savastrāḥ pātrasaṃyutāḥ ||
kṛṣṇo ‘smi karmaṇā kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇājinam atas tilaiḥ |
kṣṇair yutaṃ praticchasva kṛṣṇaḥ saṃprīyatām iti ||
evaṃ datvā dvijebhyas tu dadyāt paścāc ca dakṣiṇām |
tilāhāro bhavet tatra brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ ||
evaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ datvā naro vigatakalmaṣaḥ |
pitāmahān samuddhṛtya svargaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
[703]        tatra bhogāṃś citaṃ bhuktvā pitṛpitāmahair vṛtaḥ |
sa naro ‘sya prabhāvād dhi yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||
iti aparakṛṣṇājinadānavidhiḥ
atha madhamakṛṣṇājinadānam | tatra pulastyaḥ |
athātaḥ kṛṣṇājinadānavidhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ vā candrasūryagrahe viṣuvaty ayanayor vā kṛṣṇamṛgājinaṃ sakhuraṃ saśṛṅgam avraṇaṃ manoharaṃ hiraṇyaśṛṅgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitam antarmāṃsaṃ bahirlomaṃ prākgrīvaṃ syāt, gomayaliptāyāṃ bhuvi, kutapān āvistīrya tasman avikaṃ vastraṃ prasārya tasminn ajinaṃ hiraṇyanābhaṃ kṛtvā, tilaiḥ pracchādya tadrūpaṃ kṛtvā vastrayugena tilān pracchadeyet, catasṛṣu dikṣu catvāri pātrāṇi tāmraraupyakāṃsyasauvarṇāni yathāśaktitaḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi kṣīrapūrṇaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dadhipūrṇaṃ paścimasyāṃ diśi ghṛtapūrṇam uttarasyāṃ diśi kṣaudrapūrṇaṃ nidadhyāt, catasṛṣu dikṣu catasro gṛṣṭīr nidadhyāt, paścime bhāge susamiddham agniṃ kṛtvā parisamūhya paryukṣya paristīrya prāgagre darbhe mahāvyāhṛtibhis tilān ghṛtāktān juhuyāt, śūdrasya namaskāreṇeti tata āhitāgnaye brāhmaṇāya sarvāṅgasaṃpūrṇāya pātrasaṃyuktāya viduṣe vastrayugopacchannāyālaṃkṛtāya dadyāt, sarvaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadāmīti nābhiṃ spṛśann aditaye kṛṣṇājinaṃ pratigṛhṇāmīti asāv api gṛhṇīyāt, pratigrahaṃ vācayet |
[704] atra hiraṇyaśṛṅgm ityādau hiraṇyādiparimāṇaṃ yathāruci vittaśāṭhyarahitenācaraṇīyam | bahirlometi uttaralomety arthaḥ, kutapāḥ kuśāḥ | āvikaṃ vastrakambalaḥ | gṛṣṭiḥ ekavāraprasūtā gauḥ | nābhiṃ spṛśann iti tilamayīṃ suvarṇādyalaṃkṛtāṃ nābhiṃ dātā spṛśann ity arthaḥ | aditaye kṛṣṇājinam iti, pratigrahamantraḥ | asāv iti pratigrahītā svanāmoccārayan pucchadeśe pratigṛhṇīyāt |
viṣṇudharmottare |
kṛṣṇājinavidhiṃ brūhi mama mādhava pṛcchataḥ |
anyāny api tu dānāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca kārttikyāṃ viṣuve tathā |
ayane grahaṇe vāpi dadyāt kṛṣṇamṛgājinam ||
bhūmau gomayaliptāyāṃ darbhān āstīrya mānavaḥ |
tatrāvikaṃ tathā vastraṃ prāgagraṃ ca prasāritam ||
tasmin kṛṣṇājinaṃ bhūpa nirmāṃsaṃ saṃprasārayet |
prāggrīvam uttaramukhaṃ saśṛṅgaṃ sakhuraṃ tathā ||
svarṇaśṛṅgaṃ rapuyakhuraṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitam |
tilaiḥ saṃcchādya kṛṣṇais tu yathāśaktyā yathāvidhi ||
sauvarṇaṃ kṣīrapātraṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ diśi dāpayet |
rājataṃ dadhipātraṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ diśi dāpayet ||
tāmrapātraṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ paścimāyāṃ nidhāpayet |
śaṅkhaṃ sunābhiṃ sumukhaṃ kṣaurapūrṇaṃ tathottare ||
[705]        catasraṣu tathā dikṣu catasro gṛṣṭikāḥ kramāt |
tatsvarūpaṃ tu rājendra tilān ācchādya vāsasā ||
paścime tu tato bhāge vidhinā sthāpya pāvakam |
tilān ghṛtāktān juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiḥ samāhitaḥ ||
āhitāgniṃ tato vipram avyaṅgāṅgaṃ supāṭhakam |
pravaktāraṃ yājñikaṃ ca dātāraṃ smṛtivit param ||
saṃpūjya vastrayugmena alaṃkārais tu śobhitaiḥ |
diśaḥ saṃprokṣya gāyatryā tilamiśreṇa vāriṇā ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha saśiro gṛṣṭibhir yutam |
dadāmi pratigṛhīṣva prīyatāṃ dharmarāḍ iti ||
nābhiṃ spṛśaṃs tan ninayet pratigṛhṇātv asāv iti |
aditir dyaur iti japet praṇavenādinā tataḥ ||
praṇavaṃ mantraṃ pratigrahādyaṃ tayoḥ pratigrahītā japet |
gobhūhiraṇyasaṃyuktaṃ mārgam etad dadāti yaḥ |
gobhūhiraṇyasaṃyuktam ity atra yathāśaktyā gobhūhiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā | sa sarvapāpakarmāpi sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo vrajet |
iti madhyamakṛṣṇājinadānavidhiḥ |
atha mahākṛṣṇājinadānam | viṣṇudharmottare |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
muṇḍite yā tu yā proktā prāyaścittaṃ purābhavat |
hatyāyāṃ brāhmaṇasyaiva tāṃ pravakṣyāmi mānada ||
[706]        bhūmiṃ prākpravaṇāṃ śuddhāṃ gomayenānulepayet |
tasyāṃ haritadarbhāṃs tu dhanān āstīrya yatnataḥ ||
madhye kṛṣṇājinaṃ rājan nārdraṃ sarvāṅgikaṃ dṛḍham |
āstīrya śṛṅgasahitaṃ prāggrīvaṃ śirasā saha ||
ketitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ patralakṣaṇalakṣitam |
ketitam iti nimantritam ity arthaḥ |
prakṣālya pādau tasyaiva dadyāt kṛṣṇe tu vāsasī ||
sauvarṇe kuṇḍale deye kaṇṭhābharaṇam eva ca |
sauvarṇe kaṅkaṇe deye hastābharaṇam eva ca ||
sragdāmabhis tu saṃpūjya śṛṅgayor madhyadeśataḥ |
prāṅmukhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sthāpya mṛgaṃ sauvarṇaśṛṅgikam ||
tilaiḥ pracchādayet kṛṣṇair brāhmaṇaṃ śirasā saha |
yadā śiro brāhmaṇasya magnaṃ bhavati bhūbhuja ||
japed vai mūlamantraṃ tu gāyatrīṃ vā samāhitaḥ |
pāpaṃ saṃcintya cittena hananaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu ||
nābhimātraṃ samuddhṛtya tilaiḥ saṃchādayet punaḥ |
saṃchādite punar vipre japen mantraṃ tu pūrvavat ||
punar uddhṛtya vipraṃ tu nābhimātraṃ tu pārthiva |
punaḥ saṃchādayet tasya śiraḥ kṛṣṇais tilais tathā ||
trikṛtvas tu nimajyaivaṃ dātā dadyān mṛgājinam |
pātraṃ manasi saṃcintya toyam apsu vinikṣipet ||
prīyatāṃ viśvakarmā tu viśvātmā viśvarūpadhṛk |
evaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ datvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
[707]        pāpiṣṭhaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yāti yatra na śocati |
iti te guhyam ākhyātaṃ dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanam ||
muṇḍitena tu kṛcchārya brāhmaṇe ghātite sati |
sahasraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyān niyataṃ brāhmaṇāya tu ||
iti mahākṛṣṇājinadānavidhiḥ |
atha kṛṣṇājinaprasaṅgena mṛgadānam ucyate | āha baudhāyanaḥ |
hariṇaṃ kārayet tāmraṃ ghanantu daśabhiḥ palaiḥ |
tadardhena tadardhena śṛṅge rūpyamaye dṛḍhe ||
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāpya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
āḍhakatritayaṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vā svaśaktitaḥ ||
pāduṣe caturṣu sthāpya kāṃsyapātracatuṣṭayam |
vāyudaivatamantraiś ca homaṃ tatra prakalpayet ||
samidājyacaruṃ kṛtvā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ dvija |
aṣṭāviṃśatir evātha dānamantreṇa kārayet ||
vāyo carasi bhūtānām antas tvaṃ lokapāvana |
vāhanasya pradānena vātavyādhiṃ vināśaya ||
anena kṛtamātreṇa yathoktena vidhānataḥ |
vātavyādhivinirmukto nīrujaḥ sukham aśnute ||
iti mṛgadānavidhiḥ |
vāyupurāṇe |
guror alīkanirbandhād apatantrī bhaven naraḥ |
[708]        vakṣye tasya pratīkāraṃ dānaṃ homādisaṃyutam ||
palena vā tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
kārayed dhariṇaṃ haimaṃ vāyor vāhanam uttamam ||
śṛṅge ca rājate kārye parvatrayasamanvite |
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāpya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
āḍhakatritayaṃ yad vā tadardhaṃ vātha śaktitaḥ |
pādeṣu caturṣu sthāpya kāṃsyapātracatuṣṭayam ||
vāyudaivatamantraiś ca homaṃ tatra prakalpayet |
samidājyacaruṃ hutvā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ dvijaḥ ||
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajñaḥ sarvavidyāsu niṣṭhitaḥ |
etaddānaprayogajño vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||
agner īśānadigbhāge sukumbhaṃ sthāpayet sudhīḥ |
navaratnāni deyāni alābhe svarṇam eva tu ||
nikṣipen mṛttikāṃ vāpi rocanāṃ guggulaṃ tathā |
caturbhir brāhmaṇaiś cāpi śāntikarma prakalpayet ||
āpohiṣṭādibhir mantrair hiraṇyādibhir eva ca |
pavamānānuvākena devasya tveti caiva hi ||
tataḥ pīṭhe samāsāinam abhiṣiñceyur ādṛtāḥ |
vastreṇāveṣṭitaṃ kumbham ādāya caturā dvijāḥ ||
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharo naro śuklānulepanaḥ |
ācāryeṇa samaṃ pūjāṃ hariṇasya prakalpayet ||
vāyoḥ śatena mantreṇa talliṅgenātha vā punaḥ |
tatas taṃ hariṇaṃ dadyāt prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ ||
[709]        mantreṇānena vidhinā ācāryāyātha bhaktitaḥ |
vāyo carasi bhūtānām antas tvaṃ lokapāvana ||
prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānādyabhidhānataḥ |
alīkaṃ yat kṛtaṃ deva pūrvajanmani māruta ||
tvaṃ vetsi sarvam etad dhi paramātmā yathaiva hi |
vāhanasya pradānena apatantraṃ vināśaya ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ caturṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇā |
ācāryas tv ahataṃ vāso gṛhītvā śuklam eva tu ||
tena tasya yathāliṅgam aṅgāni visṛjet sudhīḥ |
akṣibhyām anuvākena yathāliṅgaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
darbhāgramuṣṭinā caiva darbhapiñjalakair api |
hiraṇyaparṇāḥ śucayaḥ āpohiṣṭeti vai punaḥ ||
pavamānānuvākena āpo asmāṃs tathaiva ca |
anyaiś ca pāvanair mantrair yajurbhir lokapūjitaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi yathāvibhavato naraḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā tu niyatam apatantrād vimucyate ||
āyurārogyasaṃpannaḥ sustho bhavati mānavaḥ |
mahāvyādhiṣu cānyeṣu dānam etat karoti yaḥ |
tattaddoṣair vinirmukto nīrujo bhavati prabho ||
ity aparamṛgadānavidhiḥ |
atha mahiṣīdānam | viśvāmitraḥ |
mahiṣīṃ suprajāṃ rājan kṣīrāḍhyāṃ yuvatiṃ tathā |
[710]        datvā caiva tu kārttikyāṃ dhenūpaskarasaṃyutām ||
daśadhenupradānena yat phalaṃ tat samaśnute |
prāpnoti putrapautrāṃś ca sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
bhaviṣottare |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
mahiṣīdānamāhatmyaṃ kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira |
puṇyaṃ pavitram āyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmasukhapradam ||
candrasūryagrahe puṇye kārttikyām ayane tathā |
śuklapakṣaś caturdaśyāṃ sūryasaṅkrāntivāsare ||
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ ca kurunandana |
tadaiva deyā mahiṣī saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā ||
supayodharā sujaghanā suśṛṅgī sukhurā tathā |
prathamaprasūtā taruṇī suśīlā doṣavarjitā ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgatilakā ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitā |
raktavastrāvṛtā ramyā tāmradohanikānvitā ||
piṇyākapiṭakopetā sahiraṇyā ca śaktitaḥ |
saptadhānyayutā deyā brāhmaṇe vedapārage ||
purāṇapāṭhake tadvaj jyotiḥśāstravide tathā |
deyā na vedarahite na bakavratine kvacit ||
dravyair ebhiḥ samāyuktā puṇye ‘hni vidhipūrvakam |
dadyān mantreṇa rājendra purāṇapaṭhite na tu ||
indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā |
[711]        mahiṣīdānamahātmyāt sāstu me sarvakāmadā ||
darmarājasya sāhāyye yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
mahiṣāsurasya jananī yā sāstu varadā mama ||
dānamantraḥ |
dadyāt pradakṣiṇī kṛtya brāhmaṇe tāṃ payasvinīm |
pratigrahaḥ smṛtas tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe svayaṃbhuvā ||
atredaṃ dānavākyam |
om adya amukasagotrāyetyādi imāṃ mahiṣīṃ prathamaprasūtāṃ taruṇīṃ suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ suvarṇatilakāṃ suvarṇābharaṇāṃ ghaṇṭātāmradohanakānvitāṃ piṇyākapiṭakopetāṃ saptadhānyaputāṃ pādukavatīṃ yamadaivatām amukakāmas tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na maety uktvā pūrvoktaṃ mantram udāhaet |
amukasagotrāyetyādi etan mahiṣīdānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dakṣiṇāmidaṃ hiraṇyaṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti |
evaṃ datvā vidhānena brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet |
kṣamāpayet tato viprān susaṃtuṣṭo bhaveti ca ||
anena vidhinā datvā mahiṣīṃ dvijapuṅgave |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti iha loke paratra ca ||
yā strī dadāti mahiṣīṃ sā rājamahiṣī bhavet |
mahārājaḥ pumān rājan vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
yajñayājī bhaved vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet |
[712]        vaśyas tu dhānyadhanavān śūdraḥ sarvārthasaṃyutaḥ ||
tasmān nareṇa dātavyā mahiṣī vibhave sati |
putrapautraprapautrārtham ātmanaḥ śubham icchatā ||
daśadhenusamāṃ rājan mahiṣīṃ nārado ‘bravīt |
viṃśaddhenusamāṃ vyāsaḥ sarvadānottamāṃ kaviḥ ||
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhundhumāreṇa gādhinā |

mahiṣīdānamahātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā naraḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||

lokadvayaṃ ca jayatīha kim atra citram ||
iti mahiṣīdānavidhiḥ |
atha meṣīdānam | tatra kaśyapaḥ |
yo ‘pi dadyād aviṃ cātra brāḥmaṇāya manoramām |
so ‘py agnilokam āsādya bhuṅkte bhogān suśobhanān ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
meṣīm aśeṣapāpaghnīṃ datvā yāt paraṃ padam |
vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnoti datvorabhraṃ narottama ||
[713] bhaviṣyottare |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
śṛṇu pārtha paraṃ dānaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam |
yad datvā vividhaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo vilayam ṛcchati ||
suvarṇaromāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratyakṣāṃ vā suśobhanām |
suvarṇatilakopetāṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām ||
kauśeyaparidhānāṃ ca divyacandanabhūṣitām |
divyapuṣpopahārāṃ tu sarvadhāturasair yutām ||
saptadhānyasamāyuktāṃ phalapuṣpavatīṃ tathā |
śatena kārayet tāṃ ca suvarṇasya prayatnataḥ ||
yathāśaktyātha vā kuryād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet |
ayane viṣuve puṇye grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ ||
duḥsvapnadarśane caiva janmarkṣe tithisaṃkṣaye |
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam ||

dadyāt tīrthe gṛhe vāpi yatra vā ramate manaḥ ||

brahmāṇaṃ saha gāyatryā saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā ||
ratyā saha tathānaṅgaṃ lokapālān grahān api |
tān tu pūjya vidhānena gandhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ ||
umāśaṅkararūpam āha viśvakarmā |
carmāmbaraś caturbāhuḥ śūlakhaṭvāṅgapāśadhṛk |
[714]        pṛṣāṅkaḥ śaṅkaro gaurī vāmotsaṅge sthitā bhavet ||
brahmagāyatrīrūpaṃ tu, padmapurāṇoktabrahmāṇḍadāne draṣṭavyam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇayos tu hemahastirathadāne | ratyanaṅgayos tu kalpapādapadāne, lokapālānāṃ ca, brahmāṇḍadāne, graharūpāṇi ca, grahadāneṣu vakṣyante tāni (?) ca yathāśakti suvarṇamayāni kartavyānīti |
tadagre kārayed dhomaṃ tilājyena mahītale |
alaṃkṛtya dvijaṃ śāntaṃ vāsobhiḥ paripūjya ca ||
talliṅgamantrair homaś ca kartavyo jvalite ‘nale |
tatas tāṃs tilakumbhasthān lavaṇābhimukasthitām ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena mantram etam udīrayet |
romatvaṅmāṃsamajjādyaiḥ sarvopakaraṇaiḥ sadā ||
jagataḥ saṃpravṛtto ‘si tvām ataḥ prārthayec chivam |
vāṅmanaḥkāyajanitaṃ yat kiṃcin mama duṣkṛtam ||
tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu tvaddānam upasevitam |
evam uccārya tāṃ dadyād brāḥmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
dānavākyaṃ tu mahiṣīdānavad avagantavyam, kevalaṃ mahiṣīsthāne meṣīprayoga iti |
nābhibhāṣet tato datvā na mukhaṃ cāvalokayet |
duṣṭapratigrahahato vipro bhavati pātakī ||
norṇāyur dakṣiṇāhīnā dātavyā nāvidhānataḥ |
dakṣiṇā vidhinā hīnā duḥkhaśokāvahā bhavet ||
purā dattam idaṃ dānaṃ gauryā dakṣagṛhasthayā |
[715]        tena śubhapatir labdhaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ||

atha meṣadānam | tatra baudhāyanaḥ |

[716]        sauvarṇāś ca khurāḥ kāryāḥ śvetavastreṇa veṣṭayet |

dānamantraḥ |

iti meṣadānam |

evaṃ samuccared bhaktyā dvijahaste jalaṃ kṣipet |

ye bālatve kṛtāḥ pāpāḥ kāmato vāpy akāmataḥ |
yauvane vārdhakonmāde prasaṅgenāpi pātakam ||
ajādānasya māhātmyāt niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ |
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sadācāramatiś ciram ||
mahābhārate |
ajām alaṃkṛtāṃ datvā vahniloke mahīyate |
tam eva lokam āpnoti datvājaṃ vidhivan naraḥ ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti ye ye cetasi saṃsthitāḥ ||
tathā |
ajāvikaṃ ca mahiṣaṃ datvā viprāya śaktitaḥ |
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo yatra yatra sa modate ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
uṣṭraṃ vā gardabhaṃ vāpi yaḥ prayacchati tu dvije |
ajām urabhraṃ tugaraṃ (?) tathā śaktyā sadakṣiṇam ||
alakāṃ sa samāsādya yakṣendraiḥ saha modate |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
[719]        tasmād ajāṃ prayaccha tvaṃ tataḥ sarvam avāpsyasi |
mantreṇānena vidhivad alaṃkṛtya svaśaktitaḥ ||
tvaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā pavitrā bhavatī param |
tvatprasūtotthitā yajñās tasmāc chāntikarī bhava ||
pratigṛhṇīta tāṃ caiva pṛṣṭhadeśe dvijottamaḥ ||
dānavākyaṃ tu mahiṣīdānavad vijñeyam |
evaṃ pradāya viprāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya modate vaiṣṇave pure ||
ity ajādānavidhiḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe kṛṣṇājinādidānaprakaraṇam ||
[720]
atha ekādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha devatādānāni |
āhūtā yasya yajñeṣv anavarataparīrambhasaṃbhogalolā-
garbhasvarmāninīnāṃ katham api śithilīkṛtya tokān nivṛttāḥ |
gīrvāṇaśreṇimukhyās tribhuvanajayibhir yac caritraiḥ pavitrāṃ
dhātrīm āsādya sadyaḥ svabhavanagamanaṃ vismitā vismaranti ||
viśvopakṛtiśīlena tena hemādriśūriṇā |
krameṇa devatādānam idānīm upavarṇyate ||
tatra baudhāyanaḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kārayet kāṃsyato ‘pi vā |
yad vārkamūlakāṣṭhena vighnaṃ vibhavato naraḥ ||
puṣkaraṃ kalpayed dhaimaṃ sauvarṇaṃ locanadvayam |
ākhuṃ ca kalpayet tasya yathā deyo vinirmitaḥ ||
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca kalpayet tasya gulmavān |
anantaraṃ taṃ vāsobhiś candanāgurupūjitam ||
sahiraṇyaṃ brāhmaṇāya svaśaktyā pūjitāya tu |
kṛtahomāya śāntāya sarvaśāstrārthavedine ||
[721]        mantreṇāne vidhivad dakṣiṇābhimukhāya tu |
vināyaka gaṇeśāna sarvadevanamaskṛta ||
pārvatīnandana mama gulmam āśu vināśaya ||
dānamantraḥ |
kṛtenānena dānena nirogo jāyate naraḥ ||
iti vināyakadānavidhiḥ |
tathā |
brāhmaṇaśvāsarodhena hy apasmāro bhaven naraḥ |
vakṣye tasya pratīkāraṃ dānahomakriyādibhiḥ ||
palena vā tadardhena tadardhārdhen vā punaḥ |
vināyakapratikṛtiṃ kuryāt svarṇena śobhanām ||
rājataṃ ca tathā nāgam upavītam prakalpayet |
puṣkaraṃ padmarāgeṇa hastaṃ ratnaiḥ prakalpayet ||
vināyakārdhamānena cākhuṃ devasya kalpayet |
tasyāpy aṅge pradeyāni ratnāni vividhāni ca ||
māṇikyena prakurvīta cakṣuṣo tasya śobhane |
pūrvedyur maṇḍapaṃ kuryād vastraiḥ ṣōḍaśabhir dṛḍham ||
yad vā dvādaśabhiḥ kuryād aṣṭābhir vā prayatnataḥ |
maṇḍapasya caturbhāgāṃ vedikām api kalpayet ||
rātrau vināyakasyāpi hy adhivāsanam iṣyate |
caturbhir brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdham ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstravit ||
svayam eva hi ācāryo dharmajñaḥ satyavāk śuciḥ |
[722]        kulīno na ca vṛddhaś ca sarvaprāṇihite rataḥ ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā madhyarātre baliṃ haret |
matsyamāṃsena sahitaṃ tathā kṣīrodanena ca ||
ācāryaḥ prayato bhūtvā mantreṇānena saṃyataḥ |
pūrvasyāṃ diśi taṃ dadyād baliṃ vai sārvakāmikam ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā devā bhūtāni sarvaśaḥ |
sarvāḥ piśācā ḍākinyaḥ śākinyaḥ pānthadevatāḥ ||
apasmārābhidaivaṃ ca vetālā nairṛtās tathā |
balidānena dattena śāntiṃ kurvantu sarvaśaḥ ||
balidānamantraḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā svahastavāsasaḥ |
bhūṣitāḥ kaṭakaiḥ samyag upavītāṅgulīyakaiḥ ||
kuṇḍāni dikṣu catvāri mekhalāsaṃbhṛtāni tu |
kuryāt teṣu prakurvanti homamantraiḥ svakaiḥ sadā ||
pūrvasmin bahvṛcaḥ kuryāt samidājyacarūtkaṭam |
vināyakaṃ samuddiśya gaṇānāṃ tv eti mantrataḥ ||
tatpuruṣāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi tan no dantī pracodayāt ||
adhvaryur dakṣiṇe kuṇḍe kuryād dhomaṃ samāhitaḥ |
chandogaḥ paścime vāpi taddaivatyena homayet ||
ātharvaṇaś cottare ca kuṇḍe homaṃ prakalpayet |
vināyakāya devāya sarvabhūtahitāya ca ||
gāṇapatye niyuktāya hūṃ phaṭ svasti svadhā namaḥ ||
[723]        samidājyacaruṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutyantam eva hi |
ācāryaḥ pratimānāṃ tu brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃyutaḥ ||
āsane vedikāmadhye vitānādisuśobhite |
tilānām upari sthāpya gandhamālyaiḥ prapūjayet ||
vastrair nānāvidhaiḥ śubhraiḥ keyūrakaṭakādibhiḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣōḍaśabhir naivedyāya ca modakāḥ ||
yathā deve tathā cārye ‘py alaṃkārādi kalpayet |
ācāryaḥ parayā bhaktyā gaṇeśāya prakalpayet ||
apūpādi tathānyac ca kārayed bhakṣakādikam |
nivedya pārvatīṃ cāpi devadevaṃ maheśvaram ||
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā ācāryaṃ svayam eva hi |
tathaiva rogavān bhaktyā saṃpūjya gaṇanāyakam ||
gaṇānāṃ tveti mantreṇa tūṣṇīṃ śūdras tu pūjayet |
tato madhyaṃdine prāpte pratimāṃ dakṣiṇāyutām ||
mantreṇānena dadyāc ca sa rogī prāṅmukhaḥ svayam |
udaṅmukhopaviṣṭāya brāhmaṇāyātibhaktitaḥ ||
vināyaka prapannārtihara vighnavināyaka |
tvaṃ devaiḥ prathitaḥ pūrvaṃ vighnavighnaparāyaṇaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇaśvāsarodhena yaj jātaṃ mama vaikṛtam |
pūrvakarmavipākena hy apasmāronmadādikam ||
jāḍyaṃ vāpy atha vādhiryaṃ nāsikyaṃ vātha bhāṣiṇam |
tvadarcāyāḥ pradānena rogam āśu vināśaya ||
[724]        caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca yathā śaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
evaṃ kṛtvā gaṇapater dānaṃ martyaḥ sukhī bhavet ||
iti vināyakadānavidhiḥ
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyapittalato ‘pi vā |
yad vārkamūlakāṣṭhena vighnaṃ vibhavato naraḥ ||
puṣkaraṃ kalpayed dhaimaṃ sauvarṇaṃ locanadvayam |
ākhuṃ ca kalpayet tasya pādena ca suvarṇakam ||
nāgākāraṃ copavītaṃ suvarṇena prakalpayet |
tilāḍhakadvaye vastrayugmasyopari sthāpayet ||
bhūmau śuddhapradeśe tu bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ |
vastreṇāveṣṭya mativān pūjayet taṃ vināyakam ||
candanāgurudhūpaiś ca kuṅkumenopalepayet |
pūjayed vāhanaṃ vāpi yathā devaṃ tathaiva hi ||
ācāryas tu tilair homaṃ kuryād aṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
gaṇānāṃ tveti mantreṇa tathaivājyāhutīḥ kramāt ||
tasmai homaṃ kṛtavate śāntāya prayatātmane |
dharmaśāstrapravīṇāya vedavedāṅgavedine ||
svācārāyātiśiṣṭāya dakṣiṇābhimukhāya ca |
śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ tu sarvam etat prakalpayet ||
pūjayet taṃ tathācāryaṃ vastreṇa prayataḥ śuciḥ |
pūrvakarmavipākena iha karmakṛtena ca ||
plauhagulmodarāṣṭhīlā udaravyādhayas tu ye |
[725]        tat saraṃ naśyate tūrṇaṃ dāne dāne na saṃśayaḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivad bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ |
vināyaka gaṇeśāna sarvadevanamaskṛta ||
pārvatīnandana mama śamaya vyādhim audaram |
gulmaplīhānam aṣṭhīlaṃ vyādhijātaṃ yad audaram ||
tava dānena mahatā yuktenākhuratena hi |
nāśayāśu maheśānaputra bhaktasya ca prabho ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ kuryād gaṇapater dānaṃ vyādhivimocanam |
iti vighneśadānavidhiḥ |
atha sarasvatīdānam | vāyupurāṇe |
vāgvirodhaṃ guroḥ kṛtvā bhaved gadgadavāk naraḥ |
tasya vakṣye pratīkāraṃ dānena ṛṣibhāṣitam ||
palenātha tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
sārasvatīṃ ca pratimāṃ kuryād bhujacatuṣṭayām ||
varadaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca bibhratīṃ dakṣiṇe kare |
pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dadhānāṃ haṃsavāhanām ||
atiśubhreṇa raupyeṇa kūṭasvarṇena vā bhavet |
āsanaṃ ca prakurvīta sauvarṇaṃ padmam uttamam ||
tasyopari ca saṃveśya devīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ parām |
[726]        muktādāmabhūṣitāṅgāṃ śuklavastreṇa saṃyutām ||
vāgīśvareṇa mantreṇa pūjayet sitataṇḍulaiḥ |
śvetapuṣpaiḥ śvetagandaiḥ saṃskṛtya vidhipūrvakam ||
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvaśāstrajñaḥ kuśalaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ |
mantravādapravīṇaś ca tena homaṃ ca kārayet ||
pāyasaṃ juhuyād aṣṭaśataṃ śālimayaṃ tathā |
juhuyāt samidhaś cāpi tathājyaṃ ca tilān api ||
sarasvatīpredamava iti vā mantra iṣyate |
kṛte brahmodvāsane tām ācāryāya nivedayet ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
saṃpūjya brāhmaṇaṃ samyak vastrālaṃkārapūrvakam ||
yā vaktre brahmaṇo devī yā sā vāgīśvarī parā |
brahmaviṣṇuśivaiś cānyaiḥ pūjitā sarvavanditā ||
tuṣṭā bhavatu dānena dattenānena vāk parā |
vāgvirodhaṃ guroḥ kṛtvā yan me gadgadabhāṣaṇam ||
tat sarvaṃ kṣapaya kṣipraṃ brāhmī tvaṃ lokapāvanī ||
tathā dānamantraḥ |
anujñāpya brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta mānavaḥ ||
iti sarasvatīdānavidhiḥ |
tathā |
svaropaghātī vācāṃ ca hartā mūkaḥ prajāyate |
vakṣye tasya pratīkāraṃ dānahomair narottamaḥ ||
[727]        palārdhena tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
rajatena suśuddhena kuryāt pratikṛtiṃ śubhām ||
sarasvatīṃ caturhastāṃ pāśāṅkuśakamaṇḍalum |
tathaivābhayahastāṃ ca śvetavastreṇa saṃyutām ||
śvetamālyaiḥ śvetagandhair mūlamantreṇa pūjayet |
homaṃ ca kārayet tatra samidājyacarūtkaṭam ||
sarasvatipredamava iti mantraś ca coditaḥ |
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajñaḥ svācāraḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca medhāvī supadas tathā |
evaṃlakṣaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvatrācārya iṣyate ||
praṇamya gṛham ānīya pūjayed bhaktipūrvakam |
evaṃ homaṃ ca kṛtvā tu pūjayec ca sarasvatīm ||
sarasvatyai nama iti yathāliṅgaṃ tu mantrataḥ |
tasmai hutavate tāṃ tu devīṃ dadyāt sadakṣiṇām ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
saumye devi mahābhāge sarvadevanamaskṛte ||
padmāsanagate sarvajagatām ārtihāriṇi |
svaropaghātān madīyaṃ tu prajñājāḍyam apānuda ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu prakṛtiṃ sarasvatyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
svaropaghātajanitāt prajñājāḍyād vimucyate ||
medhākaram idaṃ dānaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
[728]        viśeṣaś cāyam udito japasyopakramo bhavet ||
tadaitat prathamaṃ dānaṃ kṛtvā japam upakramet |
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāt svayaṃ tad upayojayet ||
pūrve dyur upavāsaṃ ca kṛtvaivopakramo bhavet |
kāyaśuddhiś ca kartavyā yāvatālavaṇo bhavet ||
ity aparasarasvatīdānavidhiḥ |
atha ghaṇṭādānam | brahmavaivartapurāṇe |
guruṇā hy ananujñāto yo vedādhyayanaṃ caret |
sa prajñayā vihīnas tu saṃsāre jāyate naraḥ ||
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ śuddhakāṃsyamayīṃ dṛḍhām |
śobhanāṃ ghāṭayed ghaṇṭāṃ śubharekhāvibhūṣitām ||
palais tu kuryād viṃśadbhis triṃśadbhir vā tadardhataḥ |
susvarāntām atiślakṣṇāṃ pañcagavyena dhāvayet ||
śvetavastreṇa saṃvītān taṇḍulopari vinyaset |
taṇḍulānāṃ parīmāṇaṃ droṇānāṃ trayam eva ca ||
tadardham atha vā grāhyaṃ parīmāṇaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajño vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||
dharmaśāstre ca kuśalaḥ svācāraḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ |
āhūya parayā bhaktyā svayam eva gṛhaṃ gataḥ ||
[729]        tenaiva kārayet pūjāṃ ghaṇṭāyāḥ śāstracoditaiḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir mantreṇānena bhaktataḥ ||
āvāhayet tu vāgīśāṃ ghaṇṭāyāṃ parameśvarīm |
ehy ehi devi sarveśi ghaṇṭāyāṃ saṃnidhiṃ kuru ||
sarvasattvopakārī tvaṃ jñānamudre pātāt pare ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
evam āvāhya tāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi pūjayet |
brahmayajñānamantreṇa ghaṇṭāṃ pūjya tathāmbaram ||
mantrādhyāyoktamārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāpyātha bhaktitaḥ |
homaṃ kuryāt prayatnena samidājyatilair api ||
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyād devyai ca brahmaṇe tathā |
sarasvatipredam iti mantraḥ sarvatra saṃmataḥ ||
tasmai hutavate dadyāt tāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ pūjitāya tu |
mantreṇānena vidhivad rogī pūrvamukhaḥ śuciḥ ||
udaṅmukhopaviṣṭāya satīyām atha bhaktitaḥ |
guror avajñayā yac ca svādhyāyādhyayanaṃ kṛtam ||
sarasvati jaganmātar jagajjāḍyāpahāriṇī |
sākṣād brahmakalatraṃ tvaṃ viṣṇurudrādibhiḥ stutā ||
tan mamādhyayanotpannaṃ jāḍyaṃ hara varānane |
ghaṇṭādānena tuṣṭā tvaṃ brahmāṇī lokapāvani ||
evaṃ dānaṃ ca datvā ca tam ācāryaṃ kṣamāpya ca ||
anyebhyaḥ śaktitodadyād brāhmaṇebhyaś ca bhojanam |
[730]        tataḥ svabandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ snātvā bhuñjīta mānavaḥ ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute dānaṃ prajñāhīno jaḍo ‘tha (?) vā |
prajñāvān ajaḍo jantur jāyate vākpatir yathā |
jāyate vākpravāhaś ca sākṣād gaṅgām avāhayat ||
iti ghaṇṭādānavidhiḥ |
atha lakṣmīdānam | liṅgapurāṇe |
lakṣmīdānaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahad aiśvaryavardhanam |
lūtādibraṇanāśāya viśeṣeṇa śivoditam ||
pūrvoktamaṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā vedikoparimaṇḍale |
śrīdevīm atulāṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyena yathāvidhi ||
sahasreṇa tadardhena tadardhārdena vā punaḥ |
aṣṭottaraśatenāpi sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām ||
maṇḍale vinyasel lakṣmīṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutām |
tasyāstu dakṣiṇe bhāge sthaṇḍile viṣṇum arcayet ||
pūrvokteti, kuṇḍamaṇḍapamaṇḍalavedikāvitānādiliṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavihitam iti veditavyam | sahasrādisaṃkhyā cātra niṣkaiḥ paripūraṇīyā, liṅgapurāṇoktadāneṣu prāyaśas tair eva vyavahāradarśanāt |
lakṣmīlakṣaṇam uktaṃ kalpapādapapradāne |
arcayitvā vidhānena śrīsūktena sureśvarīm |
arcayed viṣṇugāyatryā viṣṇuṃ viśvaguruṃ harim ||
[731]        ārādhya vidhinā siddhiṃ pūrvato homam ārabhet |
samiddhutyā vidhānena ājyāhitim upācaret |
pṛthag aṣṭottaraśataṃ homayed brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||
śrīsūktam, hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīm ityādi | viṣṇugāyatrī tu liṅgapurāna evoktā nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi tan no viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt iti | pūrvoktamaṇḍale lakṣmīṃ vinyasya tasyā dakṣiṇataḥ sthaṇḍile viṣṇudaivatyā gāyatryā viṣṇudevam ārādhya tataḥ pañcadaśarcena śrīsūktena yathākramaṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ śriyaṃ pūjayet ārādhya siddham iti siddhilakṣmīḥ |
kāmite tu |
śrīmantreṇa yajel lakṣmīṃ śrīsūktenātha vārcayet |
pūrvavac chivapūjā ca homaś caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
ekahomaṃ tu vā kuryāt prāguktavidhinā guruḥ |
sahasrakalaśādyaiś ca śriyam arcya śriyaṃ dadet || iti |
homaś ca śrīsūktenaiva āhūya yajamānaṃ tu tasyāḥ pūrvadiśi sthale |
tasmaitāṃ darśayad devīṃ daṇḍavat praṇamet kṣitau |
praṇamya viṣṇuṃ tatrasthaṃ śivaṃ pūrvavad arcayet ||
pūrvavad iti liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavad ity arthaḥ |
tasyā viṃśatibhāgas tu dakṣiṇā vai prakīrtitā |
taddaśāṃśā tu dātavyā itareṣāṃ yathārhataḥ ||
tatas tān bhojayed viprān vedavedāṅgapāragān |
[732]        tasyā lakṣmīpratimāyāḥ viṃśāṃśasya samānato ||
anyad dhanaṃ gurave dakṣiṇāṃ daśāṃśamānaṃ pratyekam ṛtvigbhyaḥ itarebhyo dvārajāpakebhyo ‘pi ṛtvigardham | tad uktaṃ vātule |
lakṣmīṃ praṇamya vidvadbhyaḥ śrotriyebhyaḥ samarpayet |
tasmād viṃśatibhāgas tu dakṣiṇā deśikasya hi ||
taddaśāṃśas tu dātayvo japtā vedavidāṃ varaḥ |
puṇyāhavācakānāṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ dāpayet tathā ||
iti lakṣmīdānavidhiḥ |
atha nārāyaṇadānam | brahmaproktam |
yajñavighnakaro martyo jāyate cāntravṛddhimān |
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ dānahomādikarmaṇā ||
kuryāt svarṇamayīṃ mūrtiṃ śubhāṃ nārāyaṇasya tu |
vyāvahārikaniṣkābhyām ekenātha tadardhataḥ ||
nārāyaṇalakṣaṇam uktaṃ hemahastirathadāne |
prakṣālya pañcagavyena sthāpayet kuṅkumopari |
śvetavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya gandhamālyaiḥ samarcayet ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir ācāryo vaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ |
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajño brahmavidyāsuniṣṭhitaḥ ||
[733]        homaṃ ca kārayet tatra hy āgneyyāṃ diśi śāstrataḥ |
samidājyatilaiś caiva mūlamantreṇa vai samit ||
ājyaṃ nārāyaṇāyeti tilān vyāhṛtibhir hunet |
rogī tathārcayed devaṃ nārāyaṇam anāmayam ||
mūlamantreṇa vidhivan naivedyaṃ carur iṣyate |
namo’ntaṃ nāma soṃkāraṃ mūlamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
tatas tāṃ pratimāṃ dadyāt prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
mantreṇānena vidhivad bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||
nārāyaṇa jagannātha śaṅkacakragadhādhara |
pūrvamanmani yajñāder vighnād yad vai kṛtaṃ mama ||
antravṛddhimahārogaṃ dānenānena toṣitaḥ |
cakrahasta gadāpāṇe śamayāśu jagatpate ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu taṃ devaṃ kṣamāpya brāḥmaṇaṃ tataḥ |
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dadyāt snātvā bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ ||
evaṃ kṛtvā samāpnoti nīrogatvaṃ naro bhuvi |
ārogyayukto nityaṃ sa śuciraṃ sukham edhate ||
iti nārāyaṇamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
ath gopālamūrtidānam | tathā |
naktāndhyaṃ jāyate tasya yo gavāṃ nayanadvaye |
[734]        karoti śūlaprakṣepaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim ||
viṣṇoḥ śrīgopaveṣasya yathāśaktyā ca bhaktitaḥ |
suvarṇena pratikṛtiṃ veṇuvādanatatparām ||
varhāpīḍakasaṃyuktāṃ dvibhujām ūrddhvasaṃsthitām |
kārayitvā śubhākārāṃ prakṣālya śubhavāriṇā ||
vastreṇa veṣṭayitvātha gandhamālyaiḥ samarcayet |
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāpya yathāvibhavataḥ svayam ||
pūjāṃ ca mūlamantreṇa kuryād devasya bhaktitaḥ |
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajño vedavedāṅgaparagaḥ ||
evaṃbhūtaṃ samānīya tena pūjāṃ prakalpayet |
homaṃ caiva prakurvīta samidājyatilair api ||
idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pratadviṣṇur viṣṇor nukam iti kramāt |
mantrādhyāyoktamārgeṇa cāgneḥ saṃsthāpanaṃ bhavet ||
praṇītāmokṣaparyantaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ prapūjayet |
devasya dadyān naivedyaṃ haviḥ sarvaṃ samantataḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśatenāpi mūlamantreṇa vai śrutam |
juhuyād atha rogī tu prāṅmukhaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhamālyānulepanaḥ |
sadakṣiṇāṃ ca tān dadyāt prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivan namaskṛtyātibhaktitaḥ ||
govinda gopījanavallabheśa
kaṃsāsuraghna tridaśendravandya |
govardhanādripravaraikahata
[735]                saṃrakṣitā śeṣagavām anīka ||
gocakṣuṣāṃ cātinirodhajena
pāpena me nāśaya āndhyam etat |
tvadīyadānena suhṛṣṭarūpaṃ
naktāndhyam etat samupākarotu ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā pratīkāraṃ gopaveṣadharasya tu |
tatkṣaṇād eva hi sukhī jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti gopālamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha varāhadānam | bhaviṣottarāt |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
dānam ādivarāhasya kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira |
dharaṇyāṃ yat purā proktaṃ varāhavapuṣā mayā ||
puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ āyuṣyaṃ sarvadānottamottamam |
mahāpāpādidoṣāghnaṃ pūjitaṃ munisattamaiḥ ||
deyaṃ saṃkramaṇe bhānor grahaṇe dvādaśītithau |
yajñotsavavivāheṣu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ||
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam |
tadaiva tasya kālaḥ syād adhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ ||
kurukṣetrāditīrtheṣu gaṅgādyāsu nadīṣu ca |
[736]        goṣṭhe devālaye vāpi ramye vātha gṛhāṅgaṇe ||
deyaṃ purāṇavidhinā brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine |
avyaṅgāya śuśīlāya vedavedāṅgavādine ||
deśaṃ kālaṃ ca pātraṃ ca yathāvat te mayoditam |
śṛṇu dānavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param ||
pūrvottaraplavāṃ bhūmiṃ gomayenopalepayet |
kuśair āstīrya tāṃ pārśve praṇavākṣaramantritaiḥ ||
upariṣṭāt tilais teṣāṃ vārāhaṃ parikalpayet |
droṇaiś caturbhiḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ tadardhenātha vā punaḥ ||
āḍhakenāpi kurvīta vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet |
suvarṇena khurau kāryau bhujau cakragadānvitau ||
rājatīṃ kārayed daṃṣṭrāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣitām |
śaṅkhaṃ ca sthāpayet pārśve vanamālāṃ hiraṇmayīm ||
puṣpair vā kārayed vidvān pādau raupyamayau tathā |
daṃṣṭrāgralagnavasudhāṃ sauvarṇīṃ kārayec chubhām ||
sarvadhānyarasopetāṃ vastrālaṃkṛtavigrahām ||
droṇādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ paribhāṣāyām | pṛthvīlakṣaṇaṃ ca dharādāne draṣṭavyam |
pracchādya vastrair deveśaṃ varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam |
romarājiṃ kuśaiḥ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpair athārcayet ||
navagrahamakhaḥ kāryo homaś cātra tilaiḥ smṛtaḥ |
evaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivat tataḥ stotram udīrayet ||
[737]        varāhā śeṣaduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni ca |
marda marda mahādaṃṣṭra bhāsvatkanakakuṇḍala ||
śaṅkhacakrāsihastāya hiraṇyākṣāntakāya ca |
daṃṣṭroddhṛtakṣitipate trayīmūrtimate namaḥ ||
ity uccārya namaskṛtya triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇam |
tatas taṃ brāhmaṇe dadyād yathālaṃkāravigraham ||
pratigrahaś ca tasyoktaḥ pādayoḥ paramarṣibhiḥ |
anena vidhinā datvā varāhaṃ dakṣiṇānvitam ||
ācāryam atha saṃpūjya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
evaṃ datvā mahīnātha varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
yat phalaṃ samavāpnoti datvā devaṃ janārdanam |
yathā samuddhṛtā devī varāheṇa vasundharā ||
tathā kulaṃ samuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ strīṇāṃ śūdrajanasya ca |
etat sādhāraṇaṃ dānaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām ||
viprāya vedaviduṣe nṛvarāharūpaṃ
datvā tilān api suvarṇamayaṃ suvastram |
uddhṛtya pūrvapuruṣān sakalatramitraḥ
prāpnoti viṣṇubhuvanaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam ||
iti varāhadānavidhiḥ |
[738]
atha narasiṃhadānam | kālikāpurāṇe |
nṛsiṃhaṃ cātha raukmaṃ tu kṛtvā caturbhujaṃ vibhum |
tāmrapātre pratiṣṭhāpya raupye daṃṣṭre prakalpayet ||
cakṣuṣī padmarāgeṇa nakhānāṃ vidrumās tathā |
puṣparāgaṃ bhruor deśe karṇayor hīrakāv ubhau ||
nṛsiṃharūpaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottarāt |
kāryas tu bhagavān viṣṇur narasiṃhavapurdharaḥ |
pīnaskandhakaṭigrīvaḥ kṛśamadhyaḥ kṛśodaraḥ ||
siṃhāsano nṛdehaś ca nīlavāsāḥ prabhānvitaḥ |
ālīḍhasthānasaṃsthānaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
jvālamālākulamukhojvalat kesaramaṇḍalaḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipor vakṣaḥ pāṭayan na kharaiḥ kharaiḥ ||
devajānugataḥ kāryo hiraṇyakaśipus tathā |
devaś ca śaṅkhacakrābhyāṃ bhūṣito ‘rdhakaradvayaḥ || iti |
gandhapuṣpais tathā dhūpair jāgaran tatra kārayet |
rājavartma ca vaidūryam indarnīlaṃ sumastake ||
kṛtvā rūpam idaṃ ramyaṃ tat pātraṃ madhunā budhaḥ |
pūrayet khaṇḍamiśreṇa tatra devaṃ punar nyaset ||
vastrayugmena saṃchannam āsane viniveśayet |
naivedyaṃ kalpayed agryaṃ bhakṣyair nānāvidhair budhaḥ ||
vitānopari saṃyuktaṃ puṣpadāmabhir arcayet |
[739]        gandhapuṣpais tathādhūpair jāgaraṃ cārcya kārayet ||
kṛtvā samastam etat tu haraye pūrvavad dadet |
yat kiṃcit prāg vinirdiṣṭaṃ kuryāt sarvam ihāpi tat ||
prāgvinirdiṣṭam iti vaiṣṇavamantreṇa pūjanam, mūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśataṃ tilājyahomaḥ dvādaśebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadakṣiṇam annadānam iti |
kārtikyāṃ vātha caiśākhyām āśritya dvādaśīm atha |
kṛtvā vidhim imaṃ samyak nūnaṃ tat padam aśnute ||
araṇye vātha saṃgrāme taskarair daṃṣṭribhir vṛte |
na bhayaṃ jāyate tasya sakṛd yas tvaṃ tad ācaret ||
vidārya cāpado ghorān dhanam āyuḥ prayacchati |
santatiṃ caiva rūpaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ ca manorathān ||
evaṃ bhavati yat puṇyaṃ nṛsiṃhākṛtidānataḥ |
tena viṣṇoḥ padaṃ prāpya tatra krīḍanti dehinaḥ ||
etat śrutvā mahat puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
dhanam āyur vivardheta śrāvakasya viśeṣataḥ |
śrāvake dakṣiṇān dadyāc chaktyā cātmavibhūtaye ||
iti nṛsiṃhadānavidhiḥ |
atha lakṣmīnārāyaṇadānam | tatra baudhāyanaḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ rūpaṃ suvarṇena prakalpayet |
[740] lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpam uktaṃ kāmike |
palena vā tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
padmāsanagataṃ kuryād devadevaṃ caturbhujam ||
dakṣiṇādhaḥkare padmaṃ śaṅkham ūrdhvakare nyaset |
vāmordhve ca bhavec cakraṃ lakṣmīpṛṣṭhe karo ‘paraḥ ||
vāmotsaṅgagatā lakṣmī ratnapātrakarā bhavet |
dakṣiṇaś ca bhujā devyāḥ pṛṣṭhe devasya cakriṇaḥ || iti |
garuḍaṃ rājataṃ kuryād devadevasya vāhanam |
pakṣau ca tasya sauvarṇau sauvarṇī caiva nāsikā ||
vastrair atyantaruciraiḥ paridhāpyātikautukam |
arcayet kusumair yugmaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakam ||
prasannaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca garuḍoparisaṃsthitam |
tato vipraṃ samāhūya suśīlaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ||
ācāravantaṃ dharmajñaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam |
pratigrahanivṛttaṃ ca śrutismṛtipathe sthitam ||
svayaṃ bhaktyā samānīya pūjayed vastrakuṇḍalaiḥ |
kuṅkumāgurukarpūrair upavītāṅgulīyakaiḥ ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena homaṃ tatra tu kārayet |
mantreṇānena taṃ dadyāt sarvalokanamaskṛtam ||
lakṣmīpate devakinandaneśa
kṣīrābdhiśāyin vacasām agamya |
[741]        govindadāmodara vātaraktaṃ
vināśayāśu kṣapitārivarga ||
dānamantraḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyaivaṃ mūrtiṃ datvātibhaktitaḥ |
ārogyavān sukhī nityaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha garuḍadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi garuḍaṃ kārayet sudhīḥ |
tāmreṇa vātha palataḥ svaśaktyā vāpi nārada ||
nāsikāṃ svarṇamayīṃ kuryāt kuryān netradvayaṃ tathā ||
garuḍamūrtilakṣaṇaṃ tu tithidānaprakaraṇasthitaikādaśīvihitagāruḍadāne vilokanīyam |
śvetavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya tāmrapātropari sthitam |
candanāgurukarpūraiḥ śvetamālyair viśeṣataḥ ||
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā gāyatryā garuḍāhvayam |
homaṃ kuryāc ca tatraiva samidājyatilais tathā ||
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvaśāstrārthakuśalo nimalātmavān |
vaiṣṇavo dhārmikaḥ śāntaḥ svācāraḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ ||
tat puruṣāya vidmahe pakṣirājāya dhīmahi tan naḥ suparṇaḥ pracodayāt |
[742]         tat puruṣāya vidmahe vāyuvegāya dhīmahi tan no ‘mṛtamathanaḥ pracodayāt |
tat puruṣāya vidmahe vaitaneyāya dhīmahi tan nas tārkṣyaḥ pracodayāt |
samidājyatilānām tu mantrā ete yathākramam |
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ ||
yajamānaḥ svayaṃ bhaktyā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
brāhmaṇāya pradadyāt taṃ hṛdi nārāyaṇaṃ smaran ||
mantreṇānena saṃpūjya vastrādyaiś ca svaśaktitaḥ |
vihaṅgarāja pakṣīśa suparṇītanaya prabho ||
sarpāśana viyadratna pūrvajanmani yat kṛtam |
devadravyāpaharaṇaṃ tena yad vai kṛtaṃ mama ||
vināśayāśu me sarvaṃ śrīnārāyaṇavāhana |
tato niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā nīrujo jāyate naraḥ ||
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpāt yasmāj jātaṃ hi vaikṛtam |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā svaśaktyā tu viśeṣataḥ ||
iti garuḍadānavidhiḥ |
athāha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
kāmalī bhaktacauraḥ syāt tasya vaikṣyāmi niṣkṛtim |
kuryāc ca śatamānābhyāṃ viṣṇor vāhanam uttamam ||
suvarṇenātiśuddhena pakṣayor mauktikadvayam |
[743]        nāśikāyāṃ tathā vajram uttarīyaṃ ca rājatam ||
evaṃ kṛtvā garutmantaṃ ghṛtadroṇopari nyaset |
śvetavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya śvetamālyaiḥ samarcayet ||
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajño vaiṣṇavo dharmapāṭhakaḥ |
brāhmaṇas tv arcito bhaktyā yajamānena śaktitaḥ ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir dvijam abhyarcayet tathā |
āgneyyāṃ diśi homaś ca kartavyaḥ sthaṇḍile śubhe ||
samidājyatilais tatra palāśasamidho ‘pi ca |
manto garuḍagāyatrī samit tv ājyaṃ ca kīrtitā |
tilahomo vyāhṛtibhiḥ kāryaḥ sviṣṭakrtaṃ yajet ||
garuḍagāyatrī prāgabhihitā |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ sitavastreṇa veṣṭitam |
nikṣipen navaratnāni mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ tathā ||
aśvasthānād gajasthānād valmīkāt saṃgamād hradāt |
pañcatvakpallavāni syuḥ pūrayet tīrthavāriṇā ||
tenābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta āpohiṣṭhādibhiḥ kramāt |
hiraṇyavarṇeti ṛcā pavamānena caiva hi ||
tataḥ snātvā śucī rogī viṣṇor vāhanam uttamam |
sadakṣiṇaṃ mudā yuktaḥ prāṅmukhāya nivedayet ||
mantreṇānena vidhivad ācāryāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇa paramānanda jagataḥ paripālaka ||
pūrvajanmani yat pāpaṃ bhaktacauryaṃ mayā kṛtam |
[744]        tenāvāptuṃ tu vairūpyaṃ tanmayaṃ hy atiduḥsaham ||
kāmaloyam imaṃ deva tava vāhanadānataḥ |
vināśayāśu me kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ pālako hy asi ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ garuḍadānaṃ tu kṛtvā martyaḥ sukhī bhavet |
ācāryaṃ bhojayitvā ca praṇipatya visarjayet ||
ity aparagaruḍadānavidhiḥ |
atha padmapurāṇe |
janmāntarākṣirodhena jāyate hy akṣivedanā |
yakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ brahmaṇā bhāṣitaṃ purā ||
palena kārayed dhemnā garuḍaṃ viṣṇuvāhanam |
rājatau ca tathā pakṣau ratnair naddhau suvistṛtau ||
kartavyaṃ cākṣiyugalaṃ māṇikyābhyāṃ prakalpayet |
pādayoḥ svarṇakaṭakaṃ ratnābhyāṃ parikalpayet ||
graiveyakaṃ svarṇamayaṃ grīvāyāṃ ap vinyaset |
nāsikāṃ vajravaidūryaṃ mauktikopari kalpayet ||
vastrair nānāvidhair naddham alaṃkṛtya śubhākṛtim |
sthāpayet purato viṣṇoḥ prītyarthaṃ ca nagādhipam ||
gandhapuṣpākṣatair vyastraiḥ [?] pūjayed brāhmaṇottamaḥ |
vedavedāṅgakuśalo brahmavidyāsuniṣṭhitaḥ ||
homaś ca tatra kartavyo mantrais tadvācakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
[745]        yad vā garuḍagāyatryā samidājyatilādibhiḥ ||
agneḥ pratiṣṭhā kāryā tu svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ |
garuḍagāyatrī prathamagaruḍadāne darśitā |
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ ||
tasmai hutavate dadyāc chauriprītyartham ādṛtaḥ |
bhaktyā saṃpūjya vidhivat keyūrakaṭakādibhiḥ ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāyākṣirogavān |
devadeva jagannātha lakṣmīpriya parāt para ||
vāhanasya pradānena tuṣṭaḥ karmavipākajam |
akṣirogaṃ jagannātha nārāyaṇa jaganmaya ||
puṣpaṃ vā paṭalaṃ vāpi vātaraktam athāpi vā |
raktaṃ vāpy atha naktāndhyaṃ tathānyad budbudādikam ||
dānamantraḥ |
tato visṛjya viprendra śiṣṭair iṣṭaiś ca bandhubhiḥ |
snātvā viprān bhojayitvā sukhī bhavati mānavaḥ ||
iti garuḍamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
athomāmaheśadānam | āha baudhāyanaḥ |
brāhmaṇāṅgāni yo hiṃsyād dadrurogī bhavet tu saḥ |
tasyopaśamanaṃ vakṣye suvarṇena tu kārayet ||
tadardhena tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
[746]        umāmaheśvaraṃ rūpaṃ vṛṣabheṇa tv adhiṣṭhitam ||
caturbhujaṃ tu dvibhujām umāṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
akṣamālāṃ triśūlaṃ ca tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ||
devīpṛṣṭhagataś caiko varadaś cāparaḥ karaḥ |
vāmotsaṅgagatā devī śivapṛṣṭaikapāṇikā ||
vṛṣabho rājataś cātra kāryo ghaṇṭādisaṃyutaḥ |
svaśaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ tu kurvato niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
tatrāpy āropya deveśam umayā sahitaṃ prabhum |
vastrair mālyais tathā gandhair mūlamanteṇa pūjayet ||
tato brāhmaṇam āhūya daridraṃ dharmakovidam |
śrutsvṛttopasaṃpannaṃ śāntaṃ caivātmavedinam ||
vastrāṅgulīyakais tasya pūjāṃ bhaktyā prakalpayet |
homaṃ ca kārayet tena samidājyatilair api ||
mantraś ca rudragāyatrī sarvatreti viniścayaḥ ||
rudragāyatrī tu liṅgapurāṇe |
sarveśvarāya vidmahe śūlahastāya dhīmahi tan no rudraḥ pracodayāt |
yad vā tryambakenaiva samidho juhuyāt sudhīḥ |
kadrudrāyeti mantreṇa juhuyād ājyam ādṛtaḥ ||
tilāṃś ca mūlamantreṇa sarvatraivaṃ kramo bhavet |
tathā brahmodvāsanānte mithunaṃ brāhmaṇāya tu ||
vṛṣabhopari tiṣṭhantaṃ bhaktyā tu vinivedayet |
[747]        mantreṇānena vidhivad dadrurogī jitātmavān ||
kailāsavāsī bhagavān umayā sahitaḥ paraḥ |
bhaganetraharo dadrurogam āśu vyapohatu ||
dānamantraḥ |
tataś ca brāhmaṇaṃ samyak praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
brāḥmaṇān bhojayec cāpi svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
evaṃ datvā mahādānaṃ dadrurogād vimucyate ||
iti umāmaheśvaradānavidhiḥ |
atha rudramūrtidānam | vāyupurāṇe |
annacauro bhaved yas tu so ‘kasmāj jāyate kṛśaḥ |
vakṣye tasya pratīkāraṃ dānahomābhiṣecanaiḥ ||
palena vā tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
savarṇena pratikṛtiṃ kuryād rudrasya bhaktitaḥ ||
yad vā vibhavasāreṇa trinetraṃ caturānanam |
caturbāhuṃ dhyānaparam upaviṣṭaṃ sukhāsane ||
vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam |
śvetavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya taṇḍulopari vinyaset ||
taṇḍulānāṃ parīmāṇaṃ droṇānāṃ tu catuṣṭayam |
yad vā svavibhavenaiva tatra pūjāṃ prakalpayet ||
gandhamālyaiḥ surabhibhiḥ śvetair nānāvidhair api |
[748]        upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstravit ||
mūlamantreṇa sarvaṃ ca kāryaṃ pūjādikaṃ caret |
homaś ca tatra kartavyaḥ sthaṇḍile supariṣkṛte ||
mantrādhyāyoktamārgeṇa cāgneḥ saṃsthāpanaṃ bhavet |
samidājyatilair mantrānimāṃs tatra prakalpayet ||
āmbakaṃ kadrudrāya vāmadeva iti kramāt |
saṃkhyā cāṣṭottaraśataṃ pratyekam iha gṛhyate ||
hutvā hutvā ca saṃpātāt pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
agneḥ pūrvottare deśe sthāpayet sakalaṃ dṛḍham ||
vāsasā veṣṭayitvā ca pañcapallavasaṃyutam |
aśvasthānād gajasthānād valmīkāt saṃgamād dhradāt ||
prakṣeptavyā kurvīta homānte ca guruḥ svayam |
āpohiṣṭādibhis tadvad dhiraṇyādibhir eva ca ||
pavamānānuvākena śannovākena caiva hi |
śarīrābhyāṃ janaṃ kāryaṃ saṃpātaikyena sarvaśaḥ ||
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ |
yajamānaḥ śucir bhūtvā deveśaṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
mūlamantreṇa ca punas tasmai hutavate ‘rcite |
dadyāt tāṃ devadevasya pratimāṃ śaṅkarasya tu ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
devadeva maheśāna vṛṣabhadhvaja śaṅkara ||
annacauryeṇa yat pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ janmāntare mayā |
[749]        tena yaj janitaṃ kārśyam asahyaṃ mama dehajam |
tava dānena dattena pīno ‘smi rakṣa pāpinam ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ yo vidhinānena śaṅkarapratimān naraḥ |
dadāt vipravaryāya sa kārśyād vipramucyate ||
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇān api bhojayet ||
iti rudramūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha dakṣiṇamūrtidānam | vāyupurāṇe |
śrūyatāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dānaṃ sarvottamottamam |
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ yena nāśaḥ prajāyate |
pāpānāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ proktā munibhiḥ śāstradarśibhiḥ ||
tapohomajapaprāyā sā hi kāryā prayatnataḥ |
etat tu sarvapāpānāṃ prāyaścittam anuttamam ||
mahāpātakadoṣeṣu pātake copapātake |
anyeṣām api doṣāṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ parivartate ||
palatrayeṇa deveśa suvarṇasya prakalpayet |
īśānaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ sarvajñaṃ lokasākṣiṇam ||
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau vinyasya paṅkajam |
nānārajobhis tanmadhye puṇḍarīkaṃ nyaset tataḥ ||
[750]        tatkarṇikāyāṃ deveśam arcayed dhemarūpiṇam |
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śāntaṃ sarvakāraṇakāranam |
sarvadevanamaskṛtyaṃ sarvadevāntavedinam ||
pāpendhanamahāvahniṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraṇam |
karuṇaughamahāsindhuṃ candramauliṃ maheśvaram ||
varadānābhyakaraṃ sarvāṅgaṃ ca mahārṇavam |
evaṃ saṃcintya deveśam arcayed brahma paṅkajaiḥ ||
śvetair vikasitaiḥ padmaiḥ sitacandanavāriṇā |
karpūraviddham aguruṃ dhūpārthaṃ ca nivedayet ||
kṣaume ca vāsaso dadyāt pāyasaṃ ca nivedayet |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nivedya paramātmane ||
ātmānam arcayitvā tu tato vipraṃ samarcayet |
vedavedāṅgaviduṣaṃ śāntaṃ śivaparāyaṇam ||
jñānanirdagdhakarmāṇaṃ nityanaimittike ratam |
tam eva devaṃ saṃkalpya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
praṇipatya tu taṃ devaṃ tato mantram udīrayet |
bhagavan sarvabhūtajña sarvajñāmṛta śaṅkara ||
tvatprasādena me śeṣaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatu sarvataḥ |
yat pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavaṃ mama śaṅkara ||
tava rūpapradānān me vilayaṃ yāntu sarvataḥ |
ajñe pāpe nirācāre tvam eva śaraṇaṃ gate ||
mayi sarvaughanāśena dayāṃ kuru maheśvara |
[751]        ity āmantrya tato dadyāc chivaḥ saṃprīyatām iti ||
