kriyākalāpam akhilam ātmānaṃ malasaṃcayam |
sarvaṃ nivedayet tasmai viśvarūpāya śaṃbhave ||
anena vidhinā yas tu pradadyāt sarvaniṣkṛtim |
tasya sarvāṇi pāpāni vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
yathā naśyanti sūryasya saṃnidhau sakalaṃ tamaḥ |
tathā śivapradānena sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyatu ||
yathaidhāṃsi samiddho ‘gnir bhasmasāt kurute kṣaṇāt |
tathāyaṃ bhagavān śaṃbhuḥ śaraṇāgataduṣkṛtam ||
sarvadharmavihīnasya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
api cet syāt sa sarvebhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ kṛtamānasaḥ ||
sarvaṃ śivaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ saṃtariṣyati |
tasmād yaḥ sarvam utsṛjya śaraṇaṃ yāti śaṅkaram ||
bhaktyā paramayā tasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit |
jīvato hi bhavet pāpam avaśyaṃ mānuṣātmanaḥ ||
tasya pāpasya vai nāsti prayaścittaṃ vinā kṣayaḥ |
tasmāt kuryāt prayatnena niṣkṛtiṃ prativatsaram ||
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmāt saṃpad ārogyam eva ca |
narakottāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasmād ātmahitecchayā ||
iti dakṣiṇāmūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha paraśudānam | vāyupurāṇāt |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
samīraṇa namas tubhyaṃ yat proktaṃ bhavatā vratāt |
prāyaścittam aśeṣeṇa tad asmābhir dṛḍhīkrtam ||
vaktuam arhasi bhūyo naḥ prasāda sumukha prabho |
yat tu mānasikaṃ pāpaṃ buddhipūrvaṃ surottama ||
vaktum arhasi dānena tasya pāpakṣayo bhavet ||
vāyur uvāca |
manaso durvicāratvād bahutvāc ca tapodhanāḥ |
avaśyam eva bhavati mahatām api niścayaḥ ||
vinā dānena bhūyo ‘pi narakāya pravartate |
tasmāt tasya kṣayopāyaṃ dānaṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam ||
upapātakasaṃyuktaṃ yena pāpaṃ vinaśyati |
aṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya pūrvāhṇe śālitaṇḍulaiḥ ||
bhāratrayeṇa kurvīta rūpaṃ vastreṇa śūlinaḥ |
caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ ca sukhāsīnaṃ saroruhe ||
tasya dakṣiṇahaste tu suvarṇaṃ palanirmitam |
paraśuṃ kalpayitvā ca tataḥ saṃprati pūjayet ||
sarvaṃ paraśuhastāya mantreṇārādhanaṃ bhavet |
bilvapatraiḥ kuśaiś cāpi pūjayet parameśvaram ||
paraśuṃ ca pṛthak puṣpai raktair abhyarcya śāntadhīḥ |
[753]        pṛthaktvaṃ śivabhaktaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
arcayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ tato mantram udīrayet ||
nīlalohita deveśa sarvapāpabhayāpaha |
paraśuvyagrahastas tvaṃ tavāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
yan mayā manasā pāpaṃ kṛtam ājanmanaḥ prabho |
tat sarvaṃ kṣapayāśeṣa vibho paraśudānataḥ ||
anena sarvapāpāni mānasāni vināśaya |
mayi dīne dayāṃ deva darśayādya prasādataḥ ||
ity uktvā taṃ dvijendrāya paraśuṃ taṇḍulādikam |
trivedavedakalaśaṃ bhūmidevaṃ dvijottamam ||
ity uktaṃ paraśor dānaṃ mānasāghavināśanam |
yad yat karoti manasā pāpam ājanmanaḥ purā ||
niṣkṛtis tasya pāpasya dānam etat prayatnataḥ |
māsi māsi tato dayaṃ dānam etat tapodhanāḥ |
vatsare vatsare vāpi sarvadoṣāpanuttaye ||
iti paraśudānavidhiḥ |
atha śūladānam | vāyupurāṇāt |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
samīraṇa jagatprāṇa pavamānakriyāvibho |
vaktum arhasi no dānaṃ yena pāpaṃ vyapohati ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā yad abuddhikṛtaṃ bhavet |
[754]        pāpaṃ tasya kṣayopāyaṃ vaktum arhasi naḥ prabho ||
yasmād bhogād ṛte nāsti kṣayaḥ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ |
karadaṇḍena vācātha prāyaścittena vā punaḥ ||
rājadaṇḍaḥ prakāśasya pāpasya kathitaḥ purā |
abuddhipūrvaṃ yat pāpam ajñānāc ca mahīpate ||
niṣkṛtir na kṛtā yasya tasya vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ |
tasmāt tasya kṣyopāyo vaktavyaś caratāmbara ||
vāyur uvāca |
ahaṃ vaḥ kathaviṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ |
yā niṣkṛtis tu pāpānāṃ kṛtānāṃ prajñayā vinā ||
yat pāśupatam ākhyātam astraṃ devasya śūlinaḥ |
tasya pradānāt sakalaṃ tat pāpaṃ saṃpraṇaśyati ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyām aṣṭamyāṃ vā sitetare |
kuryād dvādaśaniṣkena triśūlaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ||
yugāntakaraṇaṃ ghoram aghavighnaṃ sanakṣamam |
nānārajoviracite cakre ṣaḍārabhūṣite |
nābhau nidhāya saṃpūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ tāmranirmitam ||
pātram āḍhakasamānaṃ tatra śūlaṃ nyaset punaḥ |
kuryāt tenaiva mantreṇa tasya pūjām anukramāt ||
nirūpākṣaṃ ca tatpārśve kamalopati pūjayet |
aghorebhyo ‘pi mantreṇa pūjānte praṇipatya ca ||
aghoramantras tu liṅgapurāṇe |
[755]        oṃ aghorebhyo ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaś ca sarvataḥ sarvebhyo
namas te ‘stu rudrarūpebhyaḥ | iti |
vipraṃ ca jñātinaṃ tadvatsaṃ pūjya munipuṅgavāḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tato gatvā imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
bhagavan bhaganetraghna dakṣayajñavimardana |
tavāyudhapradānān me pāpaṃ naśyatu śaṅkara ||
yugānte yena lokānāṃ tvam antakavināśanam |
vidagdhaṃ taṃ mayāpy etat tena pāpaṃ praṇāśaya ||
yena dagdhaṃ kṣaṇārdhena tripuraṃ suradurjayam |
tena pāśupatenāśu mama pāpaṃ praṇāśaya ||
yad abuddhikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mama cājñasya mānasam |
tat sarvaṃ kṣayam abhyetu tava śūlapradānataḥ ||
ity āmantrya tato dadyāc chūlaṃ tasmai dvijātaye |
yad ātmanaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpam ajñānād yat purā bhavet ||
niṣkṛtis tasya sarvasya śūladānam idaṃ matam |
avaśyaṃ kurute pāpam ajñānān mānavo yataḥ |
varṣe varṣe tato dadyāt tasya tasyāpanuttaye ||
iti śūladānavidhiḥ |
āha baudhāyanaḥ |
ataḥ paraṃ vipākotthaṃ sarvaṃ śūlavināśanam |
dānaṃ yad brahmaṇā proktaṃ tat samyak kathayāmy aham ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi śūlaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
[756]        yathāvittānusāreṇa palārdhenātha vā punaḥ ||
tāmreṇāthāyasā vāpi khadireṇātha vā punaḥ |
mahādevapraharaṇaṃ yathā tadvat prakalpayet ||
raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya raktacandanacarcitam |
raktamālyena saṃveṣṭya tilānām upari nyaset ||
tilānāṃ tu parīmāṇaṃ droṇaṃ vātha tadardhakam |
tadardhaṃ vā yathāśaktyā pūjayed brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ ||
arghyādi mūlamantreṇa ṣoḍaśaivopacārakān |
kriyāvidbrāhmaṇaṃ pūjya kartā homaṃ prakalpayet ||
śūlasya dakṣiṇe pārśve dakṣināgniḥ praṇīyate |
samidājyatilān hutvā puruṣasyeti vai samit ||
tryambakena ca mantreṇa ājyahomaṃ prakalpayet |
yat indreṇa ca tilān śaṃ naḥ śāntiṃ prakalpayet ||
tenodakena vā siñcec chūlinaṃ rogiṇaṃ naraḥ |
tato hutavate śūlaṃ saṃpūjya ca svaśaktitaḥ ||
dadyāt sadakṣinaṃ taṃ tu prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
mantreṇānena parayā bhaktyā sarvaṃ paraṃ smaran ||
tvaṃ śūlaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ tvaṃ purāṇaṃ vināśakam |
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca śaṅkarasyāyudhaṃ sadā ||
kukṣistham atha pārśvastham atha vā pṛṣṭhasaṃgatam |
śūlaṃ vināśaya tvaṃ me mahādevena dhāritam ||
[757]        tataḥ snātvā ca bhuñjīta brāhmaṇair bandhubhiḥ saha |
śūlahiṃsāsamutpannāṃ vedanām āśu nāśayet ||
ity aparaśūladānavidhiḥ |
atha sūryamūrtidānam | āha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
bibhrāmayati yo mūḍhān auṣadhādiprayogataḥ |
bhrāmaṇaṃ jāyate tasya dehino ‘tīva duḥsaham ||
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ dānahomādikarmaṇā |
vyāvahārikaniṣkais tu tribhir dvābhyām athāpi vā ||
ekena vā svaśaktyā ca sūryapratikṛtiṃ śubhām |
kuryād vihastām ūrdhvaṃ tu padmadvayasubhūṣitām ||
rathopari sthitāṃ raktavāsasā samalaṃkrtām |
kuṅkumenāṅkitāṃ samyag ratnamālyair alaṃkṛtām ||
snāpitāṃ pañcagavyena tāmrapātropari nyaset |
pātrasya ca parīmāṇaṃ tilānām aṣṭakaṃ viduḥ ||
tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā yathā vibhavato bhavet |
pātraṃ tilānām upari vinyased darbhasaṃstṛte ||
evaṃ bhūtāṃ tu tāṃ mūrtim ācāryaḥ pūjayet sudhīḥ |
gandhamālyaiḥ surabhibhir haṃsaḥ śuciḥṣaḍ ity ṛcā ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ kṣipet |
āgneyyāṃ diśi homaś ca kartavyaḥ śubham īpsubhiḥ ||
[758]        samidājyatilaiś caiva mantrair ebhir yathākramam |
citraṃ devānāṃ tac cakṣur udatyaṃ jātavedasam ||
yad asya karmaṇaś ceti sviṣṭakṛddhoma iṣyate |
agner uttarato bhāge kalaśasthāpnaṃ bhavet ||
abhiṣekādikaṃ sarvaṃ śāntikarmapuraḥsaram |
sukhāsanopaviṣṭasya kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
praṇītāmokṣaparyantaṃ brahmodvāsanam eva ca |
tataḥ snātaḥ śucir hṛṣṭaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ ||
śuklamālyaiḥ śobhitaś ca ācāryāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
prāṅmukhāyopaviṣṭāya dadyāt pratikṛtiṃ śubhām ||
sahasrakiraṇo devaḥ khagaḥ pūṣā gabhastimān |
sarvadevamayo brahma jagaccakṣustrayītanuḥ ||
auṣadhādiprayogeṇa purā yad bhrāmaṇaṃ kṛtam |
viprāṇāṃ pādam abhyarcya yad bhūtaṃ bhramaṇaṃ mama ||
pratimāyāḥ pradānena tuṣṭo devao bṛhaspatiḥ |
bhramaṇaṃ dehagaṃ sarvaṃ vāsudevo vyapohatu ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu taddānam ācāryāyātibhaktitaḥ |
āsīmāntād anuvrajya praṇipatya kṣaṃāpayet ||
anyebhyo ‘pi brāhmaṇebhyo dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
evaṃ dānaṃ purā proktaṃ datvā martyo ‘tibhaktitaḥ |
pūrvakarmavipākotthaṃ bhramaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ||
[759]
iti sūryamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
tathā |
brāhmaṇaṃ ghātayed yas tu kuṣṭī jāyate naraḥ |
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ sūryadānaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
palena vā tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
sūryapratikṛtiṃ kuryāt kadalīṃ caiva saṃnidhau ||
kuṣṭhopahatadehānāṃ śāntyarthaṃ kārayec chubhām |
suvarṇena palārdhena patrapuṣpair alaṃkṛtām ||
sūryas tu dvibhujaḥ kāryo rājate ca rathe sthitaḥ |
raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya kuṅkumenānulepayet ||
rambhāṃ tu śvetavastreṇa śvetapuṣpaiś ca candanaiḥ |
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāpya nānāphalasamanvitām ||
taṇḍulānāṃ parīmāṇaṃ droṇamātraṃ prakīrtitam |
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śāntamānasam ||
sarvavidyāsu kuśalaṃ daridraṃ cāgnihotriṇam |
gṛham āhūya bhaktyā tām pūjayed vastramālyakaiḥ ||
tato homaṃ prakurvīta samidājyatilākṣataiḥ |
lājāś ca madhunā miśrā hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||
mantreṇa caiva gāyatryā durgāgrahādhidevatāḥ |
juhuyāc ca tato bhaktyā samidājyacarūn api ||
tathaiva hy ājyasaṃpate rakṣitā ity anena tu |
samañjanaṃ prakurvīta yathā liṅgaṃ śarīrake ||
[760]        śannodevyanuvākena śāntiṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥ |
tasmai hutavate rogī dadyād bhaktipuraḥsaram ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ |
āditya sūrya dyumaṇe sarvarogavināśaka ||
sahasrakiraṇāmbhojabandho timiranāśana |
dvādaśātmṃs trayīdeha jagaccakṣur dvākara ||
pūrvakarmavipākotthaṃ kuṣṭham āśu vināśaya ||
iti sūryapratikṛtidānamantraḥ |
kadalī sarvadevānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ sarvaśarmade |
lakṣmyā śacyā ca parvatyā devakanyābhir eva ca ||
sāvitryā rambayā caiva kāryārthaṃ pūjitā purā |
aṅgapratyaṅgajaṃ sarvaṃ kuṣṭhajātam apānuda ||
kadalīdānamantraḥ |
tataḥ snātvā ca bhuñjīta brāhmaṇair bandhubhiḥ saha ||
ity aparasūryamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha vahnimūrtidānam | tatra baudhāyanaḥ |
suvarṇenātha tāmreṇa kuryāt pratikṛtiṃ budhaḥ |
vahner vibhavasāreṇa palenārdhena vā punaḥ ||
[761] vahnilakṣaṇaṃ tu lokapālaprasaṅgena brāhmāṇdadāne darśitam |
tathā jvālākulāṃ raktacandanena vilepitaḥ |
raktavastreṇa saṃvītāṃ meṣasyopari saṃsthitām ||
taktamālyais tu saṃchannāṃ muktādāmapariṣkṛtām |
kanakācalavarṇābhāṃ dvādaśārkanibhāṃ śūbhām ||
brahmacaryānvite vipre karmaniṣṭhe ‘gnihotriṇi |
aṅgulīyakavastrādyair bhūṣite tāṃ nivedayet ||
mantreṇānena vidhivad agniprītyarham ādṛtaḥ |
tretārūpo ‘gnir īḍyas tvam antaś carasi vai nṛṇāṃ ||
tvaṃ vettha prāktanaṃ pāpam atīsāraṃ vināśaya |
evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyag atīsāraṃ vyapohati |
nīrujaḥ susukho nityaṃ dīrgham āyuś ca vindati ||
ity agnimūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha kālapuruṣadānam | bhaviṣyottare |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
dānāny anyāni me kṛṣṇa kathayasva yad uttamam |
maṅgalyāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ||
saṃsārasāgarottārahetubhūtāni mādhava |
dharmādharma parijñāne tvadanyo neha kaścana ||
[762]                śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathitāni mayā tava |
punar eva pravakṣyāmi yady asti tava kautukam ||
kathitāni mayā tubhyaṃ kathayiṣyāmy ahaṃ tava |
mahatārthena siddhyanti prayacchanti mahat phalam ||
kāmyo dānavidhiḥ pārtha kriyamāṇo yathātatham |
phalāya munibhiḥ prokto viparīto bhayāya ca ||
jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ pārtha dāneṣu vidhir uttamaḥ |
madhyamas tu tadarthena tadardhenādhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meṣyāṃ ca kālapuruṣe tathānyeṣu mahatsu ca |
evaṃ vṛkṣe rathe ‘ṇḍe ca dhenoḥ kṛṣṇājinasya ca ||
aśaktasyāpi kṛṣṇo ‘yaṃ pañcasauvarṇiko vidhiḥ |
ato ‘py alpena yo dadyāt mahādānaṃ narādhipa ||
pratigṛhṇāti vā tasya duḥkhaśokāvahaṃ bhavet |
puṇyaṃ dinam athāsādya bhūmibhāge same śubhe |
caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ vā viṣṭyāṃ vā pāṇḍunandana |
viṣṭir bhadrākaraṇam |
pumān kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadantaḥ suvarṇadṛk
suvarṇādiparīmāṇam atra yathāśakti saṃpādanīyam |
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrgho javākusumakuṇḍalaḥ |
[763]        raktāmbaradharaḥ sragvī śaṅkhamālāvibhūṣitaḥ |
tīkṣṇāsiputrībandhena visṛgdārikatītaṭaḥ ||
astiputrī chūrikā |
upānadyugayuktāṅghriḥ kṛṣṇakambalapārśvagaḥ |
gṛhītamāṃsapiṇḍaś ca vāme karatale tathā ||
evaṃvidhaṃ pumān kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
yajamānaḥ prasannātmā imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
saṃpūjya gandhakusumair naivedyaṃ vinivedya ca |
sarvaṃ kalayase yasmāt kālas tv antena cocyase ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tvam asādhyo ‘si suvrata |
pūjitas tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā pārthivaś ca tathāsukham ||
tad budhyate tava vibho tat kuruṣva namo namaḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā taṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
brāḥmaṇaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā |
dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadyāt praṇipatya visarjayet ||
dakṣiṇāṃ pūrvoktāṃ niṣkādikām |
anena vidhinā yas tu dānam etat prayacchati |
na ca mṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhavet ||
bhavaty avyāhataiśvaryaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ |
dehānte sūryabhavanaṃ bhittvā yāti paraṃ padam ||
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
[764]        sattrayājī śriyā yuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ||
saṃpūjya kālapuruṣaṃ vidhivad dvijāya
datvā śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtam |
rogāture sakaladoṣamaye ‘tra dehe
dehī na moham upagacchati tat prabhāvāt ||
iti kālapuruṣadānavidhiḥ |
atha kālacakradānam | mṛtyuñjayāt |
cakraṃ raupyamayaṃ kṛtvā muktāraśmimayātmakam |
kṛtvā mūrdhni śaraccandraṃ raśmimadhyāntarasthitam ||
tvaṅmāṃsāni tu raupyāṇi gātreṣu ca samantataḥ |
evaṃ dhyānavatas tasya sacandraḥ kṛṣṇatāṃ vrajet ||
tato ‘py anantaraṃ paścāt sthitvā viprapradakṣiṇam |
taṃ gṛhītvā vrajed dūram adṛṣṭatvam api vrajet ||
svayaṃ cāmṛtasaṃghātapūrṇakāyasthitisthitaḥ |
kālacakram idaṃ nāmnā dānaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam ||
imaṃ te rājataṃ cāndraṃ raśmijālasamākulam |
apamṛtyuvināśāya dadāmīti samuccaran ||
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ vāte vinaśyeta apamṛtyur na saṃśayaḥ ||
tatas tasmāt sadā deyam apamṛtyubhayānvitaiḥ |
jvarādirogagrastair vā mahāpatpatitair api ||
[765]        tato gṛhyoktavidhinā sthāpayej jātavedasam |
juhuyāt kālanāmnā tu śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tilaiḥ ||
tatas tu bhojayed bhaktyā viprān dvādaśasaṃkhyayā |
svayam akṣāralavaṇaṃ bhuñjīta sakṛd eva hi |
evaṃ kṛte naro nūnaṃ ciraṃ jīven na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti kālacakradānavidhiḥ |
atha yamadānam | mṛtyuñjayāt |
lohapātrasthitaṃ kāṃsyaṃ tatra padmaṃ tu rājatam |
tasmin kāleśvaraḥ svarṇaiḥ puruṣākāratāṅgataḥ ||
yamarūpam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
vastrālaṃkārasaṃyukto bhayadāstrāṇi sarvataḥ
trilohākārapuruṣaiḥ kāladūtaiś ca pārśvataḥ |
bhayadāstrāṇi khaḍgacchurikādīni | trilohaṃ tāmrakāṃsyapittalākhyam | kāladūtāḥ puruṣākṛtayo daṇḍahastās trayaḥ |
kṛtvā ca mahiṣaṃ pṛṣṭhe taṃ dadyād yamam ālapan |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ karoti vidhinā tu yaḥ |
sa mucyate dhruvaṃ nāśād datvā ghṛtaghaṭottaram |
yamam ālapann iti mahiṣapṛṣṭhasthita lohapātrī paristhitaḥ kāṃsya[766]pātraniviṣta-padmārūḍhaṃ yamaṃ dadāmīty uccārayan ity arthaḥ | ghṛtaghaṭasya uttare dakṣiṇāsthāne yasyeti dānavivekakāraḥ apare tu suvarṇadakṣiṇeti |
iti yamadānavidhiḥ |
athodakumbhadānam | śaunakīyāt |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
bhagavan kena dānena tapasā kena karmaṇā |
aprāpya narakaṃ ghoraṃ svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
narakeṣu vipacyante jantavaḥ satataṃ mune |
alpāyāsena devarṣe parihāro ‘sti ced vada ||
sūta uvāca |
evam ukto ‘tha bhagavān mārkaṇḍeyen dhīmatā |
uvāca nārado dānam alpavittaṃ mahāphalam ||
mārkaṇḍeya śṛṇuṣvedaṃ brahmaviṣṇvoḥ purānagha |
tad āha bhagavāñ chambhur dvayoḥ pṛṣṭas tayos tathā ||
śrūyatām udakumbhākhyaṃ dānaṃ vakṣyāmi suvratī |
yat kṛtvā puruṣaḥ strī vā na yāti narakaṃ kvacit ||
svargyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam ārogyaṃ pāpanāśanam |
mama prītikaraṃ puṇyaṃ yuvayoś ca priyaṃ tathā ||
[767]        vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃca kārtikyām atha taddine |
svajanmadivase kāryaṃ duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ||
bhūmau gomayaliptāyām udakumbhaṃ nyased budhaḥ |
puṣpaiḥ phalaiś ca saṃveṣṭya vastreṇa sitarūpiṇam |
vidhānena tilair miśraṃ guṇḍaṃ tatraiva nikṣepet ||
dharmarājaṃ nyased devaṃ sauvarṇaṃ śaktitaḥ kṛtam |
sumukhaṃ dvibhujaṃ devam āsīnaṃ daṇḍahastakam ||
varadaṃ kṛpayā yuktaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāriṇam |
evaṃ saptaghaṭān kṛtvā gandhādibhir athārcayet ||
viprebhyo dāpayet kumbhān ebhir mantrair yathākramam |
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca ||
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca |
evam ārādhya tān kumbhān dadyād udakapūvakam ||
prīyatāṃ bhagavān eva mantrāte (?) samudāharet |
evaṃ kumbhapradānena deva devaḥ sa tuṣyati ||
kartā kārayitā svargaṃ prāpnotīti na saṃśayaḥ |
na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ na prāpnoty aśubhaṃ kvacit ||
yamasvarūpī bhagavān prīto bhavati tasya vai |
yaḥ kumbhadānaṃ viprebhyo dadāti ca yathāvidhi ||
ity udakumbhadānavidhiḥ |
atha makaradānam | tatra baudhāyanaḥ |
[768]        kuryāt tu makaraṃ samyag rājataṃ tāmram eva ca |
palatrayeṇa dvābhyāṃ vā yad vaikena śubhākrtim ||
pucche ratnāni deyāni kaṭiṃ rūpyeṇa kārayet |
netre svarṇamaye kārye jihvā kāryā prakalpayet ||
pādayoḥ prakṣipet tatra ghṛtapātre puro dvayoḥ |
kṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya candanāgurucarcitam ||
tāmre ‘tha jalapātre ‘tha sthāpayen makaraṃ śubham |
brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasaṃpannaṃ vṛddhaṃ dāntam alolupam ||
vastraiḥ kaṭakakeyūraiḥ pūjayed aṅgulīyakaiḥ |
homo bāruṇadaivatyair mantrādhyāyoktamārgataḥ ||
tatas tv audarike vipre makaraṃ taṃ nivedayet |
jalādhideva deveśa paścimāśāpate vibho |
udaravyādhināśaṃ me kuru dānena toṣitaḥ ||
iti makaradānavidhiḥ |
atha dhanadamūrtidānam | vāyupurāṇe |
daridro jāyate martyo dānavighnaṃ karoti yaḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ jāyate yena karmaṇā tac chṛṇuṣva me ||
palārdhena tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
dhanadasya pratikṛtiṃ kuryāt svarṇamayīṃ śubhām ||
dvibhujāṃ vāhanopetāṃ nayanānandakāriṇī |
[769] dhanadalakṣaṇaṃ dhānyaparvatadāne draṣṭavyam |
śaṅkhapadmanidhibhyāṃ ca yuktāṃ tāṃ pārśvayor dvayoḥ |
śvetavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya taṇḍulopari vinyaset ||
taṇḍulānāṃ parīmāṇaṃ bhaved droṇacatuṣṭayam |
tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ||
śvetamālyais tathā gandhair anulipya prapūjayet |
āgneyyāṃ diśi homaś ca samidājyatilair bhavet ||
mantro rājādhirājāyety eṣa yojyaḥ saliṅgakaiḥ |
vyāhṛtyā tilahomaś ca kartavyo dhanakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajño vinītaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ |
mahākulaprabhūtaś ca dharmajñaḥ satyavāk śuciḥ ||
kārayed arcanaṃ tena dhanadasyātibhaktitaḥ |
tad daivatyena mantreṇa sa ca kāmīśvaro bhavet ||
tasmai homaṃ kṛtavate pradadyāt pratimāṃ tu tām |
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ ||
uttarāśāpate deva kubera naravāhana |
padmaśaṅkhanidhīnāṃ tvaṃ patiḥ śrīkaṇṭhavallabhaḥ ||
dānādyena yathā prāptaṃ dāridryaṃ mama duḥkhadam |
tat sarvam ātmadānena pāpam āśu vināśaya ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ kuberadānaṃ yaḥ karoti vidhipūrvakam |
dhanadena samo martyas tat kṣanād eva jāyate ||
[770]
iti dhanadamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha nāgadānam | tatra vṛddhabaudhāyanaḥ |
sarpais tu yaḥ khādayati sa visarpī bhaven naraḥ |
dānenopaśamaḥ kāryo homena ca viśeṣataḥ ||
palena vā tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
kuryān nāgaṃ suvarṇena phaṇāpañcakasaṃyutam ||
māṇikyāni ca deyāni pratyekaṃ phaṇapañcake |
ratnaṃ pucche tathā deyaṃ vajre locanayos tathā ||
evaṃ kṛtvā śubhaṃ nāgaṃ kuṅkumena tu lepayet |
raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya tāmrapātropari nyaset ||
pātrasya ca parīmāṇaṃ palānām aṣṭakaṃ viduḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir arcayen nāgam uttamam ||
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajño dharmaśāstraparāyaṇaḥ |
homaṃ cāpi prakurvīta samidājyatilaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
namo ‘stu sarpebhya iti tribhir mantrair yathākramam |
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu aṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vā ||
aṣṭāviṃśatir evātha parimāṇaṃ pṛthag bhavet |
hutvā cāhutisaṃpātaiḥ pātre caikīkṛte svayam ||
śrāvayogāni cābhyajya rogiṇaṃ tu visarpiṇam |
ṛgbhis tu sarvarājñībhir bhūmir bhūmrādibhiḥ kramāt ||
svastho yathāsau bhavati gātrāṇām apy arogataḥ |
[771]        guggulaṃ ca sugandhiṃ ca patridāru ca nikṣipet ||
prakalpya kalaśaṃ kuryād abhiṣekaṃ jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
oṃ namaḥ sarpebhya iti cārdhais talliṅgakair api ||
hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pavamāno ‘nuvākataḥ |
āpohiṣṭāmaya iti śannovāta itīrayet ||
utsāditāṅgaruciraṃ limped agurucandanaiḥ |
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
tataḥ samarcayed yatnād gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
saradaivatyamantreṇa ācāryo ‘pi samarcayet ||
anantaṃ sarparājaṃ tam ācāryāya nivedayet |
yo dhatte pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saśailavanakānanām ||
kṣīrābdau yasya śayyā ca vāsudevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ |
svīyadānena nāgo ‘sau tuṣṭo vyādhim apohatu ||
vaisarpikavikāraṃ me vāgdoṣajanitaṃ tathā |
raktadoṣodbhavaṃ vāpi mātṛtaḥ pitṛto ‘pi vā |
aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃbhūtaṃ vikāraṃ me vyapohatu ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu taṃ nāgam ācāryāya sadakṣiṇam |
bhūmau (?) praṇamya śirasā śanaiḥ śatapadaṃ vrajet ||
ācāryeṇa hy anujñātaḥ svagṛhaṃ praviśet sudhīḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ ||
[772]
iti nāgadānavidhiḥ |
athātmapratikṛtidānam | bhaviṣyottarāt |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ātmapratikṛtir nāma yan noktaṃ kasyacit purā |
tat te ‘haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānaṃ mānavivardhanam ||
dānakālaḥ sadā tasya munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
puṇyaiḥ puṇyadinaṃ pārtha prāpyate jīvitecale ||
haimīṃ pratikṛtiṃ bhavyāṃ kārayitvā tato nṛpa |
abhīṣṭavāhanagatām iṣṭālaṃkārasaṃyutām ||
abhīṣṭalokasahitāṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām |
abhīṣṭalokasahitām iti, priyajanasahitām ity arthaḥ |
tatra paṭṭapaṭīvastraiś chāditāṃ sragvibhūṣitām |
kuṅkumenānuliptāṅgīṃ karpūrāguruvāsitām ||
strī ced dadāti śayane śayitāṃ kārayet svayam |
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ pārśvato nyaset ||
upakārakaraṃ strīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca yad bhavet |
tat sarvaṃ sthāpayet pārśve svayaṃ saṃcintya cetasi ||
etat sarvaṃ melayitvā sve sve sthāne niyojayet |
pūjayitvā lokapālān grahān devīṃ vināyakam ||
[773] devīśabdenātra durgocyate, vināyakasāhacaryāt |
tataḥ śuklāmbaraḥ snātvā gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
imam uccārayen mantraṃ viprasya purataḥ sthitaḥ ||
ātmanaḥ pratimā ceyaṃ sarvopakaraṇair yutā |
sarvaratnasamāyuktā tava priya niveditā ||
ātmā śambhuḥ śivaḥ śauriḥ śakraḥ śivagaṇair yutaḥ |
tasmād ātmapradānena mama cātmā prasīdatu ||
ity uccārya tato dadyād brāhmaṇāya yudhiṣṭhira |
brāhmaṇaś cātha gṛhṇāti kodād iti ca kīrthayan ||
kodād iti vājasaneyaprasiddhamantragrahaṇam |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya praṇipatya visarjayet |
vidhinānena rājendra dānam etat prayacchati ||
yaḥ pumān atha vā nārī śṛṇuyāt phalam āpnuyāt |
sārdhaṃ varṣaśataṃ dviyaṃ sarvalokaiḥ surair vṛtaḥ ||
abhīṣṭaphaladānena cābhīṣṭaphalabhāg bhavet |
yatraivotpadyate jantuḥ prāptakarmakṣayakṣaṇam ||
tatraiva sarvakāmānāṃ phalabhāk sa bhaven nṛpa |
iṣṭabandhujanaiḥ sārdhaṃ na viyogaṃ kadācana ||
prāpnoti puruṣo rājan svargaṃ cānantam aśṇute ||
yaś cātmanaḥ pratikṛtiṃ varavāhanasthāṃ
haimīṃ vidhāya dhanadānyasamākulāṃ ca |
sopaskarāṃ dvijavarāya dadāti bhaktyā
candrārkavad divi vibhāti sa rājarājaḥ ||
[774]
ity ātmapratikṛtidānavidhiḥ |
athāśvinor dānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
athāpṛcchan munayaḥ sutasūnuṃ
tadāraṇye nainiṣe satriṇas te |
ugraśravaḥ paripṛcchāmahe tvāṃ
kathaṃ vidvān śamayed rogapīḍām ||
evaṃ pṛṣṭo munibhiḥ sūtasūnum
uvācedaṃ dānam āhātmyam atra |
śṛṇudhvaṃ vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi dānaṃ
yat kṛtvāsau mucyate rogapūgaiḥ ||
abhīṣṭasiddhir bhavatīha kartur
āyuṣyam ārogyam upaiti cāgryaṃ |
ugrāṇi sarvāṇi śamaṃ prayāṇti
śriyaṃ tathā prāpnuyād yena dātā ||
svarbhānunā grasite candrasūrye
rāśyantare saṃkrame vātha bhānoḥ |
graste rogais trividhe cādbhute vā
mano nityaṃ ramate yatra bhūmau ||
tasmin kuryād āśvinaṃ nāma dānaṃ
[775]                śucau deśe gomayenopalipte |
vedīdvaye hastamātre samantāt
kṛtvā tilais taṇḍulair āḍhakākhyaiḥ ||
tatra devāv aśvinau jātarūpau
pratyaṅmukho ‘bhyarcayitvā jātarūpau |
jātarūpau suvarṇamayau aśvinau | tallakṣaṇam uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
dvibhujau devabhiṣajau kartavyau cārulocanau |
tayor oṣadhayaḥ kāryā divyā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ||
vāmayoḥ pustakau kāryau darśanīyau tathā dvija |
ekasya dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme cānyasya yādava ||
nārīyugaṃ prakartavyaṃ surūpaṃ cārudarśanam |
tayoś ca nāmanī prokte rūpasaṃpat tathākṛtim ||
ratnabhāṇḍaṃ kare kārye candraśuklāmbare tathā || iti |
gandhair vastraiḥ puṣpadhūpapradīpaiḥ
pradakṣiṇaṃ devamukhyau ca kṛtvā |
puṣpāñjaliṃ tau pradade praṇamya
abhyarcya vipradvayam ādareṇa ||
pratyekam ekaṃ tu hiraṇyarūpaṃ
dadyāt tu tasyādakapūrvam atra |
samīrayen mantram atha krameṇa
[776]                dātā samādhāya manaḥ prāsannam ||
nāsatyadamrau yugavor hiraṇya-
rūpapradānān mama śāntir astu |
yathā yuvāṃ devabhiṣag bhavetāṃ
tathā ca me rogaśamāya devau ||
ity aśvidānavidhiḥ |
atha candrasūryadānam | viṣṇudharmottarāt |
bhagavān ucāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānaṃ rājan narādhipa |
yad datvā tu balī rājā śakrarājyam avāpa ha ||
śakraś ca balino rājyaṃ datvā punar avāpa ca |
candrasūryoparāge ca viṣuve ayane yathā ||
dvādaśyāṃ candrakṣaye ca vaiśākhyāṃ putrajanmani |
kārttikyāṃ ca mahāmādhyāṃ saptamyāṃ jayāyāṃ tathā ||
dandrādityau ca dātavyau sūryaḥ sauvarṇa ucyate |
śuddhasya rajatasyaiva maṇḍalaṃ himarociṣaḥ ||
dvādaśyāṅgulavṛttaṃ tu ubhayor api maṇḍalam |
vṛttau padmasamākārau madhye caiva tu karṇikām ||
bhānuṃ tāmramaye pātre ghṛtapūrṇe tu nikṣipet |
somaṃ gaṅge kṣīrapūrṇe upari sthāpayed budhaḥ ||
[777]        sūryaṃ tu raktakusumaiḥ somaṃ śuklair tathaiva ca |
ādityāya tu dhūpaṃ vai sugandhiṃ caiva dāpayet ||
somasya guggulo deyo gandhaḥ śuklas tathaiv aca |
kuṅkumaṃ tu pataṅgāya dīpaṃ caiva ghṛtena tu ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya yatnena candrādityau pṛthak kṛtau |
amṛtamūrtaye somaṃ mano’ntenaiva pūjayet ||
khakholkāyeti vai sūryaṃ namo’ntena punaḥ punaḥ |
āhūya brahmaṇaṃ bhaktyā vedavedāṅgapāragam ||
kuṭumbinaṃ daridraṃ ca āhitāgniṃ tathaiva ca |
saṃpūjya puṣpadhūpaiś ca dvijaṃ sūryam ivāparam ||
ravibimbaṃ candrabimbaṃ ghṛtasthaṃ tu nirīkṣya vai |
samarpayed brāhmaṇāya mantreṇānena bhūmipa ||
rukmaṃ ca puruṣaṃ caiva parṇaṃ puṣkaram eva ca |
trayo tu vidyā sāṅgā tu yasyāṅgaṃ viśvarūpiṇaḥ ||
sa vai caṇḍakaro devaḥ prīyatāṃ vipra mā ciram |
evam uccārya bhānuṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
kṣīrajaṃ devadevaṃ ca dvijarājaṃ tathaiva tu |
amṛtamūrtiṃ śītāṃśuṃ dadāmi ca dvijottama ||
gāyatryā caiva sūryasya grahaṇaṃ jāyate vibho |
somaṃ taratsamandīyaṃ japan śuddhena cetasā ||
evaṃ candraṃ raviṃ datvā balī rājyam avāpa ha |
sarvaṃ tena tu dattaṃ syād yo dadyāc candrabhāskarau ||
[778]        sarvaṃ tena kṛtaṃ rājan sarvaṃ tena ca saṃśrutam |
sarvaṃ dakṣiṇayā yaṣṭaṃ saṃsāre tu narottama ||
pūjyate siddhagandharvair ṛṣibhir devadānavaiḥ ||
iti candrādityadānavidhiḥ |
atha dhvajapāśadānam | āha baudhāyanaḥ |
dhvajaṃ pāśaṃ palaikena kuryāt tu rajatena vai |
palārdhenātha vā śuddhasphaṭikopamam ādṛtaḥ ||
ratnair marakataiḥ samyak baddham aṅgeṣu sarvataḥ |
kumbhaṃ ca sthāpayet tatra tilānāṃ droṇapañcakam ||
kumbhasyopari saṃsthāpyo dhvajapāśaś ca śobhanaḥ |
sahiraṇyaṃ dvayaṃ tat tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
vastreṇāveṣṭayet kumbhaṃgandhamālyākṣatārcitam |
śrutavṛttaiḥ samṛddhāya śrotriyāya kuṭumbine ||
varuṇasya tathā vāyoḥ prītyarthaṃ vinivedayet |
namaḥ pāśabhṛte tubhyaṃ namo dhvajadharāya te ||
jalādhipataye tubhyaṃ vāyoḥ sarvajanapriyaḥ |
yuvayoḥ prītaye dattau dhvajapāśau surājatau ||
śvāsakāsau haretāṃ me prītau sarvajanāśrayau |
evaṃ kṛtvā śvāsakāsau nīrogas tatkṣaṇāt bhavet ||
[779]
iti dhvajapāśadānavidhiḥ |
atha brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaradānam | liṅgapurāṇe |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvadānottamottamam |
pūrvavad deśakāle ca maṇḍape vā vidhānataḥ ||
prapāyāṃ kūṭamadhye vā sthaṇḍile śivasaṃnidhau |
pūrvaṃ viṣṇuṃ samārādhya padmayoniṃ tataḥ param ||
mantrābhyāṃ vidhinā tābhyāṃ praṇavādinamo’ntakam |
atra pūrvavac chabdena liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavihitaṃ kuṇḍamaṇḍapādi sarvam pasaṃgṛhyate tatraitasya tatprakaraṇe paṭhitatvā | praprāṃkūṭau (?) maṇḍapaviśeṣau | uktamaṇḍapaviśeṣe sthaṇḍilaṃ vidhāya śivasaṃnidhau brahmaviṣṇū pūjayed ity ārthaḥ | śivasaṃnidhāv ity anenaiva śivapratimākaraṇam api gamyate | tathā coktaṃ kāmike |
maṇḍalāṇtaḥ śivaṃ haimaṃ pārśvayor brahmakeśavau |
tān uddiśya pradātavyaṃ śrotriyebhyo dhanaṃ bahu ||
uttamaṃ trisahasraṃ tu madhyamaṃ dvisahasrakam |
sahasraṃ kanyasaṃ proktaṃ samāsāt procyate mayā |
pūrvavac chivapūjā ca ṛtvigācāryadakṣiṇā ||
[780] mantrābhyām iti vakṣyamāṇābhyām ubhābhyāṃ viṣṇubrahmāṇau pūjayet praṇavādinamo’ntakam iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam |
nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi tan no viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt |
bṛhadbṛṃhaṇabhedāya brahmaṇe dhanadāya te |
śivāya haraye svāhā svadhā vauṣaṭ vaṣaṭ namaḥ ||
iti viṣṇubrahmamantrau | śivasya tu japtvā rudrān iti vakṣyati |
pūjayitvā vidhānena paścād dhomaṃ samārabhet |
sarvadravyaṃ ca hotavyaṃ dvābhyāṃ kuṇḍe vidhānataḥ ||
japtvā rudrāṃs tu niyataḥ śivaikagatamānasaḥ |
ṛtvijau dvau tu kartavyau guṇāḍyau vedapāragau ||
tān uddiśya yathānyāyaṃ viprebhyo dāpayed dhanam |
śatam aṣṭotaraṃ tebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthag anuttamam ||
vastrābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram |
guruś ca ṛtvijau caiva brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ||
teṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthag dadyād bhojayed brāhmaṇān api |
śivārcanā ca kartavyā snapanādi yathākramam ||
sarvadravyam ityādi, sarvadravyaṃ liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadāne nirūpitam | dvābhyāṃ kuṇḍa iti, dvābhyām ṛtvigbhyām ekasmin kuṇḍe hotavyam ity arthaḥ | tān uddiśyetyādi, tān brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān uddiśya pratidaivatam [781] ṛtvigācāryavyatiriktebhyo viprebhyaḥ pṛthagakakaśo aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyaṃ dhanaṃ dāpayed ity arthaḥ | atrānupāttajātiparimāṇa-viśeṣe ‘pi dhanaśabdena, sarvatra bahuśo niṣkāṇāṃ prakrāntatvāt tair eva aṣṭottaraśataṃ saṃpūraṇīyam | guruś cetyādi, eko guruḥ dvau ṛtvijau tebhyo brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān suvarṇamayān vidhāya dadyāt | teṣāṃ lakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne tebhyo dakṣiṇādānaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ svastivācanaṃ ca kāryam | deśikaṃ pūrvavat saṃpūjya ṛtvijāv api pūjayet,
puṇyāhavācakān viprān pūrvavat pūjayed budhaḥ (?) |
iti vātulokteḥ |
evaṃ kṛtena labhate sarvayajñaphalaṃ naraḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti nirvāṇaṃ cādhigacchati ||
iti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaradānam |
atha trimūrtidānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
sūta uvāca |
apṛcchan munayaḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ |
ugraśravasam āsīnaṃ romaharṣaṇam ādarāt ||
uktāni bhavatāsmākaṃ dānāni vividhāni ca |
mūrtidānaṃ ca noktaṃ vai tvayā brahmavidāṃ vara ||
kadā vā kutra vā kāryaṃ yathā vā dharmasādhanam |
[782]        brūhi tvaṃ sarvadharmajña dānaśuśrūṣayo vayam ||
ity evam ukto balibhiḥ śaunakapramukhas tathā |
uvāca dānamahātmyaṃ munīnāṃ sūtanandana ||
śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve dānaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ yac ca maṅgalyaṃ sarvamuktidam ||
purā deva yuge devaḥ provāca madhusūdanaḥ |
svanābhikamalasthāya viriñcaye mahātmane ||
tathāham api vaḥ sarvaṃ vadāmi śṛṇutānaghāḥ |
trimūrtidānaṃ dānānām uttamottamam ucyate ||
viṣuvaty ayane vāpi candrasūryagrahādiṣu |
nityaṃ vā pañcadaśyāṃ ca janmarkṣeṣu samācaret ||
devālaye nadītīre puṇyeṣv āyataneṣu ca |
gṛhe vā kārayed dānaṃ pañcabhūmiḥ śucir bhavet ||
caturasrāṃ samāṃ bhūmiṃ gomayenopalepayet |
tatrākṣatābhir vikiret puṣpāñjalīn samantataḥ ||
tatraikahastā dvihastā vā triguṇā dairghyataḥ smṛtā |
trivedikā bhavet tiryak śvetataṇḍulamiśritā ||
brahmātha viṣṇur bhagavān murārir
hiraṇmayās tatra niveśanīyāḥ |
caturbhujāḥ svāyudhabhūṣaṇāḍhyā
kirīṭinaś cāpi yathā krameṇa ||
brahmādilakṣaṇam uktam brahmāṇḍadāne |
snānārthapādyācamanīyavastra-
[783]                gandhādibhis tān abhipūjya bhaktyā |
pradakṣiṇī kṛtya sapuṣpahastaḥ
praṇamya codvāsya tataḥ pradadyāt ||
pratyekam evaṃ bahudānapūrvam
saṃpūjya dātavyam anukrameṇa |
tvayā jagatsṛṣṭikṛtā svam etat
tvam eva sarvasya pitāmaho ‘si ||
tvam eva kartā jagatāṃ vikartā
tvam eva dhātā jagatāṃ vidhātā |
tvatsaṃpradānād anagho yathāham
tvayā ca sāyujyam upaiti deva ||
tathā kuru tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ papanne (prapanne?)
mayi prabho devavaraprasādaṃ |
tvayā jagad hy āptam idaṃ samastam
tvaṃ viṣṇur ity eva vadanti santaḥ ||
tvatsthāni sarvāṇi vadanti deva
svayā dhṛtaṃ viśvam anantamūrte |
tvatsaṃpradānād anagho bhavāmi
yathā jagatkāraṇakāraṇeśa ||
tathā kuru tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapanne
mayi prabho devavara prasādaṃ |
tvayā marāṇām amṛtaṃ vidhāya
hālāhalaṃ saṃhatam eva yasmāt ||
[784]        tathāsurāṇāṃ tripuraṃ ca dagdham
ekeṣuṇā lokahitārtham īśa |
tvadrūpadānād aham apy aśeṣam
doṣair vimuktāṃs tu gaṇān prapadye ||
tathā kuru tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapanne
mayi prabho devavara prasādaṃ |
ity evam uktvā vidhivad dadāti
sa yāti sāyujyam atha trimūrteḥ ||
yaḥ kārayed vipravarāya tasmai
suvarṇasaṃkhyāgaṇitaṃ hiraṇyaṃ |
dadyāc ca vāsoyugam ādareṇa
tathā kṛte ‘yaṃ labhate phalaṃ tat ||
iti trimūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha tripuruṣadānavidhiḥ | mṛtyuñjayāt |
suvarṇaraktikānāṃ ca śatenaikena śaktitaḥ |
kāryo brahmātha viṣṇuś ca śaṅkaraś ca tathaiva ca ||
paladvādaśamānena pīṭhaṃ lohena kārayet |
devānāṃ sthāpanārthāya cakravat parimaṇḍalam ||
tatra brahmādayaḥ sthāpyā yamadūtaṃ puro nyaset |
caturmukhaś caturbāhuḥ padmahastaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
śaṅkaro dvibhujaḥ śūlī vṛṣārūḍhas trilocanaḥ |
[785]        viṣṇuś caturbhujaś cakrī gadāgaruḍavāhanaḥ ||
yamadūtaḥ pāśapāṇir daṇḍavān vikṛtānanaḥ |
sa tu lohamayaḥ kāryo bhīto baddha ivāgrataḥ ||
tato vidhāya devānāṃ pūjāṃ puṣpaphalādibhiḥ |
yajamānaḥ kare khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā niśitaṃ navam ||
idaṃ śiraś chinadmīti dūtasyāsya durātmanaḥ |
ity uccārya śiraś chittvā dūtasya yamadiṅmukhaḥ ||
tataś caturbhir viprais tu kāryaṃ brāhmaṇavācanam |
tato brahmādidevānāṃ dānaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ ||
devālaye gṛhe vāpi tīrthe vānyatra kutracit |
brāhmaṇāya tu tān dadyād divyāṅgāya ca śīline ||
suvarṇadakṣiṇāyuktān brahmādīn anupūrvaśaḥ |
apamṛtyubhayāt trasto yo dadyād devatātrayam ||
tasya mṛtyur vinaśyeta dānād asmān na saṃśayaḥ |
mṛtyunā gṛhyamāṇo ‘po jīvaty eva naraḥ sphuṭam ||
cāmīkarapratikṛtitritayaṃ vidhāya
brahmādidānam iha yaḥ puruṣaḥ karoti |
rogān nirasya sakalān api durnivārān
naivāpamṛtybhayam eti naraḥ kadācit ||
iti puruṣatrayadānavidhiḥ |
atha caturmūrtidānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
ṛṣayaḥ satram āsīnā naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ |
ugraśravasam āsīnaṃ prapracchur munisattamāḥ ||
romaharṣaṇasūno tvaṃ sarvajñānamahārṇavaḥ |
ity ukto munibhiḥ sūtaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ ||
yathāha bhagavān brahmā nāradasya pitāmaḥ |
śṛṇu nārada bhadraṃ te dānaṃ sarvāghanāśnam ||
dharmaśuśrūṣavaḥ sarve vayaṃ tvatto mahāmate |
anāyāsena kenevaṃ saṃsārābdhiṃ samuttaret ||
naraḥ prabrūhi dānaṃ vā vrataṃ vā śrutam eva vā |
ity ukto munibhiḥ sūtaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ ||
yathāha bhagavān brahmā nāradasya pitāmahaḥ |
śṛṇu nārada bhadraṃ te dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanam ||
caturmūrtividhānaṃ tat strīṇāṃ maṅgalyakāraṇam |
dhanyam ārogyam āyuṣyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ||
putradaṃ śrīkaraṃ puṇyam abhīṣṭaphaladaṃ śubham |
sarveṣu puṇyakāleṣu candrasūryagrahādiṣu ||
devāgārādideśeṣu gṛhe vā dānam ācaret |
caturasrāṃ samāṃ bhūmiṃ liptāṃ gomayavāriṇā ||
catasras tatra lekhāḥ syuḥ prācyodīcyaś ca tāḥ samāḥ |
nava koṣṭhāni tatra syuḥ koṇakoṣṭhāni varjayet ||
tatra teṣu ca mūrtiś ca caturdikṣu niveśayet |
prāgādyuttaraparyantaṃ jātarūpamayīḥ śubhāḥ ||
śvetataṇḍulapadmeṣu puṣpavatsu niveśayet |
[787]        purato vāsudevaṃ ca saṅkarṣaṇamataḥ param ||
pradyumnaṃ cāniruddhaṃ ca caturmūrthiṃ yathākramam |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītavāsasam acyutam ||
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ caturbāhuṃ keyūramukuṭojvalam |
nīlāmbaradharaṃ devam anantaṃ muśalāyudham ||
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ kaṭakādivibhūṣaṇam |
pradyumnaś cāniruddhaś ca śaṅkhacakragadādharau ||
pītaśvetāmbaradharau keyūrādivibhūṣitau |
evaṃ kṛtvā caturmūrtiṃ caturbāhuṃ samarcayet ||
palasyārdhāt suvarṇena yathāśakti vinirmitam |
prāgādyuttaraparyantaṃ devānām arcanakramaḥ ||
svasvamantreṇa devānām ārādhanam anukramāt |
snānaṃ vāsoyugaṃ cārghapādyam ācanīyakam ||
gandhasumanasau dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyam eva ca |
dhārātrayaṃ śuddhajalais tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet ||
parito lokapālāṃś ca gandhādibhir athārcayet |
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
udvāsya viprān ārādhya dadyāt mantram udīrayet |
namo ‘stu vāsudevāya jagatāṃ pataye namaḥ ||
tava saṃkīrtanād dānāc chreyaḥ syāt tu sadā mama |
saṅkarṣaṇa namas te ‘stu jagatsthityantakarmaṇe ||
tava deva pradānena sarvapāpaharaṃ bhavet |
pradyumnāyākhileśāya bhaktānāṃ duḥkhahāriṇe ||
[788]        namo ‘stu devadevāya bhaktānām ārtihāriṇe |
sadā namo ‘stu jagataḥ sṛṣṭisthityantahetave ||
aniruddhāya devāya viṣṇave paramātmane |
yadi dadyāc caturmūrtiṃ śraddhāyuktas tu nārada ||
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi yathoktaṃ phalam aśnute |
ity āha nāradāyaivaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
yathā mamāpi tat sarvam abruvan munisattamāḥ
iti caturmūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha āyuṣkaradānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
sūta uvāca |
atha dānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ |
āyuṣkaram iti proktam ārogyaṃ sarvasiddhidam ||
yatra sādhanasiddhaḥ syāt tatra dānaṃ samācaret |
bhūmau gomayaliptāyāṃ dakṣiṇottarataḥ śubhaṃ ||
nidhāya tatra pāṇibhyāṃ pūrṇāni sitataṇḍulaiḥ |
catvāri teṣu haimāni maṇḍalāni niveśayet ||
sauvarṇāṃś ca tato devān arcayec ca yathākramam |
pūrvam ātmabhuvaṃtatra viṣṭaraśravasaṃyutam ||
kṛttivāsasam (?) īśānaṃ vajrapāṇiṃ śatakratum |
[789] ātmabhūr brahmā, viṣṭaraśravā viṣṇuḥ, īśānaḥ śivaḥ prasiddhaḥ eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne | ete ca yathāśakti suvarṇamayā vidhātavyāḥ |
gandhādibhir athābhyarcya dakṣiṇottarataḥ kramāt |
pratyekam ekaṃ viprebhyo dadyād ārādhya bhaktitaḥ ||
taṃ taṃ devam iti dhyātvā mantrān etān udāharet |
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhagavān ātmabhūr ity udīrayet ||
saṃprīyatāṃ jagadvyāpī bhagavān viṣṭaraśravāḥ |
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhagavān kṛttivāsā iti dhruvam ||
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhagavān vajrapāṇiḥ śatakratuḥ |
evam āha purā brahmā nāradāya surarṣaye |
proktaṃ mayāpi tat sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ ||
ity āyuṣkaradānavidhiḥ |
atha pañcamūrtidānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
atha dānaṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcamūrtir iti śrutam |
yat kṛtvā puruṣaḥ strī vā sarvasiddham avāpnuyāt ||
yat pāpaṃ manasā vācā karmaṇā ca purā kṛtam |
janmāntarasahasreṣu tanāśaṃ yāti sarvataḥ ||
yathā hedaṃ purā devo nāradāya mahātmane |
pṛṣṭas tenāpi bhagavān abjayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
tathāham api tat sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ |
[790]        pravakṣyāmi mahādevaṃ pañcamūrtir iti śrutam ||
śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ ca devarṣe dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanam |
dānam ārogyam āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ bhuktimuktidam ||
candrasūryagrahe vātha viṣuvaty ayanādiṣu |
sarveṣu puṇyakāleṣu gṛhe vāyataneṣu ca ||
ācāryaṃ varayed vipraṃ tasyānujñām avāpya ca |
vidyāvinayasaṃpannaṃ sarvaṃ tenaiva kārayet ||
lepayet tu samāṃ bhūmiṃ gomayenodakena ca |
catasras tatra rekhāḥ syuḥ prācyodīcyas tu tāḥ samāḥ |
trihastamātrās tāḥ sarvās tatra syur navakoṣṭhakāḥ ||
tatra pañcaiva saṃgrāhyā catuṣkoṇāni varjayet |
teṣu pañcasu koṣṭheṣu pratyekaṃ kamalaṃ nyaset ||
śvetataṇḍulapuñjeṣu aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam |
teṣu taṇḍulpadmeṣu pañcamūrtīr niveśayet ||
suvarṇanimirāḥ pañca mūrtīḥ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
īśaṃ sauvarṇam āsīnaṃ keyūramukuṭojvalam ||
caturbāhum udārāṅgaṃ kaṭakādivibhūṣitam |
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ haste savye tu mṛgapotakam ||
abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe savye śūlaṃ netratrayaṃ nyaset |
sadyojātaṃ vāmadevam aghoraṃ puruṣaṃ tathā ||
suvarṇenaiva kurvīta pradānād ardhamānataḥ |
sadyaṃ paścād uttare vāmadevaṃ
tathā cānyad dakṣiṇe cāpy aghoram |
[791] sadyaṃ sadyojātam ity arthaḥ |
tacchabdoktaṃ puruṣaṃ pūrvakoṣṭhe
teṣāṃ madhye caivam īśānam eva ||
snānaṃ vastraṃ dhūpadīpau haviṣyam
abhyarcitāḥ pañcamūrtīḥ krameṇa |
mantraiḥ pañca brahmabhir mānapūrvaṃ
saṃpūjya caivaṃ vidhinoditena ||
savyādivedāṃś ca yathā krameṇa |
sadyojātādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ liṅgapurāṇoktatilaparvatadāne | pañca brāhmaṇāḥ sadyojātādi | mantrāḥ taittirīyāṇāṃ prasiddhāḥ | tenaiva vipreṇa ca sarvam etat kṛtvaiva dānaṃ svayam eva kuyāt |
dānakāle tu saṃprāpte dātā nārī naro ‘tha vā |
snāpito guruṇā tena mantrapūtaiḥ kuśodakaiḥ ||
abhyarcya vipraṃ gandhādyair mantrān etān udīrayet |
pratyekam ekā dātavyā devamūrtir anukramāt ||
namo ‘stu sadyojātāya bhavāya bhavasaṅgine |
bhavasaṅgo bhaven mahyaṃ tava rūpapradānataḥ ||
somāya vāmadevāya śivāya śivarūpiṇe |
sadā me śivam evāstu tava rūpapradānataḥ ||
[792]        namo ‘ghorāya ghorāya jagatsaṃhṛtikarmaṇe |
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapanno ‘ham aśaṅkaṃ mama śaṅ kuru ||
puruṣāya purāṇāya harāya varadāya ca |
tasya rūpapradānān me śreyase ‘stu nomo ‘stu te ||
īśāno jagatām īśo devānām abhayaṃkaram |
rakṣa tvaṃ śeṣabhūtānām īśo māṃ śaraṇaṃ gatam ||
triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
praṇipatya tato dadyād ebhir mantrair yathākramam ||
madhyamaṃ gurave dadyād anyasmai vā pradāpayet |
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt suvarṇaṃ caiva vāsasī ||
etan nao ‘tha vā nārī nāradeha samācaret |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivasāyujyam āpnuyāt ||
ity evam ṛṣayo dānaṃ nāradāya caturmukham |
yathovāca tathā proktaṃ mayā vai pañcamūrtikam ||
iti pañcamūrtidānavidhiḥ |
atha digdānam | viṣṇudharmottarāt |
kārtikyām agnidaive me viṣṇor brahmāntakasya vā |
prācyādi kurvīta diśaś catasraḥ pṛthivīyutāḥ ||
strīveṣāś caiva kartavyāḥ pūrṇakumbhakarāḥ śubhāḥ |
gorūpā pṛthivī kāryā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā ||
[793]        kṛtvā kamalasaṃsthānāḥ suvarṇadvitayena tu |
pūjayitvā dvijān pañca suvastrābharaṇais tataḥ ||
tāmrapātraṃ dale kṛtvā kadaḷyāḥ pīṭhasaṃyutāḥ |
yo dadāti pradattā syāt pṛthivī tena pārthivaḥ ||
pitaraḥ pitṛlokasthā devaloke divaukasaḥ |
saṃprīṇayanti taṃ tuṣṭā vasuputradhanepsitaiḥ ||
amāṣam annaṃ bhuñjīta datvaitad vidhipūrvakam ||
iti digdānavidhiḥ |
atha pañcadaivatyadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
atha dānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇvantu munayo ‘malāḥ |
pañcadaivatyam ity uktaṃ nāradāya svayaṃbhuvā ||
śarīrārogyam āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ pāpanāśanam |
yat kṛtvā puruṣaḥ strī vā sarvam āyur avāpnuyāt ||
puṇyakāleṣu sarveṣu janmarkṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ |
puṇyadeśe gṛhe vātha nityaṃ vā dānam ācaret ||
duḥsvaptādbhutadṛṣṭo tu sarvadoṣapraśāntaye |
dānam etat samaṃ kuryāc chraddayā parayā yutaḥ ||
snātvā kuśodakaiḥ prātar dhautavāsāḥ prasannadhīḥ |
saṃpūjya vipraṃ vidvāṃsaṃ tasyānujñaṃ avāpya ca ||
agniḥ somaś ca varuṇas tathā devī sarasvatī |
agnir viṣṇur iti prokto brāhmaṇāḥ pañca devatāḥ ||
[794] agnyādilakṣaṇam uktam brahmāṇḍadāne | sarasvatīlakṣaṇam uktaṃ sarasvatīdāne | agniviṣṇvos tulakṣaṇam aparājitenoktam |
agniviṣṇū prakartavyau kamale yugapat sthitau |
tatra śrukpāṇir asgnis tu sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
gadāpadmadharo viṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadās tathā | iti |
etāḥ pañca samuddiśya viprān ārādhya dāpayet ||
pratyekaṃ vāsasī śubhre sasuvarṇe yathākramam |
saṃprīyatām ayaṃ devo bhagavān soma ity api ||
taropadeṣṭre viprāya tat samāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadet |
puṇyāhaṃ svastim ṛddhiṃ ca vācayet pañcabhir dvijaiḥ |
teṣām api ca dātavyā dakṣiṇā ca yathārhataḥ ||
iti pañcadaivatyadānavidhiḥ |
atha lokapālāṣṭakadānam | liṅgapurāṇāt |
lokapālāṣṭakaṃ divyaṃ sākṣāt paramadurlabham |
sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ guhyaṃ paracakravināśanam ||
svadeśarakṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ gajavājivivardhanam |
putravṛddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ gobrāhmaṇahitāvaham ||
pūrvoktadeśakāle tu vedikoparimaṇḍale |
[795]        madhye śivaṃ samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ yathākramam ||
digvidikṣu prakartavyaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ vālukāmayam |
aṣṭau viprān samāhūya vedadevāṅgapāragān ||
jitendriyān kulodbhūtān sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutān |
śivābhimukham āsīnān ahateṣv ambareṣu ca ||
vastrair ābharaṇair divyair lokapālān svamantrakaiḥ |
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sadhūpaiś ca brāhmaṇāṃś cārcayet kramāt ||
atra kuṇḍamaṇḍalamaṇḍapavedikāvitānādi liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣadānavad veditavyam agnikāryam atra śivavedikāyāṃ ca paritaḥ sthaṇḍilāṣṭakaṃ vidhāya tatra yathāśakti suvarṇanirmitān aṣṭau lokapālān śivābhimukhān nūtanavastreṣv āsīnān saṃsthāpya vastādyaiḥ saṃpūjya brāhmaṇān athārcayet | lokapālalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
pūrvato homayed agnau lokapālāṣṭakamantrakaiḥ |
samidghṛtābhyāṃ hotavyam agnikāryakrameṇa tu ||
evaṃ hutvā vidhānena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān |
yajamānaḥ samāhūya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitān ||
kṛtvā tān pūjayitvātha dvijebhyo dāpayed dhanam |
pṛthak pṛthak svamantraiś ca daśaniṣkaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam ||
daśaniṣkena vastrādyam āsanaṃ kambalaṃ pṛthak |
snāpanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śivasya vidhipūrvakam ||
dakṣiṇā ca pradātavyā yathāvibhavavistaram ||
[796] agnikāryakramaḥ agnimukhādipūrṇāhutyantaḥ | kāmike tu ekasmin sthaṇḍile vāth kuṇḍe vā homam ācaret | vātule hi śakrānupūrvadigbhāge deśiko homam ācaret |
lokapālāṣṭamantrais tu pṛthag aṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
samidghṛtābhyāṃ hotavyam ante pūrṇāhutiṃ dadet ||
daśaniṣkeṇeti, tān lokeśān viprān yajamāno ‘rcayitvā pratyekaṃ daśaniṣkamitaṃ bhūṣaṇam tatsaṃmitahiraṇyātmakadakṣiṇayā saha vastādi ca dadyā | dakṣiṇā ceti gurudakṣiṇā | sa ca yathāvibhavaṃ deyā | kāmike tu |
dakṣiṇā daśaniṣkā syād bhūṣaṇaiś ca samanvitā |
vātule tu gurunavamebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ śataniṣkā dakṣiṇoktā |
etad yaḥ kurute dānaṃ lokeśānāṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |
lokeśānaṃ sthiraṃ sthitvā sthāneṣu sa sukhaṃ naraḥ |
kalpaṃ śivapure sthitvā sārvabhaumī bhaved bhuvi ||
iti lokapālāṣṭakadānavidhiḥ |
atha brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
śṛṇu nārada bhadraṃ te dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanam |
sarvamaṅgalyam āyuṣyam ārogyaṃ śrīkaraṃ śubham ||
[797]        dānānām uttamaṃ hy etat sarvasiddhikaraṃ param |
karoti dānaṃ nārī vā sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo vrajet ||
viṣuvaty ayane rāhor grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
anyeṣu puṇyakāleṣu janmarkṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
devālaye nadītīre gṛhe vā dānam ācaret |
puṇyadeśeṣu sarveṣu purāṇokteṣu nārada ||
caturasrāṃ samāṃ bhūmiṃ liptāṃ gomayavāriṇā |
ṣaṭkaraṃ cāṣṭahastaṃ vā daśa dvādaśa vā karān ||
prācyodīcyaś ca kartavyā rekhāś catasṛkāḥ samāḥ |
nava koṣṭhāni tatra syuḥ śvetataṇḍulapuñjakaiḥ ||
sitair aṣṭadalair yuktān kamalān vinyasec chubhān |
jātarūpamayaṃ devaṃ jagatkartāram avyayam |
teṣāṃ madhyamakoṣṭhe tu kamalaṃ viniveśayet ||
kamalasthaṃ brahmāṇam |
indram agniṃ yamaṃ caiva nirṛtiṃ varuṇaṃ tathā |
vāyuṃ somaṃ ca rudraṃ ca prāgādiṣu yathākrama ||
jātarūpamayān devān aṣṭau svāyudhasaṃyutān |
tripalā vā suvarṇāt tu yathāśakti vinirmitān ||
brahmaṇo ‘bhimukhān sarvān sarveṣu viniveśayet ||
jātarūpamayān hiraṇymayān | brahmaṇo lokapālānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
pratyekaṃ vāsasāveṣṭye saṃprokṣya kuśavāriṇā |
[798]        yo ‘sau kārayitā vipas tv evam etat samācaret ||
dānakāle tu saṃprāpte dātā snātvā kuśodakaiḥ |
prasannacittavadanaḥ parameṣṭhipurogamān ||
svanāmamantrair abhito namo ‘ntair
ārādhya gandhādibhir ādareṇa |
viprāṃs tathābhyarcya yathākrameṇa
saṃprīyatāṃ me tv ayam evam uktvā ||
yo ‘sau kārayitā vipras tasmai dadyāt tu dakṣiṇām |
suvarṇasaṃkhyāgaṇitaṃ hiraṇyaṃ caiva vāsasī ||
proktaṃ tu devarṣidānaṃ lokapālāhvayaṃ mayā |
kramān yac chrotum (?) icchā te tad idaṃ vada sāṃpratam ||
iti lokapāladānavidhiḥ |
atha rudrāṣṭakadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
śṛṇu deva mune guhyaṃ dānaṃ sarvārthadaṃ nṛṇām |
rudrāṣṭakam iti khyātaṃ tatpatnīputrasaṃyutam ||
madhye caturmukhopetam iti te bhagavān hariḥ |
yathāha pūrvaṃ tat sarvaṃ vadāmi tava nārada ||
rudro bhavaś ca sarvaś ca īśaḥ paśupatiś tathā |
bhīma ugro mahādeva ete rudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
jaṭilāś carmavasanāḥ sarve khaṭvāṅgaśūlinaḥ |
[799]        teṣāṃ bhāryāś ca putrāś ca nāmataḥ kathayāmite ||
sauvarcalāṅgavādā ca vikeśī ca śivā tathā |
svāhā diśā ca dīkṣā ca rohiṇī ca tathā kramāt ||
tāś ca strīveṣadhāriṇyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
rudrapatnya imāś cāṣṭau putrāṃś ca śṛṇu nārada ||
śanaiśvaraś ca śukraś ca lohitāṅgo manojavaḥ |
vasantaḥ svargaḥ santāno budhaś caiva yathakramam ||
te vālaveṣāḥ kartavyāḥ śikhino daṇḍapāṇayaḥ |
puṇyakāle tu saṃprāpte nityaṃ vā bhūtimicchatā ||
janmarkṣeṣu viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ munisattamaḥ |
caturasrāṃ samāṃ bhūmiṃ liptāṃ gomayavāriṇā ||
catasras tatra rekhāḥ syuḥ prāk tiryak caiva sarvataḥ |
hastamātraṃ dvihastaṃ vā navakoṣṭhasamanvitam ||
sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra padmāni taṇḍulaiś ca prakalpayet |
brahmāṇaṃ madhyame koṣṭhe sauvarṇaṃ vinivedayet |
chandovedīṃ ca tatpārśve tadardhena prakalpayet ||
chandodevīṃ ca gāyatrīm | tayor lakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
sauvarṇān aṣṭau rudrāṃś ca brahmārdhena vinirmitān |
prāgādyuttarapūrvāṃś ca paritaḥ parikalpayet ||
tasyāpy ardhena sauvarṇān pratyekaṃ rudrapārśvataḥ |
teṣāṃ devīś ca putrāṃś ca kalpayitvārcayet pumān ||
[800]        svasvamantreṇa pūjā syāt namaskārayutena ca |
brahmādīn pūjayed gandhapuṣpadhūpapradīpakaiḥ ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇamya ca yathākramam |
pratyekam ekaṃ prāgādīn viprān saṃpūjya dāpayet ||
pūjayitvopadeṣṭāraṃ dadyān mantreṇa madhyamam |
prīyatāṃ bhagavān brahmā parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ||
evaṃ rudrāṣṭakopetaṃ dānaṃ dadyād yathāvidhi |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvasiddhim avāpya ca ||
āyurārogyasaṃyuktaḥ putravān dhanavān sukhī |
bhuktvā bhogān yathecchaṃ ca svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati ||
iti rudrāṣṭakadānavidhiḥ |
atha grahadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
sūta uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam |
puruṣo vātha vā nārī svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati ||
nakṣatragrahapīḍāsu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane |
nimittānantaraṃ kāryaṃ naimittikam iti sthitiḥ ||
yathāha nāradāyaivaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
tathāham apy aśeṣaṃ vo vakṣyāmi munisattamāḥ ||
brahmovāca |
grahadānam atho vakṣye sarvasiddhikaraṃ param |
[801]        sarvaśāntikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
viṣuvaty ayane rāhugrahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ |
janmarkṣe somavāre vā pañcadaśyāṃ tathaiva ca ||
puṇyakāleṣu sarveṣu puṇyadeśe viśeṣataḥ |
grahadānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ nityaṃ śreyo ‘bhikāṅkṣiṇā ||
hastamātrāṃ dvihastāṃ vā trihastāṃ vātha nārada |
caturhastāṃ samāṃ bhūmiṃ gomayenānulepayet ||
rakhāḥ prācya udīcyaś ca syurś catasras tathā samāḥ |
navakoṣṭheṣu padmāni vinyaset śvetataṇḍulaiḥ ||
ādityaś candramā bhaumo budhajīvasitārkajāḥ |
rāhuḥ ketur iti proktā grahā lokasukhāvahāḥ ||
eṣāṃ hiraṇyarūpāṇi kārayitvā yathāvidhi |
triniṣkeṇātha vā kuryād yathāśaktyā pṛthak pṛthak ||
ādityaṃ madhyame koṣṭhe dakṣiṇe ‘ṅgārakaṃ nyaset |
uttare tu guruṃ vidyād budham uttarapūrvake ||
bhārgavaṃ pūrvato nyasya somaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvake |
paścime ‘rkasutaṃ nyasya rāhuṃ paścimadakṣiṇe ||
paścimottarataḥ ketuṃ saṃniveśya yathāvidhi |
tadvargaṃ gandhapuṣpādyair arcayet svasvamantrakaiḥ ||
dānaṃ śūdro ‘tha vā kuryāt strī vā tatra tu nārada |
bhūlepanādi yat kāryaṃ sarvaṃ vipreṇa kārayet ||
snānakāle tu saṃprāpte snātvā tilakuśodakaiḥ |
prayato yajamānas tu dhautavastraḥ prasannadhīḥ ||
[802]        arcayitvā svayaṃ dadyād ahaskaramukhān grahān |
pratyekam ekaṃ vipro ‘sau svasvamantram udīrayet ||
padmāsanaḥ padmakaro dvibāhuḥ
padmadyutiḥ saptaturaṅgavāhaḥ |
divākaro lokaguruḥ kirīṭī
mayi prasādaṃ vidadhātu deva ||
śvetāmbaraḥ śvetavibhūṣanaś ca
śvetadyutir daṇḍadharo dvibāhuḥ |
candro ‘mṛtātmā varadaḥ kirīṭī
śreyāṃsi mahyaṃ vidadhātu deva ||
raktāmbaro raktavapuḥ kirīṭī
caturbhujo meṣagamo gadābhṛt |
dharāsutaḥ śaktidharaś ca śūlī
sadā mama syād varadaḥ praśāntaḥ ||
pītāmbaraḥ pītavapuḥ kirīṭī
caturbhujo daṇḍadharaś ca hārī |
carmāsidhṛk somasutaḥ sadā me
siṃhādhirūḍho varado budhaś ca ||
pītāmbaraḥ pītavapuḥ kirīṭī
caturbhujo devaguruḥ praśāntaḥ |
dadhāti daṇḍaś ca kamaṇḍaluṃ ca
tathākṣasūtraṃ varado ‘stu mahyam ||
śvetāmbaraḥ śvetavapuḥ kirīṭī
[803]                caturbhujo daityaguruḥ praśāntaḥ |
tathākṣasūtraṃ ca kamaṇḍaluṃ ca
jayaṃ ca bibhrad varado ‘stu mahyam ||
nīladyutiḥ śūladharaḥ kirīṭī
gṛdhrasthitas trāṇakaro dhanumān |
caturbhujaḥ sūryasutaḥ praśānto
varaprado me ‘stu sa mandagāmī ||
nīlāmbaro nīlavapuḥ kirīṭī
karālavaktraḥ karavālaśūlī |
caturbhujaś carmadharaś ca rāhuḥ
siṃsāsanastho varado ‘stu mahyam ||
dhūmro dvibāhur varado gadābhṛt
gṛdhrāsanastho vikṛtānanaś ca |
kirīṭakeyūravibhūṣitāṅgaḥ
sadāstu me ketugaṇaḥ praśāṇtaḥ ||
ity uktvā dāpayet sarvān ādityādyān navagrahān |
puruṣo vātha nārī vā yathoktaṃ phalam āpnuyāt ||
madhyamaṃ gurave dadyād anyasmai vā pradāpayet |
atha vā dakṣiṇā deyā suvarṇaṃ vāsasī śubhe ||
sūta uvāca |
ity āha bhagavān brahmā nāradāya mahātmane |
tathāham abrūvaṃ dānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
[804]
iti navagrahadānavidhiḥ |
atha saṃpatkaradānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
athāparaṃ dānam ahaṃ bravīmi
śṛṇvantu sarve munayaḥ sametāḥ |
saṃpatkaraṃ dānam atīva puṇyaṃ
yasmin kṛte saṃpado ‘bhyeti jantuḥ ||
yathā purā ṛṣaye nāradāya
jagatkartā cābravīd dānam etat |
āyuṣkaraṃ rogaharaṃ tu pāpa-
vināśanaṃ nāśakaraṃ tv aghānām ||
svargāpavargo kulaputravṛddhiṃ
śriyaṃ tathā pradadāmīṣṭasiddhim |
hiraṇyadaḥ prāpnuyād dīrgham āyur
ity abravīd ātmabhūr nāradāya ||
ataḥ suvarṇaṃ dvijavargahaste
dātavyam evātmahitaṃ munīndrāḥ |
kāleṣu sūryagrahaṇādikeṣu
tāreṣu janmatritayeṣu kāryam ||
darśeṣu devāyatanādikeṣu
gṛheṣu vā ramate yatra kutra |
snātvā prātas tilamiśraiḥ kuśodakaiḥ
[805]                śucir bhūtvā dhautavāsāḥ prayatnaḥ ||
saṃkalpya vipraṃ viduṣaṃ guruṃ ca
saṃgṛhya tasyānumatena kāryam |
gavyena bhūmiṃ śakṛtā jalena
cālepayed viṃśatihastamātrām ||
tatraiva rekhāś caturaḥ samāḥ syuḥ
prācyaś ca tiryak ca yathopadiṣṭam ||
nava koṣṭhāni tatra syus teṣu pūrṇāni taṇḍulaiḥ |
nidhātavyāni pātrāṇi vāsobhir abhiveṣṭya ca ||
palasyārvāk triniṣkordhvaṃ yathāśakti vinirmitām |
dakṣiṇottarato devān jātarūpamayān nyaset ||
pāścātyakoṣṭhatritaye tu mitraṃ
tathā ca devaṃ varuṇaṃ ca somam |
caturmukhaṃ madhyamakoṣṭhakeṣu
jagatpatiṃ viṣṇum umāpatiṃ ca ||
divākaraṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ ca vahniṃ
saṃpūjya sarvān vidhivat krameṇa ||
atra mitralakṣaṇam āha viśvakarmā |
padmagarbhe samaḥ kāryo mitraḥ kamalasaṃsthitaḥ |
ajo ‘tulo vinālāntavikacāmbhojadhṛk prabhuḥ ||
varuṇādilakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
[806]        abhyarcya viprān api gandhavastraiḥ
pṛthak ca dātavyam anukrameṇa |
saṃprīyatāṃ mety ayam eva muktvā
tato dadyāt sodakapūrvam atra ||
ekasya caikaṃ ca hiraṇyarūpaṃ
praṇāmapūrvaṃ pariṇīya sarvān |
pātrāṇi vāsaḥ paridhāya caiva
sataṇḍulaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca datvā ||
abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ sa labheta sarvam
āyuṣyam ārogyam upeti cāgram |
athopadeṣṭre gurave suvarṇaṃ
vāsoyugaṃ dānasamaṃ ca dadyāt ||
viprais tathā vācayet svastivācyaṃ
tato dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ vācakebhyaḥ ||
iti saṃpatkaradānavidhiḥ |
atha daśāvatāaradānam | tatra viśvāmitraḥ |
dānānām uttamaṃ dānaṃ haimaṃ viṣṇoḥ svarūpakam |
tasmāt puṇyārthinā deyā haimī viṣṇoḥ svarūpikā ||
matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaś ca narasiṃho ‘tha vāmanaḥ |
rāmo rāmaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca buddhāh kalkī ca te daśa ||
vāme śaṅkhaṃ gadā dakṣe dvibhujo matsyarūpadhṛk |
[807]        narāṅghrir matsyarūpī vā matsyarūpo janārdanaḥ ||
etad eva kūrmalakṣaṇaṃ matsyapadasthāne kūrmapadayoge sati |
madhupiṅgalavarṇaṃ ca caturbāhvāyudhiar yutam |
narāṅgaṃ śūkarāsyaṃ ca manāk pīnaṃ subhīṣaṇam ||
śrīr vāmakūrparasthā tu dharānantau padānugau |
etadrūpadharaṃ devaṃ varāhaṃ bhuktimuktidam ||
jvaladagnisamākāraṃ siṃhavaktraṃ narāṅgakam |
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ lalajjihvaṃ subhīṣaṇam ||
vṛttākṣaṃ jaṭilaṃ kruddham ālīḍhaṃ pīnavakṣasam |
abhedyatīvranakharaṃ karābhyāṃ nakhair bhṛśam ||
gadācakradharaṃ dvābhyāṃ narasiṃhaṃ jagatprabhum |
kuṇḍī chatradharo dvirdor vyāmanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
kṣatrāntakaraṇaṃ ghoram udvahan paraśuṃ kare |
jāmadagnyaḥ prakartavyo rāmo roṣāruṇekṣaṇaḥ ||
yuvā prasannavadanaḥ siṃhaskandho mahābalaḥ |
ājānubāhuḥ kartavyo rāmo bāṇadhanurdharaḥ ||
śaṅkhacakradharaḥ kāryo nīlotpaladalachaviḥ |
kṛṇo dīrghadvibāhuś ca sarvadaityakṣayaṃkaraḥ ||
kaṣāyavastrasaṃvītaḥ skandhasaṃsaktacīvaraḥ |
padmāsanastho dvibhujo dhyāyī buddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
khaḍgodyatakaraḥ kruddho hayārūḍho mahābalaḥ |
svecchocchedakaraḥ kalkī dvibhujaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
[808]        yathāśaktyā prakurvīta suvarṇena vijānatā |
samena ṣoḍaśenaiva samāny etāni kārayet ||
yathāśaktyā prakurvīta suvarṇena vijānatā |
vittānurūpato rājan tulyam āḍhyadaridrayoḥ ||
saṃpūjya nāmabhis tais tu puṣpadhūpanivedanaiḥ |
bhaktinamraḥ praṇamyātha nivedyaḥ śraddhayā tataḥ ||
āhūya brāhmaṇān rājan pādau prakṣālya yatnataḥ |
upaveśyāsane sarvāṃś candanenānulepayet ||
sugandhaiḥ kusumaiś caiva dhūpair dīpais tathaiva ca |
ācchādya vastrayugmaiś ca grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
ayane viṣuve vāpi dvādaśyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ kāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
anyathā narakaṃ yātīty eva māha pitāmahaḥ |
grāhakā viṣṇurūpāś ca ahīyata vimatsaraḥ ||
ekaikaṃ devarūpaṃ tam ekaikasya samarpayet |
atha vā viduṣaḥ sarvān dadyāt saṃpūjya mānavaḥ ||
nānṛte ‘pi kadācic ca dadyāt pāṣaṇḍine tathā |
devarūpaṃ mayā vipra kāritaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubham ||
tad gṛhāṇa pradānena prīyatāṃ viśvarūpadhṛk |
etad uccārya viprasya haste toyaṃ kṣipet svayam ||
pradakṣiṇā tato deyā saṃpūjya praviśed gṛham |
asya dānasya māhātmyaṃ vadāmy ekamukhaḥ katham ||
[809]        sahasrāsyaḥ śatāsyo vā yadi śakto ‘bhibhāvitum |
uddeśataḥ pravakṣyāmi bhaktānāṃ bhaktivṛddhaye ||
daśāvatāratī rājan viṣṇor aikyaṃ sa gacchati |
kṣīre kṣāraṃ yathākṣiptaṃ payaḥ saṃharate ‘nakhaḥ ||
tathā viṣṇoḥ sa dātā vai aikyaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ |
brahmahā ca surāpaś ca taskarī gurutalpagaḥ ||
yathā muñjād iṣīkāntas tathā pāpāt pramucyate |
sahasraṃ caiva jantūnām uddharet sa idaṃ jagat ||
tasmāt prayaccha rājendra viprebhyo viṣṇurūpakān |
yena sarvasya dānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti satvaram ||
na tat tapobhir atyugrair vihitaiḥ prāpyate phalam |
viṣṇor daśāvatārāṇāṃ dānena yad avāpyate ||
yaḥ kāñcanena śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitāṅgaṃ
viṣṇoḥ svarūpadaśakaṃ vidhivad vidhāya |
dadyād dvijeṣu jagad eva hi tena dattaṃ
yasmāj jaganmayavapur vibhur eṣa devaḥ ||
iti daśāvatāradānavidhiḥ |
atha viśvāmaradānam | brahmāṇdapurāṇāt |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānaṃ viśvāmarāhvayam |
yat kṛtvā puruṣaḥ strī vā brahmalokam avāpnuyāt ||
[810]        sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvapāpavimocanam |
svargyaṃ yaśodam āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ putravṛddhidam ||
abhīṣṭaphaladaṃ nṛṇāṃ duḥsvapnādbhutadarśanam |
grahaśāntikaraṃ pitryabhuktimuktipradāyakam ||
yad āha bhagavān brahmā nāradāya surarṣaye |
yathāhaṃ kṛpayā pūrve pitā me romaharṣaṇaḥ ||
vaiśvadevam iti proktaṃ dānānām uttamottamam |
tad ahaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
graste candrarāhunā vāpi sūrye
tathāyane viṣuve janmatāre |
vyatīpāte trividhe cādbhute vā
duḥsvapne vā pañcadaśyāṃ ca kuryāt ||
kṛte pāpe niḥkṛtis tasya caitad
bhaye jāte nirbhayārthaṃ ca kuryāt |
aste rogair bahubhiḥ śrūyamāṇe
nityaṃ kuryād vaiśvadevaṃ tu dānam ||
devāgāre svagṛhe nandane vā
nadītīre ramate yatra tatra |
vipraṃ guruṃ vedapurāṇadakṣaṃ
saṃgṛhya tasyānumatena kāryam ||
vināyakaṃ vipramukhena deyaṃ
saṃpūjya dānaṃ vidhinā samastam |
gavyena bhūmiṃ śakṛtā jalena
[811]                vilipya nītvā daśahastamānām ||
tatraiva lekhāś ca caturaḥ samantāt
prācyaś ca tiryak ca bhavanti tatra |
na vātra koṣṭhāni bhavanti teṣu
sakarṇikān aṣṭadalān sarojān ||
kṛtvā sitair āḍhakataṇḍulaiś ca
saṃveśayet teṣu hiraṇyadevān |
viśvāṃś ca devāṃś characāpapāṇīn
aṣṭau samastān dvibhujān vidhāya ||
madhye mahendraṃ mukuṭādiyuktaṃ
vajrāyudhaṃ śaktidharaṃ niveśya |
hārādikeyūrayutaṃ praśāntaṃ
viśvāmarāṇām adhikaṃ hiraṇyāt ||
siṃhāsanasthaṃ jagatām adhīśaṃ
śatakratuṃ daityahanaṃ surendram ||
teṣāṃ nāmāni tu vāyupurāṇāt |
kratur dakṣo vasuḥ satyaḥ kālaḥ kāmacarācarau |
purūravādravaś caiva viśve devā daśa smṛtāḥ ||
śrāddheṣv eva prayogo ‘sti teṣām antimayor dvayor ||  iti |
prāgādimadhyāntam anukrameṇa
sarvaṃ karoty āsanārghārcanāntam |
[812]        saṃprokṣya kūrceṇa kuśodakena
ṛcā tathā yajuṣā vāruṇena ||
vastrair athāveṣṭya ca vāsavāya
vāsoyugaṃ saṃparidhāya cāgram |
pratyaṅmukhān prāṅmukha eva sarvān
ārādhya dātavyam atha krameṇa ||
vipreṇa vā guruṇā sarvam etat
kṛtvā mantravidhinā vaiśvadevam |
uktān devān arcayitvā yathoktaṃ
dātā snātvā tilamiśraiḥ kuśodakaiḥ ||
puṣpāñjaliṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ caiva sārdham
abhyarcya devān atha puṣpagandhaiḥ |
dhūpapradīpaiś ca yathā krameṇa
pratyekam ekaṃ ca yathā hiraṇyam ||
saṃprīyatāṃ bhagavān meti coktvā
dadyād aṣṭau preritaḥ sodapūrvam |
paṭhan mantraṃ gurave madhyamaṃ ca
saṃprīyatāṃ mama cāpy atra devaḥ ||
saṃprīyatāṃ bhagavān vajrapāṇiḥ
saṃprīyatāṃ bhagavān daityahantā |
evaṃ kṛtvā pañcabhir vipravaryaiḥ
puṇyāhaṃ ca svastim ṛddhiṃ ca vācyam ||
etad dānaṃ gurave dakṣiṇāṃ ca
[813]                viśvedevāḥ prīṇayanty asya viprāḥ ||
iti viśvāmaradānavidhiḥ |
adha sādhyadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
sūta uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānaṃ munivarottamāḥ |
sādhyadānam iti proktaṃ dānānām uttamottamam ||
yathāha bhagavān pūrvaṃ pitā me romaharṣaṇaḥ |
yathāhaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ śaunakādayaḥ ||
ācāryavaraṇādīni sarvaṃ vai vaiśvadevavat |
tathaiva haimān kurvīta sādhyān dvādaśasaṃkhyayā ||
vāyupurāṇe |
brahmaṇo ‘tha mukhāt sṛṣṭā yathā devāḥ prajepsayā |
sarve mantraśarīrās te sthitā mantrantareṣv iha ||
tathā |
brahmaśāpena te jātāḥ punaḥ svāyaṃbhuve jitāḥ |
svārociṣe vai tuṣitāḥ satyāś caivottame punaḥ ||
tāmase harayo nāma vaikuṇṭhe raivate ‘ntare |
sādhyāś ca cākṣuṣe nāmnā chandojā jajñire surāḥ ||
dharmaputrā mahābhāgāḥ svādhyāyāṃ dvādaśāmarāḥ |
mano’numantā prāṇaś ca naropānaś ca vīryavān ||
[814]        cittir hayo nayaś caiva haṃso nārāyaṇas tathā |
prasavo ‘tha vibhuś caiva svādhyā dvādaś jajñire ||
skandapurāṇe |
sādhyāḥ padmāsanagatāḥ kamaṇḍalvakṣasūtriṇaḥ |
dharmaputrā mahātmāno dvādaśāmarapūjitāḥ ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
vaiśvadānavad evātra sādhyadāne vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
dāne cābhyarcanaṃ mantraḥ śrūyatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
sādhyebhyaś ceti coktvā vai devebhyaś ca namas tathā |
saṃprīyatāṃ me bhagavan sādhyadevā iti bruvan ||
evaṃ dadyāt tu viprebhyo madhyamaṃ gurave tathā |
etat kṛtvā tu puruṣo nārī vā dānam ādṛtā |
vaiśvadeve ca yat proktaṃ phalaṃ tat sarvam āpnuyāt ||
iti sādhyadānavidhiḥ |
atha dvādaśādityadānam | brahmapurāṇāt |
śṛṇu nārada bhadraṃ te dānam ādityasaṃjñitam |
yathoktaṃ lokaguruṇā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||
kartuḥ pāpaharaṃ puṇyam āyuṣyaṃ śrīkaraṃ śubham |
ārogyaṃ sarvamāṅgalyaṃ duḥsvapnādbhutanāśanam ||
[815]        sarvaśāntikaraṃ hy etat sarvasiddhiphalapradam |
cakṣuṣyaṃ sarvarogaghnaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ||
viṣuvaty ayane rāhugrahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
janmarkṣe sauravāre vā pañcadarśyarkasaṃkrame ||
saptamyāṃ vātha nakṣatre sāvitre ‘dbhutadarśane |
duḥsvapnadarśane kuryād dānam ādityasaṃjñitam ||
devālaye nadītīre taḍāge varuṇālaye |
anyeṣu puṇyadeśeṣu devadānaṃ samācaret ||
ālipya vai dvādaśahastadairghyāṃ
kṣitiṃ tathā gomayasaṃyutādbhiḥ |
tasmin sitais taṇḍulapuñjakaiś ca
vistārayed dvādaśa paṅkajāni ||
prādeśamātrāṇi śubhāni tāni
sakarṇikāny aṣṭadaleṣu teṣu |
hiraṇyarūpāṇi raver nidhāya
yathākramād uttarato ‘pavargaḥ ||
teṣāṃ lakṣaṇam uktam brahmaṇḍadāne |
pratyaṅmukhān prāṅmukha eva devāṃs
tadvarṇagandhādibhir arcayitvā |
[816]        dadyād apūpaṃ saghṛtaṃ guḍāktaṃ
vastrair athāveṣṭya yathākrameṇa ||
pratyekam ekaṃ dvijapuṅgavānām
ārādhya gandhādibhir dareṇa |
saṃprīyatām ity apy atha ca krameṇa
pratyekam uccārya tadīyanāma ||
dhātā ca mitraś ca tataḥ pareṇa
mārtaṇḍanāmā ca tathāryamā ca |
śakraś ca devo varuṇas tathāsau
bhago vivasvān navamas tahaiṣām ||
ādityanāmā savitā tathānyas
tvaṣṭā tathaikādaśamaś ca teṣām |
viṣṇus tathā dvādaśamaś ca mantrair
ārādhayed devavarān dvijāṃś ca ||
purā devarṣer dānaṃ proktaṃ kalayoninā |
tathā mayāpi yuṣmākaṃ proktaṃ munivarottamāḥ ||
ity ādityadānavidhiḥ |
atha devagaṇēśadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
athāpṛcchan munayaḥ sūtasūnuṃ
tadāraṇye naimiṣe sattriṇas te |
ugraśravāḥ paripṛcchāmahe tvāṃ
[817]                kathaṃ martyo mucyate rogapūgaiḥ ||
tathā pṛṣṭo munibhiḥ sūtasūnur
uvācedaṃ prītipūrvaṃ tadānīm |
yathā purā ṛṣaye nāradāya
jagatkartā cābravīd dānam etat ||
śṛṇvantu yūyaṃ munayaḥ sametā
vadāmy ahaṃ deva gaṇeśadānam |
āyuṣyam ārogyam anantamuktim
abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ pradadāti kartuḥ ||
kāleṣu sūryagrahaṇādikeṣu
tāreṣu janmatritayeṣu kāryam |
deśeṣu devāyatanādikeṣu
gṛheṣu vā ramate yatra tatra ||
vipraṃ guruṃ vedapurāṇadakṣaṃ
saṃgṛhya tasyānumatena kāryam |
gavyena bhūmiṃ śakṛtā jalena
vilepayed viṃśati hastamātrām ||
ṣaṭ dakṣiṇe prāg api vedarekhās
tiryakkṛtais taṇḍulapuñjakaiś ca |
tasmin vicitrāṇi saroruhāṇi
kṛtvāṣṭapatrāṇi daśātha pañca ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśve ‘śvimarutas tathā |
sādhyā devās tathā caiva saptamo gaṇa ucyate ||
[818]        dvau dvau gaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyaś caturdaśa surottamān |
jātarūpamayān kṛtvā kamaleṣu niveśayet ||
madhye mahendraṃ dvibhujaṃ hiraṇyaṃ
hiraṇyarūpād adhikaṃ gaṇānām |
vajrāyudhaṃ daityahanaṃ kirīṭa-
keyūrahārādivibhūṣitaṃ ca ||
pratyaṅmukhān prāṅmukha eva devān
ādityavasvādi yathā krameṇa |
svanāmamantraiś ca namo ’ntarūpair
ārādhayed uttarato ‘pavarge (?) ||
ṣaṭ dakṣiṇe ityādi, dakṣiṇottarāyatāḥ ṣaṭ rekhāḥ kṛtvā prākpaścimāyatāś catasraś ca vidhāya pañcadaśakoṣṭāni saṃpādayet |
teṣu tāvanti taṇḍulamayāni kamalāni kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇān devān sthāpayet | tatra ādityavasulakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇdadāne | rudralakṣaṇam uktaṃ viśvacakre | eteṣāṃ nāmāni ca tulāpuruṣadāne | viśvadevalakṣaṇaṃ tannāmāni ca viśvāmaradāne | marutāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nāmāni ca maruddāne | sādhyānāṃ sādhyadān iti |
tato mahendraṃ jgatām adhīśam
ārādhayed devagaṇaiḥ sametam |
saṃpūjya tasmai gurave ca deyaṃ
vāsoyugaṃ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāni ||
tatas tv asau bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgaḥ (?)
[819]                saṃveṣṭito vastrayugena vipraḥ |
samarcayed devagaṇeśamukhyāṃs
tato homaṃ prārabhed devatānām ||
snānaṃ vastraṃ cārghapādyācamanīyaṃ
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau haviś ca |
dadyād eṣāṃ madhyaṃ devadevaṃ
samarcayed vidhinā śāstrajena ||
agniṃ samādhāya samuhya darbhaiḥ
paristared ājyam atho gṛhītvā |
satkṛtya darvīṃ vidhinā ghṛtena
pratyekam ekaṃ ca daśāhutīnām ||
hutvā gaṇebhyaś ca tathāhutīnāṃ
śataṃ tathā daśa vāpy atra hutvā |
idrasya homaṃ vidhinā samāpya
śeṣās tathā vyāhṛtibhiḥ samastāḥ ||
ity evam etad guruṇaiva kāryaṃ
dātā svayaṃ dānam athātra kuryāt |
snātvā vāso guruṇā prokṣitaś ca
kuśodakaiḥ pāvanānair yajurbhiḥ ||
pratyekam ekaṃ dvijapuṅgavānām
ārādhya dātavyam anukrameṇa |
pradakṣiṇaṃ devagaṇaiś ca sārdhaṃ
kṛtāñjaliṃ puṣpayutaṃ ca datvā ||
[820]        saṃprīyatāṃ mety aym eva coktvā
dadet sarvāṃś codakapūrvam atra |
tatas tv idaṃ gurave dāpayitvā
vipraiḥ svastiṃ pañcabhir vācayec ca ||
datvā teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vācakānāṃ
tato viprān pūjayed vai guruṃ ca |
tathā caivaṃ devadānaṃ ca kṛtvā
tataḥ sarvair mucyate rogapūgaiḥ ||
kṛtvā cāsau devagaṇeśadānam
āyuṣyam ārogyam upaiti cāgram |
bhuktvā bhogān aihikān puṣkalāṃś ca
tato gacched brahmalokaṃ viśālam ||
evaṃ purā gaṇeśākhyaṃ dānaṃ munivarottamāḥ |
uktaṃ devarṣibhiś caiva brahmaṇā vā svayaṃbhuvā ||
iti devagaṇeśadānavidhiḥ |
atha nignābhadānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
sūta uvāca
athāparaṃ dānam ahaṃ pravakṣye
śṛṇvantu sarve munayaḥ sametāḥ |
yathā purā ṛṣaye nāradāya
[821]                jagatkartā padmayonis tv avocat ||
yat kṛtvā vai puruṣo vātha nārī
phalaṃ ceṣṭaṃ labhate cobhayatra |
āyuś ca sarvaṃ labhate ‘tha rogair
vimucyate candram upaiti lokam ||
kāleṣu sūryagrahaṇādikeṣu
saṃkramyate tatra ca dānam etat |
nignābhasaṃjñaṃ tu tathaiva kuryād
deśeṣu devāyatanādikeṣu ||
gṛheṣu vā ramate yatra tatra
dvijāya nimnābhamanuṃ pradadyāt |
vaitānikaṃ vedapurāṇadakṣaṃ
saṃgṛhya vipraṃ gurum ādareṇ ||
tenaiva sarvaṃ vipreṇa kārayec caiva mādṛtaḥ |
yajamānaḥ svayaṃ kuryād dānaṃ nignābhasaṃjñitam ||
kṣitau gomayaliptāyāṃ dakṣiṇottarataḥ samam |
daśa pañca ca padmāni kārayet śvetataṇḍulaiḥ ||
maṇḍalāni yathāśakti hairaṇyāni prakalpayet |
maṇḍalatritayaṃ teṣu pratipadmaṃ niveśayet ||
āyurādīni tattvāni śarīre santi yāni vai |
tāni dhyātvātha gandhādyair arcayet tāny amantrakaiḥ ||
āyurādīni, śrotraprabhṛtīni, śrotraṃ āyur iti śruteḥ | teṣām anukramaś ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣo jihvā ghrāṇaṃ caivātra pañcamam |
śabdasparśau rūparasau gandhaś ceti kramād amī ||
ākāśaḥ pavanas tejo jalaṃ pṛthvīty anukramāt |
iti pañcadaśemāni tattvāni munayo viduḥ || iti |
viprān abhyarcya dātavyaṃ pratyekaṃ ca yathākramam |
nignābhadānamantrās tu guruṇā vacayec ca tān ||
pañcabhir guruṇā sārdhaṃ vācayet svastivācanam |
dakṣiṇāṃ ca goror dadyāt suvarṇaṃ caiva vāsasī ||
atha vā padmayugalam ekaikasyāpi dāpayet |
sarvaṃ vā gurave dadyāt saṃkalpya yatra vācanam ||
yady ekaṃ gurave dadyād bahubhyaś cetarān dadet |
abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ labhate kartā dānena vānagha ||
iti nignābhadānavidhiḥ |
atha gaṇeśadānam ucyate liṅgapurāṇe |
gaṇeśaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānaṃ pūrvoktamaṇḍape |
saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ lokapālasamāvṛtam ||
vighneśvarān yathāśāstraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam |
daśaniṣkeṇa vai kṛtvā saṃpūjya vidhinā tataḥ ||
atra kuṇḍamaṇḍapamaṇḍalavedikāvitānādi liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavihitaṃ veditavyam |
[823]        devadeveśaṃ maheśvaraṃ sauvarṇalokapālayutam |
saṃpūjya parito ‘ṣṭadikṣu vighneśān arcayed iti ||
saptakoṭimantrātmakavighnagaṇānām īśatvāt | ata eva gaṇeśāḥ | te ca yathā |
athānantaś ca śūkṣmaś ca śivaś cāpy ekanetrakaḥ |
ekarudras trimūrtiś ca śrīkaṇṭhaś ca śikhaṇḍakaḥ || iti |
śivoktavighneśāś cātra gaṇeśāḥ | te ca pratyekaṃ daśaniṣkair vidheyāḥ | tad uktaṃ kāmike |
daśaniṣkasuvarṇena nirmitāṃś ca prthak pṛthak |
svakīyāvaraṇe caitān gandhapuṣpādibhir guruḥ |
pradhāne juhuyād īśaṃ vighneśān aṣṭadikṣu ca || iti |
teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu lakṣaṇasamuccayāt |
kuṇḍī pāśāṅkuśaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ śūlaṃ ca vāmavāhuke |
śaktir vajrākṣamālāsicakrāṇi dakṣiṇe kvacit ||
dvīpicarmadharo ‘bjastho nāgayajñopavītavān |
ekāsyaḥ pañcavaktro vā tryakṣo jaṭendubhṛc chivaḥ ||
anantādyāś caturdikṣu raktanīlasitāruṇāḥ |
koṇeṣu caikarudrādyāḥ sitāsṛgnīlalohitāḥ ||
sarve cāṣṭabhujā yojyāś caturāsyā jaṭānvitāḥ |
śivāyudhadharās tryakṣāḥ sṛṇyasibhyāṃ vinā kvacit ||
[824]        digvarṇā jaṭilās tryakṣāḥ paratriśūladhāriṇaḥ |
puṭāñjalikarāḥ sarve vighneśāś caikavaktrakāḥ ||
lokapālalakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
aṣṭadikṣv aṣṭakuṇḍeṣu pūrvavad dhomam ācaret |
pañcāvaraṇamārgeṇa pāramparyakrameṇa ca ||
pūrvavad iti, liṅgapurāṇoktatulāpuruṣavad ity arthaḥ |
sapta viprān samabhyarcya kanyām ekāṃ tathottare |
dāpayet sarvatantrāṇi svaiḥ svair mantrair anukramāt ||
datvaivaṃ sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
pañcabrahmādyaiḥ pañcāvaraṇair yuktasya śivasyārcanaṃ madhye pradhānakuṇḍe homaś ca dikkuṇḍeṣu tu vighneśānām ātmīyapañcāvaraṇair gurupaṃparopadiṣṭair yuktānāṃ homaḥ īśānādisaptadikṣu saptaviprān uttarasyāṃ diśy ekāṃ kanyām abhyarcya kanyāṣṭamebhyo viprebhyaḥ svasvamantreṇa sarvatantrāṇi sarvatantramayān vighneśān dadyād ity arthaḥ | dāpayet sarvavidyeśān iti pāṭhaḥ | tebhyaḥ pradadyād vidyeśān svasvamantrair anukramād iti kāmikokteḥ | pañcāvaraṇapūjā tu vāyusaṃhitoktā grāhyā |
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ vidhivad gandhavarṇarasādibhiḥ |
mano’bhilaṣite tatra vitānavinatāmbare ||
sulipte ca mahīpṛṣṭhe darpaṇodarasaṃnibhe |
prācīm utpadayet pūrvaśāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā ||
[825]        ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ parikalpya tu |
ālikhed vipulaṃ padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ||
raktacūrṇādibhir cūrṇer yathāsaṃbhavasambhṛtaiḥ |
prativāruṇasaṃyuktaṃ bahuśobhāsamanvitam ||
daleṣu siddhayaḥ kalpyāḥ kesareṣu saśaktitaḥ |
rudrā vāmādayas tv aṣṭau pūrvādi paritaḥ kramāt ||
karṇikāyāṃ tu vairūpyaṃ bījeṣu nava śaktayaḥ |
kande śivātmako dharmo nāle jñānaṃ śivāśrayam ||
karṇikopari vāgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sauram aindavam |
śivavidyātmatattvākhyaṃ tattvatrayam ataḥ param ||
sarvāsanoparimukhaṃ vicitrakusumānvitam |
paravyomāvakāśe ca vidyayātīva bhāsuram ||
parikalpyāsanaṃ mūrtim āvāhya parameśvaram |
pañcavarṇasvamārgeṇa pūjayed ambayā saha ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ prasannaṃ śītaladyutim |
vidyudvalayasaṅkāśaṃ jaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitam ||
divyāyudhavarair yuktaṃ divyagandhānulepanam |
śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ kiṃcit smitamukhāmbujam ||
raktapadmadalaprakhyapādapāṇitalādharam |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ candrakhaṇḍaśikhāmaṇim |
[826]        atyapūrvamukhaṃ saumyaṃ bālārkasaṛśaprabham ||
vilocanāravindāḍhyaṃ bālendukṛtaśekharam |
dakṣiṇaṃ nīlajīmūtasamānaruciraprabham ||
bhṛkuṭīkuṭilaṃ ghoraṃ raktavṛttatrilocanam |
daṃṣṭrākarāladurgharṣaṃ sphuritādharapallavam ||
uttaraṃ vidrumaprakhyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam |
savilāsatrinayanaṃ candrābharaṇaśekharam ||
paścimaṃ pūrṇacandrābhaṃ locanatritayojvalam |
atīvasaumyam utphullaṃ locanatritayojvalam ||
dakṣiṇe śūlaparaśuvajrakhaḍgānalojvalam |
candrarekhādharaṃ saumyaṃ mandasmitamanoharam ||
pañcamaṃ sphaṭikaprakhyam indurekhāsamudvalam |
savye ca nāganārācaghaṇḍāpāśāṅkuśojvalam |
nivṛtyājānusaṃbaddham ānābhiṃ ca pratiṣṭhayā ||
ākaṇṭhaṃ vidyayā tadvad ālalāṭe tu śāntayā |
tadūrdhvaṃ śāntyatītākhyakalayā varayā tathā ||
pañcādhvayāpinaṃ (?) tasmāt kalāpañcakavigraham ||
īśānamukuṭaṃ devaṃ puruṣākhyaṃ purātanam |
aghoraṃ hṛdayaṃ tadvad vāmaguhyaṃ maheśvaram ||
sadyamādyaṃ (?) ca tanmūrtim aṣṭatriṃśatkalāmayam |
mātṛkāmayam īśānaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ tataḥ ||
[827]        oṃkārākhyam ayaṃ caiva haṃsaṃ śaktyā samanvitam |
pañcākṣaramayaṃ devaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramayaṃ tu vā ||
aṅgaṣaṭkayutaṃ caiva jātiṣaṭkasamanvitam |
tathecchāmi kayā śaktyā samārūḍhakamaṇḍalum ||
jñānākhyayā dakṣiṇato vāmataś ca kriyākhyayā |
tattvatrayamayaṃ sākṣād vidyāmūrtiṃ sadāśivam ||
mūrtitvenaiva saṃkalpya sakalīkṛtya ca karmāt |
saṃpūjya ca yathānyāyam arghāntaṃ mūlavidyayā ||
mūrtimantaṃ śivaṃ sākṣāc chaktyā paramayā saha |
tatrāvāhya mahādevaṃ sadasadvyaktivarjitam ||
pañcopacāraṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet parameśvaram |
brahmabhiś ca ṣaḍaṅgaiś ca tathā mātṛkayāpi ca ||
praṇavena śivenaiva śaktiyuktena ca kramāt |
śāntena ca tathānyaiś ca devamantraiś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
pūjayet paramaṃ devaṃ kevalena śivena vā |
sadyādimukham īśānaṃ kṛtvātha svapanaṃ vinā ||
pañcāvaraṇapūjāṃ tu prārabhet tu yathākramam |
tatrādau śivayoḥ pārśve dakṣiṇe vāmataḥ kramāt ||
gandhādyair arcayet pūrvaṃ devo herambaṣaṇmukhau |
tato brahmāṇi parita īśānādi yathākramam ||
saśaktikāni sadyāntaṃ prathamāvaraṇe yajet |
ṣaḍaṅgāny api tatraiva hṛdayādīny anukramāt ||
śivasya ca śivāyāś ca vāmādiṣu samarcayet |
[828]        tatra vāmādikān rudrān aṣṭau vāmādiśaktibhiḥ |
arcayed vā na vā paścāt pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni vāmādirudrāś ca tatraiva darśitāḥ |
hṛdayaś ca śiraś caiva śikhā varma ca netrakam |
svasti mety evam uktāni ṣaḍaṅgāni manīṣibhiḥ ||
vāmo jyeṣṭhas tathā rudraḥ kālo vikaraṇas tathā |
balavikaraṇaś caiva balaprathamanas tathā ||
sarvabhūtasya damanas tādṛśāś cāṣṭaśaktayaḥ |
prathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu ||
anantaṃ pūrvadikpatre śaktyā saha śivottamam |
tatraivottaradikpatre ekanetraṃ samarcayet ||
ekanetraṃ ca tacchaktiṃ paścād īśānāadigdane |
trimūrtiṃ tasya śaktiṃ ca pūjayed agnidigdale ||
śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nairṛte patre tacchaktiṃ tasya vāmataḥ |
athaiva mārute patre śikhaṇḍīśaṃ samarcayet ||
parthamāvaraṇe cejyā na vā te cakravartinaḥ |
tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ śaktibhiś cāṣṭamūrtayaḥ ||
aṣṭāsu śarvas tatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatis tathā |
ugro bhīmo mahādeva ity aṣṭau mūrtayaḥ kramāt ||
[829]        antarāntarataś caiṣāṃ mahādevādayaḥ kramāt |
śaktibhiḥ saha saṃpūjyās tatraikādaśamūrtayaḥ ||
mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ |
īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ ||
kapālīśaś ca kathyante tathaikādaśaśaktayaḥ |
tatrāṣṭau prathamaṃ pūjyā vāhneyādi yathākramam ||
devadevaḥ pūrvapatram īśānyām agnigocare |
bhavodbhavas tayor madhye kapālīśaś tataḥ param ||
tasminn āvaraṇe bhūyo vṛṣendraṃ purato yajet |
nandinaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya mahākālaṃ tathottare ||
śāstāraṃ vahnidikpatre mātur (?) dakṣiṇadigdale |
gajāsyaṃ nairṛte patre ṣaṇmukhaṃ vāruṇe tataḥ ||
jyeṣṭhāṃ vāyudale gaurīm uttare caṇḍam aiśvare |
śāstṛnandīśayor madhye munīndraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yajet ||
mahākālasyottarataḥ piṅgalaṃ tu samarcayet |
śāstṛmātṛsamūhasya madhye bhṛṅgīśvaraṃ tataḥ ||
mātṛvighneśamadhye tu vīrabhadraṃ samarcayet |
skandavidhneśayor madhye jayed devīṃ sarasvatīm ||
jyeṣṭhākumārayor madhye mahāmodīṃ samarcayet |
gaṇāmbācaṇḍayor madhye devīṃ durgāṃ samarcayet ||
tatraivāvaraṇe bhūyaḥ śivānucarasaṃhatim |
rudraprathamabhūvākhyāṃ trividhāṃ ca svaśaktikām ||
[830]        śivāyāḥ sakhīvargaṃ ca yajet dhyātvā samantataḥ |
evaṃ tṛtīyāvaraṇe vitate pūjite sati ||
caturthāvaraṇaṃ dhyātvā bahis tasya samarcayet |
bhānuḥ pūrvadale pūjyo dakṣiṇe caturānanaḥ ||
rudro varuṇadikpatre viṣṇur uttardigdale |
caturṇām api devānāṃ pṛthag āvaraṇāny atha ||
tatpūjānantaraṃ kuryāt tacchāstroktaprakārataḥ |
atha vā bhānum abhyarcya prathamāvaraṇe yajet ||
tasyātmani ṣaḍ evādau dīptādyābhiś ca śaktibhiḥ |
dīptā sūkṣmā jyā bhadrā vibhūtir vimalā kramāt ||
amoghā vidyutā caiva pūrvādiparitaḥ sthitāḥ |
dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāś catasro mūrtayaḥ kramāt ||
pūrvādyuttaraparyantāḥ śaktayaś ca tataḥ param |
ādityo bhāskaro bhānū raviś cety anupūrvaśaḥ ||
arko brahmā tathā rudro viṣṇuś caivaṃ vivasvataḥ |
vistārān pūrvadigbhāge sutā vā dakṣiṇe sthitāḥ ||
bodhanī paścime bhāge āpyāyed uttare punaḥ |
uṣāṃ prabhāṃ tathā prajñāṃ saṃdhyām api tataḥ param ||
īśānādiṣu koṇeṣu dvitīyāvaraṇe yajet |
somam aṅgārakaṃ caiva budhaṃ buddhimatāṃ varam ||
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadbuddhiṃ mārgavaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim |
[831]        śanaiśvaraṃ tathā rāhuṃ ketuṃ dhūmraṃ bhayaṃkaram ||
samantato yajed etāṃs tṛtīyāvaraṇe kramāt |
atha vā dvādaśādityān dvitīyāvaraṇe yajet ||
tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva rāśīn dvādaśa pūjayet |
saptaspatagaṇāṃś caiva bahir asya samantataḥ ||
ṛṣīn devāṃś ca gandharvān pannagāś cāpsarogaṇān |
grāmaṇyaś ca tathā yakṣaṃ jātudhānāṃs tathā hayān ||
saptachandomayāṃś caiva vālakhilyāṃś ca pūjayet |
evaṃ tryāvaraṇaṃ devaṃ samabhyarcya divākaram ||
brahmaṇam arcayet paścāt tribhir āvaraṇaiḥ saha |
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ pūrvasyāṃ virājaṃ dakṣiṇe tataḥ ||
kālaṃ paścimadigbhāge puruṣaṃ cottare yajet |
hiraṇyavarṇaḥ prathamo brahmā kamalasaṃnibhaḥ ||
kālo jātyāñjanaprakhyaḥ puruṣaḥ sphaṭikopamaḥ |
triguṇo rājasaś caiva tāmasaḥ sāttvikas tathā ||
catvāra ete kramaśaḥ prathamāvaraṇe sthitāḥ |
dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt ||
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandaś ca sanātanaḥ |
tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścād arcayeta prajāpatīn ||
aṣṭau pūrvās tu pūrvā trīn prāk paścād uttaraṃ kramāt |
dakṣo rucir bhṛguś caiva marīciś ca tato ‘ṅgirāḥ ||
paulastyaḥ pulahaś caiva kratur atriś ca kaśyapaḥ |
vaśiṣṭhaś ceti vikhyātāḥ prajānāṃ patayas tv ime ||
[832]        teṣāṃ bhāryāś ca taiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjanīyā yathākramam |
prasūtiś ca tathā kūtiḥ khyātiḥ saṃbhūtir eva ca ||
smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā caiva santatiś cānasūyakā |
devamātārundhatī ca sarvāḥ khalu prtivratāḥ ||
śivārcanaratā nityaṃ śrīmatyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ |
prathamāvaraṇe vedāṃś caturo vāsya pūjayet ||
itihāsapurāṇāni dvitīyāvaraṇe punaḥ |
tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścād dharmaśāstrapuraḥsarāḥ ||
vaidikā nikhilā vidyāḥ pūjyā eva samantataḥ |
pūrvādiparito vedāsūdanye tu yathāruci ||
aṣṭadhā vā caturdhā vā kṛtvā pūjya samantataḥ |
evaṃ brahmāṇam abhyarcya tribhir āvaraṇair yutam ||
dakṣiṇe paścime paścād rudraṃ (?) sāvaraṇaṃ yajet |
tasya brahmaṣaḍaṅgāni prathamāvaraṇaṃ smṛtam ||
dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ caiva vidyeśvaramayaṃ tathā |
tṛtīyāvaraṇe bhedo vidyate sa tu kathyate ||
catasro mūrtayas tasyāḥ pūjyāḥ pūrvādibhiḥ kramāt |
triguṇaḥ sakalo devaḥ purastāc chivasaṃjñakaḥ ||
rājaso dakṣiṇe brahmā sṛṣṭikṛt pūjyate sadā |
tāmasaḥ paścime vāgniḥ pūjyaḥ saṃhārako haraḥ ||
sāttvikaḥ sukhakṛt saumyo viṣṇur viśvapatir mṛḍaḥ |
evaṃ paścimadigbhāge śambhoḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ śivam ||
samabhyarcyottare bhāge tato vaikuṇṭham arcayet |
[833]        vāsudevaṃ puras tasya prathamāvaraṇe yajet ||
aniruddhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ pradyumnaṃ paścime tataḥ |
saumye saṃkarṣaṇaṃ paścād hy atra tau vā yajed imau ||
prathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu |
matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaś ca nārasiṃhaś ca vāmanaḥ ||
rāmeṣv anyatamaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavān aśvamukho ‘pi ca |
tṛtīyāvaraṇe caikaṃ pūrvabhāge samarcayet ||
nārāyaṇākhyaṃ yāmye ‘straṃ kvacid avyāhataṃ yajet |
paścime pāñcajanyaṃ ca śārṅgadhanur athottare ||
evaṃ tryāvaraṇaṃ sākṣād viṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ harim |
mahāviṣṇuṃ sadāviṣṇuṃ mūrtiṃ kṛtya samarcayet ||
itthaṃ catuścaturvyūhaṃ kramān mūrticatuṣṭayam |
pūjayitvā tu tacchaktīś catasraḥ pūjayet kramāt ||
prabhām āgneyadigbhāge nairṛte tu sarasvatīm |
gaṇāmbikāṃ ca vāyavye lakṣmīṃ raudre samarcayet ||
evaṃ bhānvādimūrtīnāṃ tacchaktīnām anantaram |
pūjāṃ vidhāya lokeśāṃs tatraivāvaraṇe yajet ||
indram agniṃ yamaṃ caiva nairṛtaṃ varuṇaṃ tathā |
vāyuṃ somaṃ kuberaṃ vā paścād īśānam arcayet ||
evaṃ caturthāvaraṇaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
āyudhāni maheśasya padmād bāhyaṃ samarcayet ||
[834]        śrīmattriśūlam aiśāne vajraṃ māhendradiṅmukhe |
paraśuṃ vahnidigbhāge yāmye sāyakam arcayet ||
aṅkuśaṃ mārute bhāge pinākaṃ cottare yajet |
evam āvaraṇaṃ caivaṃ saṃpūjyānantaraṃ bahiḥ ||
paścimābhimukhaṃ raudre kṣetrapālaṃ samarcayet |
sarvāvaraṇadevānāṃ bahir vā paścime ‘tha vā ||
pañcagomātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ mahokṣapurato yajet |
nandā subhadrā surabhī suśīlā sumanās tathā ||
pañcagomātaras tv etāḥ śivaloke vyavasthitāḥ |
tataḥ samantataḥ pūjyāḥ sarvā vai devayonayaḥ ||
khecarā ṛṣayaḥ siddhā daityā yakṣāś ca rākṣasāḥ |
anantādyāś ca nāgendrā nāgais tatra kulodbhavaiḥ ||
ḍākiṇībhūtavaitālapretabhairavanāyakāḥ |
pātālavāsinaś cānye nānāyoniṣu saṃbhavāḥ ||
nadyaḥ samudrā girayaḥ kānanāni sarāṃsi ca |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vṛkṣāḥ kīṭādyāḥ kṣudrayonayaḥ ||
narāś ca vividhākārā mṛgāś ca kṣudrayonayaḥ |
bhuvanāny antaraṇḍasya tato brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ ||
bahiraṇḍāni saṃkhyāni bhuvanāni mahādhipaiḥ |
brahmāṇḍadhārakā rudrā daśadikṣu vyavasthitāḥ ||
yad gauṇaṃ yac camād deyaṃ yad vā śākyaṃ tataḥ param |
yat kiṃcid arthaṃ śabdasya vākyaṃ cidacidātmakam ||
[835]        tat sarvaṃ śivayoḥ prānte buddhā sāmānyato yajet |
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve cintyāḥ smitamukhās tathā ||
sādaraṃ prekṣyamāṇāś ca devaṃ devīṃ ca sarvadā |
ittham āvaraṇāny arcya kṛtvāpy akṣemaśāntaye ||
punar abhyarcya deveśaṃ pañcākṣaram udīrayet |
nivedayet tataḥ paścācchivayor amṛtopamam ||
sarasavyañjanaṃ śuddhaṃ ṣaḍyakāraṃ mahācarum |
dvātriṃśad āḍhakair mukhyaṃ madhyamaṃ tv āḍakāvaram ||
sādhayitvā yathā saṃpat śraddhayā vinivedayet |
tato nivedya pānīyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ copavaṃśakaiḥ ||
nīrājanādikaṃ kvatvā pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
yogopayogidravyāṇi viśiṣṭāny eva sādhayet ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta buddhimān vibhave sati |
śivasyopekṣakasyāpi vyaṅgaṃ cāpy anutiṣṭhataḥ ||
na phalanty eva kāmyāni karmāṇīit satāṃ kathā |
tasmāc chāṭhyam upekṣāṃ ca tyaktvā sarvāṅgayogataḥ ||
kuryāt kāmyāni karmāṇi phalasiddhiṃ yad icchati |
itthaṃ pūjāṃ samāpyātha devaṃ devīṃ praṇamya ca ||
bhaktyā pūjāṃ samāpyātha tataḥ stotram udīrayet |
tataḥ stotrajapasyānte tv aṣṭottaraśataṃ varam ||
japet pañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ sahasrottaram utsukaḥ |
[836]        dadyāt pūjāṃ guroḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā paścād yathākramam ||
yathodayaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ sadasyān api pūjayet |
tata udvāsya deveśaṃ sarvair āvaraṇaiḥ saha ||
maṇḍalaṃ gurave dadyād yogopakaraṇaiḥ saha |
śivāśritebhyo dadyād vā sarvā evānurūpataḥ ||
atha vā tacchivāyaiva śivakṣetre samarpayet |
śivāgnau vā yajed devaṃ homadravyais tu saptabhiḥ ||
samabhyarcya yathāpūvaṃ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ |
evaṃ yogeśvaro māna triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ||
tasmād abhyadhikaḥ kaścid yogo ‘sti bhuvane kvacit |
na tad asmin jagaty asmin na sādhyaṃ yad anena tu ||
aihikaṃ vā phalaṃ kiṃcid āmuṣmikam athāpi vā |
idam asya phalaṃ nedam iti naiva niyamyate ||
