śreyo rūpasya kṛtsnasya yad idaṃ śreṣṭhasādhakam |
idaṃ tu śakyate vaktuṃ puruṣeṇa yad arpate |
cintāmaṇir ivaitasmāt tat tena prāpyate phalam ||
iti gaṇeśadānavidhiḥ
atha maruddānam | brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ |
maruddānam iti proktaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
[837]        purā devayuge devo brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
ṛṣiṇā nāradenedaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ provāca nāradam ||
śṛṇu nārada bhadraṃ te dānaṃ sarvaphalapradam |
yad yat kāmayate dātā tat tat phalam upāśnute ||
puṇyakāleṣu sarveṣu janmarkṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ |
puṇyadeśeṣu sarveṣu gṛhe vā dānam ācaret ||
devā ekonapañcāśat devendrasamatejasaḥ |
bhrātaraḥ puruhūtasya marutaḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ||
kirīṭahārakeyūrakaṭakādivibhūṣitāḥ |
khaḍgacarmadharā nityaṃ śakrasyānucarāḥ sadā ||
teṣāṃ tu pratirūpāṇi jārarūpeṇa kārayet |
teṣāṃ dānāni tat sarvaṃ vipreṇaiva samācaret ||
śucau deśe samāṃ bhūmiṃ lipya gomayavāriṇā |
dakṣiṇottarato vidyāl lekhāḥ ṣaṭ tatra tāḥ samāḥ ||
prāg ekādaśalekhāḥ syuḥ pañcāśatkoṣṭham ucyate |
caturasrāḥ samāḥ sarve hastatritayasaṃmitāḥ ||
koṣṭhe madhyamavīthyāṃ vai ṣaṣṭhe cottarataḥ sthitam |
indram āsanam ity uktam itare marutas tathā ||
koṣṭheṣu sarveṣu saroruhāṇi
kṛtvā sitais taṇḍulamaṇḍalaiś ca |
padmāni devāsanam ārabheta
[838]                saṃsthāpayet teṣu yathākrameṇa ||
atra dakṣiṇottarato rekhāṣaṭkam ālikhya pūrvapaścimāyatābhir ekādaśarekhābhiḥ pañcāśatkoṣṭhaniṣpattiḥ syāt | tatra madhyamavīthyām uttarataḥ ṣaṣthe koṣṭhake | indrāsanam uttare avaśiṣṭakoṣṭhakāḥ | marutām āsanaṃ marunnāmāni tu vāyupurāṇāt |
tatas teṣāṃ tu nāmāni mātāpitroḥ pracakratuḥ |
tadvidhaiḥ karmabhiś caiva marutānto pṛthak pṛthak ||
śukrajyotis tathādityaḥ citrajyotis tathāparaḥ |
satyajyotiś ca jyotismān satyahā ṛtapās tathā ||
prathamo ‘yaṃ gaṇaḥ prokto dvitīyaṃ tu nibodhata |
ṛtajit satyajic caiva suṣaiṇaḥ senajit tathā ||
antimitro hy amitraś ca dūremitras tathāparaḥ |
gaṇa eva tṛtīyas tu tṛtīyo yan nibodhata ||
ṛtaḥ satyo dhruvo dhartā vidhartātha vidhāraya |
dharuṇaś ca tṛtīye tu caturthaṃ me nibodhata ||
dhvāntaś ca dhunitaś caiva sabharaś ca tathā gaṇaḥ |
īdṛkṣāsaḥ puruvaś caiva anyādṛkṣāsa etanaḥ ||
saṃmitāḥ samadṛkṣāsaḥ pratidṛkṣāsa vai gaṇaḥ |
marutendraḥ sabharasaḥ tathā devaviśo paraḥ ||
yajñaś caivānuvartmānas tathānyo mānuṣīviśaḥ |
[839]        daityadevāḥ samākhyātāḥ saptaite saptakā gaṇāḥ |
ete hy ekonapañcāśan maruto māmataḥ smṛtāḥ || iti |
prāgādipūrvottaram atra caivaṃ
sarvāṇi kṛtyāni ca kārayitvā |
vastrair athāveṣṭya kuśodakaiś ca
saṃprokṣya talliṅgayutair yajurbhiḥ ||
madhye mahendras triguṇena hemnā
vajrāyudhaḥ śaktidharaḥ kirīṭī |
hārādikeyūravibhūṣitāṅgī
devādhipo lokapatiḥ praśāntaḥ ||
kāryam iti adhyāhāryam |
abhyarcya devān marutaś ca pūrvam
anantaraṃ vipravarāṃs tathaiva |
pratyekam eva pradadettu teṣāṃ
pradakṣiṇaṃ cottarapūrvam eva ||
prāpte śubhe puṇyakāle ‘tha dātā |
snātvā tatas tilamiśraiḥ kuśodaiḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ puṣpagṛhītahastaḥ
kṛtvā tu vipreṇa sahaiva sarvān ||
praṇamya puṣpāñjalinā ca sarvaṃ
pradāpayed devagaṇaṃ krameṇa |
pratyekam evaṃ dvijapuṅgavānāṃ
praṇamya mantraṃ samudāhared vai ||
[840]        vṛṇoti devaṃ marutāṃ tathaikaṃ
mayi prabho deva kuru prasādam |
tava prasādād aghanāśanaṃ me
sauvarṇarūpās tu sadāmareśāḥ ||
ity evam uktvā marutaḥ pradāya
tato mahendraṃ pradadec ca devam |
yaḥ kārayed vipravaras tu tasmai
svatīti viprāś ca purobhidhāya ||
tataḥ saṃpūjya gurave dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathocitām |
svastivācakaviprāṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathārhataḥ ||
trailokyarājo jagatām adhīśo
devādhipo daityagaṇābhihantā |
śreyāṃsi mahyaṃ pradadātu devo
devāgrajo vajradharaḥ praśāṇtaḥ ||
ity uccārya tato dadyād devaṃ vajradharaṃ harim |
pūjāyām api śaktasya mantra eṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute dānaṃ marutāṃ vidhipūrvakam |
sa sarvakāmasaṃpanno devavd divi modate ||
yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā vedaṃ nāradāya surarṣaye |
tathā mayāpi vaḥ sarvaṃ proktaṃ vai munisattamāḥ ||
iti maruddānavidhiḥ |
atha bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ | [841] bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
pratiṣṭhā śāśvatī kena dānena madhusūdana |
iha loke pare caiva kīrtiḥ syād adbhutā tathā ||
sadgatiṃ ca yathā yānti sarve pitṛpitāmahāḥ |
santatiś cākṣayā loke vibhavaś cāpi puṣkalaḥ ||
sthāpanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ kathaṃ syād yadunandana |
tadācakṣva mahābhāga dānena niyamena vā ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājan lokānām upakārakam |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā guhyaṃ paramam uttamam ||
bhuvanānāṃ samāsena pratiṣṭhā kathayāmi te |
devāsurās tathā nāgā gandharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ ||
pretāḥ piśācā bhūāś ca sthāpitāś ca na saṃśayaḥ |
kārakasyānukūle tu muhūrte vijaye śubhe ||
puṇye tithau śive ṛkṣe dine saumyagrahānvite |
saptahastaṃ paṭaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ susaṃhatam ||
bhinnāṅgaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam |
tasmin sarvāṇi rājendra bhuvanāni likhāpayet ||
caturvarṇakam ānīya vicitraṃ citrakarmaṇi |
yuvānaṃ vyādhirahitaṃ bhavyaṃ citrakaraṃ śubham ||
saṃpūjayitvā yatnena puṣpavāsovibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
[842]        tasmin karmaṇi yuñjīta paṭhamāno dvijottamaiḥ ||
śaṅkhabherīninādaiś ca gītamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ |
puṇyāhajayaghoṣaiś ca brāhmaṇān pūjya yatnataḥ ||
ācāryam api saṃpūjya vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā |
prārambhaṃ kārayed rājan paṭe tasmin yathoditam ||
paurāṇaṃ vidhim āsthāya bhuvanāni yathākramam |
madhye likhāpayed rājan jambudvīpaṃ savistaram ||
tasya madhye sthito merur meror upari devatāḥ |
diśāsu lokapālānāṃ puryo ‘ṣṭau surasaṃyutāḥ ||
saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī sapta caiva kulācalāḥ |
sāgarāḥ sapta evātra nadyo hṛdyāḥ sasindhavaḥ ||
pātālāḥ sapta vā caiva sapta svargavibhūtayaḥ |
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhuvanāni yathākramam ||
dhruvamārgas tathādityo grahatārāgaṇair vṛtaḥ |
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ||
ṛṣayo munayo gāvo devamātara eva ca |
suparṇādyāś ca vihagā nāgāś cairāvatādayaḥ ||
diggajāṣṭakam atraiva lekhayed ratnamaṇḍitam |
evaṃvidhaṃ paṭaṃ rājan kārayitvā suśobhanam ||
daśottareṇa payasā etat sarvaṃ samāvṛtam |
tattejasāvṛtaṃ bhūyo mahatogreṇa sarvaśaḥ ||
tejas tu vāyunā vāyur ākāśena samāvṛtaḥ |
bhūtādinā tathākāśaṃ bhūtādimahatā tathā ||
[843]        avyaktena mahāṃś caiva vyāpto vai buddhilakṣaṇaḥ |
avyaktaṃ tamasā vyāptaṃ tamaś ca rajasā tathā ||
tajaḥ sattvena saṃvyāptaṃ tridhā prakṛtir ucyate |
evam āvaraṇopetaṃ brahmāṇḍam akhilaṃ nṛpa ||
puruṣeṇāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ tathā |
etat sarvaṃ paṭasthaṃ tu kṛtvā citramayaṃ sudhīḥ ||
kārtikyām ayane caiva viṣuve grahaṇe tathā |
pūjayed yena vidhinā tat samāsena me śṛṇu ||
pūrvato maṇḍalaṃ cāsya vicitraṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
nava kuṇḍāni catvāri caturasrāṇi kārayet ||
dvau dvau niyojayet teṣu brāhmaṇau vedapāragau |
yajñopakaraṇopetau vastrābharaṇabhūṣitau ||
homaṃ kuryur yatātmāno mauninaḥ sarva eva te |
nāmadheyaiḥ paṭasthānāṃ mantrair oṃkārapūrvakaiḥ ||
yajamānas tataḥ sarvaṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ |
ācāryeṇa samaṃ kuryāt pūjām agre paṭasya tu ||
puṣpair vastraiḥ samabhyarcya mantram etam udīrayet |
brahmāṇḍodaravartīni bhuvanānīha yāni tu ||
tāni saṃnihitāny atra pūjitāni bhavantu me |
brahmā viṣṇus tathā rudro hy ādityā vasavas tathā ||
pūjitās tu pratiṣṭḥāsu bhavantu satataṃ mama |
[844]        evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ||
bhakṣān nānāvidhāṃś caiva naivedyaṃ tatra dāpayet |
śaṅkhatūryaninādaiś ca jāgaraṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
brahmaghoṣair vicitraiś ca gītamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ |
punaḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā śucir alaṃkṛtaḥ ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena punaḥ saṃpūjya taṃ paṭam |
ṛtvik pūjān tataḥ kṛtvā gosatena vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
atha vā goyugaṃ dadyād ekaikasyāpy alaṃkrtam |
upānahau tathā chatraṃ gṛhopaskaraṇāni ca ||
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcit sarvaṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tataḥ prakalpayed dānaṃ nāgayuktam alaṃkṛtam ||
alābhe vājisaṃyuktaṃ patākādhvajamālinam |
sahasraṃ dakṣiṇān datvā tataś cāropayet paṭam ||
brāhmaṇaṃ vā rethenātha nayed devālayaṃ budhaḥ |
tatra saṃsthāpayen nītvā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiś ca pūjayet ||
tatrāpi dadyān naivedyaṃ kuryāc cāpi mahotsavam |
yasminn āyatane tasya pratiṣṭhā kriyate nṛpa ||
pūjā tatrāpi mahatī kartavyā bhūtim icchatā |
candrātapaṃ tu ghaṇṭāṃ ca dhvajādyaṃ dāpayet sudhīḥ ||
yathāśaktyā ca rājendra guruṃ gauravayan nṛpa |
abhyarcya dakṣiṇābhiś ca brāhmaṇāṃś ca visarjayet ||
[845]        dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cānivāritam |
tasminn ahani dātavyaṃ mitrasvajanabandhuṣu ||
anena vidhinā yas tu śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ |
kuryān naro vā nārī vā pratīṣṭhāṃ sārvalaukikīm ||
sthāpitas tu bhavet tena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
kulaṃ cottāritaṃ tena saputreṇa yudhiṣṭhira ||
yāvac ca devatāgāre paṭas tiṣṭhati pūjitaḥ |
tāvac cāsyākṣayā kīrtis trailokye pratisarpati ||
dināni kīrtir yāvanti martyalokeṣu gīyate |
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
gandharvair gīyamānas tu apsarogaṇasevitaḥ |
vaseta hṛṣṭamanasā yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
puṇyakṣayād ihābhyetya rājarājo ‘bhijāyate |
putrapautravṛtaḥ śrīmān dīrghāyur atidhārmikaḥ ||
daśajanmāni rājendra jāyate hatakaṇṭakaḥ |
śrīs tasya jāyate nityā tejaś cāvyāhataṃ bhuvi ||
balaṃ buddhir dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrapautraṃ tathottamam |
etat sarvam avāpnoti kṛtvaitat surasattamaḥ ||
kīrtis tu prathitā tasya balaṃ cāpi mahad bhavet |
aparāṇy api janmāni sapta rājā bhavaty asau ||
paścād yatikule bhūtvā nirvāṇaṃ prāpnute param |
asmāt parataraṃ nāsti triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana ||
etat kṛtvā tu munayo lebhire paramaṃ padam |
[846]        etasyaiva prabhāveṇa purāṇāś cakravartinaḥ ||
tathāvidhaṃ padaṃ labdhā loke kīrtir vitenire (?) |
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi pratiṣṭhāṃ bhauvaṇīṃ tu yaḥ |
prakaroti vidhānena kṛtakṛtyo bhaved dhruvam ||
dharmaṃ ca vardhayati dharmaśatāni dhatte
prasādayati pāpam apākaroti |
vikhyāpayec ca bhuvaneṣu viśeṣaniṣṭhāṃ
tan nāsti yan na kurute bhuvanapratiṣṭhām (?) ||
iti bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ |
atha kalpadānaṃ matsyapurāṇe |
kalpānukīrtinaṃ vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
yasyānukīrtanād eva vedapuṇyena yujyate ||
prathamaḥ śvetakalpas tu dvitīyo nīlalohitaḥ |
vāmadevas tṛtīyas tu tato rathaṃtaro ‘paraḥ ||
rauravaḥ pañcamaḥ proktaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāṇa iti smṛtaḥ |
saptamo ‘tha bṛhatkalpaḥ kandarpo ‘ṣṭama ucyate ||
madyo ‘tha navamaḥ prokta īśāno daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
[847]        vyāna ekādaśaḥ proktaḥ tathā sārasvato ‘paraḥ ||
trayodaśa udānas tu gāruḍo ‘tha caturdaśaḥ |
kūrmaḥ pañcadaśo jñeyaḥ paurṇamāsī prajāyate ||
ṣoḍaśo nārasiṃhas tu samānaas tu tataḥ paraḥ |
āgneyo ‘ṣṭādaśaḥ proktaḥ somakalpas tathāparaḥ ||
mānavo viṃśatiḥ proktas tat pumān iti cāparaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhaś cāparas tadval lakṣmīkalpas tathāparaḥ ||
caturviṃśas tathā proktaḥ sāvitrīkalpasaṃjñakaḥ |
pañcaviṃśatime ghoro vārāhas tu tato ‘paraḥ (?) ||
saptaviṃśo ‘tha vairājo gaurīkalpas tathāparaḥ |
māheśvaras tataḥ prokto tripuro yatra ghātitaḥ ||
pitṛkalpas tathā te tu yā kuhūr brahmaṇaḥ smṛtā |
ity ayaṃ brahmaṇo māsaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ||
ādāv eva hia māhātmyaṃ yasmin yasya vidhīyate |
tasya kalpasya tannāma vihitaṃ brahmaṇā purā ||
yas tu dadyād imān kṛtvā haimān parvaṇi parvaṇi |
brahmaviṣṇupure kalpaṃ munibhiḥ pūjyate divi ||
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ kalpadānaṃ yato bhavet |
munirūpāṃs tataḥ kṛtvā dadyāt kalpān vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
munirūpān munyāmbhārān munilakṣaṇam uktam [848] brahmāṇḍadāne |
iti kalpadānavidhiḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe devatādānaprakaraṇam ||
atha kālaviśeṣeṇa dānaviśeṣā abhidhīyante
abhyarcan vidhinātithī viracan nakṣayogān tithīn
vārambāram udāram aṅgalaguruprītir budhaṃ prīṇayan ||
bibhrāṇaḥ priyamitramaṇḍalasadāsaṅkrāntikāntaṃ gṛhaṃ
sādhu śrīkaraṇaprayogakuśalo hemādir eva kṣitau ||
tenātha tithivārarkṣayogeṣu karaṇeṣu ca |
saṅkrāntyādiṣu kāleṣu kriyate dānasaṃgrahaḥ ||
tatra tithidānāni tāvad ucyate viṣṇudharmottare |
pratipad yaś ca puṣpāṇāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ ghṛtasya ca |
pañcamyāṃ tu phalānāṃ vai ṣaṣṭhyāṃ snānasya mānada ||
saptamyāṃ cāpy apūpānām aṣṭamyāṃ ca guḍasya ca |
kulmāṣasya navamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ bhojanasya ca ||
ekādaśyāṃ suvarṇasya dvādaśyāṃ vasanasya ca |
trayodaśyāṃ tu gandhānāṃ sitāyās tadanantaram ||
dānaṃ ca paramānnasya pañcadaśyāṃ mahāphalam |
[850] bhaviṣyottare |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
tithidānam idānīṃ te kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ||
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi karmajaṃ yad aghaṃ bhavet |
sarvaṃ praśamam āyāti dānenānena pāṇḍava ||
śrāvaṇe kārtike caitre vaiśākhe phālgune tathā |
sitapakṣe tu taddānaṃ dātavyaṃ puṣṭivardhanam ||
dattaṃ śraddhā sahāyaś ca pātraprāptis tathaiva ca |
dānakālaḥ sadaiveha kathitas tattvadarśibhiḥ ||
tīrthe cāyatane goṣṭhe gṛhe vā niyatātmavān |
yad dadāti naraśreṣṭha tad ānantyāla kalpate ||
pratipatsu dvijān pūjya pūjayitvā prajāpatim |
sauvarṇam aravindaṃ ca kārayitvāṣṭapatrakam ||
prajāpatilakṣaṇam uktam brahmāṇḍadāne |
kṛtvā tv audumbare pātre sugandhaghṛtapūrite |
puṣpair dhūpaiḥ pūjayitvā viprāya pratipādayet ||
audumbaram tāmrapātram |
anena vidhinā datvā kamalaṃ kamalāyalam |
īpsitān labhate kāmān niṣkāmo brahmasātmatām ||
[851]        vahniṃ pūjya dvitīyāyāṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti kramāt |
tilājyena śataṃ hutvā datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ ||
vaiśvānaraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayet tāmrabhājane |
guḍājyapūrite rājaṃs toyapūrṇaghaṭopari ||
pūrayitvā vastramālyair bhakṣyabhojyair anekadhā |
tatas taṃ brāhmaṇe dadyād vahnir me prīyatām iti ||
vaiśvānaralakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
yāvaj jīvakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
mṛto vahnipure yāti prāhedaṃ nārado muniḥ ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahārāja godhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ śubhām |
sthāpayet tāmrapātre tu lavaṇopari veśayet ||
jīrakaṃ kadukhaṇḍaṃ ca guḍaṃ pārśeṣu dāpayet |
raktavastrayugachannaṃ kuṅkumena vibhūṣitam ||
puṣpadhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā dvijātaye |
datvā yat phalam āpnoti pārtha tat kena varṇyate ||
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ |
gandharvā ṛṣayo yatra tatra te yānti mānavāḥ ||
svargād āhatya saṃsāre surūpaḥ subhago bhavet |
dātā bhoktā bahudhanaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ||
nārī vā tadguṇair yuktā bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ |
[852] vahnipurāṇe |
yo dadāti dvijebhyas tu tṛtīyāyām upānahau |
vaiśākhe śukle pakṣe tu sachatraṃ karaṇānvitam ||
na tasya mānaso dāho martyaloke ‘bhijāyate |
sarvavyādhivinirmuktaḥ śriyaṃ putrāṃś ca vindati |
kālād iha yad āyāti mama loke dvijottama ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ dvijottama |
yad dadāti naraśreṣṭha tad akṣayaṃ samaśnute |
viśeṣeṇa tu dānena bhakṣitānāṃ prakīrtitam ||
āha viṣṇuḥ |
vaiśākhe māsi tṛtīyāyām upoṣito akṣatair vāsudevam abhyarcya tāny eva ca hutvā sarvapāpebhyaḥ pūto bhavati yac cāsminn ahani prayacchati tad akṣayam āpnoti | iti |
bhaviṣatpurāṇe |
māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ guḍasya lavaṇasya ca |
dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ rājan strīṇāṃ tu puruṣasya ca ||
guḍena tuṣyate nūnaṃ lavaṇena caturmukhaḥ |
guḍapūjā tu dātavyā māsi bhādrapade tathā ||
tṛtīyāmāṃ pāyasena vāmadevasya prītaye |
vāridānaṃ praśastaṃ syān modakānāṃ tu bhārata ||
[853]        vaiśākhe māsi rājendra tṛtīyāyāṃ ca candanaiḥ |
vāriṇā tuṣyate vipro modakair bhīma eva hi ||
dīnaṃ tu candanasyeha padmayonāv asaṃśayaḥ |
yā tv eṣā kuruśārdūla vaiśākhe māsi vai tithiḥ ||
tṛtīyā sākṣayā loke gorvāṇair abhinanditā ||
supātrāya mahābāho bhūricandraṃ ca suvrat |
kaladhautaṃ tathānnaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ vāpi viśeṣataḥ ||
candraṃ suvarṇam, kaladhautaṃ rūpyam |
asyāṃ dattaṃ tv akṣayaṃ syāt teneyam akṣayā smṛtā |
yat kiṃcid dīyate dāma (dāyaṃ?) svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ||
tat sarvam akṣayaṃ yāti teneyam akṣayā smṛtā ||
yo ‘syāṃ dadāti karakān vāripātrasamanvitān |
sa yāti puruṣo vīra loke vai hemamālinaḥ ||
bhaviṣottare |
caturthyāṃ vāraṇaṃ haimaṃ palād ardhaṃ tu śobhanam |
kārayitvāṅkuśayutaṃ tailadroṇopari nyaset ||
vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā naivedyaṃ vinivedya ca |
tatas tu brāhmaṇe dadyād gaṇeśaḥ prīyatām iti ||
[854]        kāryārambheṣu sarveṣu tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate |
vāraṇaḥ saptajanmāni bhavanti madavihvalāḥ |
vāraṇendraṃ samārūḍhas trilokavijayī bhavet ||
atra ca – śrāvaṇe kārtike caitra ityāditithidānārambhe ‘bhihito māsaniyamaḥ sarveṣu bhaviṣyottaroktatithidāneṣu veditavyaḥ |
pañcamyāṃ pannagaṃ sarvaṃ svarṇenaikena kārayet |
kṣīrājyapātramadhyasthaṃ pūjya viprāya dāpayet ||
dvijaṃ saṃpūjya vāsobhiḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpya ca |
iha loke pare caiva dānam etat sukhāvaham ||
nāgopadravavidrāvi sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇam |
prāyaścittaṃ tathā proktaṃ nāgadaṣṭasya śambhunā ||
ṣaṣṭyāṃ śaktisamopetaṃ kumāraṃ śikhivāhanam |
kārayitvā yathāśakyā haimamālāvibhūṣitam ||
kumāralakṣaṇam abhihataṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ kāryaḥ śikhaṇḍakavibhūṣitaḥ |
raktāmbaradharaḥ kāryo mayūravaravāhanaḥ ||
kukkuṭaś ca tathā ghaṇṭā tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ |
patākā vaijayantī ca śaktiḥ kāryā ca vāmayoḥ || iti |
taṇḍuladroṇaśikhare vāsobhiḥ pūjya śaktitaḥ |
[855]        namaskṛtya tato dadyād brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
iha bhūtiṃ ca saṃprāpya pretya svarge mahīyate |
śūdro brāhmaṇatām eti brāhmaṇo brahmalokabhāk ||
saptamyāṃ bhāskaraṃ caivaṃ pūjya brāhmaṇam uttamam |
dadyād alaṃkṛtagrīvaṃ saparyāṇaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||
dānamantras tu aśvadāne draṣṭavyaḥ |
sūryalokam avāpnoti sūryeṇa saha modate |
gandharvas tuṣṭim āpnoti datte ‘śve samalaṃkṛte ||
aṣṭamyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śvetam avyaṅgāṅgaṃ dhuraṃdharam |
sitavastrayugachannaṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
dadyāt praṇamya viprāya prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā āgārāntam anuvrajet ||
dānenānena nṛpate śivaloko na durlabhaḥ |
vṛṣaskandheṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||
tasmād vṛṣabhadānena dātā bhavati bhārataḥ |
navamyāṃ kāñcanaṃ siṃhaṃ kārayitvā svaśaktitaḥ ||
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ nīlavastrāvaguṇṭhitam |
dadyād devīm anusmṛtya duṣṭadaityanivarhaṇīm ||
dvijātaye pradāyetthaṃ sarvān kāmān samaśnute |
kāntāravanadurgeṣu cauravyālākule pathi ||
hiṃsakāś ca na hiṃsanti dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
[856]        mṛto devīpuraṃ yāti pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
puṇyakṣayād ihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
daśamyāṃ nṛpaśārdūla datvāśāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ||
lavaṇe ca guḍe jīraniṣpāveṣu tile ‘py atha |
gavyatraye taṇḍuleṣu māṣāṇām uparisthitāḥ |
saṃpūjya vastrapuṣpādyair dvijāya pratipādayet ||
āśāḥ diśaḥ | tāsāṃ lakṣaṇam uktam āśādaśamīvraje | tad yathā | strīrūpāś cādhidevasya śastravāhanacihnitā iti pūrvādikrameṇa śaktyāder adhidevasya śastrādibhiś cihnitā ity arthaḥ | śaktyādīnām api śastravāhanāni brahmāṇḍadāne draṣṭavyāni |
āśāḥ svāśā sadā santu siddhyatāṃ me manorathaḥ |
bhavatīnāṃ prasādena sadā kalyāṇam astv iti ||
pūjādānamantraḥ |
anena vidhinā yas tu pumān strī vātha vā punaḥ |
nirvāpayati rājendra tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
iha lokenavāpyāgrāt (?) pretya svarge mahīyate |
saphalās tasya sarvāśā yāḥ kāścin manasi sthitāḥ ||
tataḥ svargād ihābhyetya kule mahati jāyate |
ekādaśyāṃ gurutmantaṃ kārayitvā hiraṇmayam ||
[857]        yathāśaktyā tāmrapātre ghṛtasyoparipūjitam |
pañcāgnyabhirate vipre gurave praviśeṣataḥ ||
datvā kiṃ bahunoktena viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
garutmato rūpam uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
tārkṣyomarakataprakhyaḥ kauśikākāranāsikaḥ |
caturbhujas tu kartavyo vṛttanetramukhas tathā ||
bhūsthajānūrdhvajānuś ca pakṣadvayavibhūṣitaḥ |
prabhāsaṃsthā tu sauvarṇakalāpena vivarjitaḥ ||
chatrante pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca karayos tasya kārayet |
karadvayaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tathā viracitāñjaliḥ ||
viṣṇuḥ puraś cet kāryo ‘sau dvibhujo racitāñjaliḥ || iti |
gāṃ vṛṣaṃ mahiṣīṃ hemasaptadhānyam ajāvikam |
vaḍavāṃ guḍarasān sarvān tathā bahuphalāṇy api ||
puṣpāṇi ca pavitrāṇi gandhāṃś coccāvacān vanān |
melayitvā yathā bhaktyā vastrair ācchādya tāṃ navaiḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaitāni brāhmaṇebhyo (?) nivedayet |
ekasya vā mahārāja yat phalaṃ tan niśāmaya ||
eṣāṃ dānamantrās taddānaprakaraṇeṣu gaveśaṇīyāḥ |
iha kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya bhuktvā (?) bhogān yathepsitān |
tato viṣṇupuraṃ yāti sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ ||
karmakṣayād ihāgatya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
yajñayājī dānapatir jīvec ca śaradāṃ śatam ||
[858]        śrāvaṇe kārttike caitre vaiśākhe phālgune tathā |
śuklapakṣe pradātavyam etac chreyovivardhanam (?) ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
dvādaśyāṃ caitraśuklasya citravastraprado naraḥ |
akṣayaṃ phalam āpnoti nāgalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
vaiśākhamāsi dvādaśyāṃ rukmadānaṃ tathaiva ca |
chatropanahayor dānaṃ jyeṣṭhe māsi mahībhujaḥ ||
svāstīrṇaṃ śayanaṃ datvā prīṇayed bhogaśāyinam |
āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ śvetadvīpe mahīyate ||
śrāvaṇe vastradānena viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
godaḥ prayāti golokaṃ māsi bhādrapade dvijāḥ ||
prīṇayed aśvaśirasam aśvaṃ datvā tathāśvine |
viṣṇulokam. avāpnoti kulam uddharate svakam ||
saromavastradānena kārttike divam āpnuyāt |
pradānaṃ lavaṇasyaiva mārgaśīrṣe mahāphalam ||
dhānyānāṃ ca tathā pauṣe dārūṇāṃ ca tathottare |
phālgune sarvagandhānāṃ dvādaśyāṃ dānataṃ sukhī |
evaṃ yathoktadānena datā svarge mahīyate ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
mārgaśīrṣo ‘tha vaiśākho dvau māsau mama vallabhau |
anayor māsayor yas tu dvādaśyāṃ niyatātmavān ||
[859]        dvādaśānāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ yo dadāti vasundhare |
ekaikasya tu gāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām ||
vastropānadyuge caiva karṇālaṃkāra eva ca |
ātapatraṃ pāduke ca aṅgulīyakam eva ca ||
vilipya copavītaṃ ca māṃ dhyāyan bhaktisaṃyutaḥ |
dadyād aśaktu pañcānāṃ trayāṇāṃca dvayor atha ||
aśaktau tv atha vaikasmin vedavedāṅgapārage |
akrodhane vratasthe ca āśriteṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe ‘tha vā devi vaiśākhe māsi yo naraḥ |
dadyād anena vidhinā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
manvantarāṇāṃ koṭyas tu daśa sapta ca pañca ca |
maccharīragataś cāste sarve mūrdhni liṅge śanaiśvaraḥ ||
sarve te saumyatāṃ yānti dvādaśyāṃ vidhināmunā ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāharo [-hāro?] dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam |
arcayed brāhmaṇamukhe śarkarāghṛtapāyasaiḥ ||
eṣā tithir vaiṣṇavī syād dvādaśī śuklapakṣake |
tasyām ārādhaye devaṃ prayatnena janārdanam ||
yat kiṃcid evam īśānam uddiśya brāḥmaṇe śucau |
dīyate viṣṇum evāpi tad anantaphalapradam ||
tasmād asyāṃ tithau deyaṃ bhṛṣṭam annaṃ śubhārthibhiḥ |
[860] viṣṇuḥ |
pauṣyāṃ ca samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣadvādaśyāṃ sopavāsas tilaiḥ snātas tilodakaṃ datvā tilair vāsudevam abhyarca tān eva hutvā bhuktvā ca sarvapāpebhyaḥ pūto bhavati māghyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇadvādaśīṃ saśravaṇāṃ prāpya vāsudevāgrato mahāvartidvyena dīpadānaṃ dadyāt dakṣiṇapārśve mahārajataraktena samagreṇa vāsasā tailatulām aṣṭādhikāṃ datvā vāmapārśve śvetena samagreṇa vāsasā ghṛtatulām aṣṭādhikāṃ dadyāt | etat kṛtvā yasmin rāṣṭre ‘bhijāyate yasmin deśe yasmin kule tatrojvalo bhavati |
dakṣiṇapārśva ityādinā mahāvartidvayam eva kathayati mahārajataraktena kausumbharaktena tulāpalaśatam | yamaḥ |
māghāndhakāradvādaśyām tilair hutvā hutāśanam |
tilān datvā ca viprebhyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ prītaye nṛpa |
gopradānena govindo yat pūrvaṃ kathitaṃ tava |
phalaṃ tat sarvam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
snāpayed brāhmaṇān prātas trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśa |
tān ācchādya navair vastrair gandhapuṣpair athārcayet ||
[861]        bhojayed api mṛṣṭānnaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vinivedayet |
yathāśaktyā hemakhaṇḍān dharmātmā prīyatām iti ||
dharmarājāya kālāya citraguptāya mṛtyave |
kṣayāya kṣayarūpāya antakāya yamāya ca ||
pretanāthāya raudrāya tathā vaivasvatāya ca |
mahiṣasthāya citrāya nāmānītthaṃ trayodaśa ||
uccārya śraddhayāyuktaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet |
yaḥ karoti mahārāja pūjām etāṃ manoramām ||
yamāya sa sukhaṃ martye sthitvā vyādhivivarjitaḥ |
yamārgagataṃ duḥkhaṃ paścān nāpnoty asau pumān ||
na paśyati pretapuraṃ pitṛlokaṃ ca gacchati |
puṇyakṣayād ihābhyetya sa sukhī nīrujo bhavet ||
tathā |
māheyaṃ saśubhaṃ kumbhaṃ caturdaśyāt payobhṛtam |
karṣaikena ca saṃyuktaṃ kuryāt sadvastrasaṃyutam ||
ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ vṛṣabheṇa samanvitam |
yo dadyāc chivabhaktāya brāḥmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
māheyaṃ mṛṇmayam | payobhṛtaṃ dugdhapūrṇam | karṣaikena saṃyuktaṃ karṣaparimāṇena hemna saṃyuktam,
dadyāt kumbhaṃ sahemānaṃ bhūtāyādugdhasaṃbhṛtam |
iti vātulokeḥ |
etad datvā naraśreṣṭha śivaloke mahīyate |
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ kramād etya mahītalam ||
[862]        ārogyadhanasaṃyuktaḥ kule mahati jāyate |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā yāvaj janmaśatatrayam ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
yas tu kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā devaṃ pinākinam |
ārādhayed dvijamukhe na tasyāsti punarbhavaḥ ||
kṛṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhārmikāya dvijātaye |
snātvābhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ ||
prīyatāṃ me mahādeva dadyād dravyaṃ svakīyakam |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ||
dvijamukhe ārādhayed iti, śivaprītaye dvijāṃs taddānena tarpayed ity arthaḥ | dravyam, gobhūhiraṇyādi | atha viṣṇudharmottare |
saṃprāpya caitramāsasya śuklapañcadaśīṃ (?) naraḥ |
citraṃ vastrayugaṃ dadyāt sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
brāhmaṇāṃś ca namaskṛtya saubhāgyaṃ tena vāpnuyāt |
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu brāhmaṇān pañca sapta vā ||
kṣaudrayuktais tilaiḥ kṛṣṇair vācayed yadi vetaraiḥ |
prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti yad vā manasi vartate ||
yāvajjīvakṛtāt pāpāt tat kṣaṇād eva mucyate ||
brāhmaṇān vācayed iti, svastivācanaṃ kārayed ity arthaḥ | [863] kṣaudrayuktaiḥ, madhusahitaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ, itarair iti śuklatilaiḥ brāhmaṇān prīṇayed it śeṣaḥ |
tasminn eva yathā kāle sakhuraṃ kṛṣṇamārgakam |
tilaiḥ pracchādya vāsobhiḥ sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtam ||
yo dadyāt tena dattā syān mahī savanakāñcanā ||
etadvidhivistaras tu kṛṣṇājinadāne draṣṭavyaḥ | āha yamaḥ |
vaiśākhyām eva vidhivad bhojayed brāhmaṇān daśa |
trirātram uṣitaḥ snātvā kṛśaraṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
gaurān vā yadi vā kṛṣṇāṃs tilān kṣaudreṇa saṃyutān |
datvā daśasu vipreṣu tān eva svasti vācayet ||
prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti pitṝn devāṃś ca tarpayet |
yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva muñcati ||
ayutāyutaṃ ca tiṣṭhet sa svargaloke mahīyate |
mām eva tu na paśyet tu na ca pāpena lipyate ||
jābālaḥ |
śṛtānnam udakumbhaṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
nirdiśya dharmarājāya godānaphalam āpnuyāt ||
śtānnaṃ pakvānnam |
suvarṇatilayuktais tu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca ca |
tarpayed udapātrais tu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
[864] mahābhārate |
vaiśākhyām paurṇamāsyāṃ tu tilān datvā dvijātiṣu |
tilā bhakṣayitavyās tu sadā tv ālabhanaṃ ca taiḥ ||
kāryaṃ satatam icchadbhiḥ śreyaḥ sarvātmanā gṛhe ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
sopavāsas tathā jyeṣṭhe pūrṇe tulasīlakṣaṇe |
upānahau tathā chatraṃ datvātyantaṃ sukhī bhavet ||
āṣāḍhyām annadānena prāpnoty annaṃ tathā bahu |
jaladhenupradānena śrāvaṇyāṃ svargam āpnuyāt ||
godānaṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vā paurṇamāsyāṃ mahāphalam |
āśvayujyāṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ dvijātaye ||
sasuvarṇaṃ tathā datvā dīptaujās tv iha jāyate |
kārttikyāṃ candravarṇābham anyavarṇam athāpi vā ||
ratnair gandhais tathā dhānyair bījair vastrais tathaiva ca |
kṛtvā coktam athokṣāṇaṃ datvā dīpaṃ samantataḥ ||
candrodaye naro datvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
kāntāre yamamārge tu tenāsau vrajate sukham |
prāpnoti putrapautrāṃś ca sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
mārgaśīrṣe tathā māsi pūrṇe śiśiradīdhitau |
mahārājataraktena vāsasā tu mahīyate ||
ācchādya kāṃsyapātre tu kṛtvā somaṃ samāhitaḥ |
[865] mahārājataraktena, kusumbharaktena | candralakṣaṇam, vāradāneṣu purastād vakṣyate |
lavaṇasya tu mukhyasya saṃpūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇamārgakaṃ |
mukhyasya lavanasyeti saindhavasyety arthaḥ |
datvā suvarṇanābhaṃ tu tasminn eva dvijātaye ||
saubhāgyarūpalāvaṇyayukto bhavati mānavaḥ |
gaurasarṣapakalkena pauṣe ucchādito naraḥ ||
ucchādita udvartita ity arthaḥ |
na cāvraṇena kumbhena so ‘bhiṣiktaś ca tatparam |
virūṣitas tathā snātaḥ sarvabījayutair jalaiḥ ||
virūṣita apanītasnehaḥ |
gandharatnaphalopetair ghṛtena tadanantaram |
sauvarṇaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā tat pradadyād dvijātaye ||
suvarṇamadhye ghṛtenābhiṣikta ity anvayaḥ | tad iti kumbhādikaṃ prakṛtadravyaṃ parāmṛṣyate |
ghṛtena snāpitaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaktyā saṃpūjayet tataḥ |
ghṛtaṃ ca juhuyād vahnau ghṛtaṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||
kartre vastrayugaṃ dadyāt sopavāsaḥ samāhitaḥ |
karmaṇānena dharmajñaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
mādhyāṃ kṛtvā tilaiḥ śrāddhaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
svāstīrṇaṃ śayanaṃ datvā phālgunyāṃ brāhmaṇāya ca ||
rūpadraviṇasaṃyuktāṃ bhāryāṃ pakṣavartīṃ tathā |
pakṣavatīṃ bahutarakñātiyuktām |
[866]        naraḥ prāpnoti dharmajñaḥ śriyaś caiva yathottamām ||
tathā |
nāry api bhartāraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
paurṇamāsīṣu caitrīṣu māsarkṣasahitāsu ca ||
eteṣām eva dānānāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhavet |
mahatpūrvāsu tāsv eva phalam akṣayam aśnute ||
māsanakṣatrasahitāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yadā guruvāras tadā tasyā mahatpūrvateti, māsarkṣasahitā jīve mahāpūrvā tu pūrṇameti viṣṇudharmottarokteḥ | āha viṣṇuḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe pañcadaśyāṃ śukle mṛgaśiroyuktāyāṃ ca cūrṇitalavaṇasya suvarṇanābhaprastham ekaṃ candrodaye brāhmaṇāya pratipādayet | anena karmaṇā rūpasaubhāgyavān abhijāyate | pauṣī cet puṣyayuktā syāt tasyāṃ gaurasarṣapakalkenocchāditaśarīro gavyaghṛtapūrṇakumbhenābhiṣiktaḥ sarvauṣadhibhiḥ sarvagandhaiḥ sarvabījaiś ca snātaḥ ghṛtena ca bhagavantaṃ vāsudevaṃ snāpayitvā puṣpagandhadhūpadīpanaivedyādibhiś cābhyarcya vaiṣṇavaiḥ śāktair bārhaspatyaiś ca mantraiḥ pāvakaṃ hutvā suvarṇena ghṛtena brāhmaṇaṃ svasti vācayed vasoyugaṃ kartre dadyād anena karmaṇa puṣyati | māghī maghayuktā cet syāt tasyāṃ tilaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pūto bhavet bhojanārthaṃ śrāddhe tilān datvā sarvajanapriyo bhavati | phālgunī phālgunībhir yutā cet tasyāṃ brāhmaṇāya susaṃskṛtaṃ svāstīrṇaśayanaṃ nivedya bhāryāṃ manojñāṃ pakṣavatīṃ draviṇavatīṃ cāpnoti | nāry api bhartāram | [867] caitrī citrāyutā cet tasyāṃ citravastradānena saubhāgyam āpnoti | vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ brāhmaṇasaptakaṃ kṣaudrayuktais tilaiḥ saṃtarpya dharmarājānaṃ prīṇayitvā pāpebhyaḥ pūto bhavati | jyaiṣṭhī jyeṣṭhāyutā cet tasyāṃ chatropānatpradānena nagarādhipatyam āpnoti | āṣāḍhyām āṣāḍhāyutayām annapānadānena tad evākṣayam āpnoti | śrāvaṇyāṃ śravaṇayutāyāṃ jaladhenum annavāsoyugānvitām datvā svargalokam avāpnoti | prauṣṭhapadyām tadyuktāyāṃ godānena sarvapāpavinirmukto bhavati | āśvayujyām aśvinīgate candramasi ghṛtapūrṇabhājanaṃ suvarṇayutaṃ viprāya datvā dīptāgnir bhavati | kārttikī cet kṛttikāyuktā syāt tasyāṃ sitam ukṣmāṇam anyavarṇaṃ vā śaśāṅkodaye sarvasasya ratnagandhopetaṃ dvīpamadhye brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | kāntārabhayaṃ na paśyati |
bhaviṣottare |
paurṇamāsyāṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ |
candraṃ rajataniṣpannaṃ palenaikena śobhanam |
pūjayed gandhakusumair naivedyaṃ vinivedya ca ||
candrarūpalakṣaṇaṃ tu, purastād dvāradānaprakaraṇe vilokanīyam |
dadyād viprāya satkṛtya vāso’laṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
mantreṇānena rājendra taṃ nibodha mayoditam ||
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta trailokyāṅgaṇadīpaka |
umāpatiśiroratnaṃ śivāyāś ca namo namaḥ ||
dānenānena nṛpatir bhrājate candravad divi |
apsarobhiḥ parivṛto yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam ||
[868] skandapurāṇe |
tilapātrāṇi yo dadyād dvijebhyaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ |
amāvāsyāṃ samāsādya kṛṣṇānāṃ susamāhitaḥ ||
sa pitṝṃs tarpayitvā tu akṣayaṃ narapuṅgavaḥ |
pitṛlokaṃ samāpnoti ciraṃ ca sukham edhate ||
kṣṇānāṃ tilānām iti śeṣaḥ | kūrmapurāṇe |
amāvāsyām anuprāpya brāhmaṇāya tapasvine |
yat kiṃcid devadeveśaṃ dadyād uddiśya śaṅkaram ||
prīyatām īśavaraḥ somo mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
soma umāsahitaḥ | bhaviṣyottare |

iti tithidānāni |
atha yugāditithidānam |
[866] bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
punar me brūhi deveśa tvadbhaktyā bhāvitātmanaḥ |
kathyamānam ihecchāmi śubhaṃ dharmam idaṃ mahat ||
yatrāṇur api datto hi japtaṃ vā sumahad bhavet ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
śṛṇu pāṇḍava te vacmi rahasyaṃ devanirmitam |
yan mayā kasyacin noktaṃ supriyasyāpi bhārata ||
vaiśākhamāsasya tu yā tṛtīyā
navamy asau kārttikaśuklapakṣe |
nabhasya māsasya ca kṛṣṇapakṣe
trayodaśī pañcadaśī ca māghe ||
vaiśākhatṛtīyā, yā śuklapakṣajā | māghapañcadaśī, kṛṣṇapakṣajety avadheyam |
vaiśākhasy tṛtīyā yā samā kṛtayugena tu |
tretāyugena ca samā navamī kārttike tu yā ||
trayodaśī nabhasye tu dvāpareṇa samā matā |
māghe pañcadaśī rājan kalikālādir ucyate ||
etāś catasro rājendra yugānāṃ prabhavāḥ smṛtāḥ |
yugādayas tu kathyante tenaitāḥ sarvasūribhiḥ ||
upavāsas tapo dānaṃ japahomakriyādiṣu |
yadāsu kriyate kiṃcit sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīsametaṃ jagatgurum |
[870]        nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayethāḥ puṣpagandhādilepanaiḥ ||
vastrālaṃkārasaṃbhārair naivedyair vividhais tathā ||
śrīsametaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇam | tadrūpaṃ tu devatādānaprakaraṇasthita-lakṣmīnārāyaṇadāne draṣṭavyam |
tatas tasyāgrato dhenur lavaṇasyāḍhakena tu |
kāryā kurukulaśreṣṭha caturbhāgena vatsakaḥ ||
avicarmopari sthāpya kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ |
śāstroktakramayogena brāhmaṇāya pradāpayet ||
śrīdharaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmān śrīśaḥ saṃprīyatām iti |
anena vidhinā datvā dhenuṃ viprāya bhārata ||
gosahasradaśaguṇaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ |
tathaiva kārttike māsi navamyāṃ naktabhuk naraḥ ||
snātvā nadītaḍāgeṣu devakhāteṣu vā punaḥ |
umāsahāyaṃ varadannīlakaṇṭham athārcayet ||
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyair anindyaṃ śaṅkaraṃ śivam |
umāmaheśvaralakṣaṇam uktaṃ devatādānaprakaraṇasthitomāmaheśvaradāne |
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyāt purāṇoktavidhānataḥ |
aṣṭamūrtir nīlakaṇṭhaḥ prīyatām iti kīrtayet ||
yad atra prāpyate puṇyaṃ pārtha tat kena varṇyate |
datvā gilamayīṃ dhenuṃ śivālokam avāpnuyāt ||
trayodaśī nabhasye yā kṛṣṇaṃ tasyāṃ samarcayet ||
kṛṣṇarūpam uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
kṛṣṇaś cakradharaḥ kāryo nīlotpaladaladyutiḥ |
[871]        dvibāhuḥ saumyavadanaḥ kuṇḍalābhyām alaṃkṛtaḥ || iti |
pitṛbhyo ‘nnapradānena madhunā ca tathaiva ca |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā vedavedāṅgapāragān ||
pitṝn uddiśya dātavyā savatsā kāṃdyadohanā |
pratyakṣā gaur mahārāja taruṇī supayasvinī ||
pitāpitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
prīyatāṃ gopradānena iti datvā visarjayet ||
kṛtenānena rājendra yat puṇyaṃ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ |
tat kena gaṇituṃ yāti varṣakoṭiśatair api ||
putrān pautrān prapautrāṃś ca dhanaṃ sumahad īpsitam |
iha prāpnoti puruṣaḥ paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim ||
pañcadaśyāṃ tu māghasya pūjayitvā pitāmaham |
gāyatryā sahitaṃdevaṃ devaṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitam ||
brahmaṇo vedāṅgānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne, gāyatrīlakṣaṇaṃ tu padmapurāṇoktabrahmāṇḍadāne, gāyatrī vedamūrtis tu mahābhūtaghaṭadāne |
navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ phalair nānāvidhair yutām |
sahiraṇyāṃ savatsāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
kīrtayet prīyatām atra padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ |
yat svarge yac ca pātāle yan martye kiṃ ca durlabham ||
tad avāpnoty asaṃdigdhaṃ (?) padmayoneḥ prasādataḥ |
yāni cānyāni dānāni dattāni subahūny api ||
yugādiṣu mahārāja akṣayāni bhavanti hi |
[872]        alpam alpaṃ hi yat kiṃcit pradadyān nirdhano ‘pi san ||
akṣayaṃ ca bhavet sarvaṃ yugādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ |
vittānusāre svaṃ jñātvā vibhavaṃ pārthivo ‘pi san ||
anusāreṇa vittasya asādhyena samādhinā |
bhūhiraṇyaṃ gṛhaṃ vāsaḥ śayanāny āsanāni ca |
chatropanadyugāni syuḥ pradeyāni dvijātiṣu ||
evaṃ datvā yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijān api |
paścād bhuñjīta sumahat vāgyataḥ svajanaiḥ samam ||
yat kiṃcin mānasaṃ pāpaṃ vācikaṃ kāyikaṃ tathā |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti yugāditithipūjanāt ||
pragīyamāno gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
ramate vākṣayaṃ kālaṃ svargaloke na saṃśayaḥ ||
yad dīyate kim api koṭiguṇaṃ tad āhuḥ
snānaṃ japohavanam akṣayam eva sarvaṃ |
syād akṣayāsu yugapūrvatithīṣu rājan
vyāsādayo munivarāḥ samudāharanti ||
iti yugādidānavidhiḥ |
atha vāradānāni | tatra skandapurāṇe |
ādityādiṣu vāreṣu sahiraṇyāḥ sadaiva tu |
yaḥ prayacchati tanmūrtīs tasya tuṣyanti vai grahāḥ ||
[873]        dadyād ādityam āditye somaṃ some kujaṃ kuje |
evaṃ budhādīn mande tu rāhuketuśanaiśvarān ||
brahmapurāṇe |
grahān svarṇamayān kṛtvā yo viprebhyaḥ prayacchati |
taddineṣu yathāśaktyā sarvān kāmān sa vindati ||
teṣāṃ lakṣaṇam uktaṃ brahmāṇḍadāne |
padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ |
saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuś ca dvibhujaḥ syāt sadā raviḥ ||
śvetaḥ śvetāmbaradharo daśāśvaḥ śvetabhūṣaṇaḥ |
gadāpāṇir dvibāhuś ca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī ||
raktamālyāmbaradharaḥ śaktiśūlagadādharaḥ |
caturbhujo meṣagamo varadaḥ syād dharāsutaḥ ||
pītamālyāmbaradharaḥ karṇikāradaladyutiḥ |
khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ ||
devadaityagurus tadvat pītaśvetau caturbhujau |
daṇḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalū ||
indranīladyutiḥ śūlī varado gṛdhravāhanaḥ |
vāṇavāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyo ‘rkasutaḥ sadā ||
karālavadanaḥ khaḍgacarmaśūlī varapradaḥ |
[874]        nīlaḥ siṃhāsanasthaś ca rāhur atra praśasyate ||
dhūmrā dvibāhavaḥ sarve gadino vikṛtānanāḥ |
gṛdhrāsanagatā nityaṃ ketavaḥ syur varapradāḥ ||
sarve kirīṭinaḥ kāryā grahā lokahitāvahāḥ |
svāṅgulenocchritāḥ sarve śatam aṣṭottaraṃ sadā ||
aṣṭāv ādityādayaḥ śataṃ ketava ity ubhaye ‘py aṣṭottaraśatam | ekottaraśataṃ ketava eko vā ketur iti kecit | tatra pakṣadvaye navottaraśatena devatāpratimā vidheyāḥ | svāṅgulena yajamānāṅgulena | eteṣāṃ dānamantrā grahadāne draṣṭavyāḥ prahmaproteḥ (?) | ādityavāre suvarṇamayam ādityaṃ kṛtvā raktavastraṃ padmarāgaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya pratipādayet | kapilāṃ vā sūryaloke sarvān kāmān avāpnoti niṣkāmo mokṣam | somadine rājataṃ somaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vā, maṅgaladine sauvarṇaṃ maṅgalaṃ raktaṃ duraṃdharaṃ vā, budhe sauvarṇaṃ budhaṃ jñānprāptaye dadyāt, gurudine sauvarṇaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ pītaṃ vā vastraṃ pradadyāt, śukradine rājataṃ śukraṃ śvetaṃ hayaṃ vā tatprītaye dadyāt, śanaiśvare sauvarṇaṃ śanaiśvaram indranīlayutaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgāṃ vā tatprītaye dadyāt, tasminn eva dine rāhum āyasena samanvitaṃ dadyāt, ketūn chāgasamanviān tatprītaye dadyāt, atra rāhuketavo ‘pi sauvarṇā eva, evaṃ viśeṣadānena sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
athāha yamaḥ |
ādityavāre viprāya hiraṇyaṃ ca sadaiva tu |
yaḥ prayacchati pūrvaṃ hi tasya tuṣyati vai yamaḥ ||
[875] viṣṇudharmottare |
lavaṇājyaguḍopetam apūpaṃ sūryavāsare |
sa hiraṇyaṃ naro datvā na rogair abhibhūyate ||
evaṃvidhaṃ cendudine datvā saubhāgyam āpnuyāt |
kāṣṭhadānaṃ somadine śatrunāśam avāpnuyāt ||
budhaiḥ krīḍanakānāṃ ca dānaṃ bāleṣu śasyate |
jīvāhni vastradānena parāṃ tuṣṭiṃ samaśnute ||
sarvaṃ varaṃ tat prāpnoti śukre datvā ratistriyaḥ |
abhyaṅgaṃ sauradivase datvā jīvitam āpnuyāt ||
iti vāradānāni |
atha nakṣatradānāni | tatra mahābhārate |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
śruto me bhavato vākyād annadānasya yo vidhiḥ |
nakṣarayogasyedānīṃ dānakalpaṃ bravīhi me ||
bhīṣma uvāca |
atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam |
devakyāś caiva saṃvādaṃ devarṣer nāradasya ca ||
[876]        dvārakāyām anuprāptaṃ nāradaṃ devadarśanam |
papracchemaṃ vada praśnaṃ devakī dharmadārśinī ||
tasyāḥ saṃpṛcchamānāyā devarṣir nāradas tathā |
ācaṣṭa vidhivat sarvaṃ yat tac chṛṇu viśāṃpate ||
nārada uvāca |
kṛttikāsu mahābhāge pāyasena sasarpiṣā |
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇān sādhūn lokān prāpnoty anuttamān ||
rohiṇyāṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha māṣair ratnena sarpiṣā |
payonupānad dātavyam ānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye ||
dogdhrīṃ savatsāṃ tu naro nakṣatre somadaivate |
datvādityavimānasthāh svargaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam ||
somadaivatanakṣatraṃ mṛgaśīrṣam |
ārdrāyāṃ kṛśaraṃ datvā tilamiśraṃ samāhitaḥ |
naras tarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃś ca parvatān ||
pūpaṃ punarvasau datvā ghṛtapūrṇaṃ supācitam |
yaśasvī rūpasaṃpanno bahvanne jāyate kule ||
puṣpe tu kāñcanaṃ datvā kṛtaṃ cākṛtam eva ca |
anālokeṣu lokeṣu somavat sa virājate ||
[877] kṛtaṃ ghaṭitam | akṛtam aghaṭitam |
aśleṣāsu tathā rūpyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vā prayacchati |
sa sarvabhayanirmuktaḥ śāstravān abhijāyate ||
maghāsu tilapūrṇāni vardhamānāni mānavaḥ |
pradāya paśumāṃś caiva putravāṃś ca prajāyate ||
phālgunīpūrvasamaye brāhmaṇānām upoṣitaḥ |
bhakṣyān phāṇitasaṃyuktān datvā saubhāgyam ṛcchati ||
ghṛtakṣīrasamāyuktaṃ vidhivat ṣaṣṭikaudanam |
uttarāviṣaye datvā svargaloke mahīyate ||
yad vā pradīyate dānam uttarāviṣaye naraiḥ |
sadā phalam anantaṃ ca bhavatīha viniścayaḥ ||
phālgunīpūrvasamaye pūrvāphalgunīsamaya ity arthaḥ | phānitaṃ guḍavikāraḥ | uttarāviṣaye uttarāphālgunīsamaya ity arthaḥ |
haste hastirathaṃ datvā caturyuktam upoṣitaḥ |
naras tarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃś ca parvatāt ||
caturyuktaṃ caturbhir hastibhir yuktam |
citrāyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ datvā puṇyāṅgaṃ gāṃ ca bhārata |
caraty apsarasāṃ loke ramate nandate vane ||
puṇyāṅgaṃ gām iti śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitaśarīraṃ dhenum ity arthaḥ |
[878]        svātīṣv atha dhanaṃ datvā yad iṣṭatamam ātmanaḥ |
prāpnoti lokān suśubhān iha caiva mahad yaśaḥ ||
viśākhāyām anaḍvāhaṃ dhenuṃ datvātha dugdhadām |
saprāsaṅgaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃyutam ||
prāsaṅgo yugāntarakāṣṭham |
pitṝn devāṃś ca prīṇāti pretya cānantyam aśnute |
na da durgāṇy vāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
datvā yathoktaṃ viprebhyo vṛttim iṣṭāṃ sa vindati |
nārakīyāṃś ca kleśān nāpnotīti viniścayaḥ ||
anurādhāsu prāvāravastrottmaram upoṣitaḥ |
datvā yugaśataṃ vāpi naraḥ svarge mahīyate ||
prāvāraḥ pravārapaṭaḥ, vastrottaraṃ paridhānavastrādikam |
kālaśākaṃ tu viprebhyo datvā mantraiḥ samūlakam |
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mṛtyum utsādya gatim iṣṭāṃ ca gacchati ||
mūle mūlaphalaṃ datvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ |
svapitṝn prīṇayed deva gatim iṣṭāṃ ca gacchati ||
atha pūrvāsu ṣāḍhāsu dadhipātrāṇy upoṣitaḥ |
kulavṛttopasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage ||
pradāya jāyate śreṣṭhakule bahuguṇākule |
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ paśumān dhanavāṃs tathā ||
udamanthaṃ sa sarpiṣkaṃ prabhūtamadhuphāṇitam |
datvottarāsv āṣāḍhāsu sarvalokān avāpnuyāt ||
[879] udamanthaḥ udakamiśrāḥ saktavaḥ, phāṇitaṃ dugdhakhaṇḍavikāraḥ |
dugdhaṃ tv abhijito yoge datvā madhughṛtaplutam |
dharmaniṣṭho manīṣibhyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
ayam arthaḥ | uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatracaturthapādaḥ, śravaṇasyādyaghaṭikācatuṣṭayam abhijidyogaḥ |
śravaṇe kambalaṃ datvā vastrāntaritam eva ca |
śvetena yāti yānena svargalokān asaṃvṛtān ||
goprayuktaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu yānaṃ datvā samāhitaḥ |
vastram asmin navaṃ datvā pretya rājyaṃ prapadyate ||
gandhaṃ śatabhiṣāyoge datvā sāgurucandanam |
prāpnoty apsarasāṃ lokaṃ pretya gandhāṃś ca śāśvatān ||
pūrvabhādrapadāyoge rājamāṣān pradāya vai |
sarvabhakṣyaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet ||
aurabhram uttarāyoge yas tu māṃsaṃ prayacchati |
pitṝn prīṇāti sakalān pretyānantyaṃ samaśnute ||
urabhro meṣas tasya māṃsam aurabhram |
kāṃsyopadohanīṃ denuṃ revatyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
sa pretya kāmān ādāya dātāram upatiṣṭhati ||
ratham aśvasamāyuktaṃ datvāśvinyāṃ narottamaḥ |
hastyaśvarathasaṃpanne varcasvān jāyate kule ||
[880]        bharaṇīṣu dvijātibhyas tiladhenuṃ pradāya vai |
gāḥ prasūtāś ca prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśas tathā ||
bhīṣma uvāca |
ity eṣa lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ prokto nakṣatrayogataḥ |
devakyā nāradeneha stuṣābhyaḥ sābravīd idam ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
kṛttikāsu suvarṇasya dānaṃ bahuphalaṃ smṛtam |
raktavastrasya rohiṇyāṃ saumyebhelavaṇasya (?) ca ||
kṛśarasya tathārdrāyām āditye rajatasya ca |
ghṛtasya tu tathā puṣye gandhānām atha sarpabhe ||
tilānāṃ ca tathā paitrye priyagor bhagadaivate |
āryarkṣye cājyapūpānāṃ sāvitre pāyasasya tu ||
citrāyāṃ citravastrāṇāṃ saktūnāṃ vāyudaivate |
aindre ‘gnau caiva lohānāṃ maitre mālyaphalasya ca ||
chatrasya ca tathā śākre mūle mūlaphalasya ca |
hemnaś ca madhuyuktasya dānam āpye mahāphalam ||
viśveśvare ‘nnapānasya śravaṇe vasanasya ca |
dhānyasya vāsave viprā vāruṇe cauṣadhasy aca ||
āje purāṇabījānāṃ sasyānāṃ tadanantare |
gorasānāṃ tathā pauṣṇe snānānām atha vāśvine ||
tilānāṃ ca sadā dānaṃ bharaṇīṣu mahāphalam |
[881] āha viṣṇuḥ |
pratimāsaṃ revatīyute candramasi madhughṛtayutaṃ paramānnaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā revatīṃ prīṇayitvā rūpabhāg bhavati |
yamaḥ |
māsi māsi ca revatyāṃ brāhmaṇān ghṛtapāyasaṃ |
sadakṣiṇaṃ bhojayitvā rūpabhāg abhijāyate ||
iti nakṣatradānāni |
atha yogadānāni | viṣṇudharmottare |
viṣkumbhādiṣu yogeṣu dānadharmaṃ mahāphalam |
tam ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvam ṛṣisattamāḥ ||
viṣkumbhe sarvadhānyānāṃ dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanam |
prītau tathānnapānānām āuṣmati ghṛtasya ca ||
kuṅkumasya ca saubhāgye yavadānaṃ ca śobhane |
atigaṇḍe ca vastrāṇāṃ pāyasasya sukarmaṇi ||
ghṛtau rajatadānaṃ ca śūle mūlādidānakam |
gaṇḍe maṇḍanadānaṃ ca vṛddhau godānam iṣyate ||
dhruve ca pañcaratnānāṃ vyāghāte phāṇitasya ca |
[882]        harṣaṇe gandhadānaṃ syātd vajre dadyān maṇīn api ||
siddhau siddhārthakā deyā vyatīpāte tu kāñcanam |
varīyasi tilān dadyād vastrāṇi parighe tathā ||
jalakumbhāḥ śive deyāḥ siddhe siddhānnam iṣyate |
sādhye ‘laṃkaraṇāṃ ca chatradānaṃ śubhe śubham ||
śukre copānahor dānaṃ śastraṃ brahmaṇi sarpiṣaḥ |
aindre ca dīpakān dadyād vaighṛtau kanakaṃ hitam ||
dānāny eteṣu yogeṣu yathāśaktyā dvijottamāḥ |
bhaktiyukto dvije datvā loke vasati cakriṇaḥ ||
iti yogadānāni |
atha karaṇadānāni | viṣṇudharmottare |
karuṇeṣu pravakṣyāmi dānāni dvijapuṅgavāḥ |
yave pāyasadānaṃ syāt śaktudānaṃ ca bālave ||
kaulave gorasān dadyāt tilāṃs taitilanāmani |
garābhidhāne lavaṇaṃ vaṇije deyam ambaram ||
viṣṭau ca ṣaṣṭikānnāni śakunau sarpir eva ca |
madhudānaṃ catuṣpāde śastaṃ nāge ca vāsasām ||
dānaṃ priyaṅgoḥ kiṃtughne śreṣṭham uktaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
[883]
iti karaṇadānāni |
atha saṃkrāntidānāni | tatra viśvāmitraḥ |
meṣasaṃkramaṇe bhānor meṣadānaṃ mahāphalam |
vṛṣasaṃkramaṇe dānaṃ gavāṃ proktaṃ tathaiva ca ||
vastrānnapānadānāni mithune vihitāni ca |
ghṛtadhenupradānaṃ ca karkaṭe pariśasyate ||
sasuvarṇaṃ chatradānaṃ siṃhe ‘pi vihitaṃ sadā |
kanyāpraveśe vastrāṇāṃ surabhīṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||
tulāpraveśe dhānyānāṃ bījānām eva cottamam |
kīṭapraveśe vastrāṇāṃ veśmanāṃ dānam eva ca ||
atra kīṭo vṛścikaḥ |
dhanuḥpraveśe vastrāṇāṃ yānānāṃ ca mahāphalam |
jhaṣapraveśe dārūṇāṃ dānam agnes tathaiva ca ||
jhaṣo makaraḥ |
kumbhapraveśe dānaṃ tu gavām ambutṛṇasya tu |
mīnapraveśe snānānāṃ mālyānām api cottamam ||
dānāny athaitāni mayā dvijendrāḥ
proktāni kāle tu naraḥ pradatvā |
[884]        prāpnoti kāmān manasas tv abhīṣṭāṃs
tasmāt praśaṃsanti hi kāladānam ||
skandapurāṇe |
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ rājan dadyād yaś cottarāyaṇe |
sarvakāmān avāpnoti vindate paramaṃ sukham ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
uttare tv ayane viprā vastradānaṃ mahāphalam |
tilapūrṇam anaḍvāhaṃ datvā rogaiḥ pramucyate ||
iti saṃkrāntidānāni |
atha māsadānāni | viṣṇudharmottare |
tilapradānaṃ māghe tu yāmyaṃ lokaṃ na gacchati |
priyaṅguṃ phālgune datvā priyo bhavati bhūtale ||
caitre citrāṇi vastrāṇi datvā saumbhāgyam aśnute |
apūpānāṃ pradānena vaiśākhe svargam aśnute ||
chatradānāt tathā jyeṣṭhe sarvān kāmān samaśnute |
śrāvaṇe vastradānasya kīrtitaṃ sumahat phalam ||
prauṣṭhapade tathā māsi pradānāt phāṇitasya ca |
[885]        aśvine ghṛtadānena rūpavān abhijāyate ||
kārtike dīpadānena sarvam aujvalyam āpnuyāt |
lavaṇaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu datvā saubhāgyam aśnute ||
pauṣe kanakadānena parāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca |
puṣpāṇāṃ ca site pakṣe dānaṃ lakṣmīkaraṃ smṛtam |
phalānāṃ ca tathā dānaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe mahāphalam ||
vāmanapurāṇe |
māghe māsi tilāḥ śastās tiladhenoś ca dānava |
idhmendhanādayaś cānye mādhavaprīṇanāya tu ||
phalgune vrīhayo gāvo vastraṃ kṛṣṇājinānvitam |
govindaprīṇanārthāya dātavyaṃ bharatarṣabha ||
caitre citrāṇi vastrāṇi śayanāny āsanāni ca |
viṣṇoḥ prītyartham etāni devyāni brāhmaṇeṣv atha ||
gandhāś ca dvijamukhyebhyo madhusūdanatuṣṭaye |
udakumbhas tu dhenuś ca tālavṛntaṃ sacandanam |
trivikramasya prītyarthaṃ dātavyaṃ sādhubhiḥ sadā ||
tālavntaṃ vyajanam |
upānadyugalaṃ chatraṃ lavaṇāmalakāni ca |
āṣāḍhe vāmanaprītyai dātavyāni tu bhaktitaḥ ||
[886]        ghṛtaṃ ca kṣīraumbhāś ca ghṛtadhenuḥ phalāni ca |
śrāvaṇe śrīdharaprītyai dātavyāni vipaścite ||
māsi bhādrapade dadyāt pāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣī |
hṛṣīkeśaprīṇanarthaṃ lavaṇaṃ saguḍodanam ||
tilās turaṅgavṛṣabhaṃ dadhitāmrāyasādikam |
prītyarthaṃ padmanābhasya deyam āśvayuje naraiḥ ||
rajataṃ kanakaṃ dīpān maṇimuktāphalādikam |
dāmodarasya prītyarthaṃ pradadyāt kārtike naraḥ ||
kharoṣṭrāśvatarān nāgān śūkarāśvam ajāvikam |
dātavyaṃ keśavaprītyai māsi mārgaśire naraiḥ ||
prāsādanagarādīni gṛhaprāvaraṇāni ca |
nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pauṣe deyāni yatnataḥ ||
dāsīdāsam alaṃkāraś cānnaṃ ṣaḍrasasaṃyutam |
puruṣottamasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pradeyaṃ sārvakālikam ||
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcid yac cāpy asti śubhaṃ gṛhe |
tat tad dhi deyaṃ prītyarthaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
devīpurāṇe |
mārge rasottamaṃ dadyād ghṛtaṃ pauṣe mahāphalam |
rasottamaṃ lavaṇam |
tilān māghe muniśreṣṭha saptadhānyāni phālgune ||
vicitrāṇi ca vastrāṇi caitre dadyād dvijottame |
[887]        vaiśākhe dvija godhūmā jyaiṣṭhe toyabhṛtaṃ ghaṭam ||
āṣāḍhe candanaṃ deyaṃ sakarpūraṃ mahāphalam |
navanītaṃ nabhomāsi chatraṃ prauṣṭhapade matam ||
guḍaśarkaravarṇāḍhyān laḍḍukān āśvine mune |
dīpadānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ kārtike yaḥ prayacchati ||
sarvakāmān avāpnoti krameṇedam udāhṛtam |
vratānte gāṃ śubhāṃ dadyāt savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanīm ||
sayugāṃ sasrajaṃ vatsaṃ dāpayed vidhināmunā |
devīṃ viriñcitaṃ sūryaṃ viṣṇuṃ vātha yathāvidhi ||
svabhāvaśuddho vidhivat pūjayitvā dvijottamam |
dātavyā vītarāge tu kāmakrodhavivarjite ||
ayācake sadācāre vinīte niyamānvite |
godānāl labhate kāmān goloke ca manoramān ||
vratānte māsadānākhye samāptau niyame tathā |
āṣāḍhe toyadhenuṃ ca ghṛtaṃ bhādrapade tathā ||
māghe tu tiladhenuḥ syād yo datvā labhate hitam |
yathā |
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ mādhe dadyād yad tūttarāyaṇe ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti jyeṣṭhe tilamayīṃ tathā |
pauṣe ghṛtamayīṃ dadyāc chreṣṭāhe vidhinā mune ||
ādityapurāṇe |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tilān dadyāt paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
aśvamedhasya yat puṇyaṃ tat prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||
[888] āha yamaḥ |
ghṛtam āśvayuje māsi nityaṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
prīṇayitvāśvinau devau rūpabhāg abhijāyate ||
āha viṣṇuḥ |
āśvinaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ viprebhyaḥ pratyahaṃ ghṛtam |
pradāyāśvinau prīṇayitvā rūpabhāg bhavati | tasminn eva māsi pratyahaṃ gorasair brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ārogyabhāg bhavati | tathā māghe māsi agniṃ pratyahaṃ tilair hutvā ghṛtakulmāṣaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā dīptāgnir bhavati |
āha pracetāḥ |
tilapradaḥ prajām iṣṭāṃ puruṣaḥ khalu vindati |
māghe māsi viśeṣeṇa tattamiśre viśeṣataḥ ||
mahābhārate |
māghe māsi tilān yas tu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
sarvasattvasamākīrṇaṃ narakaṃ na sa paśyati ||
iti māsadānavidhiḥ |
atha ṛtudānāni | viṣṇudharmottare |
[889]        snānānulepanādīnāṃ vasante dānam iṣyate |
dānakānāṃ tathā grīṣme chatrāṇāṃ tadanantare ||
devīpurāṇe |
yaḥ punar vidhinā vatsa devīm uddiśya prāvṛṣi |
vipreṣu viprakanyāsu tilādīn saṃprayacchati ||
tasyāḥ sā tuṣyate devī acireṇa tu vidyayā ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
śarady annasya dharmajñā vastrāṇām api haimane |
bahirdānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā sūryasyodayanaṃ prati ||
bahirdānaṃ śītāpanuttyarthaṃ vahnidānam |
śiśire satataṃ vahniṃ tarpayitvā tathā tilaiḥ |
kulmāṣaṃ saghṛtaṃ datvā yathā śaktyā dvijātiṣu ||
kāyāgnidīptiprākāśyaṃ śatrunāśaṃ ca vindati |
śaktuṃ sitākhaṇḍayutaṃ trapuṣāvārakānvitam ||
lavaṇājyayutaṃ prāvṛṣi snātaḥ satataṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ |
jalakumboparikṛtaṃ hy akṣayaṃ phalam aśnute ||
yamaḥ |
kṛśaraṃ bhojayitvā tu svaśaktyā śiśire dvijān |
dīptāgnitvaṃ samāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
[890]
iti ṛtudānāni |
atha saṃvatsaradānāni | viṣṇudharmottare |
saṃvatsare tu dātṝṇāṃ tiladānaṃ mahāpalam |
paripūrve tathā dānaṃ yavānāṃ dvijasattamaḥ ||
paripūrva iti parivatsara ity arthaḥ |
idāpūrve ca vastrāṇāṃ dānyānāṃ cānupūrvakam |
itpūrve rajatasyāpi dānaṃ proktaṃ mahāphalam ||
idāpūrva ityādi idā vatsaraḥ, anuvatsaraḥ, idvatsara iti | saṃvatsarādayaś ca jyotiḥśāstre prasiddhāḥ |
iti saṃvatsaradānāni |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍe kālaviśeṣa, dānaprakaraṇam ||
[891]
trayodaśa adhyāyaḥ
atha anantaphaladānāni |
yenārāmābhirāmāḥ parisaralaharīmagnanāgās taḍāgāḥ
prāsādāḥ sādayntī ravirathaturagasvairasaṃcāralīlām |
kūpā bhūpālasenāśatasatatapayaḥkarmanirmāṇadakṣā
nakṣatrāṇi spṛśantyo dvijavasatihitā nirmitā harmyamālāḥ ||
yena śravaḥsaraṇi saṃcaraṇocitāni
dānāni tāny api dṛśoratithau kṛtāni |
hemādrir adbhutavipaścid apaścimo ‘yaṃ
saṃpraty anantaphaladānasamūham āha ||
kāni punas tānīty apekṣāyāṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
saṃpādayec ca niyamād ārogyaṃ bhogasādhanam |
abhayaṃ pānthaśuśrūṣām annodakamahīruhān |
anantaphaladāny āhur dānāny etāni sūrayaḥ ||
atha ārogyadānam | tatrārogyadānaṃ tāvad ucyate | āha viśvāmitraḥ |
[892]        ārogyadānāt paramaṃ na dānaṃ vidyate kvacit |
ato deyaṃ rujārtānām ārogyaṃ bhāgyavṛddhaye ||
auṣadhaṃ pathyam āhāraṃ tailābhyaṅgapratiśrayam |
yaḥ prayacchati rogibhyaḥ sa bhaved vyādhivarjitaḥ ||
saṃvartaḥ |
auṣadhaṃ sneham āhāraṃ rogiṇāṃ rogaśāṇtaye |
dadāno rogarahitaḥ sukhī dīrghāyur eva ca ||
agasthyaḥ |
annauṣadhapradātāraḥ sukhaṃ yānti nirāmayaḥ ||
saurapurāṇe |
rogiṇo rogaśāṇtyartham auṣadhaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
rogahīnaḥ sa dīrghāyuḥ sukhī bhavati sarvadā ||
nandipurāṇe |
añjanaṃ yo naro dadyād akṣnor vyādhinivṛttaye |
viprāya sa pumān yāti sūryalokaṃ mahāmatiḥ |
ārogyanayano divyaḥ subhago jāyate naraḥ ||
[893]        dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇām ārogyaṃ sādhanair yutaḥ |
atas tv ārogyadānena naro bhavati sarvadā ||
ārogyaśālāṃ kurute mahauṣadhaparicchadām |
vidagdhavaidyasaṃyuktāṃ bhṛtyāvasathasaṃyutām ||
vaidyas tu śāstravit prājño dṛṣṭauṣadhaparākramaḥ |
auṣadhīmūlavarṇajñaḥ samuddharaṇakālavit ||
rasavīryavipākajñaḥ śālimāṃsauṣadhīmaṇe |
yogavid dehinām dehaṃ yo dhiyā praviśed budhaḥ ||
dhātupathyamayajñaś ca nidānavid atandritaḥ |
vyādhīnāṃ pūrvaliṅgajñas taduttaravidhānavit ||
deśakālavidhānajñaś cikitsāśāstravit tathā |
aṣṭāṅgāyurvedavettā muṣṭiyogavidhānavit ||
aṣṭāv aṅgāni āyuvedasya | yathā śalyaṃ śālākyaṃ kāyacikitsā bhūtavidyā kaumārabhṛtyam agadatantraṃ rasāyaṇatantraṃ vājīkaraṇatantram iti suśrutoktāni |
evaṃvidhaḥ śubho vaidyo bhaved yatrābhiyojitaḥ |
ārogyaśālām evaṃ tu kuryād yodhadharmasaṃśrayaḥ ||
sa pumān dhārmiko loke sa kṛtārthaḥ sa buddhimān |
samyag ārogyaśālāyām auṣadhaiḥ snehpācanaiḥ ||
vyādhinaṃ virujī kṛtya apy ekaṃ karuṇāyutaḥ |
prayāti brahmasadanaṃ kulasaptakasaṃyutaḥ ||
[884]        āḍhyo vittānusāreṇa daridraḥ phalabhāg bhavet |
daridrasya kutaḥ śālā ārogyāya bhiṣag yuvā ||
api mūlena kenāpi mardanādyair athāpi vā |
svasthī kṛte bhaven martye pūrvoktaṃ lokam avyayam ||
vātapittakaphādyānāṃ cayāpacayabhedinām |
yas tu svalpābhyupāyena mocayed vyādhipīḍitān |
so ‘pi yāti śubhān lokān avāpyān yajñayājibhiḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
ārogyaśālāṃ yaḥ kuryān mahāvaidyapuraskṛtām |
sarvopakaraṇopetāṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇām ārogyaṃ sādhanaṃ yataḥ |
tasmād ārogyadānena tad dattaṃ syāc catuṣṭayam ||
athaikam ārtaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ svasthīkṛtya prayatnataḥ |
prāpnoti sumahatpuṇyam anantaṃ kṣayavarjitam ||
jñānayogarataṃ śāntaṃ rogārtaṃ śivayoginam |
yaḥ svasthaṃ kurute so ‘pi sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet ||
brahmā viṣṇuḥ surāḥ sarve vyādhayaḥ svajanā nṛpāḥ |
yogasyaite mahavighnā vyādhayas te na yoginām ||
[895]        brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdrān rogārtān paripālya ca |
yat puṇyaṃ mahad āpnoti na tat sarvair mahāmakhaiḥ ||
ākāśasya yathā nāntaḥ surair apy upalabhyate |
tadvad ārogyadānasya nānto vai vidyate kvacit ||
puṇyenānena mahatā gatvā śivapuraṃ naraḥ |
modate vividhair bhogair vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ ||
ekaviṃsatkulopetaḥ sabhṛtyaḥ paripālitaḥ |
āste śivapure tāvad yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
tataḥ svadharmaśeṣeṇa saṃprāptaḥ prayataḥ sadā |
jñānam utpadyate tasya rudrebhyaḥ paricārakaḥ ||
jñānād viraktaḥ saṃsārāc chivadhyānam upāśritaḥ |
svadehaṃ tṛṇavat tyaktvā sarvaduḥkhāntam āpnuyāt ||
samastaduḥkhanirmuktaḥ śuddhaḥ svātmavyavasthitaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaś ca mukta ity abhidhīyate ||
tasmād bhogāpavargārthaṃ rogārtaṃ samupācaret |
viśeṣeṇa tu yogīndraṃ śarīreṇa dhanena ca ||
rogiṇo nodvijet prājño durbalān api sarvadā |
tān pāpād guruvan nityam evaṃ dharmaḥ pravartate ||
yo ‘nugṛhītam ātmānaṃ manyamāno dine dine |
upasarpeta rogārtas tīrṇas tena bhavārṇavaḥ ||
ity ārogyadānam ||
atha rogaharadānāni |
[896] brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
bhagavan prāṇinaḥ sarve rogārtāḥ prabhavanty ataḥ |
eṣāṃ tatparihārārthaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ jagatpate ||
ity evam ukto bhagavān brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā |
yad āha tasmai tat sarvaṃ bravīmi munisattamāḥ ||
ādhayo vyādhayaś caiva śarīrapariśoṣaṇāḥ |
puṇyaṃ tatparihārārthaṃ kartavyaṃ hitam icchatā ||
jvarātisāro yakṣmā ca gulmaśūlabhagaṃdharāḥ |
kuṣṭhāgnirogā vātaś ca kaṇṭhaśulamasūrikāḥ ||
kaṇṭhadantākṣikarṇeṣu śirorogopajihvakā |
tridoṣasaṃbhavāḥ sarve rogāḥ prāṇibhayaṃkarāḥ ||
granthayo mūtrakṛcchraṃ ca bastirogo mahodaram |
ete cānye ca bahavo mahāvegā mahābalāḥ ||
vyādhayaḥ śatasaṃkhyākā mṛtyor hetava eva te |
yad yad rogaśamaṃ kuryāt tat tat kāryaṃ manīṣibhiḥ ||
auṣadhaṃ japahomādi dānaṃ devārcanādikam |
sarvarogapraśamanaṃ sauvarṇadānam ucyate ||
jvare surikāyāṃ ca rājayakṣmaṇi caiva tat |
gulme tathāyasaṃ proktaṃ kuṣṭhe rājatam ucyate ||
ratnadānāc chamaṃ yānti gudotpannāś ca sarvaśaḥ |
[897]        śamaḥ syād antato vyādher bhūdānāt kamalāsana ||
śamārthaṃ vātarogāṇāṃ vāsodānaṃ vidhīyate |
kaṇṭhajihvodbhavādīnāṃ rogāṇāṃ śāntim icchatā ||
dhānyaṃ vāso hiraṇyaṃ vā dātavyāni prayatnataḥ |
suvarṇadānaṃ sarveṣāṃ rogāṇāṃ śamakāraṇam ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dātavyaṃ kamalodbhava |
akṣisaṃbhavarogāṇām ājyaṃ kanakasaṃyutam ||
pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ mudgāḥ śarkarāghṛtasaṃyutāḥ |
sarvāṅgatodakāśeṣu khaṇḍaṃ vai sopabarhaṇam ||
dadyād vaikaṇṭharogāṇāṃ kambalaṃ kamalodbhava |
tathā ca ratnarajatair yathāśaktyanurūpataḥ ||
kṛtvā ca pratimāṃ vyādher dadyād viprāya yatnataḥ |
śatena vā tadardhena triṃśatā niṣkasaṃkhyayā ||
jātarūpamayaṃ vyādheḥ pratirūpaṃ tu kārayet |
nidhāya pātre saṃpūrṇe taṇḍulaiḥ śatarūpakaiḥ ||
alaṃkṛtya ca sauvarṇaṃ rūpaṃ tv agurulepanaiḥ |
vāsoyugena saṃveṣṭya hiraṇyabahubhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
alaṃkṛtāya viprāya datvā mantram udīrayet |
yo māṃ rogāḥ prabādhante dehasthāḥ satatantatāḥ (?) ||
gṛhṇīṣva pratirūpeṇa tān rogān dvijasattama |
bāḍham ity eva tadrūpaṃ gṛhṇīyād vyādhibhiḥ saha ||
[898]        tatas ev arogī dātā ca dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ prapadyate |
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ śāntyai rogāṇāṃ kamalāsana ||
kāryam uktaṃ mayā tebhya kim anyat kathayāmi te |
evam ukto bhagavatā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
yad āha nāradāyedaṃ mayā tat sarvam īritam ||
iti rogaharadānavidhiḥ |
atha bhogadānāni | tatra ratnadānaṃ tāvad āha jābāliḥ |
ratnāni ca dvije dadyād bahumūlyāni mānavaḥ |
alaṃkāranimittaṃ vā devatābhyo ‘tiyatnataḥ ||
sa pāpatāpanirmukto muktim eva samaśnute |
na ratnebhyaḥ paraṃ vastu na cāsti bhuvanatraye ||
atas taddānato yasmāt phalaṃ yat kena varṇyate ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
yaḥ prayatnena ratnāni viprebhyaḥ saṃprayacchati |
sa sarvaguṇasaṃpannān putrān vindati nandati ||
saṃvartaḥ |
samudrajāni ratnāni naro vigatakalmaṣaḥ |
datvā viprāya mahate prāpnoti mahatīṃ śriyam ||
[899] vedavyāsaḥ |
ratnadānaṃ ca sumahat puṇyam uktaṃ janādhipa |
tāni vikrīya yajati brāhmaṇo hy abhayaṃkaraḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
vidrumāṇāṃ pradānena rudralokaṃ vrajen naraḥ |
sarvapātakanirmukto muktādānena jāyate ||
lokam āpnoti dānena naro vajrasya vajriṇaḥ |
tathā pradattair gomedair modate nandate vane ||
sarve grahāḥ pratuṣyanti puṣparāgasya dānataḥ |
gārutmatair marutvantaṃ niyataṃ jayati śriyā ||
vaidūryaiḥ sūryalokaṃ ca padmarāgair arogatām ||
dattair iti śeṣaḥ |
pradānād indranīlānāṃ līlānāṃ bhājanaṃ bhavet |
sukhī śaṅkhapradānena śaktiṃ śūktipradānataḥ ||
iti ratnadānam |
athāha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
māṇikyaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca vajraṃ vaidūryam eva ca |
mauktikaṃ gomedaṃ puṣparāgaṃ marakataṃ tathā ||
haritaṃ ca navaitāni svarṇapātropari nyaset |
atha vā rājate tāmre ājyena ca prapūrayet ||
[900]        navagrahāṇāṃ prītyarthaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā |
gandhapuṣpākṣatir dhūpair naivedyais tām prapūjayet ||
svaliṅgaiś caiva mantraiś ca homaḥ kāryas tu pūrvavat |
pūrvavad iti grahayajñoktamārgeṇety arthaḥ |
tato brāhmaṇam āhūya sarvaśāstrārthakovidam ||
ādityādigrahāḥ sarve navaratnapradānataḥ |
vināśayantu me hṛṣṭāḥ kṣipram eva bhagandaram ||
dānamantraḥ |
anena karmaṇā nūnaṃ yathāvad vihitena tu |
naro nairucyam āpnoti niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ bhagandarī ||
iti bhagandaraharadānam | tathā |
māṇikyaṃ vajrasahitam avraṇaṃ jātitaḥ śubham |
raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya khārikāpañcakopari ||
yad vā vibhavasāreṇa māṇikyaṃ yavapuñjake |
nidhāya gandhapuṣpādyair arcayed bhaktipūrvakam ||
brāhmaṇaṃ śrutasaṃpannaṃ svācāraṃ saṃyatendriyam |
vinītaveṣam āhūya bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ ||
sauvarṇenopavītena samyag vastrāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
pūjayitvā tu vidhivat kṛtahomāya pūrvavat ||
mantreṇānena vidhivat tasmai dadyād vraṇī śubham |
deva sūrya jagannātha sarvalokanamaskṛta ||
māṇikyavajradānena praṇāśayamama vraṇam |
[901] dānamantraḥ |
vraṇāḥ śastreṇa ye ‘pi syur viṣadigdhena saṃyuge |
te ‘pi śuddhāḥ prarohanti yathā proktaṃ tu vāyunā ||
iti vraṇaghnaratnadānam |
vāyupurāṇe |
galagaṇḍī galadravyahartā bhavati mānavaḥ |
dānena tat pratīkāraṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu bhāskara ||
māṇikyaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca vajraṃ gomedam eva ca |
vaidūryaṃ puṣparāgaṃ ca muktā marakataṃ tathā ||
ebhir mālāṃ prakurvīta sūtram apy atra rājatam |
alābhe mauktikādyanyatamair mālāṃ prakalpayet ||
sarvatra rājataṃ sūtram iti devaiḥ prakalpayet |
tāmrapātre vinikṣipya tilānām upari nyaset ||
tilānāṃ ca parīmāṇaṃ droṇapañcakam iṣyate |
yad vā tadardham eva syāt svaśaktyā vāpi kārayet ||
mahāśantiṃ tathā kuryāt brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ ||
mahāśantiḥ navagrahaśāṇtir ity arthaḥ |
ācāryaś ca śucir dakṣaḥ sarvaśāstrārthatattvavit |
śrutavṛttopasaṃpannaḥ sarvaprāṇihite rataḥ ||
[902]        evaṃvidhaṃ pūjayitvā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ |
homaṃ ca kārayet tena samidājyacarūtkaṭam ||
āsatyenatadhāmantro (?) gaṇānām idam ity api |
mantrāḥ krameṇa saṃyojyāḥ somaṃ rājānam ity api ||
mantreṇa sviṣṭakṛtaṃ dadyād galagaṇḍī ca vāgyataḥ |
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhāya hy udaṅmukhaḥ ||
māleyaṃ sarvadevatyā brahmaviṣnuśivādibhiḥ |
rudrādilokapālaiś ca tathā sarvāmarair api ||
satataṃ kaṇṭhalagnā vā dhāritā prītipūrvakam |
brāhmaṇāya pradatveyaṃ galagaṇḍaṃ vyapohatu |
dānamantraḥ |
grahaśāntiḥ kṛtā yais tu tebhyo dadyāc a dakṣiṇām |
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīta saha bandhubhiḥ ||
iti galagaṇḍaghnaratnadānam |
athālaṃkāradānam | brahmavaivartapurāṇe |
dvijātibhyas tu yo dadyād alaṃkārān samujvalān |
so ‘laṃkṛtaḥ svargaloke krīḍaty apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
alaṃkārapradānena surūpaḥ subhago bhavet |
tathālaṃkāradānena dīrtham āyuś ca vindati ||
[903]        narābharaṇadānena tuṣtiṃ yāti sadāśivaḥ |
yoṣidābharaṇair dattaiḥ prīyate himaśailajā ||
mahābhārate |
yuvāpy avikalāṅgo ‘pi dadhāno ‘py ujvalaṃ vapuḥ |
vinālaṃkaraṇair nūnaṃ na dhatte mañjulāṃ śriyam ||
durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ tāvat tatrāpi śubhaveṣatā |
tasyāpi bhūṣā tāruṇyaṃ jāyate narasattama ||
etat sarvaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vṛthaiva syād abhūṣaṇam |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pradadyād bhūṣaṇāni tu ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
mūrdhābharaṇadānena vrajen mūrdhābhiṣiktatām |
karṇajaiḥ karṇakīrtiḥ syāl lakṣmīḥ kaṇṭhair akuṇṭhitā ||
pāṇijaiḥ praṇijaitraḥ syāj jaghanair ajaghanyajaḥ |
jānujair manujaitraṃ syāc caraṇaṃ caraṇodbhavaiḥ ||
nālaṃkṛtebhyo narapuṅgavebhyaḥ
paraṃ nṛloke spṛhaṇīyam asti |
na labhyate tac ca vinā pradānād
ataḥ pradeyāni vibhūṣaṇāni ||
ity alaṃkāradānam |
[904]
atha vastradānam | devalaḥ |
kāntiyuk subhagaḥ śrīmān bhavaty ambaradānakṛt |
nandipurāṇe |
vastraṃ yaś cārthine dadyāc chubhraṃ vāpi yadṛcchayā |
sa bhaved dhanavān śrīmān bṛhaspatipure vaset ||
ādityapurāṇe |
yogināṃ ca daridrāṇām ye ca vastrapradā narāḥ |
teṣāṃ divyāni vastrāṇi sugandhīni mṛdūni ca |
vātaś caiva pravahati sugandho hy amṛtopamaḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
vastraṃ jalaṃ pavitraṃ ca dadyāc ca śivayogine |
sa mahābhogam āpnoti ante yogaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
mahābhārate |
vāsasāṃ tu pradānena svadāranirato naraḥ |
suvastraś ca suveṣaś ca bhavatīty anuśuśrumaḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
madhyamottamavastrāṇi padadyād ahatāni ca |
sa tenaivānusāreṇa prāpnoti vipulaṃ phalam ||
[905] viṣṇudharmottarāt |
haṃsa uvāca |
dānānām uttamaṃ loke vastradānaṃ prakīrtitam |
vāso hi sarvadaivatyaṃ sarvaprāyojyam ucyate ||
vastradātā suveṣaḥ syād rūpadraviṇasaṃyutaḥ |
yukto lāvaṇyasaubhāgyair nīrogaś ca tathā dvijaḥ ||
nīlaṃ raktaṃ tathā jīrṇaṃ na deyaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu |
deyaṃ varaṃ cāṅgirasalokaṃ yāti bṛhaspateḥ ||
datvā kārpāsikaṃ vastraṃ svargaloke mahīyate |
datvā saroma tatrāpi phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
āvikaṃ vasanaṃ datvā bhṛgūṇāṃ lokam āpnuyāt |
chāgaṃ datvā cāṅgirasaṃ kṣaumaṃ datvā bṛhaspateḥ ||
vasūnāṃ lokam āpnoti kuśakauśeyavāsasī |
kṛmijaṃ ca tathā datvā somaloke mahīyate ||
agniṣṭomam avāpnoti datvaiva mṛgalomikam |
datvā valkalajaṃ vāso vasūnāṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
samocakakadalyādi datvā caiva tathājinam |
vāravāṇam urastrāṇaṃ śirastrāṇaṃ tathaiva ca ||
pādatrāṇaṃ ca dadataḥ pṛthagyajña phalaṃ labhet |
vaastradānaṃ pavitraṃ tu pitṝṇām api tāraṇam ||
kausumbharaktaṃ datvā tu saubhāgaṃ mahad āpnuyāt |
dānāt kuṅkumaraktasya lāvaṇyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt ||
[906]        raṅgair anyaiś ca nīlaiś ca raktaṃ datvā sukhī bhavet |
yathā yathā tu vastrasya bhavatīha mahārghatā ||
yathā yathā tu śubhatā tathā puṇyaphalaṃ mahat |
anyeṣām eva dānānām etad eva prakīrtitam ||
sarvado vastradaḥ prokto yataḥ sarvatra vastravān |
avāpnoti ca darmajñāḥ tad dhi tasmād viśiṣyate ||
vastradaḥ suciraṃ kālaṃ bhuktvā devasukhaṃ bhuvi |
vimānenārkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā ||
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavaty arogaḥ
śocānvitaḥ saukhyaparopahīnaḥ |
janābhirāmaś ca tathā suveṣaḥ
pūjyaś ca loke viduṣāṃ sadaiva ||
iti vastradānam |
atha śocakīyāt |
īśvara uvāca |
vāsodānaṃ pravakṣyāmi mama prītivivardhanam |
āyurārogyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ saukhyahetukam uttamam ||
vastrayugmaṃ sitaṃ sūkṣmam ekaikasya prakalpayet |
ekādaśānāṃ viprāṇāṃ rudraikādaśarūpiṇām ||
gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya bhojayitvā vidhānataḥ |
uktamantram athaitebhyas tānivastrāni dāpayet ||
[907]        prasīda tu bhavo nityam asmākaṃ kṛttivāsanaḥ |
vastrāṇy asmatpradattāni pratigṛhṇātu śaṅkara ||
datteṣu vastreṣu naras tantubhir gaṇitāḥ samāḥ |
rudratulyo balī bhūtvā rudraloke mahīyate ||
ekādaśarudranāmāni rudraikādaśatiladāne draṣṭavyāni |
iti rudraikādaśavastradānavidhiḥ |
atha devatābhyo vastradānam | ādityapurāṇe |
vahner vastrapradānena brahmalokaṃ prapadyate |
nandipurāṇe |
vāsāṃsi tu vicitrāṇi sāravanti mṛdūni ca |
snāpitāni śive dadyād dvikoṣāni navāṇi ca ||
yāvat tadvastratantūnāṃ parimāṇaṃ vidhīyate |
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
kṣaumāmbarāṇi yo dadyāt pattorṇāni ca cakriṇe |
kārpāsajāni vā bhaktyā dadyād vittānusārataḥ ||
tatra vāsasi yāvantas tantūnāṃ paramāṇavḥ |
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
[908] bhaviṣatpurāṇe |
yo vastraṃ bhānave dadyād ahataṃ ca mahādhanaḥ |
sa helilokam āsādya vandyate tridaśair api ||
devīpurāṇe |
aṇḍajair aṇḍajair vāpi vastrair abhyarcya śailajām |
saṃbhūjyābharaṇaiḥ śakra cakravartitvam āpnuyāt ||
atha śokaharavastradānam | tatra vṛddhabaudhāyanaḥ |
vighnakartā ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ śokī bhavati mānavaḥ |
tasya karmavipākotthaṃ vyādhināśanam uttamam ||
dānaṃ vakṣyāmy aśeṣeṇa sarvaśokavināśanam |
kṣaumavastraṃ samānīya bahumūlyaṃ yad arhati ||
muktāphalāni badhnīyād vastraprānte samantataḥ |
kuṅkumenāṅkitaṃ samyak karpūragurudhūpitam ||
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāāpya taṇḍulāṃś ca svaśaktitaḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir ācāryaḥ pūjayen mudā |
yuvaṃ yuvāsuvāsābhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ pūjanaṃ viduḥ ||
yuvaṃ vastrāṇīty ekaḥ, yuvāsuvāsā ity aparo mantraḥ |
[909]        homaṃ cāpi prakurvīta samidājyatilair api |
udbuddhasva idaṃ viṣṇur āpasmin sapta ity api ||
mantraiḥ krameṇa juhuyāt sviṣṭakṛc ca yadasya ca ||
hutvā hutvā ca saṃpānān pātre sarvān niveśya tu |
saṃkhyā cāṣṭottaraśataṃ ca sarvam eva hi rogiṇaḥ ||
saṃpātenāṅgamajjā ca sarvam eva rogiṇaḥ |
akṣibhyām iti sūktena yathā liṅgaṃ tathaiva ca ||
vāsasāṃ mārjanaṃ kuryān mārjayed darbhapiñjalaiḥ |
ācāryāyātha tad vastraṃ dadyāc chokī sadakṣiṇam ||
mantreṇānena vidhivad dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ śuciḥ |
ṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro ‘gastyo lopāmudrāpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
kṣaumavastrapradānena tuṣṭo vyādhiṃ vyapohatu ||
dānamantraḥ |
brāhmaṇebhyas tathānyebhyo dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
tataḥ snātaḥ śucir bhūto vastramālyopaśobhitaḥ |
brāhmaṇair bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhuñjītātīva bhaktitaḥ ||
iti vastradānam |
athoṣṇīṣadānam | nandipurāṇe |
[910]        uṣṇīṣadāyino martyā jāyante mukuṭojvalāḥ |
vistīrṇe rājavaṃśe tu sitachatrāgryalakṣaṇāḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
uṣṇīṣāṇi vicitrāṇi yaḥ pradadyād dvijātiṣu |
raktāni vātha śvetāni kausumbhāny atha vā punaḥ ||
sa saundaryaṃ paraṃ prāpya vanitāvallabho bhavet |
sukeśāḥ sumukhā rājan yasmād uṣṇīṣadāyinaḥ |
tasmāt teṣāṃ pradāneṣu prayatasva mahābhujaḥ ||
athorṇāpaṭadānam | āha kāśyapaḥ |
aurṇaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ yo ‘pi bhaktyā dadyād dvijātaye |
so ‘pi yāti parāṃ siddhiṃ martyair anyaiḥ sudurlabham ||
yas tv akiñcanavṛttibhyas tapasvibhyaḥ prayacchati |
aurṇaprāvaraṇaṃ divyaṃ śītavātātapāpaham ||
nirastasarvaduḥkhaugho jāyate sa mahādhanī ||
vahnipurāṇe |
navaṃ sūkṣmaṃ suvipulaṃ yaḥ prayacchati kambalam |
śītārdine dvijendrāya teṣāṃ mārgasukhapradaḥ ||
[911]        niṣkiṃcanebhyo dīnebhyaḥ śītavātamahātapaiḥ |
arditebhyaḥ karuṇayā vastram aurṇaṃ dadāti yaḥ ||
na tasya sukṛtaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate tridaśair api |
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ so ‘kṣayaṃ sukham aśnute ||
atha śayyādānam | vedavyāsaḥ |
sugandhicitrāstaraṇopapannaṃ
dadyān naro yaḥ śayanaṃ dvijāya |
rūpānvitāṃ pakṣavatīṃ manojñāṃ
bhāryām ayatnopacitāṃ labhet saḥ ||
atha viṣṇusaṃhitāyām |
śayyādānaṃ ca yo dadyāt tasyāpi śṛṇu vistaram |
sarvakāleṣu dātavyaṃ tathā puṇyadineṣu ca ||
gadadantaiḥ pravālair vā suvarṇarajatena vā |
kāryā gātrāṇi pādāś ca valabhyaś ca sadakṣiṇāḥ ||
alābhe ‘pi ca kartavyās tulyakāṣṭhamayāḥ śubhāḥ |
sandhyāmrapaṭalākārair āstīrṇāstaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
śirodharaiḥ savitānaiḥ prākārair vastrasaṃyutaiḥ |
maṇisauvarṇapātraiś ca raupyais tāmraiś ca saṃyutām ||
[912]        phalapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiś ca tāmbūlādyaiḥ suvistaraiḥ |
darpaṇaiḥ padatrāṇaiś ca nānādravyair vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
catuṣkoṇeṣu saṃsthāpya yathāśakti yudhiṣṭhira |
ghṛtakuṅkumagodhūmapūrṇapātraṃ jalasya ca ||
śayyāṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā kuryāc chayyāpradakṣiṇam ||
namaḥ pramāṇyai devyeti praṇamya ca caturdiśam |
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya śrutādhyāyanaśāline (?) ||
tathā prajñānaviduṣe śayyāṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tasya dānasya yat puṇyaṃ vimānaṃ kanakojvalam ||
nānāratnasamākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpasamanvitam |
nānādivyāpsaraḥsevyaṃ nānāratnaiḥ samāvṛtam ||
nānādravyopasaṃyuktaṃ vimānam adhirohati |
tasmād indrapuraṃ gacchet sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ ||
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi krīḍayitvā yathāsukham |
indralokāt paribhraṣṭa iha loke nṛpo bhavet ||
ṣaṣṭiyojanavistīrṇe svāmī bhavati maṇḍale |
dharmajño jiitabhṛtyaś ca tejasvī rūpvāṃs tathā ||
mahābhārate |
śayyām āstaraṇopetāṃ supracchādanasaṃvṛtām |
pradadyād yad tu viprāya śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam ||
surūpaḥ subhagaḥ strīmām (?) strīsahasrābhisaṃvṛtaḥ |
[913]        daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
bhaviṣottare |
śayyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava pāṇḍukulodvaha |
yāṃ datvā śivabhāgī syād iha loke paratra ca ||
śayyādānaṃ praśaṃsanti sarvadaiva dvijottamāḥ |
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmāt paścāt ko ‘nyaḥ pradāsyati ||
tāvat sa bandhuḥ sa pitā yāvaj jīvati bhārata |
mṛtomṛta iti jñātvā kṣaṇāt sneho nivartate ||
tasmāt svayaṃ pradātavyaṃ śayyābhojyajalādikam |
ātmaiva cātmano bandhur iti saṃcintya cetasi ||
ātmaiva yadi nātmānaṃ dānabhogair na pūjayet |
ko ‘nyo hitataras tasmād yaḥ paścāt pūjayiṣyati ||
tasmāc chayyāṃ samāsādya sāladārumayīṃ dṛḍhām |
dantapatracitāṃ ramyāṃ hemapaṭṭair alaṃkṛtām ||
haṃsatūlīpraticchannāṃ dhūpagandhādivāsitām |
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayed dhemaṃ hariṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam |
ucchīrṣake ghṛtabhṛtaṃ kalaśaṃ parikalpayet ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpaṃ tu, devatādānaprakaraṇasthitalakṣmīnārāyaṇadāne draṣṭavyam |
vijñeyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha sanidrākalaśo budhaiḥ |
tāmbūlakuṅkumākṣodakarpūragurucandanam ||
[914]        dīpikopānahachatraṃ cāmarāsanabhājanam |
pārśveṣu sthāpayed bhaktyā saptadhānyāni caiva hi ||
śayanasthasya bhavati yad anyad upakārakam |
bhṛṅgārakarakādyaṃ tu pañcavarṇavināśakam ||
śayyām evaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇye ‘hni vidhipūrvakam ||
yathā na kṛṣṇaśayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyās tu tathā janmani janmani ||
yasmād aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyās tu tathā janmani janmani ||
datvaivaṃ talpam amalaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet |
evaṃ śayyāpradāne tu vidhir eṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
svarge purandaragṛhe sūryaputrālaye tathā |
sukhaṃ vasaty asau jantuḥ śayyādānaprabhāvataḥ ||
sūryaputrālaye caiva tathā vaivasvate pure |
pīḍayanti na taṃ yāmyāḥ puruṣā bhīṣaṇānanāḥ ||
na gharmeṇa na śītena bādhyate sa naraḥ kvacit |
api pāpasamāyuktaḥ svargalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ |
āhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvat tiṣṭhet pātakavarjitaḥ ||
śayyāpradānam amalaṃ tava pāṇḍuputra
saṃkīrtitaṃ sakalasaukhyavidhānabhūtam |
yo vai dadāti vidhivat svayam eva nāke
kalpaṃ vikalparahitaḥ sa vibhāti martyaḥ ||
atha śivaśayyādānam | śivadharmāt |
haṃsatūlīsamāyuktāṃ mṛdvīkhaṭvām alaṃkṛtām |
sarvopakaraṇopetāṃ śivaśayyāṃ nivedayet |
śivaṃ devīsamāyuktaṃ prauṣṭaṃ kṛtvā nivedayet ||
śivadevīrūpaṃ tu devatādānaprakaraṇasthita-umāmaheśvaradāne draṣṭavyam |
śivajñānārthatattvajñe ācārye ca dayānvite |
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyair vastrālaṅkāracāmaraiḥ ||
bhakṣyabhojyair aśeṣaiś ca tataḥ śayyāṃ nivedayet |
tadūrṇātūlīvastrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yāvatī |
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
sūryaśayyādānam | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
haṃsatūlīsamāyuktāṃ mṛdukhaṭvāṃ sukalpitām |
sarvopakaraṇair yuktāṃ sūryaśayyāṃ prakalpayet ||
rājñidevīsamāyuktāṃ tataḥ śayyāṃ nivedayet |
saurajñānārthatattvajñam ācāryaṃ tu dayānvitam ||
[916]        saṃpūjya puṣpagandhādyair vastrālaṃkāracāmaraiḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyais tathā peyair anekarasasaṃyutaiḥ ||
rājñīrūpam uktaṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
rājñī ca dvibhujā kāryā hariṇī ca kirīṭinī |
varadaṃ ca nije pāṇau bibhratī paṅkajashitā || iti |
tad ūrṇātūlavastrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yāvatī |
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
saurādisarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogān aśeṣataḥ |
kramād āgatya loke ‘smin rājā bhavati bhūtale ||
athāsanadānam | liṅgapurāṇe |
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ caiva yo dadāti yaśasvine |
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tasya duḥkhaṃ na vidyate ||
skandapurāṇe |
āsanaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta saṃvītaṃ brāhmaṇāya vai |
svārājyaṃ sthānam āpnoti tejasvī vigatajvaraḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
sugandhacitrābharaṇopaśobhitaṃ
yas tv āsanaṃ vedavide pradadyāt |
[917]        grāmādhipatyaṃ labhate sa śīghraṃ
kule mahattvaṃ sa labhet samagram ||
viṣṇuḥ |
āsanaṃ dānasya sthānam | iti |
phalam iti śeṣaḥ |
atha darpaṇadānam | mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
darpaṇaṃ yo naro dadyān nirmalaṃ ca dvijātaye |
sa candralokam āsādya modate śaradāṃ śatam ||
nandiprokte |
śivasya purato dadyād darpaṇaṃ cāru nirmalam |
paryantaśobhitaṃ kṛtvā śvetamālyaiḥ sacandanaiḥ ||
candrāṃśunirmalaḥ śrīmān subhagaḥ kāmarūpadhṛk |
kalpāyutasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
brahmapurāṇe |
candramaṇḍalasaṃkāśaṃ nakṣatre viṣṇudaivate |
dvādaśyāṃ puṇyakāle vā viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
darpaṇaṃ yo naro dadyāt srakcandanavibhūṣitam |
rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān jñānavān jāyate naraḥ ||
[918]
atha vyajanadānam | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
tālavṛntaṃ dvijebhyas tu yaḥ prayacchati bhaktitaḥ |
sa divyabhogasaṃyogam arogaḥ sarvadāśnute ||
mahātapapariśrāntidharmanirmūlanakṣamam |
na tālavṛntapavanād aparaṃ nṛparañjanam ||
paraṃ rambhorusaṃbhogasaṃbhavaṃ svedameduram |
hartuṃ śramaṃ samartheta nānyad vyajanavījanāt ||
ataḥ sadā mudāyuktas tālavṛntaṃ dvijātaye |
dadyād avadyanirmuktamuktisaṃbhuktihetave ||
mahābhāreate |
yo dadāti dvijāgryebhyo vyajanaṃ jananandanam |
sa nandanavanāmodamodamānamanā divi ||
vased aśeṣakalpān tarpayantam apakalmaṣaḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
pradāya vyajanaṃ vāṃśaṃ vaṃśe mahati jāyate |
cārmaṇaṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ datvā vyajanam aśnute ||
tathaiva datte māyūre nāyur etasya hīyate |
pātreṇa putratām eti vāstreṇa straiṇavajñabhaḥ ||
vyajaneneha dattena tasmāt taṃ pratipādayet ||
[919]
atha cāmaradānam | mahābhārate |
yas tu bhaktyā dvijāgryebhyo dadyāc cāramam ujjvalam |
sa bhūpatyam avāpnoti niḥśeṣāvanimaṇḍale ||
vāyupurāṇe |
cāmaraṃ cāmareśāya yaḥ śivāya nivedayet |
sa sarvakāmasaṃpūrṇaḥ svarṇaśailatale vaset ||
māyūraṃ cāmaraṃ yo ‘pi śivāya vinivedayet |
sa vimānavarārūḍho vījyate ‘psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
padmapurāṇe |
pradāya cāmaravaraṃ śraddhayā viṣṇave naraḥ |
paraṃ padam avāpnoti yat surair api durlabham ||
etatsarvopacārebhyo devadevasya vallabham ||
vitānadānam | kālikāpurāṇe |
candrodayaṃ suvīstīrṇṃ (?) varṇakaiś citritaṃ tathā |
pralambimuktāstavakaiḥ śobhinaṃ ratnasaṅgalam ||
[920]        suraktapaṭṭasūtrādibandhasaṃbandhavandhuram |
sarvatobhadramukhyānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ vibhaktibhiḥ ||
virājitaṃ tathā citrapatravallīsamākulam |
yakṣarākṣasagandharvakinnaradvandvamūrthibhiḥ ||
likhitābhiś ca parito mahāvismayakārakam |
evaṃvidhaṃ vitānaṃ yo vidhāyātha dvijanmane ||
śivāya viṣṇave vātha puṇye ‘hni pratipādayet |
sa samuddharate nūnam ātmanaḥ pūrvapūruṣān ||
svayaṃ śivapure ramye bhogān bhuktvā manoramān |
kramād āgatya loke ‘smin sukhī jñānī dhanī bhavet ||
padmapurāṇe |
candrodayaṃ tu yo bhaktyā prayacchati sa puṇyadhīḥ |
na tasya śreyasām antaḥ kadācid api jāyate ||
atha gandhadānam | saṃvartaḥ |
gandhān ābharaṇādyaṃ ca yaḥ praycchati dharmavit |
sa sugandhāmodayukto yatra tatrāpi jāyate ||
skandapurāṇe |
naraḥ sugandhadehatvaṃ gandhadānād avāpnuyāt |
bhogavān jāyate nityaṃ śarīraṃ nāsya tapyati ||
[921] padmapurāṇe |
anulepanagandhānāṃ pradānena hi mānavaḥ |
na kadācin manodāhaṃ dehe vā dāham aśnute |
sugaandhadhūpadānena lokam apsarasāṃ vrajet ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
anulepanadānena rūpavān abhijāyate |
naraś candanadānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
saubhāgyakārakaṃ proktaṃ pradānaṃ kuṅkumasya tu |
tathā karpūradānena sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
mṛgadarpapradānena yaśasā bhuvi rājate |
yakṣakardamadānena sāmrājyaṃ prājyam aśnute ||
atha tāmbūladānam | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
tāmbūlaṃ yo naro dadyāt pratyahaṃ niyamānvitaḥ |
devebhyo ‘tha dvijātibhyo mahābhāgyaṃ samaśnute ||
iha saṃsāriṇāṃ loke manuṣyatvaṃ sudurlabham |
tāmbūladānāt tan nṝṇām anyāyāsena jāyate ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tāmbūlam ujjvalaṃ dadyād yo viprebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ |
[922]        śivāya keśavāyātha nākaloke sa pūjyate ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
tāmbūlasya pradānena saubhāgyam api vindate |
datvā jātīphalaṃ viprāḥ saphalāṃ vindati kriyām |
mukhavāsapradānena mukhasaugandhyam āpnuyāt ||
athe puṣpadānam | mahābhārate |
mano hlādayate yasmāc chriyaṃ cāpi dadāti yaḥ |
tasmāt sumanasaḥ proktā naraiḥ sukṛtakarmabhiḥ ||
devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ |
sarvakāmān avāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate ||
tasmāt sumanasaḥ proktā yasmāt tuṣyanti devatāḥ |
yaṃ yam uddiśya dīyeran deve sumanasaḥ prabho ||
maṅgalārthaṃ sa tenāsya prīto bhavati daityapa ||
nandipurāṇe |
dhūpadaḥ surabhir nityaṃ puṣpadaḥ subhagaḥ sadā |
tasmād devāya viprāya dātavyaṃ tat sukhārthibhiḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
puṣṭir bhavet sadākālaṃ pradānād gandhamālyayoḥ |
[923] yamaḥ |
devatāpuṣpadānena jāyate śrīsamanvitaḥ |
ūrdhvāṃ gatim avāpnoti yaś ca dhūpaprado naraḥ ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
deyāḥ sumanaso nityaṃ naraiḥ punyaphalārthibhiḥ |
kim asti daivataṃ tādṛk yat puṣpair na hi tuṣyati ||
atha gītādidānam | nandipurāṇe |
yo gītavādyaṃ dadyāt tu brāhmaṇāya subuddhimān |
sa gandharvapure gacched vaset tatra yugatrayam ||
skandapurāṇe |
gāyan yāti piban yāti khādan yāti gṛhaṃ yathā |
yo bhojanasya velāyāṃ viprāṇāṃ geyam ācaret ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
devatāyatane yas tu brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛheṣu vā |
gāyan gītaṃ sumadhuraṃ gandharvāṇāṃ pure vaset ||
ātodyavidyayā rājan prīṇayan dvijadevatāḥ |
sa svargalokam āsādya devatādyair vinodyate ||
devatāgre dvijāgre vā yo nityaṃ nṛtyam ācaret |
vinodayanti taṃ svarge nityam apsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||
[924]        yo gītavādyanṛtyāni mūlyaṃ datvā tu kārayet |
sa śakrabhavane tiṣṭhed yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
yo vāpi mukhavādyena vinodayati devatām |
sa dhautakalmaṣamalaḥ svargaṃ yāt na saṃśayaḥ ||
vacanena priyeṇātha yaḥ stauti guṇino guṇānm |
svīyaiḥ parakṛtair vāpi ya stotraiḥ stauti devatām ||
tasya puṇyavataḥ puṇyam agaṇyaṃ kena gaṇyate ||
atha chatropanahadānam | bṛhaspatiḥ |
asipatravanaṃ mārgaṃ kṣuradhārāsamanvitam |
tīkṣṇātapaṃ ca tarati chatropanatprado naraḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
nidāghakāle varṣāyāṃ ghatraṃ yaḥ saṃprayacchati |
nāsya kaścin manodāhaḥ kadācid api jāyate ||
mahābhārate |
upānahau prayatnād yo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
mardate kaṇṭakān sarvān viṣamān saṃtarary api ||
śakaṭaṃ damyasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ bhavati tena vai |
yānaṃ cāśvatarīyuktaṃ tasya svarge viśāmyate ||
[925]        upatiṣṭhanti kaunteya raupyakāñcanaśobhanam |
brāhmaṇāya suśīlāya yo dadyāt kāṣṭhapāduke |
sa vāhanena divyena divaṃ gacchati bhogavān ||
sūryakarasaṃtaptareṇukādarśanakopitasya jamadagneḥ sūryeṇa saha saṃvāde —
sūrya uvāca |
maharṣe śirasas trāṇaṃ chatraṃ madraśmivāraṇam |
pratigṛhṇīṣva padbhyāṃ ca trāṇaṃ tvaṃ carmapāduke ||
adya prabhṛti caivaitallokeṣu pracariṣyati |
puṇyakeṣu ca kāleṣu paramakṣayam eva ca ||
upānacchatram etad vai bhūryeṇeha pravartitum |
puṇyam etat tu vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhārata ||
tasmāt prayaccha viprebhyaś chatropānaham uttamam |
dharmas te sumahān bhāvī na me trāsti vicāraṇā ||
chatraṃ hi puruṣavyāghra yaḥ pradadyād dvijāteye |
śubhraṃ śataśalākaṃ vai sa pretya sukham edhate ||
śakraloke sa vasate pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ |
apsarobhiś ca satataṃ devaiś ca bharatarṣabha ||
dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchaty upānahau |
snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye ||
so ‘pi lokān avāpnoti devatair api pūjitān |
goloke vasate kalpaaṃ pratisvaarge tu bhārata ||
[926]        etat te bharataśreṣṭha mayā kārtsnyena kīrtitam |
chatropānahadānasya phalaṃ bharatasattama ||
vahnipurāṇe |
gharmavarṣātapatrāṇaṃ chatraṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
sarvavyādhivinirmuktaḥ śriyaṃ putrāṃś ca vindati ||
vimānena ca divyena kiṃkaraṇījālamālinā |
mahendrabhavanaṃ yāti sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ ||
dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchaty upānahau |
na tasya manaso dāhaḥ kadācid api jāyate ||
yānam aśvatarīyuktaṃ tasya hemamayaṃ śubham |
upatiṣṭhati viprarṣe sarvaratnavibhūṣitam ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
varṣāsu chatradānena tathā grīṣme ca nārada |
sarvāhṇād ayutās te syuḥ sarvakāmaiś ca saṃyutāḥ ||
putrān śriyaṃ ca labhate yaś chatraṃ saṃprayacchati |
cakṣurvyādhiṃ na labhate yajñabhāgam athāśnute ||
kṛcchrāc ca viṣamāc caiva sa ca mokṣam avāpnuyāt |
evam āha mahābhāgaḥ śāṇḍilyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
vātavarṣātapatrāṇaṃ chatraṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
[927]        sa sarvavyādhirahitaḥ śriyaṃ putrāṃś ca vindati ||
devalaḥ |
chatradaś chāyayā yāti yānenopanahapradaḥ |
yamaḥ |
