chatrado gṛham āpnoti gṛhado nagaraṃ tathā |
jamadagniḥ |
dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchaty upānahau |
snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye ||
so ‘pi lokān avāpnoti daivatair api pūjyate |
goloke sa mudāyukto vasaty api hi bhārata ||
atriḥ |
śrāddhakāleṣu yo dadyād bhojanaṃ ca upānahau |
tasya vai vipulaṃ puṇyam aśvadānaphalaṃ labet ||
skandapurāṇe |
yaḥ prayacched dvijendrāya upānatkāṣṭhapāduke |
sa varāśvena mahatā sukhaṃ yāti mamālayam ||
atha pātradānam | skandapurāṇe |
bhājanaṃ yaḥ prayacchet tu haimaṃ ratnavibhūṣitam |
[928]        so ‘psaraḥśatasaṃkīrṇavimāne divi modate ||
rājataṃ yaḥ prayacchet tu viprebhyo bhājanaṃ śubham |
sa gandharvapadaṃ pāpya urvaśyā saha modate ||
tāmraṃ yo bhājanaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ |
sa bhaved yakṣarājasya prabhur vyalasamanvitaḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
tejasāni tu pātrāṇi datvā sunavaṇāni ca |
pātram eti ca kāmānāṃ lāvaṇyaṃ cāpnuyān mahat ||
taijasāni tu pātrāṇi satailāni prayacchataḥ |
ārogyam uttaamaṃ proktaṃ lāvaṇyam api cottamam ||
taijasāni tu pātrāṇi saghṛtāṇi prayacchataḥ |
ārogyam uttamaṃ proktaṃ svarge vāsas tathā dvijāḥ ||
taijasāni tu pātrāṇi samaadhūni prayacchataḥ |
lāvaṇyam uttamaṃ proktaṃ saubhāgyam api cottamam ||
atha rūkmādipātradānam | kālikāpurāṇe |
raukmaṃ kṣīrānvitaṃ pātraṃ dadhipūrṇaṃ ca rājatam |
mauktikānāṃ śataṃ yo ‘tha vstrayugmaṃ niveśayet ||
tataḥ puṇyāhavādyena jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ |
hariṃ caivārcayed yatnāt sthāpya sauvrṇapaṅkaje ||
viṣṇurūpam uktaṃ tu tulāpuruṣadāne |
[929]        tatas tat pātram ādāya vādyabrahmasvanaiḥ svayam |
kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ tasmai viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave ||
tataś cāmantrya vidhivat pūjayet tu viśeṣataḥ |
evaṃ vipraṃ tu saṃpūjya praṇamya ca kṣamāpayet ||
brāhmaṇān aparān bhojya dakṣyayec caiva kāñcanam |
vratinaś cānnadānena vastrādyaiḥ pūjya tarpayet ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāāṃ ca anivāryaudanaṃ dadet |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ śuklāṃ māghamāse tu pūrṇimām ||
kuryād vidhim imaṃ samyak sa hares tu vrajet padam |
upahasanti yo devān brāhmaṇāṃś ca tapasvinaḥ ||
pātrarūpavrataṃ cedaṃ na deyaṃ teṣu karhicit |
buddhirūpapradaṃ cāyurdhanasaubhāgyasaṃpradā ||
putradaṃ sukhadaṃ caiva vidhinā caritaṃ tv idam |
vratasyāsya pravaktāraṃ śamayuktaṃ guṇānvitam ||
pūjayed bhūtikāmārthaṃ pādukāvastrakāñcanaiḥ |
raukyam ājyayutaṃ cātha pātraṃ nīlamaṇīyutam ||
abhāve tu tathā hemnaḥ karṣārdhenāmbarārcitam ||
nīlamaṇer abhāve karṣārdhamātreṇa hemnā bhūṣitamadhyabhāgaṃ vidheyam |
vastrayugmaṃ navaṃ sūkṣmaṃ puṣpaprakaracarcitam |
ānīya tatra tat pātraṃ śucau deśe niveśayet ||
tato jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītavādyādimaṅgalaiḥ |
prabhāte tan nayet pātraṃ harer āyatanaṃ mahat ||
[930]        snāpya kṣīrādibhir devam viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya caiva tu |
nivedayet tu tat pātraṃ prīyatām ity udīrayet ||
tato nānāvidhair bhakṣyaiḥ sugandhenaudanena ca |
dadhikhaṇḍādyayuk datvā naivedyaṃ ca baliṃ haret ||
tato natvā gṛhaṃ gacched gatvā ca praṇamet punaḥ |
praṇamya bhojayed bhaktyā vratinaś ca dvijaiḥ saha ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣām anivāritam |
ācāryaaṃ hemavastrādyair dakṣayed vidhivat tadā ||
yathā śaktyāparāṇ caiva dīrgham āyur jijīviṣuḥ |
etat pātravrataṃ jñeyaṃ guhyaṃ cātra prakāśitam ||
na deyaṃ duṣṭayuddhīnāṃ dviṣatāṃ pāpakarmaṇām |
vaiṣṇave śivabhakte tu saure bhāgavate sadā ||
deyam etad vidhānena āyurdhanavivṛddhaye |
ye dviṣanti narā mūḍhā viṣṇuṃ vātha vṛṣadhvajam ||
te nūnaṃ viṣṇubhaktās te viṣṇuṃ caiva haranti ye |
anenāpi vratenaiva prāpya tat padam uttamam ||
modate suciraṃ kālam āyuṣmān dhanavān iha ||
atha bhāṇḍadānam | vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
dātā tāmrasya bhāṇḍānāṃ ratnānāṃ bhājanaṃ bhavet |
liṅgapurāṇe |
[931]        tāmrāyasānāṃ bhāṇḍānāṃ dātā yakṣādhipo bhavet |
labhate ca paraṃ sthānaṃ yujyate ca mahāśriyā ||
brahmapurāṇe |
audumbarāṇi bhāṇḍāni yo dadyād āyasāni vā |
mahatīm ṛddhim āpnoti durlabhāṃ tridaśair api ||
vāyupurāṇe |
svarṇarūpyamayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ devatārthe dadāti yaḥ |
kuberalokam āsādya modate bahuvatsarān ||
athāpākadānam | bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
tan me kathaya deveśa yena dattena mānavāḥ |
bahuputro bahudhano bahubhṛtyaś ca jāyate ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
purā bāratavarṣe ‘smin rājāsīd babhruvāhanaḥ |
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ tena rājyaṃ prāptam akaṇṭakam ||
na tasya deśe vidvāṃso na ca vairibhavaṃ bhayam |
śarīro tathā mahāvyādhiḥ na caivāntaradāyakaḥ ||
tasyaivaṃ kurvato rājyaṃ pūrvakarmārjitaṃ śubham |
[932]        nāsti bhṛtyo bhārasaḥ sarvarājyadhurandharaḥ ||
na putraḥ priyakṛt kaścin na mantrī madhurākṣaraḥ |
na mitraṃ kāryakaraṇe samartho na suhṛt tathā ||
na bhojyasamaye prāpte bhojanaṃ sārvakāmikam |
na patraphalasaṃyuktaṃ nāmbalaṃ vasanaṃ na ca ||
na dhanaṃ janasaṃbandhaṃ kārito ratnasaṃcayaḥ |
tasyaivaṃ kurvato rājyam avyāhativiceṣṭitam ||
athaikasmin dine vipraḥ pippalādo ‘tiviśrutaḥ |
ājagāma mahāyogī rājñaḥ pārśvaṃ mahāmatiḥ ||
tam āgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā rājño rājñī śubhāvatī |
pādyārghāsanadānena sarvathā tam apūjayet ||
tatkathānte ca kasmiṃś cit tam uvāca śubhāvatī |
bhagavan rājyam etan me sarvabādhāvivarjitam ||
kasmān ca bhṛtyāḥ putrā vā mantrimitrādikaṃ dvija |
bhogāvāptir na ca tathā sarvakālātisāyinī ||
pippalāda uvāca |
yad yena pūrvavihitaṃ tad asau prāpnute phalam |
karmabhūmir iyaṃ rājñi nātaḥ śocitum arhasi ||
na tat kurvanti rājāno dāyādā na ca śatravaḥ |
na bāndhavā na mitrāṇi yad yena ca purā kṛtam ||
tasmād bhavadbhir yad dattaṃ prāptaṃ tad rājyam uttamam |
bhṛtyamitrādisaṃbandho na dattaḥ prāpyate kutaḥ ||
[933]                śubhāvaty uvāca |
idānīm api viprarṣe kasmāt tan nopadiśyate |
tena me bahavaḥ putrāā dhanaṃ bhṛtyaḥ bhavanti ca ||
mitraṃ vā bandhuyogo vā vrataṃ dānam upoṣitam |
kathayasvāmalamate yena saṃpadyate sukham ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa pippalādo dvijottamaḥ |
āpākākhyaṃ mahādānaṃ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakam ||
śraddhayā kuruśārdūla nārī vāpy atha vā pumān |
yena dattena bhāgyānāṃ bahūnāṃ bhājanaṃ bhavet ||
tataḥ śrutvā dadau rājā āpākaṃ danam uttamam |
labhet putrān bahūn bhṛtyān mantrimitraṃ suhṛjjanam ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
āpākākhyaṃ mahādānaṃ kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira |
dattena yena kāmānāṃ putrā bhavati bhājanam ||
grahatārābalaṃ labdhvā kumbhakāraṃ ca pūjayet |
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇaiś caiva puṣpaiś cāgurucandanaiḥ ||
brūyāt tathedaṃ sāmānyaṃ yathā tuṣṭo ‘bhijāyate |
tvaṃ me bhāṇḍāni citrāṇi gurūṇi ca laghūni ca ||
maṇikādīni śubhrāṇi sthālyaś ca sumanoharāḥ |
ghaṭakān karakāṃś caiva praṇītāḥ kuṇḍakāni ca ||
śarāvādīni pātrāṇi bhāṇḍāny uccāvacāni ca |
aliñjarāḥ pratighaṭām anyanīkaṭahāni ca ||
[934]        evam anyac ca yat kiṃcid upabhogyaṃ bhaved gṛhe |
saṃpādaya maahābhāga viśvakarmā tvam eva hi ||
bhārgavo ‘pi prayatnena bhāṇḍaughair anvitaṃ śubham |
āpākaṃ kalpayed evaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
sahasram ekaṃ bhāṇḍānāṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
saṃdhyākāle mathitvā tu hutvā vāpi hutāśanam ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā nirvāpitaṃ śataiḥ ||
raktavastraiḥ samāsādya puṣpamālābhir arcayet |
yajamānas tataḥ snātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ||
haimaraupyāni bhāṇḍāni tāmralohamayāni ca |
paritaḥ sthāpayitvā ca svaśaktyā ṭani ṣoḍaśa ||
tāni catvāri catvāri nyaset pūrvādidikkramāt |
pūjayitvā prayatnena kṛtvā vāpi prayatnataḥ ||
nāryaś cāvidhvās tatra samānīya prapūjayet |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mantreṇānena pūjayet ||
āpākabrahmasvarūpo ‘si bhāṇḍānīmāni jantavaḥ |
prajānāṃ te prajāpuṣṭiḥ svargaś cāstu mamākṣayaḥ ||
bhāṇḍarūpāṇi yāny atra kalpitāni mayā kila |
bhūtvā sattvānurūpāṇi upaniṣṭaṃ tu tāni vaḥ ||
[935] atredaṃ dānavākyam |
oṃ adya imam āpākaṃ nānābhāṇḍaracitaṃ viṣṇudaivataṃ nānājanebhyaḥ saubhāgyāvaidavyasarvaguṇopetagṛhaprāptiputrapautrādisantatisvāmyayogya-sadāmukhakāmo ‘ham utsṛjāmīti |
yo hy arthī yena bhāṇḍena tat tasya pratipādayet |
svecchayā caiva gṛhnantu na nivāryas tu kaścana ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dānam etat prayacchati |
viśvakarmā bhavet tuṣṭas tasya janmatrayaṃ nṛpa ||
nārī ca datvā saubhāgyam atulaṃ pratipadyate |
gṛhaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ bhṛtyamitrajanair vṛtam ||
aviyogaṃ sadā bhartrā rūpaṃ cānuttamaṃ labhet |
pradānam etan nirdiṣṭaṃ prakāreṇa tavānagha ||
bhidyate bahubhir bhedair bhūmir eṣa narottama ||
niṣpādya bhāṇḍanicayapravaraṃ prayatnād
āpākadānam iha yā kurute varastrī |
sā putrapautrapaśuvṛddhisukhāni labdhvā
pretyāśu bhartṛsahitā sukhinī sadāste ||
atha sthālīdānam | bhaviṣyottarāt |
athātaḥ sarvapāpaghnaṃ śubhadaṃ kathayāmi te |
dānaṃ mānakaraṃ puṃsāṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam ||
[936]        kṛtvā tāmramayīṃ sthālīṃ palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ |
aśaktas tu tadardhena caturthāṃśena vā punaḥ ||
sarvaśaktivihīnas tu mṛṇmayīm api kārayet |
sugambhīrīddaradarī (?) dṛḍhadaṇḍakaḍacchakām ||
daṇḍakaḍacchakaśabdena darvīr abhidhīyate |
mṛdutaṇḍulaniṣpannakṣīraprapūritām |
upadaṃśaudakayutāṃ ghṛtapātrasamanvitām ||
kṛtapārśvāṃ dhautavarṇāṃ carcitāṃ candanena ca |
sthāpya maṇḍalakair gandhaiḥ puṣpadhūpair athārcayet ||
āditye ‘hani saṃkrāntau caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca |
ekādaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viprāya pratipādayet ||
jvalajjvalanapārśvasthais taṇḍulaiḥ (?) sajalair api |
na bhaved bhojyasaṃsiddhir bhūtānāṃ piṣṭharīṃ vinā ||
tvaṃ siddhiḥ siddhikāmānāṃ tvaṃ tuṣṭis tuṣṭim icchatām |
atas tvāṃ praṇato yāce sa tvaṃ kuru vaco mama ||
jñātibandhusuhṛdvargavipreṣu svajanais tathā |
abhuktavatsu nāśnīyāṃ tathā bhava varapradā ||
ity uccārya pradātavyā haṇḍikā dvijapuṅgave |
tuṣṭipuṣṭipradā puṃsāṃ sarvān kāmān abhīpsatā ||
vaśiṣṭhavacanaṃ śrutvāā sā cakāra tathaiva tat |
prādāt sthālīṃ brāhmaṇānāāṃ bahūnāāṃ bahudakṣiṇām ||
sthālīṃ viśālavadanāṃ sakaḍacchakāṃ ca
yacchanti ye madhuraśunvamayīṃ dvijebhyaḥ |
[937]        teṣāṃ suhṛtsvajanaviprajanena bhojyaṃ
saṃbhujyamānam api kṛṣṇa na yāti nāśam ||
athāgniṣṭikādānam | bhaviṣyottarāt |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
agniṣṭikām ahaṃ pārtha kathayāmi nibodha tām |
yathā yena vidhānena sarvasattvasukhapradām ||
ādau mārgaśire māsi śobhane divase śubhām |
agniṣṭikāṃ kārayitvā sukhāsanavatīṃ dṛḍhām ||
devāṅgaṇe maṭhe haṭṭe vistīrṇe catvare tathā |
ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayoḥ kṛtvā suśuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhasaṃcayam ||
tataḥ prajvālayed agniṃ hutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec chaktyā tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
anena vidhinā kṛtvā pratyahaṃ jvālayet tataḥ |
yadi kaścit kṣudhārto syāt bhojyaṃ tatra prakalpayet ||
idam iha dānavākyam |
oṃ adyādi hemantaśiśirākhyam ṛtudvayaṃ yāvat sarvakālaṃ (?) vā yathāsukhaṃ sarvasattvapratāpanārtham imām agniṣṭikāṃ viṣṇudaivatāṃ (?) aparimitakālabhogyabrahmalokaprāptisarvārthasaṃpannacaturvedabrāhmaṇaṃ (?) tv akāmo ‘ham utsṛjāmīti |
sukhāsīno janas tatra viśīto vijvaras tathā |
[938]        yā karoti kathāḥ pārtha na tāḥ śakyā mayoditum ||
rājavārtā dharmavārtā janavārtā yadṛcchayā |
vadel likaḥ sukhāsīno na kenāpi nivāryate ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dadyād agniṣṭikāṃ naraḥ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājan kathyamānaṃ nibodha me ||
vimānenārkasaṃkāśe samārūḍho mahāvane |
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭir varṣaśatāni ca ||
arcito ‘tyantasaṃtuṣṭo brahmaloke mahīyate |
iha loke ‘vatīrṇaś ca caturvedo dvijo bhavet ||
nirujaḥ sattrayājī ca agnitejaḥprabhāvataḥ ||
caitye surālayasabhāvasatheṣu bhavyāṃ
ye ‘gniṣṭikāṃ pracurakāṣṭavatīṃ pradadyuḥ |
hemantaśaiśiraṛtau sukhadāṃ janānāṃ
kāyāgnidīptim amalaṃ vapur āpnuvanti ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
hemante śiśire caiva puṇyāgniṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
sarvalokasya tapārthaṃ sa puṇyāṃ gatim āpnuyāt ||
yas tāpanārthaṃ kāṣṭhāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
sarvārthās tasya siddhyanti tejasvī cābhijāyate ||
vahnipurāṇe |
ya indhanāni kāṣṭhāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
[939]        sarvalokapratāpārthaṃ sa puṇyāṅgatim āpnuyāt ||
saṃvartaḥ |
dadyāc ca śiśire vahniṃ bahukāṣṭhaṃ prayatnataḥ |
kāyāgnidīptiṃ prajñāṃ ca rūpasaubhāgyam āpnuyāt ||
indhanāni ca yo dadyād dvijebhyaḥ śiśirāgame |
nityaṃ jayati saṃgrāme śriyā yuktas tu dīpyate ||
viṣṇuḥ |
indhanapradānena dīptāgnir bhavati saṃgrāme śivam āpnoti |
yamaḥ |
indhanānāṃ pradānena dīptāgnir bhuvi jāyate |
mahābhārate |
yaś cendhanārthaṃ kāṣṭhāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati |
pratāpanārthaṃ rājendra pravṛtte śiśire naraḥ ||
siddhyanty arthāh sadā tasya kāryāṇi vividhāni ca |
upary upari śatrūṇāṃ vapuṣā dīpyate ca saḥ ||
bhavaṃś cāśu suprīto vahnir bhavati nityaśaḥ |
na taṃ tyajanti paśavaḥ saṃgrāmeṣu jayaty api ||
atha dīpadānam | mahābhārate |
[940]        dīpapradāne vakṣyāmi phalayogam anuttamam |
yathā yena yadā caiva pradeyā yādṛśāya ye ||
jyotis tejaḥ prakāśaṃ vāpy ūrdhvagatyāpi varṇyate |
pradāne tejasas tasmāt tejo vardhayate nṛṇām ||
andhaṃ tamas tamiśraṃ ca dakṣiṇāyanam eva ca |
uttarāyaṇam etasmin dīpadānaṃ praśasyate ||
yasmād ūrdhvaṃgame tat tu tamasaś caiva bheṣajam |
tasmād ūrdhvagatir dātā bhavet tatreti niścayaḥ ||
devās tejasvino yasmāt prabhāvantaḥ prakāśakāḥ |
tāmasā rājasāś ceti tasmād dīpaḥ pradīyate ||
ālokya dānāc cakṣuṣmān prabhāyukto bhaven naraḥ |
taṃ datvā nopaseveta na haren nopahiṃsayet ||
dīpahartā bhaved andhas tamogatir athāśubhā |
dīpadaḥ sarvalokeṣu dīpamālī virājate ||
giriprapāte gahane caityasthāne catuṣpathe |
dīpadātā bhaven nityaṃ ya icched bhūtim ātmanaḥ ||
kuladyotaviśuddhātmā prakāśatvaṃ sa gacchati |
jyotiṣāṃ caiva sāyojyaṃ dīpadānarataḥ sadā ||
skandapurāṇe |
śivādidevatāgāre yatīnām āśrameṣu ca |
agnihotrigṛhe caiva tathaiva ca pratiśraye ||
sarvatra śaṅkaraḥ sākṣād vasatīti vicintya ca |
[941]        satataṃ dīpakān dadyāt śrotriyāṇāṃ gṛheṣu ca ||
devalaḥ |
dīpakodyotakṛd rājā bhaven mārjanakṛn naraḥ |
vedavyāsaḥ |
yathā praśaṃsate dīpān asmatpitṛhitecchayā |
tasmād dīpaprado nityaṃ saṃtārayati vai pitṝn ||
dātavyāḥ satataṃ dīpās tasmād bharatasattama |
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca cakṣuṣyās te matāḥ prabho ||
dīpālokapradānena cakṣuṣmān jāyate naraḥ ||
yamaḥ |
loke prakāśo bhavati cakṣuṣmān api dīpataḥ |
nandipurāṇe |
dūrvākṣatais tu salilair dīpadhūpamanoramaiḥ |
dīpaṃ dadāti yo martyo surabrāhmaṇaveśmasu ||
sa tu divyena yānena mahābhānuprabhāsinā |
gacchati svargam atulaṃ vaset tatra samāḥ śatam ||
yāmyaṃ tamomayaṃ ghoraṃ vartmadurgaṃ mahābhayam |
vrajanti tena muditā ye kecid dīpadāyinaḥ ||
sakandapurāṇe |
dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvā yānti dīpapradāyinaḥ |
[942]        catuṣpatheṣu caityeṣu brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu ca ||
vṛkṣamāleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca |
dīpadānād dhi sarvatra mahāphalam upāśnute ||
vipraveśmani yo dadyāt kārttike māsi dīpakam |
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
saṃdhyādīpaprado yas tu sa gacchet paramaṃ padam ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
nīlakaṇṭhasya mokṣeṇa gayāyāṃ ca tilodakaiḥ |
varṣāsu dīpadānena pitṝṇām anṛṇo bhavet ||
yas tu brāhmaṇageheṣu dīpamālāṃ prayacchati |
sa nirvartya tamo ghoraṃ jyotiṣāṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
saṃvartaḥ |
devāgāre dvijānāṃ vā dīpaṃ datvā catuṣpathe |
medhāvī jñānasaṃpannaś cakṣuṣmāṃś ca sadā bhavet ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
mahāvattiḥ sadā deyā bhūmipālamahāphalā |
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa tatrāpi ca viśeṣataḥ ||
amāvāsyā ca nirdiṣṭā dvādaśī ca mahāphalā |
āśvayujyām atītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya vā bhavet ||
[943]        amāvāsyā tadā puṇyā dvādaśī ca viśeṣataḥ |
devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve deyā tailatulānvitāḥ ||
palāṣṭakayutā rājan varttiṃ tatraiva dāpayet |
mahārājataraktena samagreṇa tu vāsasā ||
vāmapārśve ca devasya deyā ghṛtatulā nṛpa |
palāṣṭakayutāṃ śuklāṃ varttiṃ tatrāiva dāpayet ||
vāsasā tu samagreṇa sopavāāso jitendriyaḥ |
mahāvarttidvayam idaṃ sakṛd datvā mahīpate ||
svarlokaṃ suciraṃ bhuktvā jāyate bhūtale yadā |
tadā bhavati lakṣmīvān rūpasaubhāgasaṃyutaḥ ||
rāṣṭre ca jāyate yasmin daśe ca nagare tathā |
kule ca rājaśārdūla tatra syād dīpavān prabho ||
atyujjvalaś ca bhavati yuddheṣu kalaheṣu ca |
khyātiṃ yāti sadā loke sajjanānāṃ ca sadguṇaiḥ ||
ekām apy atha yo dadyād abhīṣṭam anayor dvayoḥ |
mānuṣye sarvam āpnoti yad uktaṃ te mayānagha ||
svarge tathā samāpnoti bhogaṃ kālaṃ ca yādava |
sāmānyasya tu dīpasya rājan dānaṃ mahāphalam ||
kiṃ punar mahato yasya phalasyānto na vidyate |
dīpadānaṃ paraṃ puṇyam anyadeveṣv api dhruvam ||
kiṃ punar devadevasya anantasya mahātmanaḥ |
giriśṛṅgeṣu dātavyā nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca ||
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu brāhmaṇānāṃ ca veśmasu |
[944]        vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāre gahaneṣu ca ||
dīpadānena sarvatra mahat phalam upāśnute |
yāvanty akṣinimeṣāṇi dīpe prajvalito punaḥ ||
tāvanty eva sa rājendra varṣāṇi divi modate |
dīpadānena rājendra cakṣuṣmān iha jāyate ||
rūpasaubhāgyayuktaś ca dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ |
dīpamālāṃ prayacchanti ye narāḥ śārṅgiṇo gṛhe ||
bhavanti te candrasamāḥ svargam āsādya mānaavāḥ |
keśavāyatane datvā dīpavṛkṣaṃ manoharam ||
atīva bhrā**te lakṣmyā divam āsādya mānavaḥ |
dīpadānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā kuṇḍāgāranibhaṃ śubham ||
keśavālayam āsādya nāke bhāti sa śakravat |
yathojjvalaḥ sadā dīpo dīpadānāc ca mānavaḥ ||
tathā nityojjvalo loke nākapṛṣṭhe ‘pi jāyate |
sadīpe tu yathā deśe cakṣūṃṣi phalavanti hi ||
tathā dīpasya dātāro bhavanti saphalekṣaṇāḥ |
yathaivordhvagatir nityaṃ rājan dīpaśikhā punaḥ ||
dīpadātus tathaivordhvaṃgatir bhavati śobhanā |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīpā deyā nareśvara ||
āśvayujyām atītāyāṃ yāvad rājendra kārttikī |
tāvad dīpapradasyoktaṃ phalaṃ rājan viśeṣataḥ ||
tāvat kālaṃ prayacchanti ye tu dīpaṃ sadā niśi |
tuṅge deśe bahis teṣāṃ mahat puṇyaphalaṃ labhet ||
[945]        yasyāndhakāre gahane prākāśyaṃ tu prajāyate |
prākāśyaṃ yaduśārdūla tena yānti hi tat sukham ||
śrāvaṇe dīpakaṃ datvā nadīdvitayasaṃgame |
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca rūpavān abhijāyate ||
dīpā nadīṣu dātavyāḥ kārttikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
aśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣasya yāvat pañcadaśī bhavet ||
biladvāreṣu dātavyāḥ sadā dīpā yathāvidhi |
anyatrāpi sadā dīpair mahat puṇyaphalaṃ labhet ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ |
ghṛtena dīpā dātavyās tailair vā yadunandana ||
vasāmajjādibhir dīpā na tu deyāḥ kathaṃcana |
datvā dīpaṃ na kartavyaṃ tena karma vijānatā ||
nirvāpaṇaṃ ca dīpasy hiṃsanaṃ ca vigarhitam |
yaḥ kuryāt karmaṇā tena syād asau puṣpitekṣaṇaḥ ||
dīpahartā bhaved andhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpako bhavet |
dīpadānāt paraṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||
dīpadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vipraveśmasu paṇḍitaiḥ |
dvijaveśmani yo dadyāt kārttike māsi dīpakān |
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
prāṇijāṃ nīlaraktāṃ ca dīpavarttiṃ ca varjayet |
viśeṣeṇa ca kartavyā padmasūtrabhāvā nṛpa ||
padmasūrodbhavāṃ varttiṃ gandhatailena dīpakam |
virogaḥ subhagaś caiva datvā bhavati mānavaḥ ||
[947]        prakṣālya devadeveśa karpūreṇa ca dīpakam |
aśvamedham avāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet ||
etan mayoktaṃ tava dīpadāne
phalaṃ samagraṃ yaduvaṃśacandra |
śrutvā yathāvatsatataṃ hi deyā
dīpās tvayā viprasurālayeṣu ||
iti bhogadānāni samāptāni |
athābhayadānam | tatra viṣṇuḥ |
sarvapradānādhikābhayapradānaṃ tatpradānenābhīṣṭalokam avāpnoti |
saṃvartaḥ |
bhūtābhayapradānena sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
dīrghm āyuś ca labhate sadā ca sukhino bhavet ||
nandipurāṇe |
marutāṃ sūkṣmadehānāṃ tathā ca vyādhitātmanām |
hiṃsrāṇāṃ saumyamūrtīnāṃ tathā hy aphaladābhayam ||
varam ekasya sattvasya jīvitābhayarakṣaṇam |
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ sadakṣiṇam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
[947]        dhik tasya jīvitaṃ puṃsaḥ śaraṇārthinam āturam |
yo nārtam anugṛhṇāti vairapakṣaṃ api dhruvam ||
yajñadānatapāṃsīha parata ca na bhūtaye |
bhavanti tasya yasyārthaparitrāṇe na mānasam ||
mahābhārate |
lobhād dveṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajec charṇāgatam |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahantṝṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit ||
marutām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||
tathā |
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ hi yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imām |
sattvebhyo hy abhayaṃ yaś ca tayor abhayado ‘dhikaḥ ||
rāmāyaṇe |
baddhāñjalipuṭaṃ dīnaṃ yācantam aparādhinam |
na hanyāc charaṇaṃ prāptaṃ satāṃ dharmam anusmaran ||
ārto vā yadi vā trastaḥ pareṣāṃ śaraṇāgataḥ |
api prāṇān parityajya rakṣitavyaḥ kṣatātmanā ||
[948]        na ced bhayād vā mohād vā kāmād vā tam tttu rakṣati |
svayaṃ śaktyā yathānyāyaṃ tat pāpaṃ lokagarhitam ||
vinaṣṭaḥ paśyato yasyārakṣitaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ |
ādāya sukṛtaṃ tasmāt sarvṃ gacchaty arakṣitaḥ ||
suparyāptanisṛṣṭasya nāśvamedhasya tat phalam |
yat phalaṃ jātasaṃtrāse rakṣite śaraṇāgate ||
suparyāptanisṛṣṭasyeti, suparyāptaṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ nisṛṣṭaṃ dānaṃ yasya sa tathā |
padmapurāṇe |
sarveṣām eva dānānām idam evaikam uttamam |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nāsti dānam ataḥ param ||
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānām abhayaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
sa sarvabhayanirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
vahnipurāṇāt |
gavir uvāca |
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇm ||
nāto gurutaro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo ‘sti bhūtale |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate ||
carātmakasya sattvasya pradattaṃ jīvitābhayam |
[949]        na ca viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtam ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣayo nāsti kutaścana ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevāśrayaṃ tathā |
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
catuḥsāgaraparyāntāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imām |
abhayaṃ yasya bhūtebhyo yo dadāti tato ‘dhikam ||
api tyaje rājyam ahaṃ śarīrām vāpi dustyajam |
na tv enaṃ bhayasaṃtrasthaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakam ||
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani |
bhavet trātā mahārtānām ārtināśāya dehinām ||
na hy ahaṃkāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam |
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanam ||
yathātra nānṛtāṃ vāṇīm aham etām udāhare |
satyenānena bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
sa ekaḥ puruṣo loke sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
vadhabhītasya yaḥ kuryāt paritrāṇaṃ narottamaḥ ||
[950]        śakraloke sthitis tasya yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
tamaḥpraveśabhītasya paritrāṇena mānavaḥ ||
brahmalokam avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
tamaḥpraveśanaṃ cakṣurutpāṭādinā andhīkaraṇam |
vadhād api paraṃ pāpaṃ cakṣuṣāṃ tu vijojanam |
pārthivena na tat kāryaṃ kadācid api kasyacit ||
tamaḥpraveśanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāṃ puruṣādhamaḥ |
andhatvaṃ dhruvam āpnoti yatra yatrāpi jāyate |
api kalpasahasrāṇi tamasā hy abhuyujyate ||
aṅgacchedanabhītasya kṛtvā trāṇavinirmitam |
rudralokam avāpnoti kalpāśeṣam iti śrutiḥ ||
kalpādisarge bhavati jñānayukto naras tataḥ |
kṛtvā bandhanabhītasya paritrāṇaṃ narottamaḥ ||
sarvabandhavinirmukto vāyuloke mahīyate ||
āsedhanād vibhītasya trāṇaṃ kṛtvā tathā naraḥ |
sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktaḥ sādhyānāṃ lokam avāpnuyāt ||
tāḍanād yas tu bhītasya trāṇaṃ tatra samācaret |
sarvaduḥkhavinirmukto bhṛgūṇāṃ lokam aśnute ||
vivāsanāc ca bhītasya trāṇaṃ kṛtvā tathā naraḥ |
sarvalokam avāpnoti mānuṣye sthānam uttamam ||
dhanāpahārabhītasya trāṇaṃ kṛtvā narottamaḥ |
dānapuṇyam avāpnoti lokaṃ dānadam eva ca ||
avamānāc ca bhītasya trāṇaṃ kṛtvā narottamaḥ |
[951]        svargalokam avāpnoti pūjāṃ devagaṇāt tathā ||
naro ‘kṛtaparitrāṇaḥ puṇyaṃ kiṃcid yad ācaret |
bhāgo tasyāparitrātuḥ naraḥ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ ||
paśūnāṃ ca mṛgānāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ ca tathā dvijaḥ |
tṛṇadrumalatānāṃ ca trāṇād bhavati nākabhāk ||
vadhakasya gataṃ haste paśuṃ hṛtvā narottamaḥ |
nākalokam avāpnoti sukhī sarvatra jāyate ||
yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvadvarṣāṇi mānavaḥ |
sarvalokam avāpnoti yasya trāṇaṃ karoty asau ||
api kīṭapataṅgasya trāṇāt svargam upāśnute |
bahūny abdasahasrāṇi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
cauragrastaṃ nṛpagrastaṃ ripugrastaṃ vimokṣayet |
vyālagrastaṃ tathā viprāḥ so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
vyādhitasyauṣadhaṃ kṛtvā prāṇadānaphalaṃ labhet ||
upadeśaṃ tathā kṛtvā bhiṣakmūlyaṃ (?) vinā dvijāḥ |
prāṇadānaphalaṃ prāpya nākaloke mahīyate ||
ye rakṣaṇāyābhiratā manuṣyā
bhīrūn gātās te tridaśendralokam |
avanti nādyāpi ca te nṛvīrāḥ
kāle ‘pi teṣāṃ cyavanaṃ nāsti ||
ity abhayadānavidhiḥ |
atha pānthaśuśrūṣā |
[952] gāruḍapurāṇe |
pānthaṃ paricared yas tu śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ |
sa svalpena prayāsena jayati kratuyājinām ||
pratiśrayaṃ sunirvātaṃ śucibhūmitalaṃ śubham |
adhavanīyāya saṃpādya sadyo dahati pātakam ||
varṣāyām uṣmalatame hemante śiśireṣu ca |
grīṣme ca śītalatale pānthaṃ viśrāmy nākabhāk ||
datvā vāso vivastrāya rogiṇe rukpratikriyām |
tṛṣārtāya jalaṃ svādu mṛṣṭam annaṃ bubhukṣave |
pathikāya yathā vittaṃ sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam ||
adhvanyam anumānyāpi śākamūlaphalair jalaiḥ |
sakṛt satkṛtya vācāpi śreyaso bhājanaṃ bhavet ||
adhvagānāṃ sukhārthāya mārgasatkārakāriṇaḥ |
agādhajalasaṃcāre teṣāṃ naukādhikāriṇaḥ ||
prapām apāṃ rasair dikaiḥ pūrṇāṃ pathikahetave |
ye kurvanti naro rājan sarve te svargabhāginaḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
mārge setuṃ sukhaṃ kṛtvā vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
jalaprataraṇe setuṃ yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ |
sa tīrṇaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyo nākalokaṃ prapadyate ||
[953] tathā |
śarkarāloṣṭrapāṣāṇakaṇṛakāni tathā naraḥ |
mārgād apāsya yatnena godānaphalam āpnuyāt ||
śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtvā tad eva phalam aśnute |
vījayitvā tathā pānthaṃ tālavṛntena mānavaḥ |
skandhena śrāntam ūhyāpi vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ||
vāhanenātha yānena svedaśrāntaṃ tathā vahan |
sādhyānāṃ lokam āsādya devabhogān upāśnute ||
śrāntasya bhojanaṃ datvā sthānam āpnoti śāśvatam |
śrānte tu tarpite ** svastim āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
upānadbhyāṃ ca chatreṇa śrāntaṃ saṃyojya mānavaḥ |
saṃsthāpya śubhadeśeṣu kṣaṇād bahuphalaṃ labhet ||
bhāraśrāntāt tathā bhāraṃ gṛhītvā vahate tu yaḥ |
karmaṇā tena viprendrāḥ svargalokam upāśnute ||
mūlyena vāhayitvā yaḥ parabhāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet ||
rakṣaṇaṃ pathitaḥ kṛtvā pānthānāṃ mānavottamaḥ |
prāpya vṛddhiṃ parāṃ loke rudraloke mahīyate ||
caurebhyo rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śakraloke mahīyate |
nadītīreṣu saṃtārya pānthān pathi tathā naraḥ ||
śīghraṃ tarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃś ca parvatān |
sarvapotaṃ tathā nāvaṃ yaḥ karoti nadītaṭe ||
[954]        aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya naraḥ prāpnoti karmaṇaḥ ||
sabhāsthānāni ramyāṇi yaḥ kraroti (?) vicakṣaṇaḥ |
udyānāni vicitrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate ||
prekṣaṇīyapradānena smṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati |
pānthānāṃ hi dayā kāryā karmaṇā yena kenacit |
kṛpāsthānaṃ paraṃ pānthaḥ svagṛhād yo vinisṛtaḥ ||
liṅgī vāpy atha vā varṇī pāntho pathivicakṣaṇaiḥ |
upākhyānaiś ca kartavyaḥ pānthaḥ pūjyas tu sarvaśaḥ ||
pānthasya pūjāṃ puruṣasya kṛtvā
sthānaṃ samāsādya purandarasya |
prāpnoti puṇyair divi devabhogān
pānthās tataḥ pūjyatamā nṛloke ||
iti nānopacārāḥ |
athābhyaṅgadānam | skandapurāṇe |
tailena śubhagandhena datvābhyaṅgaṃ dvijātaye |
virūkṣya śubhacūrṇena snāpya koṣṇeṇa vāriṇā |
prāpnoti candrasālokaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam ||
yas tu mārgaparīklāntaṃ dvijātiṃ grāmakarṣitam |
tailenābhyañjayet prājñaḥ sa sukhī modate ciram ||
[955]        yaś ca pakvāditailena dvijaṃ vā keśavaṃ śivam |
saṃsnāpayati puṇyātmā kiṃ tasya bahubhir makhaiḥ ||
yo dvādaśīdine viṣṇum abhyañjayati bhaktitaḥ |
śubhagandhena tailena śaktito goghṛtena vā |
tilatailena vā loke gandarvāṇāṃ sa modate ||
sarpiṣā kapilādhenor atha vānyena sarpiṣā |
uttarāyaṇam āsādya yo ‘bhyañjayati dhūrjaṭim ||
mahāpūjāṃ ghṛtenaiva tasminn eva dine śubhe |
kṛtvā manuṣyo labhate rājyaṃ vihatakaṇṭakam ||
sarpiḥpalasahasreṇa govindasya śivasya vā |
mahāsnānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā brahmahatyāṃ nirasyati ||
padmapurāṇe |
parvaṇi brahmakūrcena yaḥ snāpayati devatām |
tasya puṇyakṛto lokā na kṣīyante kadācana ||
pañcāmṛtena yo nityaṃ puṇyakāleṣu vā punaḥ |
snapanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
brahmakūrcapañcāmṛte paribhāṣāyāṃ vyākhyāte |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
śiro’bhyaṅgena viprāṇāṃ proṣitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
surūpaḥ subhagaḥ śrīmāṃs tejasvī jāyate naraḥ ||
[956]
atha pādābhyaṅgadānam | kātyāyanaḥ |
pādābhyaṅgaiḥ śiro’bhyaṅgair dānamānārcanādibhiḥ |
mṛṣṭavākyair viśeṣeṇa pūjanīyā dvijottamāḥ ||
nandipurāṇe |
pādābhyaṅgaṃ tu yo dadyāt pānthāya parivedine |
sa śubhābharaṇaiḥ pādair vandibhir nityavanditaḥ |
bhaven nṛpo mahābhāgo maṇḍale daśayojane ||
saṃvāhya tu pariśrāntaṃ pādābhyaṅgādinā naraḥ |
dharmasya puram āpnoti sarvakāmaguṇojjvalam ||
datvā vāri mukhasparśaṃ pādābhyaṅgaṃ dvijātaye |
ucchiṣṭamārjanāc cāpi godānaphalam āpnuyāt ||
nāndīyapurāṇe |
pādābhyaṅgaṃ dvije datvā yatibhyo vāpi yatnataḥ |
surendralokam āsādya modate vigatavyathaḥ ||
adhvasphuṭitapādānāṃ parcaryāṃ karoti yaḥ |
sa sarvabhogasaṃpūrṇaṃ vimānam adhirohati ||
atha yajñopavītadānam |
[957]
āha baudhāyanaḥ |
yajñopavītadānena jāyate brahmavarcasī |
tasmāt tāni pradeyāni brāhmaṇena vipaścitā ||
vinā yajñopavītena samastā niṣphalāḥ kriyāḥ |
vinā yajñopavītena brāhmaṇyād eva hīyate |
ataḥ puṇyatamaṃ prāhus tasya dānaṃ maharṣayaḥ ||
atriḥ|
kṣaumajaṃ vātha kārpāsaṃ paṭṭasūtram athāpi vā |
yajñopavītaṃ yo dadyād ghṛtavarṇaṃ suśobhanam |
yathāśaktyā vidhānena agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
nandipurāṇe |
yajate mānavo dharmo daśavarṣāṇy asaṃśayaḥ |
yajñopavītaṃ datvā tu vidhipūrvaṃ dvijāyate ||
tathā |
yajñopavītadānena surebhyo brāhmaṇāya vā |
bhaved vipraś caturvedaḥ śuddhadhīr nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
trivṛc chuklaṃ supītaṃ vā paṭṭasūtrādinirmitam |
dattvopavītaṃ rudrāya bhaved vedāntapāragaḥ ||
[958] ādityapurāṇe |
kṣaumajaṃ vātha kārpāsaṃ paṭṭasūtram athāpi vā |
dadyād yajñopavītaṃ yas te na hiṃsanti vāyasāḥ ||
vāyuprokte |
upākarmaṇi viprebhyo dadyād yajñopavītakam |
āyuṣmān jāyate tena karmaṇā mānavo bhuvi ||
tathā |
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣasya pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
pavitrārohaṇaṃ kuryād devatānāṃ yathāvidhi ||
agnibrahmāmbikebhāsyapannagaskandabhānavaḥ |
durgāyamendragovindakāmeśāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ity etābhyo devatābhyaḥ śrāvaṇe malapakṣake |
pavitrāropaṇaṃ kurvan yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||
atha śirorogaghayajñopavītadānam | vāyupurāṇe |
upavītaṃ hiraṇyena nirmitaṃ tu palārdhataḥ |
tadardhena tadardhena yathāvibhavato ‘pi vā ||
uttarīyaṃ rājataṃ ca tāvatyā saṃkhyayā kṛtam |
brāhmaṇāya brahmavide śrotriyāyopapādayet ||
[959]        mantreṇānena vidhivat pūjitāyāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
dhātā vidhātā jagatāṃ paramātmā caturmukhaḥ |
vināśayati me kṣipraṃ rogavegaṃ śirogatam ||
dānamantraḥ |
atha garbhaśrāvaghnayajñopavītadānam |
yajñopavītaṃ kurvīta kāñcanaṃ tu svaśaktitaḥ |
atyantavarṇayuktena rājataṃ cottarīyakam ||
palārdhena tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
granthapradeśe deyaṃ tu mauktikaṃ vajram eva ca ||
prakṣālya pañcagavyena gāyatryā tāmrabhājane |
mānapramāṇaṃ tasmiṃs tu nikṣiped ājyamadhyataḥ ||
ājyasyopari saṃsthāpyam upavītaṃ supūjitam |
gandhapuṣpākṣatiar dhūpair naivedyair atibhaktitaḥ ||
tato brāhmaṇam āhūya homaṃ tatra ca kārayet |
tilair ājyena madhunā miśrair aṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||
tasmai hutavate deyaṃ vastrādyaiḥ pūjitāya tu |
mantreṇānena vidhivat prāṅmukhenopavītakam ||
upavītaṃ param idaṃ brahmaṇā vidhṛtaṃ purā |
cyavano ko ‘sya dānena garbhaṃ saṃdhāraye hy aham ||
dānamantraḥ |
phalāny api brāhmaṇebhyo yasmin kāle pradāpayet |
[960]        anuvrajya tathācāryaṃ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
garbhaśrāvabhavād doṣād evaṃ kṛtvā vimucyate ||
atha yaṣṭidānam | nāndipurāṇe |
yaṣṭiṃ vṛddhāya yo dadyāt puruṣas tu dayāparaḥ |
sadā śreyo bhaven nityaṃ gatabhīḥ svargam āpnuyāt ||
ādityapurāṇe |
yaṣṭiṃ ye tu prayacchanti netrahīne ‘the durbale |
teṣāṃ tu viphalaḥ panthāḥ phalamūlopaśobhitaḥ ||
brahmavaivarte |
ye paṅgubhyaś ca pānthebhyo dīnebhyo ‘pi dayālavaḥ |
yaṣṭidānaṃ prakurvanti nīrogās te na saṃśayaḥ ||
paṅgoś caraṇakāryāṇi yaṣṭinā kurute sadā |
gosarpādinivṛttiś ca jāyate yaṣṭidhāraṇāt ||
bhītānāṃ śaraṇaṃ yaṣṭir gacchatāṃ niśi vā vane |
śaṅkā paṅkādidoṣotthām iyam eva nirasyate |
ataḥ pravikale yaś ca yaṣṭiṃ tuṣṭikarāṃ dadet ||
skandapurāṇe |
[961]        yatibhyo vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ dvijebhyo ‘pi kanitrakam |
pradāya paraloke ‘sau yamadaṇḍaṃ na gacchati ||
pradadāti yathāvarṇaṃ yo daṇḍaṃ brahmacāriṇe |
sa mahābrāhmaṇo bhūtvā brahmavarcasam aśnute ||
atha yatyādivapanam | āha yamaḥ |
brahmacāriyatibhyaś ca vapanaṃ yas tu kārayet |
nakhakarmāṇi kurvāṇaś cakṣuṣmān jāyate naraḥ ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
yatibhyo brahmacāribhyaḥ pathikebhyas tathaiva ca |
anyeṣām api dīnānāṃ prakurvan keśakṛntanam ||
nakhānāṃ dhāvanaṃ caiva kṛtvā rūpayuto bhavet |
yas tu sarvajanārthāya keśaśmaśrunakhādikīm ||
kriyāṃ samuddiśya bhṛtiṃ nāpitāya prayacchati |
devagāreṣu tīrthe vā śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ |
sa vased āśvine loke vītaśokaḥ śataṃ samāḥ ||
atha pānthaśuśrūṣāprasaṅgeṇa goparicaryā nirūpyate | tatra brahmapurāṇe |
vandanīyāś ca pūjyāś ca gāvaḥ sevyās tu nityaśaḥ |
[962]        gavāṃ goṣthe sthitānāṃ tu yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam ||
gāvaḥ pavitramāṅgalyā gavi lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
gāgo vitanvate yajñān gāvaḥ sarvāghasūdanāḥ ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ dadhi ca rocanā |
ṣaḍaṅgam etat paramaṃ māṅgalyaṃ sarvadā gavām ||
śṛṅgodakaṃ gavāṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāghavinisūdanam |
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ caiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
gavāṃ grāsapradānena svargaloke mahīyate ||
padmapurāṇe |
sadā gāvaḥ praṇamyās tu mantreṇānena pārthiva |
namo gobhyaḥ śrīmatībhyaḥ saurabheyībhya eva ca ||
namo brahmasutābhyaś ca bhūyo bhūyo namo namaḥ |
mantrasya smaraṇād eva godānaphalam āpnuyāt ||
ādityapurāṇe |
lavaṇaṃ ca yathāśaktyā gavāṃ yo vai dadāti ca |
teṣāṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ lokā gavāṃ lokaṃ vrajanti te ||
yo ‘graṃ bhaktyā (?) kiṃcid aprāśya dadyād
gobhyo nityaṃ govratī satyavādī |
[963]        śānto buddho gosahasrasya puṇyaṃ
saṃvatsareṇāpnuyād dharmaśīlaḥ ||
devīpurāṇe |
gopālako gavāṃ goṣṭhe yas tu dhūmaṃ na kārayet |
makṣikālīnanarake makṣikābhiḥ sa bhakṣyate ||
mṛtavatsāṃ tu gāṃ yas tu damitvā pibate naraḥ |
vāhitāsyāś ciraṃ tiṣṭhet kṣudhārto vai narādhamaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
gokulasya tṛṣārtasya jalānte vasudhādhipa |
utpādayati yo vighnaṃ tam āhur brahmaghātakam ||
kṛtvā gavārthe śaraṇaṃ śītavātakṣamaṃ mahat |
āsaptamaṃ tārayati kulaṃ bharatasattama ||
brahmapurāṇe |
sadoṣā gaur gṛhe jātā paripālyā sadā svayam |
duḥśīlo ‘pi dvijaḥ pūjya na tu śūdraḥ sasaṃyataḥ ||
anāthānāṃ gavāṃ yatnāt kāryas tu śiśire maṭhaḥ |
puṇyārthaṃ yatra dīyante tṛṇatoyendhanāni ca ||
hārītaḥ |
dvau māsau pāyīyed vatsaṃ tṛtīye dvistanaṃ druhet |
[964]        caturthe tristanaṃ caiva yathānyāyaṃ yathābalam ||
brahmapurāṇe |
āṣāḍhyām āśvayujyāṃ ca pauṣyāṃ mādhyāṃ ca sarvadā |
na gṛhṇīyād gavāṃ kṣīraṃ sarvaṃ vatsāya nikṣipet ||
na ṣaṇḍān vāhayec caiva na gāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍayet |
yugādiṣu yugānteṣu ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca ||
dakṣiṇottarage sūrye tathā viṣuvator dvayoḥ |
saṃkrāntiṣu ca ca sarvāsu grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyām aṣtamīṣu ca |
upacāro gavāṃ kāryo māsi māsi yathākramam ||
lavaṇasya tu catvāri palāny aṣṭau ghṛtasya ca |
parakīyasya dugdhasya tathā deyāni ṣoḍaśa ||
dvātriṃśat śītalasyāpi jalasya ca palāni ca |
ādau vicārya payasaḥ parimāṇaṃ valaṃ ruci ||
ākasmikaṃ tu dātavyaṃ puṇyārthaṃ tu gavāhnikam |
prabhāte lavaṇaṃ yatra dīyate ca tato jalam ||
tatas tṛṇāni bhojyaṃ ca poṣaṇaṃ māṃsavarjitam |
niśi dīpaḥ satantrīko divyā paurāṇikī tathā ||
evaṃ kṛte mahīṃ purṇāṃ ratnair datvā bhavet phalam |
gopradānāya yat puṇyaṃ gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇād bhavet ||
manuṣyais tṛṇagoyādyair gāvaḥ pālyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
deyāḥ pūjyāś ca poṣyāś ca pratipālyāś ca sarvadā ||
[965] tathā |
tṛṇodakādyeṣu vaneṣu mattāḥ
krīḍantu gāvaḥ savṛṣāḥ savatsāḥ |
kṣīraṃ pramuñcantu sukhaṃ svapantu
śītātapavyādhibhayair vimuktāḥ ||
imaṃ mantraṃ sa śudhātmā japen nityaṃ samāhitaḥ |
gacchan tiṣṭhan japan jighran bhuñjan krīḍan samutsṛjet ||
mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu sameṣu viṣameṣu ca |
prayāṇakāle ca tathā srtotavyam abhayapradam ||
tathā |
ghāsagrāsādikaṃ deyaṃ niśi dīpaḥ subhāsvaraḥ |
itihāsapurāṇānāṃ vyākhyānaṃ sopavīṇanam ||
antastuṣṭair yathāśaktyā paricaryā yathākramam |
tāḍanākrośakhedāś ca svapne ‘pi na kadācana ||
tāsāṃ mūtrapurīṣe tu nodvegaḥ kriyate kvacit |
śodhanīyaś ca govāṭaḥ śuṣkakṣārādikaiḥ sadā ||
grīṣme vṛkṣākule veśma śītatoye vikardame |
varṣāsu cātha śiśire sukhoṣṇe vātavarjite ||
ucchiṣṭaṃ mūtraviṭśleṣmamalaṃ jahyān na tatra ca |
rajasvalā na praveśyā nāntyajātir na puṃścalī ||
na laṅghayed vatsatantrīṃ na krīḍed goṣṭhasaṃnidhau |
na gantavyaṃ gavāṃ madhye sopānatkaiḥ sapādukaiḥ ||
[966]        hastyaśvarathayānaiś ca savitānaiḥ kadācana |
dakṣiṇottaragaiḥ prahvair gantavyaṃ ca padātibhiḥ ||
gāvaḥ kṛṣāturāḥ pālyāḥ śraddhayā pitṛmātṛvat |
giriprapātasiṃharkṣasītātapabhayāturāḥ ||
mahākolāhale ghore durdine deśaviplave |
gavāṃ tṛṇāni deyāni śītalaṃ tathā jalam ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
puṣkara uvāca |
gavāṃ hi pālanaṃ rājñā kartavyaṃ bhṛgunandana |
gāvaḥ pavitrā māṅgalyā goṣu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
gāvo vitanvate yajñaṃ gāvo viśvasya mātaraḥ |
śakṛnmūtaṃ paraṃ tāsām alakṣmītāpanaṃ param ||
tad dhi medhyaṃ prayatnena tatra lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā |
udvegaś na gantavyaḥ śakṛnmūtravyajānatā ||
gavāṃ mūtrapurīṣe tu ṣṭhīvanādyaṃ na saṃtyajet |
gorajaḥ paramaṃ puṇyam alakṣmīvighnanāśanam ||
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ caiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
gavāṃ śṛṅgodakaṃ rāma jāhnavījalasaṃnibham ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam |
pavitraṃ paramaṃ jñeyaṃ snāne pāne ca bhārgava ||
[967]        rakṣoghnam etan māṅgalyaṃ kaliduḥkhapranāśanam |
rocanā ca tathā dhanyā rakṣogadagarāpahā ||
yas tu kalyaṃ samutthāya mukham ājye nirīkṣate |
tasyālakṣmīḥ kṣayaṃ yāti vardhate na ca kilbiṣam ||
gavāṃ grāmapradānena puṇyaṃ sa mahad aśnute |
yāvatīḥ śaknuyād gāvaḥ sukhaṃ dhārayituṃ gṛhe |
dhārayet tāvatīr nityaṃ kṣudhitās tā na dhārayet ||
duḥkhitā dhenavo yatra vasanti dvijamandire |
narakaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
datvā paragave grāmaṃ puṇyaṃ sa mahad aśnute ||
śiśiraṃ sakalaṃ kālaṃ grāsaṃ paragave yathā |
datvā svargam avāpnoti saṃvatsaraśatāni ṣaṭ ||
agrabhaktaṃ naro datvā nityam eva tathā gavām |
samāṣṭakena labhate nākalokasamāyutam ||
sāyaṃ prātar manuṣyāṇām aśanaṃ vedanirmitam |
tathaikam aśanaṃ datvā gavāṃ nityam atandritaḥ ||
dvitīyaṃ yaḥ samaśnāti tena saṃvatsarān naraḥ |
gavāṃ lokam avāpnoti yāvan manvantaraṃ dvijaḥ ||
śītatrāṇaṃ gavāṃ kṛtvā gṛhe puruṣasattama |
gavāṃ prapāne pānīyaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasattama |
vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnoti krīḍaty apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
[968]        gavāṃ pānapravṛttānāṃ yas tu vighnaṃ samācaret |
brahmahatyā kṛtā tena ghoro bhavati bhārgava |
parāṃ tṛptim avāpnoti yatra tatrābhijāyate ||
gavāṃ pracārabhūmiṃ tu vāhayitvā halādinā |
narakaṃ mahad āpnoti yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
siṃhavyāghrabhayatrastāṃ paṅkalagnāṃ jale gatām |
gām uddhṛtya naraḥ svarge kalpabhogān upāśnute ||
gavāṃ lavaṇadānena rūpavān abhijāyate |
saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnoti lāvaṇyaṃ ca dvijōttama ||
auṣadhaṃ ca tathā datvā virogas tv abhijāyate |
auṣadhaṃ lavaṇaṃ toyam āhāraṃ ca praycchati ||
tāsāṃ ced avaruddhānāṃ carantīnāṃ mitho vane |
yām utplutya vṛko hanyān na pālas tatra kilbiṣī ||
govadhena naro yāti narakān ekaviṃśatim |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kāryaṃ tāsāṃ tu pālanam ||
vikrayāc ca gavāṃ rāma narakaṃ pratipadyate |
tāsāṃ tu kīrtanād eva naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate ||
tāsāṃ saṃsparśanaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
dānena ca tathā tāsāṃ kulāny api samuddharet ||
udakyāsūtikādoṣo naiva tatra gṛhe bhavet |
bhūmidoṣas tathānye ‘pi yatraikā vasate ca gauḥ ||
gavāṃ niḥśvāsavātena parā śāntir gṛhe bhavet |
nīrājanaṃ tat paramaṃ sarvasthāneṣu kīrtyate ||
[969]        gavāṃ saṃsparśanād rāma kalmaṣaṃ kṣīyate nṛṇām ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam |
ekarātropavāsaś ca śvapākam api śodhayet |
pṛthak ca pratyayābhyas tam iti sāntapanaṃ smṛtam ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ rāma sarvāśubhavināśanam |
kṛtvātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasān ekaviṃśatim ||
nirmalās tena cīrṇena bhavanti puruṣottamāḥ ||
tryaham uṣṇaṃ piben mūtraṃ tryaham uṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet |
tryaham uṣṇaṃ payaḥ pītvā vāyubhakṣaḥ paraṃ tryaham |
taptakṛcchram idaṃ proktaṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam ||
śītakṛcchras tathaivaiṣa kramāc chītaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
sarvāśubhavināśāya nirmito brahmaṇā svayam ||
gomūtreṇācaret snānaṃ vṛttiṃ kuryāc ca gorasaiḥ |
utthitāsūtthitas tiṣṭhed upaviṣṭāsu ca sthitaḥ ||
abhuktavatsu nāśnīyād apītāsu ca no pibet |
trāṇaṃ caivātmanaḥ kāryaṃ bhayārtāś ca samuddharet ||
ātmānam api saṃtyajya govrataṃ tat prakīrtitam |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ māsenaikena bhārgava ||
vratenānena pūrṇena golokaṃ puruṣo vrajet |
abhīṣṭam atha vā rāma yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
gavām āhāranirmuktān aśnan pratidinaṃ yavān |
māsena tad avāpnoti yat kiṃcin manasecchati ||
gomatīṃ ca tathā vidyāṃ sāyaṃ prātas tathā japet |
[970]        golokam āpnoti naro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
upary upari sarveṣāṃ gavāṃ lokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
na vasanti sadā yatra gāvas tv ākāśagā divi |
vimāneṣu vicitreṣu vṛteṣv apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
kiṅkiṇījālacitreṣu vīṇāsu racanādiṣu |
sadā kāmaphalā nadyaḥ kṣīrapāyasakardamāḥ ||
śītalāmalapānīyāḥ suvarṇasikatās tathā |
puṣkariṇyaḥ śubhās tatra vaidūryakamalotpalāḥ ||
mānasī ca tathā siddhis tatra loke bhṛgūttama |
taṃ tu lokaṃ narā yānti gavāṃ bhaktyā na saṃśayaḥ ||
gomatīṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm |
tāṃ tu me gadato vipra śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ ||
gāvaḥ surabhayo nityaṃ gāvo guggulagandhikāḥ |
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ svatyayanaṃ param ||
annam eva paraṃ gāvo devānāṃ havir uttamam |
pāvanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ rakṣanti ca vahanti ca ||
haviṣā mantrapūtena tarpayanty amarān divi |
ṛṣīṇām agnihotreṣu gāvo homaniyojitāḥ ||
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ śaraṇam uttamam |
gāvaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ gāvo maṅgalam uttamam ||
gāvaḥ svargasya sopānaṃ gāvo dhanyāḥ sanātanāḥ |
namo gobhyaḥ śrīmatībhyaḥ saurabheyībhya eva ca |
namo brahmasutābhyaś ca pavitrābhyo namo namaḥ ||
[971]        brāhmaṇāś caiva gāvaś ca kulam ekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam |
ekatra mantrās tiṣṭhanti havir ekatra tiṣṭhati ||
devabrāhmaṇagosādhusādhvībhiḥ sakalaṃ jagat |
dhāryate vai yadā kasmāt sarve pūjyatamā matāḥ ||
yatra tīrthe sadā gāvaḥ pibanti tṛṣitā jalam |
uttaranty atha vā yena sthitā tatra sarasvatī ||
gavāṃ hi tīrthe ca satīha gaṅgā
puṣṭis tathāsāṃ rajasi pravṛddhā |
lakṣmīḥ karīṣe praṇato ca dharmas
tāsāṃ praṇāmaṃ satataṃ ca kuryāt ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
gām ālabhya namas kṛtya kuryād yas tu pradakṣiṇam |
pradakṣiṇī kṛtā tena sapatadvīpā vasundharā ||
gavāṃ huṅkāraśabdena dṛṣṭipātena sattama |
pāpaṃ praṇaśyate yasmāt tasmāt paśyan spṛśec ca tāḥ ||
kutas tasya bhavet pāpaṃ gṛhaṃ yasya vibhūṣitam |
satataṃ bālavatsābhir junībhir alaṃkṛtam ||
yāvat tīrthāni medinyām āsamudrasarāṃsi ca |
[972]        gavāṃ śṛṅgodakasnānakalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
gavām asthi na laṅgheta mṛte gandhaṃ na varjayet |
yāvad āghrāti tad gandhaṃ tāvat puṇyena yujyate ||
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ dhanyaṃ gopradānaphalapradam |
tulyaṃ gośatadānasya bhayarogādipālanam ||
tṛṇodakādisaṃyuktaṃ yaḥ pradadyād gavāhnikam |
kapilāśatadānasya phalaṃ vidyān na saṃśayaḥ ||
pañcabhūte śive puṇye pavitre sūryasaṃbhave |
pratīchedaṃ mayā dattaṃ saurabheyi namo ‘stu te ||
bahunā ca kim uktena gāvaḥ pālyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
gāvo deyās tathā rakṣyāḥ pūjyā grāhyāś ca sarvaśaḥ ||
gāvo ye tāḍayantīha sarvalokasya mātaraḥ |
te yānti rauravaṃ nāma narakaṃ nātra saṃśāyaḥ ||
tāḍayed yas tu vai mohād yo vā kaścin narādhamaḥ |
sa gacchen narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃpīḍakam iti śrutiḥ ||
āyāntīṃ hantukāmāṃ yaḥ saurabheyīṃ vibhāvarīm |
kṣama mātar iti brūyāt sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
varāhapurāṇe |
yama uvāca |
gāvaḥ pavitraṃ māṅgalyā devānām api devatāḥ |
[973]        yas tāḥ śuśrūṣate bhaktyā sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate |
yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
lāṅgūlenoddhṛtaṃ toyaṃ mūrdhā gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ |
śaratsu hy apajātebhyaḥ sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ||
prasrave yo gavāṃ snāyāt rohiṇyṃ mānavo bhuvi |
sarvapāpakṛtān doṣān dahaty āśu na saṃśayaḥ ||
dhenoḥ stanād viniṣkrāntāṃ dhārāṃ kṣīrasya yo naraḥ |
śirasā pratigṛhṇīyāt sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ||
iti goparicaryā |
athānnadānam | mahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi dānadharmāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kāni dānāni loke ‘smin dārukāmo mahīpatiḥ |
guṇādhikebhyo viprebhyo dadyād bharatasattama ||
kena tuṣyati te sadyas tuṣṭāḥ kiṃ pradiśanti ca |
śaṃsa caitan mahābāho phalaṃ puṇyakṛtaṃ mahat ||
kiṃ dattaṃ phalavad rājann iha loke paratra ca |
bhavataḥ śrotum icchāmi tan me vistarato vada ||
[974]                bhīṣma uvāca |
imam arthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo nārado devadarśanaḥ |
yad uktavān asau tan me gadataḥ śṛṇu bhārata ||
nārada uvāca |
annam eva praśaṃsanti devā ṛṣīgaṇāsurāḥ |
lokatantrā hi saṃjñāś ca sarvam anne pratiṣṭhitam ||
annena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātum icchanti mānavāḥ ||
annam ūrjaskaraṃ loke prāṇāś cānne pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
annena dhāryate viśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagad idaṃ prabho ||
annād gṛhasthā loke ‘smin bhikṣavas tata eva ca |
annāt prabhavati prāṇaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kuṭumbaṃ pīḍayitvāpi brāhmaṇāya mahātmane |
dātavyaṃ bhikṣave cānnam ātmano bhūtim icchatā ||
brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya yo dadyād annam arthine |
vidadhāti nidhiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paraloke kim ātmanaḥ ||
ārtam adhvanivartantaṃ vṛddhaṃ dvijam upasthitam |
arcayed bhūtim anvicchan śrotriyaṃ gṛham āgatam ||
krodham utpatitaṃ hitvā suśīlo vītamatsaraḥ |
annadaḥ prāpnute rājan divi ceha ca tat sukham ||
nāvamanyed abhigataṃ na praṇudyāt kathaṃcana |
api śvapāke śuni vā na dānaṃ vipraṇaśyati ||
[975]        yo dadyād aparikliṣṭam annam adhvani vartate |
śrāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya sa mahādharmam āpnuyāt ||
pitṝn devāṃs tathā viprāṃs tīrthānica narādhipa |
yo naraḥ prīṇayaty annais tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ||
kṛtvāpi pātakaṃ karma yo dadyād annam arthine |
brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena yujyate ||
brāhmaṇeṣv akṣayaṃ dānam annaṃ śūdre mahatphalam |
annadānaṃ hi śūdre ca brāhmaṇebhyo viśiṣyate ||
na pṛcched gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ deśam eva vā |
bhikṣite brāhmaṇe ceha dadyād annaṃ prayāti ca ||
annadasyānnavṛkṣāś ca sarvakāmaphalānvitāḥ |
bhavantīhātha cāmutra nṛpate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
āśaṃsate hi pitaraḥ suvṛṣṭim iva karṣakāḥ |
asmākam api putro vā pautro vānnaṃ pradāsyati ||
brāhmaṇo hi mahad bhūtaṃ svayaṃ dehīti yācate |
akāmaś ca sakāmo vā datvā puṇyam avāpnuyāt ||
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānām atithiḥ prabhṛtāgrabhuk |
viprā yam abhigacchanti bhikṣamāṇā gṛhaṃ sadā ||
satkṛtāś ca nivartante tad atīva pravartate |
mahābhogakule janma pretya prāpnoti bhārata ||
datvā tv annaṃ naro loke tathā sthānam anuttamam |
iṣṭamiṣṭānnadāyī ca svarge vasati satkṛtaḥ ||
annaṃ pāṇā narāṇāṃ hi sarvam anne pratiṣṭhitam |
[976]        annadaḥ paśumān putrī dhanavān bhogavān api ||
prāṇavāṃś cāpi bhavati rūpavāṃś ca tathā nṛpa |
annadaḥ prāṇado loke sarvadaḥ procyate sa ca ||
annaṃ hi datvātithaye brāhmaṇāya yathāvidhi |
pradātā sukham āpnoti devaiś cāpi prapūjyate ||
brāhmaṇo hi mahad bhūtaṃ kṣetraṃ carati pādavat |
upyate yatra yad bījaṃ tad dhi puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ||
pratyakṣaprītijananaṃ bhoktṝṇām annam eva ca |
sarvāṇīhānnadānāni parokṣe phalavanty ataḥ ||
annād dhi prasavaṃ viddhi ratim annāc ca pārthiva |
dharmārthāv annato viddhi roganāśaṃ tathānnataḥ ||
annaṃ hy amṛtam ity āhuḥ purā kāle prajāpatiḥ |
annaṃ bibharti lokasya śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ||
annaṃ divyaṃ tu puruṣaṃ sarvaṃ hy anne pratiṣṭhitam |
annapraṇāśe bhidyante śarīre pañcadhātavaḥ ||
balaṃ balavato ‘pīha paṇaśyaty annahānitaḥ |
āvahāś ca vicāhāś ca yajñāś cānte ‘mṛte tathā ||
na vartante naraśreṣṭha brahman cānnaṃ pramīyate |
annadaḥ sarvam etad dhi yat kiṃcit sthāṇujaṅgamam ||
triṣu lokeṣu dharmārtham annaṃ deyam ato budhaiḥ |
annadasya manuṣyasya balam ojo yaśaḥ sukham ||
kīrtiś ca vardhate yasya triṣu lokeṣu pārthiva |
medheṣv adattaṃ naivaitat prāṇināṃ patanaṃ śivaḥ ||
[977]        na ca meghagataṃ vāri śakro varṣati bhārata ||
ādatte ca rasaṃ bhaumam ādityaḥ svagabhastibhiḥ |
vāyur ādityataś cāntaścaro devaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
tad yadā meghato vāri patitaṃ bhavati kṣitau |
tadā vasumatī devī snigdhā bhavati bhārata ||
tataḥ sasyāni rohanti yair etad vartate jagat |
māṃsamedh’sthiśukrāṇāṃ prādurbhāvas tataḥ punaḥ ||
saṃbhavanti tataḥ śukrāt prāṇinaḥ pṛthivīpate |
agnīṣomau hi tacchukraṃ prajanaṃ puṣyataś ca ha ||
evam annaṃ ca sūryaś ca pavanaḥ sarva eva ca |
eka eva smṛto rāśir yato bhūtāni jajñire ||
prāṇān dadhāti bhūtānāṃ prajāś ca bharatarṣabha |
gṛham abhyāgatāyāśu yo dadyād annam arthine ||
bhīṣma uvāca |
nāradenaivam ukto ‘ham adām annaṃ sadā nṛpa |
annaṃ sūryas tvam apy annaṃ tasmād dehi yudhiṣṭhira ||
datvānnaṃ vidhivad rājan dvijebhyas tvam api prabho |
yathāvad anurūpebhyas tataḥ svargam avāpsyati ||
annadānād dhi ye lokās tān śṛṇuṣva narādhipa ||
bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām |
nānāsaṃsthānarūpāṇi nānāstambhānvitāni ca ||
[978]        candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca |
taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ||
anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca |
vaidūryārkaprakāśāni rūkmarūpyamayāni ca ||
sarvakāmaphalāś cāpi vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ |
vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhā prapā dīrghikāś caiva sarvataḥ ||
ghoṣavanti ca yānāni yuktāny atha sahasraśaḥ |
bhakṣabhojyamayā śālā vāsāṃsy ābharaṇāni ca ||
kṣīraṃ svarantyaḥ saritas tathā caivānnaparvatāḥ |
prāsādāḥ pāṇḍurābhāsāḥ śayyāś ca kanakojjvalāḥ |
tān annadāḥ prāpnuvanti tasmād annaprado bhava ||
ete lokāḥ puṇyakṛtām annadānān mahātmanām |
tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavair bhuvi ||
agnipurāṇāt |
annadānasya māhātmyaṃ sarvebhyo munisattamaiḥ |
sukhaprītikaraṃ proktaṃ kathayāmi tavānagha ||
dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnaṃ nṛpottama |
sadyas tuṣṭikaraṃ loke kiṃ dattenāpareṇa te ||
purākalpe tu rāmeṇa yad uktaṃ vidhinānuga |
nirvedād devadevena tathāpi kathayāmi te ||
pṛthivyām annapūrṇāyāṃ vayam annasya kāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
saumitre nūnam asmābhir na brāhmaṇamukhe hutam ||
[979]        yad upyate svake dāre tasyāvaśyaṃ phalaṃ naraiḥ |
prāpyate lakṣaṇāsmābhir na brāhmaṇamukhe hutam ||
yan na prāpyaṃ na tat prāpyaṃ vidyayā pauruṣeṇa vā |
satyaṃ loke pravādo ‘yaṃ na dattam upatiṣṭhate ||
bhakṣopayogād annasya dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ param |
prakārāntarabhojyāni dānāny anyāni pārthiva ||
snātānām anuliptānāṃ bhūṣitānāṃ ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ |
na sukhaṃ na ca santoṣo bhaved annād ṛte nṛṇām ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇām annaṃ paramasādhanam |
annaṃ prajapatiḥ sākṣād annaṃ viṣṇus tathā śivaḥ |
tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavair bhuvi ||
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
annadānaṃ guṇakaraṃ sarvadānādhikaṃ nṛṇām |
annād dhi prāṇajananaṃ nṛṇāṃ vai jāyate sadā ||
prāṇāpyāyanamātraṃ tu yo viprāya prayacchati |
durbhikṣe ‘tra viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavair bhuvi ||
devalaḥ |
kṛtvā tu pātakaṃ karma yo dadyād annam īpsitam |
brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa nihanty ātmanas tamaḥ ||
ādareṇa ca bhaktyā ca yad annam upadīyate |
tat prīṇayati gātrāṇi nāmṛtaṃ mānavarjitam ||
[980]        durlabhas tu mudā dātā bhoktāraś ca sudurlabhāḥ |
mudā dātā ca bhoktā ca tāv ubhau svargavāsinau ||
yo ‘nnaṃ bahumataṃ bhuṅkte yaś cānnaṃ nāvamanyate |
yaś cānnaṃ prītito dadyāt tasyānnam upatiṣṭhate ||
prītito ‘nnaṃ ca yo dadyād gṛhṇīyād yo ‘bhipūjya ca|
prītito ‘kṣayam aśnāti pūjitaḥ svargam aśṇute ||
yo dadyād apriyeṇānnaṃ yaś cānnaṃ nābhinandati |
tāv ubhau narake magnau vasetāṃ śaradaḥ śatam ||
skandapurāṇe |
sarveṣām eva dānānām annadānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ divyaṃ balabuddhivivardhanam ||
nānnadānasamaṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate |
annād bhavanti bhūtāni mriyante tadabhāvataḥ ||
garbhasthā jāyamānāś ca bālavṛddhāś ca madhyaamāḥ |
āhāram abhikāṅkṣanti devadānavatāpasāḥ ||
kṣudhā hi sarvarogāṇāṃ vyādhiḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tasyānnauṣadhalepena pratīkāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
annadaḥ prāṇadaḥ proktaḥ prāṇadaś cāpi sarvadaḥ |
tasmād annapradānena sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dehaḥ paramasādhanam |
sthitis tasyānnapānābhyām atas tat sarvasādhanam ||
annaṃ prajāpatiḥ sākṣād annaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ svayam |
[981]        tasmād annasamaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtam na bhaviṣyati ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
haṃsa uvāca |
sarveṣām eva dānānām annadānaṃ viśiṣyate |
annadānāt paraṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||
nātra pātraparīkṣā syān na kālaniyamas tathā |
na ca deśaḥ parīkṣyo ‘tra deyam annaṃ sadaiva tat ||
śvabhyaś ca śvapacebhyaś ca patitebhyas tathaiva ca |
kṛmikīṭapataṅgebhyo deyam annaṃ sadaiva hi ||
annaṃ hi jīvitaṃ loke prāṇāś cānnanibandhanāḥ |
annadaḥ prāṇado loke sarvadaś ca tathānnadaḥ ||
bhuktvā tathā ca yasyannaṃ santatiḥ syād dvijottama |
jñātavyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha yasyānnaṃ tasya santatiḥ ||
dātavyaṃ sarvavarṇebhyo bhoktavyaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu |
yasyānnenodarasthena brāhmaṇo mriyate dvijāḥ |
tāṃ tu yonim avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
bhakṣadaḥ svargam āpnoti śakralokaṃ tu bhojyadaḥ |
lehyado ‘psarasāṃ lokaṃ vasūnām api cūṣyadaḥ ||
vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnoti tathā pānado naraḥ |
pānakāni sugandhīni śītalāni prayacchati |
sarvakāmasamṛddhaś ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
[982]        paramānnapradānena tṛptir bhavati śāśvatī |
pipāsayā na mriyate gavāṃ loke mahīyate ||
guḍapradas tathārogyaṃ sarvān kāmān madhupradaḥ |
ghṛtado jīvitaṃ dīrgham ārogyaṃ tailadas tathā ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti lavaṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
saktudas tṛptim āpnoti sikatādas tathā śrityam |
akīrtitānām anyeṣāṃ dānāt svargam avāpnuyāt ||
atha bhagavatīpurāṇe |
lavaṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ guḍaṃ hiṅguṃ ca bhārata |
kadukhaṇḍaṃ jīrakaṃ ca patraṃ śākaṃ ca śobhanam ||
datvā sukhī syād iti śeṣaḥ | padmapurāṇe |
guḍam ikṣurasaṃ caiva lavaṇaṃ vyañjanāni ca |
surabhīṇi ca pānāni datvātyantaṃ sukhī bhavet ||
āha yamaḥ |
gorasānāṃ pradānena tṛptim āpnoty anuttamām |
ghṛtapradānena tathā dīrghaṃ vindati jīvitam ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
[983]        lavaṇasya ca dātāras tilānāṃ sarpiṣāṃ tathā |
tejasvino ‘bhijāyante bhoginaś cirajīvinaḥ ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vasāṃ śukraṃ kramād annāt pravartate |
śukrād bhavanti bhūtāni tasmād annamayaṃ jagat ||
hemaratnāśvanāgendracandrasrakcandanādibhiḥ |
samastair api saṃprāptair na ramante bubhukṣitāḥ ||
nāsti kṣudhāsamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti rogaḥ kṣudhāsamaḥ |
nāsty āhārasamaṃ saukhyaṃ nāsti krodhasamaṃ ripuḥ ||
ata eva mahat puṇyam annadānapradānataḥ |
yataḥ kṣudhāgnisaṃtaptā mriyante sarvadehinaḥ ||
trailokye yāni ratnāni bhogastrīvāhanāni ca |
annadānapradaḥ sarvam ihāmutra samaśnute ||
yasyānnapānapuṣṭhāṅgaḥ kurute puṇyasaṃcayam |
annapradātus tasyārdhaṃ kartuś cārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
brahmavaivarte |
yasya hy annam upāśnanti brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ samāḥ |
hṛṣṭena manasā dattaṃ na sa tiryaggatir bhavet ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi daś bhojyā nararṣabha |
naro ‘dharmāt pramucyeta pāpeṣv api rataḥ sadā ||
bhojayitvā daśaśataṃ naro brahmvidāṃ nṛpa |
nyāyaviddharmaviduṣāṃ smṛtibhāṣyavidāṃ tathā ||
[984]        na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārāṃś ca na sevate ||
yajed brāhmaṇapūrvaṃ tu bhoktum annaṃ sadā gṛhī |
avandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryād annadānena mānavaḥ ||
bhaikṣyeṇānnaṃ samāhṛtya viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati |
svādhyāyanirato vipro datveha sukham edhate ||
sarvāvasthaṃ manuṣyeṇa nyāyenānnam upārjitam |
kāryaṃ pātragataṃ nityam annaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ ||
tathā |
kaumude śuklapakṣe tu yo ‘nnadānaṃ karoty ataḥ |
sa saṃtarati durgāṇi pretya cānantyam aśnute ||
nandipurāṇe |
annād bhūtāni jātāni devā hy annādyakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
na tasya pātrādividhir vinā śrāddhaṃ prakīrtitam ||
tathā |
api kīṭapataṅgānāṃ śunāṃ cāṇḍālayoninām |
datvānnaṃ lokam āpnoti prājāpatyaṃ samāsataḥ ||
bāndhavebhyo ‘tithibhyo ‘nnaṃ mitrebhyaś ca prayacchatām |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca svargaḥ syād annadāyinām ||
grāsamātraṃ naro datvā bhūtānām annagṛdhnate |
svargaṃ vaset samānāṃ tu śataṃ bhogair manoramaiḥ ||
grāse grāse phalaṃ hy etad vidhivat parikīrtitam |
[985]        etad devāya te proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ puṇyagauravam ||
annaṃ vinā kṛśāntasya datvānnaṃ deśakālataḥ |
phalaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvabhāvasamanvitam ||
rājasādibhāvasamanvitam ity arthaḥ |
devatānāṃ tu yo dadyād annādyaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ |
sikthāsikthād vasel lakṣaṃ samānām amaraiḥ saha ||
etaddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyam anne vyañjanasaṃyute |
yatheṣṭadevatādattād etat puṇyaṃ prakīrtitam ||
yo dadyād brāhmaṇe ‘nnāni tasya dviguṇitaṃ phalam |
tasmād viṣṇau ca datvānnaṃ dviguṇṃ phalam aśnute ||
rudrāyānnapradānena phalam etaccaturguṇam |
śraddhākālasamāyogād vyañjanānāṃ ca yogataḥ ||
śatasaṃkhyaṃ bhavet puṇyaṃ samyag annapradāyinām ||
laghuhārītaḥ |
upapannaṃ yathā hy annaṃ bhuñjate samupasthite |
āpītarasam ucchiṣṭaṃ na dadyān naiva homayet ||
vyāsaḥ |
yas tv ekapaṅktyāṃ viṣamaṃ dadāti

[986] atriḥ |

devalaḥ |
aghṛtaṃ bhojayan vipraṃ svagṛhe sati sarpiṣi |

haṃsa uvāca |
[987]        dhānyānām uttamaṃ dānaṃ kathitaṃ dvijapuṅgavaiḥ |

viṣṇudharmottare |
pānīyam eva saphalaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
vikāraḥ salilasyedaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā |
pānīyena vinā vṛttir loke nāstīha karhicit ||
kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ jalam eva parāyaṇam |
yatrodakaṃ tatra surāḥ sarva eva pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
yatrodakaṃ tatra tathā ṛṣayaś ca mahāvratāḥ |
durlabhaṃ tac ca lokānāṃ paraloke dvijottamāḥ ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
mūlyena kṛtvā dharmānnajaladānaṃ prayacchati |
[991]        prayāti candrasālokyaṃ (?) śubhamālāṃśukāvṛtaḥ ||
kṣīrakulyās tam āyānti tathā yānti madhusravāḥ |
ghṛtadadhyudakās tasya samudrā vaśavartinaḥ ||
dināni bahu jīvanti annena rahitāḥ kila |
na hi toyavihīnas tu dinam ekaṃ hi jīvati ||
sarvaprado naravyāghra jaladānāt prakīrtitaḥ |
udake sarvabījāni ity eva gauṇikī smṛtiḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
trayāṇām api lokānām udakaṃ jīvanaṃ smṛtam |
pavitram amṛtaṃ tasmāt tad deyaṃ puṇyam icchatā ||
atha karapavitrakādidānāni | devalaḥ |
satoyāṃ pathike vipre yo dadyāt karapatrikām |
phalaṃ sa kūpakhātasya nūnam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
bṛhaspater bhagavataḥ pauṣṇaś caiva bhagasya ca |
aśvinaś caiva vahneś ca prītir bhavati bhārata ||
paramaṃ bheṣajaṃ hotur yajñānām etad uttamam |
pipāsayā na mriyante svopacchandaś ca jāyate ||
na prāpnuyāc ca vyasanaṃ karakān yaḥ prayacchati |
[992]        pradadeḥ brāhmaṇāgrebhyaḥ karakān śraddhayāyutaḥ |
upasparśanaṣadbhāgaṃ labhate puruṣaḥ sadā ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
bhojayitvā dvijān annaṃ karakān yaḥ prayacchati |
suśītasalilopetān so ‘pi sadgatim āpnuyāt ||
ādityapurāṇe |
yo dadāti ghaṭīpātraṃ kuṇḍikāṃ karakāṃs tathā |
tṛṣārtasya tathā dharme labhate śītalaṃ jalam ||
skandapurāṇe |
yo ghaṭaṃ payasā pūrṇaṃ hemapātraniyojitam |
saṃpūjya vastrayugmena dadyāt svargaṃ vrajed dhruvam ||
atha dharmaghaṭadānam | āha viṣṇuḥ |
śītalena sugandhena vāriṇā pūritaṃ ghaṭam |
śuklacandanadigdhāṅgaṃ puṣpadāmopaśobhitam ||
dadhyodanayutaṃ kuryāc charāvaṃ tasya copari |
upānacchatrasaṃyuktaṃ dharmākhyaṃ kalpayed ghaṭam ||
puṣpākṣataṃ gṛhītvā tu imaṃ mantram udīrayet |
oṃ namo viṣṇurūpāya namaḥ sāgarasaṃbhava |
apāṃ pūrṇoddhārās māṃs tvaṃ duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
[993]        udakumbho mayā datto grīṣme kāle dine dine |
udakumbhapradānena prīyatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare |
pratyahaṃ dharmaghaṭako vastrasaṃveṣṭitānanaḥ |
brāhmaṇasya gṛhe neyaḥ śītāmalajalaḥ śuciḥ ||
vasantagrīṣmayor madhye yaḥ pānīyaṃ prayacchati |
pale pale suvarṇasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣāt samārabhya udakumbhaṃ tu yaḥ kṣipet |
dine dine sahasrasya gavāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ labhet ||
tasyaivodyāpanaṃ kāryaṃ māsi māsi narottama |
maṇḍakāveṣṭakābhiś ca pakvānnaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
uddiśya śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇam atha vā pitṝn ||
satilaṃ prokṣayitvā tu mantreṇānena mānavaḥ ||
eṣa dharmaghaṭādatto brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ |
asya pradānāt satataṃ mama santu manorathāḥ ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dharmakumbhaṃ prayacchati |
vasante grīṣmasamaye prapādānaphalaṃ labhet |
prapādānaphalaṃ so ‘pi prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ ||
athāśvatthasecanam | bhaviṣyottare |
[994]        udakumbhapradāne ‘pi hy aśakto yaḥ pumān bhavet |
tenāśvatthataror mūlaṃ secyaṃ nityaṃ jitātmanā ||
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhapraṇāśanam |
sarvarogapraśamanaṃ nityaṃ santativardhanam ||
aśvattharūpī bhagavān prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ |
ity uccārya namaskṛtya pratyahaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
yaḥ karoti taror mūle sekaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam |
so ‘pi tatphalam āpnoti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
atha galantikādānam | tathā |
athānyad api vakṣyāmi jaladānavidhiṃ param |
vasantasamayaṃ jñātvā gatvā devālayaṃ param ||
tatra svāyaṃbhuvaṃ liṅgam ārṣaṃ vā devapūjitam |
tasya garbhagṛhāntasya ghaṭaṃ toyena saṃbhṛtam ||
kuryāt surabhigandhaiś ca vāsitaṃ vastragālitam |
sravantaṃ ca divārātrau taj jalaṃ liṅgamūrdhani ||
evaṃ yaḥ kārayet kumbhaṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ |
śivasya viṣṇor arkasya iṣṭadevasya vā punaḥ ||
sravantaṃ kārayet kumbham acchinnaṃ devamastake |
anena vidhinā datvā naro māsacatuṣṭayam ||
tataḥ karkaṭake prāpte devaṃ pañcāmṛtena tu |
[995]        saṃsnāpya pūjayed gandhair naivedyaiś ca manoramaiḥ |
praṇipatya maheśānaṃ mantram etam udīrayet ||
oṃ namaḥ śaṅkaraḥ śambhur bhavo dhātā śivo haraḥ |
prīyatāṃ me mahādeva jalakumbhapradānataḥ ||
evaṃ saṃkalpya dātā ca paścād āgatya veśmani |
sa śaktyā śivabhaktāṃś ca vipramukhyāṃś ca bhojayet ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute grīṣme jaladānakriyāṃ hare |
yāvad bindūni liṅgasya patitāni na saṃśayaḥ |
sa vasec chāṅkare loke tāvat koṭyo nareśvara ||
atha maṇikadānam | tatra devalaḥ |
grīṣmapraveśe maṇikaṃ dadāti dvijasadmani |
yo ‘mbupūritam āpnoti sa taḍāgakṛtaḥ phalam ||
bhaviṣyottare |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
prapāṃ dātum aśaktena viśeṣaṃ dharmam īpsatā |
maṇikasya kathaṃ dānaṃ kasmin kāle ca dīyate |
kiṃ phalaṃ tasya dānena tad ācakṣva janārdana ||
[996]        prapāṃ dātum aśaktena viśeṣadharmam īpsatā |
dānaṃ tena prakartavyaṃ maṇikasya yudhiṣṭhira ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
vasante grīṣmakāle ca maṇikaṃ tatra dīyate ||
catvāriṃśatghaṭaiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ triṃśadbhir madhyamaṃ smṛtam |
viṃśatyā kanysaṃ proktam ato hīnaṃ na kārayet ||
jalapūrṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sahiraṇyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
śuklacandanadighāṅgaṃ puṣpadāmopaśobhitam ||
vāsobhiḥ saṃparicchādya sānnabhāṇḍakṛtopari |
tasyopari nyased devaṃ varuṇaṃ hemanirmitam |
sadakṣiṇaṃ tu viprāya dadyāt saṃcintya keśavam ||
āpo nārā iti proktā ādityavaruṇau yamaḥ |
maṇikaṃ pṛthivī sarvadātuḥ śāntiṃ prayacchatu ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
om āpaḥ pavitraṃ lokānām apsu śete janārdanaḥ |
maṇikāpsu pradānena prīyatāṃ jalaśāyakaḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
anena vidhinā datvā maṇikaṃ dvijapuṅgave |
dātā yat phalam āpnoti tac chṛṇuṣva narottama ||
viyogo naiva tasyāsīt putrabhātṛdhaneṣu ca |
gṛhasaṃbhāravaikalyaṃ na prāpnoti naraḥ kvacit ||
yā strī dadāti maṇikaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
[997]        aputrā labhate putraṃ durbhagā subhagā bhavet ||
vidhavā saptajanmāni na jāyeta maṇikadā |
gṛhadānaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
āśvayujyāṃ navamyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ bharatarṣabha |
saṃrūḍhapuṣpake divye ākhaṇḍalapure vaset ||
iti maṇikadānam |
atha prapādānam | mahābhārate |
prapāś ca kāryā dānārthaṃ nityaṃ tu dvijasattama |
bhuktebhyaś ca pradīyante pānīyāni viśeṣataḥ ||
nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣthaty avāritam |
sa durgaviṣamaṃ kṛcchraṃ na kacādid avāpunute ||
yamaḥ |
kūpārāmaprapākārī tathā vṛkṣasya ropakaḥ |
kanyāpradaḥ setukārī svargam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
yathā |
yeṣāṃ taḍāgāni prapāḥ śubhāś
cārāmāś ca kūpāś ca pratiśrayāś ca |
annapradānaṃ madhurā ca vāṇī
teṣām ayaṃ caiva paraś ca lokaḥ ||
[998] liṅgapurāṇe |
sarvātmanā ca savanaṃ deyaṃ pānīyam odanam |
etat sudurlabhataraṃ paraloke narādhipa ||
tasmāt kūpāś ca vāpyaś ca taḍāgāni prapās tathā |
kartavyāni yathāśaktyā narair ātmahitaiṣibhiḥ ||
grāme vā nagare vāpi mārge vā toyavarjite |
yaḥ prapāṃ kārayed ramyāṃ sa puṇyāṃ gatim āpnuyāt ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
prapāṃ pathi śubhāṃ kṛtvā nākaloke mahīyate |
prapāsthānaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā sthānam āpnoti śāśvatam ||
tasya sthānasya saṃskārāt phalavṛddhiḥ prakīrtitā |
tatropalepanaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
rajjuṃ datvā prapāsthāne godo bhavati mānavaḥ |
vāridhānīṃ tathā datvā tad eva phalam āpnuyāt ||
kumbhapradānād bhavati sadā pūrṇamanorathaḥ ||
prapāyāṃ ca tathā datvā puruṣaṃ paricārakam |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute ||
vardhamānāni yo dadyāt prapāyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ |
trividhāṃ vṛddhim āpnoti tejasā yaśasā śriyā ||
lavaṇasya pradānena rasān prāpnoti śāśvatān |
tatra haritadānena gavāṃ lokam avāpnuyāt ||
phalapradānena tathā vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
[999]        saktūnāṃ ca pradānena gośatasya phalaṃ naraḥ |
gorasānāṃ pradānena golokaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||
śayyāś ca vividhāḥ kṛtvā prapāyām āsanāni ca |
svarglokam avāpnoti vasūnāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
tatra vahniṃ tathā kṛtvā śītatrāṇāya mānavaḥ |
kāyāgnidīptiprākāśyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca tathāpnuyāt ||
indhanānāṃ pradānena ripubhir nābhibhūyate |
tatropayogibhāṇḍānāṃ dānāt svargam avāpnuyāt |
indralokam avāpnoti tāmbūlādipradānataḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
prapādānasya māhātmyaṃ vada deveśa kiṃcana |
kathaṃ deyā kadā deyā dānaṃ tasyāś ca kiṃ phalam ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
atīte phālgune māsi prāpte caiva mahotsave |
puṇye ‘hni viprakathite grahacandravalānvite ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed vidvān ghanacchāyaṃ manoramam |
purasya madhye pathi vā caityavṛkṣatale ‘tha vā ||
suśītalatalaṃ ramyaṃ civitrāsanasaṃyutam |
tanmadhye sthāpayed bhavyān maṇikumbhāṃś ca śobhanān ||
[1000]        ākālamūlān karakān vastrair āveṣṭitānanān |
brāhmaṇe śīlasaṃpanne bhṛtiṃ datvā yathoditām |
prapāpālaḥ prakartavyo bahuputraparicchadaḥ ||
pānīyapānād aśrāntān yaḥ kārayati mānavān |
evaṃvidhāṃ prapāṃ kṛtvā śubhe ‘hni vidhipūrvakam ||
yathāśaktyā naraśreṣṭha prārambhe bhojayed dvijān |
tataś cotsarjayed vidvān mantreṇāne mānavaḥ ||
prapeyaṃ sarvasāmānyā bhūtebhyaḥ pratipāditā |
asyāḥ pradānāt pitaras tṛpyantu ca pitāmahāḥ ||
idam iha dānavākyam |
adyādi māsacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvat trīn vā dvau vā ekam ekaṃ vā imāṃ prapāṃ pānīyānnavyañjanādi sahitāṃ triṃśadvarṣakoṭiparimitakālabhogya-indraloka-prāptikāmo martyaloke caturvedabrāhmaṇatvakāmaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo ‘ham utsṛjāmīti |
anivāritaṃ tato deyaṃ jalaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam |
tripakṣaṃ vā mahārāja jīvānāṃ jīvanaṃ param ||
gandhāḍhyaṃ surasaṃ śītaṃ śobhane rājate sthitam |
pradadyād apratihataṃ mukhaṃ cānavalokayan |
pratyahaṃ kārayet tasyāṃ bhojanaṃ śaktito dvijān ||
anena vidhinā yas tu śrīṣme tāpapraṇāśanam |
pānīyam uttamaṃ dadyāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
kapilāśatadānasya samyag dattasya yat phalam |
[1001]        tat puṇyaphalam āpnoti sarvadevaiḥ supūjitaḥ ||
pūrṇacandrapratīkāśaṃ vimānam adhiruhya saḥ |
yāti devendranagaraṃ pūjyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ ||
triṃśatkōṭyo hi varṣāṇāṃ yakṣagandharvasevitam |
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya caturvedo dvijo bhavet |
tataḥ paraṃ padaṃyāti punarāvṛttidurlabham ||
susvāduśītasalilā klamanāśanī ca
prānte purasya pathi pārtha sarājabhūmau |
yasya prapā bhavati sarvajanopabhogyā
dharmottaraḥ sa khalu jīvati jīvaloke ||
iti prapādānavidhiḥ |
atha jalāśayanirmāṇam | tatra kūpasya tāvad ucyate | viṣṇudharmottare |
udakena vinā vṛttir nāsti lokadvaye sadā |
tasmāj jalāśayāḥ karyāḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā ||
agniṣṭomasamaḥ kūpaḥ so ‘śvamedhasamo marau |
kūpaḥ pravṛttapānīyaḥ sarvaṃ harati duṣkṛtam ||
kūpakṛt svargam āsādya sarvān bhogān upāśnute |
tatrāpi bhoganaipuṇyaṃ sthānābhyāsāt prakīrtitam ||
[1002] skandapurāṇe |
avaṭaṃ yo naraḥ kuryād apāṃ pūrṇaṃ suśobhanam |
dadyāt subrāhmaṇebhyas taṃ bhojayitvā yathāvidhi ||
aṣṭābhiḥ suvicitrābhiḥ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam |
pitṝṃs tareta pañcāśat taṃ datvā ca narottama |
yāty apsaraḥsu gītena varuṇasya salokatām ||
nandipurāṇe |
yo vāpīm atha vā kūpaṃ deśe toyavivarjite |
snānayet sa naro yāti svarge pretya śataṃ samāḥ |
devair ekatvam atulaṃ tṛṣṇākṣudvarjitaḥ sadā ||
ādityapurāṇe |
setubandharatā ye ca tīrthe śaucaratāś ca ye |
taḍāgakūpakartāro mucyante te tṛṣābhayāt ||
viṣṇuḥ |
atha kūpakartus tatpravṛtte pānīye duṣkṛtārthaṃ vinaśyati | taḍāgakṛn nityatṛpto vāruṇaṃ lokam aśnute |
jalapradaḥ sadā tṛptobhavati
tatpravṛtte tasmāt kūpāt pravṛtte |
[1003] tathā |
kūpārāmataḍāgeṣu devatāyataneṣu ca |
punaḥsaṃskārakartā ca labhate sūlikaṃ phalam ||
devīpurāṇe |
kūpārāmaṃ yathā śastaṃ kartā loke prajāyate |
tathā kuryāt suraśreṣṭha yathā śobhāyataṃ bhavet ||
pūrvam āśritya kartavyaṃ tasyottarapathe ‘pi vā |
na pūrvavyatyayaṃ kuyān na ca devālayād gṛhāt ||
kṛtaṃ bhayapradaṃ loke tathā cāgnibhayaṃ jalam |
vāyavyaṃ vāpi devasya bhayadaṃ jāyate kṛtam ||
āha gargaḥ |
kuryāt pañcakarād ūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśatkarāvadhi |
kūpaṃ vṛttāyataṃ prājñaḥ sarvabhūtasukhāvaham ||
iti kūpanirmāṇavidhiḥ |
atha vāpīnirmāṇam | viṣṇudharmottare |
yamalokaṃ prapaśyanti na jalāśayakāriṇaḥ |
ataḥ kuryāt prayatnena surūpaṃ bhūpa kūpakam ||
kūdaśapasamā vāpī tathā ca parikīrtitā ||
[1004] devīpurāṇe |
kūpaḥ pañcakarād ūrdhvaṃ yāvad dharmas tadudbhavaḥ |
vāpī daṇḍamayād ūrdhvaṃ daśavaryā nṛpottamaiḥ ||
kartavyā sarvatottārā dvitriś caikam athāpi vā |
vijñā saṃbhadrakaṃ cānye vṛttā vā cāyathā tathā ||
asrā vā cārdhacandrā vā dhenoś cakrasamākṛtiḥ |
kartavyā dravyasāreṇa gopathā sarvakāmadā ||
vedāṣṭamadhyagotsārā karasārdhā yathā bhavet |
kūpo vā śīlayaṣṭī vā deyā nemī yathā dṛḍhā ||
bhavane kāṣṭhapāṣāṇair ūrdhvapīṭhasamucchayā |
subuddhā toraṇopetā gaṇanāthagṛhācitā ||
nāgayakṣagṛhair devyābhūṣitā krīḍitākulā |
vāpī bhadrā sureśreṣṭha sarvakāmapradā nṛṇām ||
bhadrā padmā śubhā kāntā vijayā maṅgalā tathā |
jayā yoktrī bhaved vāpi nṛpādīnāṃ śubhāvahā ||
vṛtttāyatā caturasrā vāpyaḥ sādhāraṇā matāḥ |
śeṣā kāmyādhikāreṇa kūpo vṛttaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ||
nandipurāṇe |
yo vāpīm agnisakṣyeṇa vidhivat pratipādayet |
koṇeṣūdakakumbhasthān samudrān arcya śraddhayā ||
caturaś caturantā tu tena dattā mahī bhavet |
tatsaṃnidhau dvijān arcya vidhivat pānabhojanaiḥ |
[1005]        sa yāti vāruṇaṃ lokaṃ divyakāmasamanvitam ||
atha bhadrātaḍāganirmāṇam | tatra yamaḥ |
taḍāge yasya pānīyaṃ satataṃ khalu tiṣṭhati |
svargalokagatis tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
taḍāgakartā vasati svarge yugacatuṣṭayam ||
yatra vipro ‘tha gaurikā pāyinī salilaṃ kvacit |
taḍāgaṃ tādṛśaṃ kṛtvā svarge daśayugān vaset ||
mahābhārate |
devā manuṣyāḥ pitaro gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ |
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃśrayanti jalāśayam ||
kulaṃ saṃtārayet sarvaṃ yasya khāte jalāśaye |
gāvaḥ pibanti salilaṃ sādhavaś ca narāḥ sadā ||
taḍāge yasya gāvas tu pibanti tṛṣitā jalam |
mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāś ca so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
yat pibanti jalaṃ tatra snāyante viśramanti ca |
taḍāgadasya tat sarvaṃ pretyānantyāya kalpate ||
tathā |
varṣārātre taḍāge tu salilaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati |
agnihotraphalaṃ tasyety evam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
[1006]        vasantakāle pānīyaṃ tadāge yasya tiṣṭhati |
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ sa samupāśnute ||
nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati |
vājapeyasamantasya phalaṃ maharṣayo viduḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
kṛtvā taḍāgasya tathā vāruṇaṃ lokam aśnute |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi kalpamātraṃ dvijottamaḥ |
tato ‘pi puṇyam āpnoti taḍāgakaraṇāt pathi ||
marau taḍāge pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati vai dvijāḥ |
vimānenārkavarṇena brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
prāvṛṭkāle ‘pi pānīyaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati |
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya puruṣasya prakīrtitam ||
dvādaśāhaphalaṃ tasya śiśire yasya tiṣṭhati ||
vājapeyaphalaṃ tasya vasante yasya tiṣṭhati |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya nidāghe yasya tu dvijāḥ ||
sasyānāṃ secanārthāya nadīvāhe tathā kṛte |
annadaḥ pānadaś caiva prāṇadaś ca tathā bhavet |
bhāgīrathasya lokānāṃ samavāpnoty asaṃśayaḥ ||
pānīyaśodhanaṃ kṛtvā hrade devavinirmite |
puruṣaḥ phalam āpnoti daśagodānajaṃ dvijāḥ ||
dārupāṣāṇaracitaṃ sukhasevyaṃ jalāśayam |
purāṇaṃ mānavaḥ kṛtvā nākaloke mahīyate ||
[1007]        praṇālakaraṇāt tatra tṛptim āpnoty anuttamāṃ |
mahatpuṇyam avāpnoti nākaloke mahīyate ||
svabāhukhātaṃ yaḥ kuryāt taḍāgaṃ matimān naraḥ |
tat phalam āpnoti kartā rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ||
paras tu puṇyaṃ yaḥ kuryāt kuṃcit tasya jalāśaye |
puṇyāṃśabhāgī bhavati so ‘pi yasya jalāśayaḥ ||
prāpnoti tṛptiṃ paramāṃ manuṣyo
lokāṃs tathā tān salilādhipasya |
jalāśaye ‘lpe ‘pi kṛte dvijendrā
tasmāt tu lokaṃ salilaṃ nṛlokam ||
atha dvārībandhaḥ | devīpurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
devyaḥ śastāḥ suraśreṣṭha sarvakāmaprasādhikāḥ |
tāsāṃ samupabhogārthaṃ jalapātrāṇi kārayet ||
dvārībandhādikāḥ śakra puṣkariṇyo nagāḥ śubhāḥ |
talakhātaṃ taḍāgaṃ tu vipālī pauṣṭikī matā |
śobhāḍhyā dīrghikā proktā caturasrā tu vāpikā ||
kūpāḥ pādavihīnāś ca sapādā toraṇānvitāḥ |
śakrasābandhakaraṇāj (?)jhiraṃtī jhiṇṭikā matā ||
girer antar gatā dvārā sasphoṭaṃ harakaṃ tathā |
cakramardaḥ sacalako argalā citimāntimaḥ ||
[1008]        vajranāgam adhogāmī na siddhyanti kadācana |
holātmā ca tathā cakra sukhasādhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
uttamādhamamadhyā sā svalpabuddhā sukhagrahaḥ |
dairghyāc ca bandhāgāyā tu sādhamā parikīrtitā ||
śatasahasraparyantā dvidaṇḍāṣṭadvidaṇḍikā |
dvārī śreṣṭhādhamā tāta bahabandhā ca yā bhavet ||
sikatāpaṅkasasaṃcchidrā saṃprajā parivarjayet |
śubhā hi dairghyād vistāraṃ mitrābandhaṃ samācaret ||
tripañcacāṣṭaparyantaḥ śreṣṭho bandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
śatadvayaṃ śubhā pālī karāṇāṃ saptadhādhamā ||
vistāraḥ kathitaḥ śāstre palībandhasya paṇḍitaiḥ |
prākārakūṭanalikā puṭakāṃ pṛṣṭhasaṃcayam ||
pṛṣṭhamārgaṃ bhaved bandhadharmacandraṃ sakambalam |
bhūjidvālakhate śakra sāsthānaṃ toyasaṃyamaḥ ||
pāṣāṇaghaṭitaṃ vadvamaghaṭaṃ bilvakāṣṭhajam |
śilās taṃ ca nibaddhaṃ tu pṛthuvistīrṇaṃ saṃcitam ||
vajrasaṃdhānasaṃyogaṃ samavādāntakaṃ param |
kathākālasahaṃ vidvān kukṣighātaṃ tu kārayet ||
na madhahṛdaye khāte kambale vāpi dāpayet |
mahādyoṣakaraṃ tat tu dvārīkartur bhayapradam ||
prayatnaḥ kuṭṭane kāryo mṛttikā kūrcanādikam |
nalikāsu pradātavyaṃ lohaṃ muśalaghaṭṭitam ||
samāptiparyayaṃ yāvad upalān khātayen nṛpaḥ |
[1009]        anyathā na bhaved gāḍhā sraved doṣakarī bhavet ||
pālīṃ tasmād dṛḍhāṃ kuryād grahapṛṣṭhāṃ na ghaṭṭitām |
kūrmavṛṣabhakasyādihemaṃ cādau vinikṣipet ||
prārambhe ‘syā mahāpūjā śyenakādiṣu kārayet |
vāruṇaṃ nāgadevaṃ tu yāgamantrajapaṃ sadā ||
āniṣpatti tu kartavyam anyathā bhayadaṃ bhavet |
kraturāṣṭrajane śakra dvārī ca na dṛḍhā bhavet ||
dṛṣṭārthaṃ pratirūpāṇi tadā liṅgaṃ vināyakam |
śaktiḥ pūrvāṇi kurvīta mahālakṣīr yathā pure ||
śubhadā bhavane loke nandātoyaṃ śivaṃ tathā |
āgamaṃ toraṇaṃ vāpī kūpaṃ vā samahoragam ||
dvārībandhiṣu kartavyam utsargaṃ gopradānikam |
gosahasraṃ śubhaṃ deyaṃ mahīṃ hemaṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||
śyenakaṃ nāgayajñaṃ ca dvārībandhe sadā śubham |
catustoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ patākādivibhūṣitam ||
utsargaṃ vihitaṃ dvāryām anyathā na śubhodakam |
śakaṭena balir deyaḥ paśupātapuraḥsaram ||
sphurantaṃ nāgahṛdayaṃ mantraṃ tatra prayojayet |
saṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ nyūnādhikakṛtaṃ ca yat ||
phalaṃ ca hayamedhasya yat kṛtasya bhaved iha |
samagraṃ labhate tasya dvārībandhe kṛte sati ||
iha kīrtiḥ śubhaṃ sarvaṃ viśatruś ca bhaven nṛpa |
dvārībandhaprakartāro nandanti prajayā saha ||
[1010]        taḍāgaṃ nalakopetaṃ paridāhasamanvitam |
devatārāmasaṃyuktaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam ||
dvārībandhe suvistīrṇe paridāhaśubhaḥ sadā |
anyathā na bhavec chakra dṛḍhatvaṃ pālibandhanam ||
madhe pālyāḥ suvinyāsaṃ jalamārgaṃ jalavaham |
śailaṃ pakveṣṭakaṃ vāpi kāryaṃkrīḍāyai bhūbhṛtām ||
śīlākṣuropaṇe kuryāyān nalakaṃ śobhanaṃ tathā |
sopānapālikā kāryā vistīrṇā snānabhojane ||
śobhādhikena saṃyuktā kūrce kāryo yathāvidhi |
bandhapṛṣṭhe dṛḍho bandhaḥ kāryaḥ kālasahas tathā ||
evaṃ puṇyam avāpnoti sthairyakālavaśāt kṛte |

jayanty āditaḍāgādi aṣṭau pāpaharāṇi ca |

kūpavāpījalopetā putrāyuḥkīrtidā sadā |
sā parigrahasaṃsthānaṃ bhūpater mānakalpitā ||
purapattanadevānāṃ siddhyarthaṃ jāyate śubhā |
saritsiddhālayair yā na viṣṇukrāntā vasundharā ||
saubhāgyadvārībandhasya jalaveṣṭāṣṭakabhramā |
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ taj jalaṃ tva abhinanditam ||
pāvanaṃ jāyate śakra anyathā niṣphalaṃ matam |
[1011]        anutsargitadvārīṣu apeyaṃ salilaṃ bhavet |
