gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya dvārapālān samantataḥ ||
etad vasata tān brūyād ācāryas tv abhipūjayet |
bahvṛcau pūrvataḥ sthāpyau dakṣiṇena yajurvidau ||
samagau paścime sthāpyau uttareṇa tv atharvaṇau |
udaṅmukho dakṣiṇato yajamāna upāviśet ||
rajasetyādi, rajasā taṇḍulādicūrṇena | tatprakāras tu paribhāṣāyāṃ darśitaḥ | [1019] grahān, ādityādīn adhidevatāpratyadhidevatāsahitān | lokaprabhṛtīn, indraprabhṛtīn | teṣām āvāhanādividhiḥ tulāpuruṣe draṣṭavyaḥ | jhaṣādīn, makarādīn | kamalām, lakṣmīm | ambikām, durgām | tān iti, kuṇḍasamīpasthān kalaśān | pūrvakuṇḍe bahvṛcau hotārau sthāpayet | dakṣiṇādikuṇḍeṣu yathāvedaṃ hotṝn upaveśya jāpadakṣadvārapālānām eṣa eva kramo veditavyaḥ |
yajadhvam iti tān brūyād dhotṛkān punar eva tu |
utkṛṣṭamantrajapyena tiṣṭhadhvam iti jāpakān ||
evam ādiśya tān sarvān prayujyāgniṃ ca mantravat |
juhuyād vāruṇair mantrair ājyaṃ ca samidhaṃ tathā ||
ṛtvigbhyaś caiva hotavyā vāruṇair eva sarvaśaḥ |
grahebhyo vidhivad dhutvā tac cendrāyeśvarāya ca |
marudbhyo lokapālebhyo vidhivad viśvakarmaṇe ||
juhuyād ācārya iti śeṣaḥ |
vāruṇamantrāḥ | tatvāyāmi brahmaṇā vindyamāna iti pañca | tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān iti dve | imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhīti ca | [1020] homasaṃkhyā tu samidājyayor aṣṭottaraśataṃ vidhāya grahādibhyas tu pratyekam aṣṭāviṃśatir āhutayo hotavyāḥ | grahādimantrās tu tulāpuruṣe ‘bhihitāḥ |
viśvakarmamantraḥ | raudrasūktam imārudrāyetyādi, pāvamānaṃ tu maṅgalasūktam |
rātrisūktaṃ ca raudraṃ ca pāvamānaṃ tu maṅgalam |
japeran pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ pūrvato juhuyāt pṛthak ||
rātrisūktam, rātrivākhya dāyatī ityādi | kaniktadaj januṣam ityādi puruṣasūktaṃ prasiddhaṃ sūktam |
śakraṃ raudraṃ ca saugyaṃ (?) ca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ jātavedasam |
sūrasūktaṃ japeraṃs te dakṣiṇena yajurvidaḥ ||
śakraṃ sūktam, indra nau viśvatasya rītyanuvākodudhanuśakram iti liṅgakam | raudrasūktam imā rudrā yaḥ sthiradhanvat iti ṣaṭ | ṛcaḥ saumyasūktaṃ somo dhenum iti ṣaṭ ṛcaḥ | kauṣmāṇḍasūktaṃ yad devā devaheḍanam iti catvāro | anuvākāḥ, jātavedasasūkaṃ yas tvāhadākīriṇety anuvākaḥ | sūrasūktaṃ sūryo devīm iti ṣaṭ | ṛcaḥ etāni sūktāni taittirīyāṇāṃ prasiddhānit |
vairājaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rudrasaṃhitā |
śaiśavaṃ pañca nidhanaṃ gāyatraṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca ||
vāmadevyaṃ bṛhatsaumyaṃ rauravaṃ saurathantaram |
gavāṃ vrataṃ vikarṇaṃ ca rakṣoghnaṃ ca yaśas tathā ||
[1021]         gāyeti sāmagā rājan paścimadvāram āśritāḥ |
vairājaṃ pivāsaumam indrety atra prasiddham | sauparṇāni ut hyed abhiśrutā madham ity atra, trīṇi, sāmāni saṃhitā | āvīrājānam ityādi prasiddha(m) | śaivam, uccāte jātamandhasa iti prasiddham | pañca nidhanaṃ vā, vāma devyaṃ kayānaś citrety atra prasiddham | gāyatraṃ tu prasiddham | jyeṣṭhasāmāni trīṇyāś ca dohāni vāmadevyaṃ grāme geyaṃ bṛhatmattvām iha vāmaha iti prasiddham | saumyaṃ somavrataṃ sante payāṃsīti prasiddham | rauravaṃ punānaḥ somety atra prasiddham | rathantaram abhi tvā sūrano numa iti prasiddham | gavāṃ vrataṃ tvam anyata prathamam iti dve sāmanī, vikarṇaṃ vibhrāty atra prasiddham | rakṣoghnam, yaśaḥ same bṛhad indrāyety atra prasiddham |
ātharvaṇyāś cottarataḥ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathā |
japeran manasā devān āśritā varuṇaṃ prabhum ||
pūrvedyur abhito rātrāv evaṃ kṛtvādhivāsanam |
gajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamahradagokulāt ||
mṛdam ānīya kuṇḍeṣu prakṣipec catvārāt tathā |
rocanāṃ ca prasiddhārthān gandhān guggulam eva ca ||
[1022]        snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ pañcabhaṅgasamanvitaiḥ |
pūrvaṃ kartur mahāmantrair evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||
rocanāṃ gorocanām | siddhārthāḥ śvetasarṣapāḥ | pañcabhaṅgāḥ, aśvattoḍumbaraplakṣavaṭacūtasya pallavāḥ | abhiṣekamantrāḥ, tulāpuruṣe draṣṭavyāḥ | abhiṣekas tu dvitīyadivase vidheyaḥ |
śakrādidevatāḥ sarvā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
surās tvām abhiṣiñcantu prayacchantu dhanāni ca |
nārāyaṇo jagannāthas tathā saṃkarṣaṇo vibhuḥ ||
pradyumnaś cāniruddhaś ca ṛddhiṃ yacchantu te sadā |
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ||
gandharvāḥ kiṃnarā yakṣāḥ siddhā vidyādharoragāḥ |
abhinandantu te sarve nadyaḥ sāgaraparvatāḥ ||
vedaśāstrapurāṇāni mīmāṃsācchanda-āgamāḥ |
bṛhatkathādikāś cānyāḥ kathāḥ sarvāḥ subhapradāḥ ||
gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī śacī lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī |
mṛḍānī mātaraḥ sarvā bhavantu varadāḥ sadā ||
ādityaś candramā bhaumo budho jīvaḥ sitārkajaḥ |
grahās tvām abhiṣiñcantu rāhuḥ ketuś ca tarpitāḥ ||
[1023]        indro vahnir yamaś caiva nirṛtir varuṇas tathā |
vāyuḥ kubera īśāno dikpālāḥ pāntu sarvadā ||
saṃvatsarāyane māsās tithir vārāś ca nāḍikāḥ |
muhūrtāny abhiṣiñcantu nakṣatrāṇi vidāniśam |
ity evaṃ rudrakumbhena kartāram abhiṣiñcayet ||
evaṃ kṛtvā samidājyavidhiyuktena karmaṇā |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale saṃjāte vā gavāṃ śatam ||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradātavyam aṣṭaṣaṣṭy atha vā punaḥ |
pañcāśad vātha ṣaṭtriṃśat pañcaviṃśati vā punaḥ ||
etā gāvo dakṣiṇā bhavadbhyaḥ saṃpāditāḥ karmāṅgadevatāḥ **yantām [torn paper] ity udakapūrvaṃ dadyāt |
tataḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ prokte śuddhe lagne suśobane |
vedaśāstraiḥ sagāndharvair vādyaiś ca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
kanakālaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā tatra gām avatārayet |
sāmagāya ca tā deyā brāhmaṇāya viśāmpate ||
ayaṃ cānumantraṇamantraḥ |
idaṃ salilaṃ pavitraṃ kuruṣva
śuddhapūto amṛtaḥ santu nityam |
māntārayantī kuru tīrthābhiṣekam
lokālokaṃ tarate tāryateti ||
tatpucchāgre yajamānaḥ salagnas taret |
jalāsayaṃ ca trivṛtā sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet |
[1024]        pātrīm ādāya sauvarṇīṃ pañcaratnasamanvitām |
tato nikṣipya makaraṃ matsyādīṃs tāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||
dhṛtāṃ caturbhir vipraiś ca vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ |
mahānadīṃ jalopetāṃ dadhyakṣatavibhūṣitām ||
uttārābhimukhīṃ nyubjāṃ jalamadhye tu kārayet |
ātharvaṇena sāmnā ca punar mām ity ṛceti ca |
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa kṣiptvāgatya ca maṇḍapam ||
ātharvaṇaṃ sāmā saṇ no (?) devīr abhiṣṭaye ity atra prasiddham araṇyageyaṃ yathāśrayam, jalāśayaḥ sarvopayogitvena sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo mayotsṛjyata iti tyāgaṃ kuryāt |
pūjayitvā sadasyāṃs tu baliṃ dadyāt samantataḥ |
punar dināni hotavyaṃ catvāri munisattamāḥ ||
caturthīkarma kartavyaṃ deyā tatrāpi śaktitaḥ |
dakṣinā rājaśārdūla varuṇaṃ saṃsmaraṃs tataḥ ||
kṛtvā tu yajñapātrāṇi yajñopakaraṇāni ca |
ṛtvigbhyas tu samaṃ datvā maṇḍapaṃ vibhajet punaḥ ||
hemapātrīṃ ca śayyāṃ ca sthāpakāya nivedayet |
tataḥ sahasraṃ viprāṇām atha vāṣṭaśataṃ tathā ||
bhojayec ca yathāśaktyā pañcāśad vātha viṃśatim |
evam eva purāṇeṣu taḍāge vidhir ucyate ||
kūpavāpīṣu sarvāsu tathā puṣkariṇīṣu ca |
eṣa eva vidhir dṛṣṭaḥ pratiṣṭhāsu tathaiva ca ||
mantratas tu viśeṣaḥ syāt prāsādodyānabhūiṣu ||
[1025]        ayaṃ ca śaktivārdhyena vidhir dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā |
svalpeṣv ekāgnivat kāryaṃ vittaśāṭhyād ṛte nṛbhiḥ ||
prāvṛṭkāle sthitaṃ toyam agniṣṭomasamaṃ smṛtam |
śaratkālasthitaṃ yat syāt tad uktaphaladāyakam ||
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ hemantaśiśirasthitam |
aśvamedhsamaṃ prāhur vasantasamaye sthitam |
grīṣme ca yat sthitaṃ toyaṃ rājasūyād viśiṣyate ||
etān mahārāja viśeṣadharmān
karoti yo ‘rthān atha śuddhabuddhiḥ |
sa yāti rudrālayam āśu pūtaḥ
kalpān anekān divi modate ca ||
anena lokāṃś ca mahastapādīn
bhuktvā parārdhadvayam aṅganābhiḥ |
saheti viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ yat
prāpnoti tad yogabalena bhūyaḥ ||
evam ayaṃ sādhāraṇas taḍāgādipratiṣṭhāvidhir uktaḥ viśeṣas tu śākhāvibhedena puratād vakṣyate | tatrāviruddhadharmāṇām ekatropsaṃhāreṇa pratiṣṭhānuṣṭhānam ādaraṇīyaṃ viruddhadharmasaṃbandhe tu svaśākhoktam anuṣṭheyam iti |
atha vahnipurāṇe |
dvija uvāca |
[1026]        vāruṇeṣṭir yathā vede proktā yādṛk svayaṃbhuvā |
moho na jāyate yena tat sarvaṃ brūhi me vibho ||
yama uvāca |
sudine śubhanakṣatre prāg viprān upaveśayet |
vrīhy āvāhya ca ṛgveda saṃvatsaro ‘si vai yajñaḥ ||
āvorājeti sammāni ayaṃ mehīty atharvaṇā ||
pūrvaṃ pādyaṃ tu vai dadyād idaṃ viṣṇur itīty ṛcā |
ātvāvahantu haraya ity arghaṃ saṃpradāpayet ||
tataś cācamanīyaṃ ca viṣṭarostvīti viṣṭaram |
kāṃsyapātryāṃ madhu cājyaṃ kukurosīti mantritam ||
triḥ saṃprāśya tathā cātman mantrād āpaḥ punantv iti |
dadyāt sthapataye caivaṃ sadasas pratim ity ṛcā ||
tatas taṃ brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ kas tv āyunakti karmaṇaḥ |
śākunena tato vaśyaṃ sthālīpākaṃ samārabhet ||
laukikāgniṃ puraskṛtya loko ‘hi balavān yataḥ ||
śrotriye gām anaḍvāhaṃ hanyāt kiṃ na samācaret |
cakṣuṣī pūrvato hutvā vyāhṛtīs tadanantaram ||
cakṣuṣī ājyabhāgau |
dadyāt pūrṇāhutīṃ pūrṇāṃ garbhādhānādikaṃ tataḥ |
kuryāt pañcabhikhātaṃ ca varuṇaṃ vārisādṛśam |
[1027]        tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā agnikuṇḍaṃ nayet purā ||
agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmaha ity ato dakṣiṇaṃ nayet |
vītihotraṃ tvākareti agniṃ dūtaṃ ca paścime ||
taṃ no tvām uttaraṃ paścāt agna āyāhi vītaye |
evam utpādya taṃ vahniṃ cakṣuṣī vyāhṛtīṃ hunet (?) ||
vāruṇair eva mantraiś ca pṛthak kuṇḍe ca pañcakam |
varuṇaḥ prāvṛtābhuvam imaṃ me varuṇaṃ tathā ||
ud uttamam iti dvyābhyām ṛjunītīti vā tataḥ |
somaṃ rājānam ity āhuś caruṃ prācyaṃ hi vāruṇam ||
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā yūpaṃ tad varuṇaṃ nyaset |
saṃpūjya vāruṇe kumbhe śākalaṃ homam ācaret ||
brahmaṇo brahma jajñānam ato deveti viṣṇave |
śambhave sambhavāyeti trātāram iti jiṣṇave ||
tvam agne rohitāśvāya yamāya tveti me dvija |
eṣa te nirṛte caiva varuṇasya yādaḥ pateḥ ||
vātovādyativātāya kuvidāṅgam udakpatiḥ |
īśānam asya īśasya grahāṇāṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratiam ||
ākṛṣṇa iti sūryāya imaṃ deveti indave |
kujāyety agnim ūrdhānta udbuddhaś (?) candrasūnave ||
guror bṛhaspatety āhuḥ śukrāyānnāt pariśrutaḥ |
śan no vedī tu sīres tu kavāna iti rāhave ||
ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketos tu viśvāyur viśvakarmaṇe |
bhūtāya tveti bhūtebhyo kṣetrasyeti ca bhūpateḥ |
[1028]        rakṣoghnaiś caiva mantrāṇi hutvā taiḥ kramaśo nṛpa ||
śataṃ śatasahasraṃ vā tilās tatra pṛthak pṛthak |
samidbhis tu yavair vāpi datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥ ||
sarvabhogopakārāya śāntiṃ kṛtvā dvijottamaḥ |
caruṃ tu śrapayet paktā vāruṇaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
vāruṇair eva hotavyaṃ varuṇāya niyojayet |
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato datvā kuṇḍe kuṇḍe yathāvidhi ||
varuṇaṃ ca namet tatra sayādobhiḥ samanvitam |
utsṛjet tatra dhenūnāṃ śatam evārdham eva vā ||
bahūnām apy abhāve tu ekāṃ ratnair alaṃkṛtām |
devapitṛmanuṣyebhyaḥ pucche tasyās tilodakam ||
datvā nivedayet paścāt sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām |
ṛtvigbhyo gurave pūrvaṃ triguṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ sadā ||
snāyād avabhṛthenātha putrabhāryāsuhṛdvṛtaḥ |
pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo yathāśaktyā tathā gavām ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājan vāruṇeṣṭiṃ prayatnataḥ |
sa pūrvapitṛbhir yuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati |
evam etanmayā khyātaṃ yad uktaṃ vahninā purā ||
iti vāruṇeṣṭiḥ |
bahvṛcapariśiṣṭāt |
athāto vāruṇavidhiṃ vāpīyajñaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | [1029] puṇye tithikaraṇe śubhe nakṣatre prācīṃ diśam āsthāya prākpravaṇe udakpravaṇe vā udakasamīpe ‘gnim upasamādhāya vāruṇaṃ caruṃ śrapayitvā ājyabhāgāntaṃ kṛtvā ājyāhutīr juhuyāt | samudrajyeṣṭhā iti pratyṛcam | tato haviṣā aṣṭāhutīr juhuyāt tatvāyāmi brahmaṇā vandyamāna iti pañca, tvaṃ no ‘gne varuṇasya vidvān iti dve, imaṃ me varuṇaḥ śrudhohaveti ca sviṣṭikṛtaṃ navamaṃ nava vai prāṇā prāṇā vā āpas tasmād ānavabhir juhoti mārjanānte dhenum avatārayet | avatāryamāṇāntām anumantrayet idaṃ salilaṃ pavitraṃ kuruṣva aśuddhaḥ pūto amṛtaḥ santu nityaṃ bhāvayanto sarvatīrthābhiṣiktaṃ lokālokān tarate tīryate cety anena pucchāgre yajamānaḥ svayaṃ lagnaḥ ācāryeṇānvārabdha uttīrya āpo asmān mātaraḥ śundhantv aparājitāyāṃ diśy uttāpayet |
sūṣvasā bhagavato bhavato ha bhūyā iti, yadi sā hi karoti tadā hi kṛṇvatī vasumatī vasūnām iti japet | tāṃ sacelakaṇṭhāṃ kāñcanaśṛṅgīṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ vṛṣaprajāṃ raupyakharāṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ viprāya sāmagāya dadyād itarā vā śakyā dakṣiṇām ācāryāya deyeti tataḥ utsargaṃ kuryād devapitṛmanuṣyāḥ prīyantām ity avamṛjya iti āha śaunako yajamāno brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā svastyayanaṃ vācayet |
atha vṛkṣāropaṇam | tatra mahābhārate |
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jātayaḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ |
vṛkṣagulmalatāvalkatvaksārās tṛṇajātayaḥ ||
etās tu jātyā vṛkṣāṇāṃ tadārope guṇo ‘sti me |
[1030]        kīrtiś ca mānuṣe loke pretya caiva śubhaṃ phalam ||
atītānagatau cobhau pitṛvaṃśau ca bhārata |
tārayed vṛkṣaropī ca tasmād vṛkṣāṃś ca ropayet ||
puṣpaiḥ suragaṇān vṛkṣāḥ phalaiś cāpi tathā pitṝn |
chāyayā cātithīn tāta pūjayanti mahīruhāḥ ||
kinnaroragarakṣāṃsi devagandharvamānavāḥ |
tathā maharṣayaś caiva saṃśrayanti mahīruhān ||
puṣpitāḥ phalavantaś ca tarpayantīha mānavān |
vṛkṣadaṃ putravad vṛkṣās tārayanti paratra ca |
tasmāt taḍāge ropyā vai vṛkṣāḥ śreyo’rthibhiḥ sadā ||
putravat paripālyāś ca putrās te dharmataḥ śubhāḥ ||
athāha viṣṇuḥ |
vṛkṣāropitur vṛkṣāḥ paraloke putrā bhavanti | vṛkṣaprasya vṛkṣaḥ prasūnair devān prīṇayanti, phalaiś cātithīn, chāyayābhyāgatān, daive varṣa udadakena pitṝn |
padmapurāṇe |
aputrasya ca putratvaṃ pādapā iha kurvate |
yacchanti ropakebhyas te sattīrthaṃ tarpaṇādikam ||
sattīrthaṃ putrakṛtaṃ tarpaṇādi tṛptyādijanyaṃ phalaṃ ropakasya prayacchantīty arthaḥ |
yatnenāpi ca rājendra pippalāropaṇaṃ kuru |
sa tu putrasahasrāṇām eka eva kariṣyati ||
[1031] putrasahasrāṇāṃ kartavyam iti śeṣaḥ |
dhanī vāśvatthavṛkṣeṇa hy aśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ |
plakṣo yajñapatiḥ proktaś ciñcā cāyuḥpradā smṛtā ||
jambukī kanyadā proktā bhāryādā dāḍimī tathā |
karalū roganāśāya palāśo brahmadas tathā ||
pretatvaṃ jāyate puṃsaḥ ropayed yo vibhītakam |
aṅgulle kulavṛddhiḥ syāt khadire cāpy arogatā ||
nimbapratopako yas tu tasya tuṣṭo divākaraḥ |
śrīvṛkṣe śaṅkaro devaḥ pāṭalāyāṃ tu pārvatī ||
śiṃsapāayām apsarasaḥ kunde gandharvasattamāḥ |
tintiḍīke dāsavargo vakulo daśyudas tathā ||
śrīvṛkṣaḥ bilvaḥ | tintiḍīko vṛkṣaḥ amlaḥ |
puṇyastrīdayakaś caiva candanaḥ panasas tathā |
saubhāgyadaś campakaś ca karīraḥ pāradārakaḥ |
apatyanāśadas tālo nādīśaḥ kulavardhanaḥ ||
bahubhāryā nārikelī drākṣā sarvāṅgasundarī |
ratipradā tathā kelī mocako śatrunāśakaḥ ||
mocakaḥ śālmaliḥ |
ityādayas tathā ye ‘nye yenoktās te ‘pi dāyakāḥ |
pratiṣṭhānte gamiṣyanti ye narā vṛkṣaropakāḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[1032]        varaṃ bhūmiruhāḥ pañca na tu koṣṭharuhā daśaḥ(?) |
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ sūnaiḥ kurvanti pitṛtarpaṇam ||
bahubhir vata mañjātair putrair dharmārthavarjitaiḥ |
varam ekaḥ pathi tarur yatra viśamate janāḥ ||
prāṇinaḥ prīnayaty asmāc chākhāvalkalapallavaiḥ |
puṣpachadā sutanavaḥ puṣpair devān phalaiḥ pitṝn ||
puṣpapatraphalachāyāmūlavalkaladārubhiḥ |
dhanyā mahīruhā yeṣāṃ viphalā yānti nārthinaḥ ||
putrāḥ saṃvatsarasyānte śrāddhaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
pratyahaṃ pādapāḥ puṣṭiṃ yatheṣṭāṃ janayanti hi ||
na tat karoty agnihotram asādhyaṃ yoṣitāṃ sutaiḥ |
yat karoti ghanachāyaḥ pādapaḥ pathi sevitaḥ ||
suchāyā ca supuṣpā ca suphalā puṣpavāṭikā |
kulayoṣeva bhavati bhartṛloke dvayānugā ||
aśokapallavakarā tilakālaṃkṛtānanā |
sarvopabhogyā veśyeva vāṭikā ratidāyakā ||
sadāsa sastrī bhavati sadā dānaṃ prayacchati |
sadā yajñaṃ sa yajate yo ropayati pādapam ||
aśvattham ekaṃ picumardham ekaṃ
nyagrodham ekaṃ daśa ciñcikīkam |
kapitthavilvāmalako tripañca
pañcāmravāpī narakaṃ na paśyet ||
[1033]        pratiśrayāśrāntasamāśrayitvā
damī ca sattraṃ phaladā bubhukṣave |
apatyam ete paralokahetor
vimṛśya tat kiṃ taravo na ropitāḥ ||
na khānitā puṣkariṇyo ropitā na mahīruhāḥ |
mātur yauvanacoreṇa tena jātena kiṃ kṛtam ||
chāyām anyasya kurvanti tiṣṭhanti svayam ātape |
phalanti ca parārtheṣu na svārthaikaparā drumāḥ |
ato drumāḥ sadā ropyāḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||
iti vṛkṣāropaṇaphalam |
atha vṛkṣadānam | skandapurāṇe |
yas tu vṛkṣaṃ prakurute chāyāpuṣpaphalopagam |
pathi divye naraḥ pāpāt saṃtārayati vai pitṝn ||
nandipurāṇe |
mārgaśīrṣe tu yo dadyāc chāyāviṭapasaṃkulam |
sakulyās tarukhaṇḍeṣu mahendrodyānaveśmasu ||
vinodyante sarovṛndair devavac ca yugārbudam ||
mārgaśīrṣe adhvamukhe | dadyād ity atra vṛkṣam ity śeṣaḥ |
[1034]        phalavṛkṣaś ca yo dadyād dharmam uddiśya mānavaḥ |
sa sarvakāmatṛptātmā gacched varuṇamandiram ||
mahābhārate |
devebhyo ‘tha dvijātibhyo yo dadyāt phaladaṃ drumam |
sa pīyūṣabhujāṃ loke sevyamāno varorubhiḥ ||
krīḍate devavat kālam anantaṃ pūrvajānvitaḥ |
sahakāradrumaṃ datvā kinnaraiḥ saha modate ||
yāti datvā dvije jambūm ambikāyāḥ salokatām |
vāruṇaṃ nārikeleṇa kharjūreṇa ca dhānadam ||
pūgadrumapradānena lokaṃ sārasvataṃ vrajet |
yāti candrasamo lokaṃ datvā panasabhūruham ||
ciñcāpradānato yāti ruciraṃ lokam āśvinam |
kapitthadāḍimāmrātakadalyāmalakītarūn ||
datvā nakṣatralokeṣu sukham aśnāti mānavaḥ |
anyeṣām api vṛkṣāṇāṃ sumanaḥphalaśākhinām |
pradānato naro yāti paramaiśvaryasaṃpadam ||
tathā |
puṣpopagaṃ vātha phalopagaṃ vā
yaḥ pādapaṃ sparśayate dvijāya |
sa strīsamṛddhaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ
prāpnoty ayatnopanataṃ gṛhaṃ vai ||
[1035]
atha kadalīdānam | āha baudhāyanaḥ |
kārayet kadalīṃ divyāṃ parṇaiḥ sarvatra saṃvṛtām |
phalapūgena saṃyuktāṃ suvarṇasya phalena tu ||
yathāvibhavataḥ kuryād vastreṇāveṣṭya sūtrakaiḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi bhakṣair nānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
homaṃ ca kārayet tatra pūrvavad brāhmaṇena ca |
hiraṇyagarbha ityāditalliṅgaiḥ prāṅmukhena tu ||
tasmai tām kadalīṃ dadyād vastrālaṃkārapūrvikām |
pūjitāya daridrāya vṛttisthāyātmavedine |
dharmajñāyātidāntāya mantreṇānena tām kṣayī ||
hiraṇyagarbhapuruṣa parātpara jaganmaya |
rambhādānena deveśa kṣayaṃ kṣapaya me prabho ||
dānamantraḥ |
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ |
śiṣṭair iṣṭair bandhubhiś ca saha bhojanam ācaret ||
atha nyagrodhadānam | tathā |
vraṇāḥ śastreṇa ye ‘pi syur viṣadagdhena saṃyuge |
te ‘pi śuddhāḥ prarohanti yathā proktaṃ tu vāyunā ||
[1036]        suvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmraaṃ kāṃsyam athāpi vā |
paladvayena caikena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ ||
nyagrodhavṛkṣaṃ kurvīta skandhaśākhābhir anvitam |
vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya skandhe skandhe pṛthak pṛthak |
haridrāpuñjake sthāpya brāhmaṇāya niyojayet ||
uttarāśāpate deva kubera naravāhana |
nāḍīvraṇaṃ nāśayāśu nyagrodhasya pradānataḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
athāśvattadānam | vāyupurāṇe |
bhavet sphuṭitapādas tu yo ‘bhihiṃsyād vanaspatīn |
dānena tatpratīkāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoditam ||
palārdhena tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
aśvatthavṛkṣaṃ kurvīta skandhaśākhāsamanvitam ||
māṇikyavajravaidūryaiḥ skandhamadhye svalaṃkṛtam |
vastreṇāveṣṭya sarvatra dhānyasyopari vinyaset ||
ācāryaḥ sarvaśāstrajño dharmaśāstrasuniṣṭhitaḥ |
vedavedāṅgatattvajño yajñakarmaṇi niṣṭhitaḥ |
pūjito vastramālyādyair aśvatthaṃ pūjayec chubham ||
[1037]        aśvatthe vo niṣadanam iti mantreṇa saṃyutaḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir homaṃ kuryād anantaram ||
samidājyatilair mantrair yadauṣadhaya iṣyati |
nimratināmavatībhis tāny eva iti ca tribhiḥ ||
aśvattha iti mantreṇa hunet sviṣṭakṛtaṃ tathā |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā aṣṭāviṃśatim eva vā ||
saṃpātājyena pādau dvau saktau kuryāc ca rogiṇaḥ |
sarpatvak kūrmayuktena niśācūrṇena caiva hi ||
prayātā iti mantraiś ca caturdaśabhir eva ca |
kuryāc ca kalaśiḥ snānaṃ mantrair ebhiḥ samāhitaḥ ||
idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pratad viṣṇur viṣṇor nu kam iti kramāt |
tathā cauṣadhisūktena snātaḥ śuktāmbaraḥ śuciḥ ||
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya vṛkṣaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam |
mantreṇānena bhaktyā tam ācāryāya nivedayet ||
pippalo vṛkṣarāḍ (?) iva hy agnigarbhas tvam eva hi |
prabhur vanaspatīnāṃ ca pūrvajanmani yat kṛtam ||
hiṃsanaṃ yat kṛtaṃ yac ca vairūpyaṃ pādayor mama |
nāśayāśu ca me kṣipraṃ tvaṃ dānenātitoṣitaḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
aśvattham evaṃ datvā taṃ praṇipatya visarjayet |
punaḥ snātvā tu bhuñjīta brāhmaṇair bandhubhiḥ saha ||
athāha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
[1038]        vṛkṣacchettā vṛthā yas tu sa nāḍīvraṇavān bhavet |
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ sarvalokahitāya tu ||
sauvarṇaṃ kārayed vṛkṣam aśvatthaṃ skandhaśobhitam |
palārthena tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
kuryād rūpyamayaṃ sūtraṃ tena taṃ pariveṣṭayet ||
taṇḍulopari saṃsthāpya pūjayed upacārataḥ |
aśvatthe vo niṣadanam iti mantreṇa coditaḥ ||
ācāryo dharmaśāstrajño vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
purāṇajñas tathā śāntaḥ yajñavidyāsuniṣṭhitaḥ ||
tenaiva kārayet pūjām āhūya svayam eva hi |
homaṃ cāpi prakurvīta samidājyatilair api |
agneḥ saṃsthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ mantrādhyāyoktamārgataḥ ||
yad ahaṃ vājayann eṣa samiddhome prakīrtitaḥ |
ājye nāṣṭādiko grāhyo vyāhṛtibhis tilāhutīḥ ||
īśānadeśe kalaśasthāpanaṃ śāstrato bhavet |
tenābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta āpohiṣṭhādimantrakaiḥ ||
grahaśāntiś ca kartavyā brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ |
tato nāḍīvraṇī snātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ||
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukhāya ācāryāya nivedayet |
mantreṇānena vidhivat pūjitāyāṅgulīyakaiḥ ||
vanaspatīnāṃ pravaro viṣṇurūpo ‘tipūjitaḥ |
tasya pradakṣiṇaṃ sarve namasyaḥ sarvadehinām ||
sarvakāmārthavṛddho sa prīto bhavatu dānataḥ |
[1039]        vṛthāvṛkṣachedanena nāḍīvraṇaṃ tad ātmanaḥ |
sarvaṃ vināśaya kṣipraṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ pravaro hy asi ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ datvā tu tad dānaṃ sukhī nāḍīvraṇī bhavet |
anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaś ca dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
namaskṛtya tathācāryaṃ śanaiḥ śatapadaṃ vrajet ||
tataḥ snātvātihṛṣṭaś ca brāhmaṇān api bhojayet |
śiṣṭair iṣṭair bandhubhiś ca svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
athāmratarudānam | āha vṛddhagautamaḥ |
vidrudhiḥ phalahaartā syān manuṣyo brāhmaṇasya tu |
vakṣyāmi tatpratīkāraṃ dānahomādibhiḥ punaḥ ||
palārdhena tadardhena tadardhenātha vā punaḥ |
yathāvibhavavato vāpi kuryād āmrataruṃ śubham ||
snigdhaṃ tathaiva śākhābhiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvṛtaṃ śubham |
śvetavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya phalair api sukalpitam ||
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya taṇḍulopari veṣṭitam |
taṇḍulānāṃ parīmāṇaṃ droṇānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam ||
tadardham atha vā grāhyaṃ tathā vibhavato naraiḥ |
ācāryo ‘tha vinītas tu sarvaśāstrārthatattvavit ||
[1040]        dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca kulīno lokasaṃmataḥ |
āhūya parayā bhaktyā tena pūjādi kārayet ||
vanaspater aśanāyety etayā pūjanādikam |
āgneyyāṃ diśi homaś ca samidājyatilair bhavet ||
mantrāś ca śāstrato dṛṣṭā jātāvāvatum ity api |
tilahomo vyāhṛtibhir aṣṭottarasahasrakam ||
yad ahaṃ vāyumantreṇa ājyahomaḥ praśasyate |
grahaśāntiś ca kartavyā svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ ||
hutvā hutvā ca saṃpātān pātre ‘nyasmin nidhāpayet |
tena vidrudirogaṃ me samyaag ājyapradānataḥ ||
agner uttarato bhāge kalaśasthāpanaṃ bhavet |
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya abhiṣekaṃ ca kārayet ||
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ |
sauvarṇam āmravṛkṣaṃ taṃ pradadyāt prāṅmukhāya tu ||
gandhavastraiḥ pūjitāya rogī svayam udaṅmukhaḥ |
āmratvaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ sarvaprāṇihitāya tu ||
vṛkṣāṇām ādibhūtas tvaṃ devānāāṃ prītivardhanaḥ ||
phalacauryeṇa yat prāptaṃ vairūpyaṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ |
sauvarṇavṛkṣadānena tuṣṭā sarvāś ca devatāḥ ||
vidradhīnāṃ śarīrosthaṃ bāhyam abhyantaraṃ tathā |
vināśayantu sakalaṃ svāsthyaṃ kurvantu me sadā ||
[1041]        evaṃ datvā tu tad dānam ācāryāyātibhaktitaḥ |
śanaiḥ śatapadaṃ gatvā praṇipatya visarjayet ||
anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaś ca dadyāt śaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitātha svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ \\
iti vṛkṣadānavidhiḥ |
nandipurāṇe |
krīḍārāmaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād udyānaṃ puṣpasaṃkulam |
toyāśramasamāyuktaṃ guptaṃ phalasamṛddhimat |
sa gacchec chaṅkarapuraṃ vāmas tatra yugatrayam ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
puṣkara uvāca |
uttareṇa śubhaḥ plakṣo vaṭaḥ prāg bhārgavottama |
udumbaraś ca yāmyena saumyenāśvattha eva ca ||
ete karmaṇi neṣyante dakṣiṇādiksamudbhavāḥ |
samīpajātāś ca tathā varjyāḥ kaṇṭakino drumāḥ ||
vāmabhāge tathodyānaṃ kuryād vāmagṛhāc chubham |
vāyavye prākkilāṃs tatra mṛdvīkāntāṃś ca puṣpitān ||
tatas tu ropayed vṛkṣān prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ |
snāto drumam athābhyarcya brāhmaṇāṃś ca śivaṃ tathā ||
dhruvāni pañca vāyavyaṃ hastaṃ puṣyaṃ savaiṣṇāvam |
[1042]        nakṣatrāṇi tathā mūlaṃ śasyante drumaropaṇe ||
udyānam ajalaṃ rāma nābhirāmaṃ yadā tadā |
praveśayen nadīvāhān puṣkariṇyaś ca kārayet ||
saṃskāryam udbhidaṃ toyaṃ kūpāḥ kāryāḥ prayatnataḥ |
hastomaghā tathā maitram āpyaṃ puṣyaṃ savāsavam ||
uttarātritayaṃ rāma tathā pūrvā saphālgunī |
jalāśayasamārambhe praśastaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā ||
saṃpūjya varuṇaṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ parjanyam eva ca |
kalpayitvā pravakṣyāmi praśastān pādapān dvija |
ariṣṭāśokapunnāgaśirīṣāḥ sapriyaṅgavaḥ ||
panasāśokakadalījambūlakucadāḍimāḥ |
maṅgalyāḥ pūrvato rāma ropaṇīyā gṛheṣu vā ||
kṛtvā bahutvam eteṣāṃ ropyāḥ sarve vanāntaram |
śālmaliṃ kovidāraṃ ca varjayitvā vibhītakam ||
damanaṃ devadāruṃ ca palāśaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā |
na vivarjyas tathā kaścid devodyāne vijānatā ||
tatrāpi bahulā kāryā maṅgalyānāṃ dvijottama |
sāyaṃ prātaś ca dharmānte śītakāle dināntare ||
varṣākāle bhuvaḥ śoṣe sektavyā ropitā drumāḥ |
uttamaṃ viṃśatir hastā madhyamā ṣoḍaśāntaram ||
sthānāt sthānāntaraṃ kāryaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ dvādaśāntaram |
abhyāsajātās taravaḥ saṃspṛśantaḥ paraparam |
[1043]        avyaktamiśraśukṣamatvād bhavanti saphalā dvija ||
teṣāṃ vyādhisamutpattau śṛṇu rāma cikitsitam |
ādau saṃśodhanaṃ teṣāṃ kiṃcic chastreṇa kārayet ||
viḍaṅgaghṛtapaṅkāktāḥ secayec chītavāriṇā |
phalanāśe kulatthaiś ca māṣair dugdhais tilair yavaiḥ |
śṛtaśītapayaḥsekaḥ phalapuṣpāya sarvadā ||
āvikājaśakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ tilāni ca |
gomāṃsam udakaṃ ceti saptarātrān nidhāpayet ||
utsekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidam |
raṅgatoyoṣitaṃ bījaṃ raṅgatoyāc ca secitam ||
tadraṅgapuṣpaṃ bhavati yauvane nātra saṃśayaḥ |
matsyān bhasān tu sekena vṛddhir bhabhati śākhinām |
ataḥ prādhānyato vakṣye drumāṇāṃ dohadāny aham ||
matsyodakena śītena āmrāṇāṃ seka iṣyate |
mṛdvīkānāṃ tathā kāryas tv anena ripusūdana ||
pakvāsidruciraṃ caiva dāḍimānāṃ praśasyate |
tuṣā deyaś ca bhavyānāṃ madyaṃ ca vakuladrume ||
viśeṣāt kāminīvaktrasaṃsargāt tu guṇaṃ ca yat |
praśastaṃ cātha śekānāṃ kāminīpadatāḍanam ||
śṛgālamāṃstoyena nāraṅgotthodakair hitam |
madhuyaṣṭyudakaṃ (?) caiva vadarāṇāṃ praśasyate ||
guḍodakaṃ sagomāṃsaṃ karakāṇāṃ praśasyate |
kṣīrāsavena bhavati saptaparṇo manoharaḥ ||
[1044]        māṃsapluto vasāmajjāsekaḥ kuruvake hitaḥ |
pūtimatsyāhitaṃ pūtikārpāsaphalam eva ca ||
ahimedasya seko ‘yaṃ pāṭakeṣu ca śasyate |
śṛgālamatsyamāṃsābhyāṃ campakeṣu ca dāpayet ||
phale latānāṃ kṣīreṇa rudhireṇa ca śasyate |
kapitthabilvayoḥ sekaṃ guḍatoyena kārayet ||
jātīnāṃ mallikāyāś ca gandhatoyaṃ paraṃ hitam |
tathā kupyatajātīnāṃ kūrmamāṃsaṃ praśasyate ||
kharjūranārikelānāṃ vaṃśasya kadalasya ca |
lavaṇena satoyena seko vṛddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
viḍaṅgataṇḍulopetaṃ matsyamāṃsaṃ narottama |
sarveṣām aviśeṣeṇa dohadaṃ parikalpayet ||
evaṃ kṛte cāruphalāḥ supuṣpāḥ
sugandhino vyādhivivarjitāś ca |
bhavanti nityaṃ taravaḥ suramyāś
cirāyuṣaḥ svāduphalānvitāś ca ||
devīpurāṇe |
anūpe sajale sthāne pumān deve ‘tha vā jale |
ārāmaṃ ropayet prājño vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
anūpe atisnigdhe | sajale jalāśayasahite |
kālaṃ deśaṃ tathā pātraṃ bījaṃ bījakriyāvidhiḥ |
[1045]        tathā phalasamaṃ sraṣṭam (?) evam āropitaṃ bhavet ||
phalapuṣpaviśuddhasya viśuddhaṃ sarvasaṃskṛtam |
dharmakāmārthamokṣādisādhane hanyate ‘nyathā ||
vidhivyatyayabījādibhūṣite bhūparigrahe |
kulādibhiḥ suraśreṣṭha yajamāno vinaśyati ||
pātraṃ bījavāpeyam | ārye cāryabījakriyāvidhiḥ | aṅkurajananasamarthabījakaraṇaprakāraḥ | vidhivyatyayo vidher anyathākaraṇam |
ārāmaṃ sahakārāder na śuddhaṃ kārayet kvacit |
citājvalanasaṃlagne citivalmīkadūṣite |
sahakāravanaṃ kṛtvā yāti kartā yamālayam ||
gṛhāt puro ‘tha vā tāta sthite saṃropite tathā |
pratipakṣaṃ bhavet tatra chindyād vā hitam icchatā ||
aśvatthavaṭaplakṣādi audumbaryo vidiksthitāḥ |
jagato bhayadā yasmāt tasmāt tān chedayen mane ||
ropayed bilvavīrāmrakapitthakapilārjunān |
dāḍimī bījapūraṃ ca udagāghādrumāt pare ||
plakṣāḥ prācyāṃ sadā ropyāḥ sakāsanasadhanvanāḥ |
kadambo vāyave tālo bilvāśokau ca sarvagau ||
vīraḥ bhallātakavṛkṣaḥ | kapilā śiṃśapā | asanaḥ vījakaḥ, vāyavye vāyudigbhāge |
[1046]        mayandī mādhavī rambhā krīḍāsthāne niveśayet |
jātinepālikākundatagarāgandhamallikā |
śubhāya kathitās tāta vyatyayād bhayadā yataḥ ||
pūrveṇa susamārāmaṃ tathā cottarato ‘tha vā |
paścime dhanadaṃ proktaṃ vāyavyāṃ kīrtivardhanam ||
na kuryur yāmyanair ṛtye ye cāgneye śubhārthinaḥ |
anyathā kaladodvegaṃ mṛtyuṃ vā labhate kṛtī ||
tasmād rājyāyuḥśubhadaṃ putrasantativardhanam |
paścimottarapūrveṇa ārāmaṃ jāyate kṛtam ||
atha vārāmajān doṣān cāmuṇḍā śāmayet kṛtān |
mahābhayaṃ mahālakṣmīr grahakṛtyaṃ yathotthitam ||
grahakṛtyaṃ grahapīḍā |
puṣpapatraphalānāṃ ca bījareṇusamāḥ samāḥ |
kartā devasabhāvāsaṃ vidhau yāty avidhau vadhaḥ ||
tathā |
evaṃ yathoditāṃ bhūmiṃ śuddhāṃ plavasamāhitām |
parigṛhya yathādevaṃ vanamālaṃ śikhidhvajam ||
sāmaṃ ca nāgarājaṃ ca tataḥ kuryāt parigraham |
yad bījaṃ mantrarahitaṃ garbhādhānādivarjitam ||
vāsitaṃ sahakārādi yaad bījaṃ mantravarjitam |
tajjātaṃ vāpakārāya tathā jāyena vaikṛtam ||
śaṅkarāyeti mantreṇa itthaṃ nu pañcamantravit |
[1047]        tryambakena tu rājendra bījaṃ bhavati śobhanam ||
avidhau kūpavāpyādikhananotsaraṇaṃ ca yat |
kurvanti sahakārādiropaṇaṃ tu narādhamāḥ |
phalaṃ teṣāṃ labhet teṣām iha cānte adhogtiḥ ||
ye ‘śuddhāḥ śuddhavidhinā kurvanti vanaropaṇam |
te ātmanṛpalokānāṃ mahāsaṃśayakārakāḥ ||
kūpārāmataḍāgādiprapāvāpīpratiśrayam |
sarveśādhiṣṭhitaṃ vatsa hy anantaphaladāyakam |
vṛkṣān pañca samāropya śivadhāma prapadyate ||
yea ca pāpā durācārāḥ śrītarucchedakāriṇaḥ |
te ‘tha pācyādinarake pacyante brahmaṇo dinam |
mṛtās te jīvamānās tu brahmaghnāḥ kīrtitā bhuvi ||
tasmin deśe bhayaṃ nityaṃ rājāno na cirāyuṣaḥ |
na ca nandaty ayaṃ loko yatra śrīvṛkṣacchedanam ||
ity ārāmaropaṇam |
atha vṛkṣapratiṣṭhā | matsyapurāṇe |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
pādapānāṃ vidhis tatra yathāvad vistarād vada |
vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ pādapodyāpanaṃ budhaiḥ |
ye ca lokāḥ smṛtās teṣāṃ vā nidānaṃ vadasva naḥ ||
[1048]                sūta uvāca |
pādapānāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye tathaivodyānabhūmiṣu |
taḍāgavidhivat sarvam āsādya jagatīśvara ||
ṛtvigmaṇḍapasaṃbhāram ācāryaś cāpi tādṛśaḥ |
pūjayed brāhmaṇāṃs tadvad dhemavastrānulepanaiḥ ||
sarvauṣadhyudakaiḥ siktān piṣṭhālaktavibhūṣitān |
vṛkṣān mālyair alaṃkṛtya vāsābhir abhiveṣṭayet ||
sūcyā sauvarṇayā kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ karṇavedhanam |
añjanaṃ cāpi dātavyaṃ tadvad dhemaśalākayā |
phalāni sapta cāṣṭau vā kāladhautāni kārayet ||
kāladhautāni rūpyamayāni |
pratyekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ vedyāntān adhivāsayet |
dhūpo ‘tra guggulaḥ śreṣṭhas tāmrapātrair adhiṣṭhitān ||
sarvadhānyakṛtān kṛtvā vastragandhānulepanaiḥ |
kumbhān sarveṣu sarveṣu sthāpayitvā nareśvara ||
sahiraṇyān aśeṣāṃs tān kṛtvā balinivedanam |
yathāval lokapālānām indrādīnāṃ vidhānataḥ ||
vanaspateś ca vidvadbhir homaḥ kāryo dvijātibhiḥ ||
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharāṃ sauvarṇakṛtabhūṣaṇām |
sakāṃsyadohāṃ sauvarṇaśṛṅgābhyām atiśālinīm |
payasvanīṃ vṛkṣamadhyād utsṛjed (?) gām udaṅmukhīm ||
tato ‘bhiṣekamantreṇa vādyamaṅgalagītakaiḥ |
[1049]        ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiś ca vāruṇair abhitas tadā ||
tair eva kumbhaiḥ snapanaṃ kuryur brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ |
snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharo yajamānaḥ prapūjayet ||
gobhir vibhavataḥ sarvān ṛtvijaḥ sasamāhitaḥ |
hemasūtraiḥ sakaṭakair aṅgulīyaiḥ pavitrakaiḥ |
vāsobhiḥ śabalaiś caiva tathopaskarapādukaiḥ ||
kṣīrābhiṣecanaṃ dadyur yāvad dinacatuṣṭatam |
homaś ca sarpiṣā kāryo yavakṛṣṇatilais tathā ||
palāśasamidhaḥ śastāś caturthe ‘hni tathotsavaḥ |
dakṣiṇā ca punas tadvad deyā tatrāpi śaktitaḥ ||
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcit tat tad dadyād amatsaraḥ |
ācārye dviguṇaṃ datvā praṇipatya vasarjayet ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryād vṛkṣotasavaṃ budhaḥ ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti padaṃ cānantyam aśnute ||
yaś caikam api rājendra vṛkṣaṃ saṃsthāpayen naraḥ |
so ‘pi svarge vased rājan yāvad indrāyutatrayam ||
bhūtān bhavyāṃś ca manujāṃs tārayed rāgasaṃmitaḥ |
paramāṃ siddhim āpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabhāṃ ||
iti vṛkṣapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ |
atha taruputradānavidhiḥ | matsyapurāṇe |
[1050]        daśakūpasamā vāpī daśavāpīsamo drumaḥ |
daśadrumasamaḥ putro daśaputrasamo drumaḥ ||
nandipurāṇe |
taruputraṃ tu yaḥ kuryād vidhivad vahnisaṃnidhau |
sa mahāpātakair muktaḥ samuddhṛtya kulatrayam |
narakebhyo naro yāti prajāpatipuraṃ śubham ||
skandapurāṇe |
ity evaṃ rudramahiṣī bhūmiruhasutas tava |
śrutvā patiṃ trilokeśam idam āha pativratā ||
bhagavan kena vidhinā vidhīnāṃ sārasāgara |
putrapratikṛtir vṛkṣaḥ kriyate candrabhūṣaṇa ||
salīlām iti sarvajñaḥ pṛcchantīṃ vidhim uttamam |
mahādevo mahādevīm idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
devi nāgendranāsoru nāgendragatigāmini |
śṛṇuṣva yena vidhinā gṛhyate ‘vanijaḥ sutaḥ ||
avanijo vṛkṣaḥ |
svaputrārthaṃ bhūmiruhaṃ grahīṣyāmīti pārvatī |
sopavāsā bhaven nārī śucivastrā śucivratā ||
tataś caiva sahasrāṃśāv astaśṛṅgagate ravau |
udite vimale cāpi tathādāv indusaṃnibhe ||
viprān āmantrayed rātrau pāvanān vedavādinaḥ |
[1051]        viprān nimantrayitvā tu śucivastrā śucivratā ||
śayīta sanamaskārā sadarbhāṃ bhūmim āśritā |
gamayitvā tathā rātriṃ savitary udite ‘pi ca ||
bhakṣyabhojyaṃ samādāya vrajed yatra bhavet taruḥ |
tatas taṃ snapayitvā tu sātapatraṃ sabhūṣaṇam ||
taṃ taruṃ taruṇīkṛtya tataś chāyānugāminam |
yajñopapannam annaṃ tān bhojayitvā dvijāṃs tataḥ |
puṇyāhaṃ kārayitvā tu ṛtvijā cātha vātmanā ||
tṛptānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai caitat te kṛtyam ātmanaḥ |
nivedya kṛtam uddiśya sadbhāvena pareṇa tu ||
aputrā bhavanto ‘haṃ putrapratikṛtiṃ tarum |
grahīṣyāmi mamānujñāṃ kartum arhatha sattamāḥ ||
tatas tair abhyanujñātaṃ taṃ taruṃ taruṇākṛtim |
bhūmidevasamakṣaṃ vai gṛhṇīyāt tanayaṃ priye ||
bhūmidevasamakṣaṃ brāhmaṇāgrataḥ |
anena vidhinā yas tu gṛhītataruputrakaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ nirayasthānāṃ madhudhārāṃ sa varṣati ||
gṛhīto vidhinānena śubhabhūmiruhātmajaḥ |
śubhe sukhāya bhavati viparītena duḥkhadaḥ ||
na putrāṇāṃ śataṃ vāpi pīnaśroṇipayodhare |
eko bhūmiruhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ putratve kalpitaḥ sutaḥ ||
ity evaṃ tan mayā pṛṣṭam iṣṭaṃ drṣṭāntapāriṇi |
yathā bhūmiruhaḥ putro viśiṣṭaḥ koṣṭhajaiḥ sutaiḥ ||
[1052]        tataḥ śokāpahā devī tam aśokaṃ vibhāvinī |
alaṃ cakāra saṃhṛṣṭā hy alaṃkāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
ātapatraṃ ca tasyāgre muktābhavanabhāskaram ||
ucchayāmāsa girijā mayūrāṅgaruhaiḥ saha |
nānāvarṇena cāpy asya candanena sugandhinā ||
ā mūlāt pradadau devī karapaṅkān itas tataḥ |
jāmbūnadamayaiś cāpi padai ratnavirājitaiḥ ||
sarvato bhūṣayāmāsa tam aśokataruṃ priyam |
tasya śākhāpraśākāsu muktādāmāni pārvatī ||
ābabandha satair bhāti nakṣatrair iva bhāskaraḥ |
tathā vāsoyugenāpi tam aśokaṃ guhāraṇī ||
vāsayāmāsa lokānāṃ jananī putralālasā |
tato nameruṇā cāru guggulaṃ ghṛtam eva ca ||
samavāyayutaṃ dhūpaṃ cāmaraṃ dhūpanārcitam |
tataḥ śaṅkhaninādena devatūryaraveṇa ca ||
nandinātha samānītā brāhmaṇā brahmaṇaḥ samāḥ |
vācayāmāsa puṇyāhaṃ datvā gāḥ svarṇam eva ca ||
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣānte āśīrvādasya cobhayoḥ |
anumānya patiṃ devīṃ mṛṣīṃś cāprīṇayaṃs tadā ||
brahmavaivarte |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vṛkṣasyodyāpane vidhim |
[1053]        sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam ||
aputrayā purā pārtha pārvatyā mandarācale |
aśokaḥ śokaśamanaḥ putratve parikalpitaḥ ||
jātakarmādikās tasya yāḥ kriyāḥ kulabuddhimān |
cakārātripurāṇoktāḥ śṛṇuṣvaiva yudhiṣṭhira ||
sa tu bālo ghanadalas tathaiva mṛdupallavaḥ |
śītavātātapasahaḥ saṃskāryas taruṇataruḥ ||
strīnāmā kaṇṭakī kuñjaḥ kīṭakhātasakoṭaraḥ |
nodvāpyaḥ pādapaḥ sarvaḥ śiṣṭānāṃ yo na saṃmataḥ ||
ālavāle suvihite śubhe vārdhacatuṣkakī |
śodhayitvā tam uddeśaṃ suliptaṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
tataś codyāpanaṃ pārtha pādapānāṃ praśasyate |
śubhe ‘hni viprakathite grahaṇakṣatrasaṃyuge ||
patālaṃ kṛtaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pūrvedyur adhivāsayet |
raktavastraiḥ samāsādya raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayet ||
**ṣṭādyaiḥ snāpitaṃ svarṇasarvauṣadhyā ca pādapam |
sthāpayet pūrvakalaśāṃś caturdikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
pallavālaṃkṛtamukhān sitacandanacarcitān |
sitavastrayugachatrān samālyān ratnagarbhiṇaḥ ||
paatākālaṃkṛtāḥ sarve kāryās tatsaṃnidhau drumāḥ |
mūlavinyastakalaśā raktasūtraiś ca veṣṭitāḥ ||
raktapītasitachedacarcitāḥ sumanoramāḥ |
kaladhautamayān yatra phalāni daśa pañca ca ||
[1054]        tāmrapātrasabījāni saratnāny adhivāsayet |
tūryamaṅgalaghoṣeṇa caturdiṣu kṣiped balīn ||
indrādilokapālānāṃ tanmantrair mantravid guruḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā samekhalam |
grahayajñavidhānena sarvaṃ karma samācaret ||
suvarṇālaṃkṛtān kṛtvā brāhmaṇān vedapāragān |
caturo ‘ṣṭau yathāśaktyā vaśobhir abhipūjayet ||
tilājyena ca homaḥ syāt tuṣṭipuṣṭikaraḥ sadā |
mātaraḥ sthāpayitvāgre pūjayet kusumākṣataiḥ ||
śrapayitvā caruṃ samyak payasā ca pariplutaiḥ |
homayec jātakarmādi godānaṃ yāvad eva tu ||
pādapaṃ snapayitvā tu samantrais tīrthavāribhiḥ |
jātakaṃ nāmakaraṇam annaprāśānam eva ca |
suvarṇasūcyā kurvīta karṇavedhaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
jātarūpakṣureṇātha cūḍākarma yathākramam |
badhnīyān mekhalāṃ mauñjīṃ vāsaś ca paridhāpayet ||
kṛtvā vai tad aśeṣeṇa kuryād godānamaṅgalam |
vivāhaṃ kecid icchanti mādhavīlatayā taroḥ ||
mālatyā saha śallakyā jambūṃ vā śāḷmaliṃ viduḥ |
saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtasyaiva pādapasya tathārthavat |
eṣā pratiṣṭhā nāmeti mantreṇāśīḥ prayojayet ||
yajamānas tataḥ snātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ |
puṣpāñjaliṃ samādāya mantram etam udīrayet ||
[1055]        ye śākhinaḥ śikhariṇāṃ śirasāṃ vibhūṣā
ye nandanādiṣu vaneṣu kṛtapratiṣṭḥāḥ |
ye kāmadāḥ suranaroragakinnarāṇāṃ
te ‘nena tasya duritārtiharā bhavantu ||
ete dvijā vidhivad atra hutā hutāśāḥ
paśyaty asāv api himadīdhitir antarasthaḥ |
tvaṃ vṛkṣa putraparikalpanayā dhṛto ‘si
kāryaṃ sadaiva bhavatā mama putrakāryam ||
ity evam uktvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ sparśayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
ghṛtapātre svavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvāśīḥ saṃprayojayet ||
aṅgā aṅgāt saṃbhavasi hṛdayād adhijāyase |
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ tato deyā dakṣiṇā hṛṣṭamānasaiḥ |
sthāpakāya śubhāṃ dhenuṃ datvā kuryān mahotsavam ||
dīnānāthajanānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cānivāritam |
itareṣāṃ tu dātavyaṃ saṃtuṣṭena surāsavam ||
jñātibandhajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ |
tathā karmakarāḥ sarve bhojanīyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ ||
etat te kathitaṃ pārtha vṛkṣāṇāṃ sumahotsavam |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti iha loke paratra ca ||
putrair vinā śubhaphalaṃ na bhaven narāṇāṃ
duṣputrakair api tathobhayalokanāśaḥ |
etad vicārya sudhiyā paripālya vṛkṣān
[1056]                yatnena vedavidhinā parikalpanīyāḥ ||
iti taruputravidhiḥ |
paryavasitaṃ ca dānaṃ karaṇādhipo vijayate hemādriḥ |
āvārinidhikṣauṇīmaṇḍalamaṇḍalitasvayaśorāśiḥ ||
cintāmaṇau mahāśāstre tena hemādriṇā kṛte |
dānakhaṇḍāvakhaṇḍaṃ ca jagāma paripūrṇatām ||
yeṣām agaṇyatvam avekṣya ko ‘pi
mānyo munibhyaḥ prabhūtām upaiti |
dānāni tāny ācarituṃ prabandho
hemādidevasya jagāma pāram ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-
vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
dānakhaṇḍaṃ saṃpūrṇam
[1] This is reproduced from KKT, Dāna, 2.35–45.
